tei:div.tei:p: tsho 9 zi tshodzo— nelke tsho 3ci 3zichiri+o 3 rdzi r+sha sne zhe7 chi tsho dzā sne cho kru rteji ——mi+oshā 5 ’5 ṅka4 lter+shasto ci 4 ri zherihodz+ra rdzo dze ci chiju ji 1 sto dzorte rme snye ne rke dzi snye zhe smi ngashā — twotwoṭ+wāṃmi —byu ji tsā — / ྾ sto pa rdzirme ri choci tshosto —ni byu — ‘stani — te rngo 9 ne rdzo wa dzo mo — d+ngha dzi — —d+nghane ngo — 5rte ṭ+wāṃ — sdutrīca june snarmiri rdzu 7 d+ngha kā pimirketsārmerī — ji tsho yo rdzartse 4rdzo3 rdo tsho d+ku snye — ji ri 44 d+ku ༄ — skodzi ske sa gyu ske3 mi tre nga ri —— rte ci 4 driri spre — rtso snye1 lhasnaṭ+wāṃrdukā+om+mu / drogri ci ri rdze 7po —ne sne rdzo— tsā4 snye—jiṣe r+ṣamo rdosdurme slosdu lhad+ngha spro mi dzo —snyeske ne+e ske — lā chi

snye+o/ / rje dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo'i gsung 'bum pod dang bo bzhugs so//0 yo4r+shaci rkocho rici/ ska khru ritrīci trī rdo to ——4 sdi3l+līdz+nyo྾༵྾ mtsho sngon mi rigs da྾ khang /

trīdzātshajuri snyeshā stabye /ji stu — ñca chisprer+ṣa sku3smo ‘3byā( zhi trīrī cholidurdo ༄9byedro rkañcaskrebye ṇa d+ku trī ske ‘skye da ) sku4dzemu ge4 tho tsho sgyu sga tsātsho preṣ+ṭha༄ chi zi dz+wa ri ri bam̐ ne sgo rdzi 〉rdozlo3 ༷shas—ṅge/tresna 0gesgyu — swābyewa rku twerīdzi spya ḍa ༄ tsho rte—— d+kurdzi⑫ 5 r+yā ne 4ne+eṣi ji ༷ga — thu mi chitshode ji /waṣe sna ci rte rke—༷tret+t+waṃ phro rko washane 5 she ji ri lkerdzirme ༷ṭ+wāṃ ne+er+sha sdu phro gro— r+ṣa sh+launyi ༷skre)༷k+ṣiṃbyephro+o/stamo.oṃX 7 rdzo sdisnag dzi si ji ne+e shāt+yālhithadikrotūzhe skalha〉 2ོciṭ+wāṃtsubye~Xnetrīri( radī deride ṭ+wā r+shashwe(sgyu tho shāge 6ṅkawa4kyispyo/ske 3 sku r+yārī sh+laushā 7ngolho stosko tsho ( ho 7 rid+kurte paṃ/ — spyotre 4 7 〉rda 7rno trerdodzāsnyo ri risnga ༵༷ 4tswa ju nyi nyu+o lja sgordzodū7skyo snyosnyo caskowasnyesbyi tre tshe ṭ+wāṃkhriXsmilo thonyur+yāsdo thā trī'i/༷4d+kuphyo —sgostsoXlduri tshoripa ra tre+o༄sh+lau speñcāsgrugyi༄ spyo smre ji tsho ñca rarīlja dz+warke tsho rngo ra r+yā sgo ne+eshāgyisngasle+o4 nar+sā

sgrig pa po'i gtam /slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog ni/deng dus bod mi rigs spyi'i gtsug tu mchod pa'i mkhas dbang chen po zhig red/ khong gis sku tshe gang bor rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la thugs zhen zab bzhes ngos nyams pa sor chud/ ma nyams gong 'phel/ shes rig yar rgyas kyi don du brtse gzigs zol med/ brtson pa lhod med/ gsung dbyangs 'gag med kyis rang nus gang yod phul ba'i bka' drin ni bsam brjod yul las 'das pa zhig red/ lhag par du khong gis nga tshor bzhagapa'i rig gzhung gi shul bzhag rin po che la bltas kyin bltas kyin mis gus mchi ma rab tu 'khrigs/ bsam bzhin bsam bzhin rin thang gzhal du med pa shes/ nga rang tsho mi rigs dpesgrun gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pali ngos nas bshad na/ slob dpon chen mo 'di ba'i phyag rtsom mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig bsgrigs nas par du bskrun na

ni rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod la rin chen rnar bu zhig bsnan pa lta bu'i dge mtshan chen po ldan zhing / lar blo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs la rig pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa zhig mngon par bstabs pa'i phan yon shin tu mi dz+waman pa zhig yod par mthong nas de lugs kyi brtson pa lhur len pa'i 'dun spu drag po snying la bcags khar/ nye lam rje snyed kyi sku sring bde mchog skyid dang khong gi yang tsha grwa btsun bslab gsudza rgya mtsho d+ku zung gis sa thag ring bo'i dka' sdug la ma 'dzems par rje nyidar+ṣa kyi gsung rtsom mtha' dag dre'u khal du longs pa zhig dngos su khur nas rang re'i dpe skrun khang du slebs shing / khyed dpe skrun khang sgortsom sgrig spus tshad legs pas gzhan su dang gang la'ang zhim sprad par khyed cag la gtad pa yin zhes gsung 'bum dpar — skrun gyi dngos shugs dbang cha yod tshad nga tshor phul ba dang / khyad par du nged dpe skrun khang la ma dngul gyi 'khos ka zhan pa mthong nas/ gcen po'i gsung 'bum par du btab naso bod mitshurigs kyi rig gnas la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon— na de las che ba med ces gsungs te gcen rin po che'i brtsams — yon skar gcig kyang med pa'i thog da dung gzhan las zhal tshoslo —'debs dngul sgor khri gnyis tsam bsdus nas gun gsab kyi ཿ

rogs skyor byas pa la nga tsho sems 'gul chen po dang skul ma chen po thebs te/ gzhi nas khong gi gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig sgrig— pa'i 'a ra gzhi dngos bstar byas pa yin/ da cha nga tshos par du ba skrun pa'i gsung 'bum 'di la khyon bsdoms pod drug tu bkar/ pod dang po ni gtso cher rnam thar skor yin/ 'di'i nang du nga tshos de snga sus kyang mjal ma myong ba'i mdo smad bstan pa'i bdag po rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lo rgyus tshomajal thub par ma zad/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi byung ba lo rgyus las mkhas chen dam pa zhig thos sbyang gi stobs ga 'dra zhig la brten nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i tshul la rgyus rmenga' lon cing rang nyid la sbyang stobs che ru bskyed pa'i skul ma thebs nges yin/ pod gnyis pa ni gtso cher gzhung 'grel skor te/ 'di'i nang nas rtsom pa po rang 4nyid nang don rig pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin pa'i ngos nas deng gi 'chad grwa'i gzhung khrid kyi dka' gnad la dmigs nas tshig don gnyis gsal gyi 'grel bshad gnang yod/ pod gsum pa ni gtso —cher lo rgyus skor te/ 'di'i nang du bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas dar tshul gyi— lo rgyus sogs bkod yod pas/nga tshortswalo rgyus 'di dag las rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi 3

thul byung rgyub 'bras mthong thub par ma zad/ mkhas pa —gzhan gyi gsungazun med pa'i legs bshad btso ma'i gser lta bu'ang mi nyung ba zhig zin rgyu yod do/ /pod bzhi ba ni gtso cherawā snyan ngag skar rtsis kyi skor yin/ 'di'i nang du slob dpon 'di bas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bslab bya so so rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing lha bde ba'i lam nas bkral yod pas las dang po ba rnams la nye — — — bar mkho zhing 'jug bde ba'i gnas dam pa zhig tu 'khums so/ /pod lnga ba ni gtso cher sum rtags dag gsum skor yin/ 'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa po'i deng rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs dang lta ba gsar ba/ lag len gyi rin thang ldan zhing nye bar mkho ba'i bshad pa gsar ba shes rtogs —byed thub pa yin/ pod drug pa ni gsung thor bu'i skor te/'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa pos gdul bya'i blo gang la gang —'tsham du sbyar ba'i shes bya sna tshogs/ dri ba dris lan/ chab shog sogs mjal thub la/ gsung tsag tsig la snang chung mi byed par zhib tu bklags na ni bye ma'e gseb nas gser rdo rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' snang skye'ang srid do/ / mdor na/ khong gi gsung 'bum la brjod don zab kyang tshig 'grel gsal ba/ rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i las dang 4

po ba rnams kyi blor 'tsham zhing gi sla ba/ gnas lnga rig pa'i snying bcud 'dus shing 'jug bde ba/ shes ldan rgan pas bklags na blo skyed gsar ba thob pa/ a gsar gzhon nus bklags na mos gus dbang med 'chor ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod chen po zhig yin pas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes dang brtse ba'i grogs su gyur cig gu/ /zhes 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig khang nas/ spyi lo 1996 zla 8tshes3 la phul/ lke r+sha rgya

dkar chag — rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ( 1 〉dang po rnam thar sbyi'i sdom 'god pa/ ( 6 )dang bo ra rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal ba'i sarga/ (10)bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba'i sarga/ ( 30〉tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams sdo(blangs pa'i sarga/ (47)bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad pa'i sarga/ (68)gnyis ba sku tshe 'azhi nyid kyi rnam thar rags rim bar chags su 'god pa/ (82〉sku bltams shing mtshan gyi me tog rgyacesate gong ma'i khri la mnga' gsol ba'i sarga/ (83〉chos grwar zhugs nas thos bsam gsha' ma byas te sgrub pa snying bo byed phyir gnas dben bar gshegs palī sarga/ (94〉

tre gnas dben pa bsten te sgrub pa snying bor mdzad pas zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rgyal srid la dbang 'byor ba'i sarga/ (109)skyabs mgon sku phreng bzhi bañcazhal bzhugs pa'i ring la bka' gsung dang du blangs te mdo sngags dam chos kyi char chen phab nas sangs rgyas bstan po'i srog bzung ba'i sarga/ ( 137〉ris medakyigadulabyasngarabazhinabadudapi'ibagoskalal gnang ba dang / bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i 'bras r+sha rtags lhag pa'i lha'i zhal mthong zhikhu rtogs pa brnyes pa'i sarga/ (169)dam —chos 'chad spel dang mnyam du thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis dgon sde bde 'jags mdzad pa sogs kyi sarga/ (186〉kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa sogs kyi sarga/ (208spregong sa skyabasasamagon mchog sogs snod ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la dbang lung man ngag gi char phab cing phyogs ris med du zhabs kyisajibacags te chos dang zang zing gi char phab pa'i sago/ (217)chos the du mar nabs bskyod de 'gro ba du ma dbugs dbyung zhing paṇa chen sku hrang dag bas kyang zhabs la gtugs shing ཿ tsho

tsho 5na tshun dam tshos gsan pa'i sarga/ dzo242kyibastan don rlabs chen mdzad bzhin pa dang chabs cig paṇa chen mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu shar ri'i rtser drangs te mdzad 'phrin 'od brgya'i sgo phyes pa'i sarga/ (268kyi slar yang sku 'bum phyogs su zhabs kyis bcags te gyi paṇa chen mchog sogs snod ldan rnams lazab rgyas kyi gdams pa mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba sogs kyi sarga/ (327) bar ma chad par mdo sngags dam chos kyi char phab pa dang / 'du khang chen mo'i gtsang khang sogs bskrun pa'i sarga/ 358〉spuzhan phan 'ba' zhig mdzad cing sku mya ngan las 'das — pa'i tshul bstan pa'i sarga/ 3 / zhe — (373〉gsum pa rnam thar sbyi'i don brtsa ba/ (387〉dang bo mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan/ (388〉gnyis pa tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa rtogs pa'i yon tasto brnyes pa'i tshul/ dze — (391)gsum pa gzhan don du dam chos 'chad spel gnang ste bstan pa'i srog bathung ba/ — gre ( 392〉mnug byang / (402)yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun bskal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i dpal 3

bskyed rtes bya ba bzhugs so/ / — ḍa — (405)sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i thun mongeru gi rnam cho par thar ba mdo tsam bshad pa bzhugs so/ / (43pya)— g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar/ (465)dang bo/ g.yu thog gsar rnying gnyis kyi gdung rgyud rim bar 'chad pa/ (465)/ gnyis pa/ g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po'i rnam —thar cung zad brjod pa/ rno474)gsum sa/ g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po/'i rnam thar cung zad brjod pa/ (513〉rtsom pa bo rang gi byung ba brjod pa rang gsal ā dar sha zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (525)mchod par brjod pa sogs/ (525〉sku bltams pa'i skor/ (528)rab blubyung nas dmu dge bkra shes 'khor lo'i dgon du chos grwar zhugs pa'i skor/ (533)bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer sogs gnang ba'i skor/ (539) drung chen mkhan po'i mtshan gsol nas pe cin du phebs pakha dang las byed par zhugs pa'i skor/ — — (570)4

dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon gyi slob dpon du bskos nas der 'chad nyan gnang ba'i skor/ (578〉 ming kyāng gsar 'gyur khang sogs su rgyug las gnang ba'i skor/ (583)zhing chen srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon dang khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon par bskos nas phyag las gnang ba'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che'i skor/ (597〉kha skong dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i skor/ (694〉dbyen blum mchod rten bzhongs pa'i skor/ (707)
hūṃ rīne ci ca 'i byuṅka — chici8 tsho ga ci cho ḍa

kremam nusasprerdzospru ca — — — lhe/ / nga yā kau ma/ lamu phyi l+la stso da n+ta sah+yestse dāce hu 5le' o+oṃlo5laspyozhuphred+kurme0 ri / / ha / ni ///cham4be+emamali dikurirasbur+yalha ma 1ṭ+wā ka ram sbya kormas5/ /snye0snye/snye5spi5/snyelogispyo55/zhe snyo lko0//lizhe// / snyertswar+yār+sha snar+sārnga ṭa smo rashrīsprebha dra su byu 'i ro yi ha ra ci sma/ /ce5( snyo(snyo0 5kho/

ra tsa1ñcidz+nyadzo skepobhe ṣerīsde — tre bhe sta sdethakhyotsu ra mistenyutsāri /ṭ+wāṃt+t+waṃphyoṇ+ḍaṃsidwo/8/rdo/shipye zhwa h+phu gh+ri/ — 3spyothiṭaṃrdzo sgo trī+o—s+dza— r+sha sdesne rdzotswa—rī( rī༄ neh+phu l+lī4‘d+kuX tram̐/skesneṭ+wātshothoky-isnirtelte pyo’྾ rdo+omāṃ (pho sgye (ts+tsha sdu/slit+yātshi ༄ ༄rkodzaphrodzerdze —dze —sderalnge༄༵ rkori rdza 〉ngalhesrosho༅ rtsolko)rdzarnge sgospre/hūṃjuchechurdzordzi sna7po zi+o ༄ rte bherī — zhesirmik+ṣe 3 gdāhu)tshwo/ wa/ /dze myordo4rnyidh+riram̐ 4 shā snye swā༄/ḍa

'jigs med stobs bcu'i rgyal thabs la gnas shing / /'phrin las a glo hi ṇi'i dpung rtsal gyis/ /lnga bdo'i smag chen dgra tshogs rab bcom ste/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho 'dren pa'i mgon des skyongs/ /thugs bskyed rgya mtsho bsrubs las legs 'khrungs sa bcu'i shar ri'i rtser 'phags te/ /gang 'dul sku yi gzugs ba rnyan bye ba chu klung 'bum du rab spros pa/ /bu ram shing ba zhes pa'i mtshan gyi bdud rtsis rgud pa ku na sel ba'i/ /rnam 'dren bzhi ba shākya seṅge 'bral med gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin/ / skeng gi gsang mdzod gser gyi 'khorartsolo sgyur mkhas pa/ /mchog zung 'od srung kunarīdaga' bo dang nye bar 'khor/ /la sogs dgra bcom 'phags tshogs bka' drin ches rtsi ba/ /gser ldan sgeg mos theg 'di ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /ded dpon mkhas pas hūṃ rdzings legs bcas nas/ /bsam 'phel nor bu drangs pas rgud pa bsal/ /'jig rten mig gyur skad gnyis smrardzob yis/ /mdo rgyud rin chen drangs pas rgud pa bsal /3

rgyal kun mkhyen rab da8 ra ser 'od du 'tsher ba'i nyi ma che/ /ngur smrig gar du rtsen pa'i ston mchog slar yang byon pa bzhin:/ rgyal bstan mtha' dag rmang nas/ gsos pas blo bzang rgyal —ba zhes/ /grags pa'i sgra srid pa'i /longs las brgal ba gtsug tu— bsten/ /de yi skras —mchog skye 'gro'i gnyeske dab sgyed mun dgrar gyur pa/ /rgyal tshab dam pa dar ma rin chen mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /la sogs mkhag grub pargyud par bcas pa'i zla bral 'phrin las la/ /—rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros ldan — pa su zhig gus mi 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bamyu/da pa zhes grags mkhas dgu'i gtsug gi rgya na/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gyi 'od brgya 'bar bas rmongs pa'i smag chen bsal / /—thub bstan pad tshal bskyangs pas bde skyid sprang rtsi'i dga' sto na rdzi rgyas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i byed po de la bad ga snying ra ba tu gus/ /de yi skyes rabs sku tshe 'phreng brgyud slob dang ming slob bcas/ — /'chadaci rtsodzhad rtsom pa'i dpal 'bar rgyu skar gangs la 'khu ba— yi/4 /mkhas dab tshogrub pa'iri dpalasmogyis thub bstan thekhigaba'i tshornam par zar/ /ro 'dzin stong du sprul nas bskal brgyar/ ba rdzod kyang zad mthan bral/ —/khyad par che rgu kun gyi gtsug gi nor/ —me༈ 'jigs pa med pa'i 'phrin las 'od rlabs kyis/ /zubagayorton ga dī ༷ ༷ ༷

rgyaX mardo spel ba'i byung bajidag /bdag 'dra phalamibs bsngags brjod yul las 'das/ /'on kyang dad dang snying rje'i bsod nams smin/ /nges 'byung byang sems rlung gis nyer bskul te/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i sgra dbyades shugs 'byung ba'i/ /skyes bu dag gi gsos su 'gyur ro snyam/ /zhing sa gshin po'i sa bon grung po la/ /sbung char dus su babs pas gsos pa ltar/ /dad dang nges 'byung byang sems la gzhol ba'i/ /'ga' zhig rtogs pa'itshugasos sman 'gyur ro snyam/ /nyi gzhon gesar ba'i rtse dga' rgyas pa na/ /'dab brgya ba yi ge sar rgyas pa ltar/ /sngon bsags bsod nams bgagachags brtas pa 'gas/ /dad pa'i spu long g.yo bar 'gyur ba srid/ /de'i phyir tshul 'dir lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /'bad pa'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba la/ /re ba'i kun rtog rlung gis rgyud bskul te/ /rnam thar rtsom pa'i bya ba mu /khu1gabasgyu soṣi / lke dethodzi' dir mkhas dgu'i gtsug gi nor bu mdo sngags grub mtha' rgya 343'i pha rol tu phyin nas zab rgyas kyi gdams pa thugs nyams sub storangabs grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por slebs de r+sha mo snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i srogaga'adzin pa'i gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po mtshan 5

berjod mer dka' ri b.ron gyi slad du mtshan nasre smras na/ gyi blo go rdo rje 'chong jinas yongs sgye grags pa rje btsun 'jigaso be+ed 'brin laso rgya mtsho'i rnam par thar ba rang gi blos dpag tshod tsam zhig rtsom khul byede pa la/ ne rname thor sbyi'i sdom 'a god sgyupa dang / spyo tshe 'di /—stid kyi rname thar ra—gas rim thar chags su tshwagod pa/ rnam rīthare spyi'i don bsdu gagasudzom/ — zi — dad sdo rnan ldan zhi sga zha da sko/ tsho ci ri ḍa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blobazang 'phrin las lhun zhe ཿ —snye yogyi rgyalamatshastod—pal— bzang bo 'i zhal nas/ gang gab gdu(la /bya'i mos pa dngo 'tsham par/ /gsang ba gsum gyi mdza da bathong bkod pa 'bum/ cho /bzhed pa ji bzhin 'chang ba'i ngo ma—tshar 'ad+nghaphrul/ /mkha' khyab zhing du rol ba bsam las2das/ /zhesauspusungs pa ltar/ dpag medagadod na sa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skye'i ngo boradzi rgyas madzhathag mdzad pa gang gis 'dul pya rdzo 4rī dezhegos migadulabya rnams la gangamu'atshwa gyi sku'i bkohwab dpasna 6 ṣ+ka med krose pas tshonam mkhas0nar khyabasgekyi —zhing khams thams cad sku / dalda ṅgephrin las kyis khyab pa yin mod/— rnamadzā'adren thāzhi3ba 6

shāspya seṅge'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin hūṃ che spel ba'i slad du 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can gyi ljongs su sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i 'khrungs rabs 'ga' zhig rje btsun bskal bzang thub bstan dbang rgyug sogs ye shes kyi spyan ldan dag gis bka' lung 'khrul med las byung ba ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du rten 'byung gsal mdzad 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyu ga chen po lca i pa/ mkhas mchog yon tanyan 'od sogs paṇa grub du ma'i skye ba bzhes pa dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir grub dbang lho brag mar ba/ mnyam med po to ba/ rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ dngos kyi sku gong ma mkhas pa'i mchog 095 khri 'tham da byangs rgya mtsho sogs kyi skye ba bzhes par gsungs/ gyu de dag las snga ma rnams kyi rnam thar rardorang gi rnam thar du gsal sasku gongornyim dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyi 'jam dbyangs rgya— mama'i rnam thar ni mdo smad chos 'byung las/na 3 lnga bcu ba bla rko'i tsā sar 'jam dbyangs rgya mardzini/ yab blachi ma ཿskyabs dang / yum mkhe' 'gro skyid kyi sras su chu r+pāg lasa'akhrujas/4— ma 'khrungs ripa'i sngon nas yum la bya lag rtse nas dung dkar lanaci gsum gtong chi pha ba'i rmi ltas byung / dang po dus 'a khor rmā tshadza du zhugs/ dka' 7

rams bar du song / 'don bzang ba'i tshad du byed/ tshogs bsags rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btagasablangs/ de nas thos bsam gling mdzod du zhugs/ 'dzin grwa kha dog dkar —dmar du babs/ bsdus grwa/ blo rtags/ gzhung du thal phreng yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin mdzad de phar tshad kyis mtshon bka' pod lnga d+ku la gshis phyin par3sbyangs/ 'grel chung don gsal/ mdzod rtsa/ zhe grub mtha' rtsa ba gsum thugs la bzung ste dus phyis bar rgyun tu skyor/ sde khridze rin po che la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ so bdun pa la chab ltag ma gnang / phyi lor rdo rams par bzhag lo gsul gyi ring chos grwa chag med kyis dpe gzigs dang / bsod grags pa'i 'dul ba'i rgyugs phul/ chu yos dpyid dam bcan bzhag lo de'i dgun grwa tshang dge thāskos mdzad/ shing sbrul nas ka mdo dang / kho tshe'i khrir lo rer bzhulas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa lo bzhi dang / rgyud pa dang tsha gan pe shing gi khrir lo gnyis re/slar yang rgyud khrir lo gcig uge dang dmu dge'i khri lo gsum re/ drug cu chu khyir tshogs chen du khri 'don mdzad/ chu phag la rigs grwa btang bstun dargongs khrol gyis mtshan sgrogs dgon gyi khrir bsko bzhag gnang / sngar zhig mtshan lam du bya lag rtse nas gdugs mang po babs pa nyid nas bzung bas gdugs bsto ’ 8

gsum byung ba chos sde du ma'i khri byed rgyu byung bas de'i ltas yin 'dra zhes nyid nas gsungs shing / lano cig bya lag rtse nas gzan gshog pa byas te 'phur ba tshogs chen 'du khang glo sgo la 'thogs nas sar bab pa'i mtshan lam kyang byung snang / re gsum pa shing glang la mtshan sgrogs dgon nas gshegs pa'i gdung rus la yi ge byung bar grag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang khrir phebs skabs kun tu dbang bka' ci rigs kyis skal ldan rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod paradzo nges te—/ khe tshang sgom chen sprul sku 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub rgya mtshos rang rnam las/bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabasasalnga bcu ba rje 'jam dbyangasaho rgya mtsho dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgogagyi khrir phebs skabs 4 khong gi zhal snga las 'angom dbyangs dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' du ma thob ste rta mgrin gyi bsnyen mtshams la bsdodaridzis dam sri 'ag 'a zhig gi sked pa bcad par gsungs sgro tre //// — rngo sku tshe 'di nyid kyi rnam thar spyi'i sdom ni/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal nas/ dang por rgya chen thos pa mang dutrebatsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched 9

du bsngos/ /zhes dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhal nas/mang du gsan pas rmongs pa'i dgra las rgyal/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pas rtogs pa'i btsan sa zin/ /rnam dpyod dpung bas bstan pa'i ru mtshon bsgrongs/ /'di dag ngo mtshar gtam gyi sa bon yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang po grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyis mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la thos pa rgya chen po mang du btsal ba dang /rme bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar te 'khor ba spyi dngachi bye brag las thugs byung zhing sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig ba la snying brtse ba lta bu'i brtse ba snying rje pos kun nas bslangs te byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs te nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba dang thog mtha' bar gsum gyi dge tshogs kun spyang bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos te chos kyi 'khor lo basmor cing / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas kyang bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad pa ste bzhir 'du ba yin ces/ri/ dang bor rgya chen thos ba mang du btsal ba'i sarga/ dardo bo thos pa rgya chen po btsal ba ni/ gzhon nu'i dus 10

nas sngon spyangs bag chags sad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar thun mong snang tshod la'ang sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags sad de shes brtson me ltar 'bar bas thos pa rgya chen po btsal tshul ni/ khong stag ge tshang gi mdun nas klog slob pa sogs tshegs med du mkhyen te/lo ga cig gi ring la bla rnam dang / smon lam lnga/ rgyan 'jug 'jigs byed gnyis sogs tshogs 'don chos spyod tshang ma thugs su chud/ de nas gling pad ma'i bla sar zhes pa rdo rams pa 'phrin las rgya mtshu dge rgan du bsten nas dpe gzigs dang dpe khrid ma chad par zhus te tshogs su zhugs nas bsdus grwa yongs rdzogs tshogs rgyugs la phul/ a ru hor chen tshe 'phel zhes pa'i dge bshes la 'gag ring thung gi dam bca'i skabs thog mar spyo bzhengs nas sangs rgyas 'phags pa rtsod gzhir bzung ste rnam mkhyen mi rtag par rtogs pa'i blo dang gang zag gang yin dris pas khas len 'dzin dka' ba byung / de rjes 'grel ba don gsal dang / grub mtha' rtsa ba thugs 'dzin gnang nas tshogs rgyugs la phul/ de rjes blo rtags don bdun cu bcas tshogs rgyugs la phul/ tshogs chos 'grim zhing rigs lam mtha' chod pa sbyangs/blo rigs kyi tshogs gling gnang ste rtags gsal dang / dam bca' dang ba 'dren pa gnang bas gzur gnas kun gyis 11

bsngags brjod kyi rol mo bkrol/ de ltar tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi skor thugs 'dzin dang / dpe khrid dpe gzigs sogs la gzhan dang mi 'dra bar 'bad pas tshig don gang cha nas legs paro thugs su chud/ de nas rgyan 'jug gnyis sngar nas thugs 'dzin gnang yod pa dgung lo bcu drug steng gzhung rgyugs phul nas dge 'dun nyi shu gsar rtsod byas/ de rjes skabs dang bo'i mtha' dpyod yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin gnang ste tshogs rgyugs la phul /phyis su yang paṇa chen bde lam/ 'jam sdud gnyis/ rje'i bstod 'grel —chen mo/ spyod 'jug chen mo sogs dang / dbal mang sngags kyi spyi don/ legs bshad snying bo/ 'dul sdom sogs thugs 'dzin gnang ba dang / 'dul ba lung cha tshang la zhib gzigs gnang ste bar sdom dang grangs 'dren rnams thugasapa la byang bar bzung / cho ga'i skor la bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / mgon chos lha mo rnam sras sogs kyang thugs 'dzin gnang / tshogs rgyugs phul ba sogs kyis thos bsam rdo rus thug pa gnang bas pharophyin gyi tshig don kun thugs su chud/ 'dzin grwa gtug la sgro skur dang rdzas btags 'dres mar btang bas hab cha mi thon kha med byung gsungs/ phar phyin dam bca'i naskabs/ skabs bzhi ba nas/ mi rtag bsgoms pas de blo bsgom 12

'gyur zhing / zhes pa las 'phros te mi rtag pa dang mi rtag gasgo ma pa'i blo gnyis blo gcig gis sgom na bsgom bya rnam pa gnyis dus gcig tu sgom par thal ba dang / gzhan gyis sgom na sgom byed thug med du thal ba sogs kyis rtsod pa 'ur phyogs cher byas gsungs/ phyi'i nangs par zhogs kha'i chos grwar sbyor ba'i yon tan bcu bzhi tshan pa/ gnyis rgyu mtshan can dang rgyu mtshan du'am bsgrub bya sgrub byed du sbyar tshul dang / lhag kyang de ltar bsgrub bya sgrub byed sbyar zhes sbyor tshul sogs 'phangs/ gung tshigs chos grwar dbu ma rnying ba nas gzhon nu dpal gyis shes mtshan khyad mtshan gyi bzhed tshul la gser phreng sogs kyi ngo rgyugs tsam blangs pa'i rgyugs 'phrod tsam byung gsungs/ dgung mo rdo bcal la mdzod 'dzin grwa nas phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags las brtsams te rtsod pa phyogs chen po 'od rgyu 'dra ba la grol ba myur bas de nyid 'don dgos ma byung gsungs/ phyi'i nangs par dka' rams 'dzin grwa nas co ne thos bsam bya ba langs te rgyan gyi nang nas/ thog ma dang ni de nyid gzhan nyid dang / /rang gi mtshan nyid rang dang gzhan du 'gyur/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa dang khyad par la/ /skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod par bshad/ /ces bkod de skye med brgyad re re la bzod pa thob pa yod med dang / med na skye ce

med brgyad dgo ngas gzhir bskad pa mi 'thad ces dang / 'khor ba la thog ma'i skye ba med par rtogs pa'i bzod pa yod med spyang 'phangs/ gzhan 'gyur gyi skye ba med pa stong nyid yin min dang / yin na yongs grub kyi steng gi yin dgos la/ de lta na yongs grub stong gzhir byas te de chos gzhan gyis stong bas jo nang gi gzhan stong lta bur 'gyur cub dang / bzod pa de kun re re la sbyor ba nyi shu re yod med sogs nya nyung mang po bsre ba byas zhes gsungs/ khong rang nyid kyis rnam thar sa bon shog dril skabs khengs skyu—ngas sha stag gnang yang tshig don gnyis la byang chub nas sha zhag rus zhag tu song ba red/ de dag gi skabs su gtso bo rang gi yig cha bsdus grwa nas bzung ste thugs 'dzin gnang zhing tshogs rgyugs phul ba tsam du ma zad dpe khrid dang dpe gzigs don la zhib mor dpyad pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs kyis mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes gsungs pa'i sgo mang chos dar ba'i rnam thar las/ deng sang slob gnyer la 'bad pa'i khulabyed pa phal cher yang dpe char lta tshul rang gi yig cha 'dzin skyor byed rgyu bskyur nas dpe sna mang bo zhig gis ma longs pa bzhin byas te dpe klog chab chob ra rtsi thog la yan pa bzhin 14

thams cad kyi sne btog re byas rung gnad la 'bab rgyu gcig kyang med/ gzhung tshan de'i rang lugs bskyur te gzhan lugs pa'i dgag pa'i thad nas phar 'phen rgyu re e yod gtso bor byas pas skabs der 'gro thabs tsam 'ong yang / rang la tshur 'phangs pa na 'bab sa 'di 'dra zhig dgos snyam du blor 'dzin rgyu'i gtad so zhig med stabs ri dwags thang la bdas pa bzhirna gar 'gro 'dir 'gro med cing / lo zla kha shas song dus sems ngo na ci yang med pa ni dang bo slob gnyer rgyag dus rgyag ma shes pa'i skyon du snang ste kun mukhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i zhal snga nas / gzhung tshig blo 'dzin mi byed gzhung gi don/ /dpe klog tsam gyis shes 'dod bzhad gad gnas/ /zhes dang / thad ka'i gzhung la blta ba yal bor nas/ /(dpe mang blta ba shes rab 'chal ba'i rgyu/ /gsungs pa ltar yin pas blo gsal ba rnams ya ma yeng gis nyi ma 'phul thabs de 'drar ma song bar dam pa 'di dag gi rnam thar la kha mig yar la blta ba zhig dgos so zhes gsungasartsopa ltar slob gnyer gsha' ma zhig byed 'dod pa dag gis bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rnam par thar ba ltar bslab par bya'o/ / chigazhan yang mdo sde rgyan los/ rigabyupa'i gnas lnga dag la 15

brtson par rma rgyas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen po thob mi 'gyur/ /derībs gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su bzung phyir dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de 4 de brtson byed/ /ces gsungs pa9 ltar 'phags chen dag gis gzhan don byed pa la med mi rung ba'i rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs shing—— mkhas par gyur pa yin te sngon gzhon nu'i dus stag ge dpon slob las sum rtags bslab cing / 'bo rwa'i rgya mtsho'i drung na saskar rtsis kyi lnga bsdus nas bzung ste zhag gsum par ri mo —rdzogs ༷ par sbyangs/ de rjes gso rig smra ba'i khyu mchog sman pa'i dung phrug zhes grags pa'i lnga rig pa 'jam dbyangs chos dar gyi zhal — snga las dbyangs can sgra mdo rtsa 'grel gyi steng nas de dus sgra ba snyornams la go tshor med pa'i gzhung gi bar bar gyi ri mo sgrub tshu4 lo chen thugs rje dpal dang / a kyā yongs 'dzin gyi gsung du gsal ba de dab / de dag tu mi gsal ba sngon gyi khrid rgyun— du ba49ltag pa dag dang bcas mdzub khrid lung bcas gsan sbyangs dang /ho sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnar+sā rtsa 'grel mdzustse khrid lung bcas nyan/ brda sprod kun bshad kyi mtshams su sleb pa— na brda sgrod mkhas pa dag gi mdzad srol bzhin brda sprod kun bshad kyi mtshan gsol/ slob dpon mchog de nyid kyis 'phags ma'i 16

bstod pa dang 'dod don la smon pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du btang ste/ mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin zla zhal mas/ /ma nor lam ston dran dbang tshul bzung ba/ /bshes gnyen mkhas pa mchog de'i bka' lung gis/ /dbyangs can dar ba'i lang tshor 'bod pa'i gtam/ /brda sprod gzhung brgya'i rtse mo dbyangs can ma'i/ /dgongs mthil ma nor tshul bzhin 'chad pa la/ /paṇa chen rjes su 'byor ba dang mtshungs pa/ /khyod mtshan dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rdo rje'o/ /zhes legs par sbyar ba saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang shan sbyar yirtsige dgu ba'i m+bhatsā ras bcings pa bstsal te kun bshad kyi ming btags nas me tog 'thor ba dang bcas shis pa brjod pa'i mtha' brgyan to/ /khong gi zhal nas ngas sgra slob pa'i skabs 'phags ma'i bstod pa re ma bton—par nyan masamyong gsungs/ slob dpon 'jam dbyangs chos dar ba'i zhal nas/ ngas sgra bslab yul zhig la a lags 'di ba las lhag pa'i sgra go mkhan zhig ma byung zhes gsungs pa skyabs mgon mchog gi snyan du son pas thugs dgyes pa'i bsngags brjod yang yang gnang / khong mu to grags pa rgya mtsho las snyan ngag gsan/ snyan ngag la shin tu mkhas pare gyur pa gsung rtsom rnams la bltas pa tsam gyis shes nus pa 17

daspar nadonargya na so lnga'i sgo nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod jipa'i snyan ngag gsung 'bum khrod sabazhugs pa de lta bu'o/ / snye dī nag rtsis kyang nag rtsi sa sngon 'gro cidang / bcu gsum 'khor zha ga rngogashen cirtsis kha shas sogs shes padhe byudz+wanaspore gnyis brtsirtswa kyangalhaphyisi bzhag gsungs/ ji sngar phar phyin la slob skabs shig rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las/ rnam dkar bsod nams stong gis legs bskrun pa'i/ — /shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor 'di/ /don med 'jig rten byasngubs chuhwadathonartopa/ /bdagami la snying med gyur pa gdon mi za/ /zhes dang / phal cher mi bzad zug rngu skye ba'i rgyu/ /nyeba'ibargya'i 'byur gnas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ /mkhas pa su zhig lhag par chags par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar thosagasam gsha' ma gnang ba'i 'bras bur 'a khor ba'i phun tshogs ma 'a dag la thugs shating nas zhen pa log sngar nas bla ma nang chesagyi 'dzin bdag la zhe sun gsungs/ sngar gyi khang ba btsong nazhesakhang chung zhig tu spos te grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyisacilta ’ gosatsho tshwagyong bskur nas thos bsam la 'bad brtson gnang / —phyis saskutshe tshe 'di'i rten bzhengs thams cad kyi thog ma/ mkhan rin’po che ngag ‘dbang dge legs tshang ngag dbang thub bstan rgyane 18

mtsho dang / sgo mang rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang / bde mchog/ mkha' spyod ma/ mgon4po zhal bzhi ba rnams kyi tsa ka li re bzhengs te khong sgo mang rin po cher lhag gnas zhus par nyin shas zhog gsu ngas par sku drung nas bzhag par khong nyid kyi 'dra thang gi zhal sgros la snum jigs shig lhung song bar sku nye nas gzhan gyihotsa ka brdzad zhus phar grwa rkyang gi kha la snum thigs re 'tho/sa na bzang mod gsungs/ de phyin chad zas gos kyis mi dzophongs pa 'ongs pa de ka'i byin rlabs rten 'brel tu 'khums — gsungs/ gsung bab der bltas na yang lto gos la gyong bskur nas bzhugs par shes nus/ spyo da 'jug las/ des kyang bdag don ma byas la/ /bdag kyang de don mi 'gyur bas/ /byis las thag ring bshol bar bya/ /zhes dang / 'dris nyid du mi 'gyur bar/ /tha mal ba tsam legs par bya/ /bung bsame tog sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /chos kyi don tsam blangs nas ni/ /kun la sngon chad ma mthong bzhin/ /'dris pa med par gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / mnyam med po to ba po'i zhal nas/ /gzhagagyi g.yog dang dpon mi bya/ rdu /gzhan sems mi dkrug sems mi bzung / /bsre bslad misgobya 'brel mi bya/ ltogs 'jen mi bya 'dris mi bya/ /gyong du bya zhing 'grog dka' 19

bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten gyi zhen pa a 'thas su song ba darīg dang mi mthun par bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes te thos bsalosgom gsum gyi bya ba la brtson pas dus 'da' bar byas/ de dag gi skabs su rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ kha cig phrag dog dug chus gnan dag las/ /rang nyid rgyal ba'i sgyu thabs lhur len 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phrag dog gi dugo chus myos pa 'ga' zhig gis rje 'di'i yon tan gyi gzi byin ma bzod par mi zer dgu zer gyis gleng brjod sna tshogs bslangs mod me la shing bsnan pa bzhin du rje 'di'i 'khor ba la zhen log dang / sems can la snying brtse ba sogs kyi mthun rkyen du gyur te lung rtogs me ltar 'bar bar gyur to/ /snga phyi 'di dag gi skabs gang yin kyang 'gro mgon skyobs pa rin po ches/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la/ /mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas/ /yid mos gus 'di la gzab par 'tshal /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos 'brel gang yod la skyon rtog gi blo skad cig kyang ma skyes par lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul ma log pa'i dbang gi sa che dgu thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu dang bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa red/ 20

gzhan yang thos pa rgya chen btsal ba'i skor/ snyigs dus kyi nye bar 'khor a khu rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho las dge tshul dang rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ skyabs mgon mchog las tshe dbang / a lags mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs tshang las bka' 'gyur gyi lung / bla mchod dang phyag chen— sbrags ma'i khrid/mi tra brgya rtsa/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung / dus 'khor dbang chen/ 'jigasatshobyed dmar bo mda' 'gengs kyi dug dbang /bde mchog lo hu ba'i lugs kyi dbang chen sogs dbang bka' mang bo gsan/ sgo mang rin po che las bde lam gyi khrid/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig bde mchog lca i pa dang dril bu lha lnga/ gsang 'dus lugs gnyis dang 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor chen/ mngon byang / zab don snyan brgyud kyi dbang sogs dbang du ma dang / rnam sras bka' bco lnga sog sa4rjes gnang du ma/ rgyal thang ba bsam gtan 'od zer gyi gcod skor gyi lung dang / a khu rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho las/ tā ra nā tha'i dbang mchog steng nas dbang dang du ma/ dus 'khor bskyed rim gyi lung /yang sgo mang rin po che las stag phu'i sgrol yophyi nang gnyis/ thig le bcu drug 'jigs gsang mkha' spyodabyusogs kyi sngags btu/paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum gyi lung / stabs 3ram̐

'grig tshul gyis rig byed ma'i don kun 'grub pa'i 'khor lo gsar sgrungadeng / 4ge'i sngags 'khor zhib par bskrun te khong sgo mang ri na po cher phul ba dgyes nya mayodang bcas thugs mkho che gsungs nas bdagashar r+pāzhe sa/ yang alta rin po che bstan ba rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las/ rje'i bstod 'grel/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis sogs dang / sbyor ba'i chos drug nyams su len tshul lag len zhib gsal dang bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i khrid/ —mkhanasna rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las shar ba'i lam rim snying bo don gsum/ rngog dkyil bdun/rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rim lnga/ dben sa ba'i chu bcud len steng natse de'i khrid sogs zhus/ yang sgo mang rin po che las/ 'brel ba bzhi sbrags le'u drug pa'i bar dang / sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung so9kham rādzas bka' kha shas thob /rkyebs mgon thams caltamakhyenasnepa bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gi zhal snga lasazirdo rdzorna la 'byor ma'i rtsa dbu ma che ba'i nyams khrid sogs mkha' spyod skor gyi man ngag kha shas lung bcas gsan/ yang sgo mang rin po cheko.a curje'i gsung 'bum ta pod yan gsan/ yang a khu rin po che las rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi bshad lung / dge ldan bstan 'bar ma rtsa 'grel 3lha

—gyi lung bcas gsan/ gsung bshad zin bres byas/ lam riyo mo'i bshad lung zhus/ a khu rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung sngar ma thob pa rnams a khu lung rtogs tshang la zhus/ de nas bde thang rin po che 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho las 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang / a khu rin po che sheyorab rgya mtsho'i yig cha'i steng nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud dang 'gre lachen mchan bsgrags kyi bshad lung / bsdus rgyud snying bo dang blogros chos skyong gi smon shis kyi lung sogs dang / gzu ngas gzhugs 'khrul spong / rab gnas/ ci cilas bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi khrid/dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gzhung bsrangs/ me tog bcud len/chu bcud len/ dza bur rlugakhrid/ spyon sregadangos grubar+shargya mtsho/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i gi khro sgrages sgrub kyi rnam ba shad kyi bshad lung rnams gsalha/ snyarayang rje yagasras kyi gsudz+wa'abum las sngar ma thob pa thamayo cad/ lho chibrag bka' 'bum/khyung khra nag dbyangs can dkar dmar gyi las tshogs/ sgrol dkar tshe khrid/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ dam tshig rdo rje'i pazlas pa/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg grub rgyal tshe khrid rnams kyi khrid dang / kun mkhyen gsung 'bum gyi 33

lung / bsod grags gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi lung / rtogs bdun mchan 'grel gyi bshad lung / gsang 'dus gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang / phar phyin mchan gyi bshad lung / be'u bum sngon po'i rtsa 'grel/ dpe chos rtsa 'grel/ po to ba'i chig lab ring mo/man ngag rin chen spungs pa/ ri khrod skal ldan sgron me/ blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo/ blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/ byang sems ra sgreng ba'i byang chung sems kyi chu rgyun/ gsung sgros thor bu/ sman gyi rgyud 0 gsum/ man ngag bka' rgya ma/ g.yu thog cha lag bco brgyad rnams kyi lung / a khu rin po che'i bstod 'grel bshad lung /mkhan rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi zin bris/ rwa pod dang dpal pod/ rgya gzhung las gshed skor gyi lung rgyun gang yod dang / te lo nā ro mar ba mi la ras chung ba rnams kyi rnam thar gyi lung sogs chos bka' rgya cher gsan/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍa ta'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho tshang la gsung 'bum mang bo'i lung rgyun bzhugs pas khong gis zhus ngor 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ zhogs don yod mkhas grub/ klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang /paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes/ lcang skya ngag dbang chos ldan/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje rnams kyi gsung nyu4

'bum gyi lung / thu'u bkwan gsung 'bum las sngar ma thob pa'i rigs dang / skyabs mgon mchog nas mgon po'i rigs gtad chig rgyud du gnang nas gzhan gnyis dpal mang tshang la gnang yod pas de nas nyan thabs kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ lha mo phyag bzhi ma dang / gnod sbyin gnyis kyi rjes gnang yang dpal mang rin po che las thob/ gzhan yang chos bka' mang bo zhig dbal mang rin po che las thob pas bka' drin shin tu che zhes gsungs/ dus 'khor rgya nag pa tshang gi mdun nas rgyal mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho/ rgya nag pa bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum sogs kha shas thob/ yang sgo mang rin po che las bde gsang sogs dbang chen bco brgyad gser chos bcu gsum sogs gsan/zhal snga nas bde thang rin po che las bka' 'gyur gyi lung sngar ma thob pa'i rwa pod man chad rdzogs par thob ste mjug tu sems bskyed mchod pa bcas thob/ gur pod me 'bar ma kha skong po ti bcas chig brgyud du bstsal/ zhal bzhi ba'i be'u bum phyi nang gnyis/ dmar chung skor gsum gyi chos skor/ rgya gzhung lung rgyun gang bzhugs/ 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi bshad lung / 'du'asna ba'i gleng 'bum gyi lung / yang bskyar ba/ sdus rgyud mchan bcas 25

kyi bshad lung yang thob/ yang rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'a495'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ rje dge 'dun spub kyi gsung 'amum/ dben sa ba blo bzang do na 'a grub kyi gsung 'bum/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor/ hor ston nam mkha' — dpal gyi blosbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/ glang ri thang ba'i blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma rnams dang / byang chub mi la'i skal ldan rnam thar/ skal ldan mgur 'bum/ shug yag ri khrodapa'i dge blokhasaba'i dge tshul gyi bslab bya/ — bse tshang gi rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭik+ka/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung 'bum/ sde khri rin po che'i dus 'khor bskyed rim dang /dharma kyi rti'i gsung gi khrid yig steng nas dus 'khor bskyed rdzogs dang / bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i bskyed rim gyi khrid/ legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung / rdo lag’brgyud ma'i khrid/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs pa'i khrid yig thig le gsal byed kyi steng nas thig le bcu drug gi khrid/ rdo rje tshig spram dang yi ge bzhi ba'i bsad ba zlog ma ning ha 'don rnams kyi 26

khrid/ sgra tsā snyan gyi tshe khrid/ rdo rje rtse dgu ba la brten pa'i tshe khrid/ 'jigs byed ser bo phyag na ku sha bsnams pa'i tshe khrid/sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung dang rtsa tshig gi steng nas khrid/ brag dkar bka' bcu'i bde lam zin bris kyi lung /kha dron gnas brtan gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung / skyabs mgon bar ba'i gsung bka' rgya ma'i lung / kun mkhyen rnam thar btsan po ma'i lung / paṇa chen gsung steng nas thun drug rnam 'byor gyi khrid/ dbang mdzad sgrol ma dmar mo'i be'u bum dang bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi steng nas lag len zhib khrid bcas/dgag bya ngos 'dzin gyi bshad lung / kun mkhyen gsung bka' rgya ma'i lung sogs gsan/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang rin po che bstan pa'i nyi ma las gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma/'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang ro langs pargyad skor/ 'khor chen lha bco brgyad/ rdor dbying sa/ mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum/snur lugs rnam 'joms lha mang rnams kyi dbang / mi tra'idhen nga tshan dpal mchog dang bo'i rdor sems lha re gcig pa'i dbang nas bzung thugs rje chen po lha bcu gsum gyi dbang gi bar dbang brgyad gsan/ yang skyabs mgon mchog gi zhal snga las mgon po'i rab gnag/ mchog sgrub pa'i rlung sgrub thun mong oṃḥ7

yin pa/ klu'i bum gter gyi khrid/ lo gyon— ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid/ tshe khrid zhag bdun ma dang bu ston god khug ma'i tshe khrid/srad rgyud tshe khrid/ bla ma lnga bcu ba'i bshad lung / sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i zin bris kyi lung / mgon po'i be'u bum gyi khrid la mkho ba'i man ngag du ma'i lung khrid/ bla ma zhi khro'i tshe dbang / nam mkha' bsam 'grub kyi mi la'i gsol 'debs kyi lung / lha mo tsaṭi ka'i rjes gnang bka' rgya ma bu ston gong khug ma'i tshe dbang gsan/ yang khong gi gsung 'bum lung gsung mgur gyi rim pa nas bstsal ba gsan/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge dang / las bzhi'i drug cu ba'i rnam bzhag gnyis lung khrid gcig 'thus kyi tshul tu gsan/ a mchog rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho las bde mchog tso 'jam rdor/ me tri bcu gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams kyi dbang / sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang bcas gsan/ de ltar 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng bzhi ba rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug mdo rgyud gdams pa'i gter mdzod a khu rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs yang sprul mkhan rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho/ a khu rin po tshe zhang ston bstan pa rgyu mtsho/ sgo mang mkhan rin po che rje blo 38

bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bde thang mkhan rin po che rje 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ a mchog rin po che rje 'jadzo dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho/ gung thang rin po che rje bstoṣ+ka pa'i nyi ma/ dbal mang rin po che rje 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ smra ba'i dbang phyu ga rdo rams pa gling bla sar 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ gso rig smra ba'i khyu mchog 'jam dbyangs chos dar ba dbyangs can dar ba'i lang tsho sogs bshes gnyen du ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten te thos pa rgya chen po btsal bas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa thob nas zab rgyas rikyi gdams pa gzhal tu med pa'i gter mdzod du gyur par brten mkhas dgu'i gtsug gi nor bur gyur to/ / smras pa/ —sngon gyi thugs bskyed sa bon grung bo las/ /nyer 'khrungs skyes sbyangs dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtser/ /lung rtogs me tog 'bum gyi rtse dga' ngom/ /dge mtshan dri bsung mngar bos 'jig rten khyab/ /'bad brtson skya rengs gsar bas nyer drangs pa'i/ /rnam dpyod nyi mas rang zhal ngom pa na/ /gzur gnas mtsho skyes 'bum gyi 'dab bzhad de/ /bstod bsngags sgra ma ra yi glu dbyangs snyan/ /nyin mo'i mgon 29

tshogyis rang 'od spros pa na/ /srid bya mun par thim pas 'khun sgra sgrog /dam pa'i thos bsam 'od stong 'bar ba na/ /phrag dog khung bur nyal bas ngu co sgrog /rnya ji gos hrul thos dang tshul khrims kyis/ skathugartswargyusna gser gyi bum bzang yongar+sā rga gtams/ /rigs lam zho 'thung rbas pa'i rtse brgya yir+sā/ /log rtog bcud med bdag po sde bca'aca bcom/ /zhes bla4 go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags ba rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i bad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gnen nu zhes bya ba las dang bor rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal ba'i sarga ste dang bo'o/ / bar du galung lugs thams cad gdams par shar baji sarga/'asbyigs ṭīd mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ /'a phrin lag 'od brgya 'baroba'i 'od rlabs kyis/ /thub bstan rgya rmotsho spernyi ba'i gnyen gcig ci/ /smra ba'i zla ba chen po rnam ther ༷rgyal/ sgro /ded dpon mkhas pas yiskabazhin dbang rgyal dang / /mdzes ldan 'ching bu'i khyad par 'a pa ltar/ /mnog chung srid pa'i nor dang thar ba'i bde/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i tshul de rmad du byung / /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad 30

gdams par shar ba'i tshul bshad pa la/ thog mar bai'u bum sngon po las/ man ngag thams cad ba sdus pa'i mgo ni/ /bshes gnyen dam pa mi btang ba yin/ /de las dad dang byang chub sems sogs/ /yon tan kun 'byung kunabyugyi gter yin/ /zhes dang / rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis/ /bsam dang sbyor ba'i tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ /mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gartong bar/ /bka' bzhin pasgrub pa'i spachod pas mnyes par byas/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas/ /thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin skyangs 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / yon tan rin po che sdud pa las spyang / slob ma bzang bo bla mar gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi gzhi rten/ legs tshogs ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ mchog dang thun phongadzigi dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni rang la lam phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin tu bsten pa la rag las par gsungs pas so 3ram̐

snyam du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang bsten la dam tshig gi sel cung zad tsam yang ma song bar ma zad/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag ste bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten pa dang / khyad par bka' drin rjes su dran te gus par byas shing bka' bzhin bsgrub me'i mchod pas mnyes par byas pa'i tshul ni/ khong stag ge tshangasna las klog bslabs pa dang sum tigs bslabs pas zhal nas khong bka' drin can des ka kha phral klog bslabs/ sbyar klog gzhal zhes pa'i bar bslabs te gzhan tsho bslab na zhar la shes yong 'gro gsungs nas skyabs 'gro lhang bshags sogs rim par bslabs pas bka' drin che zhes yang yang gsungs shing phyag thal mo sbyor/ deng sang chos par rlom pa 'gas klog slob pa'i slob dpon slob dpon du mi brtsi ba sogs la bltas na 'di ni gzhung luges gdams par shar nas chos kyi gnad mkhyen pa'i rtags so/ /gzhan yang stag ge tshang gis khyod tshogs chos 'grim pa sogayol khang mig chung ngu zhig gis chog gsungs pa dang du blangs pa sogs gang gsungs bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ mkhan rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho tshul bzhin bsten nas debang bka' mang bo gsan zhing bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas thugs shin tu mnyes shing khong gi gsu/nga las pha nor 33

bu la bstsal ba bzhin ci tsam pa'i bka' dam po zhig la'ang dbang gral nas phud ma myong zhing khyad par 'jigs byed dmar pongamada' 'gengs kyi dug dbang skabs ched gnyer gyis 'bod mi btang ba sogs thugs kyis rjes su bzung ba tshad med/ lhag par grub dbang yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyurwa ba lo hu ba'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha re gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du thog mar smin par mdzad pa'i bka' drin sogs bskal ba bye bar lus srog longs spyod kyis mchod kyang gzhal dka' ba'i drin chen po yin lags zhes shog dril la bris nas bzhag a khu rin po che rje zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho bsten nas gsung rtsom 'bri ba sogs phyag g.yog bsnyen bkur dang bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mnyes par byas pas thugs zin gyi slob mar gyur te khyod nged kyi rtsar 'di zhig tu bzung ste rgyud par lo shas 'gror bcug pa snyam pa yod mod ces gsungs pa dang / bla go rdo rje 'chang khong gis rgyud du po to ba chen po'i zhal nas/ bsre bslad mi bya 'brel mi bya/ /ltogs 'jen mi bya 'dris mi bya/ /gyong du bya zhing 'grog dka' bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten pa dag dang mi mthun zhing 'grog dka' ba byas nas bsgrub pa 'ba' zhig la gzhol skabs shig khong a khu rin po che de nyide kyi zhal nas/332

mi dang ma blogrorgu pare 'dug mi bub/ sadang 'grog kyang skyon yi med pa zhig gtan mi srid/ mi dang 'grig rgyu gal che/ cung zad re la ba snyad btags nas sgo langs kyin ma bsdad na bzang /res gcig gnyis re la bsrakhababatsugs te bsdad na spangs pa min yang mi mngon pa zhigaskotu 'gro rgyu sod/ kha rton mag mug gcig 'don rgyu las dpe char blta ba gtso bosaugyis/ dpe char blta ba la tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong thams cad kyi gnad 'dug pas gal chen gyis zhes sogs mtshang la rgol ba'i bslab ston gnang ba la/ deng dus kyi slob ma zhig yin tshe spo ma langs kyang bden kha rang gis bzung nas bla ma'i gsung rna rgyab kyi ser bur byed pa las mid mod/ khong rin po che 'di ba'i zhal nas/ mtshang la rgol ba'i bslab ston bka' drin durtebastsal ba ni bskal ba bye ba'i bar du mgo la thod bzhin bkur te lus dang longs spyod kyis mchod kyang gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin du 'khums zhes gsungs/ ha cang thugs dzin gyi slob mar gyur stabs/ zhu ba po med kyang dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi bshad lung gnang nas zin bris kyis gsung stabs zin bris byas pa gzigs/ 'bul zhus par spyi khog bzang ste gang bshad ma thon 'dug mjug gi chos spyong skabs mgon po chos rgyal bsten 34

dgos tshul bshad pa'i skabs kyi bshad pa 'di la don bsdu lta bu zhig las medā/ zin bris kyi rigs 'di rang gis ngos zin pa dang sla chos 'dra ba yin yang gsung ris sor bzhag bkod na snaphyis go ba bskyed tshul 'dra min yong ba dang / phyin rlabs kyi khyad che ba yod ces gsungs pa sogs dang / nyin gcig shog dril zhig gi dbu na/ tshad mar gyur pak+ṣ-i'agro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gargogs skyobs pa tsong kha ba/ //sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag bgyid na/ /pha rjes bu yis jin phar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes bris pa zhig gnang ste 'di'i 'phro la mar bstod 'grel chen mo nas don ldan ma'i 'bru 'brel rnams rje nyid kyi gsung gtsang5ma sor bzhag tu 'khod la shog gsungs pa ltar bri sa te phul bar/ 'di ngas bskul bawaṃn rgyusprebyas te khyod kyi rtsom gyi thog mar zhog gsungs kyang rta/ rje btsun gyis/ cha lugs ha cang ngan na gshis kyi brnas/ /gsungs pa bzhin gzan rkam sogs 'phyor bo med/ go sa snyan thags ni med/ yon tan can gyi grags skam zhig kyang med pas kun gyis 'phya ba dzoshis mi 'ongs snyam sbyar byang ma bzhag par phul ba bzhin nyid nas gsung 'bum khrod de bzhin bzhag 'dug ces gsungs/ 'di yang —bla ma'i thugs zin pa'i rnam thar rlabs po che'o/ /yang zhal nas nga 35

rgyal ma che na bzang sogs skabs skabs kyi skyon gang shugs che na de nyid 'bur 'arjoms kyi bslab ston zhal ta rus pa can stsol ba sogs ma mdzangs kyis bu la bzhin lugs gnyis char nas bskyangs pa'ici bka'e drin ba sam mtha' med mod ces gsungs pa sogs bka' drin rjes su dra—na pa'i nim par thar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /yang khyod— la mi ston na su la ston gsungs nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dpe sprad pa dang / dpe ris sogs 'brir bcug pa dang / lam rim gyi bshad lung gi bar mtshams rnams su zhal khrus phul ba dang / sku khams cung lci bar song ba'i skabs mtshams khong nas rnam rgyal gzungs ring dang /'dus pa'i lus dkyil gyi sgo nas susnya ra dza sogs ci lcogs bsgrubs pas thugs zin/ nyin shas mtshams nas sku'i bab rgyun ldan dang / gsung gleng rgyun chags phebs te/ pha ming bu la btags pa'i bla go tshang / /snga ming phyi mar btags pa'i bla go tshang / /da lta'i dus kyi phung gsum tsam po tshang / /khyod la bze re can gyis 'di skad zhu/ /sogs ku re'i tshul du gsung 'phros kyi yi ge yang yang phebs pa sogs da lta dran pas mchi ma dku zhes gsungs pa yang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i rnam thar —ro 36

khrod du bzhugs skabs skyabs mgon mchog khong gi gzim shag chung ngur rgyun du phebs te gsung sgros dang zhal slob sogs sdis bslab ston dang lung bstan du ma gnang ba dang bka' dog pa'i zab chos du 'dzizig brgyud du bstsal’ba sogs kyis rjes btabazung ba ma zad snang tshod lad+kutha thugs4snang nin tu 'dris pa'i rnam pa bstan to/ /dper na khong gi gsungarnam thar sa bon las/phyi nas skyabs mgon mchog spyi'adibur spyon nas/ /ka ma la dang bla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /zhes pa'i dbu can gyi sgrol dkar bstod pa zhig ljags rtsodza gnang bar bskul ba po khyod yin rgyu byas zhesatsho ri khrod kyi tshogs su btsugs/ ma 'gyang bar sgrol dkar baghon pa zhig gyis zhes phebs pas sgom khang gong nas sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa byas/ grub 'phral ri khrod du slebs pa sashuladu nged kyi steng nas zing cha che tsam zhig bslangs 'dug kyang de ma thag mtshams bsdamatha'inas chos rgyal gyi bsnyen pa zhig btang / de gro la dus gong samachog mibyin gyis zing cha rang yal du song 'dug tshe'i bar chad cig yod pa bla ma dang 'phags ma'i byin rlabs kyis nyer 'tshe phra mo de tsam gyis bablog pa yin mchi snyam du dad pa kha zhe med pa4zhig skyes zhes gsungs pa ltar red/ de skabs dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ gcong rong nags kyi 38

khrod na nyi ma bas/ /me khyer mchog tu rlom pa macithong bas skyo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ri khrod pa 'ga' zhig gis bshes gnyen nyi ma lta bu 'di'i yon tan mi mthong bar khong sgom khang gong du mtshams la bzhugs pa'i skabs/ rnga sus thug sus skyel mi thub ces sogs kyi gleng brjod bslangs pa dang / mthar gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la zhu rgyu byung tshe/ skyabs mgon mchog /khazhal nas /khyod tsho'i ja sus thug sus de 'dra rtsa chen po zhig e red/ ngas 'di ba dgon pa zhig gigikhri bar yang mngags ma bra bar bskyur yod pa 'di stong phrag shasum 'di la re rgyu zhig yod rgyu red snyam yod/ ces gsungs/ 'di dus dgung lo nyer bzhi'i thog yin mod/ phyis su stong phrag gsum ma zad bod gangs can gyi sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog 'dzin pa'i lung bstan yin no/ /yang khong gi zhal nas/ chos kyi bka' drin dang tha na sos bde gu yangs su tshe gang bor 'du ga rgyu byung ba tshun gatha gi bka' drin yin pas drin lan gzhal dka' bar yod/ ces sogs yang yang gsungs/ de ltar bsam pa dar sgrub pa'i mchod cipas mnyes par byas pa ma zad/ bkur sti dang sbyor ba'i bsten tshul la yang shin tu zab par snang ste/ dper na skyabs mgon ri khrod du yun ring bzhugs skabs mchod gtor bzo bsham sogs ma chod dpon 39

gyi las gang dgos dang / skyed ma ma 'tsho ba'i skabs kyang skar bcospu dang / khrus chog gang cir thugs bzhed ltar ba—sgrubs pa dang / mi la'i rnam mgur 'don pa sogs phyag g.yog pher bo zhus zhes zhal nas gsungs/ gzhan yang de lter bshes gnyen bsten tshul shin tu legs pa'i dbang gis bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba yin te/ gzhan gyis bka' 'gyur gyi lung zhus par skyabs mgon dang sgo mang rin po cher bka' bgros byas par sgo mang rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas thopa kyang ma thob thosge kyang 'don mi nus khyod kyis thon dang legs zhes gnang ba ltar bla grwa brgya lhag la bka' 'gyur gyi lung gnang / de'i skabs shig skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas bla brang sku tshab ched mngags kyis kha dar che legs shig bskur gnang mdzad de rje 'di bar/ gzhung chobar lo bstar chags su lam rim bde lam dang 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid res mos su yod pa mi nub par skyong dgos zhes gsungs/ skabs der brel dbang gis dang len byed rgyu ma byung /bka' 'gyur lungo gnang tshar nas sku mdun du mjal bar 'phros mol zhib rgyas zhus par/ skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/sdon chad dus skabs legs dus mnyam med sgrub khang ba/ dpon slob byams pa/ zhog don yod mkhas grub/ yongs 'dzin rin 40

po che sogs kyis bde mem dang 'jam dpal zhal lung res mos kyis ston dpyid zla chos re gnang ba'i srol mchis/ da cha bod yul chos kyi zhing sar yang ming tsam yang dkon pa 'di red pas dgon sde 'di tsho bstan pa'i 'byung gnas gnyis par byed dgos rgyur 'dug pas res mos kyis lo re bzhin ma chad na legs snyam pa yin gsungs par/ rje 'di bas lags ji srid 'tsho'i bar nyid kyi dgongs bzhed ltar bsgrub ces zhus/ 'di dag gis nang thugs kyi sras su gyur te chos kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba shes sla'o/ /de bzhin du sgo mang rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo yang bsam sbyor gnyis kyi— sgo nas tshul bzhin bsten te zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bka' shin tu mang bo gsan/ khong gis chos mang bo gnang nas bstan pa'i bdag por /dbang bskur bar dgongs te/ dbal mang tshang la gsung 'bum mang bo'i lung yod ces yang yang gsungs par brten dbal mang rin po che 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho la sa gsung 'bum mang po dang gzhan dbang lung mang po zhus nas thob la chos bka' dkon pa mang bo zhig thob pas bka' drin che zhes bris 'dug pa dang / rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gnang skabs kyangade bzhin gsungs/ bka' 'gyur gyi lung gi skabs sgo mang rin 4 dhe —— 41

po ches dpadze+eris bltan 'dzin 'phrin las ched sangags kyis kha dar dkar ser che legs srid du ring ba zhig bskur te bka' 'gyuragyi 'chad nyan kha thugs dagles par yod tshul dang de bzhin phyis su'ang bka' chos 'chad spel rgya cher gnang dgos tshul sogs nang nyatshwas dang sbyar ba'i bslab bya mang duganang ba sogs ni bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'o/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs gung thang rin po che bstan pa'i nyi ma las snga ra gzhon dus nayochos bka' mang po gsan zhing phyis su'ang mang po gsan pa dang / a mchog rin po che logs chos 'brel gang thob la bka' drin dran pa'i dad gus tshad med pa mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs chos dar ba'i zhal snga nas las sgra dang sdeb sbyor gsan skabs/ sngon nas 'thel ba'i mtshams sbyor zhig gis sam rje de nyid la skyon rtog skad cig spyang ma shar gsungs/gzhan yang baṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku gong ma dang phan tshun bla slob tu gyur/ khong gis zhal nas/ thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes te dbang bskur bzhes pas gsang sngags zab mo'i byin rlabs dang 'brel rlabs chen thugs bskyed smon pa'i rgya mtsho dang gcig tu lad mo tsam yin yang nan tan gyis byed bcug pa rgyal 42

bstan spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon ring lugs dar rgyas yun ring gi ched yin nges la zhar la mtha' med ngan song gi gting rdo bdag 'khor ba mtha' can du bsgrubs pa red snyam dga' dad shin tu rgyas/shi nga nam dran res kyis kyang byung / bka' drin de nyid stong gsum gser gyis bkang nas phul yang gzhal nus min zhes gsungs/ de ltar chos 'brel gang thob la dag snang tshad med pa mdzad pa sogs bshes gnyen bsten tshul legs pa'i rmang gzhi yod pa'i stobs kyis sku tshe ring zhing mdzad 'phrin phyogs med du rgyas/ snyigs dus 'dir bstan pa'i srog bzung zhing 'phrin las mkha' khyab tu rgyas pa'i 'bras rtags kyis bshes gnyen gang bsten la dam tshig gi sel ma zhugasatreshing bsten tshul ma log par grub bo/ /'on kyang zhi ba lhas/ mtho la phrag dog mnyam dang 'gran/ /dman la nga rgyal bstod na dregs/ /zhesapa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba re gnyis res log par rtog pa'i 'bras bu myong ste khyi rgan ku co che ba rang phung ber ka'i char 'bod du song bar ma zad rang rang mtha' rdugs su gyur pa mngon sum mo/ /gzhan yang gzhung lugs gdams par shar bas 'khor ba spyi bye brag las nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems rin po che la nges pa rnyed tshul ni/ sngar dpon tshang sogs kyis tsha kwan be shing gi khrir 43

'gro rgyu'i gros mgo bton pa thos 'phral thugs la shar ba gsungs tshul ni/ dpe shog ldeb gsum tsam yang 'dzin skyor yid phebs pa zhig mi 'byung zhes dang / gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa'i skal ba lta ci kha ton mag mug re byed rgyu'i bsod nams yang mi 'dug pa ngo shes/ bde gsang sogs lhag lha 'di rnams la mtshams thesnyen sgrub re byed rgyu ma byung na de bas phung tshab che ba mi 'dug snyam yid mi bde/ zhes gsungs/ phyis su bshol thabs kyis phebs ma dgos pa 'dra/ 'di ni rje'i byams bstod las/ bde med sdug bsngal brgya yis gtses pa yi/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs yid la dran tsam gyis/ /lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang du tshud pa ltar/ /yid la 'dod pa til tsam med par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar 'khor bde la zhen pa gting nas log pa'i rtags yin te/ bla sprul 'ga' zhig ltar khri kha gdan kha re e thob snyam du ang nyan byed pa ma yin par byang ba'i byis pa nyung mas mi mgu pa'i dpe ltar ro/ /yang zhal nas/ sngar nas bla ma nang chen gyi 'dzin bdag la zhe sun pa dang / khong ri khrod pa tsho rje bstan pa'i sgron mes/ zhe sa ngo 'dzin dgos pa'i dpon po yang med cing / /ze ba yar 'then dgos pa'i g.yog po yang med la/ /e gnod dogs pa dgos pa'i dgra bo yang med par/ /ye shes 4 4

lha tshogs kho na bsten pa zhig byung na/ /zhes pa ltar skyid du tshor ba yod pa zhig mthong bas rang yang de 'dra zhig byung na snyam pa las 'char rgyu med ces gsungs/ dgung lo nyer lnga'i thog thar ba rtser phebs nayobasnyen mtshams shig gnang skabs/ srod thun la rkyen med par gting nas ngu snying zhig 'ongs nas mang po ngus zhes gsungs kyang rkyen med pa min te ma rgan sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la mi bzod pa'i snying rje skyes pa'i rkyen gyis bshums pa dngul chu thogs med kyi rnam thar ltar yin te gsang rnam las/ rgyal yum rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rjes bskyangs pas/ /'gro la byams dang snying rje shugs drag gis/ /dbang med spyan chab chu bo'i rgyun bzhin babs/ /zhes gsungs pa byultar ro/ /de ltar gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs pa mthar thug ni gdul —bya sems can mtha' dag 'khor ba phra rags kyi rgya mtsho las sgrol ched yin par dgongs shing / gzhane dag 'khor ba phra rags las sgrol ba la sa lam gyi rim pa bgrod dgos/ de'i rtsa ba bshes gnyen dam pa tshul bzhin du bsten dgos pa yin la/ sngar thos pa rgya chen btsal ba'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag bshes gnyen — bsten pa'i gdams ngag tu shar nas bshes gnyen dam pa bsam 45

sbyor gnyis kyi sgoṇa nas tshul bzhin du bsten pas byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi thugs la sim ste gang thos pa'i gsung rab mtha' da ga tshe 'di'i snang shes 'khor ba'i zhen pa/ rang nyid gces 'dzin/ bdag gnyis sumatshan mar 'dzin pa rnams gcod pa'i gdams ngag tu shar nas mtho mtho rlung la bskur/ dma' dma' chu la bskur te ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du gnalge dben par bsnyegs so/ / — — smras pa/ rgya chen thos mang dbang phyogs ri rtse nas/ /gzhu nga lugaspogadams par shar ba'i nyi ma shar/ /lung rtogs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i ril mngar la/ /rkang drug rol ba'i mdzes pa gsar du ngom/ /gang thugs bum bzang gdams pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /yongs su gtams pas da ni 'chi med bcud/ /rab tu rtsong ba'i rdzogs ldan shar ro zhes/ /khyod thugs zag med dga' bdes gang bar gyur/ /skal ldan sgra ma ra yi khyu tshogs kyis/ /rang re'i 'tsho bcud myur du 'phel lo zhes / /'phur lding zlos gar sgyur dang chabs cig tu/ /bstod bsngags gshog glu snyan po'i dbyangs kyis brel/ /col chung bye'u'i phrag dog tsag smra dag /gzur gnas ko ki la yi dbyangs kyis mnan/ /yul gnyan skyes bu—dam par sgro skur gyi/ /rgyu mthun tha ma mi sim 46

'dam du bying / /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhis yongs sugrags /de /ji zugatetsho 14:rnopa rje btsun 'jigs da 'an las rgya sdopalad+kuzarnyi rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i ban gtam tshwa gzhon nu zhes ñca ba wo bar du'o gzhung lugs thalo cad gdams par shar ba'i sarga ste gnyis pa// tha mar nyin mtshan kun rtu nyams su blangs pa'i sarga/ 'jigs pa med yam̐ lung rtogs lus stobs kyis/ /gaṅgin phanaṭ+wāṃmi r+sā 'od rlabs 'buyo'agled cing/ /rgyamematsho sacan ngas su rgyal r+sha'ibastanawo/ /k+tol mdzakā zla da bla kā la btud nas/ /gang nyams chu 'an stug las/ /'ar ba'i sprin gyi me tog dge mtshan 'bug /ba stan 'gro 'dzin ma'i //// //bye/ ///shā /lnga/sdidad du 'bazlopa brdar/ /dbyar rnga gsangawāzhad pa tshula'agakābad/ /gsum pa / // nyin mtshan kugatustolo su blangs nyamagadang rtogs gle 'phel ba'i tshul rang bloyodapagatsho~X tsam zhigabarjod pa~Xbal/ slob dpon dbyig gnye/ sa/sbyo/tshulagakāgho dadz+wabasam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la rabatu ra/ te/sagazlosangagapa ltar gzhung lugs mtha' dag gdams par sharo tshul mas rnam par dag pa ༵

gnas nas dbain pa'i gnas bsten te sgrub pa nyams len gyis dus 'da' blo zhig byed dgos dgongs nas/ khong zhang ston rin po cher—zhus pas lan du/ dben pa re bsten nas dge sbyor bya nus na kho bo shin tu dga' gsungs/ reb kong phyogs kyi ri khrod pa tsho sgrub tshugs bzang bas de phyogs su phebs 'dod skyes te khong gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la zhus pas lan du reb kong yin dgos don mi 'dug 'di ka'i bkra shis dge 'phel du bzhugs zhes reb kong phyogs su phebs par dgongs pa ma khrol/ mkhan rin po che ngag dbang dge legs tshang dang / sgo mang mkhan rin po che rnam gnyis nas kyang gzhan du gtong mi bra ba'i gsung zur mang po byung rkyen/ reb kong du phebs rgyu bshol te ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs/ de gar skyabs mgon mchog rgyun par phebs nas zhal bkod dang man ngag mang po gnang / khong gi thugs la yang rang la pho skyes na reb kong yin dgos pa'i nges pa med dgongs nas nyams len la 'bad ba rtson bgyis/ ri khrod du phebs khar khong a khu rin po che la sbyor ba'i chos drug nyams su bstar tshul lag len zhib gsal zhus/ a khu rin po che'i gsung bkod ltar thun re re la mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad tshang ba gshar sgom byas te nyin mtshan kwan tu nyams len 48

la 'bad pa gnang / lhag lha du ma'i bsnyin pa btang ba'i grangs ka rags rim zhig bkod pa ni/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa tshar bzhi/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs lan gsum/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang 'jig rten dbakhu phyug tshar re re/ bde mchog lo hu ba lo gcig gi khongs su rgyun bsnyen byas te ka ra ka ra 'bum/ bdag 'jug brgya rtsa kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa tshar gnyis/ dril bu lus dkyil bsnyen pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa tshar gsum/ dril bu lha lnga'i bsnyen pa tshar gcig dam rdzong snyan brgyud la bsnyen pa tshar gcig 'jam lugs bde mchog dkar por bsnyen pa tshar gsum/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed la tshar gcig nā ro mkha' spyod ma la las rung gi bsnyen pa tshar bzhi/ oṃ gsum 'bru 'bum bsnyen sgrub sprags ma bcu cha dang bcas pa gcig gcod kyi phyi mtshams nang mtshams bcas/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig la las rung gi bsnyen pa tshar bzhi/ bsnyen chen du grags pa ltar bsnyen pa gle ba bsnyen sgrub sprags ma bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gcig 'jigs byed bcu gsum la bsnyen pa tshar gnyis/ gshin rje gshed da gra nag gshed dmar bcu gsum ma dang gshed dmar lha lnga/ zhe dgu ma rnams re re/ rig byed ma tshar gnyis/ gzhan yang kye — rīrīcho 49

rdor/ 'khor chin/ gur rigs bsdus/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ dus 'khor/ ma hā ma ya/thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ stag phu'i sgrol ma/ kun rig rdor dbyings/ chajamartodapal gsang ldan/ rnam snang mngon byang / 'byung 'dul// lha mo khro gnyirabyucan/ thub pa dam tshig gsuyobakod rnams la bsnyen pa re re btang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po la bsnyen pa lan bcu btang / de re re'i skabs bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum re bzlas/ phal cher la sbyin sreg phul/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng / 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ tshe dpag med lha dgu rnams la rgyud sde rang skad kyi bsnyen pa tshad ldan rdzi gan nga / thugasarje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rnam 'joms snur lugs/ rkadugs dkor/ dri med rnam gnyis rnams la re re dbyangs can maske dkar po la tshar gnyis/ bka' gdams jig le bcu drug la tshar gnyis/ chos skyong skor la mgon po bar chad kun sel la lan bcu gcig mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/ mgon ljang / tshe bdag mgon po/ gur mgon/ phyag bzhi ba rnams la re re/ zhal bzhi ba la tshar bzhi/chos rgyal phyi sgrub nang sgrub yang gsang dug ri nag po/ dmag zor ma/ drag pa lcam sring / dur khrod bdag po rnams la bsnyen 56

pa re re btang gsungs/ 'di dag ni rags rim tsam yin la sku 'da' kha'i bar du lo ltar dpyid mthug dang / ca dbyar dang /ston stod bka' cho sa bar ma chad— par gnadzozhing / ston mjugadagun dpyid stod bcas la metshams bsdamasapodayobacad rgya'i khongs su bzhugs pa kun gyis shes/ de ltar sngar nas thos pa rgya chen po btsal bar ma zad/ nyams len spyi dag/ mtshams bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su'ang mdo sngags khyi(dang / bye brag yi dmakharang rang gi rgyud dang ṭīk+ka ba skyed rdzogs sogs larang gis zhib dpyod dang / bla ma la dogs shacod zhu ba sogs thos sgoyozung 'brel kyis nyams len byas pa'i 'bras bu ni 'khor ba la zhen log dang / byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sogs thugs rgyud la 'khrungs te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don ma gtogs thugara'il dgongs rgyu mid par bshud sgrub zung du 'brel bayobastan pa'i srog bzung ba soms rnal du gnas pa kun gyis mngon sum du grub po/ /gzhan yang de ltar nyams su blangasapa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa dang / yi dam gyi hodu mas zhal gzigs pa sogs shin tu mang mod/ bka' gdams gsar rnying gi rnam par thar ba ltar yon tan thams cad busponang gi mar me bzhin sba bar mdzad cing rgyusko du khengs sgyung kho na gnang ba 51

daspir na/ khong rang nyid kyi/sa bris pa'i rnam thar sa bon las/oṃ su sti/ 'dir gleng bar bya ba'i gtam gzhi ni/ snga sor zhig byadzā rgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed lung chos yon tan gyi gter mdzod mā the zi grags pa rgya mtsho ba khu dbon gyis nyid nas rang rnam zhig thugs rjes gzigs pa mkhyen/ che phra kun gyi rnam thar la sku na gzhon pa'i skabs kyi mdzad spyod nyung ba dang / so so'i zhal slob res brtsams pa tsho ha cang ma 'brel ba dang / rnam par mi 'tsham pa'i zol sbyor mang bas rnam thar bzang bo'i gzhung bslad pa sogs kyis rang rtsom gtsang ma zhig cis kyang mkhyen zhes gsang bor smra ba nan che ba dang / khyad par gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang yongs 'odzin grags rgyam pa ched mngags kyis gdong kha dar che legs bcas nyid kyi rang rnam zhig gal che tshul nan che ba phebasakyang / skabs der nge—da rang lta bu rnam thar gyi 'os su gyur pa med tshul zhus/ phyis su yang byang rgyud kyi sde snod 'dzin pa du ma dang / gdan sa rang gi 'dun ldan du mas yang yang bskul ba nan che ba dang / dam pa de dag gi bka' lung gyen du bzlog 'os min/ khyad par du gong sa mchog rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha skal gcig pur gyur pa dang nang thugs kyi dgongs pa'ang zab cing brling bas rten 'brel ma 'dzol ba gal che snyam 5lha —

nas thabs med du sa bon tsam 'god na/ ji skad du rje bstan pa'i sgron mes/ sgro btags chu bo gyen du 'thor yang mkha' la chags pa'i gnas ma mchis/ /skur 'debs me lce thur du phyogs kyang rang gi dge ba'i yan lag bsreg /ces gsungs pas sgro skur med pa gal che zhing / lhag par bdag nyid sgrogs shing gzhan skyon gleng ba/ yon tan min pa la yon tan du btags pa'i log bshad sogs kyis ma bslad pa dang / rgyal ba'i dbang bo bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ lkog tu sgrib kyang mngon gyur ba/ /'og rlung dri ngan lta bu gang / /ci tsam sbas pa de tsam du/ /ngan par go ba rang mtshang ngo / /zhes skyon la yon tan du sgro btags pa ci byas kyang ngan pa'i rang mtshang bzang 'dod thal mos khebs pa gnas min pas rang gi spyod tshul ji bzhin 'doms dgos rgyu la rang bstod ci tsam che'ang / dman pa'i skye bo bstod drags na/ /phyi nas de nyid khyad du gsod/ /mkha' la mi gtsang gtor gyur na/ /gtor ba po yi spyi bor 'bab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lags pas snag shog gron pa las snying bo ril tsam yang med do/ /de yang 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ nga rgyal 'di yi che lugs kyis/ /dge bshes skye ba yin par nges/ /'dod chags 'di yi che lugs kyis/ /bya pho'i dze 53

skye ba yin par nges/ /zhe sdang 'di yi che lugs kyis/ /sbrul gyi skye ba yin par nges/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chags sogs dug lnga shas che zhing mkhas btsun bzang gsum sogs dam pas bsngags 'os kyi yon tan til tsam yang mi dmigs pa bcas kyis nga'i skye ba sngon ma zhig la skyes bu dam pa zhig lta ci/ kun gyis ya rab tu byed rgyu zhig kyang gtan med/ bag chags ngan pa sad lugs/ sems kyi 'char sgo/ lus ngag gi byed spyod gang la bltas kyang ngan pa thag chod cig yin pas skyes rabs bzang bo sha stag gsar bsgrigs kyis dam pa rnams la skyes rabs kyis sdig ma bsags/ 'on kyang dpal ldan zla bas/ las kyi shugs ni chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra/ /las dbang chu klung bzlog pa rab tu dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin sngon las kyi sdig pa'i khur chen theg pa'i glang rgun ser gzugs nga 'dra ba zhig tu gyur pa red lags/ zhes khengs skyung 'di 'dra ba mdzad pa ni bka' gdams pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun pa dang / rjes 'jug rnams la gdams ngag khyad par ba bstan pa las/ khong rin po che de lta bu zhig yin min ni/ ya rabs ma rabs spyod pas shes/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar khong 54 dhe

gi mdzod pa thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang cha nas thes nus so/ /de ltar thos sgom gyi 'bras bu rtags mtshan mngon du gyur pa dag ni bum nang gi mar me bzhin sbed par mdzad pas shes dka' yang / 'ga' zhig ni ri khrod du nyin gcig skyabs mgon rin po che'i sku mdun du phebs par skyabs margon rim/ po che'i 'al nas/ de ring khyod 'dir 'ongs pa la bltas sam mdang nga'i rmi lam du rang gis chos gos ser po dri ma med pa zhig gyon/ khyod kyang gam na 'dug mdun du bye'u chung zhig 'dug pa la gzhan zhig gis mkhas mchog yon tan 'od red zer ba zhig byung ba ci yin nam zhes lan gnyis gsungs/ khong a lags rin po che 'di bas gsungs pa/ de skabs ma shes mod phyis bsam na rab tshes lcags bya'i gnam lo gsar bzhad la sku phreng 'di bar rab byung 'bul ba'i gras thob pa dang / phyis tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi bslab pa phul ba sogs la bltas sam snyam pa kun rtog la shar/ zhes ṅge tsam las ma gsungs mod/ don la ni mkhas mchog yon tan 'od kyi skye ba yin par lung bstan pa dang / sku tshe 'dir yang skye bo mang bo dge tshul slong gi sdom pa la bkod pa dang / 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo'i 'grel ba sogs 'dul ba'i gzhung rtsom dang / bslab bya gnam rtse lding ma sogs 55

'dul ba'i skor gyi chos bka' mang bo'i lung dang baya/da lung khrid sogs yang yang gnang nas mkhas mchog yon tan 'od kyi rnam par thar ba ltar bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa dgung du 'degs pa'i lung bstan pa yin no/ /lo kya tun la mjal du phebs nas bde mchog yab yum gyi thugs dam mdzad tshe mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhig gis chang thod phor gang khyer te byon nas 'di 'thung zer nga ni dge slong yin pas chang 'thung mi rung snyam du ma gsol bar/ mkha' 'gro ma des phyag gis ma ne'i 'og nas bzung ste 'gram pa gtsir nas chang thod phor gang bo khar blugs pa de nas bzung ste chos 'chad pa la sngar las kyang shar shar thon pa da lta'i 'di lta bu byung zhes snod ldan 'ga' zhig la gsungs 'dug yang de'i skabs phyir lam se tha zi nas phyir 'ongs lam du rgya mo bong bu zhon pa zhig gis rjes zin nas shing thog dang / dong tse sogs gnang ste shin tu dga' nyams kyis/bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gcig rjes bzlos byed bcug ste nub phyogs shig tu song / phyis skyabs mgon rin po che nas su dang e 'phrad gsung / rgyu mtshan 56

de zhus pas de ka red ces gsung phebs/ a khu rin po che thugs rje can nas gsung 'phros su dri ba gnang ba la'ang de ltar zhus pas/ na tshod ci 'dra 'dug gsungs par/ nga las cung mtho snyam zhus par/ 'o byed dgos pa yin no gsungs pa la bltas na ḍa tī'i rol ba'am/ zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs mod kyang snga phyi 'di dag gi skabs su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas zhal gzigs pa yin te/ gsang rnam las/ grub pa mchog gi sar gshegs pha mthing ba'i/ /zung 'jug mngon du mdzad pa'i rags pa'i rten/ /he rukaḥ dpal mchod pa'i sprin spros pas/ /rgyal yum mkha' spyod dbang mo mngon sum gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/mdang nga'i rmi lam du ri khrod gong ma'i sgom khang gsar ba'i nang du yod pa 'dra ba la/ mal nas yar langs ma thag 'dra ba la gzim dpon dkon mchog bstan 'dzin nas khrus chu khyer nas 'ongs/ khrus byas pa dang thun gyi mgo brtsams pas nyi ma lhag shar bas/ nga'i sems la 'dir ri mgor song bas des shar snga ba red snyam sgo'i phyi rol tu song pas nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la shar phyogs nas nyi ma shar 'dug de'i gzugs brnyan nub ri'imakha'i mthongs su shar ba la de yang nyi ma ji bzhin pa 'dug lhor 57

bltas pas brag ri mne+e zeng nge ba mang bos bskor ba jig phyisasu mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi dbang zhig de nas lo der bton pas der bltas pa e yin snyam zhes gsungs yod/ lo der mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi dbang gsung yul ni bla go rdo rje 'chang —'di ba yin la/ der bltas pa yin snyam zhes gsungs pa ni/ rje 'di ba'i mdzad 'phrin lung bstan par snang ste/ khrus byas thun gyi mgo brtsams pas nyi ma lhag shar pas nga'i sems la 'dir ri mgor song pa des shar ba red snyam zhes pa ni/ sku tshe stod dgung lo sum cu yar mar nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mgo bzung cuba'i lung bstan dang / sgo'i phyi rol tu song bas nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la shar nas nyi ma shar 'dug ces pa ni/ bar skabasasu mdo smad spyi dang / bye brag bkra shis 'khyil 'dir hos 'khrug sogs kyi rkyen las dus mi bde ba byung mod/ rje 'di ba ri khrod nas dgon par phebs nas yun ring bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa bskyangs pas byin rlabs kyis rim gyis zhi ste bde 'jags su song bas mdo khams shar phyogs 'dir rgyal bstan nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa dang / de'i gzugs brnyan nub ri'i mkha'i mthongs su shar ba la de yang nyi ma ji bzhin 'dug gsungs pa ni/dze+enub phyogs dbus gtsang gi sangs rgyas bsta/na pa'i bdag po paṇa 58

chen sku phreng snga phyi gnyis sogs bstan 'dzin du ma slob mar gyur ba dang / mdo stod khams phyogs kyi lab mkhan chen dang /zur mang kun khyab sogs bstan 'dzin du ma slob mar gyur te bstan rgyun mdo dbus gtsang gsum du khyab pa'i lung bstan dang / lhor bltas pas brag ri mtho zeng nge ba mang pos bskor ba rmis gsungs pa ni/ mthar lho phyogs kyi yul gru chen po dag gi mi rigs rnams kyis srid la dbang sgyur ba'i lung bstan du dzhanges so/ /yang 'jigs byed gozhi bsnyen chen mor bzhugs skabs/ nang gcig thun dang bo grol 'phral kha ba phyags phyir ra bar phebs pas spyil bu'i g.yon zur ngos 'ja' tshon kha dog dmar po gsal dwangs rlum po zhig 'dug pa la ya mtshan kha ba sa la chags pas 'ja' shar ba 'dug snyam ring zhig bltas pas 'phral mig 'dzum gcig la glo bur du med song zhes gsungs 'dugade yang 'ja' rang 'ga' ba zhig —min par dag pa'i gzigs snang khyad par ba zhig yin par nges te gsang rnam las/ 'jigs mdzad rngo rje'i rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthus/ /zhi khro rab 'byams bgrang yas dkyil 'khor lha/ /dag pa'i brtan g.yo'i bkod pa 'bum shar bas/ /dmar bo'i mdangs 'dzin 'od kyi gur khyim gzigs/ /zhes gsungs/ mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen 59

chen skabs/ srod thun la rkyen med par gting nas ngu snying zhig 'ongs nas mang po ngus/ /phyi nyin nyi dros tsam na skyabs mgon nas gnang byung zer ba gcig 'byor ba la bltas pas/ srid dang zhi ba ro mnyam nyid gyur pa'i/ /sgrib bral zag med ye shes chos kyi sku/ /thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' bde yis/ /ngo mtshar gang de rdo rje 'chang gi 'phrul/ /zhes pa 'dug pas snga gong gi de yang sems sun pa min nges shar/ zhes gsungs/snga gong gi dgong mo rkyen med par gting nas ngu snying 'ongs nas mang bo ngus pa de yang / sems sun snang skyes nas ngus pa zhig min nges shar zhes don gyis rtogs pa zhig skyes pa zhal kyis bzhes 'dug la/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung ris la bltas na/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi chos sku dang / thabs bde ba chen po'i ye shes mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ par nges te/ dpal ldan zla bas/nang du rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang du 'byung / /rab tu dga' ba las byung mchi mas mig brlan zhing / /lus kyi ba spu ldang bar 'argyur ba gang yin pa/ /de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo yi sa bon yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rtogs pa khyad par ba re rgyud la skyes tshe dga' ba'i dbang gis mchi mas mig brlan ba 60

du ma yod do/ /yang gsung las/ bar skabs shig mnal lam —du brag dmar bo zhig gi sked na 'phred lam zhig yod par phyin trepas thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri red snyam pa skya btsun gnyis yod pa'i skya bo des dang bor mi rtso dga' zhing brnyas thabs byed kyang phyi nas mgo bos btud/ de nas btsun gzugs des bdag la ches cher brnyas shing 'phya ba la ma 'dzem par phyin pas brag phug cig na thugs rje chen porkami phal gyi lus tshad las nyis 'gyur gyi che ba'i sku dwangs gsal/ dar mthing gi na bza' dang dar thod can zhig bzhugs pa la tshad med gapa'i dad pa zhig skyes te bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob pa zhig mkhyen zhus par/ yong gsungs/ bsam ngo la tshe 'di'i snang shas tsam yang kha ma bri/ nyon mongs mgo rgod du 'dug pas nyon mongs pa'i spyod tshul 'dis de'i bar ji 'dra yong snyam 'jigs zhum pa zhig byung nas/ ji ltar yang las nyon gyi 'khor ba 'di bzlog thub pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen zhus par/ yong gsungs/ nged phyir thon nas brag de'i steng du phyin nas gnas pa la/ skabs shig thugs rje chen po de phyi rol tu phebs byung /dad pa tshad med pa zhig skyes/ dngos po zhig 'di la 'bul rgyu yod na ci ma rung snyam pas gzhun med kyang lag tu ja phor ba 61
