gang yod pa de phul bas/ phyag yar bskyangs te bsnams yong pas dga' dad ches cher skyes pa zhig rmis/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i rnam pa yi ge phyed dang bzhi ba bya ba zhig yod pa de dang mthun/ rmi lam gyi bab skyabs mgon gong ma de dang 'gris/ pa byung / zhes gsungs pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar zhig yod par nges mod zhib par shes dka' la/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mngon sum bstan pa yin te gsang rnam las/mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i nyams snang la/ /snying rje'i gter chen 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /rgya jas mchod cing gang gang gsol btab pa/ /de de bzhin du 'grub ces gsal bar gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang khong gis gsungs pa/ nub gcig mnal lam du ri zhig gi steng na steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad shel gyi rang bzhin can rtse bcu drug pa zhig 'dug pa la mi zhig gis steng du song dang stong gsums gyi bkod pa thams cad mthong ngo zer/ rtse bcu bzhi bdwo phyin te bltas pas khor yug kun smug teng nge ba la ri'i phreng ba re spel bar yod pa las gzhan ma mthong / da dung steng du song dang je gsal du 'gro zhes nan che ba byas kyang yom yom g.yo bas4 'gro ma nus par ri'i phag na rgyal sras sku mched gsum bzhugs — 62 sge

pa mjar du phyin/ phu chung ba yin rgyu des cang mi gsung / spyanadzhasnga bas dge bshes 'di la mjol gsungs/ po to ba dang yang mjal/ mnal sad pa dang rdo rje 'chang dang zung 'jug gi thig le mjal ma nus pa bsod nams re chung snyam yang zhib par bsam pas de dang mtshungs pa byung snyam pa log pa'i 'khrul ngor thar/po to ba skyabs mgon 'khrungs rabs na bzhugs pas mgo bo gtugs tsam min par sel ma shor ba dgos pa go /phyis skyabs margon sku 'da' bar nye ba'i sngon der zhal nas/ sku zhabs sku tshe phreng brgyud la 'khon ma zhugs pa zhig yin tshe chosargyun de kho rang gis thob 'dug na spyod pa rtsing yang mnyan pas chog 'khon zhugs yod na sel bya ba de la zer bas mnyan gsungs pas zing cha mang bo byung skabs kyang gang yin gyi zer rjes bsnyegs te rang phungs gzhan phungs ma byas pa'ang de tshos yin/ zhes gsungs /'di skabs kyi mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i nyams la ri shel gyi rang bzhin rtse mo bcu drug pa gsungs pha ni/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi nyams len la gzhol bar mdzad nas zung 'jug chos sku'i thig le mngon du gyur bas bka' gdams sku mched gsum dang dngos sumajal ba yin te gsad rnam las/ lha chos bdun ldan zung 'jug thig lde'i chos/ /zab gsal gnyis 63

med lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /zung 'jug chos sku'i thig le mngon gyur bas/ /sku mched gsum gyis dgyes pa'i dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang skabs shig rgan gya'i brag dkar la gnas mjal du phebs/ gnas khang nas rdo kha shas khyer long ba lam du chu la steng gi 'dam bkrus pas/ nub mo rmi lam du —rdo de rnams bkrus pa'i 'dam phye rnams sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs sha stag tu chu la g.yeng pa'i rmi ltas byung zhes gsungs pa yang / gang snang lha skur 'char ba'i rtogs pa brnyes pa dang / yang mtshan lam du mkha' 'od dwangs gsal gyi rang bzhin na lha dang lha mo 'phan dang rgyal mtshan thogs pa mang po shar phyogs su 'gro ba'i rjes na lab lung skyabs mgon red zer ba'i 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin dwangs gsal sgrib med la sku mdangs smug po gdong zor ba/ phyag g.yas kyis rang gi kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'phan chung g.yer kha can zhig yod pa bsnams nas mkha' la shar du 'gro ba zhig rmis/ de gnas byin rlabs che nges su 'dug ces gsungs pa yang brag dkar de 'khor lo bde mchog gi gnas yin pas bde mchog gi zhal gzigs par mngon mod zur tsam las mi gsungs 'dug rjes sor shel dgon du bzhugs skabs ma/ma gung ma lon tsam na gam 'khod grwa chung zhig ra bar phyin pas 64

gnas ri'i tshortse nas 'ja' tshon nyis rim zhig shar ba'i sne khong bzhugs gnas kyi gzims khang steng du zug pa mthong pa bzhin ri khrod pa rnams kyis kyang mthong / mkha' ngos 'ja' tshon dra ba 'od ljang khus khebs/ shel dgon nas phebs pa'i nang par bcibs thog nas nyi zla skar gsum khong nyid dang zhabs 'brang thams cad kyis mthong / zhal nas nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig la 'dzoms pa rten 'brel legs zhes gsungs/ de nas rim gyis phebs par sngar shel dgon gyi gnas ri nas 'ja' shar ba de rje nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ste 'ongs pa kun gyis mthong / zhal nas da 'gror mi 'jug ka gsungs nas bcibs las babs ste de phyogs su phyag gnang zhing rkang brgyad sogs gsungs/ de skabs 'ja' de khong nyid kyi phyogs su gcig dang / phar phyogs su gcig chad de cha gnyis su gyur/ de nas phebs pas yang 'ja' gnyis mthud de sngar bzhin 'ongs pa sogs ltas ya mtshan pa mang po byung ba ma dang mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma gnang ba red do/ /bya khyung du chos rje don 'grub rin chen gyi gser gdung zhig gso'i skabs bdud rtsi babs pa kun gyis mthong / a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub phug tu bzhugs skabs a rang byon zhig kyang byung / yang sog po'i 'dus ri'i rtser phebs skabs mkha' ngos 'ja' tshon gyis 65

sbrel ba dang nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig tu shar ba kun gyis snye—mthong zhing / rma chen gyi gangs ri de nyid 'khor lo bde mchog gi pho brang yin pa la rma chen sgo srung gi tshul du yod pa gzigs/dga' dad spro gsum dang byams snying rje'i dbang gis spyan chab ske rgyun ring bsil/ gsang rnam las/ 'dus ri zhes grags sa 'dzin dbang po'i rtser/ /phyi bltas lhun chags gangs ri'i rnam pa la/ /nang du 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang gi/ /sgo srung tshuladu rma rgyal bzhugs pa gzigs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang paṇa chen rin po che sku gong ma bla brang nas yar khams phyogs su phebs— zin skabs shig khong gi zhal nas/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du paṇa chen rin po che rus rgyan mnabs nas phebs te dung dkar zhig — gnang nas 'di bdag gyis zhes gsungs pa zhig rmis gsungs/nye gnas kyis/ paṇa chen rin po ches khong gi gsung 'bum bdag gyis zhes pa'i brda red pa zhes zhus pas/ khong gis ma red sprul sku bdag gyis gsungs pa red ces gsungs/ de nas ma 'gor bar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku 'da' tshul bstan —pa'i glog 'phrin 'byor/ yang skyabs mgon bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sku 'da' tshul bstan nas zla drug gi mtshams su khong gis gsung pa/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du mtsho chen po zhig gi kha na sprular+sha66

sku chung chung zhig 'dug paṇa chen snan po che yin rgyu byed kyang nga'i bsam par skyabs mgon yin snyam/ zhabs zhu 'ga' 'dug kyang gling sprul sogs ma red/ sprul skus mtsho khar na bza' dang sku 'dra zhig bkru bzhin phar phebs tshur phebs byas nas bzhugs 'dugamatsho de'i nang kha dog mi 'dra ba'i mtsho sna lnga dbus dang phyogs shaṃzhir yod/ mtsho de'i rgya khyon sku 'bum dang bla brang gi bar gyi sa khyon lta bu rgya che ba'i nang du 'dod yon lnga sogs mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pas gtams 'dug mtsho de lag tu blang na blang chog la/ bzhag na bzhag chog pa zhig rmis zhes gsungs pa yang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gi ci yang sprul rin po che la chos bka' mang bo phul te bdag gir bzhes pa dang / skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che 'di ba 'khrungs yul dang mdzad pa sogs lung gsal bor bstan pa sogs ma 'ongs langon sum du gzigs pa'i 'bras rtags shig tu mngon/ 'di dag ni rags rim tsam yin la gsang rnam las/ shel dgon bde chen chos kyi pho brang du/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bas/ /lha ru ka dpal mkha' spyod dbang mo sogs/ /gang snang dag pa'i rol ba 'byams su klas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /smras pa/ mnog chung srid pa'i mching bu yongs dor — 67

nas/ /byang chub sems kyi gru rdzings glugs par bsdams/ /rab dben rin chen 'byung ga nas la zhugs te/ /zung 'jug nor bu len mkhan khyod min su/ /mi gtsang dri la zhen pa'i nag chung sprang / /rab gtsang pad+ma'i tshal la mi gnas bzhin/ /bde med srid par zhen pa'i skye bo dag /bde chen thar ba'i lam dang ring du bral/ /zab gsang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /zab lam rin chen gter gyi sgo phyes te/ /zab don zung 'jug nor bu 'dren mkhas khyod/ /zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i khyab bdag nyid/ /rab tu dbe+en pa'i ri bo'i ba gam las/ /rab 'byams gsung rab nyams su bstar ba'i mthus/ /rab mang rtogs pa'i 'od snang 'bum spros pas/ /rab gsal nam mkha'i nor bu'ang mog por gyur/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las tha ma ra nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs te nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba'i sarga ste gsum pa'o/ /bstan 'gro'i don blabs tshen mngod ba'i sarga/ci rab 'jigs nyon shes sgrib pa'i grong khyer dag /gzhom 68

med bde chen zho 'thung rus pas bcom/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rin chen kyo ba yis/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho 'dren pa'i mgon des skyongs/ /thos don gdams par sharno ba'i nyams len dag /chu shel dbang bo gcig tu legs bskums nas/ /gzhan phan ga bur zegs ma 'bum spros pas/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho spel ba'i byung ba brjod/ /bzhi ba de dag kun kyang bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cing bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'i sgo nas kyang bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad pa ni/ sku bsnyung zhig bzhes pa'i skabs gung thang blo gros zhes yongs sugrags byāpa'i dge bshes chen po des kha dar zhig bskur te zhal 'don gyi skabs sogs su rang gi sku tshe brtan pa'i ched du dmigs na leg/sa tshul gsungs pa bzhin snyan bskul zhus par zhal nas/nga'i tshe gang bo 'dir kha 'don dang dge spyor gang byas thams cad tshe 'di'i ched du dmigs nas bton ma myong / /zhes gsungs/ de ltar thos bsam sgom gsum gang byas thams cad bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo bar mdzad pa ni/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa kho na'o/ /de ltar gzhan sems can gyi don 69

'ba' zhig thugs la dgongs ba na/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i zhal nas/ mi zad srid pa'i 'brog dgon nyam nga bar/ /sdug bsngal khur gyis dub pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /phan dang bde ba'i yal 'dab kune rdzogs pa'i/ /grib bsil chos dang mtshungs pa yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin/ /zhes dang / chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba las sgrol byed kyi thabs dngos ni rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos ston pa kho na yin no/ /de'i skabs thams cad mkhyen pa sgo mang mkhan rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ bka' 'gyur gyi lung ngas thob kyang ma thob/ thob kyang 'don mi nus/ khyod kyis thon dang legs zhes bskul ba dang / yang nyin gcig skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis kha dar che legs shig bskur te gzhung bar lo bstar chags su lam rim bde lam dang 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid res mos su gnang ba'i srol yod pa mi nub par skyongs dgos zhes bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba dang / zhang ston chos kyi rgyal bos/ khyod kyis bton na nga dga' gsungs nas sbas don 70

kun gsal gyi bshad lung gnang bcug sgo mang rdza rje 'chang blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtshos/ bka' 'gyur gyi lung gnang ba shin tu legs/ de bzhin du phyis su'ang bka' chos 'chad spel rgya chen gnang dgos tshul sogs bka' bskul gnang ba la sogs par brten nas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par bskor ba yim/ te rags rim zhig brjod na/ bka' 'gyur tshar gcig bstan 'gyur lung rgyun gang yod tshar gsum/ rje yab sras gsung 'bum tshar bzhi re/ 'dul 'dzin dang rje dge 'dun grub kyi gsung 'bum yang tshar bzhi/ lho brag bka' 'bum/dben sa bka' 'bum/ rgyal dbang bdun pa'i gsung 'bum/lcang skya gong ma ngag dbang chos ldan dang / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum/ klong rdol gsung 'bum/ khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma/ rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan rnams kyi gsung 'bum tshar gnyis re/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum tshar gsum/ dpon slob byams pa'i gsung 'bum tshar bzhi/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i gsung 'bum tshar bdun/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung 'bum mtshar bzhi/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum tshar drug a khu rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum tshar71

bcu gsum/ a khu rin po che zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum tshar dgu/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ zhog don yod mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta/ mkhan rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho rnams kyi gsung 'bum tshar re re/ sngags phyogs po ti/ chos spyod rab gsal sogs lung phran shin tu mang bas grangs kyis mi zin bka' gdams glegs bam tshar bcu/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang / mi la'i mgur 'bum tshar drug re ste rang rang gi grangs tshad bshad pa las mi nyung ba lhag kyang mchis gsungs/ bshad lung gi skor la/ lam rim chen mo tshar sum cur nye ba/ lam rim chung ngu tshar bco lnga/ sngags rim chen mo tshar nyi shu/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ legs bshad snying bo// grub mtha' rtsa 'grel/ lam rim mchan bzhi ma/ rje'i bstod pa don ldan ma rtsa 'grel lan mang por gsungs/ 'grel ba bzhi sprags tshar bdun/ dus 'khor 'grel chen tshar gsum/ sbas don kun gsal tshar nyi shu/ bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho tshar brgyad dam dgu/ rang gis gang thob pa rnams yang yang bton pas grangs mi zin gsungs/ khrid kyi skor bde lam tshar bzhi bcu/ 'jam dpal zhal lung tshar nyi shu lhag gsang bde 72

'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs tshar sum cu re/ mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs tshar bzhi bcu las mi nyung gsungs/ khrid chung gi skor rnams bgrangs kyis mi lang / bla mchod dang phyag chen yang mang du gnang / srad rgyud bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma brgya rtsa tshar brgyad cu lhag mdor dril na lo gcig gi khongs na bka' chos med pa nyin nyi shu las med pa mang gsungs la/ 'di dag ni dgung lo nyi shu rtsa grangs nas lnga bcu ma zin pa'i bar gyi zin tho ltar yin la/ dgung lo lnga bcu nas brgyad cu gya grangs bar du'ang bka' chos rgyun mi chad par gnang ba dang / spyi zur gyi dbang dang rjes gnang / sgom lung rigs gtad srog gtad sogs grangs kyis mi lang la/ che long tsam zhig ni sku tshe 'di nyid kyi rnam thar thar chags su 'god pa'i skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /de ltar bka' chos bar ma chad par gnang ba ma zad/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas kyang rgyal bstan spel ba ni/ dgung lo nga gsum pa sa rta lor sngar chos skyo—nga gi lung bstan du/ phrag dog gya gyu'i dri bzhon 'tshub ma nas/ /zhe sdang du ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa yis/ /gti mug gnyis 'thung bskyon pa'i na ba ste/ /nga rgyal ri bo 'bigs byed drag tu 'bebs/ /zhes gsangs pa dus su bab ste rgya hos kyi 'khrug zing la brten phyi nang — — 73

kun tu zing long byung tshe dgon bkra shis 'khyil 'jig la khad pa'i dus su/ rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul blo bzang grags pa dang / /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku tshe phreng brgyud kyi/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthu byin gyis/ /nag phyogs gdug pa'i bsam sbyor zhi bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs nas zhal slob rnams la lung gnang ste bton pa dang / rgya hos dpon la gus zol sogs thabs mkhas dang / thugs rim sna tshogs mdzad pa'i rkyen las dgon sde bkra shis 'khyil 'dir nang khag re gnyis re la nyes skyon byung ba las gzhan/ dgon spyi gra ma nyams par chags thub pa byung ba'ang rje 'di ba'i 'phrin las kho na yin/ khong gi gsung las/ dgon gra ma chag pa zhig byung bas nyin mtshan kun tu sems la bcangs/ rgyu tshe gcig la go chod pa gcig pur sems yod ces gsungs/ yang grwa ja'i tshogs zangs bcag pa thugs kyis ma bzod par dngul rdo tshad drug gis tshogs zangs bsgrubs/ lha mo bde chen gyi chos thog cig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir dngul srang sum brgya dang dngos po 'bor chen sbyor 'jags mdzad/ shing le khar dus 'khor gsar 'dzugs ched dngul srang drug cu dang / dong tse khron nyis brgya dang ras sogs sbyor 'jags dang brgya mchod phul ba sogs mang / chos dpal nengadzha 74

t+pa dngul rdo tshad nyi shus jo khang bzhengs/ rdo sbis gzhung la gro 'jags drug nas 'jags brgya dang nyi shu/ dong tse tho'u khron nyis stong dang nyis brgya mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i thebs su bzhag phyis su zhig gsos thebs la 'bru bre lnga brgya dang dngul sgor brgya gnang / bya khyung du dge 'dun re re'i phyag tu dong tse khron bdun re phul/ phyis su'ang lan gnyis su 'gyed btang /khong gi 'khrungs yul du mchod rten chen po zhig bzhengs yod pa de'i nyi zla zar tshags kyi ched dngul sgor chig stong drug brgya gnang / zhong shan jo bo la bzang gos yug gnyis las grub pa'i rnam sbyar khyad 'phags dang / dngul gyi 'khor lo 'phreng rgyan zar tshags can dang spos dmar gyi mgul 'phreng sogs phul/ sera'abras sogs dbus phyogs kyi grwa sa thams cad du mi mngags nas dgon sde thams cad la gtong sgo gnang ba dang / dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe grangs yar mar zhig nas lo re bzhin thos bsam gling la grwa ja re gtong bar mdzad pa sogs phyogs ris med kyi dge 'dun rnams la phog 'gyed gnang ste thams cad bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pa bgrangs kyis mi longs la 'ga' zhig rnam thar thar chags su 'god pa'i skabs su gsal/ lha khang gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i skor la/ tshogs chen 'du khang gi gtsang 75

khang rgya bskyed dang / 'du khang steng 'og khyams dang bcas pa la tshon rgyan gsar bas spras shing / rgya gar nag las byung ba'i bzang gos kyi 'phan dang rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas 'du khang gang ba bzhag nang rten yang rje'i lha khang gi nang rten rje'i sku brnyan chen po ni bstan pa'i gegs chag gi dbang gis yang dang yang du me skyon sogs kyi dbang gis ma 'grub par lus pa thugs kyis ma bzod par gzhi nas sman sku chen po thog tshad gnyis can gsar bzhengs mdzad/ lha bzo kun spangs gnas brtan pa dang lhan du dbu ni kho nga gis phyag bzo gnang zhing / thig rtsa sogs bzo las kun la lha bzo dang mnyam du phyag las gnang / gzungs gzhugs la bka' bstan gnyis/ gsung 'bum ches mang po sogs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pas gta mas/ gzhan yang nye sras brgyad dang byams 'jam dbyangs 'jam dpal smra seng gi sku lugs sablugs pa khri tshad ma stong lhag dang gyan thang du ma bcas sogs bzhengs/ gzhan sku bzhengs pa'i sdom grangs ni/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho/mkhan rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ bde mchogangamakha' spyod ma/ khros nag zhal bzhi ba rnams kyi tsa ka li re—bzhengs/ a lags mkhan rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan rgya 76

mtsho'i na bza'i steng du rje'i sku zhig dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rnams bzhengs pa rten bzhengs gyi thog ma red/ phyi nas 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ thugs rje chen po rgyal brgya mtsho/ dus 'khor thang sku che chung gnyis/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ gyan thang gcig bshags lha so lnga gcig thang gnyis/ gsum thang gnyis/ brgyad thang gcig sman sku tshan gnyis bsdoms pas yongs rdzogs bdun/ bde mchog gi thang ga che ba/ mgon chos 'jigs gsum gyi thang ga che ba re re/ dngul rdo tshad bzhi las bsgrubs pa'i rdo'i sku dbu rgyan rin po rnge du mas spras pa rang gi lus tshad can 'di bla brang rgyud khang steng du bzhugs/ gnas bcu dgu thang khyad mtshar zhig chos dpal zhing tshogs chen 'du khang du bzhugs/ yang gnas bcu bdun thang dgon de'i rgyud khang du bzhugs/ yang gnas bcu'i thang ga nyer gsum can khyad 'phags dang / byams pa'i gos sku bcas de ka'i gzim khang du bzhugs/ slar yang bdun thang gcig rnams bsdoms pas tshar bzhi/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi thang ga che ba/ sman bla'i zhing bkod khyad mtshar te gsum po de ka'i sman pa'i 'du khang du bzhugs/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i thang ga che legs de ka'i ri khrod du bzhugs/ rje rin po che 77

tsong kha brgyad cu'i zhal thang bco —lnga gong bsham zhal kheb sogs r+shabasdoms pas dngul rdo tshad re re song pa 'di bla brang tshogs chen 'du khang du bzhugs/ yang rje tsong kha brgyad cu gong gsham zhal kheb spus legs can gyi thang ga bco lnga sman pa'i 'du khang du rībazhugs/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i gser sku che legs shig kyang der bzhag phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi thang sku che legs gcig bla brang rgyud khang du bzhag tshe lha rnam gsum rang gi lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i thang ga che ba gsum/ yang de 'dra'i tshe dpagabyumed gcig ste bzhi/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ rta mgrin/ tshe dpag med/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma sogs bsdoms pas thang ga che chung su ma cur nye ba hor tshang dgon gsar du bzhag yang dgon der 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod gyan thang spus legs gcig bzhagasku phyogs 'khrungs rabs sogs thang ga che chung nyi shu bla brang rgyud khang du bzhag rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sman sku che ba gcig dang /thang ga byin can zhig rgyud khang steng du bzhugs/ mgon chos 'jigs gsum gyi zhal thang che ba mtha' shan spus legs sgrol dkar li ma khri tse gsum can/ rje rin po che'i li ma khri tse do/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa khri tse do/ rje rin po che dang sgrol ma'i sman sku byon legs rnams kwa ring dgon du bzhugs/ shing le khar guradzha78

negon gsar bzhengs dang / gong gi dus 'khor gyi thang sku che ba bzhag shel dgon du rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la grub chen brgyad cus bskor ba'i thang ga che ba gong gsham zhal kheb bcas spus legs shig bzhag bis mdo dgon du thub sku gser zangs las grub pa tshon dgu ba zhig bzhag se chang dgon du jo'i sku khri rgyab yol can zhig bzhag hor tshang tsag tsag dgon par dngul rdo tshad lnga las grub pa'i kun rig dang / 'od dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa thog tshad phyed dang gnyis pa can re bzhengs/ chos dpal zhing gi gzim khang du ston pa/ sgrol dkar/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo gsum rang gi lus tshad can re bzhengs/ des mtshon gzim khang der li ma dang sman sku bsdoms pas sku brnyan che chung brgya dang don bdum/ bzhugs/ yang mgon po'i sku li ma khri tse gsum can/ dngul rdo tshad drug gis blus pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig dngul srang brgya dang don gsum gyis bsgrubs pa'i sgrol ljang gtso 'khor gsum/ sgrol ma khri tshad can rnams gzim khang der bzhugs/ dgung lo zhedzidagu yan gyi sku brnyan li ma dang sman sku bcas drug cu lhag bla brang rgyud khang du bzhugs/ bla brang rngo+ogs chen 'du khang gi rgya mthong gi logs ris thams cad tshwas zos te chud 'dza' ba thugs kyis ma bzod par sngon mo ji bzhin bzhengs nas legs lha9

mdzes su bsgrubs pa de la gyan thang dgu yod pas re re la dngul srang sum cu so drug re yon du phul/ chos dpal zhing du dus 'khor grwa tshang du dngul sgor drug cu re lngas dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku —mi tshad tsam bzhengs te bzhag pa dang / dngul sgor stong phrag—gsum gyis sangs rgyas stong sku bzhengs shing log ris kyi thebs su'ang dngul srang drug cu phul/ bla brang brtsan khang du gyan thang gsum bzhag rgan rgya'i ban rgyar thang ga gsum bzhag nas ltung bshags btsugs/ gzhan yang gtongasna rtsa bzhag tho ni/ mtsho khar—bzang spyod 'don rgyun la khron lnga bcu dang 'bru 'jags bzhi/hor tshang tsag tsag dgon par bzang spyod gsar btsugs kyi thebs la khron drug brgya dang nas bre nyis brgya/ bkra shis sgar du—bde mchog bdag 'jug gsar btsugs kyi rten khron brgya dang lnga bcu/ kha gya'i sgar rnying jidu ltung bshags phyag mchod gsar btsugs la khron brgya dang nyi shu/ gsang 'dus bdag 'jug gsar tshugs la nas bre bzhi brgya/ sgar gsar du byams khang gichathebs la khron stong / mdzod dge dme po'i sgar gsar du khron—stong / chas pa rgya mkhar dgon zhig gsos 'theb la dngul sgor sum brgya dang gos ser bo kha bcu/ rje mi la'i sku tshon lnga can/dngul gyi mchod rten dang sgrol dkar li ma khri tse gang re/ sa——rī 80

dmar dgon pa zhig gsos ched tho'i khron brgya dang bco lnga/dngul ri'i ser sder ltung bshags gsar btsugs la mchod 'theb lnga bcu/ mar me'i rkong bu brgya/ dngul srang don lnga/ bla brang lo rnying lcags mkhar gyi 'theb la khron stong dang brgyad brgya bzhagagazhan yang sa bon du ma thebs pa du ma yod de dper na/ dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon du bka' 'gyur snar thang dpar ma tshar gcig gnang ba dang / rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum sogs gsung 'bum du ma bzhengs pa dang / rje rin po che'i sku brnyan sogs sku brnyan dang mchod rten gyi gzungs gzhug la'ang bka 'a bstan sogs po ti stong phrag mang bo phul ba sogs shin tu mang /khong gi zhal nas 'di dag kyang lag tu gang 'byor 'phral du phul ba ma gtogs/ gzhan la slong mo byas pa dang / gzhan gyi rdzas rang gi yin khul byas pa med ces gsungs/smras pa/ thos bsam sgom pa'i rin chen rdul mang las/ /nyer bskrun nyams rtogs rin chen lhun po la/ /bsdu bzhi'i bang rim rin chen ba gam mdzes/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las rin chen 'od stong 'bar/ /ting 'dzin lha yi gzhal med khang chen dbus/ /zung 'jug zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /bde stong ye shes rtse brgya 'bar ba yis/ /kun rtog lha min yongs kyi g.yul ngo 81

bzlog /thabayoshes gser gyi chu 'dzin stug po las/ /dam chosposprin gyi me to ga 'bum phab ste/ /log rtog zhugs chen gzhil dang lhan cig tu/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i rtsi bcud lo 'dab rgyas/ /khab len rdo chen lcags dang ma 'phrad par/ /lcags phye yongs su 'dren pa'i ngangaci tshul ltar/ /zhen pa gtan bral rigs brgya'i khyab bdag la/ /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas sprin bzhin 'du bar gyur/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong gis/ /thub bstan gling chen bzhi la dbang bsgyur te/ /zung 'jug 'chi med gnas la dbang 'byor bas/ /nga las nu yi grags pa zil gyis mnan/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa the btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las thog mtha' bar gsum gyi dge tshogs kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor cing / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas spyang bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen mdzad pa'i sarga ste bzhi ba'o/ /gasnyeska zha snyu ne+e zharda haṃd/ཿrnan gin nagaska0nin ban chagaska spyo zha|na bu/'jigasnya bral rdo rje'i khri la dbang 'byor zhing / /skal ldan (82

'chi med bye ba'i mgon du gyur/ /'phrin las lhun 'grub ga bur 'bum 'dzag pa/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho spel ba'i dpal du gyur/ /chos sku'i rang gzugs bye ba brgya stong las/ /zhing 'dir gsum ldan ngur smrig rnam rol ba'i/ /byung ba rin chen ngo mtshar 'bum phrag dag /snyan pa'i tshig gi srad bur brgyu bar bya/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa sku tshe 'di nyid gyi rnam thar rags rim thar chags su 'god pa la/ sku bltams ging mtshan gyi me stog rgyas te gong ma'i khri la mnga' gsol ba'i sarga/ rje 'di gang du skye ba bzhes pa'i yul ni/ rgyal bo'i bka' 'bum las/ bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul// /sa mtho ri gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod gangs can gyi yul yin la/ de la stod smad bar gsum du phye na/ stod mnga' risi skor gsurma/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug go /stod rma nga' ris skor gsum ni/ spu hreng / mang yul/ zangs dkar gsum skor gciga'achim mam li/ bru sha sbal ti gsum skor gcig zhang zhung cho/khri te stod/ khri te smad gsum skor gcig tu byed do/ /bar 83

thabus gtsang ru bzhi ni/ snga mo'i dus/ dbus la dbu ru g.yo ru gnyis/ gtsang la g.yas ru dang ru lag gnyis te bzhi zer yang /chos rgyal kau sgri han gyis khri skor bcu gsum dbang du bsdus te rgyal dbang lnga ba rin po cher phul phyin la/ g.yas ru/ la /yon ru/ spus ru/ gung ri bzhir byas pa yin no/ /smad mdo khams sgang drug ni/ zal mo sgang / tsha ba sgang / smar khams sgang / spo 'bor sgang / dmar rdza sgang / mi nyag rab sgang dang drug go /de dag la bod chol kha gsum du grags te/ mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan dbus gtsang chos kyi chol — kha/ de nas rma chu'i khug pa yan mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ de nas rgya'i mchod rten dkar bo yan mdo smad rta'i chol kha/ phyi ma mdo smad rta'i chol kha 'di la chu klung chen po rma chus bgos te— mdo smad lho rgyud dang byang rgyud gnyis yod pa'i nang nas/ rje 'di ba 'khrungs yul ni mdo smad lho rgyud yin la/ de yang yum las bstan pa byang nas byang du dar bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa'i byang dar gnyis pa'i lte ba/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dang thag ha cang ring ba'i sa cha/lung ba'i mdo rma klung phyogs la gtad cing / phu shar lhor bltas pa'i lung ba mang du yod pa las/ yar nang tsho lngar grags pa'i 84

ya gyal kwa ring zhes pa lung ba'i sked na ker langs kyi rdo ka ba lta bu zhig yod pa las btags pa yin zhing / lo rgyus la lar brag ker langs 'di 'dra la dngos grub kyi rtags mtshan du bshad pa'ang yod ces dang / la las bde marngog gi yul nyer bzhi'i nang gi bre ta bu ri yin zer/ chu shing 'dzoms la lo tog smin pa/ phu na 'brog gi rtswa sa'ang yod pas/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge/ /'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge/ /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog 'brog gi dge/ /khang shing bud shing shing gi dge/ /khang rdo thab rdo rdo yi dge/ /zhes pa ltar gyi sa'i dge bcu tshang ba zhig go/ /yul mi rnams g.yo sgyu med pa/ ma bcos pa'i rang bzhin drang bo can/ rkun jag sogs spyod dzan gyi mig ltos mi byed cing /dkon mchog la dad pa/ phal cher gzugs byad bzang zhing smra sgo yangs pa sogs chos sgrub pa'i rten 'os pa shas che ba'i yul sde de'i nang du rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i zad pa me pho stag gi lo'i tha skar gyi nya la dge mtshan gyi ltas dang bcas te rje 'di ba sku bltams/ rje 'di'i yab ni bis mdo'i dpon rgyud a brtan bu bdun gyi rgyud las a bo rta mgrin zer ba de yin gsungs/ a bo rta mgrin gyi pha mes brgyud rirma ni dpal ldan 'bras spungs pa'i mi ser hor sog sde ma zhes pa sa dkar gdong drug gi dbus 85

pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar a brtan zer ba srong btsan gdung rgyud du skyes pa zhig yod pas kha'i nu bo de ka'i dpon sar bzha ga ste kho rang sa skyar phyin/ gong spa rin po ches bse'i ga'u kharī sbyor dab / gur mgon sku/ dar nag po kha gang dang bcas pa bstsa la te bod sog gi sa mtshams su mngags/ de dus bla ma dka' chibazhi ba bya bas dka' chen bcu drug phyir khrid pa gdan drangs/ bse'i ga'u da lta yod pa 'di yin gsungs pas khong gi dus su yod 'dug kyang da lta yod med cha ma 'tshal/ a brtan la rgyal mtshan dang bkra shis zer ba'i bu gnyis skyes/ bkra shis kyis dkyil 'khor sgar ba byas/ rgyal mtshan gyis gzhi bzung bas bu bdun skyes pa la a brtan bu bdun du grags/ khong gi yab a bo rta mgrin3 de'i rgyud pa zhig yin la/ mo ni ko'u a dpon zer pas byang rgyud kyi dgon sde rnams brlags zin nas mdo smad lho rgyud kyi dgon sde rnams gzhom du 'ongs pa khong gi yab de nyid kyis 'thab mos bzlog ste de phyogs bde 'jags su song ba yin zhing dpa' grags che/ lo rgyus zhib par 'bras spungs 'is mdo'i mi tshan du yod zer/ des na khong gi gdung rus ni spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po'i gdung rgyud yin 'dug khongaju gi skyed yum lha mo byams ni khong gi sku phreng gong ma bla go bla tshi 8sgo

sari 'jim dergyangs rgya mtsho'i tsha mo'i bu mo yin la yab yum radzo4 bzhin drang zhing dkon mchog la dad pa dang ldan pa zhig yin/ khong gi ma yum gyis ko'u sde dpal ldan zhes pa chos dbyings stobs ldanardo rje'i skye bar gleng ba de las 'ja' tshon snying bo'i pho ba sto 'jag tshugs mjil sbyangs pas rtags thon/ khong gi yab yum gnyis dgarme 'dus su song yang khyo shug ma bsdeb pa'i bar der ma la khong mngal du zhugs/ ma yum rang gi spun zla mo lo ba zer ba'i khyim du bsdad pa 'i tshe spun zla mo'ijikhyo ga snying byams rgyal zer gdes mdang nga'i rmi lam la nged kyi khyim gzhi der mchod rten chen po zhig yod pa'i mdun na lab tse zhig kyang byung bgirmis zer5 zhi nga / de nub lha mo byams la khong 'khrungs pas snying byams rgyal dga' nas 'khur ba gsar ba gnyis btsos nas blta ru 'ongs pa red/ sku bltams dus mtshadz+wa mo yirna yang khyim du mun pa med par dkarosangs kyis song stabayogayog mo zhig yod pa des nam langs song bsam nas ldang bar—brtsams pa na yul lugs kyis skar khung na bser bu 'gog ched zar ma'i rtswa'i phung bo brdzangs pa mthong pas mo skrag ste ldang ma nus zer/ khong gis khengs skyungs gnang nas bden rdzun ma shes gsungs spyang bden par nges te phyis kyi mdzad pa dang mthun par yod do/ /sngar mi tshang dbul 87

phyug snyom pa zhig yin kyang phyis su za nyes 'thung nyes kyis nor sdas zad/ gter zhig bsgrub pa la bum pa gas pa'i rten 'brel gyis tha mar dbul bor song pa red zer/ khong dgung0 lo bane+e lnga lta bu zhig la rgad po zhig yod pa/ shi nas pha ma tsho las kasabyubrel te song shul du khong sgo khang lam srang du phag khu ma bu tsho dang lhan — sdod byed dgos byung bas grib kyis thebs te zhal gyi tshems thams cad nag por gyur/ na nas sku 'da' la khad byung / de'i tshe thar ba gling du khyer nas gser khang ba'i slob ma ri khrod pa zhig yod pas byabs khrus re gnang bas dwangs skyed cung thon yang khong gi mas nang phyags pa'i gad snyigs thab tu mer bsregs pas ma rang gi mig na nas zla ba phyed bcas gnyis tsam la thar ba gling du 'dug dgos byung / chide skabs khong stag ge tshang nas der bzhugs spong ba pa rnams la bde mchog dang 'jigs byedarī blo 'dzin gyi rgyugs bzhag pas gnas po dge slo—nga gis 'dzin gshar byed pa khong gi snyan lam du son pas blo la thon nas dge slong des blo la mi thon pā dag khong gis gsal 'debs byed thub pa byung / 'di deng dus kyi’rdzun lab kyis lung ston khul byed pa sogs la ba ga chags sad pa red zer ba dang mi 'dra bar sngon sbyangs kyi bag chags sad pa'i rtags mtshan yang dag go/ /'on kyang der 88

bzhugs ring la sangs dwangs ma byung bas shel dgon du gdan drangs/ 'di'i thad gsang rnam las/ /thar ba gling nas tho rengs dgon pa ru/ /byon pa'i lam bar nags tshal stug po'i dbus/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams dgyes pa'i gar mdzad cing / /rdo rje'i glu yis mchod pa mngon sum gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ri ltar gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar ba yod do/ /cung bzhugs stabs sku'i bsnyun dwangs mod khyim nas 'dzin mi chog pa'i lung bstan bab pas gzan sham 'dra ba re gsol te sngar skugyi thar gling gi gnas po dge slong la bcol/ sngon gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis gzan sham gang mthong gyon pa dang / khyad par sde de'i yul mi thams cad spyi khang du 'tshogs pa'i shul na skyed yum gyi ske rags ser bo zhig yod pa gzan gyi tshul du mnabs nas mi mang 'tshogs sar skyed ma'i gam du brgyugs pas kun bzhad gad thag ge bar song / rgan po 'gas bzang bo'i bag chags can du 'dug zer/ de'i rkyen gyis bla ma zhig gi sprul sku red ces mi mang gi ngag la thu+o grags shing rgan po dag snang can dang bud med dad pa can 'ag 'a res mjal kha zhu ba yang yod 'dug thar ba gling nas khong dang na mnyam gyi byis pa 'ga' bcas srang bar nas rtse bzhin yod skabs shig khong stag ge tshang bla brang nas phebs pa red zer ba bltas 89

pos khong lagoltag na yar gar+shags/ rjes lhag na zhabs zhu sdi rta la zhon bzhin 'ongs nas khong la khyod kyi ming la bla brang sku phyogs nas bskol bzang bstan pa zhes btags pa red ma brjed par gyis zhes zer bar khong gi thugs la bla brang sku phyogs nas nga mkhyen dogs yang mitshu'adug na ming spos ba ci yin snyam pa zhig byung gsungs/ thar gling gi tshogs der dge slong min pa zhugs mi chog pas dzi ring dgon gyi tshogs la zhugs/ tshogs pas drug cu ba gsungs pas de la thugs zhen te zan brdzis pa ma zo sa par phyir khyer yong nas drug cu ba 'dra ba bcas te bsdo ba'i lad rdzo byas pa dran gsungs/ byis pa gzhan zhig dang mnyam du rtse mo byas te rdo leb gor mo zhig yod pa gzhan des rang 'thag ba skor ze ra/ khong gis de ma red chos 'khor bskor zer nas ma 'cham par 'then 'khyer byed tshul khong stag ge tshang gi mdun du 'dug pas mthong nas stag ge tshang la zhus par dge ba'i bag chags yod pa kho yin 'dug gsungs/ de ltar skyes bu dam pa'i rang rtags du ma gig mthong gatri/sa bla go bla sar gyi skye sprul gyi tho yig nang bzhag go/ / de nas rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu sprel lor khong dgung grangs bdun du slebs skabs skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng 90

bzhi ba rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo'i thugs kun mkhyen ye shes kyis gzigs te gdan rabs lnga bcu ba bla go bla sar 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i sku'i skye bar thag bcad do/ /smras pa/ sgrib bral chos sku'i mkha' dbyings dag pa las/ /ye shes chos sku'i nyi zer 'bum shar te/ /skye sprul nyi ma gsar ba rab gsal bas/ /bstan 'dzin dag gi dgyes zhal zla ba mdzes/ /da ni bstan dang skye dgu'i pad tshal dag /rgyas byed sna tshogs 'od can byung ngo zhes/ /dga' ba'i ca co snyan pa'i sgra chen gyi/ /dbyar gyi rnga gsang snyan po'i khengs pa bcom/ /de nas lo der khong rang yul na bzhugs yod tshe nyin zhig khong stag ge tshang phebs nas de kar khri brgyab nas khong khri thog tu gdan drangs te skyabs mgon rin po che'i phyag mdud dang kha dar phul te khri 'don gnang / khong stag ge tshang gis de ka'i tsho mi rnams la khyed tshor gcig tu sgo mang bla ma chos dar tshang gi sku rtsar sprul sku 'di 'khrungs 'dug mi rgyud kyis ded na stag ge ngag dbang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin gyi sku nye'i rigs su 'dug gshis sprul sku 'di thag gcod kyi khur len thams cad rang gis bgyis te thag bcad pa 'di lags pas spyir kwa ring dgon grong / sgos su gro 'i thog 'bring gi tsho ba gnyis 91

nas do dam khur len yang dag byas na sngon ma tshang gi rten dang sku chas gang yod da lan khyod tsho la sbod pa yin zhes gsung nan che ba gnang / ca khong tshos dge rgan tshang la sku drin che dang thugs khur che bzhes gnang dgos zhes sogs zhus/ de nas stag ge tshang gi dpon pos rta dkar bo zhig gi chibs thog nas thar gling du gdan drangs/ de rjes 'gyang zhig nas thar gling de ka nas dgon grong kun la ston mo drangs te khri ston byas/ de skabs stag ge tshang gis khong la khyod kyis ltos dang mi mang bo 'tshogs e 'dug ces gsungs par khong phebs nas gzigs pas mi mang dga' tshom tshom byas 'dug pa gzigs nas khong stag ge tshang la 'dzin grwa 'dzin grwa byas nas 'tshogs 'dug zhus par khong la spyan cher gzigs nas phyogs 'di na 'dzin grwa zer ba'i ming tsam yang byis chung 'di 'dra'i thos yul du 'ong don med khyod la sus bshad pa yin gsungs/ khong kha rog bsdad pas ya mtshan grwa sa chen po 'grim pa zhig yin nam gsungs/ ston tshogs skabs stag ge tshang dang khong rnam gnyis khang steng du 'khod par zhung ba'i chos grags zer ba zhig gi ske la tā dkar 'dom do tsam pa zhig 'phangs/ chang dkar yol gang lag par bzung ste tshogs pa'i dbus su yar langs nas ston bshad byas/ khong gis gzhon 9lha

rnu'i rdus nas sngon sbyangs pag chags sad/ /ces spyong rba gcirka po las gzhan ma shes gsungs/ de nas khong stag ge tshang gis ka kha 'phral klog dang / sbyor klog skyabs 'gro ltung bshags/srad dben gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byos smon lam lnga/ 'jigs byed gnyis/ rgyan 'jug gdugs sher/ sgrol ma sogs tshogs chos grwa'i zhal 'don phal mo che thugs 'dzin gnang bas tshegs med du mkhyen/dgung grangs brgyad pa rab tshes chu mo byi lor khong stag ge tshang se chang dgon gyi khrir phebs dgos byung ba'i rjes su phebs te 'dzin chos kyi 'phro bskyangs/ smras pa/ thugs bskyed kun bzod ma yi lto ba ru/ /lung rtogs rin chen 'byung gnas yongs 'khyil zhing / /rin chen lhun po sku bzhi'i bang rim mdzes/ /'phrin las nyi zla zung gi rna cha g.yo/ /rab dwangs mtshe'u 'bum gyi dwangs shel du/ /rab gsal nyi zla'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa bzhin/ /rab mang gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing sa ru/ /rab mchog sprul ba'i bkod pa 'bum phrag rgyas/ /mtshan mor mun pa'i gos kyis g.yogs pa na/ /nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od kyis bshus pa bzhin/ /dus kyi bshad sgrub 'od chen yal ba na/ /bshad sgrub 'od chen 'bar ba khyod nyid 93

byon/ /bskal bzang rbub goyings kyi bstanapyigal/ /dbang 'byor lung rtogs mdzod kyis rab phyug pa/ /bstan pa'i bdag po skyabaspo yogon mchog de yi/ /zag med rnam kun mkhyen pas gsaloler gzigs/ /zab rgyas rtsibs stong gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /thub bstan khyon la dbang bsgyur rgyal bo che/ /gong ma'i chos srid gser gyi khri 'phang la/ /mnga' gsol dge mtshan zhod kyis 'jig rten khyab/ /ces bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las sku bltams shing / mtshan gyi me tog rgyas te gong ma'i khri la mnga' gsol ba'i sarga ste lnga ba'o/ / chos rgyur lugs nas thos bsam gsha' ma byas te thab pa snying bo byed sbyir gnas dben par gshegs pa'i sarga/'jigs med lung rtogs bstan pa'i chu gter che/ /'phrin las rlabs kyis byis pa'i snying rtsa 'dar/ /gdams pa rin chen gter gyis yongs gang ba'i/ /bshes gnyen rgya mtsho che der slar yang 'dud/ /ded dpon mkhas pa'i gru rdzings legs 94

bcos nas/ /rin chen gling nas rin chen dbang rgyal 'drin/ /dam pa'i bslab sdom rmang gzhi legs bting nas/ /thos bsam brtson pas zung 'jug nor bu len/ /rigs lam bye ba'i mdzod 'dzin mkhas mang dbus/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i shes rab rlabs chen gyis/ /thos bsam gnad la smin pa'i byung ba dag /brjod pa mchod pa'i sprin gyis brjod par bya/ /dgung grangs dgu ba rab tshes shing pho khyi'i lor khong stag ge tshang gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud khrid phebs dgos byung ba'i rjes su bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la bslebs/ de nyin nyi ma byang bgrod kyi 'phel kha gsar rtsom dang 'grig pas rten 'brel ma bsgrig rang 'grig tu song 'dug /dgung grangs bcu ba rab tshes shing mo phag gi lo'i gnam lo gsar bzhad la gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs pad du gnam lo gsar tshes dgyes ston la thog ma'i mjal kha zhus/thugs dgyes pa'i rnam pa cher mdzad de ka ra bag cha gcig sogs gnang / phyis shig nas bla go bla sar chung chung zhig mjal ba khyod yin 'dug ces sku 'da' kha'i bar du yang yang gsungs pas thrugs nas ma bor par yod gsungs/ lo de'i zla bzhi ba'i 95

tshis bcu gsum la snyigs dus kyi 'phags pa nye bar 'khor chen po khong a khu rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul bsgrubs pas khong gi gdul bya'i tha ma kun tu rgyu rab bzang lta bur song gsungs/ rī skyabs mgon rin po che lha sar phebs khar grwa tshang la tshe dbang gan nga dus skyabs —mgon rin po che mchog gi drung nas chos 'brel gyi thog ma thob/ dgung grangs bcu gcig pa rab tshes me pho byi ba'i lor glang pad ma'i bla ser zhes pa rdo rams pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten nas bsdus gzhung sogs mtshan nyid la sbyangs pa dang chabs cig de lor sgo mang rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las dam chos gyi bgo skal gyi thog ma srad rgyud bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gzab khrid zhib rgyas tho—ba/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang rin po che las kyang drag po sum dril gyi rjes gnang dang bzang spyod sogs kyi lung kha yar gsan/ dgung grangs bcu gnyis pa rab tshes me mo glang la dpyid ca tshes gnyis pa'i yar 'tshogs skabs chos grwar zhugs / de skabs bsdus grwa blo 'dzin sel 'jug sgrub 'jug la slebs/ dbyad+ku chos steng gong du zhus pa ltar 'gag ring thung gi dam bcar bzhongs 96

pas rtsod pa 'gran zla dang bral ba byung bas gzur gnas dag gi yid dbang 'phrog pa byung / dgun chos la bsdus grwa tshogs rgyugs su phul/ dgung grangs bcu gsum pa rab tshes sa pho stag la 'dzin grwa kha dog gong du grub mtha' rtsa ba dang 'grel ba don gsal thugs 'dzin gnang / dgung grangs bcu bzhi ba rab tshes sa mo yos la 'dzin grwa bsdus 'bring / de lor khyab bdag rdo rje sems dopa' chen po rje btsun ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo las grub lo hu ba'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu re gnyis pa'i dbang lta gon dang bcas gsan te gsang chen chos kyi sgor zhugs par mdzad/ de nas bzung bka' chos nam yod chad med lta bur phebs te gsan bzhes mdzad pa'i sdom grangs gong du bkod pa ltar la zhal nas bka' drin snying la lci zhes gsungs/ de'i dgun ngor 'grel ba don gsal dang grub mtha' rtsa ba tshogs rgyugs su phul/ dgung grangs bco lnga ba rab tshes lcags pho 'brug la bsdus chen du slebs/ dpyid yongs tshogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag drin can bla ma zhang/ ston bstan pa rgyu thurjo dopal bzang bo'i 97

zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang thob ste bstan pa'i 'ju ga sgo skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma dag/gang blo ma sogs lung phran kha yar thob gsungs/ de skabs76'i 'brug skad thog mar byung bas rten dza grel legs zhes phebs/de nas yang bka' chos nam yod la chud pa'i bka' drin bskya ngas shing / gzigs dpe gang dgos 'tshol ba dang / gsung rtsom nyung shas 'bri ba'i phyag g.yog zhu ba sogs kyi skal ba'ang thob ces gsung sa/ lo de'i dgun ngor blo rtags don bdun cu dang bcas pa'i tshogs rgyugs phul/ dgung thangs bcu drug spru rab tshes lcags mo sbru la la rtags rigs —'dzin grwar slebs ste blo rig tshogs gling gnang ba dang kā 0 gzhung rgyugs phul/ dgung grangs bcu bdun pa rab tshes chu pho rtardzilor ga zhung gsar du slebs nas dge —'dun nyi shu gsar rtsod dang dus—'grig payozla gnyis pa'i nyer drug gi bar chos grwar phebs/ de skabs dge rgan tshang nas da khyod a lags rin po che nas bka' 'a gyur gyi lung gnangane+eb nyan du song / the'u blo bzang gi gam nas sdod la dpe ltas spyang le shor med pa gyis zhes gsungs pa ltar bka 'a d+ngha 'gyur gyi lung nyan te mdo dran pa nyer bzhag gi bar song jiska — 98

pas ra dum pa nas bzung rdzogs dzirargonyan/ sngon stag ge /tshang nas khyod tshogs chos 'grim pa la khang mig chung ngu zhig gis yong gsungs pa ltar/ 'di lor khang ba snga ma btsong ste khang chung zhig tu sgos/ de phyin kha smras gleng brjod mang ba sogs dang yang dgos khams ma snyoms rdzopar brten gro ra tshang mo ma rno shos su gra gas bas brtag pa zhus par/ rtaspagrin gyi bsnyen pa dang gur drag dang rta mgrin 'khor lo sham bu can yod pas de skor zer/ de 'bol khong rang nyid rta mgrin gyi bsnyen par bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du khong dang khong gi 'dzin grwa bcas bsdus chen gyi go sar rtsod pa byed pa la khong a lags rin po che glo bur du phebs byung ba zhal dmar zhing zil che ba khro tshul gyis spyan hrig hrig phyogs kun gzigs pas khong gi 'dzin grwa'i smad sog ma cig zer ba de la brdung deg mang bo gnang ba zhig rmis/ bsnyen pa grol tshe khams kyang rang sar cung babs/ 'khor lo de 'bad pas bskor bas thams cad nas phyi phyir mi 'tsham par gyur bas 'khor los lan par shes nas gzhan la gyin/ lha khyad par ba yin nges la nged rang la snga 'gyur phyogs 'di la las 'phro ngan pas 'brel mid pa go gsungs/ rdo rje 'chang mkhan rin po che ngag dbang dge legs tshang ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho de nyid kyis dus 9rdzo

'khor dbang skur skabs sde khri sprul ba'i sku 'jigs med bstan ji pa'i nyi ma tshang nas khong ra nged rangarī ga nyis shasnya laralamanyam 'gro lhad pas de'i rton 'brel du dbang giskabasad+kums4cad du lha chu 5 sdod lhan 'gro zhes gsungs tshonas khong a lags rin po chesatsho dgi dze+e ñcak+ṣiṃl sgrub skabs gnang ba'i 'jamachadapal mtshan brjod gser rdzi pa bris shig yod pa gnanganeste chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs paro'aspyogs zhes pa'i bar tho na zhes phebs ba bzhin byas/ rjes shig la yikhyige rnag chiganang b.rokhyod bla rgan sma ra dkar po can zhig tu ma gyur / — bar na 'gro ba'i skabs med ces phebs/ skyes bu dam pa zhig yin nges la byis pa mno bsam med pa'i tshul ba zhes pa'i skabs ṇ+ḍaṃ red snyam yang phyis sog yul du byon skabs lan gru nas kha dar — gyi — 4 zhig bskur te da bud song bde bar gyis zhes phebs 'dug pa sogs sog jilul du byon pa'i don las ma go mod khong zhing gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa dang / nga rang gi tshe tshad bcas gsungs r+pā la nges pa— rnyedasmoces gsungs/ 'di yang dam pa gnyis ka'i rtogs pa'i mngon rtags yispyo te sde khri rin po ches ma 'ongs lungarnya bstan gnapre ba ji bzhin6 thog tu bab pa dang / rje 'di bas kyang sde gyirin po che skyeg bu dam pa yin par mkhyen cing lung — bstan don thugs su chud pas so/ / lte 100

— dgung grangs7 bco brgyad pa rab tshes chu mo lug gi lor 7 'dzin grwa gzhung gong du slebs/ kau 'dzin skyor daphe khrid sogs dang / sgo mang rin po che las bde lam gyi khrid nyin bdun/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig bde mchog lo hu ba dang dril bu lha lnga/'dus pa lugs gnyis dang 'jika rten dbang phyug 'khor chen / mngo na byang / zab don snyan brgyud kyi gcod dbang sogs dbang du ma dang / rnam sras bka' bco lnga sogs rjes gnang mang po gsan/ ske —skyabs mgon rin po che sku 'bum mkhan por bzhugs pa'i mtshams zhus lta bur khong stag ge tshang phebs te gong sa mchog gi ma yum dang / dpon po tshang sogs la 'phros gleng mang bo byed skabs khong rin po che 'di ba tsha kan be shing gi khrir phebs dgos kyi gros mgo bton/ de'i don rnams sba gsang med par stag ge tshang gis khong la gsungs pas khong rin po che 'di bas thugs la shar tshul gsungs pa ni/ rgyal dbang bdun pas/ /chos med chos par rlom pa'i bzang rdzu mkhan bdag gi/ /las ngan nyakhrul ngor shar ba'ishasnang’tshul la bltas na/ — /thams cad sdug bsngal bskyed bzhi— la ru 'dug pa/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin kha dog dkar dmarta gong bsdus 'bring gsumazhwachi ma gtogs lo brgyad kyi steng nas da bar lo re bzhin ston zla 101

gnyis sam phyed dang ga nyis lta bu ri la na sa bsod ces sbrang ji 'khyams/ la ma song dus mi gda'/ min kyang nged rang khri zur sprul sku yin rgyu ba byas/ khor yang khri thon zin du song ga shis nango gcig nas khra'a'imago gnyis bsdu ba sogasagasdospyo dka' 'chib la snyethug‘shaṃs dpe shog ldebs gsum tsam yang 'dzin skyor yid phebs pa zhig mi 'byung bas phyi nas kyang gzhung lugs la sbyang ba'i skal ba lta ci kha ton mag mug re byed rgyu'i bsod nams yang mi 'dug bde gsang sogs lhag lha 'di rnams dzimatshams bsnyen sgrub ltabu re byed rgyu ma byung na de bas phongs tshab che ba mi 'dug snyagoyid mi pade zhes gsungs pa yang gong du bshad pa ltar gyi rnam thar bla na mid pa'o/ /lo de'icadagun nas bzung ste phar phyin skabs dang bo tshogs rgyugs la phul/ sta dgung grangs bcu dgu ba rab tshes shing pho sprel lor 'dzin grwa skabs dang bor slebs/ dpe khrid dpe bltas 'dzin skyor sogs sngar rgyun bzhin gnang thog a khu rin po che zhang ston bstagepa rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las khong sgo mang rin po che dang lhanat+pa rgyal be+eng ba bsam gtan 'od zer gyi gcod skor gyi lung / 3 — sne ra na tha'irtsedab nga chog steng nas dbang dang lung sogs du ma dang /dus 'khor bskyed rim gyi bshad lung gnang ba rnams gsan / 102

sgo mang rin po che las stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang gnyis kyi dbang gnyis jig—le bcu drug 'jigs gsang mkha' spyod sogs kyi sngags btu/ paṇa bstan pa'i /nyi ma'i gsung 'bum gyi lung sogs chos bka' rgya cher gsan/ rig byed ma'i don kun 'grub pa'i 'khor lo gsar sgrub dang yi ge'i sngags kyi lag 'khor zhib par bskrun te khong sgo mang rin po cher phul bas dgyes nyams dang bcas thugs mkho che byon nas bdag gir bzhes/ 'dzin gagatugs la bzhengs te rtags gsal ya mtshan pa btang pas d+ngha rigs lung cher song / drang nges tshogs gleng babs te dbyar chos chen mor dam bca' sogs gshis phyin par gnang / dbyar chos grol 'phral phar phyin ston mo'i ched du 'brog phyogs su shol tsho bcas zla ba gnyis lhag 'bul sdud du phebs stabasalke tshogs gleng dngos gzhi gnang rgyu ma song / dgun ngor bde— gsang gnyis sogs lhag lha du ma zhig gi bsnyen pa btaja / dgung grangs nyi shu ba rab tshes shing mo byi lo la 'dzin grwa ska bas bzhi bar slebs/ daphyid dus su stong skor rab 'byam sa pa sbyin ba rgya mtshos nan tan chen po byas te zhus ngor bde mchog gi dbang gnang / 'di dbang gnang ba'i thog ma yin 'dra/ 〉 drug pa'i tshes drug la khong sgo mang rin po che nas mkhan slob 103

sbrags ma dang khong nyidarngokyi mchod dpon dge slong dkon mchog rgya mtsho bas gsang ston/ khong zhal snga nas lurortogs rgya ma tsho sogs kyis rīkha skong mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs te thugs rgyud sdom pa gsum gyis yongs su gtams pas gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur/ zla bcu ba'i nyer lnga la 'dzin grwar pharophyin ston mo'i bsnyen bkur bla na med pa gnang / phar phyin dam bca'i skabs rtags gsal btang tshul sogs gong du thos pa rgya chen btsal ba'i rnam thar brjod pa'i skabs su brjod zin pa ltaraskertsod pa phyogs/ chen gnang bar dam bca' khas len yang dag par gnang —/ dam bca' tshar nas sngar bsnyen pa ma song ba'i lhag lha 'ga' dang / nang mtshams zhag bdun ma sogs gnang / ri dgung grangs nyer gcig pa rab tshes me pho khyi'i lo la smon lam steng brag dkar phyogs su gnyan khrod la phebs/ gnas khang du thog ma'i bdun mtshams gnang ba dang / bkra shis 'khyil zer ba'i mis 'grim 'grul med pa'i 'gol yangs shig yod pa der bar gyi bdun mtshams gnang / mtsho kha nas tha ma'i bdun mtshams gnang ste chu stod zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes bcur sbyin sreg gnang nas sgyugrub 'phralabyugadan sar phyir phebs/ khong gis khengs skyungs gnang ste rnam rtog gi 'gyur ba ches cher brtas pa 104

la—gnyen pos 'bur 'joms kyis ma chum pas yi mug ldang ba zhi zhig las ma byung gsungs kyang gsang rnam las/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud phung bo zan bsgyur chos/ /thabs shes zab mo gcod gyis nyams bzhes gyis/ /phra rags bdud tshogs dbyings su bskrad dang lhan/ /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog cho 'phrul rang sar dag /ces gsungs pa ltar lags la/ gdan sar slebs 'phral zhal snga nas a khu zhang rin po cher mjal bar/ a khu rin po che'i zhal nas dpyid 'dir khyod ma bsdad pa de ches phangs khong a lags rin po che nas chos rgyun shin tu dkon pa 'ga' 4zhigaganang song gsungs/ de rjes cher ma 'gyang par zhwa dam ra rin po che phebs te khong a khu tshang la rje'i bstod 'grel dang sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis sogs dang / khong a lags rinace po che la shar ba'i lam rim/ snying bo don gsum/ rngog dkyil bdun sogs zhus pa khong gis kyang gsan/ sgyu de skabs tshe 'di'i rten bzhengs kyi thog ma a lags rin po che dang / sgo mang rin po che/ bde mchog mkha' spyod ga zhal bzhi ba rnams kyi tsa ka li re bzhengs te khong sgo mang rin po cher lhag gnas zhus par nyin shas zhog gsungs pas sku drung du bzhag khong nyid kyis zhal thang sgros la snum thigs shig lhung song ba sku nye nas gzhan gyi 105

ca ka badzod zhus —par grwa rkyang gi kha la sgrum thigs re 'gos na slobazang mod gsungs/ de phyin zas nor gyis mi phongs pa zhig 'ongs pa de ka'i byin rlabs dang rten 'brel du 'khums zhes gsungs/ sngar nas bla ma nang chen gyi 'dzin bdag la thug sa log ste/ zhe sa ngo 'dzi na dgos pa'i dpon poyang med la/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gi don ltar ri khrod pa tsho'i sgom sgrub la bar chad med cing thos don sgrub pa la gzhol bas thugs drangs te rang yang de 'dra ba—zhig byung na snyam pa las thugs la gzhan 'char rgyu med/ yin kyang gsar bu lo chung gi blo la phug gtad med pas dpal mgon zhalawāzhi ba rang la 'go zhing ltas mtshan gsal ngom zhig yod pas dus 'khor grwa tshang du bsang zhig btang ste snyan shal zhig phul ba logs bris kyi mgon po zhal gyi mche ba ba zhi'i rtse mor nyin shas bzung bas rang la'ang spobs pa skyes te khong zhang rin po cher 'dun gros zhus par lan du khyod kyang mi ring bar phyogs yas mas gang rigs shig tu 'gro dgos pa nges can pas de bas gzhan dben pa re bsten nas dge sbyor bya nus na kho bo shin tu dga' / sngar nged kyi sems ngor khyod nga'i rtsar zhig tu bzung ste rgyud par lo shas 'gror bcug na snyam pa yod mod/ don smin zhig mi yong ba ngo shes zhes phebs/ zhes ཿ06

gsubs pa 'di dag ni rgyal bu don kuno spub dzis grong khyir gyi sgoskeb zhi nas skye rga na 'chi dang / dge slong gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis rgyal srid dor ba'i rnam par thar ba dang shin tu mtshungs so/ /de nas zhwa dmar rin po cher zhu sna bcol te reb kong sku zhabs a rol rin po cher de ka'i ri khrod du zhugs rgyu zhus par yong gsungs zhes phebs te tshe sgrub/ tā re/ myur mdzad ma sogs rim gro kha yar bsgrubs/ a rol tshang nas bis mdor sems bskyed mchod pa gnang rgyu yin pas de skabs 'byor ba gyis zhes phebs sgo bstsal/ rgyu mtshan khong a khu zhang ston rin po che tshang la zhus par zhal nas rang re'i sku zhabs tshang la'ang gtan ma zhus par song na khong gi thugs kyi dgongs par ci 'char mi shes pas lan gcig zhus par drag gsungs pa ltar khong mgo log —phyogs su bzhugs pa la 'phrin zhus par mi 'gyang bar dgon thog tu sleb nges yin pas de'i bar sdod dang gros byed ces phebs par nyan te bcu ba'i tshes kyi bar 'gro rgyu ma byung gsungs/ phyi nas zhus par reb kong yin dgos mi 'dug 'di ka'i ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel du bzhugs dang khad nye spro bde sogs su yod ces dgongs pa ma grol/ khong a lags rin po che dang sgo mang rin po che rnam gnyis nas kyang gzhan du gtong mi bzhed pa'i 107

gsung zur mang ba bcas ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel du sdod dgos byung / de dus a rol rin po ches byin gyis reb kong phyogs kyi ri khrod pa tsho zhub tshugs—legs pa chos kyi ma na rkyen ran r+pā sogayokyis re ba che yang don smin ma byung bas zhe chad dang yi mug ldang yangatshangs pa'i lung bstan las/ mchog lhag pa'i lha zhig sgrub 'dod na/ /byang dge 'phel ri la rgyal mtshan 'dzugs/ /zhes pa'i thog tu khel nas ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs so d+ngha smras pa/ gzhung4lugs gangs kyi ri bo'i spo la 'gyings/ /lung dang rigs pa'i gad rgyangs drag po yis/ /smra ngan ri dwags tshogs rnams dpa' zhum zhing / /gzu bor gnas pa ma rig gnyid las bslangs/ /yang dag rigs lam seṅge'i ngar skad la/ /log par 'khu ba'i skye bo wa skyes dag /lung rigs mche sder rnon po'i zil shugs che/ /ma bzodwa snang mdzad shor bzhin than skad sgrog /thos pa'i don rtogs 'khor bar zhen log ste/ /dben par bsnyegs pa'i snyan pa rnga gsang sgras/ /don kun grub dang paṇa chen phul byung rje'i/ /rgyal srid dor ba'i rab snyan sgra dbyangs 'gog /'khor bde srin mo'i 'dzum bag ltar gzigs kyang / /mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rang steng du/ /len pa'i rin chen 108

sems mchog rgyan gsol te/ /bkra shis dge 'phel ba'i ri bor zhugs/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya metsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las chos grwar zhugs nas thos bsam gsha' ma byas te sgrub pa snying bo byed phyir gnas dben par gshegs pa'i sarga ste drug pa'o/ / gnas dben pa bltan te skub pa snying bor mdzad pas zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rgyal brad la dbang 'byor ba'i sarga/ 'jigs chen bdud bzhi bcom pa'i bde ba che/ /skye med yum la rol ba'i mnyam bzhag dang / /'phrin las rjes thob zlos gar 'bum phrag gis/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho 'dren pa'i byed po rgyal/ /thos don sgrub la gzhol ba'i me na ka /nyams rtogs sum rtsen gnas su rnam par rgyu/ — /bde chen ye shes nor bu'i 'phreng ba mchog /rgyan du gsol ba'i tshul 'ga' 'dir brjod bya/ /sngar gong sa mchog la zhal 'dris gtan nas med pa la de nas bzung nam 'dod du mjal chog pa dang / nam 109

du'ang gsol ja bzhesa'ikro sogs kyis gsasal ras bstsal ba sogs thugs nang nye —ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ ske zhal nas ri khrod du rkang tshugs pa dang phyag rdor 'khor chen nam rta mgrin gang rigs kyi ba snyen pa zhig thongs gsungs pa ltar mgo zla ba'i tshes la dge 'phel ri khrod der ma 'gyang bar 'khor gyi bsnyen pa sbyin sreg bcas grub par gnang / khong ri khrod du phebs khar a khu rin po cher sbyor ba'i chos drug nyams su bstar tshul lag len zhib gsal zhus pas gnang ste zhal nas lam sne re re nas 'bad pas sbyang na skye skye 'dra'ang de bas thun re re la mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad tshang ba re gshar sbyang byas na dga' mod ces gsungs pa thugs la bcangs te ri khrod nas mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa la dpyad sgom byas te rtogs pa cher 'phel mod 'on kyang khong gis khengs skyungs gnang ste gsung ba/ rang dziphro skyes na reb kong yin dgos pa'i nges pa med snyam nas nyams len zhig la 'bungs blo byas kyang rgyal dbang bdun pas/bstan bcos man ngag rnams kyis dag byas kyang / /nges par blo ngan rab dwangs nyid mi 'gyur/ /ga bur tshogs kyis yongs su bsgo sa gyur kyang / /mi bzad sgog pa rang gi dri mi gtong / /zhe sa gsungs pa ltar/ thog med nas ngan goms kyis sems ram̐10

neng du mi khug pas re dogs dang dga' sdug chu gnyir bzhin dkrogs shing khyad par sems kyi bde sdug kun nang rnam rtog gi cho 'phrul du song bas sems la 'khu 'khrigs byung na bdag 'dzin yul nas thon/ nang 'dre rang sems thul na phyi 'dre stong b.rabyuyal/ zhes pa ltar dgos nges shar mod sems rgyud rwa ltar gyong ba la sen mortsozhig ma thebs zhes gsungs pa khengs skyungs tshul gyis gdul bya rnams la man ngag gi mthil bstan pa yin no/ /dgung grangs nyer gnyis pa rab tshes me mo phag gi lor rang 'gar bsdad pas dgos pa mi 'dug dgongs nas rgyun bsnyen lta burawu bde mchog lo hu ba'i cho ga dang 'brel bar ka ra ka ra 'bum phrag gcig de'i bdag 'jug brgya rtsa brgyad rnams grub 'phral sbyin sreg stong phrag gcig phul/ deci nas lo phyed lhag tsam la de ka'i ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gnas brtan 'grig bdag gis khur bzhes te 'grig lam nyams pa thams cad sor chud dang /ma nyams pa gong 'phel btang / dbyar sgom khang bde chen 'od gsal du 'dus pa spyi dang lhan nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i rim gnyis kyi khrid spyang nyan/ nyin zhig skyabs mgon mchog gi sku mdun du phebs par/ de ring khyod 'dir 'ongs pa la bltas sam mdang nga'i rmi lam du zhes sogasabyumakhas mchog yon tan 'od 111

kyi skye bar lung bstan pa sogs gongasadu brjod zin to/ / rdagung grangs nyer gsum pa rab tshes sa pho byi ba'i lo la skyabs mgon mchog ri khrod du byon pa'i zhar la khong gi shag tu phebs/ dpe rnams bam gajigs gyis nang nas dpa' bo gtsug— lag 'greng ba'i chab shogacipod gcig dang dril bu lus dkyil gyi bla ma'i rnam 'byor sogs bzhes te phebs/ de'i skabs skyabs mgon mchog nas khong la me tog bcud len zhig la sdod rgyu yin na legs gsungs/ khong gis lto gdung gisacedaka' tshul zhus par ma zer ma mtha' smon lam kyi rten du khrid cig yin yang nyon zhes gsu ngas stabs/ khong a lags rin po cher dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rim lnga dben sa ba'i chu bcud len steng nas khrid cig kyang nyan/ khong a khu rin po che zhang tshang la bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i khrid zhus te khrums stod zla ba'i tshes nyer dgu nas 'jigs gyed bsnyen cen la bsdad/ 'jam dbyangs zhi ba'i bsnyen pa 'bum lta bu sngon du btang na bar chad chung zhes khong a khu rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa bzhin byas/ 'di skabs nang gcig thun dang po grol 'phral ra bar kha ba phyags phyir phebs pa na gzig sa snang khyad par can byung ba gong du brjod pa ltar la/ khong gis khengs skyung dang gdul bya la man ngag 'don pa'i phyir gsung 112

ba/ ci mi snyam par bzhag pa phyis brtag na/ dgapa mid pa'i — mi rnams la/ /dkar bo'i chos rnams mi skye ste/ /zhes gsungs mes dad pa dang dag pa'i snang ba ma skyes pas lan par go zhes gsungs 'dug go / / dgung grangs nyer bzhi ba rab tshes sa mo glardo gi lo'i hor zla lnga ba'i yar tshes la mtshams grol ba gnang / de'i skar+pās su khong gis paṇa chen bde lam/ 'tham sdud ga nyis/ rje'i bstohwa 'grel gyi mdo phyogs skor/ spyod 'jug chen mo/ sngags kyi snyi don/ leges bshad snying bo sogs thugs 'dzin dang / zhar la 'dul sdom spyir bestan rdzogs kyi par bam se zhig dang / skabs snga phyir bde gsang / mgon chos/ lha mo rnam sras sogs thugs 'dzin gnang / de rjes skyabs mgon mchog khong gi spyil bur byon nas ka ma la dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng zhes pa'i dbu can gyi sgrol dkar bstod pa zhig ljags rtsom mdzad nas zhu ba po khyod yin rgyu byas gsungs te ri khrod gyi tshogs su btsugs/ ma 'gyang bar sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen ba zhig gyis zhes gsungs pa spe dang du blangs te sgom khang gong nas sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa gnang / bsnyen pa grub 'phralo ri khrod du slebs pa na shul du nged kyi steng nas zing cha che tsam zhig bslangs 'dug kyang de ma thag 113

ma tshems bsdams nas chos rgyal gyi bsnyin pa zhig btat+na lta grol sloduglogong sa mchog gi byinagyis zib cha rang yal du song 'dugacespo gsungs pa'i don gong du zhus pa ltar la/ 9tre byu sgrol dkur bsnyen pa de yang bstan 'gro'i don du sku tshe brtan pa'i ched du skyabs mgon mtshog gis snyan bskul gnang par nges te khong gi zhal nas/ tshe'i bar chad cig yod pa bla ma dang 'phags ma'i byin— rlabs kyis nyer 'tshe phra mo de tsam gyis bzlog pa yin mchi snyadzom dubyudad pa kha zhe med pa zhig skyes zhes gsungs/ lo de'i ston dgun yang bskyar nā ro mkha' spyod dang / zhal bzhi ba bag tse rnams kyi bsnyen pa dang / he ru ka'i yig brgya mebum grangs bsags/ rī degung grangs nyer lnga ba rab tshes lcags pho stag gi lo la/ mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen chen las rung gi bsnyen pa yang bskyar btang nas ske.o gsum ma 'bum ther so gnyis btang / rgyal zla ba'i bcu gnyis la mtshams khongs su chud pa byas te thar gle rtse — mi thed pa'i 'gol gnas su bsdad gshis de ka nas bsnyen sgrub sprags ma bcu cha sbyin sreg rnams grub par byas/ de'i gzhi bsnyen skabs cub cig srod thun la rkyen med par gting nas 4ngu snyingajizhig 'ongs nas mang bo ngus/ phyi nyin nyi sros tsam na skyabs 114

mgon mchog nas gnang byung zer ba zhig 'byor ba bltas pas —thu'u bkwan gsung mkha' spyod chos skor dang / gzhan yig bskur cig 'dug pa bltas pas/ srid dang zhi ba ro mnyam nyid gyur ba'i/ /sgrib bral zag med ye shes chos kyi sku/ /thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' bde yi/ / ngo mtshar gang de rdorje 'chang gi 'phrul/ — /zhes 'dug pas snga gong gi de yang semagasun pa min nges shar gsungs/ 'di dag gi don gong du bshad zin to/ /de rjes shig gong sa rin poche raja shag tu phebarnabyon/ mchod khang du gsol ja bzhes rjes 'dug mal du byonanyanas bzhugs te zhal nas/ sngar nas khang chung skyid nge ba zhig yim/ mod da cha lhag par mtshams bsnyen sgrub— mang bo byas pa'i rkyen gyis byin chags shing bag dro ba zhige tu gyur 4'dug rtsig ngos 'di la dur khrod mtshan gyid tshang ba zhig dang dkar dmar nag pa'i thig le gsum phris zhes gsungs 'dug yang rjes shig skyabs mgon mchog byon nas gsol ja bzhes zin 'phral gnyid bro gsungs nas gzims la cung zad yur rte thugs sangs pa dang‘mdun 'dir rgya gling zhig 'dug ste da lta gtong gin ṣ+pe'adug — ces gsungs/ khong gis gsung de ltane phebs pa tshe mjug 'dir lung khri da man ngag sogs chos kyi༄ni skyong dgos pa'i brda'o snyam 115

than bsaḥbatheg/ 4— 5rte da gung grangs nyer drug pa rab tshes lcagal mo yos lor snyi mngabyu rin po che las 'grel ba bzhi sbrags le'u drug pa'i thad yarte chad〉 dang / sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung sogayochos bloka' kha yar gsan/ skyabs mgon rin po che nas lo 'dir hor zla brgyad pa'i nang gnyan gong brag dkar ram/ lo kya tun gang rigs shig la mjal du song gsungs/༷ khong gi thugs la grag dekar la sngar yang yang —mjal zin snyam lo rkya tun du phebs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyi na gdung du rje'i sku brnyan khyad 'phags/ ting phor/ mcho da skong sogs phul te khrus gsol/rgyan najug smon lam lnga sogs gsungs/ phyi'i nangs par nas nyin bdun la snga dro lo hu ba'i bdag 'jug re dang / phyi dro mkha' spyod ma'i bdag 'jug re gsungs/ tshes bcu'i nyin sku gdung rin po cher snyan shal/ cod pan cha/— dngul gyi me tog bkra shis kyis brgyan pa/ kha dar che legs/ mar me brgya mchod sogs phul/ der bzhugs dge 'dun rnams kyis bde mchog rkyang ba las bdag 'jug mi mdza da pa la dong tse khron brgya thebs su gnang ste phyi nas tshes bcu nam yod la bdag 'jug gsu5 rgyun btsugs/ de ka'i sa'i tshe kyi dre'u skyel mi bcas gan 116 —

go'i dgon par phyag phebs/ der zhag gcig gnas 'brel byas te se tha zir 'byor/ byams pa 'bum gling du 'gro 'dod che yang zla bo bla rgan 'gror ma nyan gsungs/ se tha zi nas phyir phebs lam du rgya mo bong bu zhon pa zhig gis rjes zin pa gogs kyi rnam par thar ba gong du brjod zin pa de byung la/ khong gis de'i don la bltas nas gdams pa/ skyabs mgon gyi gsung la bltas no skyabs 'gro gnad ma ma byas na yengs ma lam gyi dge sbyor 'dis phyi ma'i ngan 'gro tsam yang mi khegs pa'i don du go zhes gsungs/dgung grangs nyer bdun pa rab tshes chu pho 'brug la gong sa rin po che sgom khang du bzhugs pa la ngam rdzong snyan brgyud kyi dbang zhus pas co ni a mo de skabs sku mdun na bcar bzhugs kyis yod pas de'ang tshud dgos byung dze+enged rang gnyis char la tshes bcu'i nyin gsungs/ 'di skyabs mgon mchog gi gsang rnam las/ nyin gcig rmi lam du zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don gong du brjod zin pa ltar ro/ /skyabs mgon mchog gi phyag dpe g.yar bo gnang ste mi ring bar bsnyen pa zhig gyis la rgyun du thon gsungs pas bsnyen pa btangaho/ kha skong sbyin sreg skabs glo bur du 'brug grags thog tshag ser ba drag po byung ba sogs 'tshubs ltas che ba byung 'dug de nas lo gcig tsam la rgyun snye17

pa'i nyams len gnang / phyis su a khu rin po che nas rang re ri bo dge ldan pa la bde mchog mi nyung ba 'di tsam zhig yod bzhin khyod la de kas gang yong / snyan brgyud dgos na dril bu lus dkyila'adi 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo dang dben sa grub thob mched sogs kyi nyams bzhes yin pas dben sa snyan brgyud rang yin zhes bkyon pas de nas brtsams tshes bcu re lta bu la bton kyang gong sa mchog nas 'da' kha'i bar rgyang bskyur ma byed ces yang yang gsungs pas do gal che ba zhig yin nges lags zhes gsungs 'dug ston mjug gong sa mchog sgom khang du phebs/yang shag tu phebs te gsol ja gung tshigs sogs thams cad bzhes te rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa dbu ma che ba'i nyams khrid 5’ sogs mkha' spyod skor gyi man ngag kha yar lung bcas bstsal /khong gis gong sa mchog 'di ba'i chos kyi bka' drin dang tha na sos bde gu yangs su tshe gang bor 'dug rgyu byung ba tshun gang gi bka' drin yin pas drin lan gzhal dka' bar yod ces gsungs/ de yang yin te gzhon dus nas skal ldan gyi slob mar gzigs te man ngag snyan brgyud rnams phangs med du bstsal nas nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur/ gong sa mchog khong chos srid gnyis ka'i bdag po yin gshis rje 'di ba bla ma nang chen gyi /18

gi sa 'dzin pa dang / dgon khag so so'i khrir phibs rgyu/ skyi 'das rjes su sprul sku blu rgyu sogs la dgongs pa grol te bka' shog gnang / grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya po byed rgyu byung ba ma 'ongs sngon gzigs sogs yab sras kyi rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ /nyin de'i dgong mor sgom khang du phyir gshegs te phyag yig cig gnang ba'i ngos na kye rdo rje 'di lho brag mar ba dang sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rim byon rnams kyi thugs dam gyi gtso bo yin pas 'di la bsnyen pa zhig thongs/ rdo rje gdan bzhi 'di yang mar ston chos kyi blo gros dang rngog chos sku rdo rje sogs kyi thugs dam zhe gtsigs che ba yin pas 'di la'ang bsnyen pa zhig thongs zhes phebs 'dug da lta bsam na de ka nged kyi nang du khong phebs pa'i tha mar song 'dug pas yid skyo ba tshad las 'das zhes gsungs/ kye rdor gyi bsnyen pa ri khrod de nas 'phral du gnang / phyis su rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bsnyen pa yang gnang / skyabs mgon mchog gis bar skabs shig tu phyag bzhi ba/ gur mgon/ dur khrod bdag po/ dud sel ma rnams la'ang bsnyen pa re thebs par byas na rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i chos skyong 'gang chen yin zhes phebs pa bzhin du dud sel ma min pa thams cad 'grub nges gnang / skyabs mgon mchog 119

gi ma yum sku khams ma bde ba'i rkyen gyis ri khrod du skyabs mgon mchog yun ring por bzhugs skabs bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di bas skabs skabs su mchod dpon gnang ba dang / yum ma 'tsho ba'i skabs skar bcos khrus chog sogs phyag g.yog gang dgos skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs zin bsgrubs/ dgung grangs nyer brgyad pa rab tshes chu mo sbrul gyi lor thugs dgongs la sngar stag ge dpon slob las sum rtags kyi khrid dang skar rtsis shig 'bo ra'i rgya mtsho'i drung nas zhag gsum par ri mo rdzogs tsam zhig gi 'brel thob cing / bu'i spyi don snye ma dang / gsung rab pa'i lnga bsdus don 'grel steng nas khrid bzhed bzhugs kyang phyi nas nyan rgyu ma song ba de dang / da cha sgra rig cig la 'brel re e zhog snyam gsungs/ de ltar thugs la shar nas gso rig smra ba'i khyu mchog khong zhal snga nas 'jam dbyangs chos dar bar dbyangs can sgra mdo rtsa 'grel steng nas dpe khrid zhus/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal ba dang a kyā yongs 'dzin sogs kyi gsung du gsal ba dang / der mi gsal ba sngon gyi khrid rgyun ltar bar bar gyi tshigs bcad sogs kyi ri mo cha tshang gsan/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel gyi steng nas mdzub khrid lung bcas gsan/ khong gi zhal nas sngon nas 'brel 120

ba'i mtshams sbyor zhig gis sam rje de nyid la skyon rtog skad cig ma shar gsungs/ khong 'jam dbyangs chos dar ba'i zhal nas/ ngas sgra khrid yul zhig la a lags 'di ba las lhag pa'i sgrago mkhan ma byung gsungs/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang khong rang gis kyang 'phags ma'i bstod pa re ma bton par nyan ma myong de tsho'i rten 'brel yin nam gsungs/ de nas kun bshad kyi mtshan gsol tshul sogs gong du brjod zin to/ /sman zhig slob bzhed kyang gong sa mchog gis khyod ri khrod pa zhig la des ci byed gsungs pa sogs la brten nas ma bslab gsungs mod/ phyis su sman dpyad sogs la shin tu mkhas pas sman pa phal gyis bcos mi nus pa dag khong gis sman gnang ba'i nad las grol ba shin tu mang / dper na mgo log skal bzang zer ba'i grwa ba zhig la srin rus zan gyi nad byung ste shi la nye skabs bla ma rin po che mjal du song / khong gis gzigs ma thag ngas sman zhig byed dgos rgyu red ma gtogs 'di shi rgyu red gsungs nas nye gnas la sman brdung bcug ste bu ram gyi nang du sman bsres pa'i ril bu chen po bdun gnang nas nyin rer ril bu re zar bcug pas nyin gsum nas rnag khrag sogs chad nas sangs drag tu song /deng sang yang nad de la gnyen po sman shes mkhan med par nub 121

phugaso sman pas rus srin gang la zhugs sa nas rkang gcod lag gcod byed kyin 'dug go/ /snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag sogs la sbyang tshul gong du brjod zin rto/ /rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ 'di na 'jig rten pa rnams kyi/ /mig sngar mi mdzes gang yin pa/ /gang zhig ngo lkog med pa yi/ /skyes bu drang por spyod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar khong rin po che 'di bas 'jig rten pa'i mi drag sku drag sogs la zhe sa ngo 'dzin mig sngar mdzes chos sogs gang yang mi byed stabs gong sa mchog gi zhabs zhu gsar spos pa dag dang mi chen 'ga' zhig gi sgra dang sdeb sbyor sogs bslab pa la bsnyad btags te rje 'di ba ri khrod du mi bzhugs zer zhing gong sa mchog la'ang snyan phra zhus pa sogs kyis 'bo ra'i sngon po thang gi khrir bsko bzhag byas/khong rin po che nyid tshogs 'du dmar nag gi mdun du phebs te nga ri khrod pa la gnyer ba 'on po sogs ci yang med/ nga grwa rkyang 'di 'dra zhig gis khri ji ltar 'dzin zhes sogs gsung btsan bajid can byon te dgongs pa zhus/ /gong sa mchog gis rin po che 'di ba'i rang bzhin mkhyen pas dgongs pa grol/ 'on kyang sgo rtsa'i khyi bzhin de dag gi byed pas sku mdun du yang mjal rgyu 'dod mos bzhin ma byung gsungs/ 122

dgung grangs nyer dgu ba rab tshes shing pho rta'i lo la tshangs pa'i lung bstan du/ mtsho bkra this g.yas su 'khyil ba'i nang / /nya gshog drug can la btud na legs/ /zhesalpang bstan pa'i dus la bab rbe dang ri khrod nas mtshams pasnyen sgrub sogs nyams len mtha' chod pa gnang bas nyams rtogs gong du 'phel te gzhan don byed pa'i dus la bab pa na slar dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du phyag phebs te bla ma rnam pa'i bka' chos gang gsung gsan/ khong gi zhal nas dgon mtha' 'dir bka' chos gang gnang chag med du nyan rgyu byung ba lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs dang thugs rjer shes zhes gsungs pa dang / yang khong gi zhal nas/da lta bsam tshod la rje bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ 'di na 'jig rten pa rnams kyi/ /yid du sdug pa gang yin pa/ /gang dag ngo dgar smra ba dang / /byi la'i spyod pa can rnams so/ /zhes gsungs pas byi la'i rnam thar de yang dgos pa'i dus skabs yod pa gzod las ma shes 'dug snyam zhes gsungs/ khong dgung grangs nyer dgu'i skabs 'dir khong dbal mang rin po che srid skyong la bzhugs pa dang bsdongs nas sngar gyi 'phros nas gang min gyi ngan spyod mang po dgos med du bsham na yang khong skyabs rje dbal mang rin po che nyid g.yo 'gul ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis kho 1lha3

rang tsho'i ngan spyod de rmatha' rdugs su gyur/ de skabs sdang sems khong du zhugs pas bla dpon 'gas dpung sgril gyi zhu phras gong sa mchog nyid kyang mdzad dka'i mtshams su bskyal/ de skabs khong rin po che 'di ba gnas chung la bsang gtong du phebs par lam nas shog bu gru bzhi zhig rnyed nas gzigs pas logs shig na rgya gser gyes bris pa'i stag nyams dod pa zhig dang rgyab tu dbu 'bab rgya mtsho zhes pa'i yi ge zhig yod pas da ni chos skyong gi 'phrin las kyis mi skyon pa ngo shes snyam pa byung ba bzhin khyi rgan ku co che ba rang phung ber ka'i char 'bod du song /zhes gsungs/ dgung grangs sum cu ba rab tshes shing mo lug gi lor mgo log dkon bkra'i chos mdzad zer ba bla brang phyag mdzod du bzhag pas chab srid kyi byed pa bo kho gcig pur gyur pas bde 'jags byung / 'di ni mgo log dkon bkra tshang yin la khong grwa sar phebs rges 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs te chos mdzad btang bas dkon bkra'i chos mdzad ces grags/ khong gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi tsha bu yin te rang rnam las tshagabu mdzod pa zhes gsungs/ skyabs mgon mchog chab srid thog mdzad dka' byung skabs dkon bkra'i chos mdzad la yi ge btang ste nga la glulha4

grogs byed du khyod yong dgos zhis bke' nan che bas kho yong nas lo bcur bla brang phyag mdzod byas zer/ de'i bar skyabs mgon mchog stod gangs ri sogs su gnas gzigs la phebs/phyag mdzod thugs zin byung zer/ lo 'di'i dpyid ka khong rin po che 'di ba sho ba'i rta mgrin dang len spa san du phyag skor dang gnas gzigs la phebs/ zhal snga nas sgo mang rin po che las rje'i gsung 'bum gyi lung ta pod yan chad song ba'i mtshams nas gdan 'dren pa byung bar brten dbyar ston khong gi 'khrungs yul kwa ring du phebs/ de kar bzhugs skabs su sgo mang rin po ches khong la 'jam dkar gyi bsnyen pa zhig gyis zhes gsung phebs/ de don a khu rin po che la zhus pas a khu rin po che nas khyod shes rab chung bas a lags tshang nas 'jam dkar thon gsungs pa ma red/ khyod rgyud ha cang rtsub cing gyong bas je 'jam la e 'gro dgongs pa red ces gsungs/ de nas bzung bya rgyud rang skad ltar bsnyen pa skabs skabs su btang ba tshar bcu song / khong a khu rin po ches khyod shes rab chung bas a lags tshang nas 'jam dkar thon gsungs pa ma red ces pa ni snang tshod la'ang shes rab ha cang che bar gsungs pa dang khyod rgyud ha cang rtsub cing gyong bas je 'jam la e 'gro dgongs pa 125

red ces pa ni po to ba chen pos/ gyong du bya zhing 'gro dka' bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes pa bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang khong a khu rin po che'i thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur pas rjes su bzung tshul gong du bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi skabs su cung zad bshad mod gal po che la nan tan gyi tshul du 'dir dgung lo sum cu'i dkyus su yod pa thar chags su 'god par bya ste/ yang nyin gcig a khu rin po cher mjal du phebs skabs zhal nas mi dang ma 'grog par 'dug mi thub/ su dang 'grogs kyang skyon ye med pa zhig gtan mi srid mi dang 'grig rgyu gal che cung zad re la bsnyad btags nas spo lang gi ma bsgrud na bzang / res gcig gnyis re la bsran btsugs te bsdad na spangs pa min yang mi mngon pa zhig tu 'gro rgyu yod/ kha ton mag mug zhig 'don rgyu las dpe char blta ba gtso bo gyis/ dpe ltas la tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong thams cad kyi gnad yod 'dug pas gal chen gyis/zhes mtshang la rgol ba'i bslab ston bka' drin du bstsal ba ni/bskal pa bye ba'i bar du mgo la thod bzhin bkur te lus dang longs spyod kyis mchod kyang gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin du khums zhes khong gi rnam thar sa bon du bris pa ni dpon slob 126

gnyis kas gdul bya rnams la bshes gnyen bsten tshul sogs kyi man ngag gi mthil bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang zhu ba po med par rje 'di ba la dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal gyi bshad lung gnang ba dang / mjug tu dge ldan bstan 'bar ma rtsa 'grel kyi bshad lung yang gnang / 'di skabs bstan 'bar ma'i bshad pa la zin bris gyis zhes phebs/ phyi nyin gti mug mun sel glog 'phreng dra ba can/ /mthar 'dzin 'ching rgya gcod pa'i ral gri che/ /rten 'byung stong bar gzigs pa'i mnyam nyid blo/ /dmar ser 'od du 'bar ba de la 'dud/ /ces pa'i lung bshad gzhir bkod de gsungs/ ci zin zin byas kyang de sngon gzhung chen la zin bris byed ma myong ba dang /'phros bshad phal skad du gnang ba rnams dgos chung du bzung ba lta bus ma bris/ phyis su khong nyid la gzigs 'bul zhus par spyi khog bzang ste gang bshad ma thon pa mang / mjug gi chos skyong skabs mgon po chos rgyal bsten dgos tshul bshad pa'i skabs kyi bshad pa 'di la don bsdu lta bu zhig las med/ zin bris kyi rigs 'di rang gis ngos zin pa dang sla chos 'dra baspyoyin yang gsung ris sor bzhag bkod na phyis go ba bskyed tshul 'dra min yong ba dang byin rlabs kyi khyad che ba yod ces phebs/ phyi nas ri 1lha7

dran pa tsho snon bri cung zad byas mod kyang shog dril ra rgya'i bstan dar gyis khyer te stor/ 'di zi—na bris kyi thog ma lta bur song bas rten 'brel cung ma legs par go /nyin zhig shog dril zhigagi mgo na mar/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyobs pa tsong kha ba/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag bgyid na/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes bris pa zhig gnang ste 'di'i 'phro la mar bstod 'grel chen mo nas don ldan ma'i 'bru 'grel rnams rje de nyid kyi gsung gtsang ma sor bzhag tu khong la shog gsungs pa ltar bris te phul bar 'di ngas bskul ba yin rgyu byas te khyod kyi ngag rtsom kyi dang bor zhog gsungs/ bstod 'grel chen mo bsam gyis mi khyab kyang blo dman pa dag la phan phyir 'di ltar bris gsungs pa yin kyang rje btsun gyis/ cha lugs ha cang ngan na gshis kyis brnyas/ /gsungs pa bzhin gzan sham sogs 'phyor bo ni med/ go sa snyan grags ni med/ yon tan can gyi grags skam zhig kyang med pas kun gyis 'phya ba las mi yong snyam nas sbyar byang ma bzhag par phul ba bzhin nyid nas gsung 'bum khrod du de bzhin bzhag 'dug yang zhal nas nga rgyal ma che na bzang sogs skabs skabs kyi skyon gang shugs che na de nyid 'bur 128

'joms kyi bslab ston zhal ta rus pa can stsol ba sogs ma mdzangs kyis bu ba'in lugs sa/nyis char nas bskyangs pa'i bka' drin bsam mtha' med/ khong nyid kyis dpa' ris phyogs kyi grong sngags nga 'dra'i col chung zhig la/ smin grol gling gi sngags pa hong hong tsi/ /chos brgyad rlung gis bskyod pa'i che'i che'i tsi/ /blo la yar bskyed med pa'i pān pān tsi/ /bslab yang dgos pa med do pā chos tsi/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin song ba min par lung rtogs kyi yon tan khya/ga 'go na 'gos chog tu yod lags zhes gsungs/ 'di dag rags rim zhig gong du'ang yod la 'dir thar chags su balko/da pa ni zhal gdams gal che bar bsams nas bkod pa lin no/ / dgung grangs nyer dgu'am sum cu gang rigs shig la cun dkar tho yon gyis bskul ngor chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang zhig skur bar rtsom pa na khong a khu rin po ches 'bod mi zhig btang byung bar rjes gnang skur bar bshol te phebs par a khu rin po che'i zhal nas khong bde thang tshang nas gong sa mchog la 'phrul 'khor lcags mkhar gyi khrid cig zhus 'dug pas khrid dang lag len gyi rim pa la bsnyel gso zhu dgos byung bas 'khor lo'i yi ge btu ba drangs pa spo ba sogs la bya bde ba'i dpe ris 1lha9
