jishig bris te khyer shog ces dang khyod la mi ston na su la ston zhes khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dpe sprad byung bas phyi sgo sdom par brtsams pa na dpe rnams sa la 'thor bas ci drag man ngag zab mo 'di tsho blta chog pa'i gdul bya min ltas su 'dug snyam pa byung ste cung skrag gsungs/ rang shag tu slebs tshe chos nyan pa'ang slebs byung bas rjes gnang bskur/ 'di gzhan la rjes gnang bton pa'i thog ma yin zhes gsungs/ de nas bshags pa dang bla mgon dbyer med re gsungs nas 'phrul 'khor dpe ris sogs bzhed pa ltar bris te phyi'i nangs par a khu rin po che'i phyag tu phul/ 'di skabs kun tu snyan brgyud gleng mo'i tshul du byas/ liṅga dang 'khor lo 'bri tshul sogs phal cher gnang yang rang lta bu snod min du gyur pa dang / khong nyid sku na ha cang mtho bas zhu ma spobs gsungs/dgung grangs so gcig pa rab tshes me pho sprel gyi lor khong a khu rin po che sku khams ma snyoms yang dpon po mtha' yas zer bas phyag rdzas phal cher dbang shed kyis khyer dbus su chas/ gsol thab pa gcig las med kyang khams sangs phyir dbyar ngor brag dkar du phebs/ mi ring bar khong rin po che 'di ba yang sku rjes su phebs nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung zhus te nyan 130

pa'i bar mtshams su byabs khrus re yang 'bul bzhin bzhugs/ston thog khong rin po che 'di ba mtsho kha brgyud nas phyir gdan sar phebs/ de rjes khong a khu rin po che yang gdan sar 'byor/dgun khong ma khu rin po che'i sku khams cung lci bar gyur/ khong rin po che 'di bas mtshams khongs nas rnam rgyal gzungs ring dang 'dus pa'i lus dkyil gyi sgo nas susnya ra dza sogs ci lcogs bsgrubs pas thugs dgyes shing nyin shas re'i mtshams nas sku'i bab dang gsung gleng rgyun chags su song ste khong 'di ba la ku re'i tshul du pha ming bu la btags pa'i bla go tshang / /snga ming phyi mar btags pa'i bla sar tshang / /da lta'i dus kyi phung gsum tsam po tshang / /khyod la bze re can gyis 'di skad zhu/ /zhes gsung 'phros kyi yi ge yang yang phebs/ khong gis de ltar gsung phebs sogs da lta dran na mchi ma dku zhes sogs gsungs pa ni bla ma dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis yang yang gsol ba 'debs pa ni bog 'don gyi mchog tu bstan pa yin no/ /dgung grangs so gnyis pa rab tshes me mo bya'i lo sar la khong rin po che 'di ba a khu rin po che'i sku mdun du phebs par dgyes nyams dang bcas drin bzo'i 'phros mang bstsal/ sku 'da' kha'i bar nyin re bzhin sku mdun du phebs/ mgon po'i 131

stobs chen shugs bzlog dang zhasprel 'don gyi dgu gtor sogs btang / thugs rgyus yod phyir 'phros gtam sna tshogs pa'ang zhus te sku khams bsang / de rjes sprul ba'i sku gling tshang dang zhal slob dam gtsang skor 'gas tshe sgrub dang 'brel bar brtan bzhugs phul yang dge mtshan che ba ma byung zhing zhal nas 'dir 'khod kun la lo re bzhin rje'i bstod 'grel dpyad pa dang bcas tshar re blta gyin yod snyam pa sems la 'dzin zhes phebs/ bzhi ba'i tshes drug gi nyin yang sku mdun du phebs par sngar sku bskun gyis zin te dpe gzigs ma nus dzi nas a lags rin po che 'di ba dang bshes gnyen lung rtogs tshang gnyis su khom gyis lam rim che ba dang legs bshad snying bo gnyis long skabs dang bstun shog byang 'ga' snyan sgron zhu bzhin yod mtshams ye shes rang rig gi thad du yod pa'i lcang skya'i grub mtha' dang mchan gyi gsung tshul 'phros mang / mjug tu khong nyid gling tshang dge rgan yin steng skyabs mgon gsum pas thu'u bkwan yongs 'dzin du btang tshul dang / de skabs dpal mang gong mas rgya sgo nas rgya sgo dang shing sgo nas shing sgo 'grim dgos pa zhig 'byung bar 'dug smad phyogs kyi bya gzhag rim par gsung bkod gnang tshul sogs zhib mthar chod pa zhig gsungs te khyod kyang de bzhin du rgya sgo dang 132

shing sgo 'grim mi dgos mod bsam gsungs pa dang phyi nas bde thang tshang bsten zhes phebs pa sogs phyis 'byung lung bstan dang zhal bkod zhib rgyas bstsal ba ni gsung gi tha mar song zhes gsungs/ 'di'i skabs su a khu rin po ches rje 'di ba phyis su bya khyung sku 'bum sogs byang phyogs kyi sde dgon phal mo cher phebs nas zab rgyas gdams pa'i chos kyi char 'beb par lung bstan pa yin no/ /yang lo sdon ma zhig khong a khu rin po che dgon lung nas phyir phebs 'phral rje 'di ba mjal du phebs par gos ljang khu zhig phyag gis gnang nas rlung 'phar ba'i rten 'a brel yin gsungs te bzhad mo che ba zhig mdzad nas rlung khams dag pa sgrol ma'i rang mdangs yin pas 'phrin las rgyas po yong zhes phebs/ yang bar skabs shig a khu rin po che khong rang nyid kyi gsung gi sgrol ma'i bstod pa'i dpe zhig gnang ste song la ltos dang rgyan dang rgyud bla'i 'phrin las so sor sbyar tshul 'di ltar byas yod/ ngas 'di bris 'phral bla brang nang du shog zer ci yin snyam the tshom log ge bar phyin pas skyabs mgon mchog gis bla ma lab skyabs mgon tshang la bka' chos mang po zhig gnang dgos zhes gsungs byung / de nas brtsams rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las sam sna mang gi bya ba 'di 'ongs pa yin zhes phebs pa kun phyis 133

'byung gi don 'di kun gsungs 'dug ces gsungs pa ni the 'di ba phyis su 'phrin las rab tu rgyas te bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa dag lung bstan par nges so/ /bco lnga'i nyin rje 'di bas a khu rin po che'i zhabs rim du bzang spyod 'chi blu zhig gsungs pa zhabs brtan phul ba'i tha ma yin gsungs/ bcu bdun nyin skyabs mgon rin po che gdan drangs pa'i bar der sku 'das/ gdung mdun nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug dang / tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin gyi smon pa shugs drag dang gdung g.yog sogs las shor med pa bsgrubs pas khong sgo mang rin po ches khyod kyis tshe 'dir go zhig chod pa de yin gsungs/ de rjes ma 'gyang bar bde thang rin po ches dus 'khor 'grel chen gnang rgyu yin pa gsan nas snyan gsan 'beb par phebs pas 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang zhig gnang ba dang 'phrad pas chos 'brel gyi thog ma de nyid du song / de nas bzung bka' chos gang gnang la chad lus med par phyin pas bka' chos spyi dang khrid bshad pa'i rkang de nas tshugs zhes gsungs/ de nas a khu rin po che'i gsung phal che ba a khu lung rtogs tshang las gsan pa sogs gong du zhus zin to/ /lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa nas bcad rgyar bzhugs nas lhag lha so so'i 134

bsnyen sgrub gnang /dgung grangs so gsum pa rab tshes sa pho khyi'i lor mkhan rin po che ngag dbang dge legs tshang gi yang sprul mkhan chem ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las slar yang sngar ma thob pa'i bka' chos mang bo gsan/ sngar zhus bzhin dbal mang sprul sku 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las kyang bka' chos mang du gsan/ dus 'khor rgya nag pa tshang las rgyal mkhan chen gsung 'bum sogs lung kha shas gsan skabs 'di dag tu lo bstar chags su bcu ba'i yar tshes bcu gcig pa'i tshes nas bzung sku mtshams la bzhugs nas lhag lha du ma'i bsnyen sgrub gnang ba'i tho ni gong du rags rim zhig bkod pa las mtha' dag 'god mi nus/dgung grangs so bzhi ba rab tshes sa mo phag gi lor chos rgyal yang gsang gi bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ thun gseng rnams su 'dul ba'i mtha' dpyod zhib klog gnang ba dang / bar du sdom tshig gang yod dang grangs 'dren rnams thugs la bzung ste sra brkyangs gi thad du slebs pa dang mtshan mor glo bur du sku bsnyun drag po zhig bzhes/ mi ring bar sku bsnyun dwangs song yang khong gi thugs la chos spyong bka' gnyan pas 'tshub ltas su 135

dgongs te bstod pa zhig gsar rtsom byas te bshags pa gang drag byas gsungs/ khong bde thang rin po cher de'i rgyu mtshan yi ge'i 'im nas zhus par dpe ltas cung glod ces phebs pas khong gis 'tshub ltas min 'gro snyam du sems bde zhes gsungs so/ /smras pa/ srid las nges 'byung cang shes rta zhon te/ /byang chub sems kyi lcag gis rab bskul zhing / /shes rab mtshon gyis dgra tshogs nyer bcom ste/ /zung 'jug nor bu'i gling der bde bar 'byor/ /spyi bo skyes kyis gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /'chi med rgyal sa thob pa'i byung ba bzhin/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis gser 'khor gyis/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs mchog la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /'bum phrag lha yi rnal 'byor lde mig gis/ /'bum phrag dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sgo phyes te/ /'bum phrag chos sku'i dga' chen gdan khri nas/ /'bum phrag sprul ba'i gar gyis zhing khams —khyab/ /mkhyen brtse chu 'dzin stug po'i klong yangs las/ /dam chos gru char 'jo ba'i snga bsu la/ / mtshan snyan g.yu 'brug gad mo'i sgra brgya rgod/ /skal ldan mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i zlos gar ngom/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad 136

pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtame nyi ma gzhon nu zes bya ba las gnas dbe+en pa bsten te sgrub pa snying ngor+ṣamadzad pas zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rgyal srid la dbang 'byor ba'i sarga ste bdun pa'o skyabs mgon skya phreng bzhi ba zhal b.lugs pa'i ring la bka' gsung dang du blangs te mdo sngags dam chos kyi char chen phab nas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spog bzung b.ri sarga/— 'jigs byed lha yi rnal 'byor 'gran med kyis/ /bdud tshogs bcom dang chabs cig 'phrin las che'i/ /'od brgya 'bar bas gdul bya rgya mtsho yi/ /lung rtogs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dpal der 'dud/ /sems med yongs 'du ljon pa'i yal ga las/ /'bad med 'dod dgu stsol ba'i ngo mtshar ltar/ /rtog med ye shes chen po'i klong yangs las/ /chad med chos rgyun 'bab pa'i tshul de brjod/ /gong du bshad pa ltar rje bla ma bdag nyid chen po 'di bas thos bsam sgom pa mtha' chod pa gnang ba dang mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i snyan pa'i grags pa dbyar gyi rnga gsang bzhin du phyogs kun tu rgyas stabs rang dgon dang phyogs nges med nas skal ldan gyi slob ma sprin ’ 137

bzhin 'dus nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba na/ khong gi thugs la de skabs khong sgo mang rin po che dang bde thang rin po che sogs mkhas grub nyi zla lta bu zhal 'dzoms 'dug pas de dag zhal 'dzoms pa'i skabs 'di lta bur ngal ba mi dgos dgongs mod rgyang ring bo nas chos nyan du 'ongs mkhan dag 'tsho chas kyis mi 'phyid par mthong nas re gnyis la rang gis gang thob rnams sdong khrid gang 'dod byas na kun mkhyen dang bla ma rnam gnyis sogs kyi 'phrin las kyi zhabs 'degs su 'gro tshul zhig yod 'gro thugs la dgongs pa dang / gzhan yang a khu rin po che thugs rje can gyi gsung de ka bsgrubs pa'ang min rgyu med 'gro thugre/sa la dgongs nas khong dgung grangs nyi shu'i steng bde mchog gi dbang dang bo gsungs/ de rjes shig na hal ha'i bka' bcu gsum gyis rje dme shul tshul khrims tshang la rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung dang bshad lung gang yod zhus par rje'i gsung 'bum gyi lung gnang ste lhag ma ma gnang bar rje 'di ba la khyod kyis thon gsungs pa na rje 'di bas khong a khu zhang rin po che la zhus par khyed kyis bton na nga dga' gsungs nas sbas don kun gsal gyi brgyud 'debs dang rgyud kyi kha skong gi dpe bcas gnang nas gsungs par bskul bas bshad lung dang bor gsungs/138

de nas a khu rin po che'i gsung 'bum sogs dgung lo lnga bcu ma gyuzin bar du rim par gsungs pa'i grangs ka rags rim zhig sngar bkod pa ltar ro/ / dgung grangs so lnga ba rab tshes lcags pho byi ba'i lo la sgo mang rin po che las gsang bde sogs dbang chen bco brgyad/gser chos bcu gsum sogs chos bka' rgya cher gsan/ bde thang rin po ches bka' 'gyur gyi lung gnang ba las sngar ma thob pa dran nye'i ra pod yan chad gsan nas mjug tu sems bskyed mchod pa gnang ba'ang gsan to/ /dgung grangs so drug pa rab tshes lcags mo glang gi lo la yang bde thang rin po che la rje rang nyid kyis zhus te gur pod me 'bar ma kha skong po ti bcas chig brgyud du bstsal/ zhal bzhi ba'i be'u bum phyi nang gong sa mchog la dgongs bstan gyis 'di lo gcig la gnang srol med pas ha la rjes sor bstsal/ de skabs dmar chung skor gsum sogs kyang gsan to/ /dgung grangs so bdun pa rab tshes chu pho stag gi lo la yang bde thang rin po che las rgya gzhung lung rgyun gang bzhugs 'bad brtson bgyis te gsan/ zla ba dang bo'i tshes bcu nas nyin bcu drug gi bar dang nag zla'i tshes nas gsang 'dus 'grel ba bzhi 139

brigs kyi bshed lung / 'a dul ba'i gleng 'bum gyi lung bsdus rgyud mchan bcas kyi bshad lung yang bskyar thob/ reb kong nas lcang lung khri rgan tshang khong bde thang rin po cher bka' chos gsan bzhed kyis phebs pas de la gseng bar nam yod la ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang / gzhan lung gi skor yang mang bo zhig gnang /pu rad sprul sku skal bzang chos grags rgya mchos zhus ngor rgyal thang ba'i gcod skor gyi lung skal ldan chos drug le'u tshan gsum sogs gsungs so/ /sgo dgung grangs so brgyad pa rab tshes chu mo yos bu'i lo yang bde thang rin po che las rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje dge 'dun grub/ dben sa ba blo bzang don 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes rnams kyi gsung 'bum dang rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung bka' rgya ma bcas dang / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor/hor ston nam mkha' dpal gyi blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/ glang ri thang ba'i blo sbyong tshigs brgyad ma sogs gsan to/ /dgung grangs so dgu ba rab tshes shing pho 'brug gi lo la byang chub mi la'i skal ldan rnam thar dang / skal ldan mgur 'bum/140

shug yag ri khrod pa'i dge slong dang dge tshul gyi bslab bya/ bse tshang gi rten 'brel bstod pa'i ṭīk+ka/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung 'bum/ sde khri rin po che'i dus 'khor bskyed rim dang snyarma ki rti'i khrid yig steng nas dus 'khor bskyed rdzogs sogs dang / rang gis zhus te bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i bskyed rim/ legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung dang / khrid rdo lag brgyud ma/ rang gis zhus te yongs 'dzin gsung thig le gsal byed steng nas thig le bcu drug gi khrid/ rdo rje tshig spram/ yi ge bzhi ba'i bsad bzlog ma ning ha 'don/ sgra mi snyan gyi tshe khrid/ rdo rje rtse dgu ba la brten pa'i tshe khrid/ 'jigs byed ser po phyag na ku sha bsnams pa'i tshe khrid/ sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung dang rtsa tshig gi steng nas khrid/ brag dkar bka' bcu'i bde lam zin bris kyi lung / kha dron gnas brtan gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung / skyabs mgon bar ba'i gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor rnams gsan/ skabs snga phyir dmigs brtse ma'i bkru byabs/ gza' klu'i dug dbyung re 'bul ba sogs kyis thugs bzhed bskangs/ yang khong rang nyid kyis zhus te kun mkhyen rnam thar btsan po mar grags pa'i lung / paṇa chen gsung steng nas thun drug rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ dbang mdzad sgrol ma glu41

dmar mo'i bo'u bum dang bsnyen sgrub las gsum steng nas lag len zhib khrid bcas gsan/ lo rnying du gi ti tshang nas rnga ba lung rigs ched mngags kyis gsungs pa/ dam pa du ma'i bka' drin las dbang rjes gnang mang bo thob ste khrid bshad pa'i skor 'dod mos bzhin thob pa zhig ma byung / legs bshad snying bo/ ston thun skal bzang mig 'byed/ 'grel chen dri med 'od rnams kyi bshad lung gi ched smon lam grol rgyab la bsu bar 'ongs tshul gyi 'phrin 'byor ba lagyisngon a khu rdo rje 'chang yang bka' chos kyi don du 'di bas gdan 'dren zhus kyang zhal nas dgos na khong tsho tshur yong dgos pa red/ de tshor 'gro mi thub gsungs pa yid la yod pas ma phyin gsungs/ de rjes smon lam steng kirti tshang sku 'das gsungs so/ /dgung grangs bzhi bcu ba rab tshes shing mo sbrul gyi lo la yang bde thang rin po che las dgag bya ngos 'dzin gyi bshad lung dang kun mkhyen gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor khong nas khyod kyis nyon gsungs nas ched gtad kyis gnang ba gsan/ de'i dbyar khong rin po che 'di ba 'brog phyogs su sa chu 'phrod bsten la phebs nas 'brog sar bzhugs yod skabs glo bur du khong bde thang rin po che nyid zhal ma 'tsho ba gsan ma thag 'phral du gdan glu4lha

sir phibs gdung g.yog sogs bya ba thams cad li shor mid pa bsgrubs/ khong rang gi slob ma pu rad pa zhig la sku gdung rin po che bzhugs yul gyi mchod rten sa/ser zangs kyis bzhengs pa'i dge bskul dang phyi nas gzungs 'bul sogs thams cad rje 'di bas khur len gnang ste bla ma dran pa'i gdung yus kyis bsgrubs pa yin gsungs/ rnam thar gyi sa bon yang gsar sgrig gnang nas gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la phul/ dgung grangs zhe gcig pa rab tshes me pho rta'i lor ri khrod pa chos 'byor gyis zhus ngor gur zhal/ ra pod/ dpal pod rnams gnang / phyogs glang sogs 'ga' zhig gis gsol ba btab pa ltar yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi lung / 'jam mgon shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum gyi lung rnams gnang /dgung grangs zhe gnyis pa rab tshes me mo lug gi lo la pu rad bde chen chos 'khor gling gi bla ma sprul ba'i sku bskal bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ rdo rams pa phyogs glang / dge slong chos 'byor sogs kyis bka' 'gyur gyi lung nan tan chen po'i sgortsonas zhus pa bzhin skyabs mgon rin po che dang sgo mang rin po cher bka' gros zhus par sgo mang rin po che nas ngas thob kyang ma thob thob kyang 'don mi nus khyod kyis thon dang legs zhes dgyes pa'i 143

bka' phebs pa ltar/ rgyal mkhan spru'/ gragos pa rgya mtsho/ lcang lung khri rgan 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ hal ha dge bshes 'phrin las/ ci thu med bka' 'gyur ba 'jam dbyangs bzod pa sogs bla grwa brgya lhag tsam la zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes bcu gcig la rgyal ba'i bka' rin po che'i bklag lung gi dbu btsugs/ lnga ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin bka' 'gyur rin po che'i glegs bam thams cad mchod pa'i bkur sti dang bcas bshams te bklag lung gi mjug grub par byas/ tshes bcu gcig la mchod mjal rgyas par byas te rgyal bstan rin po che 'phel rgyas kyi ched sogs sgo du mar dmigs te bsngo smon rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor nan tan dang chos nyan pa rnams dang bcas skyabs mgon mchog la mjal kha zhus pas —thugs dgyes pa'i rtser son mdzad/ de skabs mgo mjug gi bshad pa dang skabs skabs su bshad pa phran bu re byas pa la rgyal mkhan sprul bskal bzang grags pa rgya mtshos zin bris legs bshad mu tig gsar ba'i 'phreng ba zhes pa'ang mdzad/ sngar khong sgo mang rin po che chu bzang du phebs khar bstan 'dzin 'phrin las ched mngags kyis kha dar dkar ser che legs srid du ring ba zhig bskur gnang mdzad de bka' 'gyur gyi 'chad nyan la thugs dgyes pa yod tshul 144

dang de bzhin du phyis su'ang bka' chos 'chad spel rgya chin gnang dgos tshul sogs nang nyams dang sbyar ba'i bslab ston mang du phebs/ de rjes 'gro ba rnams bsod nams dman pa'i dbang gis sgo mang rin po che zhal ma 'tsho ba'i sku gdung rin po che gdan sar 'byor 'phral bka' 'gyur gyi lung re zhig mtshams byas te sku gdung gi bya ba thams cad legs par bsgrubs/ bdag 'jug len pa dang bla ma mchod pā dang 'brel bar gsol ba 'debs pa sogs nan tan gnang / bdag 'jug gsung bzhin pa'i skabs gong sa mchog nas bla brang sku tshab mngags nas kha dar chewegs shig bstsal te gzhung bar lo bstar chags su lam rim bde lam dang 'jam dpal zhal lung khrid res mos su gnang ba'i srol yod pa mi nub par skyongs dgos kyi bka' bstsal ba la sngon sgo mang rin po che byang phyogs su zhabs bskyod mdzad khar gsungs pa/khong a lags rin po che la lam rim gyi gsung chos 'di dang bor bab/ lan grangs re gnyis las ma thon/ dme shul tshul khrims tshang la bab kyang rgyun ma ring / khong rang nyid la bab kyang lo shas las ma nus/ 'phro 'di khyod kyis skyongs gsungs las che'ang dang len ma byas na legs tshul phebs zhes dpa' ris bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kha dar bcas chibs bskyod pa'i 'phral 145

der btang ba thon pas yid za za'i ngang la yod skabs su gnas phyir skabs der dang du ma blangs/ bka' 'gyur rdzogs 'phral mchod mjal skabs mjal bar don der thugs ma mnyes pa'i rnam pa shar/ ring min mdun bcar gyis 'phros mol zhib rgyas zhus parosngon dus mnyam med sgrub khang ba/ dpon slob byams pa/ zhogs don yod mkhas grub/ bla ma yongs 'dzin rin po che sogs kyis paṇa chen bde lam dang 'jam dpal zhal lung res mos kyis ston dpyid gnyis la zla chos re gnang ba'i srol mchis/da cha bod yul chos kyi zhing sar yang ming tsam yang dkon pa 'di red partswadagon sde 'di tsho bstan pa'i 'byung gnas gnyis par byed dgos rgyur 'dug pas res mos kyis lo re bzhin ma chad na legs snyam pa yin yang 'u ba'i lam rim dang gdugs dkar lha khang gnyis la lab gleng mang lugs gsungs par/ lags ji srid 'tsho'i bar nyid kyi dgongs bzhed ltar bsgrub ces zhus te mi mnyes pa med par byas/ phyogs yas mas nas bsdus na mang 'gro bas ma bsdus/ khong gi bka' bzhin nyin shas la myur lam gyi khrid dang dgun ngor 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba ltar lam rim chen mo dang sngags rim chen mo gnyis kyi bshad lung byas/dgung grangs zhe gsum pa rab tshes sa pho sprel lo la rje'i 146

gsung 'bum gyi lung dang sras kyi thu bo gnyis kyi gsung 'bum dang bcas pa/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / lam rim bde lam gyi khrid/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs bcas/ ra rgya'i bstan dar la zhang ston bka' 'bum sogs mnog chos mang bo gsungs/dgung grangs zhe bzhi ba rab tshes sa mo bya'i lo la bstan 'gyur gyi lung rgyun gang yod/ 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad lung /bkra shis lhun po'i sngags phyogs pod gnyis gyi lung rnams bstsal/thabs mkhas kyis zhus ngor bde mchog lca i pa lha re gnyis kyi dbang / 'jam dbyangs bzod pas zhus ngor za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg dang dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i khrid/ thabs mkhas dang 'jigs med gnyis kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs dmar khrid nyin bdun dang / bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs nyin lnga la bstsal/ bkra shis lhun po'i gtsang ba sman pa pha gzhis chos mdzad kyis zhus ngor gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ zhang ston sgrol ma'i chos skor las rgyud ṭīk+ka 'phags ma'i zhal lung / sgrub thabs 'phrin las sgo bsgro 'byed pa'i sde mig bsnyen yig lag len rab gsal/ sher sgrub nyid byed snang ba/ snin sreg 'phrul gyi lde mig g.yang sne47

'gug dkar mo g.yas 'khyil/ brgyud 'debs margad snye ma/smon shis drang srong bden tshig rlung bskyed bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang de'i lhan thabs/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa ma tshan don gsal ba/ khyab bdag/ stag phu bas mdzad pa'i phongs sel sgrol ma'i gter sgrub/ lce spyang sngon mo'i lam srung / mar me'i sgo nas lkog gyur brtag thabs/ dge 'dun 'du 'khor sgrub tshul/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba'i cho ga sgrol dkar spyin dzesreg gung thang gsung yid bzhin 'khor lo'i 'dod gsol dang seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi tshe sgrub/ dbal mang gsung sgrol ma nyer gcig gi dkyil chog rje pra tsā'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i sgrol dkar tshe khrid mi shigs 'od kyi gur khang / tshe khrid dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'phreng ba dang zla 'od snye ma/ mkhan chen ngag gi dbang bo'i stag phu'i sgrol ma'i bdag 'jug brgyud 'debs smon lam bcas/ khong rang nyid kyi gsung sgrol dkar bstod pa ut+pal 'od kyi lcags kyu so gas lung mang du gnang / 'khor chen dbang /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang / reb kong mtshan sgrog sprul sku ched gnyer gyis phebs te zhus ngor g.yu thog sman dbang sogs bstsal/dgung grangs zhe lnga ba lcags pho khyi'i lo la pu rad sprul sku tsā48

bskal bzang chos grags rgya mtshos zhus ngor sgrub thabs rin 'byung rjes gnang lung bcas/ 'jigs med kyis zhus ngor gsang 'dus bskyed rim dmar khrid nyin lnga dang rdzogs rim nyin gsum la bstsal/ gzhan yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bde stong dbyer med ma'i khrid de sngon 'gro 'brel ba can gyi khrid bzhir grags pa dang / rdor sems yab rkyang dang yab yum gyi rjes gnang / dam can srog gtad/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig 'khor chen rnams kyi dbang /nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang /rigs gsum spyi sgrub dang 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang rnams gsungs/dgung grangs zhe drug pa lcags mo phag gi lo la gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu/ dril bu phyi dkyil lha lnga dang lus dkyil lha re gnyis/ sman bla lha nga gcig dpal mo'i lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal lha lnga/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu rnams kyi dbang / stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang gi dbang / 'jam dbyajas chos skor gyi rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing / tshe lha rnam gsum kyi rjes gnang / dbu ma ba 149

dpa' bo rdo rje'i 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes chog gsang sgrub kyi sbyin greg bcas/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i chos skor/ 'a jam dbyangs smra seng gi chos skor/ 'jam dbyangs nag po'i choyoskor dang las tsho gas btsun pa rdor rgyal gyis mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i chos skor dang dmar mo'i chos skor/ sgrol dkar chos skor/ rje drung dkon mchog nyi mas mdzad pa'i srad rgyud tshe khrid yang zab/ mergan mkhan po'i pra sgrub le tshan/ stag phu sgrol ma'i chos skor char 'beb dang /gdung 'bod bslu med ma bcas/ klu dbang rgyal bo'i las tshogs/ tshe khrid zhag bdun ma'i nyams len brgyud 'debs de'i kha skong bcas tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ rigs grwa tshang gis mdzad pa'i ze brtsegs 'gong sreg khyung nag las tshogs shar 'bum chu bas mdzad pa sogs yongs rdzogs/ khyung khra'i las tshogs gzungs dpal bas mdzad pa sogs lung mtha' yas pa bstsal/dgung grangs zhe bdun pa rab tshes chu pho byi lo la dpyid dus su bla mchod dang phyag chen sgrags ma'i khrid shin tu rgyas pa nyin bcu gcig la gnang / de nas 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang rin po che las gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma/ dgra nag 150

bcu gsum ma/ 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang ro langs brgyad skor/ 'khor chen ‘rtswa bco brgyad/ rdor dbyings/ mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum/ snur lugs rnam 'joms lha mang rnams kyi dbang gsan/ de dag gi bar gseng rnams su rong bo'i khri rgan 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs la mgon po'i be'u bum/ rnam sras mdung dmar can dang ser gyi be'u bum/gur pod me 'bar ma/ zhal bzhi ba'i be'u bum ha la nag po'i skor ma gtogs yongs rdzogs kyi lung rbestsal/ snron zla'i tshes la 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang rin po che las mi tra'o nange tshan dpal mchog dang bo'i rdor sems lha re gcig pa'i dbang nas bzung thugs rje chen po phyag ba'i/ ba lha bcu gsum gyi dbang gi bar dbang brgyad gsan/ de nas gzhan la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ sgrol dkar tshe khrid/ 'pho ba dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ma'i khrid/ zhi ba lam zab kyi khrid/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid sogs dang / lho brag bka' 'bum da nga dben sa bka' 'bum gyi lung / thar chen/ mdo sdud pa/ bzang spyod sogs kyi lung la sogs pa'i bka' chos mang bo gnang /dgung grangs zhe brgyad pa chu mo glang gi lo la rdo ram/sa pa sagon dkar gyis zhus ngor drug pa'i tshes gsum nas nyin lnga la 151

stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed dang nyin bzhi la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phar phyin mchan gyi bshad lung / gzhan yang gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung / rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang /'jam dbyangs dkar bo sgrol dkar sogs kyi rjes gnang /skyabs 'gro/ sgrol dkar ljang sogs kyi lung / nyer gcig nas bzung a khu rin po che'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung / stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang gi dbang / sgrol dkar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / sgrol dkar tshe khrid bcas/bde thang sprul skus zhus pa ltar byang chub lam rim che ba dang chung ngab gnyis kyi bshad lung dang / bde thang rin po che'i gzimahokhang du sprul ba'i sku'i gtsos bla grwa mang bo la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang mgon chos sogs kyi rjes gnang / gzhan yangardzibade mchog dril bu lus dkyil dang 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi ngadabang / nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs dang sngags btu/ nyingam sbas pa'i lug/sa kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig zhal rnam 'gyur bcu—bdun/ rnam sras bka' bco lnga/ lha mo/ dur khrod bdag po/ lcam sring / rgyal bo sku lnga'i srog gtad bcas dang / nyung 'dus la thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma 'i gsung bka' rgya ma yongs rdzogs dang / rgyal mkhan gsung bka' rgya can dang ’/ mdzod 152 d+ku

dgori khrod dbang bo'i gsung skor 'ga' zhig gi lung / smananegyi rgyud chung gsum/ man ngag bka' rgya ma'i lung / rje bla mnekhong rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i bslab bya legs par bshed pa nesnying gi gtam/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsam gtan bdag 'jug rnam sras dkar bo'i tshe sgrub kyi lung sogs chos bka' mang du bstsal/ zhal snga nas sgo mang rin po che sku gong ma de nyid bla ma rin po che khong rang la bka' drin shin tu che gsungs/sgo mang rin po che sku 'da' tshul ston bzhed kyis dgon lung du chibs bskyod pa'i nangs par yang dpa' ris bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi lag tu kha dar zhig bskur te nga dga' yod/ 'di bzhin song zhes shod gsungs te phebs pa 'phral du phyis mi mjal rgyu zhig yid kyi zur la ma shar yang gsung gi tha mar song ba dang chung dus nas sha tsha ba'i gtam gyis bskyangs pa'i bka' drin bsam na mchi ma dku zhes gsungs/ khong gi nang mi dag gi ngag bzhin sprul ba'i sku la khyung rtse thang nas rab byung phul/ gong sa mchog nas mtshan la skal bgang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes gnang ba btags/ skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha —brgya ma/ lam rim bsdus don/ dge ldan bstan 'bar ma rnams kyi lu nga / gong ma'i dus bzhin bstan 'gror sman pa'irdzo153

mdzad bzang dgos tshul zhus/ dgung grangs zhe dgu ba rab tshes shing pho stag gi lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sgo mang mkhan sprul skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhus ngor skyabs khrid/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ tshes bcu gnyis nas lam mchog snying bo/ gzhi gsum cho ga lam rim myur lam/ lam rim bsdus don/ zhi ba lam zab/ brgya rtsa/za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg rnams kyi khrid/ tshes nyer gnyis nas gsang 'dus sta gon dang de'i dbang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ bde mchog lo hu ba/ 'khor chen rnams kyi dbang /rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ tshe dbang / 'dzam dkar/ sgrol dkar/ khyung khra rnams kyi rjes gnang / gnyis pa'i nyer bdun nas rgyal tshang gis zhus te rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nas mgon po'i bka' bcu gsum/ zhi khro sprags sgrub kyi khrid/ dbal mang gsung zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi lung / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad la rgyal dbang skal bzang ba'i gsung bka' rgya ma/ khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ tshes bcu gcig nas zhog don yon mkhas grub pa'i gsung 'bum/ tshes nyer gnyis nas rgyal mkhan 154

po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga la bsdus grwa'i lung dang / sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung / tshes nyer gnyis la yi ge bzhi ba'i srung bzlogagazungs 'jug 'jam dpal zhi drag gi srung ba rnams kyi khrid/rab gnas/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor rnams kyi khrid/ zla ba lnga ba rjes ma'i tshes bcu bzhi nas lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya ma dang bcas pa'i lung /skyes rabs so bzhi ba'i lung / sna zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis la bde mchog lus dkyil bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ tshes bcu la tshems bu dmar khrid/ tshes bcu gcig la thun drug rnal 'byor gyi khrid/tshes bcu gnyis nas lcang skya ngag dbang chos ldan gyi gsung 'bum/ tshes rmebacu bdun nas dpa' cig gi dbang sta gon dngartebacas pa/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang /dpa' cig gi lung / sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i khrid/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la 'grel ba don gsal sdud mchan ni sbyar ba'i bshad lung / tshes brgyad la tshe dbang / sgrol dkar rjes gnang / tshes bcu nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / tshes bcu bdun nas nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig 'khor chen/ thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/155

oṃn bla/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal rnams kyi dbang / thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang / tshes bcu drug nas mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang /rnam rgyal ma/ 'od zer can ma/ lo gyon ma/ seng gdong ma/'jigs byed yum bcas/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ zhal bzhi ba/ sgrol ma nyer gcig rnams kyi rjes gnang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sngags btu/ rigs byed ma phyi sgrub thun mong yin min gnyis dang gsang sgrub dang dam can ra zhon rnams kyi rjes gnang / tshar ba'i rigs byed ma'i lung / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes drug nas 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang / zla dgu ba'i tshes bzhi na sa rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ gdugs dkar/rta mgrin gsum gyi rjes gnang dang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang / gdugs dkar lha mang gi dbang / dam can ra zhon gyi srog gtad/ lcam sring gi rjes gnang / sku lnga'i srog gtad/tshes bdun nas rta mgrin chos skor gyi lung / tshes bco lnga nas mkhas grub gsung 'bum gyi 'phro/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i be'u bum/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nas 'jigs byed dpa' ci ga dang dril bu lha lnga'i dbang / thig le bcu drug gi dbang / chos rgyal gsum gyi rjes gnang / lha mo'i be'u bum gyi lung / zla ba 156

bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga nas 'jigs byed ba—cu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs sogs gnang / lo 'dir gzhan yang snga phyir bka' chos gnang ba'i rim pa ni/ byin rlabs spungs zhus kyi khrid/ bde lam gyi khrid smin rgyas/ bla ma mchod pa'i nyams khrid/ sngon 'gro'i khrid chen bzhir grags pa/ 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid sogs dang / mergan mkhan po'i sgrol ma'i bra 'beb kyi khrid/ bzang spyod/ sher snying / dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa/za byed mkha' 'gro/ tsha gsur/ 'byung bzhi/ 'pho ba dpa' bo g.yul 'jug su rū ba'i gtor ma gtong tshul/ sun mdordzobargyad brgya ba/ gung thang gsung gi sman chog mdor bsdus/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs/'jagadabyangs bde ba'i rdo rje'i srad rgyud bla ma rnams kyi brgyud 'debs/ smon shis/ mergan bla ma ngag dbang blo gros kyi zin sris/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i za byed mkha' 'gro'i 'dod gsol/stag phu'i lkog gyur brtag thabs snang srid gsal ba'i me long /spyod 'jug chen mo/ skyes rabs so/ bzhi ba/ bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i gsung 'jigs mdzad dbang gi rgyal bo'i 'phreng ba/ rje zhang ston pa'i rje'i mchod chog dang de'i zur 'debs/ yig brgya bzla tshul snying gi thur ma/ bslab 157

bya snying gi gre/tam/ bsam gtan bdag 'jug rnam sras dkar bo'i tshe sgrub/ bstod pa don ldan ma// rje'i bstan pa dang mjal ba'i smon lam/ sgo mang mkhan rin po che'i gsung gi thun drug dang 'brel pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi len tshul/ tshe mdo/'od dpag med kyi bstod pa 'i/nga mchog sgo 'byed/ gdugs dkar mchog grub ma/ rgyal ba bye ba ma bzlog pa bcas/ lcags ra ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi lha mo'i sho mo 'debs tshul sogs lung gi tshogs phon che ba gnang ba dang / rmo dbang gi rim pa slar yang bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ 'jigs byed dpa' cigabade mchog dril bu phyi dkyil lus dkyil gnyis dang / rjes gnang gi skor la/ grub rgyal tshe dbang lan gnyis/ mgon bka' bcu gsum/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba jo lugs/bka' gdams lha bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs/ don zhags ser bo lha lnga/ don zhags lha lnga/ ma ti'i lugs kyi 'jam dkar/phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga/ mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba 'byung bo 'ur 'ded/ khyung nag me'i spu gri/ mi g.yo ba sngon po/ phyag rdor pus btsugs ma/ 'jigs byed dmar po mda' 'geng bcas gsungs/ gzhan yang snga phyir skyabs mgon mchog gi zhal snga las mgon po'i rab gnas/ mchog sgrub pa'i rlung 158

sgrub thun mong ma yin pa sogs dang / klu'i bum gter gyi khrid/lo gyon ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid/ tshe khrid zhag bdun ma/ bu ston gong khug ma'i tshe khrid/ bla ma lnga bcu ba'i bshad lung /sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i zin bris kyi lung sogs dang /mgon po'i be+e'u bum gyi khrid la mkho ba'i man ngag du ma'i lung khrid bla ma zhi khro'i tshe dbang / nam mkha' bsam 'grub pa'i mi la'i gsol 'debs kyi lung / lha mo tsa: ka'i rjes gnang bka' rgya ma rnams dang / bu ston gong khug ma'i tshe dbang bcas gsan/ gzhan yang khong gis skyabs mgon rin po cher khyed kyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi bklag lung zhig dgos zhes zhus par dgyes pa'i gsung 'phros du ma dang bcas gsung mgur gyi rim pa nas dbu btsugs te long skabs gang yod la bstsal zhing / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge dang las bzhi'i drug cu ba'i rnam bzhag gnyis kyi lung khrid gcig 'thus kyi tshul du bstsal/ bar skabs shig thugs shin tu spro nyams kyis/ ming snyan brtsams chos don du ngag 'chal 'ga'/ /brtsams pa'i lung rgyun spel ba don chung yang / /deng 'dir dam pas bskul ba nan che bas/ /rnga la dbyu gus bskul bzhin dbang med bton/ /zhes rje 'di ba la gnang ste 'di tsho 'phror khyod kyi rnam 159 rmo

thar gyi nang du 'jog dgos zhes gsungs pa sogs ni thugs dgyes pa'i rtser son mdzad pa tsam du ma zad rje 'di ba 'phags chen skyes bu dam pa yin pa zhal gyis bzhes pa'o/ /yang zhal nas dgon 'dir bde mchog rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa zhig yod na legs tshul gsungs pa ltar khong rin po che 'di bas a mchog rin po che las bde mchog 'jam rdor/ me tri bcu gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnams kyi dbang dang / sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang bcas gsan to/ /dgung grangs lnga bcu ba rab tshes shing mo yos bu'i lo la zla ba dang bo'i tshes bcu bdun nas dus 'khor ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i kha skong dang bcas pa'i lung / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nas bka' gdams pha chos bu chos cha tshang gi lung gnang / sbyin rgyam gyis zhus ngor skyabs mgon bka' 'bum gyi lung / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu nas rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung / zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig nas zam tsha gser khri sprul ba'i sku dang sgo mang mkhan sprul sogs bla grwa nyis brgyar nye ba la 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha ba chen po'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs bka' rgya ma dang bcas pa'i lung / zla ba drug pa'i tshes nas rgyal mkhan sprul 160

skus zhus ngor lho brag grub chen gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs bstsal/ dbang gi rim pa'ang sta gon sngon du btang ste 'dus pa 'phags lugs/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ lca i pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha re gnyis pa/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu/ snur lugs rnam 'joms lha mang sogs kyi dbang / sta gon bcas 'jigs byed dpa' cig lho brag grub chen gyi bka' 'bum las byung ba'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs bcas dang / zla ba bcu ba'i tshes la tshe dbang bu ston gong khug ma dang de'i tshe khrid bcas bstsal/ lo de'i zla ba gnyis pa'i mar ngor sku bsnyun gyi rnam pa mngon tshan che ba tsam bzhes pa la skyabs mgon mchog nas zhabs rim gang dgos kyi rim pa bkod khyab gnang ba ltar bsgrubs shing / skyabs mgon mchog nas brtan bzhugs 'bul dgos tshul gsungs pa ltar brtan bzhugs phul/skyabs mgon rin po che nyid nas kyang thugs khur che banes kyis srung mdud lha rdzas bcas gnang nas zhabs pad yun ring brtan dgos kyi gsung yig tsha nan can gnang ba sogs la brten nas sku bsnyun dwangs skyed byung / de rjes skyabs mgon nyid kyi nyams bzhes dgos tshul gsungs nas kha dar dbang ldan ma zhig bstsal nas ras chung lugs kyi phyag na rdo rje gtum chen bsrung ba'i 161

mkhar gyi sgrub thabs shig rtsom bskul gnang ba la brten nas skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar sgrub thabs ljags rtsom mdzad pas sngar gyi bsnyun gzhi lhag med du dwangs/ slar skyabasacimagon mchog la dngos mjal skabs lag rtsar gzigs skabs/ smanapapas byang chub kyi sems rtsa chags yod zer zhes zhus par/rten pho la mo rtsa chags na tshe ring / yas byams mas sdang mthun gsum dgra ru snang / zhes sku tshe ring du gnas pa 'dra gsungs/mthun gsum la gang ngos 'dzin zhus par khu bo phu nu sogs rtsir 'dug gsungs nas tshe ring du gnas dgos tshul sogs gsungs/slar rje 'di ba rang nyid kyis 'a/nga tshal ba'i lugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi ba'i sku brnyan khyad 'phags shig gsar bskrun byas te khong skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs bzhed dang mthun par phul bas dgyes ba zhes mjod cing / de skabs khong gong sa mchog nyid la mtshan rmis khyad par can zhig kyang byung ste/ khong skyabs mgon mchog nyid kyi gsang rnam las/ yang skabs shig sems la mgon po phyag drug pa bar do'i chos skyong khyad par can yin phyir nga'i rang lo mthor song gshis lha 'di la chos skyong rnams kyi nang nas gtso bor bzung na legs snyam nas cho ga 'khyer bde re rgyun 'don byas skabs bla brang mgon khang 'dra ba zhig nas mgonarte162

po phyag bzhi ba'i sku shin tu legs pa zhig gcig gis khyer yong ba nga la sprad pa'i snang ba btang byung nas 'di ka la gsol ba 'debs dgos pa e yin snyam pa byung zhes gsungs/ rje 'di bas zhus ngor gong sa mchog nas mgon po'i rigs gtad thun mong ma yin pa chig brgyud du bstsal/ lo mjug tu gong sa mchog gser skyibs nyi zla'i khang bzang na bzhugs skabs thu'u bkwan mchog gi sprul skus zhus ngor rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rmobs gsung bshad zhib la rgya che ba du ma dang bcas bstsal ba'ang rje 'di bas legs par gsan/ gzhan yang lo 'dir rje bka' drin can 'di bas zhu ba po so so'i 'dod pa ltar khrid kyi rim pa'ang mtha' yas pa bstsal te tshar chen gyi yi ge'i steng nas 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i las tshogs kyi khrid/ tshar chen gyi gnad yig sogs sbrags pa'i steng nas rigs byed ma'i bsnyen skrub las gsum gyi khrid/ rgyal mkhan chen gyi rigs byed ma'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam bzhag dngos grub nor bu'i gter mdzod kyi bshad khrid/ dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīk+ka tshig don rab gsal steng nas rigs gsum spyi sgrub lan gnyis/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dang / rin 'byung nang tshan mi g.yo ba 163

dkar bo dang dbyangs can ma dkar mo khyung nag me'i spu gri gnyis kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ bshad lung gi skor/ byang chub lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung smin rgyas/ gsang sngags lam rim/ lam rim myur lam/ lam rim bsdus don/ bla ma lnga bcu ba/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi rnam bshad 'bring bo/ blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rnams kyi bshad lung / bla ma phun tshogs pas zhus ngor rigs byed ma'i be'u bum yongs rdzogs/ mdung rtse ras pa'i dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs bcu gcig paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang sman khang ba'i dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs/ drag sngags thog mda'/ 'jigs byed byad grol/mergan bla ma ngag dbang blo gros kyi dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid yigadwags po sgom chen pa'i lam rim tshigs bcad ma/ thang sag pa'i 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs/ 'grel chung don gsal/ grub mtha' rtsa ba/ bka' gdams gsung thor/ ding ri brgyad cu ba/ang yig bdun cu ba/ chig lab ring mo/ mi chos gnad kyi 'phreng ba/ byang sems ra sgrong ba'i blo sbyong byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun/ nag tsho'i jo bstod brgyad cu ba dang / yongs grags kyi jo bstod/ shar ba'i lam rim/ so thar gyi mdo yongs rdzogs/ mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs baiḍūr zhun ma'i them skas/ blo 164

sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo/ be'u bum sngon po rtsa 'grel/ dpe—chos rtsa 'grel/ rgyal sras lag len/ bu ston snying thur/ blo sbyong rnon bdun ma dang tshigs brgyad ma/ rgyal ba jage 'dun rgya ma tsho'i 'jigs byed smon lam/ zhang zhung ba'i 'jigs byed smonadzhashis sogs chos rgyun dkon pa mtha' yas pa'i lung bstsal/dgung grangs nga gcig pa rab tshes me pho 'brug gi lor zla ba dang bo'i tshes bzhi la ngag byin rlabs kyi khrid dang rgya ra'i lta skekhrid/ tshes lnga nas nyin gnyis la 'jigs byed ser bo'i tshe khrid dang chos spyod skal bzang mgrin rgyan gyi lung / tshes bdun nas nyin bzhi la bkra shis lhun po'i sngags phyogs hūṃd gnyis kyi lung /tshes bcu gcig nas nyin gnyis la gtam brgyud rin chen 'phreng mdzes kyi lung / tshes bco lnga nas byang chub lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung / nyer gcig nas nyin bzhir legs bshad snying po'i bshad lung / nyer bdun la bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang / nyer brgyad la rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi bla ma'i rna la 'byor gyi khrid/ nyer dgu mkhas grub chig brgyud kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang / tshes gnyis la de'i khrid/ tshes gsum la thig le bcu drug gi khrid/ tshes bzhirartsothar chen gyi lung / tshes lnga la 165

rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung / tshes drug la rje'i bstod pa rdon lngan ma rtsa 'grel gyi bshad lung gi dbu btsugs/ tshes bdun la rtogs bdun mchan 'grel gyi bshad lung / tshes brgyad la 'jam dkar zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid/ tshes dgu nas nyin gnyis la rje'i bstod 'grel gyi bshad lung gi 'phro/ tshes bcu gcig nyin bde thang sprul ba'i sku la bsdus grwa'i mtha' dpyod kyi dbu nas dpe khrid dang nyin gnyis la rgyud don gsal ba'i steng nas kun rig gi phyag rgya khrid/ tshes bcu gsum la ri khrod gong mar phebs te skyabs mgon mchog la mjal kha zhus/ don skor 'ga' zhus pa las brtsams te gsung gleng dmar/ phyir phebs nas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / tshes bcu bzhir lam rim bsdus don gyi khrid/ tshes bco lnga nas nyin gnyis la sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung gnang / nyin der skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa ri khrod nas gdan sar phebs par slar yang mjal te sngar zhus ltar ma gon po phyag bzhi ba'i dbang sogs chos rgyu na dkon pa 'ga' zhig gi snyan gsan phul bar dgyes nyams dang bcas te yong / nyi shu gnyis nas 'don rgyu byed ces phebs mod khong gis glo bur du bsnyun drag po bzhes/ de skabs rje 'di nyid kyis kun rig gi dbang chen phul ba dang / 'bum ston jo 166

bo'i mdun nas gnas brtan phyag mchod 'bul sgrub sogs la rdzinan tan mdzad par ma zad dngul srang bco lnga phul nas 'di nyid 'a/banuklo brtan gyi rgyur byas te bstan 'gro'i don du zhabs pad brtan dgos kyi zhu ba phul bar zhabs brtan gyi rgyur 'gro ba cis kyang yong zhes bka' lung bzang bo phebs/ yang skyabs mgon gyis tshe sgrub cig gnang dgos gsungs pa ltar rje 'di nyid kyis bcad rgya'i khongs nas gdung shugs drag po'i gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs bzhin du gsungs/ skyabs mchog nyid kyi mkhyen pa'i gsung zur yang byung / de rjes sems can bsod nams dar/na pa'i dbang gis skyabs mgon mchog zhal ma 'tsho bar rje 'di bas gces rnar stor ba lta bu'i sems ngal tshad las 'das kyang bya thabs bral gsungs shing sku gdung rin po che ma nyams par bzhugs pa'i mdun nas gdung ba'i yus kyis tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs gsar rtsom mdzad/ yang bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par bltas te bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug len pa sogs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs su ci 'gyur gnang / sngar skyabs mgon mchog gis rang re'i dgon 'dir bde sdachog rab 'byams kyi dbang zhig yod na legs gsungs pa'i zhal gdams thugs la bzhag 1 67

4nas sku gdung zhugs 'bul gyi ched a mchon rin po che phebs pa la khong gis ched gnyer gyis zhus te bde mchog rab 'byams kyi khrod nas sngar ma song bcu lhag yod gsan te skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' bzhin du bsgrubs so/ /yang khong gis skyabs mgon rigadung mdun nas mi la'i rnam thar gyi dbu btsugs te de dang sanyam du mgur ma yang gsungs/ tshar ma thag khong ra bar phyin skabs gnyan thog blo bzang gis tsan+dan gyi mi la'i sku gzungs 'jug tu nā ro ba'i rus rgyan dang mi la'i sgom thag yod pa zhig phul bas rten 'brel legs tshogs che ba byung /smras pa/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi ba thub chen shākya seṅge yi/ /bstan la dbang bsgyur dbang phyug brgyad ldan bstan pa'i bdag po sogs/ /bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma rnams kyis dam chos gser 'khor che/ /phyag tu gtad de thub bstan khyod la dbang bsgyur 'di ko rmad/ /bstan bdag mig stong ldan pa de dag gi/ /bstan srid nor bu'i khri la zhabs bko da de/ /bstan 'dzin lha brgya'i thugs kyi yol go ru/ /bstan rgyun bdud rtsi'i char chen yongs su phabs/ /skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs bzhed rin chen snod/ /yongs su skong ched he ru ka dpal dngos/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i gser zhal 168

las/ /he ru ka dang/la rab 'byams dbang chen blangs/ /drang srong dza hus 'gro ldan bzhes pa 'a/sa/ /slar yang sdig sbyangs ched du skyugs nga/ bzhin/ /snod ldan skal ldan shing rta'igasol btab bzhin/ /dbang chen 'gro ldan ma yi rgyun bzangaspel/ /gdan sa'i gser khri mkhan sprul dge ba'i bshes/gser gyi ri bo lta bu'i gdul bya dang // /nges med phyogs nar+sāphebs pa'i skal ldan la/ /mdo sngags bdud rtsi'i char chen phangs med phabs/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las skyabs mgon sku phreng bzhi ba zhal bzhugs pa'i ring la bka' gsung dang du blangs te mdo sngags dam chos kyi char chen phab nas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog bzung ba'i sarga ste brgyad pa'o/ / ris med kyi gdul bya la sngar bzhen bdud rtsi'i bgo skal gnang ba dang/ bshad thab zung du 'brel ba'i 'bras rtags lhag pa'i lha'i zhal mthong zhing rtogs pa badhes pa'i sarga/ /'jigs mdzad gshin rje'i gnyis med bde chen gyi/ /ting 169

'dzin chu 'dzin stug po'i klong yangs las/ /'phrin las sgra brgya dang 'grog dam chos/ kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab mdzad zhabs la 'dud/ /'gag med gsung gi rdo rje'i rang gshisasnakyis/ /chad med gsung gi mdzad pa'i dga' ston la/ /risartemed gdul bya 'dus pa'i byung pa dag /bdag med ngag gi rol mos gleng bar bya/ /skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo dgongs pa rdzogs rjes srid skyong dbal mang rin po che 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang mkhan chen ngag dbang dge legs pa'i yang sprul bskal bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ bsod grags sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'jigs med bsod nams rgya mtsho ste dam pa gsum gyis bskul ba bzhin skyabs mgon mchog gi rnam thar kha skong gshes ldan yid kyi dga' ston rin chen 'phreng ba'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba ljags rtsom mdzad pa dang sku gdung rin po che zhugs 'bul sogs la yang khur len yang dag mdzad/ de nas yang bla ma rnam pas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba bzhin mu mthud de bar ma chad par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul ni/ lo de'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu tha/sum nas nyin lngar sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi lung dang gung thang 170

'jam pa'i dbyangaso kyis mdzad pa'i gtor bsngos rnam dag chos dbyings ma'i lung gnang / tshes bco brgyad nas nyin gsum la bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i bskyed rim gyi khrid gnang / de nas nyin bzhir bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi bskyed rim gyi khrid gnang / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bzhi nas nyin gnyis la de'i rdzogs rim gyi khrid gnang / tshes drug nas nyin bdun la byang chub lam gyi rim pa dmar khrid bde lam gyi khrid gnang / tshes bcu bzhi la 'jam dkar las tshogs kyi khrid dang sman mdo brgyad brgya ba'i lung gnang / tshes bco lnga la bsgrub bya du ma la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog tshes bcu drug la zhi khro sprags sgrub kyi rnam bshad 'bring bo'i bshad lung dang seng gdong ma'i las tshogs kyi lung /sdeb sbyor 'grel ba don gsal me long gi lung gnang / tshes bcu bdun la grub rgyal tshe khrid gnang / nyer drug nas nyin gsum la bde mchog bskyed rim gyi khrid gnang zhing nyin gcig la de'i rdzoṭa rim gyi khrid gnang / tshes lnga nas nyin gsum la 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gnang / tshes dgu la zhi khro sbrags sgrub rdo rje'i tshig spram gyi khrid gnang / tshes bcu la dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i las tshogs kyi khrid gnang / tshes bcu gcig la paṇa chen khrid yig tshigs bcad ma'i steng nas nā ro chos drug 171 /

gi khrid gnang / tshes bcu gnyis la jo nang khrod brgya'i lung khrid gnang / tshes bcu gsum nas nyin gnyis la bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang mkha' spyod ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bco lnga nas nyin bdun la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang lung bcas gnang / nyer gnyis nas nyin bzhi la ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung bcas gnang / nyer drug nas nyin gnyis la snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang bstsal/ nyer brgyad nas nyin gnyis la 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa sa/nang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig la 'dod rgyal sa/sang sngags sgra'i rjes gnang / sku lnga'i srog gtad dam can mgar nag gi srog gtad rnams bstsal/ pu rad sprul sku bskal bzang chos grags rgya mtshos zhus ngor tshes bdun la sta gon dang / tshes brgyad nas 'phreng kri sbrags pa'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang bskur yongs rdzogs gnang ste nyer lnga'i nyin grub/ kun spangs grags pa dar rgyas kyis zhus ngor nyer drug nas nyin ba/sum la snga dro dang phyi dro dbang re gnang nas bde mchog rab 'byams las —'khrul spong lugs kyi bde mchog lha re gnyis pa/ bstod 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog lha re gnyis pa/ bde mchog sdom 'byung lha bcu gsum/ bde mchog khams gsum rnam rgyal lha nga gcig172

mi tri bcu gsum/ wa ba ba bcu gsum ste drug dang / zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig gi snga dro bde mchog 'bum pa'am drag chen lha re gnyis pa/ phyi dro bong zhal can lha re gnyis pa'i dbang nas re zhig mtshams byas/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas nyin gnyis la brgyad stong ba'i lung gnang / tshes gsum la dza bur rlung khrid gnang / tshes bzhi la bsnyen sgrub sprags ma'i khrid dang de'i skor gyi lung gnang / tshes drug nas 'jigs med kyi zhus ngor nyin bzhir mgon po phyag drug pa'i be'u bum gyi lung gnang / nyer brgyad nas nyin bzhir man ngag bka' rgya ma'i lung gnang / zla ba dgu ba'i tshes nas sngar gyi bde mchog rab 'byams kyi 'phro nas bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro lha re gnyis/ bde mchog rdor sems lha so bdun/ bde ma chog 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha nyer lnga/ 'khor lo'i bsgyur drug lha don gnyis/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lha stong dang bzhi/ rdo rje phag mo lha nyer gcig pa rnams kyi dbang bstsal/tshes bcu bzhi la rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ drag po gsum dril/'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yum bcas dang lha mo dmag zor ma/ bram nag shan pa drug skor rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ zam tsha mchog sprul dang nor bu sprul ba'i sku gnyis kyis zhus ngor tshes bco lnga nas nyin lngar bla ma mchod pa'i khrid 173 3

dang zhi ba lam zab kyi khrid gnang / nyer gnyis nas rim par nyin lnga la stag phu'i dag snang chos skor las byung ba'i rjes gnang bcu gnyis/ sgrol ma phyi nang gi dbang ste de'i skor gang yod bcas gnang / nyer bdun la snying bo don gsum gyi khrid gnang /sgo mang mkhan chen sprul ba'i skus zhus ngor zla ba bcu ba'i tshes gcig nas gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug bde mchog nag po spyod pa/ ngam rdzong snyan brgyud kyi kye rdor lha dgu/ mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum rnams kyi dbang gnang / tshes brgyad la tshe dbang dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ sgo mang rin po che'i sprul skur dge rgan rab 'byams pa brtson 'grus rgya mtsho las bska/'a 'gyur gyi lung gsan dgos tshul dang / dge rgan tshang la'ang de lugs kyi bkod khyab zhib mo gnang / tshes dgu nas nyin drug la ra pod dpal pod ga nyis kyi lung gnang / bcu drug nas skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang rje pra dz+nyā'i zhabs kyi za byed mkha' 'gro'i spyin sreg gi zin bris kyi lung gnang / tshes bco brgyad nas nyin bzhi la gsang 'dus/ bde mchog 'aṇar chen/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu rnams kyi dbang gnang / nyer drug nas nyin gnyis la skyabs mgon mcho ga gi mdzad pa'i las bzhi'i drug cu ma'i khrid dang skyabs mgon mchog ji 174

gis mdzad pa'i bde gsang 'jigs gsum kyi bsnyen sgrub sprags ma'i khrid/ zhwa lu ba'i rtsa tshig mchan 'grel dang bcas pa'i khrid gnang / zla ba bcu ba'i tshes gsum nas nyin lnga la gur pod me 'bar ma dang kha skong po ti'i lung gang yod/ rgyal dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i gur lha brgyad ma'i gtor chog gi lung dang bcas pa gnang / tshes bcad la rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ mkhar rdo'i gsung steng nas me tog bcudatswasmon gyi khrid dang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs bcu gcig dang mkhan ngag gi dbang bo'i dmigs brtse ma'i bsnyen yig spyin sreg dang bcas pa'i lung rnams bka' drin du bstsal rto/ /dgung grangs nga gnyis pa rab tshes me mo sbrul gyi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes bcu la rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i zhi khro sbrags sgrub shin tu zab pa'i khrid gnang / tshes bcu gcig la skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang / tshes bcu bdun la rdo rje chig spram gyi khrid dang / 'jam dkar zhi khro sbrags sgrub dang / ma ning ha 'don rnams kyi khrid gnang / bco brgyad nas sgo mang mkhan sprul gyis zhus ngor zhang ston chos gyi rgyal bo rje bstan pa rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum gyi lung gnang ba zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer bdun la 175

grub/ de'i bar nas gzhan yang bcu gnyis nas mdo ting 'dzin rgyal bo'i lung / sgo mang rin po che'i rnam thar tshigs bcad ma'i lung / rta mgrin mi rjes gnang / de'i bsnyen yig thu'u bkwan gsung dang de'i sbyin sreg bcas kyi lung gnang / nyer brgyad la thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang / gcod kyi bca' yig ngang ba'i mchu sgros dang khros nag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sogs lung kha shas gnang / gnyis pa rjes ma'i tshes gsum la theg chen gso sbyong gi lung dang nyin gung nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi gsung 'bum dbu btsugs te tshes bcu bdun la mjug grub par gnang / nyer drug nas zhal snga nas zhang ston rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor dang / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung 'bum gyi dbu btsugs pa mjug zla gsum pa'i tshes dgu la spub/ zla de'i tshes bcu nas rje btsun ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum kyi lung nyin lnga la gnang zhing rtogs bdun mchan gyi bshad lung yang gnang /tshes bcu drug nas nyin gnyis la gser 'od kyi lung gnang / tshes bco brgyad nas nyin gnyis la blo sbyong brgya rtsa'i lung gnang / nyer drug nas nyin gsum la sta gon dang bcas 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang kun rig gi dbang gnang / nyer dgu la gtor ma brgya 176

rtsa'i khrid gnang ba dang mdo rtsa'i lung gnang / sum cu tham/ pa'i nyin nas bzung 'jam mgon pra dz+nyā'i zhabs kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung gnang ba zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu la grub te mjug tu 'dul 'dzin grags rgyan pa'i 'khor chen sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang / zla de'i tshes bcu gcig la khyung khra'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bcu—gnyis nas nyin gsum la skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/jim/ṇ+ḍal rnams kyi khrid gnang / tshes bco lnga la dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bstsal/ tshes bcu drug nas nyin gnyisadzhal dwags po nam mkha' grags kyi 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lung gnang / tshes bco brgyad la mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bstsal/ nyi shu nas nyin dgu la lam rim chen mo'i bshad lungardziganang / nyer dgu la bshad pa rdo lag brgyud ma'i lung gnang /zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig la grub rgyal tshe dbang rgyas pa gnang /tshes bzhi la bde mchog sngags btu'i byin rlabs gnang / tshesangalnga nas dril bu lus dkyil gyi rim gnyis kyi dmar khrid gnang /chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes la chos dpal zhing du zhabs bskyod/ tshes bzhi la tshoms chen legs bshad chos kyi dga' tshal du tsha kan ho thos/ thu'i sprul sku bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims dang tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi bsla ba pa la bkod de skal bzang 'phrin las chos kyi 177

rgyalazhe mtshan du mtshan gsol/ bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang dga' ldagalha brgya ma dang byin rlabs spungs zhus sogs kyi lung gnang ba dang yi ge gsar slob kyi dbu 'dzugs paskyiganang / tshes lnga nas nyin lnga'i ring chos thun gnyis re bgyis te bde lam gyi khrid gnang zhing de'i dkyus la byin rlabs spungs zhus kyi khrid dang skyabs 'gro'i khrid maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid bcas bstsal/gzhan yang 'pho khrid dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ma'i khrid/ tsha gsurosogs kyi lung ste lung phran 'ga' gnang / tshes bcur 'jigayobyed sta gon dang 'phrel bar bla ma lnga bcu ba'i bshad lung dang mjug tu rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bcu gcig la dpa' cig gi dbang dang 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yum bcas kyi rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / sku bar ba'i dpa' cig sgrub thabs kyi lung bcas gnang / tshes bcu gnyis la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang de'i sgrub thabs lhan thabs ma paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi gsung 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bdag 'jug zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i 'jigs byed smo na shis kyi lung bcas gnang / tshes bcu gsum la 'dus pa lha/ so gnyis kyi dbang dang brgya rtsa'i khrid mdor bsdus shig gnang /178

tshes bcu bzhi la bde mchog lo hu pa lha re gnyis kyi dbang / tshes bco lnga la thig le bcu drug gi dbang / tshes bcu drug la 'khor chen gyi dbang dang bde mchog bdag mdun bum gsum dbang lkechog smon shis dang bcas pa'i lungar+shaganang / tshes bcu bdun la rta mgron gsang sgrub kyi dbang sman bla rigs bsdus kyi dbang gnang zhing rgyal bo sku lnga'i srog gtad dang dam can mgar nag gi srog gtad gnang ba gnyis kyi skabs ser ba drag po bab pa sogs 'tshub cha che ba byung / tshes bco brgyad nas gdugs dkar byad grol bcas lha bcu bdun dbang dang legs ldan mched gsum kyi rjes gnang gzungs mdo'i lung bcas dang /gsang 'dus bdag mdun bum gsum bdag 'jug dang bcas pa'i lung sogs bstsal/ tshes bcu dgu la kun rig lha so bdun—gyi dbang / rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang / sngags phyogs po tir bzhugs pa'i gsang 'jigs gyi cho ga sogs dang rgyud gzhung 'don thabs bcas kyi lung / gzhan yang klu dbang rgyal bo gtso4'khor lnga'i rjes gnang / thu'u bkwan gsung gi 'jigs byed char 'bebs gcod kyi lung bcas gnang / nyi shu la sman bla lha nga gcig gi dbang / rab gnas dge legs char 'beb sogs lung phran kha yar bcas gnang / nyer gcig la mi 'khrugs pa lha 179

dgu'i dbang / rgyal mchog bdun pa'i dus 'khor sgrub thabs /brgyud 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa'i lung / nyer gnyis nas sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa/ de'i bar skabs su bla mchod phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid/bka' pod lnga'i rtsa ba'i lung / thar mdo'i lung sogs so so'i 'dod mos kyi lung phran mtha' yas pa bstsal te phyir gdan sar phebs nas kun mkhyen gong ma'i yi dam sgrub sko ra gyi lung sogs gnang / de nas ma 'gyang bar zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin hor gtsang dgon gsar tsag tsag sgar du phyag phebs gnang nas 'du khang rten dang brten par rab gnas dang gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang phyogs 'dus kyi bsgrub bya mang du 'dus pa rnams dge tshul slong gi bslab pa la bkod/ dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling zhes dgon pa'i ming gsar du btags/ de nas rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / thugs rje chen po/ kun rig gdugs dkar/ grub rgyal tshe dbang bcas dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga'ajam dpal mtshan brjod/ smon lam rnam lnga/ gsang 'dus smo na lam/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ ltung bshags/ gdugs she/ra sgrol ma/ sgrol bstod/ theg chen gso sbyong rnams gyi lung 180

gnang / kun mkhyin gyi 'jam dpal zhal lung / dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ gtor ma brgya rtsa rnams kyi khrid gnang / mgon po/ chos rgyul/ zhal/ lha mo rnam sras rnams kyi lung / bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ dge tshul slong gi phyir bcos/ paṇa chen sdom tshig skyabs 'gro/ ma ṇi/ dmigs brtse ma/ bstan 'bar ma gnyis bcas chos bka' mang bo gnang nas slar gdan sar phebs/ bcu ba'i tshes gnyis nas nyin lnga la 'jigs byed bskyed rim chen mo kha skong dang bcas pa'i bshad lung gnang / tshes bdun nas nyin gsum la bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung gnang / tshes bcu la sde khri rin po ches mdzad pa'i dus 'khor bskyed rim gyi lung gnang /bcu gcig nas nyin dgu la grub mtha' chen mo rtsa 'grel gyi bshad lung gnang / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis la lam gtso'i khrid gnang / tshes gsum la 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo'i bshad lung gnang / tshes lnga la skyabs 'gro dang / maṇ+ḍal/ rnor sems sgom bzlas gsum gyi khrid gnang / tshes drug gi snga dro 'brong rtse'i 'jigs byed rdzogs rim gyi lung / nyin gu4 nas lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid nyin gsum la gnang /tshes dgu nas mi g.yo ba sngon po pus ba tsugs ma'i rjes gnang sne81

bstsal/ tshes bcu gcig nas nyin gsum la te lo nā ro mar ba mi la ras pa rnams kyi rnam thar gyi lung 3gnengane / tshes bcu bzhi le sto go na dang de nas nyin gsugal bde gsang 'jigs gasgyem gyi dbeng gnang / bar skabs shigane+e tu gong du smos pa rbezhin gyi rmi lam longs sku'i rnal 'byor gyi gzugs snang khyad par can byung ba ni/ brag dmar bo zhig gi sked na 'phreng lam zhig yod par phebs pas thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri red—snyam pa skya btsun gnyis yod pas skya bo des dang bor mi dge' zhing brnyas thabs byed kyang phyi nas mgo bo btud/ de nas btsun gzugs des khong la ches cher brnyas shing 'phya ba la ske ma 'odzem par nang du phebs pas brag bug cig na thugs rje chen jupo mi phal gyi lus tshad las nyis 'gyur gyis che ba'i sku dwangs gsal dang mthing gi na bza' dang dar thod can zhig bzhurgus pa la khong gi thugs la tshad med pa'i dad pa zhig 'khrungs skes bla na mede pa'i byang chub myur du thob pa zhig mkhye na zhes zhus par/— thugs rje chen po de'i zhal nas de ltar yong zhes gsungs/ ༈khong gis khengs skyungs kyis gsungs pa/ bsam ngo la tshe 'di'i snang shas tsam yang kha ma bri/ nyon mongs mgo rgod du 'dug pas nyon mongs pa'i spyod tshul 'dis de'i bar du ji 'dra yod snyam 'jigs /8lha

zhum pa zhig byung nas ji ltar yang las ston gyiji 'khor ba 'di bzlogathub pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen zhes zhus par de ltar yongagekhris gsungs/ 'di ltar gsungs pa'i dgongs jidon ni/ tsho bla byang chub thob pa la skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi sngon du tshe 'di'i snangadze+eshas ldog pa sogs chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam sngon du 'gro dgos pa dang / nyon mongs mgo rgod du mi gtong bar las dang nyon mongs pa las byung ba'i 'khor ba la zhen pa gting nas log nedzi'i skyesajibuco'abring dang thun mong ba'i lam la slob dgos par rta bstan pa yin no/ /yang de'i 'phror khong spyan ras gzigs kyi brag phug de las phyir phebs nas brag de'i steng du bzhugs pa la skabs shig thugs rje po de phyi rol tu phebs byung / khong la dad pa tshad med pa zhig skyes/ dngos po zhig 'di la 'bul rgyu yod na ci ma rung snyam pas gzhan med kyang phyag tu ja phor gang lhayod pa de phul bas phyag bskyangs te bsnams song bas dga' dad ches cher 'phel ba zhig rmis zhes gsungs/ spyan ras gziga'adikyi skyo'i rnam pa yi ge phyed dang bzhi ba bya ba de dang mthun/ rmi lam gyi bab skyabs mgon gong ma de dang 'grig par byung zhes gsungs/ skyabs mgon gong ma de dang 'grig tshul gyi rnam thar khyad par can zhig yod gda'atshuying3ba cha ma nges/ rtse yang nub 183

gcig mi lam du ri zhig gi steng narngusteng 'og phyogs māsdums thams cad shel gyi rang bzhin can rtse bcu drug pa zhig 'dug pa laṣ+pezhig gisosteng du song dang stong gsum gyi bkod pa thams cho —cad mthong 'ong zer/ rtse bcu bzhi ba'i thār phyin te bltas pas khor yug kun rmug ting nge ba la ri'i 'phreng ba re spel bar yod pa las gzhan ma mthong / da dung steng dune+esong dang gsal du 'gro zer nan che ba byas kyang yom yom g.yo bas 'gro ma nus par ri'i ltag na rgyal sras sku mched gsum bzhugs pa mjal du phyin/ phu chung ba yin rgyu des cang mi gsung / spyan snga bas dge bshes 'di la mjol gsungs/ po to ba dang yang mjal/ de'i mtshams mnal sad pa dang rdo rje 'chang dang zung 'jug gi thig le mjal ma nus pa bsod nams re chung snyam yang zhib par bsam pas de dang mtshungs par byung snyam log pa'i 'khrul ngor shar zhes gsungs pa ni log pa'i 'khrul ngor shar zhes gsungs te khengs skyungs mdzad mod don la rdo rje 'chang dang zung 'jug gi thig le dngos su gzigs pa zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /yang zha la nas po to ba skyabs mgon 'khrungs rabs na bzhugs pas mgo bo gtugs tsam min par sel ma shor ba dgoyopar go / phyis skyabs mgon sku 'dar nye ba'i sdon der zhal nas/ sku tshe 'phreng 184

brgyud la 'khon ma zhugs pa zhig yin tshe chos rgyun de kho rang gis thob 'dug na spyod pa rtsing yang mnyan pas chog 'khon zhugs yod na sel bya ba de la zer bas ma nyan gsungs pas zing cha mang bo byung skabs kyang gang min gyi zer rjes bsnyegs te rang 'phung gzhan 'phung ma byas pa yang de tshos yin zhes gsungs pa ni bltan bdag skyabs mgon rin po che dang rang gang la chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma mtha' dag dang sel ma zhugs pa zhig nges pararidashos par gdams pa yin no/ / smras pa/ rnam kun mkhyen pa sna tshogs 'od can las/ /sna tshogs khams dang bag la nyal ji bzhin/ /sna tshogs zab rgyas 'od brgya bkye ba yis/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i rtogs pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad/ /'gro la phan bzhed lam gsum shes pha —yis/ /rigs can me yi ku mud me na ka'i/ /rab dkar mdzes pa'i bzhin ras ngom bzhin du/ /phar phyin bzhad mo'i sgra yis sa gsum 'gengs/ /thos sgrog zhi bro'i bdud rtsi tshol rnams la/ /gzhi kun mi rtag sogs su shes pa yi/ /thabs mkhas sman sbyor zab mo'i don sgrub kyis/ /'khor rtsa gtan du 'joms pa'i mi 'jigs byin/ —/mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis lam bzang gi/ /rnal 'byor mtha' ru phyin pa'i 'bras 185

rtakis la/ /yi gi phyid dang ba'i ba'i rgyud don bzhin/ /thugasalharje chen po'i zla zhal dngos su gzigs/ /bka' gdams thig le bcu drug rnal 'byor la/ /rtse gcig gzhol bas zunge 'ojug thig le gzigs/ /bka' gdams sku mched gsum gyi zhal ras las/— / /dbugs dbyung 'aḥ med bdud rtsi'i dpal yang thob / /ces bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las ris med kyi gdul bya la sngar bzhin bdud rtsi'i bgo skal gnang ba dang / bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i 'bras rtagayolhag pa'i lha'i zha la mthong zhing rtogs pa /brnyes pa'i sarga ste dgu ba'o/ / — dam chos 'chad spel dang mnyam du thabs mkhas 'phul 6 gyis dgon sde bde 'jags mdzod ba sogs kyi sarga/ 'jigs med sku gsum las byung 'od po che/ /kun khyab nyer bdun 'phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /bshes gnyen dam par slar yang phyag bgyid do/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma skem pa ra/ /15

rgyun mi 'chad pa'i las chen skye 'gro dag /'dren pa'i thabs mchog chos nyid bden pa che/ /mu mthud bstan pa'i tshul 'ga' brjod par bya/ /rgyud bla ma las/ chosakyi jes ni skul byed ltar/ /de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang / /bral yang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gis khyab mdzad de/ /skal ldan rnams la chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa'i gtso bo ni gdul bya rnams la chos ston pa yin pas rje bla ma 'di bas kyang mu mthud nas ba slab pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par bskor ba'i tshul ni/ dgung grangs nga gsum pa rab tshes sa pho rta'i lo'i zla ba — dang bo'i tshes bcu la mkha' spyod lus dkyil gyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs gnang / tshes bcu gcig nas mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid gnang / tshes bhacu drug la mkhas grub chig brgyud rkye bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid gnang / tshes bcu bdun la klu'i bum gter gyi khrid gnang / tshes bco brgyad la lo gyon ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid dang sku bar ba'i yi dam sgrub skor gyi lung gnang /nyer lnga la bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang gnang / nyer drug la lus dkyil gyi dbang dang mgon po phyag drug pa'i thun mong ma 7 /87

yin pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang 'od chen 'bar ba'i rjes gnang rnams bstsal/ nyer bdun nas sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang yongs rdzogs gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la tshe dbang / mkha' spyod ma'i sngags btu/ 'jam dbyajas dkar bo'i rjes gnang / rdo rje gcod pa sogs kyi lung kha sha sa ba cas gnang—/ tshes drug la 'brong rtse'i 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi lung / shar 'bum chu ba'i khyung nag gi las tshogs dang / mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba 'byung po 'ur 'ded kyi lung rnams gnang / tshes dgu nas nyin bdun la byang chub bde lam gyi dmar khrid gnang / tshes bcu drug nas lho brag mar ba'i rnam thar/ rje btsun mi la'i mgur 'bum/ gsang ba'i mgur drug ras chung ba'i rnam thar/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub pa'i mi la'i gsol 'debs rnams kyi lung gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis nas 'jam dbyangs bla ma khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i gsung 'bum gyi lung gnang / tshes bdun nas dus 'khor bsdus rgyud mtshan bcas dang / 'grel chen dri med 'od mchan bcas kyi bshad lung / tshes bco brgyad la thar rtse'i sbyong rgyud dkyil chog gzhan phan rgya mtsho'i lung gnang / tshes bcu dgu la gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan thod 'khor gyi lung khrid/188

nyi shu la yi ge bzhi ba'i bsad bzlog rtsa dang gshin rje sbyor tshul/ gser kyi rdo rje la brten pa'i tshe khrid bcas ciganang / nyer gcig la bla ma zhi khro'i tshe dbang / phyag rdor gtum po dang 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang rnams gnang / nyer gnyisasal rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ lha mo dmag zor ma/ dam can seng zhogasogs kyi rjes gnang rnams bstsal/ dus 'khor ngag dbang bkra shis pas zhus ngor sa ga zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas bcu gsum bar la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi bshad lung / tshes bcu bzhi la skyabs 'gro'i khrid gnang / bco lnga la bsgrub bya du ma la dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs gnang / bcu drug la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i zhi khro sprags sgrub kyi khrid gnang / nyer bdun la dpa' cig gi sta gon dang / de'i phyi nyin de'i dbang dang mgon po dang lha mo'i rjes gnang bstsal/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gnang / nyer dgu la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang dang de'i rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang /lcam sring gi rjes gnang rnams gnang / tshes gnyis la rigs gsum spyi sgrub dang nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang bstsal/ sa lugs 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ sgrol shā89

dkar 'od zer drug sbrags ma gsum gyi rjes gnango bañcal/ tshes gsum nas lam rim mchan bzhi ma'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs nas tshes bcu tham pa'i bar bton kyang skyabs rje gong ma rje ’bskalazabazang thub bstan dbang phyug de nyid kyis/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /pha bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas nas/ /'khos med kyi ban rgan snyoms las pas/ /dus de ring skyo ba'i glu chung len/ /spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs kun tu nam langs skar ma 'dra/ /sgos kun mkhyesnan bla ma'i gdan sa 'dir/ /dus deng sang khrom las ngo sor khyer/ /rje sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma de/ /gnas mi mngon zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs/ /bstan 'dzin du rlom pa'i bla 'ga'/ /'thab rtsod dang 'khrugs slong las kyis brel/tsho /tshul mthun kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /thugs khrel gyi ngang du zhum zhing bzhugs/ lngang rigs kyi dbyangs sgrog phal cher yang / /phyogs lhung gi gtam skegyi gad rgyang sgrog /btsun gzugs kyi bstan bshig 'ga' re ni/ /ngan las kyi mgo 'phang re zhig mtho/ /ltas ngan gyi 'byub bya rgyab ser 'gas/ /mun nag la skyabs byas than skad sgrog /lung las kyi mtho ba'i chos rgyal de/ /mi mang gi khrod du dma' 'beb gleng / /sha 190

med spu med kyi khu ta 'gas/ /ngan skyug gi khrod na dga' bzhin 'gying / /snga phyi yi mtha' 'obs ma mthong ba'i/ /re zhig gi rta rgyug spro na yang / /bka' chad kyi g.yang ko lhung ba yis/ /dar rgud kyi ltad mo mthong yang srid/ /kutshon mkhyen gyi thugs bskyed ma zad na/ /mchod yon gyi nyi zla zung 'brel gyis/ /nag phyogs kyi mun pa rab bcom nas/ /bde skyid kyi pad tshal cis mi bzhad/ /ces shing yos zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun la 'brog stong nas 'khyag sgang la gcig pur skyo glu blangs zhes phebs/ khyad par shing yos lo'i dbyar ngor srid skyong dpal mang rin po che la phyag yig gnang par/ phrag dog rlung dmar 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho dang / /dga' sdug snang ba sprin pār nyi shar 'dra/ /yid snang char sprin nang 'khyug glog lta bur/ /gyur 'di yang na dam sri'i 'phrul zhig gam/ /min na ngan goms bag chags sad pas lan/ /'di dag 'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'jig pa'i rgyur/ /nye bar dgongs te rkyen sel rim gro dang / /gtso cher rang sems rta pho gnyen po yis/ /rta kha gyen du bsgyur la ma 'bad na/ /skyag lang shor rang drag na mgo log gi/ /dkon bkra'i dge bshes bla brang phyag mdzod pa/ /'phrin las midza 'dzin ji bzhin 'gyur gyis dogs/ /gtam 'di sha tsha'i snying ①9/

gtam drang bo dang / /ma zad rang gzhan skyon mang bya bzhag gis/ /rgyal khams brlag pa'i rgyur song mang mthong nas/ /tshul 'di drang bor smras la yid gtad 'tshal/ /gcig tu deng dus kho bo tsam zhig las/ /nyid la sems gting sha yang tsha ba dkon/ /gnyis su 'jig rten bya ba la mkhas shing / /nyams myong ldan zhing 'chad mkhan nyin skar tsam/ /de phyir 'di 'dra'i bslab ston byed mkhan zhig /ma mthong phyir na yin lugs 'di bzhin smras/ /zhes phebs pa'i thog tu bab ste ser gzugs dag gis bsam sbyor log pa 'ba' zhig gis ser dmag bslangs 'ur jing che bar byung ba la bsten nas rje 'di bas lam rim mchan bzhi ma'i bshad lung re zhig mtshams 'jog dgos byung 'dug nyer gartig la slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor dbyangs can ma dkar mo thun mong ma yin pa dang / dmar mo'i rjes gnang bcas bstsal/ mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs yang gnang / de nas dgon par zing 'khrug gis sos mi bde bar gyur/ gang la rtsod pa yod pa de nas ni/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol 'gro bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje bla ma rin po che 'di nyid kyis zing 'khrug de dag las bshol dgos dgongs nas ri khrod maṇ+ḍal byang chub gling du phyag phebs gnang / de nas 193

sa skyoja dam pa ching wang yum sras la tshe dbang brgya rtsa gnang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin zi ling nas ma ches sang gi dmag gtos che ba lhags pa'i rkyen gyis maṇ+ḍal ri khrod de nas spyang— ma bzhugs par phyir dgon par phebs/ maṇ+ḍal ri khrod rgya dmag gis gtor bsreg byas te lhag med du btsom pa phyis kyang bskyar gso ma thub 'dug maṇ+ḍal ri khrod nas gdan sar phebs pa'i phyi nyin nangs par thu'u bkwan rin po cher mjal/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i byed spyod dar drags pas phan sleb chung yang thugs lhag bsam mdzad pa bka' drin che zhes zhus/ de'i phyi nyin nangs par srid skyong rin po ches rje 'a di bar 'bod mi gdan 'dren pa mngags te gnas tshul 'di la ci drag gi bka' 'dri gnang bar rje 'di bas rim gro gtos chen res bzlog 'gro zhes phebs/ yang khong gung thang rin po cher mjal du phyin/ thugs glod pa'i skabs min par dgon ma lag sde dang bcas pa rjes sor yang sprul rin po che'i phyag tu 'byor nges shig shul gnas rnams kyi khur du bab tshul zhus pas/ brtson pa ci rtsogs bgyid ces gsung phebs/ snga gong rje 'di bas a mchog rin po cher yang zing cha 'di mi 'ongs pa'i skyabs 'jug nan cher zhus par lan la khong tshosañcanga'i ngag la mi nyan gzhan ci byed ces gsungs nas 193

sum̐gs dzatshub nyams gnangadzha/ rje 'di bas 'o na ci byed zhus pas 'ong rgyu red thabs kyang zad ces gsungs pa rje 'di bas thug sa la yod gshis khong da ni sdod pa'i ske dus min 'gro dgongs spyosri/ sbi — mtsho khar phebs te sos bder spang ljongs nas lam rim bsdus don gyi 'grel ba de gsung rtsom gnang / de nas cher ma 'argyang par bde 'jags byung ba'i yi ge bden min rdzun min zhig 'byor bas khong phyir dgon par phebs/ thugs brtsorna cher mdzad de dkon mchog la gsol 'debs chos skyong la 'phrin bcol —gnang /khong gi thugs la skyabs mgon yab sras kyi thugs rjes mi skyon snyam pa shar gsungs/ de skabs khong gi mnal lam du khro bo sngon po zhal dbyibs ches mi mdzes pa zhig gis sna drangs te 'ablog ’ gyon pa ches mang bo zhig gis/ yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i thugs rje dang / /byin rlabs nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /zhes 'dorno ba'ino par 'cham byed kyang khong gis mjug grub kyi bar du gsung bzhin 'gro ba rmis pas mnal sad pa dang dzi kun mkhyen yab sras kyi thugs rjer nges 'drongs byung bas blo bde gsungs shing / de nas khong gis/ rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul blo bza nga grags pa dang / /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sku tshe 'phreng brgyu da kyi/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthu byin gyis/ /nag 194

phyogs/ gardug pa'i bsam sbyor zhi bar mdzormi rdzophro /cesasabaṃka' —rtsom mdzad de slob ma mang bo zhig la lung gnang / bla slob tshang mas bka' rtsom de gsung bzhin du mtha' bar phebs nas rgya hos dpoṅka po thong si ngo mar zer bar gus tshul gyis nged cag grwa ba thams cad dpon su yin gyi mnga' 'og gi chos 'don mkhan yin pas dgon sdo grwa tshang dang bcas phar gnod mi byedo par khyed kyis shes zhes zhus par/ dpon des mthe snyebong bstan te bla ma zer ba khyod red zer zhing bdu khang gtor byed kyi me skyogs btsugs yod pa sogs bsdus nas dgon pa la skyon mi gtong bar byas/ nang chen re gnyis dang maṇ+ḍal ri khrod ma ches tshang gi dmag gis gtor bshig btang ba las dgon byings la gnod pa ma byung ba yang rje 'di ba'i byin rlabs dang thugs rje thabs mkhas kho na'i drin yin no/ /khong gi zhal nas sngar chung ngu'i dus chos skyong khog zhugs kyi lung bstan zhig la/ 0phrag dog gya gyu'i dri bzhon 'tshub ma nas/ /zhe sdang du ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa yis/ /gti mug gnyis 'thung bskyon pa'i na ba ste/ ltang rgyal ri bo 'bigs byed drag tu 'bebs/ /zhes pa thog tu bsgokyang kun mkhyen yab sras kyi thugs bskyed kyis gtso bor dgon 'di grwa ma chag pa zhig byung bas nyin mtshan kun tu sems la 195

bcang rgyu tshe gcig la gochod pa gcig pur sems yod ces gsungs/ zhal 'phros/ la spyobs mgonartseskra phring dang / ba de thang tshang sku phreng yab sras dgadang da.oṃ tshig gecablo stebs skyabs mi sgro mgon mchog gi rnam thar mjug rdzogs bar grub yod pas ludz+wa gi thog ma gsan ne legs zhes gsungar+sā pa bzhin bde thang sprul ba'i ri skus lha dar che legs bcas snyan gsan phul bas thugs dgyes tshor dang bcas rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i skyabs mgon bskal glubazang thub bstan dbang phyug gi rnam thar kha skong rin po che'i 'phreng ba'i mdzes rgyan lung gsung bshad ngo mtshar ba du ma dang bcas nyin gcig la bstsal/ 'di skabs bde thang sprul ba'i —skus mtshan lam du skyabs mgon rin po che'i mdun du 'jal te bka' chos la snyan gsan phul/ khong nas rje rin po che'i rnam thar gnang gi yod pa zhig rmis 'dug 'di yang rje 'di dzo skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa dang thugs rgyud gcig par ma zad skyabs mgon mchog kyang rje rin po che dang thugs gcig pa'i mtshan ma yang dag go/ /ma ches tshang gi 'khrug zing mu khathud byung bar brten sos bde par sdod pa'i skabs ma byung bas hor gtsang dgon gsar du phebs/ de nas 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma/ dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma/ gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma rnams tsā96

la lagezung gi bsnyen pa btang / lo mjug bde thang sprul ba'i skur phyag〉 yig gnang bar/ lo snga phyi 'di dag tu dgon 'dir gegs cha shin tu che bas skyabs mgon mchog gyiyang sprul dang bstan pa'i 'ah+phal rgyas kyi ched du chos rgyal gyi bsnyen pa gnad smin zhig mthod na legs tshul kyang phebs/ hor zla bcu ba'i tshes nas bdud ris kyi phyogs kun nas reb kong phyogs kyi rong 'brog gi dmag gtos chen rgyab rten du g.yar te bkra shis 'khyil 'di ming brda rjes shul tsam yang med par byed rtsis byas kyang mcho ga— garmum gyi byino rlabs dang srung ma'i 'phrin las kyis kho tsho'i bsam pa dang go bzlog te reb kong ba rnams rgyas pham/ ma ches tshang gis dmag dpung btegs to.a mchog gi steng du phyin/ rtsi bla rgang ngos gtsang du lus stabs khong rin po che 'di ba phyir rang dgon du phebs nas bla slob tshang ma zhal 'dzoms te gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi dga' ston myong rgyu byuja / 'di skabs mnal lam du brag dmar ker langs 'jigs su rung ba zhig yod pa'i rtsar rnga rol dang bcas bag tse'i gsol kha zhig btang / gshis phyi sto 'gro 'dod pa yin tshe 'gro zhes skyabs mgon gong ma de nyid gami shed gshegs rjes su phebs pasabyogs kun brag ri sngo sangs ngos mnyam pa sgo khyim lag mgo shong com pa la'abs pa'i rjes mi zin 197
