po nezhig byung ba mis pas dgon gsar der ma— b.rid pacha phyir dgon steng du 'ong pa yin zhe sa gsungs/ 'di yang skyabs mgon mchog gis rje 'di ba la dgon 'dir bzhugs rgyu lag gzhan du / 4ma phebs gsungs pa bzhin— rje 'arda ba dgo na 'diratsā bzhugs ru tshe dgone par gegs cha che bas skyabs mgon mchog gis dgon 5 —'dir gdan drangs par mngon no/ / dzace jidagung grangs nga bzhi ba rab tshes sa mo lug gi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes lngar grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang / mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang rnamasasna bstsal/ tshes drug nas skyabs mgon rin po che'i rnamaji thar kha skong rje nyid kyis mdzad pa de dang 'jam sdud bzang gsum gyi lung gnang / rla ba gnyis pa'iphazla mjug tu chos da pal zhing —du phebs/ zla ba de'i nyer lnga'i nyin dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ milam gtso 'i khrid/ tsā ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas slob ma rjes 'dzin dang / tshes bcu nas slob ma sta gon dang / byis pa ltar 'jug ba'i dbang bdun/ gong ma gong chen gyi dbang bzhi/4 rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang / mjug tu tshogs 'khor dadz+wabacaspomi/ gzhan yang rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang / ga cod dbang / thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod dang dpal mo'i 198

lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i dbang / bu ston gong khugazuma'i : dbang / thang stong rgyal bo'i lugs kyi bla ma zhi khro'i tshe dasprong / ga sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang /thu tshe dbang dzachi med rdo rje'i srog shing /stag phu'i dag snang / rta mgrin gyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang / chos rgyal phyi sgrub/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ zhe sgrol dkar/ rnam 'a/rjoms/khyung khri/ rinā ga rar+sha/ phyag rdor gtum po/ tshe dpag med / nā ro mkha' spyod ma/ phyag rdor/ rta mgrin/ rta mgrin pabla gar dbang / legs ldan mched gsum/ 'ja ma dbyangs saseng rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ grub rgyal tshe dbang / kyai rdor gyi dbang / bde gsang 'jigs gsugagyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid /tshe gcig nyams len gyi khrid/ tshem bu dmar khrid/ bla mchod byagachen sbrags ma'i khrid/ 'pho khrid/ blo sbyong nyi me'i 'od zer gyi khri skyi/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyirkan sreg gi khrid/ lam rim mo'i ba shad lung sems bskyed mchod pa dad bcasabyupa/ sngags rim chen mo/ rim lnga —gsal sgro na/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ 'grel chen dri med 'od rnams kyi bshad lung ga nang / brgyad stong ba/ thar mdo/ dzo dzergyud sde spyo rna ma/ spyod 'jug 199

me rījin mo/ bzhi brgya ba/ bshes spreng / blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma/man ngag lhan thabs/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ rtog bdun/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud rnams kyi lung gnang /— rigs byed ma / sgrol ma/'jigs byed rnams kyi dge 'dun 'du 'khor/ rdo rje gcod pa/'jam dpal matsan brjod/ lam gtso/ dwags po'i skegasang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs/ 'jigs byed bskyed rim dngos grub snye ma/ paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi bde mchog bskyed rim/ de'i gsung lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan/ sku bar ba'i yi dam sgrub skor sogs lung mang bo gnang / lo ltar sa ga'i bco lnga'i nyin grwa tshang bzhis lhan cig tu bzang spyod stong gsum bsgrub rgyu'i thebs su dngul srang nyis brgya dang bdun cu tham pas sbyor 'jags mdzad/ lo re bzhin mgon po'i zhi rgyas kyi gtor sgrub res mos tshugs pa' gtong thebs su dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu bzhag zhabs brtan lha khang du dge 'dun zhal grangs so gsum gyis smyung gnas mdzad pa'i thebs su dngul srang brgya dang nyi shu tham pa sbyor 'jags mdzad de sgyung gnas kyi rgyun btsugs/ sman pa grwa tshang la thub pa dam dzig gsum bkod kyi bdag 'jug nyin bdun gyi mchod thebs su dngul srang brgya dang bco lnga sbyor 'jags mdzad/ cho ga chog rkyang btsugs te phag lo nas bdag 'jug 'dzugs rgyu'i ཿ00

gsung bkod dang de yang zhogs khar sman chog yi da bzhin dbang rgyal dang / gung tshigs dang dgung ja la bdag mdun dbang chog bcas rdzogs par byed dgos pa'i gsung bkod dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil chog la kha skong gi tshul du cho ga cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa tshang ba'i lhan thabs kyang gsar rtsom mdzad/ 'du khang chen mo'i steng thog rnams ma grub par yod pas de'i ched du dngul rdo tshad gsum gnang / sman pa'i 'du khang gsar bskrun gyi sar lto 'phye'i thig dang / brtag bslang sbyang gsum gyi bkod khyab dang / bde thang rdo rams pa lag gi blar bskos te rdo btegs pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i rung khang gcod pa sogs lag len mtha' dag 'dul ba dang mthun par byed dgos kyi gsung bkod zhib rgyas gnang nas zla ba lnga ba'i bco lnga la gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ gdan sar phebs te bltan 'gyur lung rgyun gang yod yongs rdzogs kyi lung / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi dbang / bde mchog rab 'byams kyi nang tshan phag moca skor gyi dbang gsum/ dus 'khor spyi bka'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ bla ma byams pa rin po che'i gsung skor 'ga' zhig gi lung sogs dang / bde thang sprul skus zhus ngor mkhas grub sangs 201

rgyas yi shes kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung / rje nyid kyi gsung gi skor las sgo mang rin po che'i rnam thar dad pa'irtakhri shing rgyas pa'i me tog bde thang rin go che'i rtogs brjod/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi bdag 'jug 'jigs byed dbang—bshad/ bzang spyod 'bru 'grel/ rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul sogs kyi sho lo ka rnams kyi lung gnang / bde thang mkhan sprul la dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang dpe ltas dpe khrid/ lung rigs kyi dogs gcod sogs dang / bku' chos nyan rgyu’/ mtshams bsnyen sgrub gang thad nas brtson pa rgyun cichags dgos tshul dang / — khong rang nyid kyang dgung lo nga bzhi tsam la slebs song bas khom pa mi 'dug ces bslab bya gnad smin dang / gsung dgongs gzhi can 'ga'— zhig gsungs/ sgo ma nga rin po ches mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i 'don sgrig dang / brag dkar bka' bcu'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing / rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lam rim tshigs bcad ma sogs kyi lung gnang / dgu 'cham steng hor gtsang du phebs nas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyi shu'i bar sku mtshams mdzad/ 'di skabs bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur gnyis gdan 'dren mdzad/ gdan sar phebs nas 'di ga'i grwa ja'i tshogs zangs 'ga' zhig gis 30lha

brgyags rtsed kyis bcag kyang ci mi snyam par lo shas la lus ji 'dug pa thugs la gzan pas rgya dngul rdo tshad drug gis bsgrubs te zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la sbyor 'jags mdza da/ dgung grangs nga lnga ba rab tshes lcags pho sprel lo la smon lam nang du thu'u bkwan rin po che'i gsung gi mkha' spyod chos skor gnang / tshes bcu bdun nas bde thang sprul skus zhus ngor kun mkhyen gong ma'i gsung 'bum gyi lung gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad nas phyag mdzod mkhan po sprul ba'i skus zhus ngor byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmar khrid thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i bde lam gyi khrid smin rgyas su gnang ste mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas 'bum ston jo bo'i mdun nas sems bskyed mchod pa gnang / 'di skabs khrid nyan pa bo rnams la thams cad kyis lam rim chen mo'i sa bcad dam min kyang bde lam gyi sa bcad yod par gyis la lam rim shar sgom lta bu re gal che tshul sogs kyi bka' gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin sgo mang mkhan sprul/ bde thang mkhan sprul/ legs tshogs dang gsum la kun mkhyen gong ma'i gsung 'bum gyi khrod nas bka' rgya ma'i skor gnang ste mjug tu nged kyi bka' chos kyi phyed sgo mang tshang dang phyed bde thang tshang ste khyed rnam gnyis kyi phyag na yod tsho 203

gsungs/ de nas ma 'gyang bar sku bsnyun gyi rnam pa mdzad/slob ma so so dang grwa tshang so so nas zhabs brtan phon cher bsgrubs/ brtan bzhugs kyang phul na'ang dwangs skyed cher ma byung / nyin zhig zhal nas gdung mādun du song nas mchod me dang snyan shal re phul la skyabs 'jug zhu dgos/ de yang nged ma shi bar yun ring bor bsdad na spyir bstan 'gro'i don dang khyad par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa yab sras kyi thugs bskyed smon lam gyis bzung ba'i dgon pa grwa tshang dang bcas pa la phan thogs pa zhig yin na myur du nad 'di las grol rgyu'i skyabs 'jug dang de min phan pa gang yang med na sdug bsngal mi myong bar myur du 'chi ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus/ bcos bsgyur mi byed par 'di bzhin gyis zhes phebs pa bzhin bsgrubs pas phyi'i nangs par nas rim bzhin dwangs/ 'di yang rnam thar ya mtshan pa'o/ /'di skabs shig tu gung thang blo gros zhes pa'i bshes gnyen mtshan yongs su grags pa des kyang thugs ma bde bar kha dar zhig bskur te zhal 'don gyi skabs sogs su khyed rang gi sku tshe brtan pa'i ched du dmigs na legs tshul gsungs pa bzhin snyan bskul zhus par khong gi zhal nas ngas tshe gang bo 'dir kha ton dang dge sbyong gang byas thams cad tshe 'di'i ched du dmigs 204

nas 'don ma myong zhes gsungs shing sku bsnyun lhag med du song / de nas bde thang sprul skus sngar nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung 'bum gyi lung yang bskyar zhus pa'i lan du spyir bka' chos la bar chad shin tu che ba skyabs mgon mchog nas gsungs pa'i sku rim re yod kyang 'don ma thub gsungs pas zhabs rim ci dgos kyang bsgrub zhus par sku rim rnam gsum/ bgegs mthar byed kyi 'phreng sngags dang bdud tshar gcod pa'i sngags sgrubs zhes bka' gnang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes gsum nas skyabs mgon 'jigs me/da dbang bo'ici gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs dang gzhan yang byang chub bde lam gyi khrid/ sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum/ rnam sras bka' bco lnga/ brgyad stong ba/ mdo sde bskal bzang sogs kyi lung dang /zla ba bcu ba'i tshes drug nas lho brag snyan brgyud kyi dbang rjes —gnang yongs rdzogs bka' 'bum gyi lung dang bcas pa zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshesasalnga nas legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung /man ngag rin chen spungs pa'i lung bcas bstsal to/ /dgung grangs nga drug pa rab tshes lcags mo bya'i lo'i zla ba dang bo'i nyi shu tham pa nas nyin gnyis la das/'a ldan lha brgya ma'i gzhung bsrangs dang chu bcud len sogs kyi khrid zla ba gnyis pa'i tsho 305

tshes drug nas lam rim mchan bzhi ma'i bshad lung / byang chub bde lam gyi khrid smin rgyas su gnang / gsum pa'i tshes nas zhwa lu ba'i sprul ba'i skus zhus ngor grub pa'i dbang phyug mi tra dzo ki7 tenas brgyugapa'i dkyil 'khor re drug gi dbang bskure yongs rdzogs sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nges su bstsal zhing gsung bshad kyang 'byams klas pa gnang / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gsum nas gung thang rin po che la chos rgyun dkon pa 'ga' zhig zhus yod pa ltar sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma/ bir lugs gshed dmar lha lnga/ dri med rnam gnyis kyi dbang rnams gnang ba ched gnyer gyis gsan/ zhwa lu sprul ba'i skus zhus bzhin snron zla'i tshes nas slob ma rjes 'dzin dang sa chog gi rim ba sngon du 'gro bas bde gshegs seṅge'i nga ro'i lha khang nang nas tshes bcu bzhi la sta gon/ tshes bco lnga la byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/bcu drug la gong ma gong chen gyi dbang / bcu bdun la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang bcas rdzogs par bstsal zhing tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan du rol te dang bo'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam bzang nyams pa med pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ bde thang sprul skus zhus ngor gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum bka' rgya 306

mi dardo bcas pa'i lung dgyes bzhin bstsal/ blo ba drug pa'i tshes nyer gsum nas ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid sogs bka' chos mang bo gnang / zla ba dgu ba'i tshes bzhi nas ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi lung bstsal/ lo de'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin smon lam chen mo'i skabs tshogs chen 'du khang gi rgya mthongs su bkram rgyu'i tsong kha brgyad cu'i zhal thang bcu gsum dang kun mkhyen gong mas chos 'brel gsan yul gyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal thang sogs mang bo 'ur zing skabs gtor brlag byas pas lo shas shul stong bar lus kyang thams cad kyis ci mi snyam par bzhag pa thugs kyis ma bzod nas thang ka re la rgya dngul rdo tshad re re'i yon byas te thang ka che legs bco lnga rgya mthongs su bzhag go / /smras pa/ mekhyen brtse'i sprin rim ba gam stug po laso/ /chos nyid bden pa'i char chen phab pa des/ /gdul bya'ijilung rtogs myu gu rab rgyas nas/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i snye ma g.yur du za/ /mi bsrun brlang spyod me chen 'khrigs pa la/ /thugs rje byin rlabs 'gog med bden stobs dang / /gang 'tsham thabs rmekhas 'phrul gyi sprang char gyis/ /lhag med gzhil ba'i bka' drin bsam lasa'adas/ /phyogs med gser ldan bu mo'i lto ba ru/ /zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal bo'i blos gar gyis/ /shis par bgyis shing 207

chos nor tshar phab pa'i/ /snyan ba lha yi rol mo chad pa med/ /byin rlabs 'od 'bar sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /mthong thos dran pas nyon mongs nad sel sman/ /gang la gang 'tsham dus sablozhengs bkod pa'i/9 /sku drin gzhal byed dngos po srid dzadir dben/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam dze+er thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las dam chos 'chad spel dang mnyam du thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis dgon sde bde 'jags mdzad pa sogs kyi sarga ste bcu ba 'o/ / ṇa kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba gong sa skyabs mgod mchogo gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa sogs kyi sarga /'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i rim gnyis rtse brgya yis/ /bdud tshogs lhag med bcom pa'i dpa'/ bo che/ /bka' 'phrin cha shasatshures kyang las kun 'grub/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon der myag bgyid do/ /slar yang nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin mdo sngags kyi/ /chos 'khor rtsibs stong ldan pa'i 'khor shugs kyis/ /thub bstan gling bzhir dbang bsgyur byung ba dag/ /ro 'dzin 208

don yode bya phyir gleng bar bya/ /de yang bzhi brgya ba las/thub rnams sdig pa churī yis mi 'khru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdugabasnga la phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhanapos 'phongamin te/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar mdzad/ — /ces gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel byed kyi thabs dam pa ni dam pa'iḥchos ston pa kho na yin pas bla ma bdag nyid chen po 'di bas kyang sngar bzhin dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin chad pa med par chos ston pa gtso bor mdzad pa ni/ /ca dgung grangs nga bdun pa rab tshes༄ pho khyi'i lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes drug nas bde mchog rgyud dang sbas don kun gas lhasbrags pa'i bshad lung dang lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lungasha khrid sogs rgya cher gnang / hor gtsang gser khri sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor rje tsong kha ba chen po'i gsung 'bum cha tshang / lam rim chen mo dang sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung bcas bstsal/ cho zla ba lnga ba'i tshes brgyad nas sta gon dang bcas gsang 'dus 'angom rdor/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bde mchog 4dril bu phyi dkyil nang dkyil gnyis/ nag po spyod pa/ ngam rdzong snyan brgyud/ kun rig rnam snang mngon byang / thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod sogs kyi wibang gnang / zla ba phrug pazhi 209

tshis nas rgyal tshab rin po chi dang / sgro mkhas grub rin po che'i ga sungadhe'abulagyi lung / zla— ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu nas phyag mdzorda mkhan sprul3)sa zhus ngor bko' gdams pha chos bu tshos kyi lung gnangarte/ zla mjug tu 'jam dbyangs bla ma gung thang rin po che'i zhal snga las dben sa tshugs kyi gcod dbaro/ spre pu nai shī'i lugs kyi gcod dbang / mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung bka' rgya skem yongs rdzogs/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mo'i lasakhrid 'jayo dpal zhal lung gi lung bcas gsan bzhes mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bzhi nas gdug sa dkar lha mang gi dbang gnang / sgrol dkar rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa sogs dang / — nyer bdun nas dben sa bka' 'bum gyi lung yongs rdzogs bstsal/ bla gdartsaba'i tshes nas khong rang nyid kyi skyed ma 'chi ba la phyogs ba ngo 'phrad pa'i ched kwa ring du phyag phebs gnang / dgon de'iji 'du khangadzigasar bzhengs la rab gnas dang / be+es mdo'i dgon par dge bshes bstan pa tshang—gi gzim khang nas tshogs yongs 'asalamarim ba sdus don gyi khrid/ byin rlabs spungs zhus kyi lung sogs gnang / dkyil 'khor dgon du spyi khang bskyar gso grub pa dang dus 'grig pas srung ma'i sku brnyan la rab gnasagater 'bula'athogs gnang / byes lha bab dus chen la skyed ma ma 'tsho 210

dza4 byams sku khong dang tshad mnyam pa'i gtsos gos tha dz+wa / ‘ chide rnasabazung lo blostar chags su )narme gcig la byams smon stong zage re khong nyid kyi skyed ma'i dge rtsar 'don rgyun gyi thebs su lkekhron nyis brgya sogs gan nga 'jog mdzad/ sgogong sa mchog—tshul rin po che smon lam stengazigasung chos kyi thog mar byonagyu rgyur gsung bshad gsar bsgrigs ji byas pa la khong yongs 'dzin grags pa rin po che chi la ri nyid mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po yin yang de 'i nang gi—r+pār snyen pha gyi bshad pa dor te shul du gzhan zhig dris pas rten 'brel cung 'dzol sku sna — dgung grangs nga brgyad pa rab tshes chuṅkamo—phag gi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes bdun nas sngags nim chegamo'i bshad lung / gsang 'dus bde mchog 'jigs gyed lha bcu gsum ma/ 'khordze chen/ kye rdor rnams kyi dbang gnang / dwo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la yongs 'dzin dang yabamanyags kyis skyabs mgon rin po cher bkau' chos 'bul dgos gyi snyan gsan /'bul bar byon par— lam du 'du khang chen mor gzhan zhig giyosku dkar phul ba dang dus mtshungs pas rten 'brel legs dzogs che ba byung / nang du phebs nas yongs 'dzin tshang dang sgob rnams— gagyis nas de skor gyi zhu ba nan tan che ba la brten nas khong gis kyang zhal gyis 311

bzhes dgos byung / dzā gnyes pa'i bcu gcig lta bla brang nang du phethās te byin rlabs spurdzasu zhu yokyi bshad lung dang / brgyad stong ba'i lung gi dbu btsugs/ sku gsung thugs rtenapalha dar dkar byucerozung bcas dbang ludz+wa rjes gsum sogs chos rgyun yongs rdzogs kyirika' drin skyong dgos zhes zhu ba nan cheraho mdza da/ ji khong gis slar lha dar dkar bo dri bral srid du ring ba zhig5sku zhabs rin po che'i phyag tu phul te zhabs pad brtan cing sku phreng gongasto ma rnams kyi mdzad pa ji lta ba gnang dgos shing / bka' chos 'bul ba la gegs med lhun 'grub 'ong ba'i skyabs — 'jug nyidaṭ+wāṃkyi bugs la 'dzin dgos/ nyid kyi thugs la bzung na kho bo nas dka' tshegs la mi 'dzem par rang la rgyun gang yod dang gzhan las nyan dgos rnams nyan te 'bul rtsis byed bsam pa / mthar phyin pa zhig thugs nas 'dor med mkhyen zhes zhu ba phul/ tshes bco lnga la brgyad stong ba'i mjug grub nas bcu drug lang tshe mdo/ mdo sdud pa/ spyod 'jug 'jam dpal mtshan brjog rnams kyi lung gnang / bcu bdun bco brgyad gnyis tshwa lam rim bsdu ge don gyi bshad lung zhib rgyas gnang / de nas nyin bdun la byang chub lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung ga nang / nyer drug la lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs te 21lha

rdzogs par gnang / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes gcig nas 'bum ston jo khang nas skyabs mgon rin po cher rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen po la dngos su gsungs pa'i 'jam lugs tshe dpag med lha lnga'i rjes gnang bstsal zhing / de nas rim par rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang 'jam dbyangs chos skor las byung ba'i rjes gnang yongase rdzogs/ sa skya'i gser chos sdocu gsum gyi byin rlabasakhyidang rjes gnang skor yongs rdzogs/ klu ba'i gser chos su grags pa seṅge'i sgra'i ngag grol gyi gdams pa'i lung dang bcas pa jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang nyer gnyis/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ zur bka' thor bu'i skoracal sman bla mtho brtsegs/ klunobango rgyal bo gtso dzakhor lnga/sa lugs 'jam dbyangs demar ser/ sgeg rdor lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ gtsug tore rnam rgyal lha dgu/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ sgra tshad pa'i lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dkar mo thun mong ma yin pa/ dbyangs caspyo ma dmarari mo phyag gnyisam/— spyanatsho ras gzigase phyag bzhi ba/ dpal au'i lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal/ sgrol ma nyardzogecig phyogs bsdebs/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ sgol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo bka' babalha13

dgu ldan/ sgrol dkar rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa rigs bdag la brten nas tshe yar ba 'gug pa sogs kyi da/migs pa dang bcas pa/ lha mo shra ma ṇi'i rjes gnang bum chog la brten pa/ pa ri lugs kyi rdo rje rnam 'joms ljang sngon gtso rkyang / sa lugs kyi khro bo ze brtsegs dud kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga/ rdo rje khyung khra/ mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba 'byung bo 'ur 'ded/ khyung nag me'i spu gri/ 'jam dzodapal nā ga rat+na/ lha mo 'od zer can ma gtso rkya nga / jo lugs — 'dzam dkar lha lnga/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rdor sems yab rgyang dang / bla med lugs kyi rdor sems yab yum bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang mkha' spyod ma'i sngags btu/ 'jigs byed zhal phyagi dhe yongs rdzogs dang phyag gnyis pa ma he la zhon pa/ 'jigs byed dmar bo mda' 'gengs/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ rta stogrin gsang sgrub/ seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum/ lho brag bka' 'bum las byung ba'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ mgon po'i bka' bcu gsum snying zhugs rigs gtad dang bcas pa/chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / yang gsang dug ri nag po/ rnam sras bka' bco lnga/ zhal rnam 'gyur bcu bdun/ 'di'i bram ze nag po mngags gtad kyi skabs dpal 214

mnon zhal bzhi ba'i brnyan thang byin can zhig dang ral gri zhig /skyabs mgon mchog la dngos su gtad de chos skyong khyad par can 'di nyid bstan pa srung ba'i bka' sdod dang pho nya las mkhan du bka' bsgo zil che ba zhig gnang / 'dod khams dbadze+ephyug dmag zor rgyal mo/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ dregs pa lcam sring dang sku lnga'i srog gtad/ gnod sbyin tse'u dmar gyi srog gtad/ dam can seng zhon dang ra zhon gnyis kyi srog gtad/ thams cad kyi mjug tu gur gyi mgon po khro bcus bskor ba rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i rjes gnang phul te zhal nas/ dpon slob sde bcas lha 'di'i mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang du btsud de phyi nang gi bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i rten 'brel lta bur lo 'di'i bka' chos kyi mjug sdud byas pa yin gsungs/ 'di dag gi skabs chos skyong la bka' bsgo tshul mi 'dra ba mang du mdzad cing khyad par zhal gyi skabs sugatso gtor gshegs gsol yoganang bar skyabs mgon nyid la gnang / khong rang nyid kyi thugs dam gyi rten zhal gyi bris thang yum bzhi sogs 'khor gyis bskor ba gnang ste 'bral med byed dgos gsung ba dang / skyabs mgon sku gong ma'i zhal gyi srog 'khor spyang 'bral med byed dgos tshul gsungs/ 'di yan skyabs mgon mchog la rjes gnang lnga 215

brgyar nyi ba phul zin/ dgu ba'i nyir gnyis la skyabs mgon mchog la dge tshul gyi sdom pa phul zhing de 'phral rjes mdzad pa'i dge tshu la gyi bslab bya gan ma rtse lding ma'i lung gnang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i glegs bam dang lha dar ser po srid du ring ba bcas ge 'bul gnang mdzad de snyan bskul zhus so/ / smras pa/ tshogs gnyis rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i/ /gsang gsum rin chen mdzod kyi sgo phyes te/ /mdo sngags thang mar brdal ba'i dga' ston la/ /ris med skal ldan pad mtshor ngang mo bzhin/ /khyad par rgya bod paṇa chen mkhas kun la/ /'gran bzod mkhas grub kun mkhyen chen po yi/ /yang sprul lha mi'i gtsug rgyan skyabs mgon mchog /'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /gtsug gi nor bur bsten pa'i dga' ston la/ rī /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kutshon 'dus nas/ /da ni dam chos nyi ma shar ro zhes/ /bstod bsngags rol mo'i sgra yis 'jig rten khyab/4 /byang phyob/sa rmugs 'dzin dbang bo'i mdzod chen la/ /'khu ba'i thugs mdzod gdams pa'i gter mdzod las/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i da4chos rin char/ /lhug par bstsal bas rdzogs ldan gsar ba bskrun/ /ces bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje 216

btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu —zhes bya ba las kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa sogs kyi sarga ste bcu gcig pa'o/ / ne+e gong sa skyabs mgon mchog sogs snod ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la dbang lung man ngag gi char phab cing phyogs ris med du zhabs kyis bcags zhe chos dang zang zing gi char phab pa'i sarga/ 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba'i skye 'gro dag /'jigs med skam sar 'dren pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa'i zhabs skyes rdul/ /bla med byang chub bar du spyi bor bsten/ /dza hu'i bu mo'i rgyun la 'khu ba yi/ /chad med rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos rgyun gyis/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho gsos pa'i byung ba dag /brjod pa'i ngag gi rol mo slar yang dkrol/ /de nas dgung grangs nga dgu ba rab tshes shing pho byi ba'i lo la kye rdor grwa tshang gsang sngags dar rgyas gling gi 'dus spyis zhus ngor dpal kye rdo rje lha dgu/ gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor lo chen po bco 217

rbargyad/ rnam 'byor nam mkha' rnams kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa bstsa la ba dang/ de dag gi cho ga bdag mdun bum pa bdag 'jug smon lam shis brjod bcas/ tshogs 'don gyi skor lung rgyun gang yod rnams dang / khyab bdag stag phu ba'i lugs kyi sgrol ma phyi nang gi dbang grwa tshang de ka'i tshogs yongs lam̐ bstsal/dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi 'dus spyi nas zhus ngor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs lha so gnyis pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ 'khor lo bde mchog lca i pa lha re gnyis pa rnams kyi dbang dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi cho ga'i lung bcas gnang / bzhi ba'i tshes gcig nas nyin bcu gsum ring la byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmar khrid thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i bde lam gyi khrid rgyas pa'i phyag srol ltar nyin rer bshad pa lan gsum re dang phyi nyin snga ma'i bshad pa mdor brdus bcas bzhi bshad kyi tshul dang de yang nyin dang bo bcu gnyis la yongs 'dzin rin po che dang / gung thang 'jagapa'i dbyangs kyi gsung rgyun ltar thog mar tshigs bcad re gnang zhing nyin tha ma'i nyin bla ma byams pa rin po che dang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i phyag bzhes ltar gnang / de'i rgyu mtshan yang phyis su lam khrid rgyas pa dka' dgongs nas de ltar gsungs 218

skabs zin bris byid mkhan yang 'ga' re byung / ston dus byang rgyud nas slar ri khrod dbang bo ma the si grags pa rgya mtsho khu dbon gnyis 'byor te sngar nas nan bskul byas yod pa ltar mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang dgos zhes nan che bar brten thag ring nas ched gnyer gyis 'ongs pa sogs la dgongs te khong khu dbon gnyis dang mchod dpon 'jigs med gsum sogs la grub pa'i dbang phyug mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi dbang drug cu re drug nyin nyer lnga'i bar rdzogs par byas shing de skabs kyang sla chos gtan nas ma gnang bar bshad pa gang rgyas rgyas dang phyag len gang zhib zhib kyis gnang ba'i zin bris gzhan gyis byas pa'ang yod 'dug go/ /de min lo 'di'i rnam thar gyi sa bon brtsad ma chod/ dgung grangs drug cu ba rab tshes shing mo glang gi lo'ine zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gsum nas bde thang mkhan rin po che'i sprul skus zhus ngor hor gtsang khri chen sprul ba'i sku rin po che'i gtsos nyung 'dus la be'u bum sngon po rtsa 'grel/ dpe chos rtsa 'a grel/ chig lab ring mo mi chos gnad kyi 'phreng ba/ tho chos dang ang yig bdun cu ba/ ri khrod skal ldan sgron me/ ding ri brgyad cu ba/ blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo rnams kyi lung dgyes bzhin du bstsal te skyabs mgon gong ma nas rang re'i dgon 'dir bka' gdams 2/9

gong ma rnams kyi gsung gi skor gyi 'chad nyan re yod na bzang zhes bka' phebs yod tshul bcas gsungs/ ston mjug hor gtsang mtsho khar gdan drangs pa ltar phebs te zhag shas der bzhugs nas hor gtsang dgon gsar du phebs te bla ma lnga bcu ba/ bka' pod lnga'i rtsa ba/ grub mtha' rtsa ba/ bse bsdus grwa/ byang chub lam sgron/ spyod 'jug chen mo/ rgyal sras lag len/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtogs bdun dang rtogs gsum gnyis/ sgyung gnas cho ga sman byin rlabs/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ tshe gcig nyams len/ shasnya la'i smon lam/ yon sbyong gi cho ga tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs 'don thabs/ tsha gsur/sman byin rlabs/ d+ngha ltung bshags/ spyi bshags/ dge slong gi phyir bcos/ byams smon/ gsang 'dus smon lam/ thu'u bkwan rta mgrin gtor bzlog bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ bstan 'bar ma dang / dge ldan bstan 'bar ma/ lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid/ gtor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid/ nyung 'dus la lha mo'i gtor chen gyi lung / 'jigs byed bsnyen chen gyi skor/'jam bstod gang blo ma/ dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/ nyi gzhon 'char kha ma/ lam gtso/ seng gdong ma/ sher snying sogs lung phran mang bo dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo 220

gcig dzi/ gosang 'ardus/ bde mchog thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi dbang / mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ 'od zer can ma/ lo gyon ma/ gdugs dkar sgrol dkar/ sgrol ljang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma/ rig byed ma/ seng gdong ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ chos rgyal snaphyi nang gnyis/ zhal bzhi ba/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ lcam sring /dam can rnams kyi rjes gnang bcas chos bka' mang du bstsal te dgu ba'i nyi shu la gdan sar phebs 'phral dga' ldan lha brgya ma/rje nyid kyi gsung gi sgrol dkar bstod pa ut+pal 'od kyi lcags kyu rnams kyi lung dang de ltar mkha' dbyings ma'i lung / dbyangs can ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid/ zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu'i steng nas sbyin sreg gi khrid/ 'jam dkar las tshogs kyi khrid/thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal kyi dbang / seṅge'i sgra/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ dbyangs can dkar mo gsum kyi rjes gnang rnams bstsal/ dgung grangs re gcig pa rab tshes kyi mjug zad pa me pho stag gi lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes lnga nas paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum gyi lung / tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing / rab gnas dang ngag byin rlabs/ thun drug rnal 'byor/221

klu'i bum gter rnams kyi khrid/ zla gnyig pa'i tshes bco lnga la bde thang sprul ba'i sku rin po che sogs la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bstsal te sprul ba'i sku rin po che nyid la rje nyid kyi bzhugs gding gnang ste bstan 'gro'i don byed dgos kyi bka' phabs/ nyi shu tham pa'i nyin se chang bkra shis dar rgyas gling gis gdan zhus ltar phebs nas thog mar thams cad la tshigs snga phyi'i bslab pa gzhi sgrub byas te nyer dgu'i nyin dus 'brel gso sbyong du phebs nas mdo gsungs/ de skabs than pas gdung ba la dus 'khor sa chog byas pa'i nub kha ba chen po babs pas khong tshor dga' dad lhag par 'phel/ de nas gi tsha'i dge bshes grags can tsho byon pa dang / lwa mo nas kyang grwa ba mang drags phebs pa sogs gzhi byes kyi tshogs pa kun la bde lam gyi khrid/ skyabs 'gro dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i 'jigs byed gnyis/ kun rig mngon byang / thugs rje chen po/gcod dbang / mgon chos lha mo gsum/ dur bdag sogs kyi rjes gnang / theg chen gso sbyong sogs chos bka' du ma gnang /sgom grwar phebs te dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang gsung bshad zab cing rgya che ba dang bcas bstsal/ rdul tshon grub kyi bar nyin re bzhin chos thun re ma chad par gnang / rnam snang mngon byang gi 222

dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gsar tshugs gnang ste thebs su tho'u khron brgyad brgya sbyor 'jags gnang / bcu gsum la nang gi bdag 'jug bcu bzhi la sta gon/ nag nya la byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ bcu drug bcu bdun gnyis la gong ma geng chen dang rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang bcas yongs rdzogs bstsal te kla klo'i sde tshogs zil gyis gnon pa'i rten 'brel du spyog dar 'dzugs pa sogs kyi bkod khyab gnang ste dbang 'di lo rjes mar bskur rgyur song na rigs ldan rgyal bo ma 'gag pa chos kyi rgyal srid du dbang bskur ba dang dus mtshungs pas shin tu legs kyang stabs cung zhig ma 'grig gsungs/ de skabs lwa mo'i zhabs drung dkar bo nas kyang ri khrod dbang bo grags pa dar rgyas brgyud de lwa mo bde chen phyogs su gdan 'dren dang bka' chos mang bo dgos tshul nang mdzod che legs srid du ring ba bcas snyan gsan phul bar thugs dgyes pa'i nyams dang bcas phyis bka' bzhin sgrub chog pa'i gsung lan zhib rgyas bstsal/ rdo sbis dgon grong thun mong nas gdan 'dren nan cher byas kyang zhal bzhes ma mdzad par phebs skyel du ma dang bcas bco brgyad la slar gdan sar 'byor te bsgrub bya 'ga' la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bzhi nas rten 'brel 323

bstod pa'i bshad lung / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum/ bde lam dang gzungs 'jug rab gnas rnams kyi khrid/ skal ldan mgur ma'i lung / zla ba drug pa'i tshes nas byams chos sde lnga/ thar chen/ rigs tshogs drug rdo rje tshig sbram gyi bshad lung / grub mtha' chen mo rtsa 'grel gyi bshad lung / sman pa grwa tshang la rta mgrin pad+ma gar dbang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ sman bla lha nga gcig mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu rnams kyi dbang dang mgon po bar chad kun sel/ rnam sras ser chen gong gnon dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / bdun pa'i tshes nas 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ mdzod rtsa/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi cho ga smon shis bcas/ kun mkhyen gsung 'bum/ rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ brgyad pa'i tshes nas gser 'od kyi lung / rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung / lam gtso'i bshad lung / tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing / bde mchog lo hu ba'i dpang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi sngags btu/ mkha' spyod sngags btu/byin rlabs chos nyid ngo sprod/ drag po sum dril gyi rjes gnang /dgu ba'i tshes brgyad nas rje dge 'dun grub kyi gsung 'bum/bde mchog rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor bcu bdun/ gur mgon lha brgyad ma sogs dkyil 'khor lnga'i dbang / bcu ba'i 224

tshesaunas lam rim bsdus don gyi bshad lung / lam gtso'i bshad lung / yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i bshad lung / dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid/ kye rdor lha dgu dang rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang /khyung khra dang khyung nag gi rjes gnang / bsdus grwa'icamatha' dpyod/ mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs stag phu'i gsung dang / zhi sprul 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyi mdzad pa/ dpe chos rtsa 'grel/ man ngag rin chen spungs pa/ shar ba'i lam rim sogs kyi lung yang bstsal to/ / dgung grangs resnyeganyis pa rab rgyal me mo yos bu'i lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes nas lu mo gong mas zhus ngor 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med pa'i gsung 'bum/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum/ blo sbyong brgya rtsa/ skyabs 'gro/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal gsum gyi khrid/ snang mdzad bsrung ba'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i 'od dang de'i dkyil chog rnams te le tshan drug gi lung / yi ge bzhi ba'i bsad bzlog gi khrid/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ gser chos bcu gsum/ zhal rnam 'gyur bcu bdun/ཿ25

bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sngags btu/ 'tham dkar shes rab blo 'phel/ gur brag rdzong ma'i rjes gnang / jo bo'i rnam thar chos kyi 'byung gnas/ 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dbang /sman gyi rgyun chung gsum/ rwa pod/ dpal pod/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nyi shu nas bde mchog rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs rdzogs/'ga' dag tshang gis zhus ngor bram ze mchog sred nas brgyud pa'i mgon po gri gug lha lnga/ mal gyi lha brgyad ma/ stag steng ba'i lha bcu gnyis ma/ gyi ljang lugs kyi lha bcu bdun ma rnams gyi dbang / grub mtha' chen mo'i bshad lung / 'jam mgon shes rab rgya mtsho'i bka' 'bum dang rje tsong kha ba'i gsung 'bum/brgyad stong ba/ thar mdo/ man ngag bka' rgya ma rnams spyi lung / lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung / bde lam gyi khrid/lam mchog snying bo'i bshad lung / tshe gcig nyams len/ skyabs khrid/ gtor ma brgya rtsa dang bla mchod phyag chen sprags pa'i—khrid dang tshe dbang / brgyad stong ba'i lung / 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang bstsal/ sa ga'i nya la bsgrub bya mang bo bsnyen par rdzogs/ bzhi ba'i nyer lnga nas zhwa dmar tshang dang zla ma dkar bo tshang rnam gnyis kyis zhus ngor rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dkar las tshogs dang dbyangs can ma'i 226

las tshogs kyi khrid sogs dang / drug pa'i tshes nas kyai rdor lha dgu/ dgra nag bcu gsum/ gshed dmar bcu gsum/ rdo ra dbyings rnams kyi dbang dang / tshes bcu nas nyin nyer brduspyo la mi tra thun mong min pa'i dbang re drug gnang / bdun pa'i mar ngor rgan gyar sa chu'i 'phrod rten du byon/ brag dkar dang khad nye bas gnas mjal du phebs/ gnas khang nas rdo kha shas bsnams 'ong ste lam bar du chu la steng gi 'dam bkrus pas nub mo mtshanalam du rdo de rnams bkrus pa'i 'dam phye rnams sangs rgya/tse byang sems kyi sku gzugs sha stag chu la g.yeng ba'i rmi ltas byung bas nangs par ma legs rdo dang steng gi 'dam thams cad lha'i sku yin 'ardug snyam yid pham pa skyes zhes gsungs/ yang nub cig nyin mo char zim gyi rjes su sprin dkar shal shal mang bo rgyu ba mthong ba'i rkyen gyis mkha' la 'ja' 'od dwangs gsal gyi rang bzhin lha dang lha mo 'phan dang rgyal mtshan thogs pa mang bo shar phyogs su 'gro ba'i rjes na lab lung skyabs mgon red zer ba'i 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin dwangs gsalabyusgrib med la sku mdangs smug po/ gdong zor ba/ spyag g.yas kyis rang gi kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'phan chung g.yer kha can zhig yod pa bsnams nas nam mkha' la shar du 'gro ba zhig rmis byung ste gnas byin rlabs che 227

nges su 'dug kyang rang rgyud ngan pas gnas byin rlabs che ba'i dgos pa ma grub pa go lags zhes gsungs pa'i go don gong du bshad zin/ ston mjug lwa mo bde chen du phebs/ zhal nas 'gro dga' che ba min kyang zhabs drung rin po che sku bskun bzhin sku tshegs la ma 'dzem par phebs te gdan skyod kyi gsung phebs nan che ba dang / nyid kyi sku don 'gang cher gtad pa sogs kyis bde chen chos gling ngam dge tshogs gling du bskyod ces gsungs pa ltar chibs bskyod skabs rje gser khang ba'i bzhugs gnas bkra— shis chos lung ngamatshakhri lung du grags pa'i gnas su lamajirim chen ske mo'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs/kā phar phyin mtha' dpyod kyi dbu nas rtsi bzhag gnang rjes chos 'khor dang bsdus grwa'i dam bca' re btsugs/ ser 'phreng gi bsu ba dang bcas bde du phebs nas de phyogs ha cang dmu rgod pas grwa ba ser dmag tu9 tsho — 'gro ba sogs kyis thog mar nyin gsum gyi ring thams cad gzhi sgrub kyis bsnyen rdzogs su bkod de skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ snying bo don gsum/ bde lam dmar khrid/ yospyo tan gzhi gyur ma rnams kyi zab khrid/ don ldan tshang gis zhus ngor dbal mang rin po che'i gsung 'bum nang gi cha pod yongs rlorī rdzogs kyi lung gnang / stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang gnyis kyi byin 228

rla bayodang de'i las tshogs dang bcas pa'i lung / rigasajigasum spyi sgrub/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/ zhal bzhi ba rnams kyi rjes gnang / lta khrid dran pa bzhi lda na gyi khrid/ 'jigs byed bsnyen chen gyi khrid sogs bstsal/de'i yul mi rnams rang bzhin drang bas blo kha chos la phyogs pa mang bo byung gsungs/ de 'og sta gon sngon du btang nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang dpa' cig 'khor chen/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ bcu gcig zhal/ gdugs dkar lha mang sogs kyi dbang / legs ldan mched gsu ma gyi rjes gnang byad grol dang bcas pa/ seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum dang sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang / rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ rgyan 'jug mdo rtsa rnams kyi lung / gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung / lcang skya'i 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i cho ga rgyal dbang sman chog chen mo/ bla ma rin po che nyid kyi gsung gi gsang bdag dang 'grel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mi 'khrugs pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor9/ 'jigs byed bsam gtan bdag 'jug sogs lung mang bo rte gnang / dngos 'bul dngul srang bzhi brgya dang gzhan dag gis kyang dngos 'bul mtho bas sngon bde chen dpon slob kyi chos thog cig yod pa phyis chad pa nyams gso'i phyir lo bstar chags su 229

bzhi ba'i yar ngo la ltung bshags/ nyin re la mi re sa tshar lnga bcu re 'gro nges kyi bkas bcad gnang / de ka'i the bas su dngul srang sum brgya sogs dngos po gang byung sbyor 'jags gnang / hor zla bcu ba'i tshes la phyi ra btegs pa'i lam zhor la shing le khar phebs/ dus 'khor gsar 'dzugs kyi ched dadzul srang drug cu dang / khron nyis brgya dngartsoras sogs 'jog pa gnang / de nas shel dgon du phebs gnartswakhang du mchod me brgya phul/ de nub nam gung ma lon tsam na gam 'khod grwa chung zhig ra bar phyin pa na gnas ri'i rtse nas 'ja' tshon nyis rim zhig khong rin po che bzhugs gnas kyi gzim khang steng du zug pa mthong ba bzhin ri khrod pa rnams kyis kyang mthong / mkha' ngos 'ja' tshon dra ba 'od ljang khus khebs 'dug shel dgon nas phebs pa'i nangs par chibs thog nas nyi zla skar gsum khong rin posgeche nyid dang zhabs zhu thams cad kyis mthong / khong gi zhal nas nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig la 'dzoms pa rten 'brel legs zhes gsungs/ de nas rim gyis phebs par sngar shel dgon gyi gnas ri nas 'ja' shar ba de khong rin po che'i ji bzhin 'brang ste 'ong ba kun gyis mthong / zhal nas da 'gror mi 'jug ka gsungs chibs las babs te de phyogs su phyag gnang 230

zhing rkang brgyad sogs gsungs/ de ṣ+kabs khong nyid kyi phyogs su gcig dang phar phyogs su gcig cha da de cha 5nyis su gyur/ de nas phebs par yang 'ja' gnyis mthud de sngar bzhin 'ongs pa sogs ltas ya mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / bcu bdun la phyir gdan sar 'byor/ rgyal mkhan sprul ba'i skus zhus ngor 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang / 'khor chen dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang bstsal/dgung grangs re gsum pa rab rgyal sa pho 'brug gi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes brgyad la grub rgyal tshe dbang / bde mchog dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang / bcu bdun nas rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'bum dang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'bum gnyis kyi lung bstsal/khros nag lha lnga'i dbang / ma cig zhi drag gi byin rlabs/ sgrol dkor 'od zer drug sbrugs/ 'jam dkar thun mong ma yin pa/thugs rje po bcu gcig zhal dang jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig rnams kyi rjes gnang / lam rim nyams mgur gyi bshad lung /zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la bde mchog lo hu ba'i dbang / nye ra bdun la tshe gcig nyams len gyi khrid/ gsum pa'i tshes la dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dbang bdun gong ma gong chen bcas/ gong 23/

ma'i dbang gi skor karma tshe dbang kun khyab kyi ngor sde dge si tu'i gsung gis zur sgron te dus 'khor che ba'i skabs su byung ba ltar pyis/ 'on kyang a mchog tshang nas dbang bdun las ma gnang bas 'di rto ga bzor song e yod snyam gsungs/ bcu drug nyin gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / 'di la lnga ba chen mo'i dkyil chog yod mod kyang khri chen gung thang ba nas dpa' cig ltar —gnang ba'i de bzhin byas/ bcu bdun la dam tshig rdo rje'i gsung steng nas thubacipa chen po 'od zer dri med/ bco brgyad la gtsug tor dri med kyi rigs gtad/ zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga la theg chen gso sbyong / de nas lam rim mchan bzhi ma'i bshad phung / la ma gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje / mergan bla ma/ dbal mang rin po che'i zhal shes rnams sprags pa'i steng dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gzab khrid rgyas pa/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg blo sbyong don bdun ma dang tshigs brgyad ma rnams kyi khrid/tshe gcig nyams len dang dge ldan bstan 'bar ma'i bsha da lung / bla mchod dang phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid shin tu rgyas pa gan nga / lo 'dir bdun pa'i bcu gnyis la sta gon dang bcu gsum nas bla brang nang du mi tra brgya rtsa gnang ba dang don ldan 23lha

gyis zhus ngor dbal mang cha pod ma gtogs gsung 'bum gzhan tshang ma'i lung gnang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes gsum nas zhabasardzidrung dung dkar gyis zhus ngor sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes ji gnang lung bcas/ bdun pa'i tshes bcu na sa sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang brgya dang zhe brgyad lung bcas/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang don dgu lung bcas/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nas snar thang brgya rtsa lung bcas/ bcu gnyis la sman bla mtho brtsegs/ klu dbang rgyalo bo'i rjes gnang / chos spyod skal bzang mgrin rgyan gyi lung /rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / mkha' spyod ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshogs chen 'du khang gi rgya mthongs kyi logs ris thams cad tshwas zos te chud 'dza' ba kun sngon ma rtsoji bzhin ras bris byas te legs mdzes su bsgrubs/ bla brang gnas chung btsan khang zhig gso'i rkyen gyis logs ris zhig pa la gyan thang gsum bzhag dgung grangs re bzhi ba rab rgyal sa mo sbrul gyi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i yar rdzar grub rgyal tshe dbang / lo snga ma'i sgrub thabs rin 'byung 'phro mi g.yo ba dkar bo/ seng gdong ma/ dmag zor ma gsum gyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa dang sgrol dkar 233

'od zer drug sbrags/ 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rirjes gnang rnams zhabs drung dung dkar sogs la gnang / mar ngor dur khrod pa dag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs rnam dag gtsug tor ltar gyi seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan thod 'khor gyi khrid/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal lha lnga/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma rnams kyi dbang / snga phyir skyabs 'gro/ ltung bshags dga' ldan lha brgya ma 'dod gsol bcas/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung gi lcam sring gtor bsngos dang yon tan mchog brnyes ma/ dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs bcu gcig skyabs mchog 'jigs med dbang bo dang mdzod dge mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i gsung gi sgrol dkar tshe sgrub/ bla ma rgyang 3bod/ bar do'i 'phrang sgrol/lcang skya'i gsung gi bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs/ thu'u bkwan gsung bag tse'i gtor chog gung thang gsung dpa' cig bdag 'jug stag phu'i sgrol ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid char 'beb dang bcas pa/ 'grel ba don gsal/ yongs su grags pa'i smon lam lnga sogs kyi lung / zla gsum pa'i tshes bzhi nas maṇ+ḍal dang rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ 'jam dkar las tshogs 334

dang byin rlabs spungs zhus kyi khrid sogs/ rgyal bo'i bka' 'bum dang bka' gdams pha chos bu chos kyi lung / rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung / blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer steng nas blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid/ lcang skya'i khrid yig steng nas tshi gas brgyad ma'i khrid/ 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yum bcas/ 'khor chen dang rdo sems yab rkyang / 'od zer can ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / bcu gcig zhal/ —rnam snang mngon byang / dpa' cig rnams kyi dbang / lam rim myur lam gyi khrid dang rten 'brel bstod pa'i lung bshad bstsal/ blo lnga ba'i bcu gsum la 'bo rwa'i sngon po thang du chibs bsgyur gnang nas tshogs mang la rgyan 'jug chos spyod sogs kyi lung gnang te chos dpal zhing du chibs bsgyur gnang nas der dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ sta gon dang bcas te 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma/ ro langs brgyad skor/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/'jig rten dbang phyug dril bu lha lnga dang lus dkyil gnyis/nag po spyod pa/ spyod rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum ma rnams kyi dbang bstsal/ slar yang sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ 'jigs byed gnyis/ 'khor chen/ rta mgrin/ kun rig mngon byang /235

bcu gcig zhal/ gdugs dkar/ sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ dam tshig gsum bkod rnams kyi dbang gnang / g.yu thog yon tan mgon po phyi nang gsang gsum/ sgrol ma/ seng gdong ma/ legs ldan mched gsum/ dbyangs can ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang rnams gnang ste zhal nas dbang lung khrid man ngag snyan brgyud gang yod bum pa gang byo'i tshul du byas pa ni spyir deng dus chos la blo kha phyogs mkhan nyung / chos kyi lad mo byed mkhan tsho yang byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra ba mig 'khrid tsam las 'ga' yang rnam par dag pa'i chos rgyun kun la rtog dpyod byed mkhan dang bya sa'i yul gtan bral ba ma bzod pas yin gsungs/ jo'i khang sa la tha 'og chos rgyal mdun nas tshogs pa mang dang bcas gsol kha btang ste zan sgril bar dus 'khor grwa khang gi mdun la bab/grol 'phral mar lam kun sa der 'khod 'dug pas thams cad lhan cig tu rgyun chags gsum pa bton nas shis brjod bstan 'bar mas gnang / sa der gzigs pa dang mi zhig gi lag tu ze'u zhig thogs te 'ongs par ci yin gang la 'khyer rgyu nes bka' 'dri gnang bas 'o ma yin rung khang la 'khyer rgyu yin zhus par thugs shin tu mnyes/ phyi nas zla skar bzang ba dang bstun 236

a khu bsod nams sogs bzhi mgo dpon du bskos/ go yudze+eci tsam yong ba gzhal te blo ngor lon par byas/ khong rang nyid nas rgya dngul rdo tshad nyi shu lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i rgyur gnang ste rim gyis ser skya thams cad la de lugs bkod khyab gnang bas thamagacad kyis khur len byas/ bdun cipa'i tshes dgu la dus 'khor grwa gzhung nas gtor rgyag go yul mi 'dug ces gleng bas khong gis —sa bskor te bstan/ bcu gcig la lto 'phye brtag bslang sogs dang bkra shis gso sbyong / brgyad stong ba gsung sgrogs rnams byas/ dus 'khor sa gar byed bcug lcags pho rta dang lcags lug sa sprel ste lo gsum gyi ring la legs par grub/ rtsigs pa'i phyi ngos su yang sangs rgyas kyi sku sum stong lnga brgya/ de mtshungs ma ṇi yig drug lami 'bur dod pa dang / mda' yab kyi 'og tu bod khams yongs la chos kyi bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnams dang chos rgyal mes dbon rnams ri mor bzhengs pa sogs phyi nang thams cad mdzes gyur mig gi bdud rtsir bskrun/ de nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang gnang ste khri las thog pa bde thang mkhan sprul rin po che nas maṇ+ḍal bshad pa mdzad/ dbyar gzhung gdan sar phebs 'phral dbal mang bka' rgya ma dang bcas gsung 'bum yongs rdzogasalakyi lung gnang / sngags rim chen mo'i bshad 237

lung / paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal rīmatshan gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung / tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing /ru rdor dbyings dbang / mkha' spyod ma'i dbang / srad rgyud lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ 'jigs byed ser bo phyag na ku sha bsnams pa'i tshe khrid/ 'jam dpal zhi drag gi bsrung ba dang tshe spel ba sogs kyi khrid/ gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan 'dzugs chog gi khrid/ nag po spyod pa'i bde mchog gi dbang sogs chos bka' mang bo bstsal/ lo 'dir gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gnang / dgung grangs re lnga ba rab rgyal lcags pho rta'i lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes bco brgyad nas dmar mo skor gsum du grags pa mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi lung yongs rdzogs/ shar ba'i lam rim gyi lung / nyer bzhi nas nyin bzhir bla mchod dang phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid/ nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma spyi sgrub/ jo lugs dzam dkar lha lnga/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring rnams kyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ dus 'khor sdom chen/gtsug tor dri mid/ 'od zer dri med/ gshed dmar lha lnga rnams kyi dbang / 'grel ba don gsal/ lam khrid gser gyi yang zhun/ rgyal bo'i bka' 'bum/ mkha' spyod ma'i be'u bum/23myi

mi la'i mgur 'bum sogs lung mang bo bstsal/ zla ba gnyis pa'i bcu gcig nas bka' bstan sogs sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas chos dpal zhing du phyag phebs/bde thang sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor lha mo'i gtor bzlog sto dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag pa'i 'phrul 'khor zhes pa ljags rtsom mdzad de lung yang bstsal/ de nas bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/ bka' gdams gzhung drug rgyud gzhung / khong rin po che nyid kyis brtsams pa'i 'jigs phyed bsam gtan bdeg 'jug sogs lung mang bo gnang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ sta gon dang bcas dus 'khor dbang yongs rdzogs/ phag mo lha bcu gsum gyi dbang / rmo ga ri'i dgon pa'i ngor bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / kun rig gi dbang / dpa' cig mgon chos sogs kyi rjes gnang / sta gon dang bcas mi tra'i dbang yongs rdzogs gnang / de nas chibs bsu dang bcas bde thang dgon du phebs/ lha khang 'du khang sogs kyi nang rten rnams la zhib mjal gnang nas sprul ba'i skyo rin po che la phrug sogs kyi gnang cha'ang bstsal/ sprul ba'i sku rin po ches rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i li sku khyad 'phags dang kha dar dkar ser sogs dngos 'bul spus gtsang phul bar dgyes bzhes mdzad de 239

nged lo drug cu rtsa lon pa la khyed kyis tshe dpag med kyi sku phul ba rten 'brel shin tu legs zhes zhal gsung phebs/ de nas chibs skyel dang bcas kha gya phyogs su lgegebs te dus 'khor dbaromo che gnang / kha gya'i sgar sar/ mdzod dge sgar/ rgyal mkhar sgar sogs su 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad nas phyir chos dpal zhing du phebs/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid sogs dang rim lnga gsal sgron/ legs bshad snying bo/ gzhi gsum cho ga rnams kyi bshad lung bstsal/ rgyud pa grwa tshang la gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal thang dang 'du khang gi logs ris zhig gso'i thebs su sgor mo sum brgya dang mar rgya ma sum brgya bcas gnang / de nas phyir gdan sar phebs/ zla bdun pa'i bcu bdun nas tshogs chen khri las thog pa mi to sprul ba'i skus zhus ngor nyin drug la lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / bā rin tho yon sprul skus zhus ngor rgyal ba seṅge nga ro'i lha khang nas sems bskyed mchod pa/ 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi bshad lung bla ma rgyud mchod dang bcas pa/ rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang / srad rgyud bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid smin rgyase/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang / bde lam gyi dmar khrid rgyas pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ dur bdag 240

yab yum dang 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogayoyum bcas kyi rjes gnang dang de'i sngags btu/ 'ja ma dkar 'brug zhon sogs kyi rjes gnang sogs mang bo bstsal to/ / 'dir smras pa/ 'dzad med nor bus gtams pa'i chu gter che/ /chu phran 'bum phrag btung bas ngoms mid ltar/ — /byams dang snying rje'i dbang gyur skyes bu che/ /'gro don dpag med 'grub kyang ngoms ma mchis/ /slar meng snying stobs go cha rab bgos te/ /'phrin las sde bzhi'i dpung gis dgo legs dgra/ /rgud pa'i dpung tshogs ma lus lhag med du/ /bcom pa'i grags pas srid pa'i khyon kun 'gengs/ /chos da/ pal zhing chodang bde chen chos sde sogs/ /ris med gnas la zhabs kyi ri mo bkod/ der gnas 'gro ba kun gyi shes rgyud la/ /thar ba'i sa bon bzhag pa'i dge mtshan rgyas/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos kyi char /chen dang / /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar longs phyes te/ /chos dang zang zing sbyin pa'i/char chen gyis/ /bstan/— 'gro bskyangs pa'i ngo mtshar dpag par dka'/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las gong sa skyabs mgon 241

mchog sogs snod ldan gyi gdul bya rnams lajidabang lung man ngag/gi char phub /khyung phyogs ris med du zhabs kyis bcag ste chos dang zang zing gi char phab pa'i sarna ste ba cu gnyis pa'o/ / ri gechos zhe du mar zhabs bskyod de 'gro ba du ma dbugs dbyung rko zhing pa chen sku phreng dgu bas kyang zhabs la gcugs zhing phan tshun dam chos gsan pa'i sarga/ 'jigs chen dgra las rgyal ba'i dpa' skad kyis/ /mtha' med khyon kun 'gengs pa'i dpa' bo che/ /'phrin las 'od dkar rgya mtsho la 'khu ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma slar yang gtsug gis mchod/ /ji srid sems can khams rnams ma zad par/ /de srid 'phrin las lha chu'i rgyun bzhin du/ /'bab pa'i gsung dzimadzad pa mchog de yis/ /n+destan 'gro bskyangs pa'i mdza da bzang brjod par bya/ / 5 ne+e dgurkeng thangs re drug pa rab cirgyal— lcags mo lug gi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes bcu dgu nas sa lugs 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang / rim lnga’gsal sgron gyi bshad lung / blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid rnams gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis nas blo sbyong tshigs brgyad ma/ blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/242

lha snying bo don gsum rnams kyi khrid/ lam rim bsdus donagasdong rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung / bcu gcig nas nyin bzhirogasang 'dus bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung / de nas rim par thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/ spyag rdor 'khor chen lha bco brgyad/ bde mchog nag po spyod pa lha re gnyis/'jam rdor lha bcu dgu 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu/ 'di skabs bla ma byams pa rin po che'i 'jam rdor dbang chog gzhir byas kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs slob ma rdo rje soms dpa' yum bcas su bskyedasapa gnang /— kye rdor lha dgu'i dbang bcas bstsal/ khong rin po che nyid kyi gsung rtsom 5la che ra gyi lung dang spyod 'jug 'grel ba lam bzang gsal ba'i rin dze sgron me'i bshad lung / sde khri rin po che'i mchan dang sbrags nas lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung / zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bcu dgu nag nyin gnyis la lam rim glang smyon 'dul ba'i lcags myu'i bshad lung / 'grel ba don gsal sdudachapa dang sbyar ba dang phar phyin mchan 'grel rtsom 'phro'i bshad lungar mas gnangaka zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis nas legs bshad snying tho'i bshad lung / bco lnga nas nyin dgur lam rim tshen mo 'i bshad lung gnang / nyer lnga nas nyin gsum la rje'i bstod pa do na 2na ma rtsa 'grel gyi 4 243

bshad lung / zla ba bdun pa'i bcu bdun nas nyin dgur grub mtha' mo phyo'agrel gyi bshad lung / nyer drug nas 'khor chen/ bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig rnams kyi dbang / zlawā dgu ba'i tshes bdun nas mthong brgyud zin bris steng nas rab gnas kyi khrid/ khrid yig rdo lag brgyud ma lag rjes dang bcas pa'i khrid/ skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma sogs kyi khrid mang —bo gnang ba dang dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ma'i 'pho khrid bcas gnang / —dgung grangs re bdun pa rab rgyal chu pho sprel gyi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes bcu bdun nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum gyi lung gi dbu btsugs te lung skabs dang bstun nas gnang / bar skabs su bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang / snying bo don gsum gyi khrid sogs gnang nas bka' rgya ma dang bcas gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gi mjug zla ba gsum pa'i bco brgyad la grub/ bka' gdams gsung sgros thor bu'i lung yang bstsal/ nyer gnyis nas rgyo'i rgya'i kun spangs ri khrod pa rnams kyis zhus ngor gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi bde mchogaspyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi dbang / 'don cha'i lha44

skor bla ma byams pa rin po che'i 'jam rdor sgrub dkyil cha tshang /'jam pa'i dbyangs bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi bde mchog nag po spyod pa'i mngon rtogs/ rje zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung gi nag po ba'i mdun skyed bum pa dbang chog dang bcas kyi lung sogs dang klu dbang rgyal bo gtso 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang bcas bstsal/ zla ba bzhi ba'i zla mjug tu rdo sbis phyogs su phebs/ nyer brgyad la sta gon sngon du btang ste rim par 'jigs byed dpa' cig dpa' mo'i lugs kyi thugs—rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma dang lha mang ma gnyis/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ kun rig sman bla/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs lha so gnyis/ mgon po gur lha brgyad rnams kyi dbang dang grub rgyal tshe dbang rnams bstsal/ rjes gnang gi rim pa yang rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba/ seṅge'i sgra/ sgrol dkar bka' babs dgu ldan/ klu dbang rgyal bo/ / dzam dkar 'brug zhon lha lnga/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig yum bcas/ mgon po bar chad kun sel/ rnam sras ser chen lha dgu/ gur mgon/ zhal sgrub dus/ dam can srog gtad/ jo lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang 34bya

bcas bstsal/ rdodzāsbis gzhungasgyul gro 'jags drug —nas 'jags brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu tho'u khron stong gnyis dang nyis brgya gnang ste mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i bkod khyab zhib mol gnang ba dang rtog 'jug zhib mor gnang ste gang du bzhengs pa'i sar bkra shis gso sbyong gnang / zu ba lnga ba'i marī ngor slar rang dgon du phebs pa'i lam zhor la brag dkar gnas mjal kyang gnang / zla ba drug pa'i nyer dgu nas sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis dang gsugal 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang / tshes bzhi nas nyin bcu gnyis largyal mkhan sprul rin po ches zhus ngor sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ snur lugs rnam 'arngoms bcu gcig zhal/ mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum/ gung thang khri sdemachog sprul rin po ches zhus ngor 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i da bang sta gon dang bcas pa/ mgon po bar chad kun sel dang chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / dgu ba'i tshes gnyis la gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug tshes gsum la phyag rdor 'khor chen/ tshes bzhi la 'jam dpal gsang ldan lha nga dgu rnams kyi dbang / tshes lnga la dbyangs can ma dkar mo thun mong yin min gnyis kyi rjes gnang / dbyangs can ma 346

dmar mo'i sdes gnang yig rnying gi lung dang bcas pa tshos drugasgyu bdun brgyad rnams la rnam sras bka' bco lnga yongs rdzog sa gnang / bcu bzhi la bde mchog phu i pa lha re gnyis/ bco lnga la bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil/ bcu drug la bde mchog ngam rdzong snya/na brgyud kyi dbang rnams dang / bcu bdun nas nyin bdun la 'jigs byed bskyed rim chen mo rdzogs rim dang bcas pa'i bshad lung / nyer gnyis la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom lung gnang ba dang dbyangs can ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid dang sgrol dab/ra tshe khrid/ zla ba bcu ba'ing tshes gcig la grub rgyal tshe dbang / tshes drug nas sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum 'dod rgyal gsang sngags sgra ma gtogs yongs rdzogs bstsal/ gzhan yang lo 'dir rtso brag bka' 'bum gyi lung yang gnang / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nas sbas ne+ejon kun gsal gyi bshad lung gnang / chaske ske dgung grangs re brgyad pa rab rgyal chu mo bya'i lo'i zla ba dang bo'i nyer gcig nas sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sprags kyi rjes gnang / 'khor chen rjes gnang mtha' rten gtorodabang bcas/seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang / kun mkhyen gong ma'i khrid yig steng nas 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid sogs khrid 247

du ma gnang / de nas zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshis la sdi tsha ri khrod bkra shis sdings su phebs/ de nas 'jigs byed dpa' cig lha bcu gsum ma/ zhe dgu ma/ ro langs brgyad skor/gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyugabade mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud/ shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga sprags/ ni gu'i sgyu lus dbang mo che/ rngog dkyil bdun/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ khros nag lha lnga rnams kyi dbang dang gcod dbang 'ga' bcas gnang / slob ma rjes 'dzin dang sta gon sngon du btang nas dus 'khor dbang yongs rdzogs/ rdor dbyings/ kun rig dri med rnam gnyis/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum rnams kyi dbang dang rjes gnang gi rim pa la'ang rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs/ gser chos bzhi ba ku ru ku l+le phyi sgrub dang gsang sgrub lha lnga/ tshob/sa bdag 'dod rgyal/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ dmar ser/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang dmar mo/ drag po sum sgril/ mi g.yo ba dkar bo/seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum/ mgon po bar chad kun sel/chos rgyal phyi sgrub/ rnam sras ser chen lha dgu gong gnon dang 248

bcas pa/ lha mo/ dur bdag yab yum/ lcam sring rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid rgyas pa sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas ba gnang / thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ thig le bcu drugagator ma brgya rtsa/ me tog bcud len rnams kyi khrid/ lam rim bsdus don/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ lam gtso/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ legs bshad snying bo/ bla ma lnga bcu ba/ sbas don kun gsal/ rim lnga gsal sgron rnams kyi bshad lung / spyod 'jug chen mo/ bskal bzang rgyan 'phring / mdo sdud pa/ tshe mdo/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/ gsang 'dusadzhartsa rgyud rnams kyi lung dang gzhan yang lung thor bu mang bo gnang / de nas bya khyung theg chen yon tan dar rgyas gling du phyag phebs/ bde yangs bla brang du gra sgrig byas yod pas sku 'khor rnams der bzhugs/ khong rin po che gcig pu a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub phug tu bzhugs te nangs nub kun tu thugs dam la gzhol bar gyur/dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dbang gi nangs par cho ga sgrub skabs rgyab ri'i rtser 'ja' tshon dkar bo brkyangs pa'i 'og tu 'ja' kha dog sna lnga zlum por yod pa shar ba dang khong der phebs ma thag gser gdung la mjal zhu gnang skabs glor bur du rlung 'tshub 249

drag po 'khyug pa sogs gsor gdung las bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i ltas rnams mngon du gyur/ mjal ba bkag na bdud rtsi mang bo 'bab nges mod khong gi zhal nas rgyang ring bo nas 'ongs pa tsho snying re rje 'gog mi dgospogasungs pas mjal 'grul ma bkag stabs mis rgyu 'grul mang rkyen ma bab/ 'on kyang ltas ya mtshan pa byung bas de ka'i bla grwa dag dga' drags te mkhan sa nyin shas yin rung 'dzin dgos kyi zhu ba che nan phul/ khong gis gsungs pa/ gdan sa 'dzin na rang dgon gyi gdan rabs lnga bcu ba rje bla ma'i sprul ba 'byung bar gsungs pa de ka'i ming thob pas de 'dzin dgos rgyu la de 'dra'i rigs la zhe sun che bas ma bzung /'di nas kyang de 'o zob mi byed ces bzlog par mdzad mod khorīng rnams kyis nan tan chen po'i zhus pas zhal gyis mi bzhes thabs med byung ba lta bus chos rje don 'grub rin chen gyi khri 'phangs mthon por gding ba gsar ba bting ste khrir phebs nas khri 'don gnang ste chos bka' du ma gnang / gro mo ri zhi'i zhabs drung bas brtan bzhugs bshad pa dang bcas dgon gzhung nas dngul srang brgya/ gos phrug brgya sogs dngos po sna tshogs pa'i 'bul ba btegs/ grwa tshang thams cad kyis kyang ci 'byor gyi 'bul ba dang bcas mjal kha gnang / 'bul ba'i dngos rdzas rnams phyi 250

nyin dge 'dun tshogs par sku 'gyed du phul/ 'gyed tshan gnyis bsdoms par dge 'dun re rer khron bdun re babs/ de nas phebs zhor mchod rten skas dgon du 'jigs byed kyi dbang sogs chos bka' 'ga' gnang ste sku 'bum byams pa gling du phya ga phebs/ sku 'bum du gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma/ dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma/ bde mchog nag po spyod pa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi dbang / grub rgyal tshe dbang / bu ston gong khug ma'i dbang / rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang / sman bla rigs bsdus kyi rjes gnang / mgon po bar chad kun sel dang mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang / grub mtha' rtsa ba/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ rta mchog rol ba'i zhal lung / khong nyid kyi gsung gi gshed dmar rgyun 'khyer rnams kyi lung bstsal/ ra dge'i ri khrod du phebs nas mi tra'i nang tshan sgrol ma nyer gcig dang rdor sems sgom bzlas/ rdor sems lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / rgyal dbang bdun pa'i gsung gi de'i sgrub thabs dang mdun bskyed bum pa bdag 'jug smon shis bla brgyud gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i lung dang dbal mang gsung sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub dkyil yid bzhin dbang rgyal dang khong rang nyid kyi gsung gi rig pa'i dbang lnga'i bshad sbyor ma li ka'i 'phreng 351

mjos/ dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil lhan thabs mu tig 'phreng mdzes rnams kyi lung bstsal/ de nas gro tshang dgon du phyag phebs bde lam gyi khrid/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs lha so gnyis/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang dpa' cig rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ kun rig thugs rje chen po rnams kyi dbang /rigs gsum spyi sgrub dang mgon chos lha mo rnams kyi dbang /lung kha shas bcas gnang ste gro tshang rdo rje 'chang zhes grags pa'i sku brnyan chen po'i mdun du mchod mjal du phebs/ der tshogs mang la sems bskyod mchod pa gnang / lcags mkhar gyi 'don sgrig dang thig rtsa sogs la gsung bkod zhib gsal dang 'jigs byed bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i khrid dang lung yang gnang / de nas dug kyā dgon par phyag phebs/ der kun rig gi dbang dang gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring gi rjes gnang bstsal te bstan 'gro spyi'i zhabs rim du lcam sring gtor sgrub 'dzugs dgos tshul bkod khyab zhib rgyas gnang ba ltar phyis shel dgon gyi bskal bzang rgya mtsho mngags te legs par btsugs/ de nas rim par bgrod de bcu gcig nyin lung ba'i phu nas zhag mal byas te phyi nyin drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nangs par lam thog nas sgo mo lha brag dang shel dgon phyogs la mjal bar kha dog sna tshogs pa'i ཿbyalha

rngo'aja' tshon du ma dang sprin dkar cher 'khrugs pa'i go bar phyes nas lha brag dang shel dgon phyogs gsal bar gzigs pas de phyogs su phyag 'bul ba sogs mdzad nas phyir gdan sar phebs te gdan sa'i bzhugs spyil du 'byor nas zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes nang tshe gcig nyams len gyi khrid/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal zhal lung khrid yig steng nas 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid gnang / 'khor chen dbang yang bstsal/ zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu nas nyin gsum la lho brag snyan brgyud kyi rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ nyi shu la sta gon sngon du btang nas rdog dkyil bdun gyi dbang / sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ zla bcu ba'i tshes dgu nas nyin drug la gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid sogs mang du bstsal/chidagung grangs re dgu ba rab rgyal shing pho khyi'i lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes bcu gcig la grub rgyal tshe dbang / 'od dpag med la brten pa'i 'pho khrid/ 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum gyi lung rnams bstsal/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang / bde mchog rim gnyis kyi dmar khrid sogs ri 253

7 bstsal te shing le khar phebs/ de nas skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ lam rim bde lam gyi khrid gnang / sta gon sngon du 'gro bas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang dpa' cig gur lha brgyad ma/ tha/dugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma/ bcu gcig zhal lha lnga rnams kyi dbang / slob ma rjes 'dzin dang sta sdon sngon du btang nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen yongs rdzogs gnang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub/'jam dbyangs nā ga rar+sha/ mgon chos lha mo gsum/ gur zhal ba/nyis/ lcam sring / legs ldan mched gsum rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang du ma/ sher snying / gdugs dkar mchog grub ma/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ gung thang rin po che'i gsung gi khyung khra'i las tshogs dang nā ga rak+ka'i bum chog a khu rin po che'i gsung dang paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung gi sham bha la'i smon lam dang bla mchod sogs kyi lung bstsal/ de nas phyugs ri'i dgon dang bis thang la kha'i sgar sogs brgyud de kwa ring dgon du 'byor/ lam rim nyams mgur gyi bshad lung /theg chen gso sbyong / 'jigs byed dpa' cig bcu gcig zhal lha lnga/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma rnams kyi dbang /legs ldan mched gsum dang chos rgyal phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang /254

skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ bla mchod/ gdugs dkar mchog grub ma/ gung thang rin po ches bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi nā ga rak+ka'i bum chog khong rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i smyung gnas kyi phan yon mdor bsdus/ smon lam drugabyams smon/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma sogs kyi lung bstsal/khong gi zhal nasacirgyang ring nas pha gzhis mthong ba na ka bzhi gdung brgyad kyi rjes su song 'dug pas yid pham zhes —gsungs shing ngag dbang bkra shis tshang dang mnyam du skyo ba skyes pa'i zhal 'altos mang bo gnang zhing mthar khong gis gros rimago bton te 'khrungs gzhis kyi shul du mchod rten rmang gzhi 'dom phyed dang brgyad yod pa bzhengs/ khong rin po che rang nyid nas so nyid slob bu blo gros rgya mtsho zer ba bskul te dngul sgor chig stong drug rdzobargya'i yon gyis nyi bla zar tshags kyis brgyan cing nang rten dang gzungs dang glegs bam sku brnyan byin can sogs mang du bzhugs/ — rab gnas gyi skabs mkha' la sprin dkar ling ling mang bo dkrigs pa'i bar du 'ja' tshon gyis sprel ba sogs ltas ngo mtshar ba mthong skabs mang mang sgodaga' dad ches cher rgyas/de nas bis mdo dgon du phyag phebs/ der legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung / 'grel ba don gsal mdo sdud pa dang sbyar 255

ba'i bshad lung / 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i bshad lung / byin rlabs spung zhus kyi khrid/ bde lam gyi khrid/ gdugs dkar gyi dbang /legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang / gur mgon khang du de ka'i mgon khang ba rnams kyis zhus ngor mgon khang nang nas dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po khro bcu'i bskor ba'i rjes gnang dang rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i gsung gi gur gyi gtor chog khong rang nyid kyi gsung gi gur gyi 'phrin bcol dang gsol 'debs mtshan sngags dang bcas pa'i lung bstsal/ de nas shel dgon chos kyi pho brang du phebs/ mar ngo'i tshes bcu la bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bdag 'jug blangs/ de skabs khong gis gsungs pa/ yid gting nas 'khul ba zhig byung bas bcom ldan 'daspodapal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la gdung ba'i yus kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur dbyangs shig gsar spel byas zhes gsungs/ gnas khang nang du mar me brgya phul/ nub re bzhin gnas khang du mar me chad med gnang / a rol sprul ba'i sku rin po ches gtsos reb kong ri khrod pa spyi'i zhus ngor sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung gnang / sngar nas yang yang gsol ba btab kyang zhal nas reb kong phyogs shig nas stabs 'grig yong zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'di skabs thugs dgyes bzhin rngog dkyil 356

bdun gyi dbang yongs rdzogs sta gon bcas gnang zhing sngar dus 'khor dbang gi skabs lhag gnas byas pa'i rdor dril kyang bstsal/shel dgon spyi'i zhus ngor bzhi ba'i mar ngo'i tshes bcur rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi rtse mo bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bde mchog lha re gnyis can gyi dbang bskur te mjug tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug ldan du rol/ nangs par cho ga sgrub skabs gnas ri'i rtse mor 'ja' tshon shar ba dang tshogs gtor las bdud rtsi bab pa sogs legs pa'i ltas dang mtshan ma mang bo byung / tshogs phud gnas khang du bskyal/ gzhan yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma na ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid chos nyid ngo ston gyi byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ ris/sa gsum spyi sgrub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ tshe gcig nyams len gyi bshad khrid rgyas pa/ lam gtso'i khrid/ dbyangs can ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid/ thog ma'i blo sbyong gi lung / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi len tshul rje ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i mdzad pa dang de'i zur 'debs sgo mang rin po ches mdzad pa'i lung / sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung gi dbu btsugs/ 'phro ma phyis su yong zhes phebs/ de nas dkyil 'khor sgar du zhabs bskyod/ sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdul tshon gyi 357

dkyil 'khol du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma dang bde mchog lha re gnyis kyi dbang / thugs rje chen po/ khyung khra/ mgon po/ chos rgyal rnams kyi rjes gnang / gcod dbang / gdugs dkar mchog grub ma'i lung bcas bstsal te rdo sbis saphebs/ dopal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gsar bskrun la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas lhag gnas kyi me tog 'thor te byin rlabs kyi gter du brusgrubs/ lung kha shas gnang / de nas se chang dgon du phebs/ de kar chos grwa gsar tshugs gnang ste 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad lung gi dbu btsugs pa dang mnyam du char bab pas legs lam ngo mtshar ba byung / sngon chad bca' yig med pas bca' yig gsar 'arjog gnangari zhing 'chad nyan rgyun ring dulke skyong ched 'grel chedz+wa gyi dpe zhig kyang sbyor 'jags mdzad/ slar dkyil 'khor dgon du phyag 'byor byung ste 'grel ba bzhi sgrags kyi dbu nas chos thun gcig gnang ste chos grwa gsar bar zhal gso gnang nas slar rang dgon du phebs te kun mekhyen gsung 'bum gyi lung dang dbu ma'i dgag bya ngos 'dzin gyi bshad lung sogs gnang / dgung grangs budun cu ba rab rgyal shing mo phag gi lo la jo lugs tshe dbang / sengardzildeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang / stog 258

phu'ilhal ma phyi nang gnyis kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang rjes gnang / kun rig dang bde mchog lohu ba gnyis kyi dbang /gcod dbang / bla med rdor sems dang rdor sems yab rkyang /ras chung lugs kyi srung mkhar rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khri da/4 rdor sems sgom bzlas dang thu na drug rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ bla brang nang du skyabs mgon mchog la grub rgyal tshe dbang gis dbu btsugs te 'jigs byed bskyed rim mo'i bshad lung / gsang 'dus bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung / sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung / sbyin srig dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung / rtsa tshig gi khrid/ rwa pod dang dpal pod gnyis kyi lung / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang rngog dkyil bdun gyi dbang rnams gnang / rang shag nas 'jam lugs tshe dbang gis dbu brtsams te bde mchog lca i pa/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig snyan brgyud zhi drag dbang / chi stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang gi dbang lung dang bcas pa/ kun rig gi dbang lung dang bcas/ 'ujam dpal zhal phung gi khrid/ snying bo don gsum gyi khrid/ blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i bshad lung /lam gtso'i khrid// seng ldeja nags sgrolha gyi rjes gnang / 'jam 259

dkar las tshogs kyi khrid/ rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi khrid/thun drug rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ rdor sems yab rkyang dang yum bcas kyi rjes gnang / phyag rdor gtum chen gyi rjes gnang /stag tshang lha mo tshul khrims zhes pa'i bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes grags can des zhus ngor thu'u bkwan gsung mkha' spyod chos sbyor dang mkha' spyod be+e'u bum gyi lung / bka' 'gyur gyi dbu btsugs te mdo sde bskal bzang dang rgya cher rol ba'i lung bstsal/ sngon chad rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing byi lor gyi paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng dgu ba blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo rgya nag tu chibs bskyod skabs bla ma rin po che 'di nyid kyi zhal snga las bka' chos 'ga' gsan bzhed kyis lan gru nas gdan 'dren gyi bka' shog gnang byung yang bla ma rin po che 'di bas dus rtag tu khengs skyungs gnang stabs cha gang thad nas bdag de lta bu'i 'os su mi 'dug gsungs shing / khyad par skyabs mgon gong ma rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gi gsung las phyogs gzhan du yengs ma lam la phyin pa bas rang dgon 'dir 'chad spel re thub na legs zhes phebs pa thugs la bzhag nas dgongs zhus kyi gsung shog phul nas zhal gyis ma bzhes/ de rjes slar yang sog 260

yul nas gsung shog 'byor bar skyabs mgon bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gi gsung de dgongs pa gzhan du bkral te dbang khrid gang dgos kyi tho dang bcas bka' lung rgya can tsha nan che ba phebs/ 'di'i skabs kyi phan tshun gnang ba'i chab shog snga phyi dag ni bla ma rin po che 'di nyid kyi gsung 'bum khrod kyi chab shog skor du bzhugs 'dug paṇa chen rin po che sku 'bum du phebs nas yang gdan 'dren pa slebs te khal rta'i 'u lag tshun chad bsgrig bkod kyis gsung 'phrine bcas bstsal bas sku 'bum du/ phebs dgos byung / lo de'i zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu drug gi nyin gdan sa nas sku btegs te zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la zhong shan du 'byor/ der zhong shan lha chen la bzang gos yug gnyis las grub pa'i snam sbyar khyad 'phags/ dngul gyi 'khor lo 'phreng rgyan zar tshags can dang gzhan spos dmar gyi mgul phreng sogs phul te bsngo smon gnang / der zhag bzhugs gnang nas phyi nyin nangs par sdi tshar phebs/ gsar bzhengs kyi gos sku gnyis la rab gnas gnang / de'i phyi nyin tshes gsum la sku 'bum du 'byor/ tshes bzhi la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang zhal mjal te phan tshun bkur bzos dang dgyes gzigs bla na med pa mdzad/ khong gis paṇa chen rin po che la sham bha la'i smon lam 261

dpadzildan dang bo ma'i lung zhig zhus parom 'ongs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye zhes gsung gnang dang bcas lung bstsal/ paṇa chen mchog gi zhal nas bka' chos zhu dgos kyi skor 9'di tsho yin/ rim gyis gzigs rtogs mdzod dang nga re zhig gser dgon du rib tsam phyin nas 'byon zhes gsung phebs/lo der char zhod tshe stabs paṇa chen rin po che zla ba gcig lhag tsam 'gyangs pa'i shul nas phyogs yas mas dang sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bla grwa kha shas la bzhed bstun gyi chos bka' mang du rka gnang ba yin te lam rim glang smyon 'dul ba'i lcags kyu/ gsang 'dus bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho'i khrid/ rje'i bstod 'grel mo/ sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho/ blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rnams kyi bshad lung / a lags mi nyag tshang gis zhus ngor lagarim bde lam gyi khrid rgyas pa nyin bcu bdun dang —/ bla ma mchod pa dang phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid nyin lnga/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i las tshogs/ klu'i bum gter/ lo gyon ma'i las tshogs/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bskyed rdzogs/ bsnyen sgrub sprags ma/ las bzhi'i drug cu ba/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum/ tshe gcig nyams len/ lam rim bsdus don/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed 262

rdzo rdzogs rna mas gyi khrid/ snga phyir grub rgyal tshe dbang tshar gsum/'jam lugs tshe dbang / stag phu'iḥsgrol ma phyi nang gi dab nga /bde mchog tsho i pa/ bde mchog dril bu lha lnga dang lus dkyil rnams kyi dbang / drag po sum dril/ bla mgon dakhyer ṣ+kad/sman bla rigs bsdus/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ dmag zor ma/ rgyal bo sku lnga/ gnod sbyin tse'u dmar bo rnams kyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam rim/ shar ba'i lom rim/tso dwags po sgom chen gyi lam rim/ kun mkhyen snga phyi'i yi dam sgrub skor/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgyung gnas rnams kyi lung / snga phyir pasnyen rdzogs lan gnyis dang dgejitshul mang bo bsgrubs/ —paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa zla ba bdun pa'i nyi shu'i nyin char chu dang 'dam gyis lam mer gyis gang ba'i nang du bka' chos thugs bzhed che ba'i dbang girtswagashed du 'jam dbyangs sgar bar phyag phebs gnang ste bka' chosamyizhus pa la mgon po'i besnye bum gyi dbu btsugs te yongs rdzogs dpe ris dang bcas pa shanang / de rjes paṇa chen mchog nas thugs khom skabs nam yod du zhalatsho bzhi ba'i be+e'u bum phyi ma bcasagasan bzhes mdzad/ ri paṇa chen mchog gi zhal nas nga rang rgyu yul sogs phyogs med 'grims pas grib kyis gnod pa lha63

chis shin tu che bas rdo rje rnam 'dzoms kyi bum sgrub byabs khrus dgos tshul phebs gnang bzhin zhus shing tshe sgrub kyang phul/ zhes gsungs/ bka' chos gsan bzhes kyi skabs shig mdo smad lhorgyud du go gung 'khrug pa'i gtam 'ur ba la brtag pa dgos tshul phebs par brtag pa gnang ste rim gro'ang kha shas phab/ paṇa 7chen mchog gis lha mo'i drag po'i gtor chen dgos gsung gnang bzhin khong gis rtse'i mgon khang ba kha shas bcas gtor chen kyang bsgrubs/ yang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/yar lam tshor yang gtor chen 'di yang bskyar sgrub dgos par shar bas lag len ngos po zhig dgos gsungs pa bzhin khong gis yan lag laṅga bri sgrub sogs be'u bum dang bsnan lag len yang dag cig kyang gnang / yang bar mtshams shig mgon po'i srog 'khor gsar ba bstan te gzhung dang mthun min zhib 'jug gnang rogs gsungs byung / slad nas khong gis srog 'khor gsar bzhengs mdzad de rdzas byug pa/ skabs babs kyi spel tshig gsar bcug dang ngag 'don sgrig 'god gnang ste rgyal bstan spyi'i rim gror dmigs nas bris pas kyang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi bzhed pa legs par bskang bar mdzad do/ /zla ba dgu ba'i nyer gcig gi mtshan srod 'khor 264

tsam na khong paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gis dus 'khor slob dpon snyan gsan 'be+eb tu mngags te nangs par gser gdung mdun nas thams cad mkhyen pas dus 'khor bdag 'jug bzhes rgyu yin pas khyed spyang tshogs gral du phebs rogs gnang zhes phebs byung gsungs/ phyi nyin dgu ba'i nyer gnyis kyi nangs snga nga tsha grub tsam la rtse'i dbu mdzad gdan 'dren du byon/gser gdung chen mo'i mdun du byon pa la skabs shig rje 'di bas mar me'i skong bu che ba zhig paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag tu phul bar thugs smon rgyun ring du gnang nas phyir khong rin po che 'di ba'i phyag tu phul/ de skabs gzim dpon chen mo nas khong la khyed kyis mar me 'di la thugs smon nan tan mdzad rogs zhus/ khong rin po che 'di bas thugs smon gnang tshul ni khong gi zhal nas/ spyir sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyi byugs kyi bzhed pa gang yin 'grub pa dang / lhag par thams cad mkhyen pa rang gis thugs smon gang mdzad de 'grub par gyur cig snyam pas phul/ zhes gsungs/ gung thun la maṇ+ḍal gyi skabs paṇa chen mchog gis kha dar dkar ser 'dom gnyis lhag re dang mar me rkong bu che ba bcas rje 'di ba'i phyag tu gtad nas mchod rten gyi bum pa'i sgor phul la thugs smon mdzod ces 265
