gsungs pa ltar rje 'di bas thugs smon rgya chen po gnang / khong gi zhal nas/ 'dug gnas su 'khod nas bsam blo zhig btang bar dus phun sum tshogs pa ston pa bcomaphyoldan 'das lha las — bab pa'i dus cheno dang / gaspyos phunarmesum tshogs ba rje rgyal ba gnyis pa sku bltamagapa'i gnas dang / rten phun sum tshogs pa rgyal ba seṅge'i nga ro'i sku brnyan 'bum phrag mang bo bzhugs r+pā'i gser gyi mchod rten chen por thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal phye ste dbang bskur bzhes pas gsang sngagase zab mo'i byin rlabs dadzi 'brel rlabs chen thugs bskyed smon pa'i rgya mtsho dang gcig tu lad mo tsam yin yang nan tan gyis byed bcug pa rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon ring lugs dar rgyas yun ring gi ched yin nges la zhar la mtha' med ngan song gi gting rdo bdag 'khor ba mtha' can du bsgrubacho pa red snyam dga' dad shi na tu rgyas shing nam dran res kyis kyang byung / bka' drin de nyid stongajigasum gser gyis bkang ste phul yang gzhal nus min rang giyokyang bdog pa blos ci lcog gis shugs bskyed/ gser dgon nas phyir byon 'ephral lta bur dngos skyes dang bcas nub re bzhin mgon po'i gtor chung re thongs gsungs pa bzhin gtor chung nyer gcig re ma chad par byas zhes 266

gsungs/ 'dir smras pa/ mtha' yas gsang gsum rol ba dpag med las/ /mtha' 'khob zhing 'dir 'phrin las 'bum shar te/ /mtha' med 'gro ba'i rgud pa nyer bcom nas/ /mtha' dag bstan pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtser bsgrongs/ /mdzad mchog gsung gi 'od dang chabs cig tu/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin 'od stong gis/ /sa chen yongs su khyab pa'i snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /'jig rten gsum du grags pa'i dpal yon 'bar//lum+bi'i dga' tshal gnyis pa byams gling dang / /shar phyogs dpa' bo'i gdan sa bya khyung sogs/ /chos sde du mar zhabs skyes bkra shis rdul/ /bkod de 'gro ba dpag med dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /khyad par chos kyi rdo rje mi'i zlos gar/ /paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba thams cad mkhyen/ /blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma yis/ /gang gi zhabs la gtugs te zab rgyas kyi/ / chos tshul du ma gsan pa'i dga' ston la/ /yi dam lha yis shis brjod tshome tog 'thor/ /dam pa rnam gnyis phan tshun dam chos kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' stobs pa'i dga' sto na rgyas/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzakhu bo'i rnam par thar ba dad 267

pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las chos sde du mar zhabs bskyod de 'gro ba du ma dbugs dbyung zhing paṇa chen sku phring dgu bas kyang zhabs la gtugs shing phan tshun dam chos gsan pa'i sarga ste bcu gsum pa'o/ / bstan don blabs chen mdzad bzhin pa dang chabs cigle par+ṣa chen mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu shar ri'i rtser drangs te mdzad 'azin 'od brgya'i sgo sges pa'i sarga/'jigs bral rdo rje'i khri la zhabs bkod de/ /mtha' med 'gro rnams mdzad 'phrin dpag med kyis/ /zhi ba'i las dang bde chen sar 'god pa'i/ /gdams pa'i rgya mtsho de yis skyongs gyur cig /'khor ba ji srid bar du 'phrin las ni/ /rgyun mi chad par gsungs bzhin sngar rgyun bzhin/ /mdzad 'phrin bsam las 'das pa'i cha 'ga' zhig /rang blo'i dpag tshod tsam zhig brjod par bya/ /de nas khong gi thugs la dgun gyi bar du sku 'bum du lus na dgun lhag pa che bas lam bar du bgrod dka' bar dgongs nas de lugs paṇa chen mchog la zhus par paṇa chen mchog nas gser sbyangs kyi 'khor lo zhig phul te bzhugs dang chos zhu rgyu yod ces gsungs/ de rjes zhabs sdod 268

pa kun gyis byang sde la chibs sgyur gyi grabs byed kyin 'dug stabs khong gis yang bskyar gzims chen brgyud de sngar ltar zhus pas paṇa chen mchog gis lam bar gyi na bza'/ lam chas kyi dngul/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku brnyan li ma/gser srang du ma dang dngul rdo tshad kha shas/ gos phrug ras sogs dngos 'bul spam mtho bar bstsal ba dang sku 'khor rnams la'ang dngul dang gos phrug ras sogs gnang cha mang bo bstsal te thugs dgongs ltar phebs cho ga pa'i bka' gsung gnang /de nas zla ba bcu ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la chibs bsgyur gnang ste ji tshar phyag 'byor/ nyin gcig la der bzhugs nas khong gis gsar du brtsams pa'i rdor sems lha bcu bdun ma'i sbyin sreg gi lung sogs gnang / de'i phyi nyin di tsha'i dpon tshang du phyag phebs gnang / lam nas sngar gos sku bzhengs pa'i lhag 'phro sgor brgya yod pa brtson 'grus kyi lag tu bzhag nas gsang sngags bde chen du rje yab sras gsum gyi sku bzhengs rgyu byas/ lhag mas dgon pa'i mdun gyi rten phur sogs kyi ched mchod rten zhig bzhengs rgyu'i gnyer nang so mgon po tshe ring dang dge bshes gsung rab la bcol/ de nas bya khyung du phebs/ der lam gtso'i khrid/ mgon po gur gyi gtor chog gi lung sogs lung kha lha69

shas gnang / bya khyung las sne rnams kyis nan tan gyis zhus pa'i ngag ma bzlog par bco lnga'i nyinader bzhugs/dzo gure gyi 'phrin bcol sogs gsar rtsom gnang / mgon khang sosnyesor khrus gsol sogs gnang nas gser gdung bskyar gso 'i ched zan bsgyur gnang bas bskyar gso legs tshul bab/ de'i thebs su dngul srang bzhi bcu zhe gsum bzhag pa dang / tshogs mang la mang ja gsum dang sku 'gyed dong tse khron re phul/ tshes bcu bdun la lwa mo'i mgud rnam rgyal gling nas lam rim bsdus don sogs lung kha yar gnang / rten rnams la zhib mjal dang tshogs la sku 'gyed kyang gnang / bco brgyad4la bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum sogs bzhugs gnas byin chags pa lo rdo rje brag tu phebs/ sgrub khang der bkra shis gso sbyong byas par 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal grangs dang mthun pa byung bas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas gnang ba'i shub pa gnas brtan bcu drug gdan 'dren pa dang / 'dul ṭīka rin chen 'phreng ba dang lam rim 'bul mi byung ba sogs rten 'brel legs lam che ba byung / gnas der bde mchog skor dang mdo gdugs sgrol ma sogs kyi lung ‘ dang / mkhan chen zhi 'tsho dang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gnyis kyi sku brnyan mi tshad lhag tsam bzhengs rgyu'i bkod khyab 270

dang / de'i thebs su dngul sgor brgya gnang / 'dul ṭīka rin chen 'phreng ba'i dpe de gzungs 'jug tu phul/ phyi'i nangs par snang ra'i dpon tshang du phebs/ der zhag gnyis la bzhugs/dpon rang gi rgyab rten du mchod rten che ba zhig bzhengs rgyu'i gsung bkod dang de bzhengasu sa'i sar gzigs/ mdo gdugs/tshe mdo/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ sgrol dkar sogs kyi lung gnang / ko'u ba dgon gyis byin rten dang 'chad nyan 'phel ba'i g.yang 'bod dgos tshul zhus pa ltar gsar rtsom gnang / bde chen pa rnams kyi dus ngan mi ngan gyi bya byed log pa la tshad 'dzin mi nyung ba gnang bas bla ma grwa ba su'i thad nasaci phyin chad de 'dra mi byed pa'i bro bor ba'i dpang por gser khang dam can bzhag nas bde chen— du phebs rgyu zhal gyis bzhes te pha nyer gcig la phyag—phebs gnang / der tshems bu dmar khrid dang 'dul sdom sogs lung kha shas gnang / nyer lnga la spangaci dkar thad du chibs bsgyur/ de kar rje'i sku brnyan bkra shis do kha mar rab gnas gnang ba dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid mdor gasdus re dang tshems bu dmar khrid sogs gnang / yang tā kha re'i sku 'gyed kyang gnang / de nas phebs te glang gya'i bsan/ gtan tshang du zhag bzhugs gnang /271

dpon tshang gis gdan 'dren nan tan zhus pa bzhin phebs te khyim gzhir bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor/ de nas phebs te nyer bdun la mgar rtse dgon du 'byor/ der yang rje la brten pa'i sgrib sbyong bya tshul/ sher snying / gdugs dkar/ tshe mdo sogs kyi lung / mang ja'i steng du sku 'gyed yang tā kha phyed re/gzhan yang shel dgon sogs dgon pa gzhan dag la'ang sku 'gyed yang tā kha phyed re gnang ba dang tho rgya'i bod skor la yang tā kha bco lnga gnang / 'di yan gar phebs la bsu ba ser 'phreng sogs yod/ 'di nas bsu ba ser 'phreng sogs ci yang med par rang dgon du bab/ de nas gdan sa 'dir bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang dang rgyan 'jug sogs kyi lung gnangardzo/zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga nas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ dpa' cig gi dbang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs bka' chos mang bo bstsal to/ / dgung grangs don gcig pa rab rgyal me pho byi ba'i lo la thugs rje chen po'i dbang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ khyung khra/— sgrol dkar/ seng gdong ma/ dam can rnams kyi rjes gnang / lamagyigatso'i khrid/ stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed kyi bshad lung /'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dbang / sngags rim chen mo'i 272

bshad lung / mi rtog bcud len gyi khrid/ lam rim bde lam gyi khrid/ ko'u ba sprul skus zhus ngor 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi bshad lung / rdo rje rnam 'joms/ lha mo shra ma ṇa/ khyung khra/lha mo/ seng gdong ma rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung nyin gsum la gnang / 'jigs byed bsnyen khrid/ lam mchog snying bo'i khrid/ bde mchog gi dbang /gcod dbang zhi drag gnyis kyang bstsal/ zla ba bzhi ba'i nyer lnga la snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdan sa po dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du phebs pa la rje 'di ba— phebs nas mjal kha zhus shing phyi nyin nangs snga bar nang mjal thog gsung gleng dmar zhing rje 'di bas paṇa chen mchog la rje 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis par dus 'khor sbyor drug dang sbyar ba'i bstod pa zung 'jug 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya brteka dag chos dbyings ma'i lung zhus pas de ma thag tu gnang / rje 'di ba la paṇa chen sku 'khor nang ma dngul chu sprul skus zhus ngor ske 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad lung gnang / mtshan zhabs dka' chenarmebasod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kyis zhus ngor dbyangs can sgra ṭīka gi bshad lung dag/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel gyi bshad lung bstsal/ paṇa chen thams 273

cad mkhyen pas slar yang bka' chos zhus par zhing skyong dgyes pa'i mchod sprin ltar zhal gyi be'u bum nang ma/ dkar chag gis ma zin pa'i skor dpe ris dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs/— demag zor ma'i be'u bum cha tshang / phyag drug pa'i be'u burma rnams kyi lung / snying zhugs rab gnas dang bcas pa rnams kyi khrid/ pha dam pa'i mkhyud spyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi lung / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed dzogs kyi khrid/ smad rgyud pa'i khrid brgyad kyi zab khrid rnamaso phul/ lo der zhu ba so so'i 'dod molge ltar 'jam dpal gsang sden gyi dbang / sa lugs 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang / sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ dzad+ngham dmar srog sgrub/ g.yu thog sman dbadz+wa / gur mgon mal lugs lha brgyad/ mgon po bar chad kun sel/dmag zor ma/ lha mo 'od chen 'bar ma rnams kyi rjes gnang /tse'u dmar srog gtad rnams bstsal/ be ru sprul skus zhus ngor mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang / bla mchod dang phya gi tsheno sbragagapa'i khrid rgyas pa/ blosbyong tshigs brgyad ma dganyi ma'i 'od zer gnyis kyi khrid/ rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid rnams gnangakalha mo'i tshul khrims zhes grags pa 'i dge bshes chen po de bas ri 3ba4

zhus ngorodus 'khor bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ smad rgyud khrid chen brgyad/ 'jam dpal 'i drag/ gi srung ba/ yi ge bzhi ba'i bsad bzlog 'jigs byed ser bo'i tshe khrid rnams bstsal/ ra phug gnyis su grags pa'i nang tshan dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po daskan ma chog bsam 'grub kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ sman pa grwa tshang gis— zhus ngo ra sman pa'i 'du khang nong du sta gon sngon du btang nas rta mgrin pad+ma gar dbang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa hodagu rnams kyi dbang / zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi rjes gnang / 'don cha'i skor lung rgyun gang yod cha tshang / hor gtsang gser khri sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhu sa ngor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsu/nga 'bum/ gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung 'bum/ da ben sa bka' 'bum gyi rdziglegs lung sogs mang du bstsa'// de skabs nushaṃ gcig mnarma lam du mi zhig gis zhing bkod kyi thang ga cig sprad/ gcig shos mchog sprul gyi rnam pha can byon legs khyad mtshar gcig bzhugs pa'i zur na bde mchog zhing bkod cig bzhugs pa mthong bas re zhig na gtso bo bde mchog de mkha' spyod ma'i skur gyur/ khyad mi 'dug snyam zhib tu mjal bar gtso mo'i khri'i g.yas zuru na rganar+shapo skra byi zhing 'gram lpags lha75

steng sma ra thar thor yod pa— lag tu dpe cha zhig bzung yod pa mthong bas sems la las bzangahobo khyod zhing 'dir skyes pa'i rgyu ga 'dra zhig yin nam snyam pa shar/ phyi nyin a mchog rin sho ches phyag yig cig gnang bar/ lags zur du gsol 'bras sngar sku tshe de la thos bsam sgom gsum dang bstan 'gro'i don hur thag gnang / rjes su de bzhin bgyid pas khong gi thugs la gang dgongs pa ltar du skye ba bzhes nges lags la bdag gis bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab ste nyid kyi thugs la gang ) dgongs pa ltar 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug smon pa bgyid nges lags pa zab yangs mkhyen pa'i klong du smin par zhu zhus lags/zhes phebs byung bas mdang gi rmi ltas de yang 'di yin 'dug snyam du dga' dad tshad med pa zhig skyes zhes gsungs/ yang khong gis dus rnam kun du khengs skyung sha stag gsungs pa yin gshis 'dir yang khong gi zhal nas/ phyis gsung de lwa zhib tu brtag na thos bsam sgom gsum dang bstan 'gro'i don hur thag byas na zhing khams gang 'dod du skyes chog pa'i shugs kyis rang sgo gang thad nas sems la de 'dra bcang rgyu med pas mi skye ba go snyam nas sems sdug tshad med skyes zhes khengs skyung mdzad mod khong rin po ches thos bsam sgom gsum dang bstan 'gro'i don 376

rlabase chen mdzad pa la sus kyang 'gran zla med pa zhig yin pa mngon sum gyis grub pa 'di lags pas gsung 'di drang don yin la nges pa'i don gong du gsungs pa ltar zhing gang 'dod du phebs bzhin pa yin no/ /khengs skyung gi tshig des thos bsam sgom gsum dang bstan 'gro'i don hur thag byes na dag zhing du skye thub pa dang / de ltar ma yin par rgyu med rkyen med kyi tshig gi smon pa tsam gyis skye mijithub par gdams pa yin no/ /zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin khong gis lu mo bde chen du rgyud grwa gsor 'dzugs kyi gsung bkod gnang ba dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi zhal thang khyad 'phags tsharardzogasu ma/ gsang 'dus kyi cho ga tshar nyi shu/ rnam rgyal bum pa las bum/ nang mchod ka pā li/ rdo dril lnga/ dril gdan dang maṇ+ḍal mchod rkong brgyad/ steng khermes gnyis/ dung chos gzungs rdor rnams gnang zhing ju ba drug pa'i tshes bzhir grwa grangs so gcinyis gsar 'tshogs byed rgyu'i gtor thebs dang / sku 'gyed la gos dar so lnga/ yang tā kha so lnga bcas bstsal/ phyis su zhal bkod ltar she la dgon grwa rigs bskal bzang rgya mtsho la d+nghagadangs debyangs rta 'dur phyag len so ga sa bslab bcug ste bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyi la 'khor sgrub mchod/ rab lha77

gnas dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'be+eb sogs btsugs te gsang chen bstan pa'i rmang gzhi brtan par gnang ba yin no/ /dgung grangs don gnyis pa rab rgyal me mo glang gi lo la khong gis sgyu ma'i nor rdzas rnams dbus gtsang gi chos sde sogs su mchod 'bul gyi thebs sogs kyi sgo nas bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gro nges pa byed dgos dgongs nas dngul brtsegs pa'i steng du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas gnang ba'i sgrol ma byin can bzhugs pa'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba'i mchod pa bshams te nyin bdun gyi ring la nyin rer thun bzhi gnang nas sgrol ma bsgrubs/nyin brgyad pa'i nangs par gtang rag grub pa dang khal 'gel ba dus mtshungs gnang / de ltar gnang ba'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs la brten nas thugs dgongs bzhin legs grub byung ste bod yul dbus gtsang rgya gar bal bo sogs kyi rten byin can gang bzhugs dang / sa skya/ dge ldan/ rnying ma/ bka' brgyud/ jo nang ste ris med kyi dge 'dun zhal grangs sum khri nyis stong nyis brgya don gsum la dngul zho bzhi re'i sku 'gyed dang / lha sa smon lam mo'i steng lo snga phyi gnyis la sku 'gyed zho re dang / bkra shis lhun por zho lnga re dang / yang bskyar sa skyar ṭaṃ ga re/ dwags po bshad sgrub gling du yang bskyar ṭaṃ ga re/37byi

'ol kha rdzing phyi'i byams par mchod pa sna lnga stong tshar re/ des mtshon rten so so'i spyan sngar mar me snyan shal gos dar 'dom phyed re sogs phul ba sogs kun bsdoms pas mar me khri lhagasnyan shal chig stong sum brgya phul ba dang / jo bo rin po cher zhal gser dang jo mdun nas snga phyir stong mchod tshar gnyis sogs legs par tshogrub ste thams cad bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo bar mdzad do/ /'on kyang khong gis dad 'bul chud ma zos pa'i lad mo tsam lags zhes khengs skyung gi gsung gnang 'dug zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes mgo nas lwa mo bde chen gyi rgyud grwa ba rnams la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/mgon chos kyi rjes gnang / tshogs 'don gyi cho ga'i skor/ bdag mdun bum gsum dang sa chog bdag 'jug smon shis klu chog dang bcas pa cha tshang / mgon chos kyi bskang gso cha lag dang bcas pa rnams kyi lung gan nga / kho tshe gur sgar ba rnams kyis zhus ngor gcod dbang dang gcod khrid/ gcod gzhung blo gros mig 'byed kyi bshad lung sogs dang / 'jigs byed dang gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / seng gdong ma/mgon po/ rnam sras rnams kyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/a lags karmas zhus ngor gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang / 'jam 279

dbyangs rgya mtshos zhus ngor rnam bshad dazhongs pa rab gsal gyi bshad lung rgyas par gnang nas mjug tu 'di khong a khu thug sa rje can de nyid kyis zhu ba po gzhan med par nyid kyi thugasastabazhe da kyis gnang ba'i skabs su thob pa yin pas da res 'chasno nyan byedadhergyu byung ba bskal ba bzang / phyin chad kyang khyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis 'jam mgo na rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad zla med pa 'di tsho rgyun mi 'chad par 'chad spel byed rgyu thugs la 'dzin dgos zhes bka' bstsal/ dge bshes bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos zhus ngor dpal gsang ba 'dusaci pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid smin rgya sa/ bla brang nang du skyabs mgon 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog la zung 'jug lag ba cang du gtong ba'i gdams pa 'phags lugs lha so gnyis pa'i smin byed bskyed rim dang grol byed rdzogs rim gyi dmar khrid/ gzhi gsum cho ga'i ba shad lung dang 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i bshad lung gnang / ri khrod pa zhig la 'jigs byed da pa' cig gi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ bsnyen gyi khrid lung dang bcas pa bstsal/ saltasprul sku sogs la 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang sogs dang bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i bcu cha rmo sogs de skor gyi lung gang yod cha tshang / brgya rtsa'i khrid bcasartso 280

bstsal/ gro tshang gis zhus ngor yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid dang tshes gcig nyams len gyi khrid/ dgon lung gi gsar bu zhig gis zhus ngor bla ma mchod pa dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ brgyadaristong ba'i lung / rag rgya'i sbyin pas zhus ngor ting nge 'dzin rgyal bo'i lung / smad sog cig gis zhus ngor sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / sman pa'i 'du khang du 'jigs byed gsar bzhengs kyi ched du dngul sgor bdun cu don lnga dang phrug dang dngul sogs gnang ba dang / mi 'khrugs pa'i sku brnyan brgya la dngul sgor nyis brgya drug cu/ khi lang kha lnga bcas gnang ba dang / dus 'khor thang sku che ba gcig la gser gsol ched dngul sgor sum cu/ gser shog nyis brgya bcas bstsal/ rin chen dar rgyas kyis zhus ngor sgrol ma'i chos skor kyi lung gnang / sman pa'i 'du khang du 'jigs byed sku brnyan la rab gnas/ de skabs skyabs mgon sku phreng lnga ba chen po dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing sar chibs bskyod kyi lam bar nas gnas tshul gyi phyag yig 'byor bas thugs dgyes nas bka' lan mgur ma zhig gnang ba chab shog skor du bzhugs yod 'dra/ lha chab kyi dge 'dun rnams la mgon po'i rjes gnang bstsal/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes ga cig la sa skyong mi'i 281

dbang bo wang kun dga' rab brtan gyis sngar nas yang yang bskul ba ltar sog por phebs/ tshes gnyis nas tshe gsum nyams len gyi khrid dang tshes bzhi dang lnga la dus 'khor gyi sa chog tshes drug nas byang chub bde lam gyi khrid/ tshes bcu bzhir sta gon bco lnga la byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ bcu drug la gong ma bzhi dang gong chen/ bcu bdun la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang bcas bstsal/ bco brgyad nas rim par gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ kun rigagadugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma rnams kyi dbang / rta mgrin/nā ga rar+sha/ mgon po/ chos rgyal rnams kyi rjes gnang / lha kha sprul skus zhus ngor bag tse'i rjes gnang bstsal/ bsgrub bya du ma bsnyen par rdzogs/ brgya rtsa'i khrid/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo dang dge ldan bstan 'bar ma'i bshad lung rnams gnang / nyer bzhir 'dus ri'i rtser zhag mal gnang / nangs par mkha' ngos 'ja' tshon gyis sprel bar nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig tu shar ba sogs ltas ngo mtshar ba mang dag byung / 'di skabs nyams mtshar lta bu'i mgur zhig kyang gsungs/ ri rtse der khri gsar rgyag byas pa'i steng nas lam rim bsdus don sogs kyi lung bstsal/ sngon kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas dngo/na pa gsar tshugs kyi 282

dbu brtsams sa der bkra shis gso sbyong gnang / grwa tshang gsar tshugs kyang gnang ste gsang sngags chos rdzong gling zhes pa'i ming 'dogs par mdzad/ lam rim chen mo'i dbu nas thun gcig bstsal/ lam rim mchan gcig ma'i dpe dang gaṇ+ḍi gcig dngul sgor brgya rnams spyi 'jog mdzad/ re zhig gur sgar byed rgyu dang thams cad kyis bslab khrims srung ba gzhir byas te 'dod chung chog shes kho nar gnas pa las grong chog 'grim pa dang / rnga rdung 7ra 'khrol sogs mi bya ba dang lo mtshams zla mtshams lta bu byas na legs tshul sogs bslab ston zhib rgyas bstsal te der bzhugs/spong ba pa rnams la yang tā kha re dang bsod nams kha dar re/chos nyan du phebs pa'i ser mo ba rnams la kha dar re gnang /sngar gyi dus 'khor dbang gi skabs kyi khri de'i steng du dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi lha yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa bon brkos te bzhugs su gsol ba'i srib rdul tshon gyi bye mas sdibs/ dus 'khor gyi rab gnas gnang nas gzugs bsgyur ma gnang bar bzhugs su gsol/ nad pa rnams kyis de la bskor ba byas pas nad sangs pa sogs byin rlabs mngon du gsal bar gyur/ bdun pa'i tshes gcig la uger phebs te wang 'khor bcas la rig byed ma'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes gsum nyin kho tsher gdan drangs pa ltar 38bye

phyag phebs gnang / phyi nyin kun la45sa 'brel dang mjal kha gnang / rim dzir phebs nas tshes bdun la dgospyotshosteng du 'byor/ so so'i 'do—da mos ltar tshe dbang / sgrol da—kor darnga (khyung khra'i rjes gnang bstsal/ spyi la khro rgyal gtsug —tor 'bar riba'i rjes gnang / bla mchod dang phyag chen sprags pa'i khrid/bdun pa'i bcu dgu nas de ka'i dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang du sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dbang /bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sngags btu/ — tshogs pa'i zhal 'don skor gyi lung yongs rdzogs/ mgon chos gnyis kyi rjes gnang bcas bstsal/ gzhan yang blo sbyong dorīn bdun ma'i khrid sogs gnang / blo ba bdu na pa'i nyer bdun la sku btegs te lam bar dus dmar dgon gsar la rab gnas dang bkod khyab gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la chos dpal zhing du phyag phebs/ 'jam dar re dang tho'u khron re'i 'gyed brtetang /tshes blorgyad la jo sku gdan drangs te jo khang gsar bsgrubs der bzhugs su gsol/ bcu gcig nas nyin gsum la dpal —gsang ba 'duse pa'i cho ga dang 'brel bar rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho'i charami'abe+eb ltar lhag gnas kyi me tog 'thor te skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bsgrubs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin lha khang 384

der mchod pa'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas sems bskyed mchod pa byas/ phyi nyin nas nyin gnyis la bsgrub bya mang po bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong dang dge tshul gyi bslab pa la bkod/ sta gon dang bcas 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa dang bcu gsum ma/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma rnams kyi dbang / rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / sgrorme dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / rang spyil bde chen 'od gsal du thar chen gyi lung / yo na tan gzhir gyur ma dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ bde lam gyi khrid mdor bsdus/ lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi dbu tshugs tsam byas/ lo snga phyir sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs pa'i tho rags rim tsam ni/ bka' bstan co dpar cha tshang / byams pa'i gos thang /gnas bcu gcig thang nyir gsum gong gsham spus legs/ gnas bcu bdun thang de mtshungs/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas spyan drangs pa'i thub sku/ skṛ ti'i phyag tsha dngos/ phag gru byi za ma/ rgya gar li ma gang mang / rgya nag li sku byin chags sogs snying la phangs pa'i rten mang bo gzim khang rgyud khang sogs su sbyor 'jags gnang / de gong zhabs brtan lha khang du'ang nyi ma sbas — 285

pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo rnams kyi li sku khru phyed dang do can dang / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser dang rdor sems gyi thang ga che legs/ mi 'khrugs pa'i thang ga sogs dang /jo khang nang du'ang rje rang gis bzhengs pa'i gar blugs kyi mar me mdzad kyi sku brnyan khru gang ba bzhi brgya dang nyi shu/ srib pa'i khang gsar du tshe dpag med gar blugs tshun lnga ba stong phrag paṇa chen 'khrungs rab zhal thang spus legs btsu bzhi/ dus 'khor thang ga che legs/ gnas brtan bcu drug bdun thang sogs mang bo zhig dang rten gtsor rje'i sku rang gi sku tshad can de bzhugs rgyu'i thugs dgongs yod mod 'du khang gi gral mgo stong bar lus pa thabs gzhan ma rnyed par yod pas der bzhugs/rgya dngul rdo tshad bzhi bcu mgar ba'i gla phog sogs kyi ched dang sgor mo stong dang sum brgya sogs kyis mchod rten gsar bzhengs sogs gnang / zhabs brtan lha khang gi rten gtso thugs rje chen po dang / gtsang khang gi kun bzang / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sogs khong gis yon bdag la bskul ma gnang nas bzhengs pa sha stag red/ der ma zad dus 'khor grwa tshang gi dus 'khor sku/ rigs ldan nyer lnga/ jo khang bar khyams kyi gnas brtan 286

pacu drug 'jigs byed chos rgyal sogs khong gis dge bskul gyi mtshams sbyor las byung ba red/ mchod thebs dang mar me'i rkong bu brgya tshar re dang gzhan yang nyer mkho'i yo byad bzhag pa mtha' yas so/ der gzim khang gsar bskrun byas pa shin tu skyid pas dgun ngor der bzhugs rgyu'i thugs dgongs yang yang btang kyang bla brang nas khu bo bstan pa de tsam mi bde bas myur du phebs dgos zhes 'phrin 'byor ba dang / bla brang gzhung nas kyang 'tshams zhu ba 'byor te gyigong sa skyabs mgon mchog gdan sar bzhugs med pa'i shul stong lta bu'i dus 'dir gdan sa'i dgon srung la cis kyang phebs dgos zhes nan tan chen pos gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin phyir gdan sar phebs dgos byung ste zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer bdun la btegs/ rgya mkhar dgon brgyud zla dgu ba'i tshes gcig la gdan sar 'byor/ tshes lnga nas 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang / rim par mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba'i bshad lung / myur lam bshad lung / thar chen gyi lung /seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang / theg chen gso sbyong / mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs sngags btu sgrub thabs kyi lung dang bcas pa/dbe+en sa'i gcod dbang / bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/ bla mchod kyi khrid/ de skabs bzang spyod khrid sgrub bcug ste 'bul bar 287

khro na stong phul/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs te brgyad stong ba bsgrublos/ sngon nas tā rin dpa' ris bstan 'dzin 'phrin las rnam gnyis dngul sgor nyi shu rtsa lnga dang kha dar bcas rig byed ma 'i bskyed tshordzogs gsar rtsom gyitso khuskul ma zhus pa re zhig 4ma gnang / rjes sor tā rin gyis rgya yul nas bskul ma nan che ba zhus pas rig byed ma'i bskyed rdzogs dzhagasar rtsom gnang / phyo nyi bzlog gi/ nyin nas bzung bsdus grwa'i mtha' dpyod sogs la dpe bltas gnang ste phyi ma'i slob gnyer la smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor byas pa yin gsungs/ khong gi zha la nas nyin gcig dhā mari'adi ba zhidzobag phebs—ngang nas tshar chen gyi mkha'i spyod smon lam dal 'byor gru chen ma'i tshig la yid gshar zhig byas par don rags pa tsam thon pas dga' drag ste 'bri bar brtsams kyang rībasam blo zhig btang bar nyi ma yang 'phyi mor song / sangatshorgyal zla ba'i tshes bcur 'dug pas der gris na yong snyam/ ci'i nangs par bdag 'jug grub 'phral 'bri bar brtsams de mgo tshugs tsa nanya gnas legs bshad tshorgya mtshos lam srang nas rnyed zer sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i tsa ka li byon legs gsar ba zhig byung bas/dga' dad 'gran zla med pa zhig skyes/ zhib par brtag na ltas dz+wa phyi kun bsdoms na lha 288

mchog 'di nyid kyis rjes su 'dzin par nges snyam zhes gsungs/'di yang gong du bshad pa ltar gzhon nu nyid nas bde mchog yab yum gyis rjesarisubazung zhing phyis su bsnyen sgrub la brtson par mdzad pas nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba'i rtags dang gsung zur du ma yod pa'i gcig go/ / dgung grangasabyudon gsum pa rab rgyal sa pho ltag gi lo la bla brang phyag mdzod chen mo'i ngor phyag rdor gtum chen gyi rdzes gnang / sa skyong mi'i dbang bo a bho blo bzang tshe dbang laspyotshe dbang gnang / gzhan 'gar rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi khrid/'dan sprul ba'i skus zhus ngor grub rgyal tshe dbang / tha byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi khrid/ sgrol dkar/ drag po su/ma dril/rig byed ma/ bag tse rnams kyi rjes gnang / rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi khrid/ dga' ldan gzhung bsrangs kyi khrid/ sgrol dkar tshe khrid/ 'pho khrid/ dam tshig rdo rje'irtsobazlas pa'i khrid/ 'jigs byed ba skyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ bsnyen khrid snga phyir lan gnyis/ lung kha yar bcas bstsal/ rmog rirub rnams la 'jigs byed/ rtasnamagrin/ seng gdong ma/ khyung khra nag mgon chos lha mo rnams kyi rjes gnang / lung mang bo/ g.yu thog bla sgrub kyi dbang /bde ma/chog dang 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen khrid rnams bstsal/ zla ba 289

gsum pa'i tshes lnga nas lam rim mchan bzhi ma'i bshad lung gnang / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes gnyis nas gcod dbang zhi dragagur zhal gyi rjes gnang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen po lha mo'i tshul khrims kyis zhus ngor rim lnga ga sal sgron gyi bshad lung dang / sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung gnang / tshes bco lnga la bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba dang rab gnas kyi khrid sogs spyang bstsal/ yang bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba dang gzungs 'jug gi khrid/ 'jigs byed bsnyen chen gyi khrid/ gtsang gi ri khrod pas zhus ngor mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs/ de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ sbyin sreg gi khrid/ bcud len gyi khrid rnams bstsal/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig nas 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid/ mi g.yo ba sngon po dang sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang / rje'i bstod 'grel chen mo rtsa 'grel gyi bshad lung / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs dang 'jam dpal zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid/ brag dkar dgon pa spyis zhus ngor gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ bde mchog tso i pa/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang dpa' cig rnams kyi dbang bstsal/ mgon chos rnam sras gsum gyi rjes gnang / rgyud gzhung gi lung bcas gnang / a lags bya khyung gis zhus ngor zhi khro sbrags sgrub gyi khrid dang / rnga dges zhus lha90

ngor gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung / bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i khrid/me tog bcud len dang tshe gcig nyams len gyi khrid rnams gnang /a kyā hu thog thu sprul ba'i sku rin po che sogs kyis zhus ngor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid dang bde mchog gi rim gnyis kyi dmar khrid rgyas pa/ thig dang blos bslang brtsigs tshul gyi phyag khrid dang bcas pa bstsal/ 'ga' zhig dge slong gi sdom pa la bkod/ slar yang dge tshul kha shas bsgrubs/ zla ba bdun pa'i shol zla la'ang mang bo la dge tshul slong gi sdom pabyuphogagi tsha ba zhig gis zhus ngor bla ma lnga bcu ba'i bshad lung / bla ma mchod pa'i khrid/ lam mchog snying bo'i khrid bstsal/ go re'i ri khrod pas zhus ngor thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ rgya yag sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i khrid dang za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi khrid/ gser tog no mo han sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i las tshogs kyi khrid/sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung dang / sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nas 'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang /'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ bstod sprin rgya mtsho'i lung sogs 291

dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po lha mo'i tshul khrims kyis zhus ngor lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lungaka dge bshos bsang khog tshul khrims kyis zhus ngor dus 'khor bskyed rim gyi baspyod lung dang rdzogs rim gyi khrid/ ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ smad rgyud khrid chen baspya da kyi dmar khrid bcas gnang / rdo rams pa the bu'i shes rab kyis zhus ngor grub mtha' mo'i bshad lung dang / gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan thod 'khor gyi khrid/ gnam sngon zhabs drung gis zhus ngor 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ klu'i bum gter dang dga' ldan lha brgya jima'i khrid bstsal/ ching wang kun dga' rab brtan gyis zhus ngor tshe dbang dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ gzhan dag gis zhus ngor phar phyin mchan gyi bshad lung yang gnang / ju thu med bka' 'gyur ba 'jam dbyangs bzodapas zhus ngor khong gi gsu nga rtsom de skabs dpar la bkod zin pa pod gnyis kyi lung gnang / du ma zhig bsnyen paraldogs/ bsnyen khrid dang de'i skor gyi lung / dril bu lus dkyil gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ yang du ma bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhung gsar ba rnams la rgyan 'jug gi lung bstsal/ sngar bde chen du thog mar phebs skabs 'char can gyi zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes la ltung bshags kyi cho ga nyin lnga/ sgyung 292

ga nas brgya re'i thebs so/gas su spyi 'jog mang bo gnang / phyis su bshags lha so lnga dang bde gshegs brgyad kyi bris thang spus legs khyad par du 'phags pa gsum bstsal/ rgyud khang gsar bskrun gyi nang du jo bo'i sku dang rje'i sku che tshad re bzhengs thebs su dngul sgor brgya phrag 'di dag la cang khebs gser gzhung ma'i pang khebs bzhi dang steng khebs bcu bskur gnang mdzad/khong bcad rgyar bzhugs pa'i skabs dgun mjug tu khu bo bstan pa dus kyi chos nyid du gyur/ de'i ched du dbus su skyabs swogon bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog la rgya dngul rdo tshad gcig bsngo rten du phul te skyabs 'jug zhus pas bka' lan du jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs rten 'gang chen rnams la mchod 'bul dang skyabs 'jug zhus tshul phebs/ khong rin po che rang nyid nas kyang gtong sgo byed par ched mngags bsod nams rgyal mtshan lags spran te smon lam chen mo'i steng se lhabras dge gsum la bsnyen bkur zhus skabs skyabs 'jug zhus chog pa byung / gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil 'di nas kyang bla ma khri gdan zur rnams la 'bul nod dang bsngo rten grwa tshang so so dang tshogs chen/ ri khrod bzhi— bcas la mang bskol sogs kyi bsnyen bkur yang dag pa gnang nas dge rtsa rlabs chen bsgrubs/ nyin kha shas nas rgyud smad la bde mchog 293dze

bdag 'jug gser yig gser rkong sogs dang gdan sa so sor yang 'phral du dge rtsa bsgrubs/ gzhan yang zhag zhe dgu'i bar du khong rang nyid kyis bcad rgya'i ngang nas mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga dang 'brel bar sngags bzla ba/ bdag 'jug len pa/khrus chog bskur ba rnams ma chad pa gnang / mthar rus pa rnams la sku dpar 'debs pa sogs bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa zhig mdzad do/ / ci dgung grangs don bzhi ba rab rgyal sa mo yos bu'i lo la cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i mjug gi bcad rgya'i khongs nas a kyā hu thog thu/ gser tog no mo han/ rgya yag sprul ba'i sku sogs la rig byed ma'i be'u bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung bstsal/ bcu bdun la gnam sngon zhabs drung sogs 'ga' zhig bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi bslab pa la bkod/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin 'dan sprul skus zhus ngor grub rgyal tshe dbang bskur/ dgon 'dir bka' 'gyur gyi lung rgyun chad la nye ba thugs kyis ma bzod par paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba'i yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med mtshan can dang gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng drug pa'i yongs 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang bo dkon mchog bsam 'grub rnam gnyis la bskul ma gnang ste 294

khong rnam gnyis dang cun gar mkhan sprul rin po che dang dam chos 'od zer rnams kyis thu med bka' 'gyur ba 'jam dbyangs bzod pa la zhus par khong rin po che 'di ba nas zla ba gnyis pa'i bcu gcig nas dbu btsugs te gnang rgyu'i zhal bkod gnang /ska sar ba zhig gis zhus ngor gser 'od kyi lung dang nyer bzhi nyer lnga gnyis la nam mkha' sgo 'gyed dang khros nag lnga lha'i dbang / reb kong ri khrod pa bya khyu nga sprul skus zhus ngor dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg rdor sems bsgom bzlas gsum gyi khrid bstsal/ gzhan yang skyabs khrid/rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / rig byed ma'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / dge bshes rdo rams pa gsung rab dngastargya stod lha rams pa'i sprul sku gnyis kyis zhus ngor rje'i gsung 'bum gyi dbu btsugs/ rab nas 'ga' zhig la bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ bla ma mchod pa'i dmigs khrid/ ra rgya'i a dga' grub chen sprul skus zhus ngor 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang / theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom lung / kun rig gi dbang dang mgon po'i rjes gnang bstsal/ dpyid der khu bo gshegs pa'i dge rtsar dmigs te sman bla longs sku bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa gsar banengs gnang ste sman pa'i 'du pho95

khardonang du bzhugs/ji sa ga'i nya la bsgrubra bya bduno cu lhag tsam la bslab pa 'i ga zhitsengasaskesu snyerdzogs mi'i dege slong dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa la bkod/ zla ba de'i nyer drug nas 'jagadabyangs bla ma gung thang sprulaba'i sku rin po ches zhu sa pa ltar sgrub thabs rin 'a byung gi rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs pachalung dang bcas pa gnang / multo sprul skus zhusaror bde lam gyi khrid rgyas pa dang bsnyen rdzo gas kha shas bsgrubs/ — zla ba bdun pa'i tshes mgo la glosnabur du sku bsnyun drag po zhig bzhes/ slob ma thams cad kyis theg pa khur blangs kyis nyin mtshan bar ma chad par zhabs brtan phon cher bsgrubs pa gnad du song / 7 gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' lung bzhin bka' 'gyur dag tshar dang brgyad stong ba brgya tshar bsgrubs ripa lakhong rang nyi da nas yon kyang phul/bka' 'gyur ba rnams kyis brtan bzhugs phul zhing de skabs rje nyid kyi zhabs brtan sgrub rgyu shin tu gal che bas sku bsnyung lhag med du ma song bar du bka' 'gyur gyi 'chad nyan mtshams bzhag nas zhabs brtan bsgrub rgyu yin zhus par khong gi zhal nas de ma zer/ chos 4rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin de/ /'dun pa'i rtsa bar rab tu gnas/ /zhes gsungs pha ltar gtso cher 'dun pawo rag las pas bka' 'gyur gyi 'chad nyan yang nged kyi 396

zhabs brtan dang rim gror song chog phan pa'i lan du mchod pa r+pā ba ni/ /bsgo rba'i tshig ba zhin nyams su len pa yin/ /zhes rang la gang gsung bka' ribazhin du bsgrub pa mchod pa'i mchog red/ chos ldan gyi bya ba yin yang bla ma'i gsung gi zur phra mo re dang 'gal na mi legs pa 'byung rgyu yod pa bla ma pongs 'dzin rin po‘che khri nam bzang ba'i mdun du mjal ba'i lo rgyus lta sum̐ red/ bka' 'gyur gyirte'achad nyan 'di mthar phyin pa zhig shin tu gal che zhing nged kyi rim gro yang de las lhag med pas sang nyin nas sngar ltar bka' 'gyur 'chad nyan la rem zhes bka' bstsal/ rim gyis sku gzugs dwangs/ bcu bdun nas bde chen rgyud grwa ba rnams la sta gon dang bcas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ gsang 'dus lha so gnyi saṃ pa/ bde mchog lha re gnyis pa rnams kyi dbang gnang / tsha kho zangs dkar ba rnams kyis zhus ngor dus 'khor spyi bka'i dbang bstsal/ ga—ser lag pa 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor gcod dbang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum la rje'i gsung 'bum gyi mjug grub par gnang / tshes bcu gsum nas hor tshang dgon gsar ba rnams la bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dpa' lhag kun rig gdugs dkar lha mang rnams kyi dbang / mgon chos zhal lha mo/ — seng gdong ma 297

rnams kyi rjes gnang dang rgyan 'jug sogs kyi lung bstsal/ bco lnga'i nyin bka' 'gyur gyi lung grub ste rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po gtso byas bla slob thams cad sku mdun du phebs te mjal bas zhal nas spyir deng dus bka' chos gsung chos thams cad nyag phra bar gyur te dgun dus kyi chu phran ltar gyur/ khyad par rgyal ba'i dka' 'gyur rin po che'i lung rgyun nyag phra bar gyur pa sems kyi zug ngur song / yang da res bla slob thams cad kyis mthar phyin par byas pa bka' drin che/ sngon dgon pa 'dir kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i bka' drin las cha har bka' 'gyur ba chen pos gnang ba da bar gnas pa khong rnam spru tsho'i thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthu grub pa'i dbang gis red/ deng skabs chad la nye ba na a khu 'jam dbyangs bzod pa tshang 'di bas spel te chad mthud lta bur song bas khong yang thugs bskyed smon lam gyi mthu grub pa'i rtags red/ khyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis phyin chad 'chad spel rgya chen po byas te rgyun phyogs yas mas dang yang dgos dgon 'dir mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba thugs la 'dzin dgos/ sdon lha lung gi dbang phyug rin po che ma/sa lam po che zhig gi khar byon te bka' 'gyur gyi shog byang 'ga' re phyag tu bsnams nas yar 'gro mar 'gro thams cad la shog byang gcig lha98

tsam yin yang nyan du bcug pa dang dbal mang rin po che nas da phyin chad bka' chos tsho byin rlabs gnya' 'jog byed dgos pa'i dus shig 'ongs gsungs pa ltar da lta de'i dus la slebs yod pas ji srid bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du lung gi rgyun 'di yang gnas pa zhig gi thabs la 'bad pa gal che/ zhes sogs bslab ston rgyas par bstsal/ nyer gnyis la bka' 'gyur ba rnams kyis zhus ngor mchod pa'i yo byad bsam yul las 'das pa lta bu dang bcas tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo'i nang nas gung thang mchog sprul rin po che dang bla brang mdzod pa chen mo'i gtsos khri gdan zur sprul sku che chung grwa mang bcas tshogs pa sum stong lhag la sems bskyed mchod pa byas te thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /de skabs lung nyan mkhan la yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / de rnams kyis phyis su lung rgyun spel ba ni dper na dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje lha mo'i tshul khrims zhal snga nas dgon 'dir bka' 'gyur gyi lung gsungs pa dang / dus mtshungs su yongs 'dzin rin po che dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bos rang dgon 'di nas gsungs shing / khong klog la yang byang bas zla ba gsum tsam la mjug grub par gnang / bla 299

ma dkar bo'i yongs 'dzin chos dpal zhing bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes grags pa'i dge bshes chen po des chos dpal zhing nas tshar gcig gnang / yongs 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang bo rje 'jigs med rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos thar shul ri khrod nas tshar gcig lkeganang ba sogs gdan sa bkra shis rmekhyil dang phyogs yas mas su dar ba dang / deng skabs yang hal ha dge bshes blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling dpal ldan bkra shi sa 'khyil nas bka' 'gyur gyi lung gnang bzhin yod pa sogs ci bstan pa'i gegs chag 'di 'dra che ba'i dus 'dir yang bka' chos kyi rgyun 'ga' zhig gnas yod pa ni rje bla ma bla go rdo— rje — 'chang 'di ba'i bka' drin du 'khums legs so/ / bhe cid ni dkyus la 'jug par bya— ste gung thang mchog sprul rin po ches zhus ngor nyi shu lnga la sta gon dang bcas mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang yongs rdzogs bstsal ba dgu ba'i bcu bdun la grub/ rgyud pha dpon slob cun gar mkhan sprul/ bla ma dbu mdzad/ 'dan sprul sku sogs nyung 'dus la rim lnga'i khrid rdo lag brgyud ma lag rjes dang bcas pa/ khong nyid kyi gsung rtsom gyi gras nas sngar lung ma song ba 'ga' zhig gi lung / 'gyang ro sprul sku sogs la 'pho 'khrid/ bcu ba'i tshes gcig tshe dpag med stong sku— gas ra 300

bskrun— byas pa rdzogs par grub ste mgar ba rnams la yon dngul sgor nyis stong lnga brgya/ legs grub spyo gtang rag tu gos phrug rmegs gnang nas bzo bo rna mas yon gyis mgu bar byas te grub ston kyang byas so/ /tshes gsum la 'ga' zhig la bsnyen rjegs gnang / tshes bzhi la ko'u sprul ba'i sku rin po cher tshe dbang gnang / tshes drug bdun gnyis la 'jigs med zer ba'i gsar bu zhig gis zhus ngor lam mchog snying bo'i khrid gnang / tshes brgyad la khya dge sprul sku dang dam chos 'od zer sogs kyis cho bskul ngor rang rtso ma lam rim nyams n+degur gyi 'grel ba theg mchog lam bzang gsal ba'i tshig —gi blo shel gyi bshad lung gi dbu btsugs te bshes gnyen baḍasten tshul bar bstsa la to/ /de nas phyag mdzod mkhyen rab don 'aspyoblo dang gros bstu—na gyis rje sku chen mo bzhengs rgyu'i sta gon gnang / rī kro'i bla ma la mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang gnange / nyin shas kyi mtshams nas gung thang mchog sprul rin po che sogs gsum la ku ne —mekhyeskemi gyi gsung bko' rgya ma'i skor gyi lung— dang / ko'u rmebarda mchog sprul la ma ning ha 'edon gyi khrid gnang ste zla ba bcu gcig padza tshes gcig nas bcad rgyar bzhugs te rgyun pa'i thugs —dme —dang bslab spyod 'grel ba sogs la dpe gzigs gnang / 301

— dgung grangs bdun cu don lnga ba rab rgyal lcags pho 'brug gi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes gcig la sa skyong dam pa ching wang kun dga' rab brtan la tshe dbang gnang / de rjes shig la kro'i bla ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa la bkod/ tshes brgyad dgu gnyis la mi'i dbang byug dam pa zi len blo bzang tshe dbang la rig byed ma'i rjes gnang dang rta mgrin gyi dbang bstsa'// tshes bcu la kro'i bla ma la 'jigs byed kyi dbang gnang / bcu gcig la zi len tshang la thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / bco lnga la bla brang chen mor phebs nas sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nas rong bar dgon par bde gsang 'jigs gsum kun rig dang bcas pa'i dbang / mgon chos lha mo rnam sras dam can rnams kyi rjes gnang / brgya rtsa'i khrid/ mtshan sgrog spyi ba la brgyad stong ba dang thar mdo'i lung bstsal/ tshes bcu gsum la tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing / rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ ldong sprul skus zhus ngor dam can srog gtad/ kro 'i krang gis zhus ngor gzhi gsum cho ga'i khrid/ kha gya'i dbu mdzad kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed kyi dbang rjes gnang lung bcas gnang / nyer lnga la gcod dbang gnang / nyer bdun nas bkra shis dge 'phel ri khrod pa rnams kyis zhus ngor thig le 302

bcu drug dang dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang / mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs rnams bstsal/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas rmog ri dgon pa'i grwa ba rnams kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed dpa' cig bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ rta mgrin/ kun rigagadugs dkar rnams kyi dbang / thugs rje chen po/ khyung khra nag nā ga rak+ka/ seng gdong ma/ mgon chos lha mo rnam sras rnams kyi rjes gnang / skyabs 'gro/ maṇ+ḍal/ brgya rtsa rnams kyi khrid/ tshes brgyad la bla ri mgur ba zhig la bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ 'di rnams shog dril kho na las bris/ rang bstan gyi gegs lta bur yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sku brnyan rten brten pa glo bur du me skyon phog pa lo mang 'gyang ba yengs ma lam la sri zhu byed mkhan ma byung ba khong gi thugs kyisagam bzod par zla gnyis pa'i tshes mgo nas dbu brtsams te sgrub cing gzungs 'jug gser tshon rab gnas bcas 'phral du grub/ gong du zhus pa ltar gnas brtan pa dang mnyam du khong gis phyag bzo gnang zhing bka' bstan gsung 'bum sogs rang bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams pa'i dkar chag logs su yod do/ /zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes gcig nas mu to sprul baṣāsku rin po ches zhus ngor rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung / gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi 303

bsnyen khrid/ nā ga rasnya'i rjes gnang / tshes bco lnga la dge tshul slong brgya bsgrubs/ bcu drug nas mu to sprul ba'i sku rin po che sogs kyis zhus ngor sbas don kun gsal dang za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi khrid/ dam tshig rdo rje bzlas pa'i khrid/ ri khrod pa zhig gis zhus ngor 'jam dkar rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa dang yang ri khrod pa zhig gis zhal ngor gcod khri da gnang / zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig la mu to sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor gsang 'dus bde mchog mkha' spyod ma rnams kyi sngags btu dang mkha' spyod lus dkyil rnams bstsal/ hal ha blo bzang— rgya mtshos zhus ngor dpa' bo g.yul 'jug ma'i khrid/ mu to sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor lo hu ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ tshes bcu bdun nas gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/dpal blos’zhus ngor nā ga rasnya/ stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang /sgrol dkar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ g.yu thog bla sgrub/rig byed ma thun mong ma yin pa dang gsang sgrub/ drag po sum dril rnams kyi rjes rīganang / sku 'bum rgya mtshos zhus ngor rnal 'byor nam mkha' dang mngon byang gi dbang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug nas khong gi zhal rtsom spyod 'jug 'grel ba'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs/ tshes bcu bdun nyin skyabs mgon mchog khong gi 304

gzi ma shag tu phebs nas spyi sgor gyi gsung glong dmar/ nyir bdun la spyod 'juka 'grel ba'i bshad lung mjug grub/ yang thugs rje chen po/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ dril bu phyi nang gnyis rnams kyi dbang / rig byed ma dang nā ga rasnyi'i rjes gnang / mkha' spyod lus dkyil sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang bcas gnang / zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga la hor tshang shog kha bzhi'i ser skya tshang mas chibs bsu thabs bsu sogs bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas hor —tshang mtsho khar phyag phebs/ der thugs rjesna chen po'i dbang / skyabs 'gro/ dmigs brtse ma/ gdugasatsho sher sgrol ma/ ma ṇi rnams kyi lung gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'iritretshes gcig la tsag tsag dgon du phyag phebs gnang / tshes gnyis la slob ma rjes 'dzin dang sa chog thig tshon skabs nyin bdun gyi ring la bde lam gyi khrid/ gzhan yang thugs rje chen po'i dbang / gdugs dkar/ 'od zer can ma/ sgrol ma/seng gdong ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'ga' zhig la 'jigs byed bsnyen skor dang lha mo'i gto ra chen gyi lung gnang /lab tse bkra shis rgyal mtshan gsar stod mdzad/ da/da ldan snyan grags zer bas tshogs dbur gdan drangs thog dngos 'bul gzab/ tshes bcu bzhi la dus 'khor dbang gi sta gon gnang 305

skabs 'brug sgra ldir zhing sprang char bab pa sogs dge ligs chi ba byung / tshes bcu bdun la dus 'khor dbang chen rdzogs/tshes bco brgyad la yi ge thang dgon pa dngarī shing sgo phyogs su phebs te 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ kun rig mngon byang /gdugs dkar rnams kyi dbang /— brgya rtsa'i khrid/ lung kha shas bcas gnang / de ka'i dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten la dus 'khor gyi rab gnas dang / nyer lngar gdan sar phyir phebs/ zla ba dgu ba'i tshes gcig nas rdor 'phring gi dbu tshugs/ dbang 'di yang gung thang sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus pa yin la dbang nyan mkhan khri gdan zur bla sprul dge bshes sogs bla grwa ba ni brgya lhag yod/ nyi shu'i nyin rgyo'i rgya'i ri khrod pa rnams kyis zhus ngor gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang nag po spyod pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog gnyis kyi dbang gnang / nyer gnyis la theg chen gso sbyong gsung bshad zab rgyas bcas gnang / zhar shul sprul ba'i sku sogs kyis zhus ngor bsnyen rdzogs bzhi bcu bsgrubs/ zla ba bcu ba'i tshes gcig nas sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung rgyas pa/ bcu gcig la bkra shis rgya mtshos zhus ngor thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang dang khyung khra'i rjes gnang bcas bstsal/ nyer gnyis nas dpal ldan 'od zer gyis 306

zhus ngor mi la'i rnam mgur gyi lung dang gsang ba'i mgur drug gi lung gnang / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas gzhung gis zhus ngor 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid smin rgyas nyin bcu/tshes dgu nas sku mtshams bsdams/ nyer lngar slog po'i dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi lan byung ste thag gcod gnang / mtshams khongs nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la tshogs zangs legs grub kyi gla rngan la dngul srang bdun brgya dang sum cu gnang ba sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba rlabs chen mdzad do/ /dgung grangs bdun cu don drug pa rab rgyal lcags mo sbrul gyi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes bcu gcig la mtshams grol/ de nas dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs dang skal— ldan chos drug nang gi le tshan gsum dang / rgyal thang ba'i gcod skor/ smon lam mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i gcod gzhung rnams dang / gser lag sprul sku sogs kha yar la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas tshe dbang / 'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang dmar ser/dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ khyung khra rnams kyi rjes gnang dang thar mdo'i lung / bla brang phyag mdzod chen mos zhus ngor skyabs khrid/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ tshes dgu nas a rigs tshang gis zhus ngor bsnyen rdzogs/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog307

thugs rje chen po/ kun rig rnams kyi da bang gnang / dge tshul kha shes bsgrubs/ rme tshes bco lnga la dpa' ris pa tsha nga rab tu byung / nyer lnga nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gnang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum nas phyag mdzo/ da dzi mo mkhye/narterab don 'grub kyis zhus ngor bla mchod deng ba rda lam gyi khrid nyin brgyad/tshes bcu bdun la a dga' tshang la sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang / sgrol ma nyer gcig dzam dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ phyag mdzod mos zhus ngor dug dbang gan nga / nyer gnyis la brgya rtsa'i khrid/ zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bdun la lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung grub nas mchod mjal mdzad/ tshes brgyad la theg chenachagaso sbyong gnang / lha khang so sor mchod mjal byas te mar me brgya rophul/ tshes bcu— gcig la dpa' ris pa tshang la dpa' cig gi dbang sta gonanang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang / yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid gnang / tshes bcu rgesum nangs par theg chen gso sbyong gnang / tshes bco lnga la bsnyen rdzogs don gsum bsgrubs pa dang dge tshul zhe gcig bsgrubs/ tshis bcu drugeci larī lha bstan sgar ba rna mas kyis zhus ngor skyabs khrid dang tshes bcu bdun la zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid gnang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang sprul gyi don la 308

'phrin yig 'byor/ tshes bco brgyad la phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi sku bzhengs/ ko'u ba sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi’khrid/ lta khrid/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gzhung bsrangs rnams gnang / nyer drug nas nyin gnyis la legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung dang rigs gsum phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / lung kha yadzo gnangapo nyer brgyad la bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul bsgrubs/ nyer dgu la dpa' cig gi dbang sta gon bcas/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig nas ma lags nor bu tshang gis zhus ngor 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gnang / dkon mchog rgya mtshos zhus ngor zhi khro sprags sgrub kyi rnam thashad kyi khrid/ cha har dpal ldan 'od zer gyis zhus ngor skal ldan skegur 'bum gyi lung gnang / tshes bzhi la bsnyen cirdzogs dang rab byung gnang ba dang grwa tshang la grwa ja btang / tshes bdun nas dge bshes po bkra shis rgya mtsho sa zhus ngor khong gi rnasung rtsom kha shas kyi lung ga nang / tshes bcu gcig nas gung thang rin cipho ches zhus ngor sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ snar thang brgya rtsa rnams gnang / 'cham pa rnams kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang mgon chos rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ dge bshes bkra shis rgya mtshos 309

zhus ngor rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsnyen khrid/ dge bshes klu shod pas zhus ngor 'jam dkar zhidze khro sprags sgrub kyi rnam bshad kyi khrid/zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la rgan gya'i brag dkar du chibs bsgyur gnang / dgon nas tshes bco lnga nas 'jigs byed sta gon dang bcas pa/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog mi 'khrugs pa/ rta mgrin rnams kyi dbang / mgon chos gnyis kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ de nas rgan gya'i ser sder sman bla'i dbang / sde ba spyi la gdugs dkar gyi dbang / legs ldan mched gsum/seng gdong ma/ thugs rje chen po rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ gzhan yang brag dkar dgon pa spyis zhus ngor gcod dbang /rig byed ma'i rjes gnang / skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma rnams kyi khrid/ gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung rnams gnang / bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul bsgrubs/'du khang zhig ral du song ba bskyar gsos kyi thebs su dngul sgor bzhi brgya sbyor 'jags mdzad/ sku 'gyed dge 'dun rer khron bzhi dang kha dar re/ gnas khang gnyis su brgya mchod re dang snyan shal phul/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la 'du khang nas rig byed ma'i rjes gnang grub 'phral lam du btegs/ zhag bzhugs gnang sar gtor 'bul gsungs shing bsang gsur byi10 rī

ṅkasogs gnang bas der gnas ser skya thams cad dga' spro dang dad pa rgyas/ tshes lnga la snyan grags kyis zhus ngor tshe dbang gnang / tshes bdun nas ba ri brgya rtsa gnang / tshes bco lnga la paṇa chen rin po che'i zhabs grwas sku zhabs gsol 'degs pa phebs/ 7 paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang sprul gsal 'don lung bstan rnams zhib bsher go bsdur byas/ tshes bcu drug nas grub chen brgyad cu'i rjes gnang bstsal te mjug tu rigs gsum spyi sgrub zhig gnang rgyu'i thugs dgongs gnang ste cho ga bsgrubs nas gsung bshad gnang bzhin pa'i skabs su bar chad cig byung nas mtshams 'jog gnang ste legs grub ma byung / nyer dgu la mdzod dger btegs/ lam bar ja thabs steng a lags rgya khri sogs lngacel 'jigs byed tshobasnyen khrid gnang / kha gya brgyud zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis la mdzod dge'i dgon du 'byor/ tshes gsum nas bde lam gyi khrid/ tshes brgyad la sems bskyed mchod pa gnang / tshes dgu'i nyin spyod pa spyi bslabs rdzogs/ tshes bcu la 'jigs byed sta gon dang de nas rim par 'jigs gsang bde gsum/ 'khor chen/ rta mgrin/ kun rig thugs rje chen po/ gdugs dkar rnams kyi dbang /gcod dbang / mgon chos/ bag tse/ storigs gsum spyi sgrub/311—

gnas pacu rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed bsnyen chen/rna ba lathazablo/ blorgya rtsa rnams kyi khrid dang / gzhirtso ga—sum cho ga'i bshad lung rnams bstsal/ gshin 'dre'i gnod pa'i na tshangasgron chod dang oṃr mi rdong ba'i ched du phyogs su 'od dpag med/thub pa/ sgrol oṃ rnams kyi rdo sku44sungs/ de ka'i skyadziser bgres gzhon kun spyan chab thon pa sogs dad 'dun 'phel ba'i nyams che/ lo bstar chags subaka' 'gyur 'don ba'i thobartswa su dngul sgor drug brgya 'jog gnang mdzad/ nyer gsum la phyir kha gyar 'byor te thugs rje po'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa bstsal/ theg chen gso sbyong dang skyabs khrid gnang / 'gyang ro sprul skus zhus ngor dam can srog gastod gnang / zla ba dachu ba'i— tshes gcig la bkra zhis sgar du thugs rje chen po'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ 'jam darkar rjes gnang / chog rogs pa brgyad dang lhan du 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs la rab gnas gnang / — nyung bshags phyag mchod kyi thebs su sngon ma'i stongardzotho'u khron lnga brgya gnang / seng ge'i sgra'i rjes gnang bstsal te yul der sa bdag nad kyis zin pa mang phyir yul kun tu bum chu khyab che bar bkram/ de nas sman lung du phebayonas chadabar gnang zhing lha khang gsar bzhengs la khron brgya dang byams sku'i —312 —

jibs su dngul sgor brgya dang lnga bcu gnang / tshis bzhir rong bar la phyag phebs/ sta gon dang bcas gdugs dkar gyi dbang / legs ldan mched gsum/ lo gyon ma/ 'od zer can ma/ seng gdong ma/ seng ge'i sgra/ rnam 'dzoms/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ dgon de rgya dmag gis btsom nas rten med par bzos pas gnas bcu'i zhal /thang bcu gcig gsar bzhengs thebs su dngul sgor sum brgya gnang /tshes dgu la lha chab dgon du 'byor/ der rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang / chos bsgrags pa'i mdo dang so thar gyi mdo rgyasapa'i lung / gyan thang gi shul stong ba zhig yod ba der thang ga gsar bzhengs kyi thebs su dngul sgor nyer lnga gnang / tshes bcu'i nangs par gdan sar 'byor/ nyer gnyis la ba snyen rdzogs dge tshul kha yar bsgrubs/ lo der rje'i lha khang gi gyang ris nang ngos su mgon po/ chos rgyal/ steng sgo'i thad du rje'i thugs dmaralha drugamakha' spyod ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnams kyi gyan thang / gzhan yang rje rin po ches rgyun du gtor 'bul mdzad yul gyi choyoskyong rnamasadang phyi khyams su rje 'di ba rang nyid kyis choyo'abrel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams dang / las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa'i rtogs brjod dang ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod/ rgyal bo 313

chen po sde bzhi'i gyan thang / ku shi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal rnams legs par bsgrubs so/ /dgung grangs bdun cu don rībadun pa rab rgyal chu pho rta'i lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes dgur tshe dbang / lha mo'i rjes gnang /'jigs byed yum bcas kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ bcu gcig la zhi ba lam zab kyi khrid gnang / de'i gong gi dgun ngo yar mar gyi tshes bcu rnams la yi ge bdun pa sa ya bsgrubs/ tshes bco lngar gung ru mkha' 'gro ma'i yang sprul la dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ nyer lnga nas nyin gsum la gcod dbang / dben sa lugs kyi gcod dbang / zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas phyag mdzod mkhan po'i sprul skus zhus ngor rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ mkhas grub chig brgyud kyi bla rnam/ ba so'i lta khrid/ 'jigs byed ser bo'i tshe khrid/ 'jam dpal zhi drag gi bsrung ba/ yi ge bzhi ba'i bsad bzlog sgra mi snyan gyi tshe khrid/ sgrol ma'i pra 'beb/ lo gyon ma'i las tshogs/ me tog bcud— len/ dza bir rlung khrid/ klu'i bum gter rnams kyi khrid bstsal/ stag phu sgrol ma'i chos skor rnams kyi lung / zam tsha ri khrod pas zhus ngor 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi sgrub las nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub ma gnang / 'tshub che ba byung ba'i rkyen gyis red/ zla 314

ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum nas gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' bzhin tshogs chen gyis sgrol dkar/ kyai rdor grwa tshang gis bde mchog dkar bo/ rgyud stod grwa tshang gis gnas bcu/ dus 'khor grwa tshang gis bde mchog dkar bo/ rgyud smad grwa tshang gis bde mchog dkar bo/ sman pa grwa tshang gis kyang brtan bzhugs phul ba sogs grwa tshang so so nas brtan bzhugs phul ba ba dag gir bzhes shing dngos po phul ba thams cad phyir grwa tshang so so la gnang / tshes bco lnga la dge tshul slong bzhi bcu lhag bsgrubs/ rka'adi skabs rgyud stod pa'i byams chen gyi gzungs 'jug rengs ba'i 'phrul 'khor steng dge 'dun 'du 'khor bri sgrub gnang /tshes bcu bzhi la 'jigs byed bsnyen chen gyi khrid gnang / zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes gcig nas rgyud stod 'du khang nas bde lam gyi khrid smin rgyas gnang ste bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis zhus ngor gser khang nas sems bskyed mchod pa gnang skabs sbyin bdag rang ngos nas mar rgya ma bzhi brgya dang bcu gsum gyis mar me dang gser khang nang tshe 'bar bzhag de nas 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi khrid gnang / tshes bco lnga la tsardon gyi jo sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba de sman pa'i 'du khang du bzhugs su gsol zhing bsnyen rdzogs don brgyad dang dge tshul nyi shu lhag bsgrubs/ de bye/5

nas 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sgrags sgrub kyi khrid/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / mi nyag tshang gis zhus ngor lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ bde chen rgyud grwa dang tsag tsag dgon gyi bca' yig gsar skertsom gnang / nyer drug nas sngags kyi sa lam gyi bshad lung nyin drug la bstsal/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bzhi nas stod rgyud khang gsar du bde gsang 'jigs gsum/'jam dpal gsang ldan rnams kyi dbang / mgon po/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/ khyung khra rnams kyi rjes gnang / dam can mgar ba nag po'i srog gtad/ tshogs chos zhal 'don skor gyi lung mang bo gnang / a khu rin po che'i zin bris steng nas nyin drug la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad khrid gnang / nyer gnyis nas mdzod rtsa/ thar chen /'grel ba don gsal sogs lung mang bo bstsal/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig la tshe dbang gnang nas rgan gyar chu'i 'phrod rten la phebs/ phyugs nad chad cing dud 'then mang bos dud pa bcad/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa len mkhan drug cu tsam byung /bcu gsum la phyir gdan sa'i gzim shag tu 'byor/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nas gung thang rin po ches zhus ngor bde mchog gi dbang gnang bas nyan mkhan sum brgya lhag byung / de nasadzobyeshā6

gzhan zhig gis bskul ngor bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/ dpa' cig thugs rje chen po rnams kyi dbang / 'jigs byed sngags btu/ mkha' spyod byin rlabs rnams bstsal/ cha har zhabs drung gis zhus ngor rdor sems gnyis kyi rjes gnang / stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang gi dbang / sa lugs 'jam dbyangs dmyo/ra ser/gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang / gtsug tor 'bar ma shra ma ṇa/ khyung nag me'i spu gri/ drag po sum dril/ rig byed ma rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ stag tsha sprul sku rin po ches zhus ngor skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ byin rlabayospudzoyozhus/ maṇ+ḍal rnams kyi khrid bstsal/ gzhan yang tshe dbang /rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang sogs bstsal/ pu rad bla loskyabs kyis zhus ngor dbe+en sa snyan brgyud kyi gtsod dbang dang zab don gcod dbang lung bcas gnang / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la ltung bshags phyag mchod gnang / gung thang rin po ches zhus ngor jo nang khrid brgya gnang / dge bshes chos dpal zhing bkra shis rgya mtshos zhus ngor tshe dbang dang khong gi gsung rtsom bka' rgya ma'i skor gyi lung bstsal/ zla ba dgu ba'i tshes nas pu rad rdo rams pa blo bzang rgya mtshos zhus ngor lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung nyin bcu gnyis la gnang / tshes bco 317

lnga la yang phyag mchod gnang / de nas bsod grags gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi lung / nyer gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul nyi shu lhag bsgrubs/ zla ba bcu ba'i tshes bzhir bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul kha shas bsgrubs/ tshes lnga'i nyin 'jigs byed bsnyen khrid gnang / de nas reb kaung sku zhabs a rol tshang phebs/ gos phrug sku brnyan sogs 'bul chen btegs nas chos lung kha shas zhus pa ltar gnang / tshes bcu la sgo me mchod rten skas kyi bca' yig dang snang ra ba zhig gis zhus ngor rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang / gzhan 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor rdor sems dang sgrol dkar rjes gnang / snang ra'i bsngo rten 'byor lan gnang nas tshes sum cu nas sku mtshams bsdams so/ /dgung grangs don brgyad pa rab rgyal chu mo lug lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes brgyad la sku mtshams grol/ bcu gcig nyin klu lding rdo rje'i pho brang du phyag phebs gnang nas yab chen mgon po don 'grub sogs la tshe dbang gnang ste gnas su bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor/ mar ngor mjal kha sogs las bka' chos ma gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la mkhas dbang yongs 'dzin rin po che dkon mchog bsam 'grub pas zhus ngor grub rgyal tshes dbang gnang / tshes gnyis la co ne sku skyes sogs la 318

rab byung bsgrubs/ tshes gsum nas nor bu sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor sgrol ma'i pra 'beb kyi khrid gnang / bde chen bya mas pas zhus ngor zhi khro sprags sgrub kyi khrid bstsal/ khang sar dpon po paṇa chen gyis zhus ngor gdugs dkar gyi dbang / bag tse'i rjes gnang / dam can srog gtad bstsal/ u rge'i a mchod kyis zhus ngor mgon po'i rjes gnang bstsal/ nyer gnyis la paṇa chen rin po ches zhabs gras sku drag kha shas phebs/ paṇa chen nang ma sgang gi spyi khyab chen mo dzajigs med grags pas zhus ngor tse'u dmar srog gtad rnams bstsal/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nas yon tan gzhir gyur ma dang brgya rtsa'i khrid/ rje'i lha khang nang du 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi sku brnyan gar blugs khri tshad ma stong phrag bzhengs rgyu'i dbu brtsams/ thar chen gyi lung gnang / tshes brgyad la theg chen gso sbyong gnang / tshes dgu nas 'jam dpal zhal lung nyin bdun la gnang / bco lnga la bsgrub bya sum bcu la dge tshul dang go gsum la bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ nyer bdun la tsa yi dgon par bde lam gyi khrid nyin lnga/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dpa' cig rta mgrin/ kun rig rdor dbyings/ sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa/ gdugs dkar/ bugs rje chen po rnams khye dbang / mgon po dang 3/9

lhas rgyal gyi rjes gnang / 'khor gyi dbang / zla ba lnga ba'i tshes nas bla ma mchod pa'i khrid/ bsne gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sngags btu/ rigs gsum dzisgrub/ nā ga rasnya/ lha mo/ rna ma sras/ lo gyon ma'i rjes gnang / rgyudwa gzhung sogs bka' chos sang bo gnang / tshes bco lnga la dge tshul sum cu/ dge slong bzhi bcu bsgrubs/ bcu dgu la 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi lung khrid/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub rdo rje'i tshig spram gyi rnam bshad 'bring bo'i lung bcas gnang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug nas mgon po'i bka' bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang / legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung nyin lnga dang dpa' cig bskyed rdzogs nyin gsum la gnang / rab byung 'ga' bsgrubs/ sman bla'i mdo chog rgyas pa'i lung dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gnang / zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nas mu to sprul ba'i sku rin pomiches zhus ngor phag mo 'byung mchog gnyis kyi dbang dang —/ gur lha brgyad ma'i dbang /bsnyenaldogs kha shas bsgrubs/ rdor sems yab rkyang dang yum bcas kyi rjes gnang / klu dbang rgyal bo gtso 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang bstsal/ yang bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul kha shas bsgrubag 'jam dbyangayodamar ser sa lugs kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ dpa' ris pa tshang la mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang / 'jigs 320

byud rnaja rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsnyen khrid gnang / dar dge mkhan sprul gyis zhus ngor tshe dbang / theg chen gso sbyong / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid rnamakho bstsal/ rdo rams pa 'jigs med rgya mtshos zhus ngor dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang dang zla ba dgu ba'i tshes nas dril bu phyi nang gi khrid rnams bstsal/ bla ma dka ra bo tshang dang gung thang rin po che/ 'dan sprul sku logs la chos rgyal yang gsang gi rjes gnang— be'u bum bcas bstsal/ bla ma dkar bo tshang gis zhus ngor mgon po'i be+e'u shum/ rin 'byung rjes ga nang gi bka' rgya ma rnams dang / snying zhugs/ khoja rang nyid kyi gsung rtsom 'ga'i lung rnams gnang / gtsug dge gcod sprul gyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed dbang snya gon dang bcas pha/'pho khrid dang rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi’khrid/ tshe dbang / chos rgyal rjes gnang rnams bstsal/ nyer bzhi la sde khri rin po che'i sprul sku mjal zhur phebs/dgung grangs don dgu ba rab rgyal shing pho sprel lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes gcig la bla brang’chen mocasalo 'dir gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gdan sar mi bzhugs stabs lo sar la khyed kyis sarngal kha gnang dgos zhes zhus pa ltar grwa mang la mjal kha gnang / bcu gcig la tre dbang gnang / 'cham 'bag la 321

rab gnas/ de nas rgyud par sdogs phyogs po )'i lung gnang /kha shas bsnyen par sdogs/ de skabs nad yams mched par rim gro pharba pa sogs ma gnang /5 sman sta dag la sman ster 'jug pa dang bkod khyab srung ba sogs thabs gangal drag gnang / lo gyon ma'ijirjes gnang dang khride lung sogs bstsal/ 'phral du pan ngo byung / bar skabs so sorabyu bka' khyab phran bu re gnang /zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes dgu nas kho tshe gur sgar ba rnams kyis zhus ngor bde mchog lo hu ba'i dbang sta gon bcas/ zab don gcod zhi drag gi dbang / 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang rnams ribastsal/ a lags hor gyis zhus ngor mgon po'i rjes gnang bstsal/ gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi ma yum gsheg sa pa'i sngas su phebs te gong sa mchog gi thugs bzhed bskang / bcu dgu la hal ha blo bzang gis zhus ngor nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ljang gi rjes gnang bstsal/ nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes nas 'du khang chen mo'i steng du khong gi gzim shag tu rgyun bzhuspus kyi rten mang bzhugs sa'i go yul bkram/ kun dga' ra ba shel sgo lcags dra sogs gsar bsgrig gi thebs su bla brang phyag mdzod chen mo mkhyen rab don 'grub kyi phyag tu dngul sgor stong phrag gnang bas tha skar bla ba'i yar tshes la legs grwab byung / dza byelhaḥ

kho/'i —dpon chen rdo rje dpal bzang gis zhus ngor tshe dbang dang paṇa zhabs brtan gsol 'debs kyi lunge / bco lnga la byams 'jam dbyangs bzhengs rgyu'i dbu btsugs te sa ga'i nya lda grub/ seng bar rnams su 'jam dkar/ sgrol dkar/ dbyangs can ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / tshes bcu la zhi ba lam zab dang lam gtso'i lung bstsal/ rje'i bstod 'grel chen mo'i bshad lung nyin bzhir gneng / theg chen gso sbyong / thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsnyen chen gyi lung sogs bstsal/ bco lnga la bsgrub bya gya bzhi bsnyen rdzogs dang nyer gsum dge tshul la bkod/ de nas bla ma phun tshogs tshang la mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang khrid bcas/ lcags mkhar skor kha shas kyi lung dang mchan bshad rgyun ltar gnang / lo sar skabs nas bzung paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang sprul gsar 'donaji sogs kyi ched du sku 'bum du bskyod dgos kyi gtam tsam byung ba rna la gzan pas chog pa byung gsungs kyang hor zla gsum pa'i nang mkhan po che chung sogs gdan zhur 'byor gdong la sku 'bum gyi mkhan po'i gtsos tshogs 'du bla sprul khag nang ma sgang gi gsung 'phrin tsha nan che ba phebs te gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar shol zla'i tshes la phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba bzhin zla ba bzhi ba rjes ma'i 323

tshes gsumakhal phebs byams gra sgrig sogs byas pas/ phebaru'ibyams stejing nas gdan drangs/ bla brang chen mo nasar+sha nyin skyel dang zhagaskyel mdzad/ la'iblor nas ko ring bis mdo sog4kyisa'itharang bsaser 'phreng ba cas bis mdo dgon paratshuphyag phepas/ bka'o chos phran bu gnang / phyi'i gongs par ko mdo'i sdob bsu blang4te der zhag bzhugs gnang / de'i phyi nyin thon nying tshang giso thab bsu zhus/ tig rkyur lung kha shas gnang / la saubar za dkar sogs thab bsutshozhu mkhan mdza / zitrephing rdu phebs pa na dpa' ris rgya tig tshang sman gyi 'phrod rten ched der bzhugs pa lke la bklag lung kha shas bstsal/ zhabs drung tshang bsu bar byon pa'i drung du phyin/ phyi'i nangaspo par paṇa chen nang oṃsgang dang sau 'bum gzhung / gsoldatshosdogs bde chen sogs bas ba mang tho dang thab bsu'ang snga phyi ra gsum lhag byung / de nayosku 'bu.oṃbyams pa gling gi grwa mang gis ser 'phreng bcas sku 'khor dang bcas 'jam dbyangs sgar bar myag ba bas/ paṇa— chen nango ma sgang nas sne lin mtsho gtu gzab pa'i dkar spro dado paṇa chenarte mchog sprul rin po che nas mjal 'phrad zhus/ sku 'bugatshogs chen sogs so sos sder skal phul ba bzhes/ tshes bcu'i nyin paṇa chen mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che la gzim chung mjal — 32 4

khamatshothog maṇ+ḍal/ sgrol dkar thang sku dang / sku gsung thugs rten/ rgya dngul rta rmig ma gcig gser srang gsum sogs phul/tshes bcu gcig nas paṇa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang sprul kun kozigs nyi ma oṃchog gisasarjeco'adi bo'i zhabs rdul spyi bor h+langasatshute dam pa'i chos kyi thadud rtsir rolo ba'i gsola'adebs dodzo 'brel rim par chos kyi 'khor lo bskoracab ni/ lam ri/0oṃsdus don gyi steng nas lam khrid/ skyabs khrid rgyas pa/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrido/ tshes bco rngo gser sdong chen mo'i bar steng nas bcu tshogs kyi dbus su rab byung dang tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa phul b.ro paṇi tshen mchog gi sprul ba'i skyo rin po chesabyog sero bubajisgo.ā+oṃso/ gser srang gangaspyo/ rgya dpulardo tshad brgyad sorigs dngos rdzas kyi 'bumu ba spam oṃtho ba phulag tshes bcu drug nyin 'jigs byed sta gon gnang / de nyin paṇa chen nang ma sgang dang sku nabum lhan rgyas kyigorje 'di sdor glamachod tshospo/sa 'khor dadz+wa bcasartepa'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs dang 'brel maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsu nga 6 gas rten/ rin tsheno dang bo spong brgya/ rgya dngul rta rmig ma bzhi/ phrug sogs dngos 'bul rgya chen bstar/ snonas paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po tshe sogayol grub rgyal tshe dbang / 'jigs byed dpa' cigamo 325

'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ bde mchog lo hu ba rnams kyi dbang nyi ma re rer gnang / de'i bar du zhwa dmar sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil dang lus dkyil gyi dbang gnang / zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig nas dbu btsugs te paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po che sogs la grub rgyal tshe dbang / rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ sgrol dkar ljang /sgru 'jam dbyangs dkar ser/ mgon po dang chos rgyal/ lha mo/ bag tse/ 'jam lugs tshe dbang sogs gnang ngo smras pa/ lung dang rtogs pa'i g.yu ral mkha' la 'phyo/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sder 'phring rab g.yo bas/ /rgol ngan ri dwags tshogs kyi snying rtsa 'dar/ /thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba khyod min su/ /'phrin las nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od chen la/ /phrag dog spar mos khebs pa'i skabs bralha zhing / /mdzad 'phrin 'od chen mthong ba'i skal med 'gas/ /rang mthong mun pa'i khung bur 'khun sgra sgrog /sna tshogs 'od can nub rir yib na yang / /slar yang shar ri'i rtse ru 'phags pa bzhin/ /paṇa chen gong ma 'da' ba'i tshul bstan kyang / /yang sprul nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'dzum zhal ngom/ /sku tshe du mar 'brel ba'i rten 'brel 326

gyis/ /rje 'di spyan drangs gtsug gi nor bur bsten/ /'cho med bcud la rnam sad rol ba bzhin/ /mdo sngags bdud rtsi'i bgo skal ngoms med bzhes/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las bstan don rlabs — chen mdzad bzhin pa dang chabs cig paṇa chen mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu shar ri'i rtser drangs te mdzad 'phrin 'od brgya'i sgo ske phyes pa'i sarga ste bcu bzhi ba'o/ / sna —blar yang sku 'bum phyogs su zhabs kyis bcags te 7 paṇa chen mchog sogs sdod ldan rnams la zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mtha' dag bum pa gang byos tshul du gnang ba sogs kyi sarga/ 'jigs pa brgya yis zin pa'i skye 'gro la/ /'gog med thugs rje'i sprin chen ba gam las/ /'phrin las gru char 'jo ba rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /zhabs pad byang chub bar du gtsug gis bsten/ /nam mkha'i mtha' la tshad bzung ma mchis shing / /dam pa'i mdzad 'phrin mtha' la'ang tshad ma mchis/ /de'i 3lha7

phyir tshun mthong sbyod tshul ga la zhig /'on spyang rang skal chu thigs tsam zhig brjod/ /de nam gzhan 'ga' zhig/ la bla ma mchod pa'i khrid bsdus pa zhig bstsal te nyer lnga la sku 'bum byu — gzhung dang paṇa chen na—nga ma sgang bcas kyisa.er 'phreng dang /bla sbrul logam kyi sa stabasaskyelagyisalab tshe ka bzhi'ibar phe bas / lab tse ka bzhir bza shis kyi se tog gtor/ lam tsam phebs byams pa dag gis lam nor nas phyir skyel thab steng du slebs pa la skyel ma sogs kyisarten 'brel legs zhes dga' smo byed pa — byung / de nyid mchod rten skas/ myi'i nangagapar hor rgya/de'i phyi nyin gsang sngages bde chen du phebs 'byor byung / lam bar kun tu dgon pa dang sde 'bangs sngags sgar bcas kyis so sor thab bsu rta bsu bcas kyis brel zing che ba byung / dgon der dpa' cig dang kun rig gi dbang gnang / bsnyen rdzogs mang bo zhig bsgrubs/ dam can srog gtad dang tshe dbang bstsal/ chos grwa gamar ba'i nang nas 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo bshad khrid dang bla ma mchod pa'i khrid gnang / gso sbyong sī phebs nas mdo skasungs/ de skabs dgon pa re rer sku 'gyed dang chos bka' gang 'tshams re gnang / rtor rgyar khri ka'i bla sprul ser skya mang bo byung bas de dag gi ladun ma bskang / de 328

nas phyi lam mchod rten skas la phebs skabs sgo rtse'i ri rtse nas sprin dkar zhig glo bur du byung ba'i nang nas 'brug grags shing kha char zim bu zhig bab ste sbrin dkar des khong gi ne+ephebs byams la bskor ba byas nas nyi ma cung zad kyang ma sgrib pa ni der gnas kyi lhas bsu ma byas par gor ma chag mchod rten skas der 'jigs byed bsnyen chen gyi khrid/ sgrol dkar/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ rgyan 'jug gi lung gnang ba dang tshogs mang lha rjelpoganang 'ga' gnang / phyi nyin kun gyis lam bcos chibs skyel sogs tshegs chen pos bsgrubs/ de nas gi tsha dgon gyim dgon chen la 'gran bathod pa'i rta bsu dang thathā bsu ser 'phyeng bcas rdi tshar 'byor/ khong zhwa dmar tshang gtsos tshang mas nyin shas bzhugs dgos zhes u tshugs byas mod sku brel dbang gis de nyid tsam du bzhugs nas dpa' cig gi dbang gnang / khong dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po grags pa rgya mtsho la zhal 'dzoms gnang nasa'aphros gleng dmar/ phyi'i nangs phar zhong shan du be+ebs/ ja thab blangs nas zhong shan lha chen gyi mdun nartswakhong byang phyogs su phebs nas chos ldan gyi bgyi ba mtha' dag byang chub tu bsngo ba'i phyir bla slob thams cad nas bla mchod dang smon— lam gsungs shing rdi tsha'i dge bshes dag la sems bskyed kyi 329

bgro gleng byed bcug ste der zhag bzhugs gnang / sku zhabs gzim chen dang brtson 'grus gnyis la 'bod mi byung bas phyir 5btegs/ phyi'i/ nangs par ra dzas thab bsu byas/ ka mdo nas bsu ba ser 'phreng dang thon jing dang rab brtan gyi ja zhus blongs ste dgon par babs/ phyi'i nangs par zam pa brgyud de kwa ring ba rnamasarikyi bsu ba dang / de phyogs kyi sde so so'i ja thab bzhes/khong 'jigs med bas ma gtan pa'i slob ma rnams mjal bar byon ste khong nas yang bskyar 'tshams zhus phul ba sogs bzhes/sngar khong rin po che sku 'khrungs sa'i mchod rten che ba'i 'khor yug tu 'dom so gnyis yod pa zhig bzhengs grub pa la dus 'khor gyi sgo nas rab gnas gnang ste dga' ston tu phrug gcig sgor mo brgya/ a shu kha dar bcas bstsal te dgon steng du phebs/dgon spyi dang khong rang gi tsho ba'i ja zhus blangs/ nangs par 'du khang nang nas dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gnang / ser skya yongs la mjal kha gnang nas lam du btegs/ de nas bis mdo'i gzhung gi ja thab blangs/ de nub shel dgon dang sho 'phong sde ba kha shas kyis gsol ston zhus thog der zhag bzhugs gnang /phyi'i nangs par dge 'phel thang sgar du bzhugs/ 'od zer can ma'i rjes gnang bstsal/ phyi nyin nangs star rgan gya'i rta thab 330

kyis bsu ba bya sa/ der cha gsum dang drug cu ba gsungs/ shasnya'i smon lam dang / gang ser ma gsungs nas dmag la rab gnas mdzad/ zla ba lnga ba'i bcu gcig la gdan sar 'byo ra/ bco lnga la a lags thur ma tshang dang dus 'khor dge bskos sogs la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / khong gi rten rnams 'du khang steng du spyan drangs pa dang / byams pa dngaci 'jam dbyangs la gser gso gnang ste rje'i lha khang du bzhugs su gsol/ stong dzi sku'i gzungs 'jug gi 'phro skyong ba sogs thugs brel che ba'i ngang —nas thog ma'i blo sbyong / blo sbyong don bdun ma dang tshigs brgyad cim rnams kyi khrid/ tshe dbang / sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang 'ga' bstsal/ zla ba drug pa'i nyer gsum nas sdi de lam gyi khrid kyi dbu btsugs/ zla ba bdun pa tshes nas khri ka'i tshul khrims kyis zhus ngor bla mchone dang phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid nyin drug la gnang / gsar bu 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor 'ja/ma dbyangs dkar bo/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ ri khrod pa zhig gis zhus ngor thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / gzhan zhig gis —zhus ngor tshe dbang dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ dpa' ris pa tshang gis zhus ngor bla ma lnga bcu ba'i bshad lung gnang /33hūṃ

nyer brgyad nas smad rgyud grwa tshang gi rgyud khang nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ bde mchog dang gsang 'dus kyi dbang / sgrol dkar ljang / rig byedaphyom/mgon chos/ dzasnya la dkaraḥdamar/ gnas bcu rnamasaukyi rjeso ga(spong dang lung kha shas bstsal/ a mchog r+sā rigos shig gis zhus ngor skyabs khrid/ bla mchod kyi khrid gnang / 'cham gsar slob rnams la dpa' cig gi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rdzes gnang / mgon chos kyi lung bcas bstsal/ nom chi mkhan pos zhus ngor yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i bshad lung / ra rgya'i grwa rigs shig gis zhus ngor dril bu musadakyil gyi dbang / r+pāg dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ a mchog mtshan nyid dgon gyi grwa ba zhig gis zhus ngor thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang dang de'i cho ga'i lung / bla ma dkor bo tshang gis zhus ngor 'jigayobyed dmar bo'i rjes ba/nang lung khri da bcas/ smad sog zhig gisauzhus ngor rta mgrin gsango sgrub kyi dbang / bag tse'i rjogag nang bstsal/ de'i mtshams nas sngar gyi la ma rim bde lapo'aphro bcu gcig bcu gnyis nyin gnyis tshwaganang / phyag mdzod chen mos zhus ngor gsang 'dus dang 'khor chen gyi dbang gnang / 3332
