tshar rgyam gyis zhus ngor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i gzhung bsrangs kyi bshad lung gnang / bco lnga la lam khrid kyi mjug grub/ bcu drug nas nyin gnyis la man ngagartsilhan thabs kyi lung dang bcu dgu nas gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung / bla ma lnga bcu ba'i bshad lung / 'jigayobyid bsnyen khrid dang de'i skor gyi lung tshang ma/sgrol ma'i pra 'beb/ dpa' cig zhi khro sprags sgrub/ thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi khrid gnang / nyer ga nyis la theg chen gso sbyong blangs shing srog blu gnang / nyer lnganyar drug gnyis la lhan thabs kyi 'asdo gsungs/ de nas nyin shas la sku bsnyun tshul bzhes pa la gyi gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gis gsung bkod gnang ste tshogs chen nas nyin gsum la sgrol dkar snyi nga bo bsgrubs pa'i mjug tu 'du khang nang nas brtan bzhugs phul te dngul rdo tshad gcig phul ba spongs stegs la 'jog ga—nang mdzad/ phyi'i nangs par kye rdor grwa tshang gis brtan bzhugs phul/ sku bskun tshul bzhes pa'i grags pa kun tu mched nas thams cad rtab rtab por gyur te sku 'bum nas paṇa chen thams ’ cad mkhyen pa'i gsol dpon chen mo dang yongs 'dzin sogs zhabs gras che chung dmag mi bcas mi grangs nyi shu phebs nas gser dngul gos phrug bcas brtan bzhugs phul te skyabs 333

mgon paṇa chen gong ma mdo smad du byon 'phral lan gru dang /de rjes su nyid ṭ+wāṃ wang gi gzhi thog nas kyang bka' chos ches nan gyis zhu 'bul bcas gnang ba kun sku tshe 'di bar gzigs par nges pas ring du 'tsho zhing gzhis dgos zhes zhu ba nan che ba phul bas sku rim gyis dwangs ngos nas bka' chos du ma gnang nas rje'i lha khang gi 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi stong sku legs grub byung rjes sku mtshams bsdams te rgyun gyi zhal 'don thugs dam la gzhol zhing bzhugs/ dgung grangs brgyad cu ba rab rgyal shing pho byi ba'i lo'i gnam lo gsar bzhad la chos dpal zhing gi bla ma tshogs 'du dga' ston la phebs/ tshes lngar tshe dbang gnang / khyim pa pho mo mang bo zhig bsnyen gnas dang dge bsnyen la bkod/ byang rgyud nas sku phyogs thal shul rinajipo che dang lwa mo zhabs drung dkar bo sku zhabs zhwa dmar rin po che/ a rol rin po che sogs kyis brgyad cu'i ba yar la dngos skyes dang tshe'i bum sgrub sogs 'bul du byon byung / snga phyir ching wang bkra shis tshe ring gis zhus ngor sgrol dkar/ dur khrod bdag po rnams kyi rjes gnang /'dan sprul skus zhus ngor tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang / gzhan gyis zhus ngor skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ 'dul ba rgyu mtsho'i snying bo'i—bye34

bshad lung / spyod 'jug chen mo'i lung / zam tsha tshang cin dkar tshang / shar ba rnams re res zhus ngor tshe dbang gnang /zla ba gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la khong gis 7 gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la dngul sgor stong dang dngul rdo tshad gsum/ phrug bub bcu rnams phul/ tshur gong sa mchog gis brgyad cu'i gya ston la gdan 'dren bsu bkod rol mo bcas bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas gnang ba'i steng dngul rdo tshad lnga/ maṇ+ḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten bcas phul/ khong rang nyid kyis tshogs chen dang / ri khrod bzhi sogs tshogs pa thams cad la ja thug dang 'gyed dngul sgor gcig dang khron bzhi re phul/ tshogs ḍachen dang grwa tshang so so nas sder skal phul/ tshes bco lnga la 7 gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gis tshe dbang zhus/ dngul rdo tshad gsum phul/ nyi shu nas gzhan gyis zhus ngor dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog gi phyi dkyil— dang lus dkyil gyi dbang dang / da be+en sa snyan brgyud kyi gcod dbang / zab don gcod da bang rnams gnang / nyer drug nas rnga ba dkon stan dang sde dge'i a lags gnyis kyis zhus ngor bla mchod dang phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid bstsal/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis nas dme shul mu to rin po ches zhus ngor lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung nyin bdun la gnang / de nas zhi ba nam 335

mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang / ma cig khros ma'i dbang / dben sa snyan brgyud rdzigacod dbang / sgrol dkar rjes gnang rnams dngang/ gtor ma brgya rtsa da rdo 'pho khrid da pa' bo g.yul 'jug gi khriskaganang / tshes bco lnga nasauje'i lha khang gi rton/ rnams la gar+sāng 'dusardzikyi sgo nasarab gnayorgyas par gnang rgyur rgyud grwa ba kha shos gdan drangs te rab gnaspogyis pa dang / nyung bshags phyag mchod/ bstodrug nas lam mchog snying bo'i bshad lung gnang / nyer lnga nas ba de lam khrid kyi dbu btsugs nas gnang /blosbyong nyi ma'i 'od ze ra/ thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi khrid/ mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi tsong gnadzo/ zla ba baṣ+ka—ba'i bak+ṣiṃganyis nas 'jigs byed bsnyen gyi khrid/ baṣ+ka gas nga 'jigs gsum gyi sngagagabatu/ ni gu'i chos drug girdzikhrid/ba ṭagocan gyi zhing mdo'i lung / mkha' myung sngags btu rnams bstsal/ tshes bco lnga labasgru ba bya brgya dang sum cu tshigs snga phyi'i sdob pa la bkod/ theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom lung gnang / bla ba lnga ba'i nang sngags rim chen mo'i bshad rmung / rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung rdo lag brgyud me dang sbrags pa/ nyer lnga natsegacod dbang / bsnyen rdzogs/ thar chen gyi lung sogs dang bsnyen chen gyi khrid gnang / zla padun pa'i tshes gcig la 'du 336

khang chen mo'i steng dge ldan lha khang nang du sgra mi snyan gyi tshi daphag mdatshukyi skya mi tshad tsayobazhugs/ tshes gsum la sku 'bum bla(masakhasashas kyis zhus ngor rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ dga' ldan lha ba rgya ma'i khrid bcas bstsal/ de skabs rje'i lha khangartsodu/ nye ba'i srasamebargyad kyi nang tshan phyag rdor gyi sku ban ngasri nas bzhugs/ mdzod daṣ+kastod ma'i bla spul kha shespokyis zhus ngorartsotshe dbang / 'jam dkor rjes gnang / kun rispu gi daspung sogs gnang / sde dge a lags kyis zhus ngor bde mchog sngags btu/ tsa yu sgaraspyobangarnamasakyis zhus ngor dam can srog gtad/ rdo ramamu pa spu shod pa dkaun mchog rgya mtshosartezhus ngor mkha' spyod bamaskyed rdzogs kyi — cikhrid/ sheladagon babyu'aspur dpa' cig gi dbang / 'jigartswagled bsnyen khrid/ zlob brgyad pa'i bcu dgu la reb kong a rol rin po ches zhus ngor dri med rnam gnyis kyi dbang / bu nai shri'i gcodadabang gnang / zam tsha gsor khri dzul ba'i sku rin po che dang a lags stag sgotshang sogasaspyorngilobasnyen khrid gnang / nyer gsum nasardzinyin gsum la sngagaspokyi spyi don gyi lung bshad gnang /nyar lnganas lagorim chen mo'i bshad lung gaspyo nga / zla b.ragu ba'i bcu gcig nasarim r+pār za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi khrid/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i khrid dardo mdzod rtsa'i lung 337

gnang / phyag mdzod mkhan po'i sprul skus zhus ngor dpa' cig bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid gnang / rnga ba'i sgo mang sgaratsho ba kha shas la rig byed ma'i rjes gnang dang / skusnyan grags tshang sogs la rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan gsung gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi khrid sogs gnang / a lags gzhu shub tshang gis zhus ngor me tog bcud len/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ 'pho khrid dpa' bo g.yul 'jug rnams kyi khrid/ 'jam dkar las tshogs kyi khrid gnang / rgya yag sprul ba'i sku rin po che/ byabs khrus mkhan po/ khros tring sogs mi sna gdan 'dren pa 'byor/ nyer gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs du ma bsgrubs/ dben sa'i gcod dbang bstsal /zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid gnang / de nas sku mtshams bsdams te rgyun gyi thugs dam sgom sgrub la gzhol bar gyur/ dgung grangs gya gcig pa rab rgyal me pho khyi'i lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes bco lnga la lha mo nyin gyi shing za tshang sogs bsgrub bya dgu bsnyen par rdzogs/ che ba tshang sprul sku chung ngu rab tu byung /bcu bdun nas lam gtso'i bshad khrid/ thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'jam dkar zhi khro sbrags sgrub/ rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams kyi khrid bstsal/ gung ru tshang gis zhus ngor seng gdong 338

ma'i rjes gnang / khri zur dme shul mu to sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhus ngor lam mchog snying bo/ klu'i bum gter/ rgyal mtshan thod 'khor me tog bcud len rnams kyi khrid/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la dpa' ris pa tshang gi sprul sku dang / nyang tshang sprul sku/ grwa tshang dge bskul sog po'i tshul khrims rnams kyis zhus ngor grub rgyal tshe dbang gnang / tshes gnyis la thugs rje chen po'i dbang / tshes gsum la rdor sems sgom bzlas dang thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis kyi khrid/ tshes bco lnga lagyigong sa skyabs mgon rin po che'i thugs bzhed bzhin mchod rten sa sgang nas khong nyid kyis dbu mdzad/ 7 gong sa skyabs mgon rin po che'i gtsos/ khri gdan zur/ bla sprul dge bshes che khag rnams kyis gso sbyong mdzad/ rje nyid kyis gso sbyong gi mdo gsungs/ spyi nas brgyad stong ba tshar gcig gsungs/ tshes bcu bdun la kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po ches gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar sku 'bum du chibs bsgyur gnang / lam bar bis mdo dgon nas 'jigs byed dpa' cig sta gon dang bcas/ ka mdo dgon par shasnya la'i smon lam gyi lung bstsal/ra rdzi sde spyi nas zhus ngor char 'beb mdzad pas kha ba chen po yid tshim pa babs/ zhong shan lha chen gyi mdun nas 'ga' zhig gi bye39

'dod mos ltar dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung / rdi tshwa dgon par bzhugs gral thog dge bshes gathis kyis tshoshas gleng byas pas thugs dgyes pa cimadzad/ 'du khang du zhwa dmar sbru'athaba'i rtsa rin smo che gtsos bla grwa thams dbyu lko dga' lhan lha brgyu ma'i khrid kanang / nyer lnga la rtsa'abum rtu spyag phebs/ 'jam dbyangs sgar ba na sa gyi paṇa chen mamog sbrul rin po che dang mjal 'phrad skabs mjal dar rtse sprod gnang ste yab sras gnyis ka bugs dgyes pa'i rtser son mdzad/ — snyi nyin nas nyin gsum la lhod bzhugs gnang / nyer bāgu la slob ma rjes 'dzin dang lung 'ag 'a zhig ba stsal/ bla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la 4sa chog mdza da/ tshes gsum nas byang chub bde lam gyi khrid 3na bcur gnang/ / ji tshes bcu gsum la dus 'khor gyi bdag 'jug bzhes te tshes bcu bzhi la slob sta gon mdzad/ bco lnga la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa ltar 'ardug pa'i dbang bdun dang bcu drug la gong ma gong chen/ bcu bdun la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang bstsal te mjug snyo tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshim pa drug shan du rol/ 7 kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po che nas maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa yid 'phrog pa mdzad pas zhal nas sku na ha cang phra ba'i skabs mi mang gi dbus sabag tsha ba med prer spyo 340

gsung gdangs dang spobs pa mtho ba 'di 'dra dam pa'i rang dzertags yin pas ya mtshan che zhes dgyes pa cher mdzad/ tshes bco brgyad la grub rgyal tshe dbang gnang / a ri ga chan hus zhus ngor rig byed ma'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshesabacu dgu la bsgrub bya brgya lhag la tshigs snga ma dge tshul dang phyi nyin bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ so thar gyi mdo'i lung kyang bstsal/ nyi shu'i nyin ru ngan a lags kyis zhus ngor nyung 'dus la 'jigs byed bsnyen sgrub sgrags ma'i khrid gnang / nyer gcig nyin mi tra'i dbang gi sta gon sdon du btang ste nyer gnyis nas gshed dmar lha bcu gsum nas bzung rim par gnang bas zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes drug gi snga dro bla med skor grub/ phyi dro rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang gi sta gon sbyong rgyud kun rig ltar dang / gnang rgyun ltar gtsug dgu rdor 'phreng nas tshur bsnan/ phyag na rdo rje la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba dang / phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis so sor phye ste sbyong—rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu'i dbang mi tra'i dkyus spyi zur gcig 'thus kyi tshul du thar rtse'i dkyil chog dang sde khri'i gsung ltar gnang / khams gsum rnam rgyal nas spyi bka' ltar gnang / bcu gnyis bcu gsum la sku 'khrugs lta bu bzhes/bcu bzhi bco lnga gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs kyi dbang gis dbang ma chi 4lha

ga nang kyang bum pa phur gtor sogs ma chag pa mdzad/ nyin gnyis la lwa mo'i zhabs drung dkar bo dang or tu sa'i zhabs drung sogs kyis zhus ngor bsgrub bya brgyad cu tshigs snga phyi'i bslab pa la bkod/ bco lnga'i phyi dro bla mchod phyag chen thags pa'i dbu tshugs/ tshes bcu drug nas mi tra'i dkyus la zhugs te nyi shu'i nyin rnal 'byor rgyud rdzogs te bya spyod kyi sta gon mdzad/ nyer bzhi'i nyin mi tra'i dbang yongs rdzog sa kyi mjug tu tshogs la rol/ a kyā tshang dang gser tog tshang sogs kyis zhus ngor nyer lnga la dben sa'i gcod dbang / snyan brgyud gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ nyer drug la khros nag gi dbang dang gcod khrid kyang rgyas par bstsal/ nyer bdun la sbyong rgyud lhag galha chen brgyad dang 'jigs byed dgu bskor gyi dbang gnyi sa/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes nas blu mchod phyag chen sprags pa'i khrid kyi mjugaske grub/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig la rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang sta gon dang de'i mjug tu dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīk+ka tshig don rab gsal steng nas rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi khrid kyang bstsal/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gi mjug grub/ de'i seng bar rnams su ka thog sprul sku dang lwa mo'i phyag mdzod gnyis kyis zhus ngor thugs bzhed 'grub ba'i smon tshig cig bka' rtsom 343

mdzod/ dwags po sgom chin gyi lam rim legs gsung kun gyi nying khu'i lung dang / 'di skabs kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po che'i thog ma'i bka' rtsom tshigs bcad kyi 'grel ba'ang bka' rtsom gnang / 'di skabs gsung rtsom mdzad par dgongs te saṃ ṭa phyag tu bsnams pa na ja sag blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis ba so la brkos pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs mkhyid gang tsam zhig phul bas de'i rten 'brel la ji6 bsalonas/ bde stong dbyings su gdengs pa ma he'i zhal zhes sogs kyi mchod brjod de bris pa yin zhes zhal nas dngos su phebs/ nyi shu tham pa dang nyer gcig la phyag chen gyi khridajiganang /nyer gnyis la sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang gi dbu — btsugs te rim bzhin gnang / dbus nas drung chen blo rgyam pa/ shar rtse mkhan po sogs paṇa chen rin po che gdan 'dren du cho'abyor gdong / 7 kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po che myur du gdan sarachibs bsgyur dgos tshul sogs kyi don las brtsams pa'i gyi rgyal dbang mchog dang bodashu srid skyong stag brag rin po che/ dga' ldan khri las thog pa/ bka' phyag lhan rgyas/bla ma byams pa rin po che'i mchog sprul dang gzhung sogs kyis bskur ba'i phyag yig rnams dgyes bzhesacimadzad/ zla ba drug 343

pa'i tshes gsum la sgrub thabs rin 'byung mtshams mdzad de 'grel ba don gsal dang / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sgrub dkyil yongs rdzogs kyi lung bstsal/ tshes bzhi la gzungs 'jug gi khrid dang / gung thang gsung dpa' cig bskyed rdzogs kyi lung sogs gnang / tshes lnga la rab gnas kyi khrid dang bka' rtsom 'grel ba legs gsung ka lamimiṅka'i sgra dbyangs kyi lung gnang / tshes drug la theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom lung / gung tshigs grub nas a lags rgya mtsho sprul skus zhus ngor bsgrub bya bcu gnyis bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa la bkod/ tshes bdun la dka' chen tshogs gnyis kyis zhus ngor 'pho khrid dpa' bo g.yul 'jug gi khrid dang thar mdo'i lung bstsal/ tshes brgyad nas rin 'byung gi mtshams nas gnang /tshes bcu gnyis kyi snga dro nyung 'dus la drag po gsum 'dril gyi man ngag bskyed rim gsang chen rol mtsho'i nang ltar gnang /tshes bcu gsum gyi snga dro 7 kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog a kyā ho thog thu/ zhabs drung dkar bo/ zhwa dmar sprul sku rin po che/thal shul rin po che sogs nyung 'dus la 'jigs byed kyi dug dbang bstsal/ nyer bdun la sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs te mthar bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs 'khor bcas 344

dam pa zhong ma'i phyag bzhes ma nor ba mdzad/ nyir brgyad la 7 paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sogs bla sprul nyung 'dus la rin 'byung nang tshan bka' rgya ma gsum gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ nyer dgu la mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu dang phyi dro lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gnang / zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la snga dro tshe dpag med lha dgu dang phyi dro dpa' mo'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal lha lnga'i dbang gnang / tshes gnyis la gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun dang lha mang gnyis kyi dbang gnang / tshes gsum la dam tshig gsum bkod dang sman bla'i dbang gnang / tshes bzhi la rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang gnang / tshes lnga la 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dbang dang tshes drug la kun rig gi dbang bstsal/de dag gi seng bar rnams su mi nyag sprul skus zhus ngor khro bcu'i bsrung bzlog dur be+ed zhabs drung gis zhus ngor ya ma rā dza'i 'grel ba/ 'dan ma sprul skus zhus ngor zhal gyi rtsa sngags dang 'grel ba'i don bstod/ gyikun gzigs mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mgon po'i bstod pa/wang ho thog thus zhus ngor klu dbang rgyal bo'i sbyin sreg rnams bka' rtsom mdzad/ tshes bdun dang brgyad gnyis la ngal gso mdzad/ tshes dgu la a kyā tshang gispozhus ngor nag po spyod pa'i — 345

rmugs kyi brdo mchog gi dbang / tshis bcu la kye rdor lha dgu'i dbang dang / phyi dro 7 paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sogs nyung 'dus la rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed rtsa sngags kyi 'grel ba dang / zhal bzhi ba'i rtsa sngags dang 'grel ba'i don bstod kyi lung yang gnang / tshes bcu gcig la 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs lha bcu dgu'i dbang / tshes bcu gnyis la snga dro a kyā tshang dang gser tog tshang gnyis kyis zhus ngor rgyal thang lugs kyi gcod dbang / pu nai spri'i lugs kyi gcod dbang / phyi dro skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang / tshes bcu gsum nyi na gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po'i dbang gnang / 'di de skabs kyi dbang thams cad kyi mjug tu gnang ba ni thugs dgongs zab par mngon no/ /tshes bcu bzhi bco lnga gnyis la 'jam mgon snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa dge ldan lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos 'jam dbyangs chos bskor kyi rjes gnang khrid dang sgrags te gsung bshad rgya che ba dang bcas bka' sdod gsum ma gtogs cha tshang bar gnang / bka' sdod gsum sprel lor gnang zin stabs 'dir ma gnang / bco lnga'i phyi dror mā yang sman pasazhus ngor gdan zhus su phebs pa'i bkris lhun mkhan po blo bzang shes rab rgya mtsho/ gser khog rgyud pa ngag 346

dbang 'phrin 'a sa rgya mtsho sogs bsgrub bya nyi shu rtsa grangs bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi bslab pa la bkod/ snga phyir bsnyen rdzogs gnang skabs rnams su dad ldan gyi rgya mi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa len mkhan mang du byung / tshes bcu drug la sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sprags kyi rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ khro rgyal gtsug tor 'bar ba/ seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum/ sgra tshad pa'i lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dkar mo thun mong ma yin ba rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi dbu btsugs/ tshes bcu bdun la gsang 'dus dang 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu/ 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdan can dang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yum bcas kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bco brgyad la bde mchog sngags btu'i rjes gnang / phyi dro gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ byang phyogs skye dgu'i 'dren mchog thu'u bkwan mchog sprul skal bzang dam chos nyi ma ched gnyer gyis phebs pa la thugs bzhed dang mthun par thog mar skyabs 'gro dang srad rgyud bla ma'i rnal 'byor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i lung sogs dang / bde mchog bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid nas bzung khong ba'ang bka' chos gsan bzhes mdzad cing / sger gyis bka' chos 'ga' zhu ba mdzad /347

tshes bcu dgu la gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs mjug grub nas bde mchog bskyed rdzogs kyi dbu btsugs/ phyi dro paṇa chen yongs 'dzin rin po ches zhus ngor7 paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang thu'u bkwan rin po che sogs bzhi la dge ldan bstan pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa chos rgyal yang gsang dug ri nag po'i rjes gnang be'u bum gyi lung bcas dang yum lha mo 'od chen 'bar ma'i rjes gnang bcas dgyes bzhin gnang / nyer gsum la snga dro bskyed rdzogs dang phyi dro grub rgyal tshe khrid/ nyer bzhi la 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid mjug grub nas thu'u bkwan rin po ches zhus ngor bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtsa tshig gi 'grel ba snyan brgyud gsang ba'i lde mig gi lung bstsal/ nyer lnga nas nyin gsum la rnam sras bka' bco lnga dang / nyer brgyad la mgon bka' bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang las bar chad kun sel sogs bzhi dang / nyer dgu la bla mgon dbyer med sopo/sa drug gnam gang la 7 gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku don du zi ling du rib tsam phebs dgos byung bar brtengan phyi dro mgon po dbang rgyal gyi rjes gnang gcig pu/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la mgon ljang tshe bdag dang mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs bstsal to/ /tshes gnyis la snga dro dpal ldan gur 34byi

gyi mgon po lha brgyad ma dang / gur khro bcus bskor ba rdo rje brag rdzong ma gnyis kyi rjes gnang / phyi dro sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo bka' bab dgu ldan gyi tshe khrid gzab rgyas bstsal/ tshes gsum la snga dro thu'u bkwan rin po ches zhus ngor rgyal bo sku lnga'i srog gtad/ dam can mgar nag gi srog gtad/ phyi dro spyi chos la sgrol dkar tshe khrid kyi mjug grub/ tshes bzhi la snga dro a kyā sprul ba'i sku rin po ches gsol ba btab par nyung 'dus la rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed rtsa sngags kyi 'grel ba sgron me'i snang ba'i bshad lung smin rgyas dang spyi chos la rje'i gsung steng nas sgra mi snyan gyi tshe khrid/ kun mkhyen bar ba'i yi dam sgrub skor nas 'byung ba ltar gyi gser gyi rdo rje la brten pa'i tshe khrid/ tshar chen gyi rgyun 'khyer steng nas tshe khrid zhag bdun ma'i khrid/ rje'i gsung steng nas 'jigs byed ser bo'i tshe khrid/ lcang skya'i gsung steng nas srad rgyud tshe khrid bcas bstsal/ tshes lnga la thu'u bkwan rin po ches zhus ngor 7 kun gzigs mchog sprul rin po che'i gtsos bla sprul hrag bsdus la mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs khrid kyi dbu btsugs shing 7kun garigs mchog dang lhan cig tu tsan danar ba nas spro sangs rgyas par mdzad/ tshes drug la sngar gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi 'phro dang spyi chos la 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i las 349

tshogs kyi khrid gnang / tshes bdun la mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs dang spyi chos la dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i las tshogs kyi khrid gnang / tshes brgyad la a kyā ho thog thu/ tsha kwan ho thog thu/gser tog no mo han sogs kyis sngar nas gsol ba btab cing /khyad par rgya yag sprul ba'i sku rin po ches nan cher gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig byed ma'i be'u bum gyi khrid/ nyin gung ja sag bla ma o yon blo bzang rgyal mtshan pa'i gtsos zhabs gras spyi nas gsol ba btab pa ltar gdugs dkar byad grol dang mjug tu 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung sogs 'dod mos ltar gyi re ba bskang / tshes dgu la mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs mjug grub nas phyi dro bsnyen khrid dang de skor gyi lung 'ga' zhig gnang /tshes bcu la zhabs zhu byings nas zhus ngor tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing bka' drin du bskyangs/ phyi dro mi nyag zhabs drung legs bshad rgya mtshos zhus ngor jo bstod brgyad cu ba dang gtam rgyud rin chen 'phreng mdzes kyi lung gnang / tshes bcu gcig nyin sku 'bum gzhung nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'du khang chen mor gdan drangs te bla ma mchod pa dang 'brel bar mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs tshogs 'khor bcas rgyas par mdzad/ mkhan po las thog pa mtshan sgrog mkhan chen gyis maṇ+ḍal bshad pa zhus shing 350

dge ṅgedun mang bo dang phyogs nas bka' chos don gnyer gyis byon pa'i bla grwa thams cad la mjal kha gnang / tshes bcu gnyiyo la 'jam dbyangs sgar ba nas 7kun gzigs paṇa mchog gi gtsos zhabs 'brang ba thams cad dang chos nyan pa rnams bcas kyis bla ma mchod pa tshogs 'khor bcas brtan bzhugs maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sku gsung thugs rten sogs dngos 'bul rgya che ba bcas gyi paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rang nyid kyis maṇ+ḍalabashad pa gzab la rgya che ba/ sku na tshod phra yang 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba med par gsung gi gdangs mtho zhing /snyan cing 'jebs la tshig gi gcod mtshams legs pa sogs ngo mtshar zhing yid 'phrog pa mdzad pas tham/sa cad kyi mig nas mchi ma byung ba dang / yab rje dam pa nyid kyang thugs gting nas dgyes pa'i nyams chen po mdzad/ nang sgang lhan rgyas nas yab sras gnyis char la dkar sgo rgyas par bstar thog gyi mchog sprul yid bzhin nor bu la gsan bzhes rgya cher mdzad pa la legs so'i mjal dar kyang phul/ slar yang yab rje dam pa nyid nas kha dar nang mdzod cig methams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag tu phul nas maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa legs po mdzad par ma zad mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang thad nas bstan pa 351

rin po che'i gsos su 'gyur bar mdzad dgos par phobs pa la zhal bzhes kyi bka' lan bzang bo gnange / tshes bcu gsum la yab rje nyid nas gzim chung mjal kha zhus te dbus rdzong dang 'brel bar sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul rta rmig ma bco lnga/gos bub lnga/ phrug bub lnga/ bzhugs gdan/ rgyab yol/ khri khebs/ dkar yol yu ring / ja nag bub lnga/ sog ja bub lnga/ spos bag cha nyi shu/ zur du tshe sku gcig grwa zhabs spyi la dngul rdo tshad gnyis/ sems bskyed mchod pa'i zhal 'debs la dngul sgor nyis brgya 'bul bar mdzad cing / ljags smin bzhes spro yang mnyam gnang mdzad/ phyi dro'i char gtam rgyud rin chen 'phreng mdzes kyi lung rdzogs nas rje'i gsang rnam sogs lung phran mang bo so so'i 'dod mos bzhin gnang / tshes bcu bzhi la thu'u bkwan skal bzang dam chos nyi ma mchog gis zhus ngor mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang / sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sprags ma sogs dang / tshes bco lngar gser gdung chen mor mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas sems bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas smon sems dam bca' can gyi kun gzigs mchog dang thu'u bkwan rin po che sogs bla grwa stong phrag gsum lhag la bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog gi sa bon brtas par mdzad de/ de nas dge ldan 353

bstan 'bar ma'i khrid gnang / sku 'bum nas mgon po'i gtor sgrub btsugs pa'i thebs su dngul rdo tshad bcu dang dngul sgor brgya 'jog pa gnang / tshes bcu drug la thig le bcu drug gi dbang / tshes bcu bdun la mkha' spyod byin rlabs/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang / brgya rtsa'i khrid/ tshes bco brgyad la thu'u bkwan rin po ches zhus ngor rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang dang de'i rjes gnang / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i drang nges zin bris kyi lung gnang / tshes bcu dgu la snga dro 7 paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa la mgon bo snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ rig byed ma'i be+ezu bum gyi mjug grub/ phyi dro zhalabazhi ba dang lha mo'i rjes gnang bstsal/ nyi shu la rgya ra'i lta khrid dang lung kha shas gnang / lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs/ phyi drogyi paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa la dngos 'bul mang bo dang lha dar srid du ring ba bcas phul/ zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer gcig la sku 'bum nas chibs bsgyur gnang / de skabs kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog sku dngos dang / ja sag bla ma/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sogs zhabs zhu che khag rnams 'jam dbyangs sgar bar phebs nas sku skyel mdzad pa sogs bkur bzo rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas bla ma che khag mang bo dang gong gi zhabs zhu thams 353

cad/ sog po wang sogs chibs skyel brgya phrag du ma bcas bsam gtan gling du phyag phebs/ nyer gnyis la snga dro skyabs 'gro sogs kyi lung dang de ka'i 'du khang du dge ldan bstan 'bar ma'i lung bstsal te dge 'dun rnams la 'gyed dang spyi 'jog la dngul sgor brgya dang dngul rta rmig ma gcig gos phrug ja mar/ gdan sogs 'jog par gnang / phyi dror gi tshar phebs/ sgrol dkar thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / de'i tshe khrid/ legs gsung ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs kyi lung bcas bstsal/ nyer gsum la zhwa dmar bla brang du phebs nas snga dro seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang / lo gyon ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid/ dam can srog gtad/ phyi dro dpon tshang nas tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing bstsal/ rdi tsha'i dgon rnying la dngul sgor bco lnga/ dgon gsar la dngul sgor nyer lnga skyabs 'jug zhu rten du 'jog pa gnang / dpon tshang nas zhag bzhugs dang de'i gzhi gsar la rab gnas gnang / nyer bzhir bya khyung du phebs pa dang mnyam du gser gdung zhig gsos kyi ched du ar chog gsung rgyu'i snyan gsan phul nas bdud rtsi 'bab rtags shig yod gsungs/ nyer lnga la ar chog gnang stepabum sgo blangs nas gzigs rtog mdzad/ zhabs nas bang rim gsum tsam blangs dheco354

pa'i mtshan mor bdud rtsi bab pa kun gyis mthong / de nas yor pa tsa na'i sgrub phug tu zhag drug tsam bzhugs/ nyer drug la mchod rten mdun du rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bstsal/nyer bdun la bla ma zhig gis zhus ngor tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon tshig gsar rtsom mdzad/ nyer dgu la nyid kyi thugs dam rten thub sku/ dngul gyi ga'u dang de'i nang du gdung rus thams cad tshud par mdzad nas mchod rten gyi bum nang du bzhugs par mdzad/ bla grwa nyi shu tsam la jis gnang zhig kyang bstsal/ zla ba dgu ba'i tshes gcig la nyid rin po ches gtsos bla grwa nyer lngas rab gnas rta thog ma gsungs/ de dag gi skabs su mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba dang tsan dan gyi sdong bo la me tog dkar bo skyes pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du byung / tshogs dbus su dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gnang / mang mang gis sgrol dkar brtan bzhugs phul bar mjal kha gnang / dge 'dun re re la khron gnyis re'i 'gyed phul/ gser gdung bzhengs thebs su gser srang sum cu so gsum dang zho lnga/ khron lnga brgya/ gdan dkar nyi shu tham pa/ dngul rta rmig ma gnyis bcas gnang / tshes gnyis la bya khyung nas chibs bsgyur te rtsa ring mo brgyud nas ra rdzir phebs/ tshe dbang gnang / sngon dpon po che ba zhig gi pha 355

yinathozer ba'i rgad po rangamu brtan gyi 'du phung ma bde bas 'pho ba zhus par rje nyid kyis 'pho ba gsung bzhin pa'i skabs kho dus las 'das pas thams cad ya mtshan par gyur/ de nas ka mdo lha khang sere bo rnams brgyud de rdo sbis rgya tshang du rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten zhig gsos kyi thebs su 'bru bre lnga brgya dang dngul sgor brgya gnang / tshes brgyad la se chang du 'byor/tshes dgu nas 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed bsnyen gyi khrid/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung sogs gnang ba dang / byams sku la rab gnas mdzad/ gos sku bzhengs thebs la dngul sgor nyis brgya dang dge 'dun re re la khron gnyis dang kha dar re gnang / dkyil 'khor dgon gyi dge 'dun re re la khron re dang kha dar re gnang / tshes bcu gcig la chibs gong du bzhengs te bcu gsum la rang dgon du phyag phebs so/ /smras pa/ rnam dag thugs bskyed smon lam brgya phrag gi/ /'bras bu dus su smin pa'i mthu dpung gis/ /snyigs dus rgud pa'i smag chen rab bcom rnya/ /rgyal bstan pad tshal brtas pa'i ngo mtshar rmad/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang sngar rgyun bzhin/ /chu bo'i rgyun ltar chad med khyad par du/ /356

mdzad mchog gsung gi mdzad pa lha chu'i rgyun/ /chad med bstsal bas thub pa'i gdung 'tshob gyur/ /snang mtha' mi yi zlos gar paṇa chen dang / /thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i yang sprul mchog /bskal bzang dam chos nyi ma la sogs pa'i/ /che ba'i bla sprul kun gyi gtsug gi nor/ /lusbra'i dga' tshal gnyis pa byams gling sogs/ /chos sde du mar zhabs skyes 'khor lo'i rdul/ /bkod de rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos 'khor gyis/ /skye 'gro dpag med 'khor ba'i 'dam las drangs/ /gdul bya dbang rnon bde chen sa la bkod/ /dbang 'bring zhi ba'i bde la rnam par bkod/ /ma smin pa rnams smin lam la bkod deṭ+wāṃ /sdug bsngal khur chen can rnams dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /mdor na lnga bdo'i smag chen bcom dang lhan/ /rdzogs ldan dus ston drangs te snyigs dus 'dir/ /blo bzang grags pa slar yang dngos byon bzhin/ /zab rgyas mdo sngags rin chen thang mar brdal/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las slar yang sku 'bum phyogs su zhabs kyis bcags te gyi paṇa chen mchog sogs snod ldan rnams la zab rgyas kyi 357

gdams pa mtha' dag bum pa gang byos tshul du gnang ba sogs kyi saṅgā ste bco lnga ba'o / / bar ma chad par mdo sngags dam chos kyi char phab ba dang /'du khang chen mo'o gtsang khang sogs bathan pa'i sarga/ 'jigs bral gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor mchog /gzhom med bde chen rtse brgya 'bar ba yis/ /bdud bzhi bcom te 'phrin las 'od dkar gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab mdzad zhabs la 'dud/ /de yi gsang gsum mdzad pa rlabs po che/ /theg gsum 'phags pas brjod kyang zad mtha' bral/ /'on spyang de lal chu thigs tsam zhig ni/ /rang gi bsod nams skal bar brjod par bya/ /de nas bco lnga'i nyin gyi gong sa skyabs mgon rin po che nyid rje nyide kyi sku mdun du mjal 'phrad mdzad par phebs/ bcu dgu la ngag byin rlabs kyi khrid/ nyi shu la gcod khrid sogs gnang / nyer gcig la rmad byung thos bsam gling la grwa jas bsnyen bkur zhus thog dge 'dun re re'i phyag tu khron gsum re dang kha dar re/ grwa tshang gzhan lnga'i dge 'dun re re'i phyag tu khron gnyis dang kha dar bcas phul/ nyer gnyis la b.rūb bya bco lnga tsam bsnyen par rdzogs/ de'i snga dro mgar rtse a 358

lagase thugs brtag bcad/ ri khrod bzhi'i dge 'dun rnams la'ang 'gyed snga ma ltar gnang / zla ba bcu ba'i tshes gcig spyogrub rgyal tshe dbang / gnyis nas 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid smin rgyas/ tshes bzhi la dge tshul dang rab byung bzhi tsam bsgrubs/ tshes brgyad la rje'i lha khang nang du dge 'dun pa bco lnga la 'tsho 'bul gang bzang ngos ltung bshags phyag mchod gsung bcug chos dpal zhing du dge 'dun re rer khron ga sum dang kha dar bcas kyi 'gyed gnang / de'i seng bar nas sku 'bum grwa rigs smad sog cig gis zhus ngor 'jam dbyangs sgrub chog sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gsar rtsom gnang / de nas 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid kyi 'phro gesungs nas bco lnga'i nyin mjug grub/bcu drug la dge 'dunaladar rgyas tshang sogs gzhung rgyugs pa rnams kyis zhus ngor rgyan 'jug gnyis kyi lung gnang / bcu bdun la 'jigs byed sta gon dang rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bco brgyad la 'jigs byed kyi dbang / ba cu dgu la rta mgrin gyi dbang dang mgon po dang bag tse gnyis kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ nyi shu la kun rig gi dbang dang chos rgyal gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ nyer gcig la lha mo'i rjes gnang / nyer gnyis la sman chog chen mo'i lung gnang / nyer brgyad la brgya359

rtsa'i khrid/ nyer dgu la 'gyang ro chung ngus zhus ngor dam can dang tse'u dmar gnyis kyi srog gtad bstsal/ de'i mtshan mor mtshan lam du rje nyid sku 'bum du bzhugs nas khro bcu'i sbyin sreg cig gnang ba'i mdun du gro'i skar ba'i dpon po yod pa shar gsungs/ gnam gang la 7 goja sa skyabs mgon mchog rje nyid kyi gzim shag tu phebs nas gsung 'phros gnang / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la gong sa mchog gis rje nyid nor 'dzin pho brang du gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin phebs nas gnas chung sku rten bab ste rje nyid la gsang lung mang bo zhus/ de nas phyir phebs lam du gnas chung brtsan khang dang dpon tshangaganyis la phebs/tshes gnyis la dngul ra'i dge bshes bsta na 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs brgyad kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi dbu btsugs/tshes gsum la yang gong sa mchog rje 'di ba'i gzim shag tu phebs nas khong rnam gnyis kyi sa 'du khang chen mo zhig gsos kyi ched bka' gros mdzad/ tshes lnga la skyabs mgon mchog dang rje 'dis gtsos khong rnam pa 'gas gdung mdun nas zan bsgyur bar bskyar gso legs rtags bab/ tshes bdun la skyabs mgon mchog yang bskyar rje nyid gyi gzim shag tu phebs par rje nyid nayo'adu khang chen mo zhig gsos kyi khur bzhes rgyu zhal gyis — 360

ba zhis/ yongs 'dzin mkhas dbang dkon mchog bsam 'aspubajitshang gis zhus ngor sgrol dkar thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bcu gnyis kyi dgung dus nas sku mtshams la bzhugs/ nyer bzhi'i dgung mo mtshan lam du rgyud pa grwa tshang klu chog tu phebs pa'i gdugs gsum yod par snang gsungs/dgung grangs gya gnyis pa rab rgyal me mo phag gi lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes gnyis la nye gnas blo bzang bstan 'dzin la reb kong shar tshang la khong nyid mjal 'dod che zhing / de ka'i lcang lung khri rgan tshang nas yang yang gdan 'dren zhus par brten lwa mo bde chen la dang bor bskyod dus rong bo dgon chen du 'gro 'dun yod kyang de skabs rmi lam du lung bsum mdo zhig na khang ba che ba zhig yod pa'i nang kho bsdad 'dug lcang lung khri rgan yang der bzhugs yod par grwa ba zhig gisazudakyil 'khor gyi thig 'bri bzhin pa gsal bar mthong la rim gyis mi gsal bar song ste khong dang thig gnyis kyi bar brag rdo zhig gis chod pa shar gsungs/ brag de phyis shel dgon na yod 'dug de'i stabs mjal ma thub gsungs/ tshes bdun gyi dgung mo mtshan lam du skyabs mgon gong mar khang chung zhig gi nang nas mjal bar thugs cung ma dgyes pa'i rnam pa la dag pa'i rdo rje zer ba'i grwa ba 361

lo bco brgyad pa zhig la ril bu mang bo gnang gi yod par phyag mdzub kyi bar nas ril bu mang bo 'thor ba khong nyid kyi phyag tu bab/ de rjes thugs dgyes nyams mdzad nas rnam gnyis kyis gsung 'phros gnang ba shar gsungs/ tshes brgyad la pye kun gzigs paṇa cachen thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag yig phebs pa la thugs dgyes pa cher mdzad/ nyer lnga'i nyin thu'u bkwan ho thog thu khong gi gzim shag tu phebs nas mjal phrad zhus/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs drung gis zhus ngor 'jam lugs tshe dbang / tshes gnyis la mi g.yo ba dkar sngon gnyis kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs kyi lung / tshes gsum la rgyud stod dge rgan sogs kyis zhus ngor 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid kyi 'phro gsungs/ tshes brgyad la bya khyung gzhung nas gser gdung nang du bzhugs rgyur rje nyid kyi 'dra sku bzhengs pa'i gzungs gzhug la nyid kyi phyag dpe 'grel ba don gsal gnang / tshes dgu la 'du khang chen mor zhig gsos kyi ched bkra shis gso sbyong dang 'brel bar lag gi bla bskos/ tshes bcu la shing gcod pa'i mgo tshugs/ thu'u bkwan rin po ches zhuṅge ngor mkha' spyod lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs/ bcu gcig la lto 'phye'i thig btab/ rje nyid phebs nas cho ga 362

gsungs/ gdung mdun dang mgon khang gnyis la mchod mi dang kha dar phul te snyan gsan phul/ phyir gzim khang du phebs nas rten 'brel legs gsungs/ khros nag gi rjes gnang bstsal/tshes bcu gnyis la zhal gdong snyan can dang bag tse gnyis kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bcu gsum la grub rgyal tshe dbang bstsal/tshes bco lnga nas rdo rams pa bkra shis nyi mas zhus ngor dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid gnang / tshes bcu bdun la lu mo'i zhabs drung dkar bos zhus ngor zhal gyis be'u bum gyi lung gi dbu btsugs/ tshes bcu dgu la rgyud stod dge rgan gyis zhus ngor rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang phyag rdor gtum chen/ dam can seng zhon rnams kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bstsal/ nyi shu nas smad sog smon lam gyis zhus ngor thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang /tshonyer gcig la thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi dbang bcas bstsal/ nyer gnyis la bde chen a lags shig gis zhus ngor bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul kha shas bsgrubs/ nyer bdun la bkra shis nyi mas zhus ngor yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid gnang / zla ba gnyis pa rjes ma'i tshes gcig la smad sog cig gis zhus ngor brgya rtsa'i khrid gnang / tshes gnyis la gcod dbang gnang / 363

tshes bzhi lnga gnyis la sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags/ 'khor chen/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo rnams kyi rjes gnang /lo gyon ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid/ tshes bdun nas blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi khrid/ tshes bcu gcig nas 'du khang chen mo zhig gsos kyi ched du sku mtshams la bzhugs te sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi ba nyin gsum/ mgon po gnas chung gnyis nyi ma re re la gsungs nas tshes bcu drug la sku mtshams grol/ tshes bcu bdun la snga dro zi len blo bzang tshe dbang tshang phebs nas gyi skyabs mgon mchog sku khams ma bde bar yod pas rje nyid nges par phebs dgos zhus par brten nor 'dzin pho brang du phebs te gong sa mchog la rnam 'joms byabs khrus phul zhing drug cu ba gsungs/ nyer gcig la dung bed bla ma bka' 'gyur bas zhus ngor 'jigs byed ser bo'i tshe khrid bstsal/ nyer gsum la snga dro nor 'dzin pho brang du phebs nas gdon tshogs dgu ma dang / drug cu ba/ cha bzhi rnams gsungs te —phyir phebs/ yang gdan 'dren pa yong nas phebs dus 7 gong sa mchog zhal ma 'tsho bar zhing gzhan du gshegs tshar/ nyer bzhi la bla brang nas rje nyid gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te dge bshes rnam pa bzhi dang bcas 'jigs byed bdag 'jug gsungs nas thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i zhal 'don 364

bsngo smon gnad smin dang / dgongs rdzogs la phrug gnyis/ gos chen gcig dngul rta rmig/ ma gcig bcas 'bul gnang mdzad/ myur 'byon gsol 'debs ljags rtsom mdzad/ zla ba 'di'i bcu gcig nas nyin rer sa ts+tsha lnga dang / sgrol dkar gyi sku 'dra nyer gcig thub sku bdun re phyag dpar gnang rgyu'i mgo btsugs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la 7 skyabs mgon mchog gi sku gdung zhugs phebs kyi mgon du gdan drangs pa ltar phebs nas sku gdung bsreg chog gsungs/ tshes drug la sngar gser tog tshang nas zhus pa'i dus 'khor bstod pa'i 'grel ba ljags rtsom grub/ zam tsha ho thog thus zhus ngor bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i gdung dbyangs gsung rtsom gnang / tshes bdun la dam chos kyis zhus ngor skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ tshes brgyad la bzod pa rgya mtshos zhus ngor grub rgyal tshe dbang / tshes bcu gcig nas rdo rams pa bstan pa dar rgyas dang dam chos gnyis kyis zhus ngor bla mchod phyag chen sbrags pa'i khrid/ tshes bco lnga la bsnyen rdzogs drug cu tsam dang dge tshul bzhi bcu bsgrubs/citshes bcu dgu'i nyin mtshan lam du rje nyid khang ba gzhan zhig na yod par nyid kyi thugs la skyabs mgon sku phreng bzhi ba yin snyam pa yod kyang sku la bltas na yin min mi shes pa la 'dir shog bye65

gsungs pasasong ba na don tshan gsum gsungs te gcig khyim gzhi 'di bar rigs rgyud dkon gi yin na gsungs/ gzhan gnyis khong gis ma gsungs/ nyer lnga la smad sog cig gis zhus ngor bde mchog lca i ba'i sta gon dang nyer drug la de'i dbang /nyer bdun la dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang / nyer brgyad la zhi ba nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ nyer dgu la khros nag gi dbang bcas gnang / bla brang phyag mdzod dang zi len tshang / spyi khyab mkhan po bcas kyis zhus shing slar yang rgyud stod tshogs 'dus zhus pa bzhin 7 gong sa mchog gi gsang rnam ljags rtsom gyi dbu btsugs/blo ba bzhi ba'i tshes gcig la brgya rtsa'i khrid/ tshes drug bdun gnyis la nom chi mkhan pos zhus ngor gsol mchod dam rol mtsho gsung rtsom mdzad/ tshes brgyad la gsang rnam ljags rtsom grub ste phyag mdzod tshang phebs nas yar gdan 'dren zhus/ bcu gsum nas mu to sprul ba'i skus zhus ngor 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid/ bco lnga'i nyin bsnyen rdzogs drug cu tsam dang dge tshul bzhi bcu bsgrubs/ bcu drug nas dge bshes bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos zhus ngor lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan gyi khrid gzab rgyas gnang / bco brgyad la mkhas dbang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog bsam 'grub pas zhus ngor rgya ra'i lta khrid dang skyabs mgon 3 66

mchog gi gsang rnam dang logs gsung ka la t+paṅka' sgra dbyangs rnams kyi lung gnang / bcu dgu'i nam ma langs tsam na mtshan lam du gyi gong sa kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po ches gser gyi mchod rten zhig phul khong nyid la brtan bzhugs 'bul ba shar gsungs/ nyin kha shas kyi sngon du sku gzugs cung ma bde bar yod pa thugs bskyed mdzad 'phrin de'i mthus myur du dwangs song / de'i nyin zhu ba po med kyang gdan sa 'dir yod na legs gsungs nas ba so'i lta khrid bstsal/ de nas zla ba rjes ma'i tshes kyi bar rje rang nyid kyi rnam thar sa bon bsgrigs/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes gcig la lde chung ba chos grags kyis zhus ngor grub rgyal tshe dbang bstsal/ tshes bzhi la bsgrub bya lnga tsam rab byung dang dge tshul la bkod/ tshes bcu gcig la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang dang skyabs mgon mchog gi gsang rnam gyi lung gnang /tshes bco lnga nas dpa' ris pa tshang dang bstan pa dar rgyas gnyis kyis zhus ngor bde lam gyi khrid gnang ba nyer gcig la grub/ nyer gnyisacil 'pho khrid gnang / nyer bzhi nas rgyud smad 'dus spyis zhus ngor chos spyod rab gsal gyi lung gnang / nyer bdun nas zhu ba po de'i ngor bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung gnang / nyer brgyad la 'du khang phug gi byams mgon mdun gyi — 36 7

nyi sras brgyad kyi gcig zhig gsos kyi dbu brtsams te gzungs gzhug la brgyad stong ba dang skya paṇa chen sku gong ma'i phyag nas phebs pa'i rten 'dus la rta byas pa'i 'jim par paṇa chen de nyid kyi 'dra dpar dang / ston pa'i sku/ paṇa chen 'di ba'i phyag tsha dang / khong rang nyid kyi phyag tsha ston pa'i sku bcas rten sna mang bo bzhugs su gsol/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gsum rme bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bshad lung mjug grub/ tshes bzhi la dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi 'du khang nang nas grwa tshang de dang slob ma byings nas brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes drug la gong sa mchog gis phul ba'i rdza khog dang stag ge shong ma tshang gi gsol tog gnyis kyi nangu du gter rdzas kyis bkang ste mgon khang byams pa'i khri nang du gter du sbas/ tshes bcu gcig nyin mgon khang gi mgon chos 'jigs gsum bzhugs sa spor ched snyan dar phul/ tshes bco brgyad nas gso rig gzhan phan gling gi 'dus spyis zhus ngor rje'i lha khang nas rta mgrin pad+ma gar dbang gi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub /sman bla/ mi 'khrugs pa rnams kyi dbang / rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ mgon chos/ zhang blon rnams kyi rjes gnang bcas bstsal ba nyer gsum la grub/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la khong rang 368

nyid kyi phyag daspi bka' bstan bcos yongs rdzogs/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum tshar gcig bcas kun mkhyen gong ma'i sku gdung rmechod rten gyi khri nang du bzhugs/ tshes brgyad la bsgrub bya gsum bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ tshes bcu bzhi la smad sog blo gros nyi mas zhus ngor mkha' spyod byin rlabs/ bco lnga la sku lnga'i srog gtad/ bcu drug la bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/bcu bdun la bde mchog lus dkyil/ bco brgyad la mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ bcu dgu la bod gzhung mi drag cig gis zhus ngor tshe dbang / phyi dro bskyed rdzogs kyi 'phro gsungs/nyer brgyad la mtshan lam du khong sa phyogs mi shes pa zhig tu bzhugs yod par bltas tshod la paṇa chen rin po che yin rgyu la bsam ngor skyabs mgon yin snyam/ zhabs zhu 'ga' 'dug kyad gling sprul sogs min 'dug sprul sku de nyid ha cang chung zhing mtsho chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gi khar na bza' dang sku 'dra zhig bkru bzhin phar phebs tshur phebs byas nas bzhugs 'dug mtsho de'i nang na kha dog mi 'dra ba'i mtsho sna lnga dbus dang phyogs bzhir yod/ mtsho de'i rgya khyon sku 'bum dang bla brang gi bar gyi sa khyon lta bu rgya che ba'i nang du 'don yon lnga sogs mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtams 'dug369

mtsho de lag tu blang na blang chog la bzhag na bzhag chog pa zhig rmis/ khong gi thugs la skyabs mgon yang sprul 'khrungs pa e yin snyam yang zla ba drug las ma song bas min rgyu red/ ces nye gnos blo bzang bstarge 'dzin la gsungs/ nyer dgu nas 'cham bra grwa tshang gis zhus ngor sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i 'jigs byed dpa' —cig gi dbang / chos rgyal phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bcas nyin gnyis la bstsal/ zla ba dgu ba'i tshes gcig la smad sog su nyid pa zhig gis zhus ngor 'jam lugs tshe dbang / stag phu'i sgrol ma phyi nang gnyis/ tshes gsum la 'kha' spyod ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bstsal/ tshes bcu la tshogs chen mgon khang du phebs nas mgon chos 'jigs gsum la na bza' phul/ 'du khang rtse'i rgya phibs kyi dbur rdo rje dang bum pa btsugs/ tshes bco lnga la sa gzhan gyi grwa ba 'ga' la bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/ nyer gnyis la'ang bsgrub bya 'ga' la bsnyen rdzogs gzhi sgrub gnang / zla spro baṃcu ba'i tshes gcig la kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba'i sku gdung mchod rten gsar bzhengs la bkra shis snye ma'i steng nas rab gnasanyin gang mang gnang / tshes brgyad la thos bsam glingo la grwa ja btang / 'di yan la grwa ja bzhi bcu zhe brgyad btang zhes bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsungs/ grwa tshang gzhan la yang de 370

mtshungs yin pas de gcig pu yang bsam gyis mi khyab/ tshes bcu nas sman pa grwa tshang la sman gyi rgyud chung gsum gyi lung gnang / de nyin nas dge bshes rnam pa bdun la gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid kyi dbu btsugs/ tshes bco lnga la bsgrub bya bcu bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer gnyis la rtags rigs 'dzin grwa'i bla ma 'gyang ro dang skyor dpon blo gros gnyis kyis zhus ngor gzhung rgyugs pa rnams la rgyan 'jug gi lung gnang / nyer gsum la dngul gyi mchod rten che ba/ tshe dpag med kyi 'bag sku che ba/ zangs rkong rag rkong che ba gnyis bcas gling tshang la bskur te gsang sngags chos rdzong du 'jog pa gnang / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi mjug grub/ tshes bzhi'i snga dror cha har dpal ldan 'od zer gyis zhus ngor 'jigs ged zhi khro sprags sgrub kyi khrid gnang / phyi dro nas sku mtshams la bzhugs/ tshes bcu gnyis la lā mo'i zhabs drung tshang gi lo sar 'bul mi yong / bco lngar lwa mo'i zhabs drung tshang la mgon chos 'jigs gsum gyi zhal thang gsum dang dngul gyi mchod rten bcas gnang / skyabs mgon mchog gi yang sprul myur phebs ched thugs brtag gnang ba'i rim gro yig tshang la gnang / phyogs gang du 'tshol dgos kyi glog 'phrin lha sar 371

btong / mtsho sngon 'dab bzhi'i bla ma be ru tshang gi yang sprul byugs brtag bcad do/ / smras pa/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rlung gi shing rta las/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i char chen chad med pa/ /ris med gdul bya'i shes rgyud zhing sa la/ /snyom par phab pas bde dge'i lo tog bskrun/ /thugs bskyed don zhags rnon pos nyer bzung ba'i/ 'phrin las me na ka yi ngo mtshar gyis/ /dpyod ldan skye bo yongs kyi yid byed dag /yongs su 'dren pa'i 'phrul de mngon du gyur/ /kun mkhyen bla ma dngos su byon pa bzhin/ /mdo sngags 'chad spel bstan pa'i srog rtsa bzung / /sku gsung thugs rten spyi dang bye brag tu/ /gtsug lag gtsang khang rin chen ri bo bskrun/ /rgyud kyi dgongs don 'khrul med ar chog dang / /rab gnas gtor ma sbyin sreg 'phrul 'khoraca sogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kyi sgo phyes nas / /thub bstan rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal la bkod/ /ces bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las bar ma chad par mdo sngags dam chos kyi char phab pa dang / 'du khang chen mo'i gtsang khang sogs byi7lha

bskrun pa'i sarga ste bcu drug pa'o/ / —4 gzhan phan 'ba' zhig mdzad cing sku byu ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i sarga / 'jigs med bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis/ /mtha' dag rgud mun bsal dang lhan cig tu/ /'phrin las 'od dkar 'a bar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /thub bsnan rgya mtsho spel ba'i mgon der 'dud/ /gang gi mthun snang mdzad 'phrin rgya mtsho las /rang blo ku sha'i rtse la cung chags pa/ /skal mnyayogroga.ā+oṃpo dag dzob sang gtor du/ /slar yang 'bul ba'i sbyor gal zhugs so/ /de nas de'i sngon zhig nas phyag dpe rnams sku gdungamachod rten khri nang du bzhugs su gsol ba dang / sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyang dgon pa so sor gnang bkram sogs kyi gsung nyams dang bka' chos gsungawāshad sogs kyang sngar dargami 'dra bas yun ring mi bzhugs pa'i rnam pa yogakyang sku bsnyun sogs yod pa'i mdzad pa mi ston yang lo de'i tha ba ba cu gnyis pa'i zla 5dkyil zhig nas sku snyung cung zad bzhes pa'i rnam ba bstan/ zla de'i nyi shu'i nyin gyi snga dror smad sog rnam rgyal/ tshul khrims phan ༄tshogs/ dge bdun rgyu mtsho gsus sku mdun du bos nayonged la bye73

yang sprul med pa'i bka' shog skyabs mgon gong mas gnang ba skyabs mgon 'di bar phul yang re zhig nyid kyis bsnam na zhes ma bzhes pa 'di red ces de rnams la bstan te 'phror bla brang phyag mdzod la 'bul dgos tshul dang / paṇa chen sku snga phyi'i phyag nas 'ongs pa'i 'bul ba rnams go rim ltar gyi yi ge zur gsal bzhin phyag tu 'phrod nges zhig dang / gzhan bya gzhagyig thams cad gsung bkod mang bo zhig phebs pa la khong rnams kyis ngu ngag dang bcas de/ 'dra gsung mi nyan zhabs brtan gang dgos bsgrub nas sku gzugs myur dwangs sgos zhabs pad brtan rgyuji khong mkhyen zhes nan cher byas nas zhus par zhal lan phyir phebs la nga la rang dbang yod na 'dug 'dod los yod mod rang dbang med/ 'on kyang skyabs mgon 'di bas mchod rten sa sgang nas bla ma dge bshes du ma bcas bkra shis gso sbyong gnang zhing brgyad stong ba gsung bcug pa la dgos pa zhig dang rgyu mtshan re yod rgyu red mod sogs dgongs gezhi can gyi gsung mang tsam phebs nas zhabs rim sgrub na ci nus bsgrub chog gsungs/ de nas thams cad rtab rtab por gyur te bla brang phyag mdzod gtsos zhal slob rgan pa 'ga' sku mdun du bcar nas spyi sger gyi rgyu mtshan du ma gdung yus dang bcas zhabs pad brtan 374

zhing sku gzugs myur dwangs gnang ba nyid mkhyin/ zhabs brtan ci 'dra dgos na'ang bsgrub ces zhuse par zhal nas dgon 'dir lo re bzhin rgyal 'gong / da ma sri/ byad phur sogs je thu red/de'i bzlog thabs la gdugs dkar/ rī dmigs brtse ma sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma gsum gal che bas sgrubs gsungs/ bla ma gzhan la zhus par mkha' 'gro'i bsu bzlog sogs zhabs rim mang du phe/bas/ de nas tshogs chen/ grwa tshang so so/ slob ma rnams zur 'tshogs kyis zhabs rim sgrub pa la 'bad/ tshogs chestogyis brtan bzhugs phul bar zhal lan du kun mkhyen mchog gi thuges bskyed smon lam gyis gtso bo dgon pa 'di yin tshul gsu ngas nas bla ma dge bshes su yin yang 'dir bzhugs nas chos 'a chad nyan 'grig lam kun spyod sogs la kun gyis thugs khur che bzhes dgos tshumu sogs gsung gnad can mang du phebs kyang dngos gzhi'i zhal lan de tsam mi gsal/ nyer gcig gi mtshan lam du smad rgyud dbang gi sta gon gyi gra sgrig yang yang byas kyang legs po ma byung bas bzhag nas nye gnas la brda byas pa'i nyams shar gsungs/ nyer gnyis kyi snga dror gus slob byings nayosgrol dkar brtan bzhugs phul zhing de nas bzung zhabs brtan nyin mtshan bar ma chad par bsgrubs/ nyer gsum snga 375

dror yang tshogs chen gyis brtan bzhugs phul/ gung tshigs la grwa tshang drug gi dge 'dun pa re re'i phyag tu khron gsum re dang kha dar dkar bo re 'bul4 bar mdzad/ zha nas chos—thamagacad dgag byas stong ba yin tshe ngas lus kyi 'khrugasadzha'adinyang de rasnye thal bas med par 'gyur gsungs/ nyer lnga'i nyin nye gnas dge 'dun mngagayote slob ma rnams la rnam dzitshos zhabs brtan sgrub rgyu camatshams byas na bzang / de ringaglang brtag ni red/rgya tsho yin na lo 'aspyogazug ba yin bas de'i rten 'brel gyis dhe — zhabs brtan mtshamabrangasnyos/ skya bas mgon gong mas sgra mi snyan na tshe stong ste/ / zhes pa drangs nas 〉ringab 'i rtega'abrel snga phyi mang bo bsgrigs par mdzad/ rje zhapaston—bayokyaro'ajagaspugs tshe chog sogs gnang ste—tshe ripa brdzirten 'grelabasgrigs pa sogs kyis nga la skyonamed thamakha'icad thugs bde mospro/nongs zhesagasungaspophebs/ rī dgung grangs gya gsum parab rgyalīyopho byi ba'i lo'i zla ba dang bo'i tshes gcigagi snga dror dbal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gis brtan bzhucags bul/ de nyinanas slob ma rnams kyis bkadzo'agyur dag tshar sgrub ba tshes gsum gosub ste rje nyid kyi phyag sdas steng nas 'tsho 'bul gang zab gnang / gyi kun gzigs bad+nghaṇa ji+o 376

thasaus cad mkhyen pa'i yongs 'dzin rin po ches gtsos rtse mgron zhabs 'brang bcas dang / gdan sa chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling nas bstan pa'i gsal byed mi nyagatshang gtsos 'dus spyi bcas phebs nas/ 7paṇa chen thamayocaltamakhyen pa'i phyag yig bcas bzhugs dgos kyi zhu ba nan cheraphul/ zhal nas paṇa chen—'di ba sku gong ma 'khrul med red/ mdang sku gong ma phebs/khong gi chos skyong yang mang bo phebs/ khyad par bswe khrab pajiphebs pa rmis gsungs/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas ngas nad gzhi 'di rkyen dbang gis red ces yang yang gsungs kyang rkyen cidheyin gsal kha btod pa zhig byung nasnyagaste bkra shis 'khyidze+edarga/ sku 'bum gyis drag zhan kun gyis gdan sa phagatshun gyi gnartswachung sku rten phab pa/ bla ma rnams la thugs brtag zhu ba sogs brtson pa hur bskyed de 'bad kyang kho thag chod ba zhig gabyung /'o na kyang rje nyid dang paṇa mchog gi gsung dang / chosaskyong sku bab sa kyi lung bstan rnams kyi bab la dpag na dam sri'i 'phrul 'dra/ 'on kyang sngar khong gi zhal—gsung dzosngar skyabs mgon gong mar sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dbang zhig zhus/ skyabasangamagon khong gi zhal nas de ring don 'grub zer ba zhig gis mar lo zhig khyer byung bas mar ni tshe rdzas yin/ khyed tshe ring rgyu red rī 377

gsungs pa dang yang skabs shig khyed kyi tshi tshad lo brgyad cu gya bzhi yin gsungs zhes gsungs/ 'di skabs dgung grangs gya gsum la slebs yod pa la brtan bzhugs skabs kyi zhal lan sogs la dpag na de skabs rgyal 'gong dam sri sogs kyis bstan srid la shin tu gnod pa bzlog ched dang sku tshe'i lhag ma cung zad yod pa de dgon sde bkra shis 'khyil sogs kyi bstan pa'i chu bo 'phel phyir bsngo ba mdzad pa lteyin lags te sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su phebs mod gya gcig la sku 'da' tshul bstan te sku tshe'i lhag ma bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo bar mdzad pa dang 'dra bar gnang ba'o/ /zla ba de'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dror paṇa chen gzhung / sku 'bum gzhung / bla brang tshogs chen bcas thun mong nas gnas bcu'i brtan bzhugs phul/zhal gsung phyir phebs la spyi sger gyi bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las tshul/ de thugs mthun khrims gtsa nga ngos 'chad nyan bshad sgrub 'grig lam kun spyod sngar rgyun ltar gnas pa la rag las tshul lung 'dren mang bo dang bcas gsungs te thams cad kyi thugs la bsnams na rim gyis skyed thon yong zhes thugs gso yang gnang / 'di skabs shig mtshan mo zhig la dpon po sangs rgyas la gdugs dkar 'di bsam gyis mi khyab/378

kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'di bsam gyis mi khyab/zhing 'di'ang mi 'dra ba red/ nga dri med zhing tshor song tha/gsungs pa sogs dag pa'i snang ba 'byams klas pa zur tsam gsungs/ zhabs brtan rim gro bar ma chad par sgrub bzhin pa nyid nas yang yang mtshams byos ga sungs par brten bco lnga'i snga dror thams cad la gos dar re phul naspozhabs rim sgrub pa mtshams byas/ bcu bdun nyin yul phyogs spyi la steng gdon gyis mi tshugs ched slob ma brgyad la gza' yum nyin bdun sgrub bcug ste grub rjes bum chu grwa tshang thams cad dang grong ba rnams la'ang 'grems par mdzad/ nyer lnga nas slar yang rta mgrin bye ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs mang bo bsgrubs/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bzhir bla ma dge bshes bcu gnyis kyis bde mchog dkar bo'i tshe sgrub sna gsungs te tshes lnga'i zhogs khar slob ma spyi nas bde mchog dkar bo'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs phul bar zhal gsung legs par gnang nas thams cad la zhal mjal gnang / gzhan zhabs brtan dmigs bsal can rnams skabs skabs su bsgrubs/ zla de'i nyer drug la gyi paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas sku 'bum la gdan drangs na nyes skyon med tshul gsungs pa bzhin sku zhabs gsol na bye79

'degs pa'i gtsos gdan 'dren pa du ma 'byor/ nag nya'i bar du sku 'bum du 'byor na sku la skyon med ces chos skyong bswe khrab pa sku bab nas gsung tshul bcas gdan 'dren zhu ba naske tshe mod/ bkra shis 'khyil rang gi yig tshang gtsos bla grwa thams cad nas nyid misku gzugs kyi bab sogs spyi sger gang la bsam kyang phebs 'os min tshul u tshugs mthar skyel gyis zhus/ rje nyid nas kun mkhyen gdung mdun nas zan bsgyur na 7 gong sa paṇa chen mchog dang gdan sa phan tshun la gnod 'gal med tshul kyi — gsung rdo rje'i tshig gnang / paṇa chen mchog gi yongs 'dzin rin po ches gtsos zhabs gras rnams dang sku 'bum gyi mi sna/ bla brang yig tshang dang bla grwa thams cad kyis thugs 'dun rtse gcig phas zan bsgyur bas bkra shis 'khyil 'a dir bzhugs rgyu babartswa nas bzhugs rgyu thag bcad/ de'i skabs shin tu yig tshang gi mi chen rnams gzim khang sgor phebs bsnyun 'dri zhus par thams cad sku mdun du shog gsungs pa bzhin sku mdun du bcar ba na/ thams cad kyis nga'i lus rgas khog 'di la cig ltos gsungs/ de ni don la sku mi bzhugs pa'i brda bstan 'dug zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas sku gzugs kyi bab rim lhod du song ste tshes gnyis nas gsung mi 'byon/ zhal gyi mdangs 380

dbugs kyi rgyu ba thugs dam gyi rim pa gang la bltas kyang brjod yul las 'das/ de skabs yang bde mchog snying bo yi ge bdun pa rgyun ma chad par gsung ba'i nyams mdun na yod pa rnams kyis tshor/ snga phyir zhabs rim bsgrubs pa ni/ gdan sa rang nas gdugs ring sha stag 'bum gnyis stong gsum nyis brgya/ tshe gzungs sa ya dgu dang —brgyad 'bum lnga khri sum stong / rnam rgyal gzungs ring bye ba gcig dang sa ya gcig dang 'bum gcig khri brgyad dang sum brgya/ sgrol dkar snying bo bye ba bzhi dang sa ya bzhi drug 'bum drug stong sum brgya/ sman bla ring thung gnyisagyibasdoms na bzhi stong brgyad brgya nyi shu/ ya ma rā dza bye ba gnyis/khro bcu bye ba gnyis dang drug 'bum/ seng gdong ma bye ba gcig sa ya gcig 'bum gcig khri brgyad sum brgya/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa bye ba gnyis 'bum gcig yig brgya sa yahogacig dang bdun khri bdun—stong / dmigs brtse ma sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum chig khri drug stong / gnayobacu sugakhri lnga stong drug brgya/sher snying chig 'bum lnga stong brgyad brgya/ sgrol ma chig 'bum drug khri/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sngags 'bum re/ thugs bzhed 'grub pa'i smon tshig khri gcig stong gnyis/ sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma sum khri bzhi stong druhwabargya/ dge ldan bstan 381

'bar ma chig stong sum brgya/ bka' thang bsdus pa khri gcigastong nyid le'u khri gcig lo gyon ma sa ya gcig dang sum 'bum sum khri/ myur mdzad ma chig khri/ smyung gnas sum stong brgyad — brgya nga brgyad/ tshe thar lnga stong dang brgya dang bcu gsum/bzang spyod chig khri bzhi stong dang brgya/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gsol 'de bas khri gcig sa bcu ma brgya dang bcu gsum/mdo sdud pa chig stong lnga brgya/ rnam rgyal stong mchod lan gsum /rta mgrin bye ba gcig dang sa ya bzhi dang brgyad 'bum chig sto nga / rab gnas sum brgya/ khrus gsol sum brgya/ bgegs mthar byed lnga khri lnga stong / sku phreng lnga ba'i gsol 'debs chig 'bum brgyad khri/ sgra mi snyan gyi tshe gzungs sum stong / 'chi med rnga sgra tshar brgya/ 'jigs byed lho sgo tshar brgya/ gsang 'dus lho sgo tshar sum brgya/ mgon chos gnyis gyi bskang bshags chig khri brgyad brgya/ drug cu ba stong / sgrol bstod sum stong bdun brgya/ mkhyen brtse dri med ma stong gcig rnam 'joms gzungs ring sum 'bum chig khri/ ma ṇi bye ba dgu sa ya gnyis 'bum bdun/ skyabs 'gro sa ya drug 'bum dgu/ ltung bshags khri/ maṇ+ḍal lnga khri nyis stong / phyag bye ba/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod tshar lnga brgya/ sgrol dkar sbyin sreg tshar 383

gastes/ 'jigs byid sbyin srig rta mgrin sbyin sreg mkha' 'gro'i bsabazlog rnams lan bzhi re/ de bzhin gshe0/sa pa'i yig brgya 'bum gcig brgyad stong ba tshar brgya dang so bdun/thugs rje chen po'i gzungs ring chig 'bum bdun khri/ ha ri ni sa bye ba gnyis dang sa ya brgyad/ bde mchog rkang brgyad khri/rtsa sngags sum khri/ oṃ gsum ma sum khri/ shā sa na 'bum gcigabyang chub lam sgron tshar lnga brgya/ bka' 'gyur dag tshar gcig bcas zhabs brtan gtos che ba bla spyi gzhung gsum/ grwa tshang drug ri khrod pa rnams dang slob ma zur 'tshogs kyis bsgrubs pa thanas cad rje nyid kyi sku gzugs myur dwangs kyi ched du bsgrubs pa yin na'ang rje nyid nas thub bstan spyi dang yang sgos dge ldan ring lugs 'phel rgyas kyi ched dang mkha' khyabu skye rgu'i ched du bsngo bar mdzad pa ni gsung snga phyi dag las gsal zhing / brtan bzhugs kyang yang yang phul spyang thugs dgongs gzhan du gtad pa bzlog k+ṣiṃmed par zla gsum pa'i tshes bdun gyi nam gung ma longs tsam la mkha' spyod —chos kyi pho brang du gshegs/ rje nyid nas sngar zhal gsung la rab byung na gdung zhun phebs tshar gi bar dang min yang nyin kha shas la gsang rgya gyis zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsungs pa bzhin nyin gnyis tsam la gsang rgya byas/383

tshes bcu nos sku gdung rin po che za ma tog tu bzhugs su gsol nas mchod tshogs rab 'byams sbos te rgyud sde gong 'oga'akhodakyil 'khor so so'i zhal phyes nas bdag 'jug len pa sogs cho ga sko chos spyod/ gzhung chen du ma skyor sbyang / grwa tshang thoso'i gdurgamadun bcas thams cad kyis dad gdung shugs drag pos thugs —dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs la nyin mtshan 'khor mar brtson pa cher bskyed/ nyin bdun gyi mthar rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i thugs dam grol rtags rna mas te byang sems dkar dmar bab pa—so gas byung / rje nyid nas dgung grangs lnga bcu'i nang zhig ladur sa'i gong du sa dpyad gnang ste ngo mtshar ba'i sa dbon po sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la ngo sprod gnang ba'i sa der tshes bco lnga'i nam ma lang tsam la sku gdung rin po che gdan drangs te byanywag gnang zhing gdung rus rnams zhugs laphul nas cha tshang ba phyir la gdan 'dren zhus pa la grwa tshang drug gis gdugs rgyalamatshan mchod rol sna tshogs bcas ser 'phreng byas lkogazim khang du bzhugs su gsol/ de ma thog grwa tshang thams cad kyis gdung mdun dang mjal kha zhus/ nye gnas rnam gnyisakyis kyang phyag rdzas rnams chud mi 'dzad cing thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs su dmigs te chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling dang bla brang —sbya84—

bame shis 'khyil gyi gtsos 'brel yod dgon sde ri khrod che chung bzhi bcu rtsa grangs/ la ja thug 'gyed phog sogs bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus/ gyi kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen mchog gi gtsos mdo smad kyi bla sprul phal che bar bab dang bstun ngos 'bul ba tshan grangs bcas phul ba sogs thugs zag 2da —kyi dgongalge pa khyad par caltoyongs su rdzortayopa'i thabs la 'bad brtson lhur blangs pa dang / spyag rdzas 'phro ma dag giyo'adu khang steng 'og gi khyams bcas gser tshon gyis spras pa dang rje nyid zhal bzhugs dus bdag la lami 'bri dgos kyi bka' gsung phyi bor bab pha bzhin gtsang khang du khong nyid kyisashasung bkod bzhin dri med rnam gnyis kyi gzungs sogs bris pa dang / 'du khang steng du bzang smyod sogs dang / khyams su chos skyong so so'i sngags bcas 'bri ba'i zhabasdo 'degs zhu ba'i skal ba thob/gzhan yang nye gnas rnam gnyis kyis bzang gos kyi mchod rdzas 'du khang gang ba phul ba dang phyag rdzas 'phro ma dang gzhan dad ldan gyi rgyal blon dang myin bdag slob ma risogs kyis zhal 'debs byung ba'i dngul 'bor chen sku gdung mchod rten che ba dngul shog srab rdung ma yin par dngul pags shin tu 'thug pho sogasasto gro song gang che gnang ba dang / byur spros g.yang ṭi mu men sogs 385

rin po cher rin thang che ba'i phra rgyasko phun sum tshogs pas mergyan te gdung rus dang—sku bal sogs gzudz+was gzhug phun sum tshogs pa 'bul sgrub gnang tshonas gso rig gzhan phan gling gi 'du khang phug gi gtsang khang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i dkar chag logs su yod do/ / smras pa/ thub pa'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid dpal/ /snugazad mar me bzhine du gyur pa na/ ‘ /rgyal kun 'phrin las yongs 'du ljon pa las/ /rin chen char gyis rdzogs ldan gsar ba bskrun/ /de lta na' nga dbyings kyi 'od po che/ /dus su chu lha'i pang du 'jug pa bzhin/ /mi rtag srin mo'i gdong zhal mi sdug gzugs/ /'di 'dra'o zhes ston smir 'da' tshul bstan/ /de tshe bstan la dga' ba yi/ /dkar phyogs lha yi zhul zla bas/ /nag po ra ri'i dri ma bzung / /shes ldan tso ngan khring bur zhugs/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma nub po zhes/ /mya ngan smre sngags bzla bzhin du/ /'dren byed zung las mu tig 'thor/ ཿ /shugs ring sgra yis rna ba 'tsher/ /'on kyang gang gi thugs gsang las/ /byung ba'i zla ba bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /thugs kyi yol gor 'khyil rnams kyis/ /thugs dam zab mo'i thugs dgongs rdzogs/ /mchode sprin 'od kyi rtse dga' yis/ /nyi zla 386

ska—ra ma'i khengs pa 'phrog /mi rtag dran pas rgyud bskul nas/ /risgom sgrub las la brtson par gyur/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs thub pa'i bstan/ /dri med lugs mchog mtsho chen po/ /rab tu rgyas pa'i thabs 'ba'— zhig ci /'chud nyan bshad sgrub las la gzhol/ /zhes bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med— 'phrin las rgya mtsho depal bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma gzhon nu zhes bye ba las gzhan phan 'ba' zhig mdzad cing sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i sarga ste bcu bdun pa'o/ / — — ci gagun da rnan thān spyizhi kaun busdu bu/ tsho sta 'jigs chen bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las rgyal zhing / /gnyis med ye shes zung 'jug go 'phang brnyes/ /'phrin las 'od kyis 'dzam gling yongs la khyab/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho spel la sutremi gus/ — /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho che / dro /bdag blo byis pa'i yol gor shong min yang / /skal bar thob pa'i skra rtse'i thigs pa tsam/ /tshe mjugasgrudon yod bya phyir brjod dze+er bya/ /gsum pa rnamā thar spyi'i don bsdu ba ni/ mang du rī ri 387

thos pa l+yang gi yon tan/ tshul thāzhin bsgrubs pa rtogs pa'i yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul/ gzhastodon du dam chos 'chad spel gnang te bstan pa'i srog bzung ba dang gsum/ dang bo meng du thos pa lung giciyonasnyetan/ ri dang bo mang du thos pa lu ja gi yon tan ni/ rje dkon mchog 'jigayomed dbang bo'i nal nas/ thosu bsam sgom pas shes rgyud ma sbyangs par/ /rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang ci ltar 'thob/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa kun tu mel ba'i phyir/ /thog mar thos pa'i sgron me bsten pa gces/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje 'di nyid sku gzhon nu 'i dus nas thortswabs ma byed pa la thugs brtson shin tu che bas bsdus grwa/ blo rtags/ grub mtha' rtsa ba/'grel ba rdon gsamu/ phar phyin mtha' dpyod sogs gzhung du rothugs 'dzin gnang / khong spyir tshogs chen khri zur sprul sku che 3khag yin modahwa/nga chen gyi 'dzin bdag sogs thos bsam 5ma —gsum gyi bar chad du dgongs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das — shākya thubhāpasposhākya'i rgya'adisrid mchil ma'i thalab bzhin rtsador ba'i rnam thar bdagadzāgir bzhes/ sdig pa'i grogs po spang r+ghartezhing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes ga/sungs 388

pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten nas chos kho na nyan pa ma gtogs/ tshe 'di ba don gnyer can dang 'grogs 'dres mi byed par sna thag rang mgo la dkris pa'i dpe bzhin thos bsam kho nal 'bad pas blun po 'ga' zhig gis kun spyod rang dang mi mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas bla sar skor log zer mkhan yang byung / de ltar grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyisadape cha mi 'dzin dpe klog tsaphamu re/ khorgos sogs kyi slob gnyer geg sa rnams spangs te skabs su gang bab mithad 'phreng zur bkol bcas thugs 'dzin dang dpe khrid zhu ba/ tshogasasnachos grwa 'grims te tshogs rgyugs 'bul ba dang rtsod pa brdar sha chod pa /gnang / de yang bu ston rin po ches/ rang nyid grags 'dod pha roladama' 'beb 'dod// /g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba dzig lhub ngan seskas can/ /ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra zhing gzhan rgyud sreg /da lta'i rtsod pa 'di yang dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar ma yin par rang gzhun gyi sems rgyud 'dulko byed kyi thabs kho na la dmigs te — thos bsam chos su 'gro bar mdzad de blo gros kyi pad mo rgyasapar gyur ba ni/ blo gros lus stobs rgyas pa'i rkang dru/ga khyod/ /thub bstan pad+mo rgyas pa'i dga' tshal du/ /thos bsam kun dga'i rol rtsed mthar phyin te/ /lung rigs smra ba'i dbang bor 'gyur 38mi

bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltare lung rigs smra ba'i dbang bor —gyur to/ /de ltar mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i dbang bor gyur nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum lo thogs pa smred par gyur stabs skyabs mgon thams cad —mkhyen pa rje bskal bzang thub ba/ stanardzadebang phyug gi thugs la shin tu bab cing gsung rtsom sogs la bsngags brjod mdzad pa ni dper na skyabs mgon khong gi rang rnam las/ sa sprel hor zla gnyis pa'i tshesabargyad la bla go bla sar tshang nas don zab cing ji 'brel chags pa'i ring 'tsho'i brtan gsol gang legs mdzad/ ces dngatso / der bla go bla sar sprul ba'i sku phebs pa dang grubargochen du ma'i rnam thar las brtsams pa'i gsung 'phros mang du 'phel bas sems spro/ zhes dang / nyer gsum nyin nas bla go sprul ba'i sku dang dge bshes 'ga' rer dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar las brtsams pa'i 'phros pa dogs dpyod mang du byas/ zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu mang / gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo tshul bzhin du bsten nas mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi chos shin tu mang bo gsan nas zab rgyas gdams pa'i gter mdzod du gyur to/ / 390

gnyis pa tshul bzhin bathabs pa rtogs pa'i smon tan bsnyes pa'i tshul/ — —gnyis pa tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa rtogs pa'i yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar gdams pa'i mdzod du gyur pa na/bla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ grong dang grong khyer dag la dga' spong la/ /rtag tu nags khrod dben pa bsten pa—ra gyis/ /bse ru —lta bur rtag tu gnyis med byos/ /ring bor mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar da'en pa'i ri khrod du 'byon par chas pa'i skabs su gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi bkas thag ring du phebs pa bshol te ri khrod bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs nas sdom gsum dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du bzung nas de dang 'brel bar gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i ldam rim gnyis kyi nyams len snying bor bzung ste sgrub pa nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas me la shing bsnan pa dang de la mar khu bsnan pa bzhin du nyams dang rtogs pa gong nas gong du mched cing 'bar te yi dam gyi lha du ma'i sku'i zhal mthong / gsung gis dbugs dbyung / thugs bde chen gyi ye shes dang gcig du 'dres 'jig rten lha mi gongs kyi mchod gnasdo dam par gyur/391

rgyal sras thogs med kyi rnam thar las/ snying stobs ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /bsgrub na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /dka' yang brnags pa ma dor na/ /ri bo rnams kyang thal bar rlog /ces gsungs pa ltar bugs bzhe da lhun gyis grub pa yin te lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i zhal nes/ thos bsam phyogs su ma song zhing / /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba yis/ /mnyan 'os rirges pa'i lasasmra ba/ /de nyid la ni mkhas pa zer/ /nyon mongs dpal ni chog pa dang / /rang dang gzhan rgyud rmedul bar nus/ /lta sgom 'khrul bral gdengs dang ldan/ /de nyid la ni grub pa zer/ / mkhas pas grub pa ma bcom zhing / /grub pas ba—tsu na ba ma bcom par/ /ba stan la phan pa sgrub pa la/ /skyes bu dam pa zhes bya zen/ /zhes ga sungs pa ltar mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i nges pa don gyi mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug— tu gyur to/ / rigasum pa gzhan don du dam chos 'chad thal gnadi rtse bstan ba'i.ā+og bzung ba/ gsum pa gzha na don༄ dam chos 'chad spel gnang ste — ske bstan pa'i srog bzung ba ni shāl dbang skrapha bzang rgyu mtsho'i nal 39lha

naso/ snang byed kyi bdag po rta bdun dbang / / kho rang mthong che ba ma lags te/ /'di skye 'gro mi yi bsod nams las/ /dgung mthon po'i dbyings su shar ba yin/ /rang blo gros gtsa dema'i thabs shes kyis/ /rgyud yon tan dkyil 'a khor rgyas pa na〉/ /khong 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug na mdzes/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gong du bshad pa'i mkhas shing grub pa'i yon tan gyi dkyi'akha 'khor rab ṭurgyas pa na snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu mchede —cing 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur/ de'i tshe bstan pa rin po che 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa nyin skar tsam du gyur nayonyagasto bar gyur pa na rje btsun 'di nyid dayochos 'dzin pa'i smon lam—gyi mthu grub pa zhig yin par dgongs nas gong sa skyabs mgomāsku phreng bzhi ba dang / rje zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho/ sgo mang ri na po che blo bzang tshul khri mas rgya /mtsho so gas kyis bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i khur chen rje 'di ba la gtad/ rje rang nyid kyang bstamāpa rin po che spel ba'i thug sa dgongayoshinatu zab ba yin te rje bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gi zhal nas/'jigs med stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i/ /dri medalugs bzang bshad sgrub 'phrin las kyis/ /spol ba'i thugayodagongs rgya mtsho ltar zab pa/ /zheyogasungs pa ltar ro/ /sno393

nas phyogs kun nas dam chos don du gnyer ba'i skal ldan gyi skye bo du ma pad+mo'i mtsho la ngang ba bzhin du 'dus pa la mdo dang stags kyi gdams pa thang mar brdal te bstan pa rin po che nyin byed kyis 'od stong spros pa bzhin gsame bar mdzad pa ni/ k+ṣan snamakhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i zhal nas/ mkhas pa gar bsdad bstan pa'i 'od stong dang / /bstanatsho rdzo'agro'i phan bde'i 'od stong cig car du/ /bzhad sdi nyin byed dbyar gyi gling bzhi bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ de yi rgyu las tshe rabs mang bo zhig /gzhan phan thams cad sgrol gyi gtam bzhin du/ /tshig shudang don gyi 'bras bu ches bzang ba'i/ /lag rjes bskal ba'i bar du gzhag tu med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar tshig dang don gyi lag rjes 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum las/ 'chad pa'i yon tan ni chos rgyun spel ba tsam ma yin par dam chos gang 'chad spyang tshig sbyor legs shing tshig cag sogs gtan nas med par lung dang rigs pa'i rgyab skyor dang 'brel bar shar shar gsung zhing bstan pa'i tha ma la gang phan dang gdul bya'i shes rgyud dang 'tsham par tshig don rna bar skyel mkhas pas bka' chos la thengs kha shas song mtshams slob ma phal cher gyi rgyud la nges 'byung gi bsam pa 394

lhage ger skyes nas 'ga' zhig ri khrod du sgom sgrub la bsnyegaso sang dang / ci ri khrod du ma bsnyeg kyang shes rgyud mngon gsal du dul nas slob ba/nyer la gzhol ba dang sdom pa gong ma len pa dang — mtshams bsnyen sgrub la gzhol ba sogs mang bo byurnga / tha na 'o lags so zhes pa'i gsung gdengs thos pa —tsam gyis skal ldane ci dag gi rgyud la nges 'byung dang byang sems kyi rtogs pa skye nus pa mig masgong lag zin du yod do/ / rtsom pa legs bshad kyi phreng ba spel ba ni/ spyod 'jug chen mo'i mchan 'grel dang bzang spyod 'grel ba/ lam rim bsdus do na gyi 'grel ba/ legs bshad snying bo'i zin bris/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo'i 'grel ba sogs mdo phyogs kyi bstan bcos du ma dang /rig byed ma'i bskyed rdzogs/ 'khor chen rdzogs rim dang / 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil chog sogs khrid yig dang cho ga rgyas bsdus sna tshogs/ gzhan yang dkar chag dang 'phrin yig gi skor sogs gsung rtsom shin tu mang bo rnams ni mdo las/ don bzang bo/ tshig 'bru bzang bo/ zhes gsungs pa ltar brjod bya bslab gsum rim gnyis kyi don ma nor yang dag pa dang / rjod byed snyan ngag gis brgyan pas rna bar 'jebs shing nyan spro ba/ dus dang bsnan pa'i nye bar mkho ba sha stag go/ /snyigs dus 'dir bshad 395

sgrub kyi bstan pa rim gyis nyamasaninas mdo sngags kyi dbang lung marne ngag gi rim pa chad la khad gyur ba'i skabs der skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la dpe mkhyud dang skyo ba spangs te dgung grangs mthon por slebs pa'i skabs su'ang bar ma chad par dam chos 'chad spel gnang ste bstan pa rin po che'i srog bzung ngo / /de ltar bshad sgrub zung gis rgyal bstan bskyangs pa'i 'bras bur brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni slob ma bgung gis mi langs pa gnam gyi skor ma dang sa yi dreg pa ltar yin pas grangs 'dzin mi thub mod/ 'on kyang rang gis shes tshod che long tsam zhig brjod na/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 7 paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng snga phyi gnyis/ 0kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba/ thu'u bkwan mchog sprul rin po che/ khri gung thang sku phreng drugamipa/ khri chen zam tsha sprul ba'i sku/ khri chen gyor tshang sprul ba'i sku ste gser khri rnam gsum/ lung las kyis mtho ba bla ma dkarathobo mchog sprul/ rgyal ma khan chen sprul ba'i sku/ sgojimang mkhan rin po che'i yang sprul/ bde thang mkhan chen yang sprul sogs gdan sa'i mkhan spruspu rnams dang / gzhan yang gdan sa'i sprul sku brgya phrag du ma yod do/ /gdan sa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo rags rim tsam zhig 396

brjod na/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yongs 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang bo rje 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ skyabs mgon sku phreng drug pa'i yongs 'dzin tha mas cad mkhyen pa rje dkon mchog bsam 'grub/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rje lha mo'i tshul khrims sogs dbang lung man ngag gi brgyud 'dzin du ma dang / gdan sa'i dge bshes bgrang las 'das dzidabus gtsang phyogs nas 7 paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po che'i yongs 'dzin dngul chu rin po cherte dang / mtshan zhabs mkhan po sogs zhabs gras che khag rnams cidang gzhan yang mang / sku 'bum byams pa gling gi a kyā hu thog thu/ gser tog no mo han/ rgya yag rin po che/ chu bzang rin po che sogs lung las kyis mtho ba'i skyes sprul du ma dang /lwa mo bde chen gyi zhabs drung dkar bo sogs kyi bla chen du ma —dang / rdi tsha'i zhwa dmar rin po che sogs dang / sprul sku dgejubashes chen po grags rgyam pa sogs bla grwa thams cad dang /khams phyogs nas kyang zur mang kun khyab/ lab mkhan chen sprul sku sogs du ma yod/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa yab rgyal bo mgon po don 'grub dang / dbang zi len yum sras/ sog po wang rgyal bo yum sras/ byang phyogs kyi rgyal blon nang so sogs mang bo zhig yod/ 'di dag ni bdag giyo4 397

mthong thos su gyur ba'i nang nas che long tsam zhig brjod pa lags/ bdag gis mthong thos su gyur ba'ang tshang ma brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ khyod kyi yon tan smos ci 'atsal/ /sras kyi yon tan mthong bas 'khums/ /skya rengs shar ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /pa'o'i gnyen gyi 'od zer go/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar slob ma mkhas grub nyis 'dzoms bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i slob mas phyogs kun khyab par bla ma rin po che'i yon tan dang 'phrin las go nus so/ /mdor na sku tshe gang bor bla chen gyi rdzig shom mkhas pa'i 'gying bag sogs med par ri khrod pa dkyus ma'i lugs kyis sku tshe 'da' ba gnang ste gzim khang yang grwa khang rnyid ba zhig gi nang du bzhugs nas bsdad/ de la khong bzhugs sa'i khang mig nang du ngo ban ske rags ma zhig las med mod stod du 'dam zhal byas nas ngor grub mtha' smra ba bzhis lta ba'i skor la rtsod pa rtsod lan byed pa'i dpe ris bris/ ma khang gi rtsig pa'i sne mor zhal ba byas te sems gnas dgu'i dpe ris bris/ chab gsang sa'i 'gram gyi sab la zhal ba byas pa'i ngo na/ spros bcas rgad po kho rdzig rdzig ji ltar che rung / /spros med rgan mo yi drung na ro dang mtshungs so/ /zhes bris pa'i steng du rgad po dang rgan mo'i 398

gzugasacho ris bris 'dug khong la phyag rdzas char ltar babs kyang gzim shag la shing leb gcig gis kyang zhig gso mi byed par 'dam zhal kho na byas/ phyag rdzas byung tshad gong du zhus pa ltar sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang gtong sgo dang gtong thebs sogs chos phyogs kho nar 'gro bar gnang ba sogs bgrang gis mi lang ba dang bsam gyis mi khyab/ grwa rkyang dkyus ma zhig gis 'bul ba kha dar gcig las med kyang 'dod chos gang zhus gnang ba sogs byams snying rje'i rang mdangs phyi rol tu mngon/bstod pa brgya lnga bcu ba las/ mtho la phrag dog mi mdzad cing / / dman la rngan can mi mdzad la/ /mnyam la 'gran pa mi mnga' bas/ /khyod ni 'jig rten gtso bor gyur/ — /zhes gsungs pa ltar dman sa bzung bas kun gyi rtse mor slebarme so/ / smras pa/ 'jigs bral stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' gzhom med ye shes rtse brgya yis/ /sgrib gnyis sbyin skyes bcom pa'i 'phrin bzang phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs/ /'gro 'dren las la gzhol bas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yongs su bskams/ /rgyal bstan pad tshal gnyen gcig de la slar yang phyag bgyid do/ /dpag med du sa nas sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs la ni dbang 'byor zhing / /sna tshogs sprul ba'i zlos/ gar cir yang ston pas zhing khams gang / /dpag 399
