med 'gro ba 'dren pa'i 'phrin las 'od kyis nor 'dzin khyab/ /de lta'i byung ba 'phags chen gyi ni ye shes kho na'i yul/ / thugs bskyed sa bon dus su smin phas zhing 'dir sku yi ljon pa char+pā tu 'khrungs/ /cirlabs spyod pa'i kho lag rab tu rgyas te gzhan phanagrib ba sidze+ekun la sman/ /lung dang rtogasapa'i me tog—mdzes—pa 'i 'dzu.oṃzhal snyigs dus bstan pa'i dpyid du smrin/ / legs gsung dri bsung mngar bos rgud pa'i rims nad mtha' dag bsal ba'i grags pa 'bar/ /de lta'i grags snyan lha yi rngabo che/ /skal ldan rnam sad dag gis bskul ba na/ /zab dang rgya che'i sadabyangagodapag med kyis/ /skye 'gro dpag med ma rig gnyid las bslangs/ /de lta'i dge mtshan byung ba na/tsho ṣi lnga bdo'i duyokyi me naka /rdzogs ldan gsur ba'i gos kyis bathubs/ /bzhin gyi me tog cir yang bzhad/ /rab tu dkar brdzi'od dpor can/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i dgyes zhal 'dzum/ /rabarakar kun da'i dga' tshal’la/ /rab tu phog pas dge— mtshamārgyas/ /legs gsung 'od stong sbos pa na/ /legs pa'icodage mtshagapad+ma 'bum/ legaspopar bzhad pa'i dga' ston la/ /legs bshad don gnyer bung ba 'dus/ — /dgetsab bcud kyi ro myangs pas/ /dge ba'i lus stobs kun nas 400

rgyas/ /dgi ldan bstan pa'i dga' tshal la/ /dgi bcu'i sgra dbyangs snyan pos khyab/ /zasargyas ston pa'i thugs dgongs zab/ /zab gsal gsung gi dgongs don zab/ /zab dang rgya che'i sku mchog zab/ /zab gsum gdul bya'i dpal du zab/ /sna tshogs 'od can —shar gyihorir/ amar 'od dang bcas shar ba na/ /ma bzod mtshan mo'i 'khun dzi can/ /mya ngan khung bur gnyid du yung/ /yang dgadalhosapa'i 'dab stong can/ /rab tu dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar ngomaṣi /nyi ma'i zer la 'thur ba'i bcud/ /sgra mahwaṭa yi gsos su smin/ khriragro rnams bkre sa pas gdungs te tshe srogawādodz+waba'i nyen da/nga 2phrad pa na/ /'dod dgu'i char chen phab ste dbul ba'i sdug bsngal rnam padz+wa bco4pa bzhin/ /bltan lha rin chen lnga bano'i stsag girtswa g.yogs te snang gyur pa na/ skerī/gang gi thugs rje'i ci'o da stong spros pas dge 2na bltan pa'i tshe srog/ bzung / /zhes/ bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongar+sā su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i rnam parathar ba dad pa'id+kud+mo bzhasna — pa'i —bden gtalonyi ma gzhon nu zhes bya ba las rnam thar spyi'i —don bsdu ba'i sarga ste bco brgyad bzho/ / 401

naspyoglu py-id / bla ma'i byin rlabs drod kyis bskyangs pa'i mthus/ /rnam dpyod pad+mo'i dri bsung mngar bo yis/ /dam pa'i byung ba ngo mtshar 'bum ldan dag /dad ldan dad pa'i lam du legs par bskyal/ /rten 'brel bco brgyad me tog rab rgyas pa'i/ /lus kyi ljon shing 'khyog po ma 'gyel gong / /'di 'dra'i lase la zhugs pa'i skal ba de/ /bla ma lha yi byin mthu las gzhan ci/ /'ga' zhig dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dmag las la sogs brjod pa la/ /rnam thar dang ni rtogs brjod ces sogs chos kyi tha snyad 'dog /de lta'i sgro skur gtam la rnam thadz+wartogs brjod ming gis ci/ /bdag ni rang gzhan 'khor ba'i mtsho las thar la rnam thar 'dod/ /rnam thar skad dod muk+ṣi zhe sa pa rnam par thar la 'jug /mdo sngags gzhung chen las bshad sa dang lam gyi rtogs pa dag /rim par thob pa'i gtam la rtogs brjod ces su mkhas la grags/ /'khor ba'i chos la 'jol nyog spyod cing gsod rdung khrims gcod dag /brjod par rtogs brjod ces pa'i sgra 'di blun po'i gtam nyid do/ /'di na rnam thar sa rme40lha

bon yang dag la ni bcos bslad med/ /sgro skur gtam daskeng phyogs res nyag nyog gtam gyi sbyor ba med/ /gzhan gyi ngag rgyun gang thos brdar sha ma bcad bsres pa med/ /med pa gsum gyis yongs dag rnam thar nyi ma gzhon nu yin/ /'on kyang bdag nyid skyes sbyang blo gros dman zhing rmongs gyur pas/ /ma dag ma tshang ra ri'i dri ma chags pa gang mchis pa/ //bla ma lha la 'chags shing mkhas pa'i blo gros ga bur chus/ /dag par bkru ba'i tshul de la ni bdag nyid snying nas re/ /de ltar 'bad pa'i dge ba 'o ma'i rgyun/ /rang gzhan dus gsuyodage ba bdud rtsi'i mtshor/ /yongs su 'dres te thub bstan rgya mtsho ts+tsha/ /dbyar gyi chu mtsho bzhin du rgyas gyur cig /sreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin yongs dag pa'i/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan rin chen mchod—sdong che/ /yongs su dar ba'i 'od chen nyi ma'i zlas/ /'jig rten khams kun rab tuḍo gsal gyur cig /de yi mthu las sna nag ma zhes pa'i/ /ming bcas dmigs med dbyings su nub gyur nas/ /lha mo bkra shis ma yi zla zhal gyis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag brgyan gyur cig /ces bla go rdo rje 'chang zhes yongs su grags pa rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal —bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i bden gtam nyi ma 403

gzhon nu zhes bya ba 'di ni sngar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes bstan pa rgya mtshos rnam thar gyi sa bonakaisruru'idag cig gyin dis de 'phral rtsom 'dod tsa ma skyes spyang re zhig ba zhag de rjes ra gnasatsā yo lorobon rnga stod sgo mang sgar du yodaskabs7kun garigs paṇi chen thaspus cad mkhyen pa mchog gis khri gung thadz+wam chogaskrul rin rdzoche brgyud rnam zar mis bon dang lha reg dri ma mid pa srid du ring gabacas spyi bor bstsal te glurnam thar phris shig ces pa'i bka' lung /gser mime tog spyi bor phabs bas bdag kyang skal ba bzang snyam pa 'i blo skyes te dang du blangasanas bla ma—mchog gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob bu'i tha shal bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas lo de ka'i lo mjug nas dbu brtsams na'ang bar skabs su tshogs 'du che chung dang chos bka' 'chade spel gyi gzugs brnyan sogs rnam g.yeng gi dbang du gyur pa dang 'du phung bde min sogs kyi dbang gis lo gciga'agyang 'gor byung yang rab gnas sa 'brug lo'i hor zla bcu ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs po gnyis pa/ rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i gdung mchod kyi dus chen nyan mjug rdzogs par sbyar r+pā'i yi ge ba ni shes brtson phul du byung ba sprul ba'i sku di skebasam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan no/ / / /404

ra༅ོ / /yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun bskal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i dpal bskyed ces bya ba bzhugs so// bskal bzang rnam 'dren bstagapa nyin mor byed/ /dpal ldan bkra shis ris med phyogs kun tu/ /chos 'byor bde skyid dpal du 'dren mdzad pa/ /'phrin las kun khyab bzang bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bsnaskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi ba'i bstan pa la/ /mkhyen pa'i dpal dang brtse ba'i 'byor ba yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rab bzang goms pa'i mthus/ /byang chub chen po baṣ+pes la dus kun 'dud/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las dpal/ /rab 'byor gsung gi mdzad pa bzang bo 405

yis/ /snyan brgyud spel ba'i mdzad pa mchog de la/ /blo ldan kun gyis bstod bsngags —rol mo 'khrol/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi ba shāka thub kyi/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel snang ba 'i mdzod/ /bshes gnyen nyi ma bzang bor gus pas 'dud/ /bskal ba bye bar bsgrubs pa'i mdzad bzang dpal/ /rab tu 'byor ba'i mdzad pa bzang bo dag /skye bo bdag 'dra'i brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /'on kyang dam pa'i bka' bzhin cung zad brjod/ /de yang rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po gyi rje btsun bskal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba rgya mtsho lta bu las chu thigs tsam zhig rang gi bsod nams kyi skal bar blangs te cung zad tsam zhig brjod pa la/ rje 'di 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ yul mdo smad kyi rdo sbis zhes bya ba'i nyin pa zhes pa'i yul tsho'i nang du rje gong ma'i 'khrungs gzhir yab rin chen rgyal dang / yum lha mo gnyis kyi sras su/ rab tshes chu rta lo'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lngar sku bltams/ khong 'khrungs pa'i lo'i dgun zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang rgya sgo'i steng me tog ser chen chen po zhig —'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas thāgs snying rje'i dbang du gyuraji406

rte sims can nyam thag pa mthong na bshum porangamadzad/ sprang bo sogs la sprang rdzas yag po ma byin tshe/ kyi lkog tu song nas bshum bsdad pa dran gsungs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas thugs snying rje 'i gzhan dbang du gyur te snying rje'i rang mdangs phyi rol tu mngon par gyur/ de lta bu'i byis pa ya mtshan pa zhig 'ekhrungs yod pa skyabs mgon sku phreng bzhi ba bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis gsan/ khong gidzāyongs 'dzin rdo sbis lha rams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho thugs rje chen po'i sprul ba yin pas/ khong gi sprul sku yin rgyu red gsungs nas/ dgung grangs bzhi'i steng rdo sbis lha rams pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i yang sprul du thugs thag bcad/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan sar bkod de/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i mduganas dge bsnyen dge tshul gyisdom pa bzhes te bskal bzang dge legs rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ 〉 de nas bzung ste sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar tshul khrims mig 'bras ltar bsrung bas/ kun gyis btsun pa mchog gi tshad —du brtsi/ khya dge rab 'byams pa zhes pa'i dge bshes chen po dge rgan du bsten te/ dgung lo bcu gcig steng bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs zhugs gnang ste/ skyabs mgon bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyugaḥ mchog gi rang rnam ri)407

las/ rab tshis chu 'brug lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshis bcu gcig nyin/ kho bo'i yongs 'dzin rin po che bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sprul ba'i sku'i tshogs zhugs la gral mtshamasasogs kyis bkur bzos phul/ zhes dang / gle ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin/ yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rin po che chos grwar zhugs pa'i ngo ston tshogs chen khri rin po che mi bzhugs stabs bdag la byas/ bco brgyad la gsol dpon mkhan po tshang la sprul ba'i sku rin po cher 'bul rgyu'i rgyan 'jug gi dpe cha zhig khyer shog ces par khong nor te/ rnam 'grel dpe cha zhig phyag tu byung / de 'phral kho bo'i sems la sngon sku gong ma de nyid nas nga rang la sgo mang rnam 'grel la de tsam rtsod pa med stabs/ kho rang nasta kyang rnam 'grel la thos bsam yid tshim pa zhig byed rgyu ma byung bas/ skye ba rjes ma tshor rnam 'grel la 'brel re 'jog thub rgyu'i skyabs 'jug mdzad dgos zhes gsungs pas/ de ring rgyan 'jug btsal yang de'i tshab tu rnam 'grel gyi dpe rnyed pa legs snyam pa byung nas sprul sku tshang la/ yang dpe cha de ka phyag tu phul/ zhes gsungs/ de nas tshogs su zhugs te blo 'dzin dang rtsod pa hur thag pa gnari / chos grwar zhugs pa'i tshe gzhan la shags 'gyed kyi tshig ngan bshad pa dang / rang gzhan gyi dge 408

rtsa srig pa'i tshig rtsub sogs gtan nas gsung ba mid par zhi zhing dul bas rang nyid dman sar bzung ste gzhan la bkur ba'i brtul zhugs kho na mdzad/ yang sku greng bzhi ba'i rang rnam las/ nyer gnyis la yongs 'dzin rin po che'i yang sprul byon nas/ gzhung rgyugs sprod lor song gshis rgyan 'jug gi lung zhus/nged kyis dgos sogs chos bzhi'i rtags gsal 'ga' khong la phul/ zhes gsungs/ tshogs chos grwa 'grim ste slob gnyer byed zhor la/ gyi skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng bzhi ba/sgo mang rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ dme shul rin po che tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ dbal mang sprul sku bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs bla ma du mar bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos bka' shin tu mang bo gsan/ yi dam dang lhag lha du ma'i bsnyen 5ba la gzhol/ dgung lo bcu gnyis thog lha mo'i bsnyen mtshams dzibazhugs skabs/ dpal ldan lha mo nam mkha' na sa byon te mi mgo'i phreng ba rnying ba de khong la phul/ khong gis mi mgo'iphreng ba gsar ba zhig phul ba rmis gsungs/ dgung grangs nyi shur+sāb lcags glang lo'i zla ba dgu ba'i nyer gnyis nyin/ gong sa skya bas mgon sku phreng bzhi ba bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gi mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs bzhes te/ bskal bzang dpal 'byor bzang 409

bo zhes mtshan/ gsol/ bsnyin par rdzogs nas bzung rnya/ ltung ba sde lnga— mig gi 'bras bu ltar baspung / gzhan yang sngags kyi gzhung mtha 'a dag la sbyangs shing / rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'a khor gyi thig rtsa dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi thig rtsa/ chos skyong so so'isne srog 'khor sogs kyi thig rtsa/ lha'i thig rtsa sogs thig rtsa mtha' dag la sbyangs shing byang chub par gyur/ skyabs mgon rin po che'i rang rnam las/ yongs 'dzin sprul sku phar phyin dam bca' mthar—phyin pa'i mjal 'phrad la 'ong thog lugs bzhin ka ra sogs phul/ yongs 'dzin tshang sgo me'i khrir bsko bzhag byas/ sgo me dgon grong la kho bo cag gi yongs 'dzin gyi sprul sku yin zhing khri'i thog ma lags pas/ brtsi bkur sogs la rim dgos kyi bkod khyab yi ger springs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgo me gsang sngags bde chen/ dmu dge/ a mchog chos dpal zhing /kho tshe gur sgar/ mdzod dge sgar sar sogs kyi khrir rim par bzhugs/ skabs gang du yang chos srid kyi dbang cha thams cad dge rgan la phul nas rang 'dod phra mo tsam yang mi byed/ dge rgan yang thugs btsan zhing zhib cha che bas/ dge rgan tshang gi bka' ltar danon sde so sor khrir bzhugs skabs chos srid kyi 'grig lam le shor med par gnang snyi skyabs mgon thams cad 410

dzi/khyen pas bka' shog la sogs pa gnang ste/ khong gi bka' ltar byang phyogs kyi sog yul/ hal ha dang / so nyid/ cha spyor phyogs su phebs te/ dus 'khor dbang mo che sogs chos bkatshwa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas de phyogs kyi sems can rnams kyi rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ ri bo rtse lngar phebs nas mjal skor rgyas pa gnang ste/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bsnyesto mtshams la bzhugs der lha mo shra ma ṇa bsgrubs/ ha la ha nas bka' 'gyur sogs sog yul nas dpe cha po ti brgya phrag du ma —blus/ dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur dang / dbul phongs li sbyin gtong mdzad/ gdan sa rang du tshoms chen dang / bde yangs rmad du byung ba bskrun te dngul gyi mchod rten dang / dngul gyi kun dga' ra ba/ dngul gyi sgrol dkar gyi sku sogs bzhengs pa dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i rje/ kun mkhyen/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs bzhengs te/ kun dga' ra ba spus tshad shin tu legs pa'i nadz+wa du legs par bzhugs/ bka' bstan 'gyur sogs mdo dbus kyi gsung 'bum sogs dpe cha yod tshad blus te po ti stong phrag du ma bzhugs su gsol/gnas brtan bcu drug dang / ma cig lab sgron gyi 'khrungs d+kurabs sogs thang sku brgya phrag mang bo bzhengs te gong gsham dang no4snye/

thang tog sogs shin tu spus legs pa bzhengs/ skyabs mgon bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i khong gi zhabs brtan gsolacho'adebs las/ phyogs kyi tha gru yangs pa'i 'khor lo'i dpyid/ /bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i dpal yon can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ — byang phyogs kyi hal ha nas bzung ste/ stod phyogs kyi dmu dge sogs su/ mi tra rdor 'phreng sogs chos bka' bar ma chad par gnang ba yin te/dmu dge/ ser bo dgon/ brag ra dgon/ stag tsha sgar/shis tshang sgar sar/ a mchog dgon chen/ mdzod dge dgon sgar gsar rnying sogs su yang yang zhabs kyis bcagasacote chos bka' bar ma chad par gnang / skyabs mgon thamems cad mkhyen pas rgyud stod gsar tshugs kyi skabs su/ rgyud stod 'du khang spus legs/ gtsang khang du gser zangs las grub pa'i byams chen thog so las brgal ba bzhengs/ rgyud stod gsang chen rdo rje gling gi khrir lo drug bzhugs/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gnas brtan bcu drug sogs sku brnyan mang bo bzhengs/ rab rgyal shing sprel lor tshogs chen khrir bzhugs te gdan rabs gya gnyis pa red zer/ lo gsum gyi ring la chos srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag mi nyams gong 'phel gnang / dge 'dun mang gis ba stod sngags 41lha

kyi rol mo 'khrol/ tshogs chen 'du khang chen mor gsor zangasacilas grub pa'i spen rgyan du ma dang rgyal mtshan cha gcig sbyor 'jags gnang / chos grwa'i 'dzin grwa gtugs kyi tshogs gur nang du gdugs dang ba dan spus legs tshogs gur gang ba bzhagagong sa rin po cher dngul gyi mchod rten brgyad kyis dngos 'bul btegs/ khri'i skabs su/ de sngar a lags sgang kha tshang gis lha khang bzhengs grub tsam dang / rta mgrin gyi sku rgyu zangs las grub pa smad sog nas blus te lhu sgrig ma thub par lus pa/ khong gis lhu bsgrigs mdzad de mtshams kun gzer gyis mnan/ gzungs 'jug la sogs pa khong gis gtsor byas nas bsgrubs/sri mnan gyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i skabs/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ khyed cag gi sbis dkar gyi sgor rnga mong zhig btags 'dug gsungs/ dam sri zhig yod pa rnga mong gi gzugs su bkug pa yin nam snyam/ khong gis phyag bstar te gzungs 'jug phul/ rta mgrin gyi sku la tshon 'bul ba dang sbyan dbye ba sogs khong gis phyag bstar te gnang / rdo sbis nyin pa'i sgom grwa grwa tshang gi 'du khang bzhengs/ nang du gser zangs las grub pa'i byams pa/ gzungs 'jug la sangs rgyas 'od srung gi tshems sogs rten sna bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa bzhengs/ a 413

mchog dgon du rnam rgyal ma'i lha khang rten dang brten pa ra bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang / tshogs chen 'du khang du gser zangs las grub pa'i byams sku thog tshad can/ dus 'khor 'du khang shing rtsi bcas gsar bzhengs gnang / dgon der nang chen gyi gzim khang phun sum tshogs pa zhig bzhengs/ dmu dge'i dgon du gser zangs las grub pa'i gañjir dang / chos kyi 'khor lo ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa sbyor 'jags gnang /rab rgyal chu bya lor slar yang dmu dge'i khrir phebs te chos srid kyi 'grig lam dag ther gnang / de'i skabs su/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug tshe dpag lha dgu sogs dbang chen du ma dang / 'jam dbyangs dkar ser/ lo gyon ma/ 'od zer can ma sogs kyi rjes gnang mang bo gnang / 'on kyang lo gcig lhag las bzhuyis rgyu ma byung bar/ 7 skyabs mgon sku phreng lnga ba dbus phebs kyi don du sog yul du 'bul sdud la phebs dgos byung / de nas dmu dge nas btegs te stag tsha dgon du phebs/ stag tsha dgon grong kun gyis zhus ngor/ bde mchog dril bu lha lnga dang / phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang / seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs gnang / de'i skabs bdag kyang de/ ra yod/414

bdag kyang bla brang du grwa sar zhugs na legs min gyi brtag pa zhus pas/ shes rab kyi lha zhig bsten nas grwa sar zhugs na legs gsungs/ de nas khong sog yul du phebs te/ phyir phebs nas gong sa mchog la dngul rdo tshad sum brgya phul/ khong dgung lo lnga bcu'i nang zhig tu phebs ska bas bar dge rgan dang 'bral med gnang ste/ 'di phyi'i skyabs su bla ma bsten na yang / /bden kha rang gis bzung ba yi re mug /ces gsungs pa ltar ma yin par/ dbang cha thams cad dge rgan la phul te rang 'dod skad cig tsam yang ma byas par bshes gnyen bsten pa red/bshes gnyen bsten tshul shin tu legs pa'i stabs kyis chos srid kyi bya ba thams cad legs lam du song ste/ lhun gyis grub pa red ces grwa rgan rnams dang / dge bshes rnams kyis gleng gin 'dug dge rgan khya dge rab rgyas tshang dkongs rdzogs su grwa tshang la nyin zhag gcig gis bsnyen bkur zhus/ skyabs mgon thams cad myo/khyen pa gzim shag tu gdan drangs te 'bul chen btegs/ dge rgan rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs nas zhabs thang gis byang phyogs su mjal skor la phebs/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa dbus phyogs su bzhugs skabs gdan 'dren la phebs/ de'i skabs su grwa sa se 'bras dge 4/ bya

gsum dang / sa skya dang bkra shis lhun po sogs su bla ma dang dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur bla na med pa zhus/ rtse shod kyi bka' 'gyur sogs dpe cha po ti brgya phrag du ma gdan drangs/de 'i skabs su lha mo'i bla mtsho la mjal/ mtsho nang nas rlung nag 'tshub ma zhig gzigs/ lha mo mthong la khad yin kyang mthong ma thub gsungs/ rgyal bo stag brag paṇ+ḍi tas gsung bskul ltar/rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum sogs mdo smad kyi dpe cha mang bo 'bulam̐ zhu mdzad/ dmu dge'i khrir lan gnyis phebs/khri dang bo'i skabs/ kun rig gi skyor lta dang / 'jam dkar rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs lung kha shas gnang / grwa ba nyung shas shig gis log sgrub byas par chos skyong srung ma'i bka' chad mngon sum du bstan/ khri gnyis pa'i skabs su/ lam gtso rnam gsum kyi khrid sogs khrid 'ga' zhig dang / rbede gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang sogs dbang dang rjes gnang du ma gnang / chu mo lug gi lor slar yang dgon pas gdan 'dren zhus te phebs nas/dus 'khor dbang chen gnang ste/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la sta gon/ bco lnga la byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang /bcu drug la gong ma gong chen/ bcu bdun la rno rje slob dpon 416

gyi dbang / shing sprel lo'i sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga la rab gnas chen mo btsugs/ de ltar lo ngo gnyis la bzhugs nas chos bka' mang bo gnang / me phag lor skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng lnga ba dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan pa'i skabs/ gdung bzhu phab dang gdung khang ji ltar bsgrub par zhal bkod kyi khur bzhes pa gtso bo'i gras su bzhugs/sku gdung rin po cher dngul gyi gdung rten bzhengs par gser srang nyi shu phul bar bshad/ slar yang ser skya kun gyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin sa byi lor dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon 'dir phebs te lo ngo gnyis la bzhugs nas/ mi tra/ rnor 'phreng / sgrub thabs rin 'byung sogs dbang rjes gnang du ma dang / 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi bshad lung sogs lung khrid du ma gnang / 'di'i skabs su bka' chos la bzhugs mkhan bla grwa tshang ma sde dpon bcas dang / phyogs gzhan nas phebs mkhan stag tsha rin po che/ yongs 'dzin the bo dge bshes don grub tshang sogs yod la/ bsod grags rin po che dgon sde 'di'i khrir bzhugs skabs yin pas khong yang bka' chos zhu ba'i gras su yod/ snga phyi gnyis la dge tshul dang dge slong brgya phrag du ma bsgrubs/ de nas gdan sa bkra shiyo'akhyil du phyag phebs/4shā7

sasamo glab gi lo'i ston khar/ bla brang sa char gung dmag sleb tre+e ba'i skabs/ 'ur gtam sna chogayokyis/ bla brang dang nang khagachi ches mang bos nom rdzas gnas spor dang / lagrwa mang bo nyen byol gyis dgon par sdod bzodangami tshugs pa'i kha 'khrugs byung batre sa/ bla spyi nas gnas chung chos rgyal chen po sku khog tu spyan drangs te brtag lan du/ skyon med/ yongs 'dzin chang la phugs gtod/ ces grwa tshang tshogs pa'i dbus su gsungs nas/blo brang dgon pas bya ba che chung thams cad khong nyid la gtad de rim gro sgrub pa dang / gung khran tang gis dgon pa la skyon mi 'jug tshul gsungs/ a blo tshang bros byol gyi rnam pas a mchog sgar du phebs 'dug pa/ khong la gsung brtag zhus pas/ brospo byol byas pa'i mi thar/ gung khran tang la 'go btags na legs ngo shar gsungs/ gdan sa rang nas skal ldan 'ga' zhig la dbang bka' man ngag 'ga' zhig gnang / stag tsha sprul ba'ir+shagarin po che sogs la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog gzhan yang dge tshul slong kha shas bsgrubs/ bdag kyang las grwar thengs kha shas zhugs/ lcags pho stag gi lor a mchog dgon grong gis gdan 'dren zhus te/ dgon chen du phebayonas/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs dbang bka' mang bo gnang / gzhan yang 4nyu8

— ṅgedzod dge/'i sgar gsar rnying sogs—su phebs nas/ skal ldan snams dam pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ lcags mo yos lor kun mkhyen gyi sprul sku gdan sar myur 'byon gyi ched du rim gro zhu— sa yang yin/ lo de'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga nas/ kun mkhyen 'di ba'i sku rtsa mtsho sngon rkang tsha kho tshe'i a lags tshang gi sgaraladu rgyun bzhugs gnang zhing / chu pho 'brug gi lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin/ kun mkhyen ristopo che gdan sar 'god pa'i bar du sprul sku rin po cher zhabs phyi zhus te thab tshang so so tsam las lhan du bzhugs/ lo 'dir/ pe cin dang / lan gru bar gyi lcags lam grub pa'i ston thog tu/ bla spyi ga zhung bzhi'i sku tshab tu lan grur phebs/ yang lo 'di'i ston mjug rgyal khab gyis gro phye gtos che ba zhig drangs te/ bla bra nga sgar gyi nang chen khag sgar mtha'i lha khang rnams kyi khyams skor bcas su bzhag skabs/ mi la la'i 'chal gtam bshad stabs/yongs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs rje dashon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas/ yongs 'dzin tshang la za ma 'di 'dra mang bo drangs par za mkhan zhig 'ong nges tshod 'dugawin/bla ma grwa tshang la nyen yod med kyi thugs brtag zhus par/ thugs lhod lhod gnang chog khong gis brtag pa ltar na skyon ci yang med 419

gsungs pa bzhin/ phyis nasajispyang gnas skabs bde bar gnas pa byung / bdag pe cin nas rang dgon du 'byor skabs/ chu mo sbrul gyi lor/ yang grwa tshang gis gdan 'dren zhus ma/sa/ zla ba dgu ba'i nyer gnyis nyin dgon 'dir phyag phebs/ phyi nyin grwa mang gis brtan bzhugs phul/ bdag gis brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa zhus/ de nas ri khrod mtsho ltem du phebs nas sgrol ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ lnga mchod rjes nas grwa tshang mang la/ lam rim snechen mo'i bshad lung / sngags rim chen mo'i bshad lung / rgyub mtha' chen mo'i bshad lung / spyod 'jug chen mo'i bshad lung / gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung / ljags gyin rlabs kyi khrid/ thun drug bla ma'i rnale 'byor gyi khrid/ bde lam gyi khrid rgyas pa/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ dga' ldan 'pho khrid sogs khrid rnams dang / gung thang yi dam sgrub skor gyi lung / 'jam dkar gter sgrub nor bu'i bang mdzod/ zur rgyan zur 'debs dang bcas pa cha tshang gi lung / bkra shis lhun po'i sngags phyogs pod gnyis kyi lung /byams chos sde lnga'i lung / rdo rje gcod pa'i lung / mkhan po ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 420

sgo nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi thun mong dang thun min stabs gcig tu len tshul dang / de'i zur 'debs sgo mnge blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtshos mdzad pa gnyis kyi lung / khyim pa skor zhig la bsnyen pa nas yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'ga' zhig la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog bdag gis zhus ngor/ dbu ma gsar ba yan chad la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ ri khrod dbang bo a khu chos grags kyis zhus ngor/ nā ro chos drug dang ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid/ sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i khrid/ de'i bar du nga zhi lha sgron gyis zhus ngor/ nyung shas shig la phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang / bar zhing sprul sku'i zhus ngor/ bdag dang sprul sku gnyis la lha mo shā ma ṇa'i zur bka'i rjes gnang / sprul skyo la shra ma ṇa'i tsa ka gnang / bdag cag nyung shas shig la 'jigs byed gzhi bsnyen chen mo'i khrid ṅka gnang / bdag gis zhus ngor rgyud sde so so'i 'akyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi thig rtsa dang / sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig dang / mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa rnams phya ga khrid gnang / gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan 'khor lo'i phyag khrid gnang / snga phyir bsgrub bya brgya phrag lhag la dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog de nas 'jam dbyangs mgon po nas 421

brgyud pa'i gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang / khros nag gi dbang / zhi ba lam zab/ khros nag gi cho ga gdan thog gcig bu ma/ phaṭa bdun ma/ gdon tshogs dgu ma—/ dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung gi gcod gzhung blo gros mig 'byed dang / zhubadud gcod ral gri sogs dang / rā ga a gya'i gsung gi gcod byukyi 'dul dkar nag gi lung sogs bstsal/ slob ma skor zhig la gcod kyi 'don rta dbyangs logs nyin shas la khrid/ zla ba gsum par zung tshu nas gdan 'dren byung ba ltar/ de phyogs su chibs kha cibasgyur te/ ser bo dgon nas dus 'khor dbang chen gnang /gzhan yang dbang dang rjes gnang la sogs pa chos bka' ci rigs gnang ste/ —de phyogs kyi skye 'gro rnams la thar ba'i sa bon bzhag rab rgyal shing rta lo'i zla ba bzhi ba nas dgon 'dir / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / 'jigs byed dpa' cigaphyag rdor 'khor chen/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ sgrol ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha nyer lnga/ dwags po'i snyan brgyud bde mchog lha lnga/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug lha bcu dgu/ tshe dpag lha dgu/ gdugs dkar lha mang dang / lha bcu bdun ma byad grol dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang cha tshang / bla ma dbu ma ba'i gsung gi 'jam dbyangs chos 422 /

skor gyi lung / snying zhugs ma gtogs pa'i mgon po'i bka'ejibacu gsum cha tshang / seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng / rdo rje mkha' lding nag po/ khyung nag me'i spu gri/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ legs lhan mched gsum/rigs byed ma rnams kyi rjes gnang rnams gnang / bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nangs par grwa tshang dang ser skya yongs la theg gso sbyong gnang / de'i nyirdzon gso sbyong gi —mgon du phebs/ de'i nyin a 'phur bla mas sbyin bdag byas te grwa tshang la mang 'gyed —dang / khong rin po che la gnas bcu'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs phul/ de'i tshe bdag rdo rje slob dpon byas te brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa rgyas pa zhus pas thugs mnyes/ de nas sems bskyed mchod pa gnang / de skabs rgyam khos 'bul chen btags te bdag gis maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa zhus / dgon grong kun dad 'dun shin tu che bas/ dmu dge'i sde so so dang sger gyi khyim tshang mang bos gdan 'dren zhus te/ 'dod mos kyi chos dang rim gro sogs bsgrubs/ rang nyid kyis nus tshod kyi 'bul ba phul ba rnams dngul dkar khal bcu gcig lhag tsam 'dugadamu dge nor bas gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar/ hor zla drug pa'i nang / lto 'asge'i thig dang rgyags brngan lha bsang btang / ston 423

bo lung nas dus 'khor dbang mo che gnang ba/ zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu'i nyin sta gon dang / nyer gcig nyin byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang / nyer gnyis nyen gong ma gong chen/ nyer gsum nyin rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang de'i skabs su dmu dge'i dgon grong dang / a mchog the ba sogs dbang nyan mkhan stong phrag kha shas 'dus/ mjug tu dpal ldan dang bo ma'i lung gsungs/de'i skabs shig tshe dbang lha gcig pu ma gcig gi dbang dang /gdugs dkar mchog grub ma sogs kyi lung gnang / mjug tu 'tshub cha cung zad byung / khong gi zhal nas dus 'khor dbang chen gyi mjug 'tshub cha cung zad byung ba chos nyid yin gsungs/nor ba'i sde'i nang cung zad ma 'cham pas/ de'i don du gzhi tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po che dang / nged gnyis grwa ba byas te nyin gcig la rigs byed ma'i sgrub pa mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin nas bdag gis gyod bshad pas legs 'grig byung / de'i skabs/lha rams pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ gzhi tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po che/ nged gsum gyis khong la rnam thar gyi rtsoms skul zhus/ gsol tog gi zho'i nang bu ram btab pa de'i nang nas kha gzar gang re gnang ste/ nged gyi rnam thar 'di 'dra zhig red ces gtso bo kha shas gsungs/ de nas datsa dge nas btegs te 424

mdzod dge stag tsha sgar du phyag phebs/ de nas rdo rje phreng ba'i —dbang sogs dbang bka' du ma gnang / de nas btegs te shis tshang sgar sar du phyag phebs/ de nas gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil du phyag phebs te/ grwa tshang la mang 'gyed nyin zhag gcig gis bsnyen bkur zhus/ gdan sa nas skal ldan skyes bu nyung shas re la/ gsang sngags bka' rgya ma sogs chos bka' ci rigs gnang / shing lug lo'i hor zla gnyis pa phyi mar/ rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba mchog gdan 'dren zhu bar lan grur phebs/rgyal dbang rin po che bla brang du phebs nas/ tshogs chen btsugs shing du thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang bas dbang gral du bzhugs/ de rjes paṇa chen nin po ches btsugs shing du dus 'khor lhan skyes gnang skabs kyang slob ma'i gras su bzhugs/ rgyal dbang gis gsung brtag gnang bar/ dgon pa'i phyogs bzhi'i ri sgang sa bkra gang legs su sa bcud bum gter ci thub sbas gsungs pa'i bum pa'i bzo dbyibs/ che chung / thos sgrub/ dar 'ching / ri mo sogs yod tshad khong gis gtso bo'i thugs 'gan bzhes nas nam laris sa rub tu sku tshegs chen po'i ha lam zla ba phyed dang lhag la 'bad pa gnang zhing / tha na phyogs g.yas g.yonartse gyi ri sgang du mar phebs te mjug grub par mdzad/ ri 425

bcos sgyur gyi sngone 'tshub cha shisna tu che ba'i skabs/ bla brang yig tshang gis gsung brtag zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas ngas rgyun du brtag pa byed kyin yod/ 'tshub cha shin tu che/ 'on kyang da lta'i spyi gegs 'di bzlog rgyu med/ sems can spyi mthun gyi las shig red gsungs nas kha dar gyi steng la khong gis kha dar zhig bcas phyir phul/ gtso bo kun mkhyen rin po che zhing gi bdag po red/ khong la zhus zhes gsungs/ rab rgyal sa khyi lo'i zla drug par/ mtshan sgrogs sprul sku dang / bsod grags tshang sogs bla brang gi sprul sku du ma zhig dang / mi chen 'ga' zhig dang mnyam du lan grur drangs te slob gso khang du bzhugs bcug de'i skabs su mnyam du yod pa gzhan dag gis bshad don/ de dus nyin mtshan med par khong dkyil krung gis bzhugs/ sku rgyab gyang la bsnyel tsam las/ sku glor phab nas gzim pa ye mi gnang / bzhes pa'ang ches nyung ngu re nam rgyun mang nyung tshad 'dra 'drar bzhes/ sku la snyung zug dang / thugs ngal gyi rnam pa gtan nas med/ la las a lags tshang / nga tsho thar dus shig e yod zhus tshe/ khong gis 'di ni/ spyir sems can spyi'i las dbang zhig yin paṭas / so so'i sngon bsags la rag las/ lhag par rang re'i dgon pa lta bu la mtshon na426

'byor ba rgyas song ba de ma 'grig kun mkhyen gong mas 'byor ba rgyas na mi bzang gsungs yod pas/ de gnas chung gi 'phrul gyis med spur gtong nges/ khyed tshos 'jig rten pa'i chos skyong re'i gtor bsngos 'phrin bcol bton pas phan mi thogs/ rang gang la dad pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs ci thub thon gsungs/ zla ba dgu ba'i mjug nas 'dri zhib byas kyang / khong la tsha 'dri gtan nas ma byas/ skabs 'gar stabs 'grig tshe/ khong gi gcung 'on po rgya mtsho grags pas zhabs bsil re phul te bzhugs/ sa khyi lo'i lo mjug tu sku cham zhig bzhes tshul bstan/ de'i skabs las byed sogs kyis sman khang du skyel grabs byas/ khong gis sman khang du mi 'gro gsungs/ btsan shed kyis sngags pa rin chen rgyal gyi rgyab tu bkal skabs/ khong gis glo bur du 'pho ba gnang ste/ de ltar dgung grangs don bdun bzhes pa'i skabs su gdul bya rdzogs te mdzad pa'i tha ma sku mya —ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /bsod grags tshang gis gtso'i khong rnam pas sku gdung la bsnyen bkur zhus te/ sku gdung bye phung du sbas/ lo kha shas kyi rjes su nye gnas 'ga' zhig song dus sku gdung ma nyams par yod 'dug de nas bla brang du gdan drangs te zhugs la phul/ 427

spyir rdo sde 'chang 'de nyid bskal ba dpag tu mid pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas pa yin kyang / sku tshe 'dir dge slong dkyus ma'i lugs kyi mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mdzad pa mdzad tshul ni/mkhas pa'i mdzad pa ni/ gzhung bka' pod chen po lnga dang /rgyud sde chen po bzhi la sbyangus pa'i 'bras rtags su mdo sngags kyi gzhung gang la thug kyang thogs pa med pa dang / dper na rtags gsal gtong tshul dang / sngags kyi cho ga phyag len/ mchod pa bshams tshul/ gtor ma'i bca' bshams sogs zhib cing phra ba dang / thig dang dkyil 'khor/ tha na chos skyong so so'i srog 'khor 'bri ba sogs ma 'dres par zhib cing phra ba mkhyen la/dkyil 'khor dang gtor gdan sogs phyag bzo kho na gnang ba lha bri0pa bzang shos kyis bris pa las lhag cing / kha byang gi yi ge sogs yig gzugs legs la dag cha sogs ya mtshan pa yod do/ /tha na dbyangs rta sogs kyang gsung skad snyan cing 'jibs la zhib cing phra ba sogs mkhyen pa'o/ /btsun pa'i yon tan ni/sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams phra zhing phra ba dag legs par bsrungs nas/ sku 'khor du yun ring bzhugs pa rnams kyis chags sdang gi rtog pa phra mo tsam yang skye ba mthong ma myong zer zhing / gzur gnas mkhas pa dag gis thun mong snang tshod 428

la'ang dgra bcom pa red zer to/ /bzang bo'i yon tan ni/ chos srid kyi bya ba gang byed kyang / bstan 'gro kho na'i don la dgongs pa las rang don du 'khor g.yog dang / gzhis ka rgya bskyed pa sogs gtan nas med/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phyogs nas/ 'chad pa'i phyogs la/ dgon sde so so'i khrir bzhugs skabs dang / bka' chos sogs kyi skabs/ tshig ha cang mang ba ma yin par/ tshig sbyor legs shing go bde la/gdul bya'i blo ngor 'char sla ba sogs dang / rtsod pa'i yon tan ni/ gtso bo gzhung tshig 'grel ba/ lung rigs kyi sgrub byed dang ldan pa 'phen pa las/ gzhan la khyad gsod dang zur za sogs gtan nas med par rtags gsal 'byams klas pa gtong bas/ gzhan rgyud la blo skyed chen po 'byung nus pa dang / rtsom pa'i phyogs la snyan dngags kyi tshig sbyor dang ldan pa'i gsol 'debs dang / tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon tshig bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bsang yig dkar chag dang bca' yig sogs kyi 'go mjug gi rtsom sogs snyan zhing 'jebs pa/ gzhan yang gsung rtsom mang mod/ khong gis phyag bris las/ drung yig med stabs phyogs gcig tu sgrig mkhan med pas bor brlag tu mang bo song / mdor na byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs rgyud la 439

mnga' bas/ chos tshig bzhi tsam gyis phan pa rgya cher 'byung ba ni/ ma rabs rgyud gyong bo 'ga' zhig gis zhal mthong gsung thos pa tsam gyis kyang dad pa can ya rabs su gyur pa shin tu mang / gzhane yang gzhi bdag dang lha 'dre gdug pa can btul ba ni/ dper na/ dmu dger khyim tshang zhig tu 'jig rten pa'i lha bsten pa/ lha bdud du bab ste 'khu ldog byed pa'i skabs su lha 'dre de nyid khyim tshang de las bkar te/ rten thang dang mda' dar sogs khong gis khyer stabs/ phyin chad khyim tshang de la lha 'dre'i gnod pa med par gyur/ gzhan yang / sog po ru ba zer ba'i sdewā de sngar grwa tshang dang cung zad ma mthun pa'i stabs kyis sde ba yongs la rigs rgyud 'dzin pa'i bu med par gyur stabs/ khong gdan 'dren zhus te rim gro bsgrubs nas/ deng phyin chad rigs rgyud yod do gsungs pa ltar deng sang rigs rgyud mang bo 'phel/ grwa tshang la byad phur zhig gi stabs kyis/ dge bshes dag la gza' nad byung ste phal cher 'das/ de'i don khong la zhus pas/ phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi rtsa sngags kyi rlung 'khor sa4 gnad gnyis la bzhag pas gza' nad de rbad kyis chad/ dgon pa la dgra chen po gsum byung ba'i skabs su khong la zhus pas/ rigs byed ma'i snyob mchod cig btsugs/ de ma 410

thog dgra de rnams dbang du 'asdus te/ dgon pa'i zhabs 'degs mkhan du gyur/ skabs shig lung ba 'di la klu nad 'byung dogs yod pas/ nā ga rasnya mang bo thon gsungs/ de'i rjes su lung ba de la mdze nad kha shas byung / de'i rjes khong phebs te/ khyung dkar nag gi rjes gnang sogs gnang bas mdze nad rbad kyis chad/ sngar khong la log sgrub byed pa 'ga' yod pa dag la byams snying rje'i rang mdangs phyi rol tu mngon te rjes su bzung bas thams cad kyang dad ldan gyi slob mar gyur/phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ces gsungs pa ltar/ dgung lo bdun cu'i nang slebs kyang / sku lus kyi rtsa mi mngon pa dang / sku lus yang la phebs bde ba sogs dar ma ltar yod pas ya mtshan du yod do/ /khong gis rgyun gyis nyams len ni/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor/ kun rig sogs lhag pa'i lha du ma la bsnyen pa tshad ldan btang ste/ de dag gi bdag 'jug rgyun du gsungs /dus rgyun du nam gyi cha stod smad la mi gzim par rnal 'byor la —brtson/ skabs shig khyed snga mo bzhengs pa shin tu snga 'dug zhus pas/ nam langs pa'i bar du bdag 'jug tshar bdun 'gro gyin 'dug gsungs/ skabs shig grwa ba zhig la pra phab tu bcug 431

pas/ khong la mtsho chen po zhig gi nang du mchod rten bcu gsum yod kyang / bcu gnyis mthar phyin 'dug gcig da dung mthar ma phyin 'dug de nas nga la nyams len zhig yod pas de la phobs gsungs pas/ pra bas/ ri lnga'i rtse mo la lha khang lnga yod kyang /lha khang bzhi legs par mthar phyin 'dug lha khang gcig mthar phyin grabs 'dug zer/ khong gis cang mi gsung yang bdag gis bsam par/ rdzogs rim gyi rim pa lnga'i dang bo bzhi mthar phyin nas/ rim pa lnga ba mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi mtshams su slebs pa e yi na snyam/ de nas khong gis/ bsod grags tshang la gcig phobs gsungs pas/ bsod grags tshang la/ gser gyi rgya phibs bcu gsum yod pa'i dgon pa'i nang du phebs ma thub na sku gegs che ba bab zer/ rjes su khong la ngas de ci red zhus pas/ dgon pa de bkra shis lhun po red/ der phebs ma thub na sku gegs che rgyu red gsungs/ phyis su de bzhin byung / de'i 'phror a lags rigs grwa la gcig phobs gsungs pas/ mtsho zhig gi nang du bya 'ga' zhig yod pa 'bab4 zer/ rjes su ngas de ci yin zhus pas/ bya ni mtsho nang du yun ring mi sdod par 'phur 'gro ba red mod gsungs/ phyis su de bzhin byung / de'i sngon du bkra shis rab brtan du mtshams la yun ring bzhugs/ de'i 432

thes su rigs grwa dang nang chin kha kha so so byas/ khong giribonaji tan ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bskal bar brgyar brjod kyang zad du mid pa yin mod/bdag gis mthong thos kyi chu thigs tsam zhige brjode pa 'dis kyang bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /smras pa/ thugs bskyed sa bon grung bo smin pa las/ /byang chub spyod pa'i yongs 'du'i kho lag rgyas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yi/ /dpag bsam ljon pa dus kun spyi bor 'dzin/ / tshogs gnyis rin chen sbrang char bsags pa las/ /khyod kyi yon tan phyogs kyi rgya mtsho che/ /hub kyis 'thung ba'i blo stobs mi mnga' yang / /chu thigs tsam zhig dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/ /bdag cag ltos bcas tshe rab thams cad du/ /bshes gnyen khyod kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi la/ /longs su spyod pa'i skal ldan rigs gyur nas/ byang chub spyod pa myur du mthar phyin thog /ces yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang chen po 7 rje btsun bskal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i dpal bskyed ces bya ba 'di ni/ gzhi tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po che sogs slob ma dad ldan 'ga' zhig gis lha reg dri med dang dngos skyes bcas yang yang bskul ngor/ 7tha snyad pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros 433

su 'bod pas/ daladagi bkra shigo'akhor lo'i dgon gyi rang shag bslapa gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod du rab gnas lcags lug lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i nyin sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni myug 'dzin —dbawa bo dge slong shes rabu shā marda'o/ / / / — 434 ci

rī — sto༄༅//sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byerdeci gzhon tshu'i thun mong gi rnam par thar ba mdo tsam bshad pa ba—zhugs r+shaso// d+ngha gnyis med ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar las/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rims nade dgra sde'i tshogs/ /yongs su 'joms pa'i rgyal thabs la rol ba/ /gnyen gcig hrang srong de yis shis pa stsol/ /de la 'dir sman ba'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed gzhon nu zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi thun mong gi rnam par thar ba mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom —ldan 4'das shākya thub pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus tsam na/ 'phags yul gyi yul ma ga rtswa'i rgyal bo bzo sbyangasmegazugs can snying bo la sras gsum yod de/ khab kyi btsun mo las btsas pa rgyal bu ma skyes dgra/ yangs pa can gyi aratrerma skyong ma las btsas pa rgyal bu gzhon nu 'jigs med/ —snyol bo'i kheb kyi khyim bdag cig gi 435

chung ma las btsas pa rgyal bu 'tsho byed gzhon nu ste gsum mo/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu 'jigs med dang 'tsho byed gzhon nu gnyis chen por gyur pa na/ 'tsho byed gzhon nus/ gzhon nu 'jigs med la smras6 pa/ bdag cag gi nu bo rgyal bu ma skyes dgra ni rgyal bor 'gyur gyi/ bdag cag gis gatho cung zad bslab na/ bdag cag gi phyi dus kyi 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de gnyis kyis de ltar gros byas pa las/ gzhon nu 'jigs med kyis shing rta bzo mkhan dag mthong ba'i rkyen byas/ bdag gis yab la zhus nas shing rta bzo ba bslab snyam nas/ yab gzugs can snying bo la zhus pas/ rgyal bos bkas gnang ste/ shing rta bzo ba bsla ba par brtsams so/ /'tsho byed gzhon nus/ sman pa gos dka ra po gon pa/ mi gos dkar po gon pa rnams kyis bskor te rgyal bo'i pho brang du zhugs pa mthong nas/ gzhan dag la dris pa/'di su zhig red/ de dag gis sman pha red zer/ 'tsho byed gzhon nus bsams pa bdag gis sman dpyad bslab par bya snyam nas/ de pha'i gam du song ste/ lha gnang bar mdzod cig bdag gis sman dpyad bslab lags so/ /zhes zhus/ rgyal bos smras pa/ khyod rgyal bo'i sras yin na sman dpyad kyis ci bya /'a tsho byed gzhon nus/ rgyal bo'i bus ni bzo thams cad bslab 436

par bgyi lags so zhus pas/ phas bu gal te de lta na slobs shigaces bka' thob ste des sman dpyad slob par brtsams te bslab pa na sman dpyad lobs nas mkhas par gyur na'ang / des klad pa'i thod pa dbye ba'i dpyad ma shes/ des yul rdo 'jog na sman pa'i rgyal bo rgyun shes kyi bu zhes bya ba yod pa des klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad shes so/ /zhes thos nas/ de yab rgyal bo'i drung du song ste smras pa/ snyolha rdo 'jog tu mchi'o/ /rgyal bos ci zhig gi phyir/ des yul de na sman pa'i rgyal bo rgyun shes kyi bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ des klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad 'tshal bas de slob tu mchi'o/ /rgyal bos smras pa/bu khyod 'dis 'tsho'am zer/ des lha yang na ni dpyad mi bslab/yang na ni legs par bslab par bgyi'o/ /rgyal bos bu gal te de lta na songs shig ces dgongs pa bstsal nas yul rdo 'jog gi rgyal bo pad+ma'i snying bo la yi ge springs pa/ bdag gi bu 'di sman dpyad slob tu rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du 'ong gis/ 'di'i dgos pa thams can khyod kyis sbyor cig ces bris/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu rim gyis yul rdo 'jog tu phyin pa dang / rgyal bo pad+ma'i snying bos kyang springs yig bklags te rgyun shes kyi bu la gtad nas/rgyul bo'i bu 'di khyod kyi drung du ched du 'ongs kyis 'di la sman 437

dpyad slobs shig ces bsgos pas/ rgyun shes kyi bus 'tsho byed la sman dpyad ston pare byed pa na/ slob dpon des nyung zad cig bstan kyang 'tsho byed kyis khyad par dang bcas pa lobs so/ / ri rgyun shes kyi bu'i rikun tu spyod pa ni gang gi tshe nad pa ltar 'gro ba'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u zhig khrid de 'gro ba yin pas dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed khrid de song nas nad pa la bltas te des sman 'di dag byin cig ces smras nas sgor byung ngo / /'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/ 'di ni mkhan pos nyes te/ gal te 'dis sman 'di zos na deng nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mkhan pos bstan pa ni legs pa ma yin phyis thabs shig bya'o snyam nas/ de rgyun shes kyi bu dang lhan cig tu sgor byung yang slar nang du zhugs te/ mkhan pos 'di skad ces gsung ngo / /kho bos sman bstan pa gang yin pa de ma sbyin par 'di dang 'di dag byin cig ces zer ro/ /nad pa des de bzhin du byas pas sos par gyur to/ /ji tsam nyi ma gzhan zhig na rgyun shes kyi bu nad pa de'i khyim du song nas/ na ba ji ltar sos par gyur pa dris nas/sang yang sman de nyid byin cig zer/ khyim mi de dag gis ci snga ma lags sam/ 'on te slad kyis bstan pa lags nes zhus /43byi

sma—na pas ce bdag sgos snga phyi gnyas bstan tam zer/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni khyod kyis mngon sum du bstan rto/ /'di ni 'tsho byed la 'phrin springs pa red zer/ des bsams pa/bdag gis nyes kyis 'tsho byed ni shes rab can yin no snyam nas smras pa/ 'tsho byed kyis bstan pa gang yin pa de byin cig zer/de nas rgyun shes kyi bu 'tsho byed la dga' ba skyes pas de gang du 'gro ba der 'tsho byed khrid do/ /bram ze'i khyi'u gzhan rnams kyis skesmras pa/ mkhan po khyod rgyal bo'i bu'o snyam nas 'di la ni spro pas ston par mdzad kyi/ bdag cag la ni mi mdzad do zer/mkhan bos smras pa/ 'tsho byed ni shes rab can yin pas ngas bstan pa gang yin pa de rang gis rnam par 'byed nus kyi khyed cag gis ni de lta ma yin no zer/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan pos ji ltar mkhyen/ mkhan pos gal te de lta na ngas khyed cag gis mngon sum du rig par bya'o/ /zhesri smras nas dus gzhan zhig na/ mkhan pos bram ze'i khye'u rnams la mi re re la/khyod kyis rdzos che ge mo zhig gi rin dris shig khyod kyis ni rdzas gzhan zhig che ge mo'i rin dris shig ces de rnams tshong 'dus su btang / 'tsho byed la'ang khyod kyis kyang rdzas che ge mo zhig —gi rin dris shig ces bsgos/ de thams cad tshong 'dus su phyin 439

nas/ bram ze'i khyi'u rnams kyis mkhan pos ji skad bstan pa kho na'i rin dris kyi gzhan ma dris so/ /'tsho byed kyis kyang ji skad bstan pa bzhin byas nas bsam pa gal te mkhan pos rdzas gzhan gyi rin 'dri bar byas na bdag gis ji skad brjod par bya/ thams cad du rdzas thams cad kyi rin dri'o snyam nas dris so/ /de dag thams cad mkhan po'i drung du song nas/ mkhan pos sngar ji skad bstan pa'i rdzos de dag gi rin smras so/ /rgyun shes kyi bus ma bstan pa'i rdzas kyi rin dri bar brtsams te/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig la rdzas che ge mo zhig gi rin ji tsam/ des smras pa ma 'tshal lo/ /gzhan dag la dris pa/ smras pa ma 'tshal lags so/ /'tsho byed la dris pa dang des rdzas thams cad kyi rin smras so/ /rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis thos sam/de dag gis thos lags so zer/ ngas 'tsho byed ni shes rab can yin te cung zad bstan na yang de la rang gis rnam par 'byed nus so zhes smras pa ni don de yin no/ /gzhan mkhan pos yang mngon sum du bya'o zhes de rnams la smras pa/ thang shing can gyi rir dong la sman ma yin pa de dag khyer te shog cig de dag thang shing can gyi ri la dong nas/ gzhan rnams kyis sman ma yin snyam pa gang dang gang btus so/ /'tsho byed kyis bsam pa sman ma 440

yin pa cung zad kyang med do snyam nas/ des 'dam hūṃ mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba dang / rdo'i dum bu zhig blangs so/ /ji tsaskamin de dag lam gyi phyed na slebs tshe/ phyugs rdzi mo zhig gi mig na nas zho'i bum pa dang phrum tshud ('o ma dang dar ba bskol ba'i snyigs ma/ ) khyer te rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du 'gro ba dang 'phrad/ 'tsho byed kyis gang du 'gro/ ces dris pas/ des zhib par smras/'tsho byed kyis gnas de nyid na yod pa'i sman zhig blangs nas dpyad byas pas/ de mod la sos par gyur rto/ /de dga' ba skyes nas smras pa/ zho'i bum pa daje phrum tshud 'di khyod snoms shig 'tsho byed kyis phrum tshud blangs te/ zho'i bum pa de nyid la phar byin/ phrum tshud de khyer te song ba las ji tsam na bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis lam gyi dbus na glang bo che'i rjes zhig mthong nas/ de rnams kyis de la brtag par mertsams pa dang / 'tsho byed kyang 'ongs nas smras pa/ 'di ci yin/ glang po che'i rjes so/ /'tsho byede kyis 'di glang bo che'i rjes ma yin gyi/ 'di ni bal glang mo'i rjes yin te/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba de ring kho nar glang po che'i phru gu 'byung bar 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ de la zhon pa ni bud med yin la/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sbrum ma de ring nyid du bu pho btsa' bar 'a gyur ba zhig yin no/ /441

zhes smras/ ci tsam na de dag rgyun shis kyi bu'i drung du 'ongs nas gang gis gang khyer te 'ongs pa'i rdzas dag bstan to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ bram ze'itshukhye'u dag 'di thams cad ni sman yin te/ che ge mo 'di ni nad che ge mo la phan pa'i sman yin la de bzhin du gzhan dag kyang 'di dang 'di'i sman yin no zhes smras nas/ 'tsho byed la dris pa khyod kyis ci khyer te 'ongs/'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ mkhan po thams cad sman lags te/ sman ma lags pa ni ci yang ma mchis so/ 'on kyang bdag gis 'dam bu rtsa ru'i rtsa ba dang / rdo'i dum bu dang phrum tshud cig 'tshal te mchis so/ /'di dag ci la dgos na/ sdig pas(sdig pa ra tsa/ ) zin pa la 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba'i dud pas bdug go /phrum tshud kyis ni glan par bgyi'o/ /rdo'i dum bu ni ston kha'i dus na zho'i bum pa 'chag par 'gyur ro zer/ (zho legs par 'chag byed kyi rdzas shig yin nam/ ) rgyun shes kyi bu 'dzum pa dang / bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis bsam pa/ mkhan po ni 'di la khros so snyam nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan po 'di gcig pus 'di ltar snyam mam/ bdag cag mchi ba na lam gyi dbus su glang bo che'i rjes shig mthong ba na 'di bal glang mo'i rjis yin te/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sprum ma de ring kho 442

nar glang po che'i phru gu 'byung bar 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ de la zhon pa ni bud med yin la de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sbrum ma de ring nyid du bu pho btsa' bar 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o/ /rgyun shes kyi bus dris pa 'tsho byed bden nam/ mkhan po mad do/ de bal glang mo'i rjes yin pa ji ltar shes/ des smras pa/ mkhan po bdag ni rgyal bo'i rigs las chen por gyur pa lags na ci ste ma 'bol/ glang bo che'i rjes ni zlum mo/ bal glang mo'i rjes ni chur ring ngo / mig g.yas pa zhar ba ni ji ltar shes/ g.yon phyogs su ran 'tshal zhing mchis pa lags so/ /g.yon phyogs kyi rtswa legs pa dag zos nas g.yon phyogs su song ba'i don/ sbrum ma ji ltar shes/ rkang ba gnyis gnon cing mchis pas so/ /deng4 kho nar 'brang bar 'gyur ba (btsa' ba/ ) ji ltar shes/ gcin be'u snabs dang bcas pa 'byung bas so/ /glang bo che'i phru gu pho yin pa ji ltar shes/ rkang ba g.yas pa lhag par gnon cing mchis pas so/ /de la bud med zhon pa ji ltar shes/ babs nas rkang ba'i bar du gcus pa las so/ /de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba ji ltar shes/ g.yon phyogs su me tog 'thu zhing mchis pas so/ /de yang sbrum ma ji ltar shes/ de'i rkang ba'i ting ba ciphal cher gnon cing mchis pas so/ /deng kho nar btsa' bar 443

'gyur ba ji ltar shes/ gcin ljan ldin dang bcas te 'byung ba las so/ /de ltar lags/ gal te mkhan po thugs mi ches na mgron po de gnas pa'i phyogs der bram ze'i khye'u 'ga' zhig blta ru mngag tu gsol/ mkhan pos bram ze'i khye'u zhig btang nas ltar bcug pas/ 'tsho byed ji skad smras pa bzhin du gyur to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus bram ze'i khye'u rnams la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u dag khyed cag gis thos sam/ 'tsho byed ni de 'dra shes rab can no/ / 'tsho byed kyis klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad ma gtogs pa thams cad bslabs so/ /ji tsam na mi zhig klad nad kyis thebs nas rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du song ste smras pa/rgyun shes gyi bu/ bdag la dpyad mdzod cig des smras pa/ kye nang rje de ring dong rkos la lci ba dag sta gon gyis shig dang sang bdag gis khyod la dpyad bya'o/ /'tsho byed kyis de thos nas nad pa de'i phyi bzhin song ste/ kye nang rje bdag gis cung zad bslabs pa gang yin pa de thams cad ni sems can la phan pa'i phyir yin na/ bdag gis klad pa'i thod pa dbye ba ma bslabs kyis/ sang khyod la dpyad byed pa'i skabs rji ltar byed blta dgos pas/ khyed kyis bdag dben pa zhig tu zhog des smras 444

pa/ de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /des lkog tu 'tsho byed khrid de khyim gyi phyogs dben pa zhig tu bzhag de nas rgyun shes gyi bu 'ongs nas mi de dong du bcug ste thod pa dbye ba'i dpyad kyis thod pa phye nas skam pas srin bu de len par brtsams pa na 'tsho byed kyis/mkhan po gzu lums su ma len rigs kyi bu 'di deng nyid du 'gum par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas/ mkhan pos 'tsho byed 'ongs sam/ mkhan po bdag mchis so/ /mkhan pos srogachags 'di ji ltar blangs par bya zer/ 'tsho byed kyis mkhan po skam pa tsha bar mdzod de rgyab tu reg nas rkang lag 'khum par gyur ba dang de nas bor cig ces smras pa ltar byas pas nad pa de sos par gyur to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ 'tsho byed kho bo shin tu mgu bar gyur gyis khyed kyis khrus byos la shog cig dang klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad sbyin no/ /'tsho byed kyis khrus byas nas 'ongs pa dang des de la klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad byin nas smras pa/ 'tsho byed bdag cag ni 'dis 'tsho ba yin gyis/ yul 'dir khyed kyis ma bya zhig 'tsho byed kyis rgyun shes kyi bu la mkhan po de ltar bgyi'o zer nas rgyun shes kyi bu la phyag byas nas rgyal bo pad ma'i snying bo'i drung du song ste phyag byas nas/ bdag gis sman dpyad bslabs lags kyis 445

mchi'o/ zhes smras/ de'i tshe rgyal bo pade ma'i snying bo dang mi mthun pa mtha' 'khob pa skya bseng zhes bya ba dag cig yod/ rgyal pos smras pa/ 'tsho byed bdag dang mi mthun pa mtha' 'khob pa skya rbasenge zhes bya ba zhig yod/ khyod ni shes rab can dang nus po can yinari pas— re zhig de phob la phyis song zhig zer ba 'tsho byed kyis kyang khas blangs pa dang / rgyal bo des dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi bo bsdus te btang ba las des mtha' 'khob pa skya bseng de rnams phab nas gte bo bzung dpung blangs te slar bde bar 'ongs nas khyer te 'ongs pa de bzhin du rgyal bo la phul ba dang / de shin tu dga' nas rjes su yi rangs te bya dga' gnang ba dag 'tsho byed kyis rgyun shes kyi bu la phul to/ /de nas 'tsho byed 'gro bar brtsams te rim gyis grong khyer bzang byed du phyin nas de nyid du dbyar gnas te/ 'byung po thams cad kyi skad ces bya ba'i bstan bcos bslabs/ grong khyer bzang byed nas chas te 'gro ba'i tshe lam du mi zhig gis shing khur gcig 'khur nas grong khyer du 'jug pa de'i rus pa dang pags pa khrag dang rtsa dang bcas pa mthong ba/ 'tsho byed kyis mthong nas/ na la smras pa/ kye nang rje ci zhig gis gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur/ des smras pa/ bdag gis kyang mi shes shing khur 'di 446

khyir nas bdag gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur to/ /'tsho byed ni shing brtag pa la mkhas pa yin pas/ kye nang rje shing khur 'a di 'tshong ngam/ des 'tshong ngo / /rin ji tsam/ kar dzi pa ṇa lnga brgya'o/ /'tsho byed kyis de nyos nas bltas pa na/ shing de'i nang du 'byung po thams cad dang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i nor bu yod pa mthong / de'i mthu ni 'di 'dra ste/ gang gi tshe nad pa'i mdun du bzhag pa de'i tshe mar me khyim na yod pa'i ros bzhin du nad de lta ba bzhin du snang ngo / /de rim gyis u dum wa rar phyin pa dang / de na mi bres 'bru 'jal ba zhig yod pa des gzhal nas bres mgo la bsnun pa 'tsho byed kyis mthong nas smras pa/ kye nang rje ci'i phyir de ltar byed/ des bdag gi klad pa lhag par g.ya' bo zer/ tshur shog blta'o zhes des de bsnyalda nas klad pa la bltas/ de nas 'tsho byed kyis 'byung bo thams cad dang bar byed pa'i nor bu de klad pa'i steng du bzhag pa dang ji tsam na srin gyi med cig snang ngo / /kye nang rje khyed kyi klad pa na srin gyi med yod do/ /des 'tsho byed kyi rkang ba gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ bdag la dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho byed kyis khas blangs te bsams pa/ mkhan pos ji skad bstan pa de bzhin du 'di'i dpyad bya'o snyam nas de la smras pa/ kye nang rje 447

re zhig de ring dong rkos la lci ba dag sta gon byos shig dang sang dpyad bya'o/ /des de bzhin sta gon byas/ 'tsho byed kyis de'i phyi nyin 'ongs nas de dong du bcug ste klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad myas klad pa'i thod pa phyes nas skam pa tsha bas srin gyi med kyi rgyab la reg pa byas te des rkang lag 'khum pa dang skam pas blangs te bor bas sos par gyur to/ /des 'tsho byed la yon kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang de kyang rang gi slob dpon rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /de nas 'tsho byed yul ro hi ta pozhes bya bar phyin pa dang / yul de na skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong ba zhig yod pa der song nas bsdad/ der mi dmu chu'i nad gyis thebs pa sman pa thams cad kyis thabs ma rnyed par spangayopa zhig yod/ 'tsho byed kyis de la dris pa/ nang rje khyod ci'i phyir 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs su gyur/ des 'tsho byed la ji ltar gyur pa dag smras pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis de la/ la phug gi sa bon mar byung ba'i dar bar btags pa 'thung du bcug ste dpyad byas pas sos par gyur te/ mi des kyang 'tsho byed la kar dzi pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / de yang rang gi slob dpon rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /de nas 'tsho byed rim gyis bcom brlag tu phyin nas bcom brlag gi phyi rol na shing zhig gi drung du ngal gso zhing 48

'dug go dzi /ji tsam na gyad kyis gyad gcig brdabs nas de'i nang khrol rnams 'khrugs nas de shi'o zhes phyi rol du sgra byung ngo / /de nas 'tsho byed langs te ro'i drung du song nas/ de gar gnas pa'i mi dag la dris pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ci zhig de rnams kyis smras pa/ gyad kyis gyad brdabs pas shi ba red/ 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ zhog cig dang blta'o/ /de rnams kyis bzhag pa dang / de nas 'tsho byed kyis 'byung bo thams cad dang bar byed pa'i nor bu klad par bzhag nas brtags pa na/ ji tsam na nang khrol rnams 'khrugs par byas pa mthong nas sgyug ma'i sbrubs su sman gyi phye ma slugs te bus pa dang phye mas nang khrol la reg nas sos par gyur to/ /gyad des kyang 'tsho byed la kar dzi pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis yang rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /bcom brlag na khyim bdag cig gi chung ma gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa de'i mo ma tshan du srin 'bu gdug pa can zhig grub nas/ de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod pa thams cad shi bas/ de nas de dang dga' yang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par mi byed do/ /bud med des sman pa 'tsho byed der 'ongs so zhes thos nas de de'i drung du song ste smras pa/'tsho byed bdag la bro nad mchis kyis dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho 449

byed kyis de mthong zhing smra ba'i tshig thos nas thabs dran te smras pa/ khyod kyis dam zhig bca' bar bya dgos te/ bdag dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad na dpyad bya'o/ /des smras pa/ g.yar tsha lags so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ khyod kyi nod la phan pa'i dpyad gzhan ni med do/ /bdag las phangs pa gzhan med pas des khas blangs so/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis mo sgron mor phyung ste bzo bcos bus nas mo mtshan gyi sgor sha'i dum bu zhig bzhag pa las/ de nas srin bu de de la chags pa dang des de blangs nas bor te sos par gyur to/ /de 'dod pa'i 'dod chags la lhag par zhen pas 'tsho byed la brda zhig smras pa dang 'tsho byed kyis rna ba gnyis bkag ste smras pa/ khyod kho bo'i sring mo dang 'dra ste khyod kyi dpyad de yin pas kho bos de ltar byas pa ra zad do/ /bud med des kyang 'tsho byed la kar dzi pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / de yang gyun shes kyi tsubu la bskur ro/ / de nas 'tsho byed rim gyis chu bo ya mu na'i 'gram du phyin pa dang / des de na mi ro zhig yod pa de'i rting ba'i phyogs na rgyus pa'i breng yod pa nya rnams kyis drangs pa las de'i mig 'byedasgepa dang 'dzum pa mthong nas/ 'tsho byed kyis de thams cad brtags te/ ji ltar rgyus pa dang long mo la sogs pa'i tshigs kyi 'brel 450

thabs ṅge di kho na ltar 'dug go snyam naskes/ de rim gyis— yangasarmo pa can du phyin pa dang / ji tsam na gyad kyis gyad gcig la thal mos bsnun pas/ mig gi 'bras bu 'phags pa dang / 'tsho byed de'i drung du song nas/ de'i ting ba'i rgyus pa'i breng nasajidrangs pa dang slar tshud par gyur to/ /des kyang 'tsho byed la kar dzi pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis rang gi phu bo gzhon nu 'jigs med kyi ma ar ma skyong ma la byin no/ /yangs pa can na mi zhig gi rna bar srin gyi med zhugs te/ der de las phru gu lnga brgya byung bas de rna ba'i nad kyis nyen parogyur nas 'tsho byed kyi drung du song ste smras pa/ dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/ sngar ni padag gis mkhen pos bstan pa'i las byas kyi/ da ni rang gi blos las bya'o snyam nas/ des mi de labasgo ba/ kye nang rje song la lo ma'i spyil bo byos te ras sngogapos g.yog la de'i 'og tu rnga zhig zhog ste sa yang dron por gyis shigami des ji skad bstan pa bzhin thams cad byas so/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis mi de sa la bsnyal nas sa der chus chag chag btab nas/ de nas rnga brdung ba dang srin bu gyi med kyis dbyaratregyi dus la bab po snyam nas phyir byung ngo / /'tsho byed kyis de'i rna ba'i drung du sha dum bu zhig bzhag pa dang / de slar yang nang du 451

zhugs te phru gu rnams khrid de byung nas phru gu rnams dang lhan cig sha'i dum bu la chags pa dang / de nas 'tsho byed kyis de'i mod la sha'i dum bu bor ba dang mi de sos par gyur to/ /mi de sa kar dzi pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / de yang 'jigs med kyi ma la byin no/ /'tsho byed rim gyis rgyal bo'i khab tu phyin pa dang / rgyal bo gzugs can snying bos 'tsho byed ji ltar 'ongs pa thos nas/ des gzhon nu ma skyes dgra la bsgo ba/ bu khyod kyi phu bo 'ongs kyis bsur song zhig de bsur 'ong ba dngari'atsho byed kyis ma skyes dgra bsur 'ongs pa thos nas des bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis des bsur 'ongs pa rang gir byas na/ de nam rgyal bor gyur pa de'i tshe bdag la gnod pa byed par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de slar log ste sgo gzhan zhig nas zhugs so/ / dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed skye bo'i tshogs chen pos yongs su bskor te g.yeng zhing song ba dang / ji tsam na bram ze zhig mig nad kyis thebs nas 'tsho byed kyi drung du song ste bdag la sman ston cig 'tsho byed tshig pa za ba'i rnam pas thal ba thob cig smras/ de drang bo zhig yin pas mig la thal ba btab pa dang sos par gyu ra to/ mig nad kyis thebs pa gzhan zhig 'tsho 452

byed kyi drung du 'gro ba de sngar gyi bram ze des mthong nas dris pa/kye nang rje gang du 'gro/ des ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang bram ze des smras pa/ khyod la 'tsho byed ci dgos/ 'tsho byed kyis kho bo la gang bstan pa de byos shig de yid ches par gyur nas des mig la thal ba btab pa dang long bar gyurabyuto/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal bo gzugs can snying bo'i spyi bor phol mig byung ste/des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag sman pa rnams khug cig blon po rnams kyis sman pa rnams bkug pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga'i spyi bor phol mig byung ba la dpyad byos shig de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha sman pa chen po 'tsho byed mchis na bdag cag gis bgyi ba ci 'tshal/ rgyal bos smras ba/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byed khug cig de rnams kyis bkug pa dang / rgyal bos smras pa/ 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ lha dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te lha la bdag nyi da kyis khrus bgyid du gnang na bgyi'o/ /rgyal bos de bzhin gyis shig gsungs pas/ de nas 'tsho byed kyis skyu ru ra'i khu ba bskus shing smin par 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab nas smin par 'gyur pa'i rdzas rnams dang bsres pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blugs nas smin pa de tshe na ma tshor bar spu gris reg par byas pa dang rdol te/453

'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab ste 'asketsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzame rnams dang bsres pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blugs pa dang / rma de sos shidz+wapags pa sor chud/ skra yang mnyam par gyur to/ /nyin gcig rgyal bos khrus byas ma thag smras pa/ 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig des smras pa/ lha re zhige bshos gsol cig rgyal bos bshos gso la nas 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig 'tsho byed kyis lha bgyis lagaṭa/so/ /de yid ma ches nas lag pas byugs na phyogs gang na rma yod pa ma shes/ me long blangs te bltas na yang ma mthong / btsun mo la dris na des kyang phyogs gang na rma yod pa ma shes so/ /rgyal bo mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang skur cig mi long ba des rgyal bo la smras pa/ lha ci sras la byams pas sam/ 'on te sman la mkhas pas dbang bskur bar mdzad/ rgyal bos smras pa/ sman la mkhas so/ /gal te de ltar lags na 'dis bdagabyuni sos par ma bgyis so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ kye nang rje bdag gis khyod mthong yang ma mthong na sos par lta ga la byas/ des smras pa/ de ni mad la 'on kyang khyod kyis gang la bstan pa des bdag la bstan rto/ /ci zhig bstan/ che ge mo zhig gi mig la thal ba btab pas sos 454

pa des bdag la bstan pa ltar byas nas long bar gyur to/ — /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ de'i khams kyang gzhan la khyod kyi khams kyang gzhan yin gyis/ da ni 'di dang 'di dag byos shig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /des de ltar byas nas sos par gyur pa dang / rgyal bo la smras pa/ lha 'di sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas 'tsho byed glang bo che la bskyon nas dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang bskur to/ / yang rgyal bo'i khab na khyim rnga/dag cig yod pa skran nad kyis thebs nas/ sman pa thams cad kyis dpyad byas kyang ma sos pas sman pa thams cad kyis spangs pa dang / de'i bsam pa la 'tsho byed kyi drung du 'gro/ dpyad cig byas na legs/ gal te ma byas na bdag nyid 'chi'o snyam nas/ de 'tsho byed kyi drung du song nas/ 'tsho byed bdag la dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ kye nang rje khyod kyi snan 'dihoni rnyed pa dka'o/ /des bsams pa/ 'tsho byed kyis kyang spangs na 'di la ci byar yod/ dus la bab kyis bdag ni 'chi'o snyam nas/ de dur khrod du song / de na ro sreg pa'i— me 'bar bar ni'u le gdug pa zhig dang srog chags go dha tsan dan zhes bya ba 'thab ste ṅgehrelhung ba 455

dang de bkres pas )na pas de gnyis zos te/ dur khrod du char bab pa'i chu 'khyil ba 'thungs nas dur khrod dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na gnasku lhas yod pa der song ste/ ko dra'i chan dang mar phyung ba'i zho 'thungs pas skran rdol te yar rlon mar 'khrus nas(myugs bshal/ ) sngon ji lta ba bzhin du gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo lus 'phags mo'i 'doms kyi phyoshas su phol mig byung ngo / /des rgyal bo la smras pa dang rgyalabos 'tsho byed la bsgo ba/ ma yar mo la dpyad byos shig desakhas blangs nas/ zan byas te ma ma la byin nas khyod 'di stengadu sdod cig des de ltar bsdad pas zan gyi thog tu phol mig gi rjes yod pas 'tsho byed kyis phol mig yod pa'i phyogs de shes nas phol mig smin par 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab ste/ smin par shes pa'i skabs su zan gyi nang du gtsag bu sbas te ma ma la bsgo ba/ khyod 'di'i steng du 'di ltar sdod cig btsun mos de bzhin byas pas gtsa ga bus phol mig la reg ma thag rdol bar gyur to/ /de nas 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas dang bsres pa bska ba'i chus bkrus te 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams btab pas —sos par gyur/ de nas 'tsho byed rgyal bo'i drung du song ba dang rgyal bos smras pa/ 'tsho byed khyod kyis ma yar mo la dpyad byas 456

sam/ lha bgyis so/ /khyod kyis sgren mor phud de ma bltas grang / lha ma bltas so/ /ji ltar byas/ des ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang rgyal klo mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas/ blon po rnams la smras pa/ 'tsho byed lan gnyis par sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang skur cig mi skran can la4'tsho byed kyis khyod kyi sman rnyed par dka' 'o zhes smras pa gang yin pa des rgyal bo la smras pa/lha ci sras la sdug pas sam/ 'on te sman la mkhas pas dbang bskur bar mdzad/ rgyal bos smras pa/ sman la mkhas pas so/ /des gal te de ltar lags na 'dis bdag ni sos par ma bgyis so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ kye nang rje ngas khyod la dpyad ni ma byas kyi/ 'on kyang ngas khyod kyi sman ni rnyed par dka' 'o zhes smras so/ des smras pa/ bdag gi sman ji lta bu dag yin/ 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ gal te zla ba mar gyi ngo tshes bcu bzhi la mi ser skya zhig shi nas de dur khrod du sreg pa na ne'u le gdug pa dang srog chags go dha tsan dan 'thabs nas mer lhung ba dang de gnyis khyod kyis zos la dur khrod du char bab te 'khyil ba'i chu de 'thungs la/ ko dra'i zas zos shing mar rgyung ba'i zho 'thungs na de lta na khyod sos par 'gyur te/ bdag gis de la bsams nas sman rnyed dka'o zhes smras pa yin no/ /des mo 457

smras pa/ shin tu legs par shes te/ de bzhin du bdag gis zos so/ /de nas mi de dga' bar gyur nas rgyal bo la smras pa/ /lha 'dis sman pa'i rgyal bo'i rngo thogs kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gnyis su sman pa'i rgyal bor dayang bskur to/ /gang gi tshe mi dge ba'i grogs po lhas byin gyis ma skyes dgra bslus nas pha rgyal bo gzugs can snying bo srog dang bral bar byas pa de'i tshe ma skyes dgra skran gyi nad kyis thebs par gyur/ des sman pa rnams la smras pa/ nga la dpyad gyis shig sman pa rnams kyis smras pa/—lha lha'i gcen sman pa'i rgyal bo bla na med pa 'tsho byed 'di mchis bzhin du bdag cag gis dpyad bgyid pa rngo ga la thogs rgyal bos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byedatsho khug shog de rnams kyis bkug pa dang / 'tsho byed nga la skran nad byung gis dpyad byos shig lha bgyi'o/ 'tsho byed kyis bsams pa rgyu gnyis kyis skran rdol bar 'gyur te/ lhag par dga' ba'am/lhag par khros pas yin na sems can gdug pa can 'di lhag par dga' bar ga la 'gyur gyi/ rnam pa thams cad du khros par bya'o bsams nas smras pa/ lha dam zhig bca' dgos te/ gal te gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo'i sha gsol ba lta na dpyad bgyi'o/ /'char byed bzang bo ni rgyal bo ma skyes dgra kho rang gi 458

bu'o/ /rgyal bos thos nas khros te smras pa/ legs so ngas ni pha srog dang bral/ khyod kyis kyang 'artar byed bzang bo srog dang phrol/ nga yang nad kyis shi nas khyod ni rgyal bor 'gyur mod/des smras pa/ lha dpyad ni 'di lags te/ gzhan gyis sos par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /bdag dang 'dra ba'i phangs pa med pas rgyal bos khas blangs so/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rgyal bo la phul te/ lha gzhonartsonu 'char byed bzang bo la legs par gzigs pa de ltar mdzad du gsol/ phyis gzigasnya par mi 'gyur ro/ /de snas de ltar bstan nas khyim du khrid nas bzhag go/ /de nas 'tsho byed sha'i don du bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du song ba las bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod ni ros stong ba ma yin pas de nas ro'i sha blangs te yo byad kyi khyad par dag dang g.yos byas nas/ rgyal bo'i dro la bab pa'i dus su bstabs so/ ri /de nas ma skyes dgras sha khu'i phor ba blangs nas za bar gzas pa dang 'tsho byed kyis 'phrogs nas klad du bsnun te sdig can khyod kyis pha chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal bo srog dang bral la bu'i sha yang za bar byed dam / des rngam nas smras pa/ gal te de lta na ci'i phyir gsad ces mi bzod pa drag po skyes pas de'i skran rdol 459

nas yang rlan mar 'khrus te/ kha nas khrag dang bcas par byung ba de kho rang gis mthong nas brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /de nas chu gtor nas dbugs slar byung ba dang khrus byas te 'phrod pa'i zas byin pas sngon ji lta ba bzhin sner to/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas khrid de rgyal bo'i drung du song nas rkang ba gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lhartsogazhon nu 'char byed bzang bo 'di lags te/bdag srog chags grog spur yang srog dang bral bar bgyid mi phod na gzhon nu lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'on kyang thabs 'dis lha 'tsho bar 'gyur bas bdag gis thabs bshams par bgyis pas so/ /rgyal bo mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas/ blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang skur cig blon po rnams kyis 'tsho byed glang bo che la bskyon nas dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos lan gsum par yang sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang bskur to/ / de nas 'tsho byed dregs pa skyes nas bdag dang mnyam pa'i sman pa 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ bdag ni lus kyi dpyad sged pa rnams kyi mchog yin la/ bcom ldan 'das ni sems kyi dpyad mdzad pa rnams kyi mchog yin no snyam mo/ /dus gzhan 460

zhig na 'tsho byed bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba las de dregs pa'i snyems pag bden pa ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed na ci'i phyir bden pa ma mthong bar gyur snyam na/drigs pa'i snyems pa las gyur par gzigs nas/ de'i dregs pa spang bar bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed la bka' stsal ba/ 'tsho byed khyod kyis ri'i rgyal bo gangs can mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed khrid —nas/ ri'i rgyal bo gangs can gang na ba der gshegs pa dang /de na sman rnam pa sna tshogs/ sgron meribazhin du 'od 'bar ba yod/bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal te/ 'tsho byed sman ci tsam 'dod pa longs shigade song nas sman rnam pa sna tshogs dag blangs nas bcom ldad——ci'adas kyi spyan sngar 'ongs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ 'tsho byed sman 'di'i ming ci yin/ des gsol ba/bcom ldan 'das che ge mo lags te/ cho ga 'dis nad che ge mo zhig zhi bar 'gyur/ 'di ni che ge mo zhig lags te nad che ge mo zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur la/ gzhan rnams kyi ming yang mi shes 4khyinyu

so/ /ma shes pa gang yin pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ 'tsho byed 'di ni che ge mo ste cho ga che ge mos nad che ge mo zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'di yang che ge mo zhig ces bya'o/ /de ltar re re bzhin gsungs pas 'tsho byed kyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sman dpyad kyang mkhyen lags sam/ zhes zhus pas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'tsho byed la bka' stsal ba/ 'tsho byed sman zug rngu 'byin pa yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa dgos te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ nad la mkhas pa/nad kun nasu slong ba la mkhas pa/ nad byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa/ spangs pa phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po nad la mkhas pa ni/ nad 'di ni 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu yin no zhes shes pa'o/ /gnyis pa nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa ni/ nad 'di ni rlung gis kun nas bslang ba'am/ mkhris pas kun nas bslang ba'am/ bad kan gyis kun nas bslang ba'am/bdag las gyur ba'am/ gzhan las gyur ba'am/ 'dus pa las gyur ba'o zhes shes pa'o/ /gsum pa nad byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa ni/ nad 'di ni mig sman nam/ sku mnye'am/ smyug sman nam/ bkru sman nam/ snar blugs pa'am/ du bas bduchog pa'am/ nan rtsi'i las kyis spang bar 'gyur ba la sogs 462

tha r+shas pa'o/ bzhi ba nad spangs pa phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa ni/ nad 'di la ni 'phrod pa'i cho ga 'di dang 'di lta bu byas te spangs na phyis mi 'byung ngo zhes shes pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs— pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa yang sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med pa zhes bya'o/ /'tsho byed bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhinadu rab tu mkhyen to/ /'tsho byed de bzhin gshegs pas ni skye ba'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spang ba'i sman mkhyen to/ /rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spang ba'i sman mkhyen to/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i rgyud la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /smras pa/ phra rags rims nad 'joms pa'i sman mchog gis/ /skye 'gro'i zug ju mtha' dag rab bcom nas/ /gtan bde'i bdud rtsi sman mchog la rol ba'i/ /skal ba mchog la spyod 463

pa e ma rmad/ /ces pa 'asgru ni 'tsho byid gzhon nu'i gdung 'tshob dam pa sman pa bstan khos bskul ngor tha snyad pa bsam gtan rgya mtshos 'dul ba lung las btus pa yin la/ri gsar bu rnams rtsom lugs sna tshogs la rgyus mnga' ched/ tshig sbyor 'dul lung bzhin byas so/ / / / 464

—rngo ༄༅/ / g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar /dad sdo/ gaṭaṃ rdog gaskan haṃd gahaṃska / gdud /da nin dan zhachad da/ ci 'dir g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes grags pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gnas la sku drin lhag par che ba'i mkhas pa po snga phyi gnyis kyi rnam par thar ba rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig bri bar bya ste/ de yang g.yu thog la g.yu thog rnying ma dang g.yu thog gsar ma gnyis yod la/ de gnyis kyi gdung rgyud rim par 'chad pa la 'di ltar/ sngon bod kyi rgyal bo lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus su/ rgya gar gyi rgyal bo rnga chen po zhes bya ba la bu bi byi dga' byed ces pa yod/ bram ze dril bzo ma zhes pa la bu mo bi lha dga' mdzes zhes bya ba yod/ de gnyis kas pha ma la gnang ba zhus te/465

bram ze rgyun shes kyi bu zhis bya ba'i sman pa mkhas pa chis snyan grags che ba zhig yod pa'i drung du sman gyi rig pa slob tu byon te/gso dpyad kyi gzhung lugs sdang bo la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ — de gnyisdo grogaso por gyur te rgya gar shar nupaṃb dang / rgya nag li yul/ bal yul rnams su byon nas 'gro ba mang bo la sman dpyad kyis phan btags shing /gzhan mang bo la gso ba rig pa bslabs/ skabs shig tu khong gnyis bod du byon/ sde khrod cig tu l+lebs pas/ bu mo zhig gis bud med dar ma zhig khur nas sgo skyer bskyal song /sman pa gnyis kyis 'di sgor bskyal nas ci byed ces dris/ bu mo na re/ 'di nga'i ma yin mod nad pa red zer/ sman pas/spyir ma yin zhing dgos su ned pa yin pas sgor ma 'don nang du zhog gsungs pas/ bu mo na re ma yin kyang nged rnams la nad dri phog cing khyim lha mi mnyes/ nged bod rang gi a lugs(goms lugs) yin zer ro/ /de nas sman pas khyed bod la nad gso ba po'i sman pa yod dam/ zhes dris pas/ bu mos/ nad byung na zas kyi tshod 'dzin/ rma gsar ba la mar bzhus nas btang bas rtsa kha sdom shes tsam yod/ nad gso ba po'i sman pa pha ma yod zer/ yang sman pas dris pa/ khyed bod kyi lugs la nad 466

pa yin tshad sgor 'don nam gsungs pas/ bu mo na re/ bu tsho na na pha mas sgor mi 'ardon/ pha ma na na bu tshas phyir 'don zhus pas/ sman pa'i thugs la bod mtha' 'khob red/ lugs ngan pa 'di 'dra 'dug snyam du snying rje tshad med pa skyes nas/ bu mo la/ bod yul 'di mun pa'i gling du 'dug mi rnams phyugs las blun/ pha ma nad pa sgo phyir 'bud pa ga la rung / pha ma ni bsnyen bkur dang mchod pa'i gnas yin/ ma nang du khyer/nged gnyis kyis sman dpyad byed/ nged gnyis kyis bod 'dir gso dpyad kyi rig pa spel rgyu yin/ khyod kyis gzhan la dril bsgrags gyis gsungs pas/ bu mos ma dang / sman pa gnyis nang du gdan drangs/ ma la nad g.yogarisman pa gnyis kyi ngag ltar byas/ sman pa gnyis kyis ma la sman dpyad byas nas drag de nas bu mo des/ bod na nad gso ba'i sman pa gnyis rgya gar nas phebs 'dug ces dril chen po bsgrags so/ / de nas sman pa de gnyis kyis sman dpyad kyis phan btags pa dang gso rig spel bas snyan grags rgyas stabs/ bo da rgyal lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis gsan nas sman pa gnyis pho brang yum bu bla sgang du spyan drangs/ bsnyen bkur bla na med pa byas/ bod du yun ring bzhugs dgos pa'i zhu ba phul ba sman pa gnyis kyis 467

zhal gyis bzhes/ rgyal bo'i sus mo lha lcam yid kyi rol cha sman pa mi byi dga' gyed la phul nas sman pa'i yum du bzhes/ lha lcam yid kyi rolatsha la sras dung gi thor cog can 'khrungs so/ / sman pa gnyis kyis reg pa rtsa'i mdo/ 'a tsho ba zas kyi mdo /sbyor ba sman gyi mdo/ gtar sreg dpyad kyi mdo/ rma chas bzo'i mdo rnams dang / rtsa 'grel 'grel bshad khog dbug sa dpyad lag len dang bcas pa gnang ste bod yul du gso rig gi bstan pa spel/ lo shas la bzhugs nas slar rgya gar du phebs so/sto/phyis snyobi byi dga' byed kyi sras dungagi thor cog can yang sman pa mkhas par gyur te lha tho tho ri dang / de'i sras khri gnyan bzung btsan gnyis ka'i bla sman mdzad/ khri gnyan bzung btsan gyi sku tshe'i smad du dung gi thor cog gi sras blo gros chen pos bla sman mdzad/ blo gros/chen po'i sras blo gros mtshungs med kyis/khri gnyan bzung btsan gyi sras 'brong gnyan lde'u'i bla sman mdzad/ blo gros mtshungs med kyi sras blo gros rab gsal gyis 'brong gnyan lde'u'i sras stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi bla sman mdzad/ blo gros rab gsal gyi sras blo gros rgyal mdzod kyis/ stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi sras gnam ri srong btsan gyi bla sman mdzad/blo gros rgyal mdzod kyi sras blo gros bshes gnyen gyis chos rgyul 468

saung btsanalke sgam po'i bla sman mdzad/ — blo gros bshes gnyen gye sus 'dre rje rgya gar badz+ra yin la/ 'dis rgyal bo gung ru gung btsan dang / mang srong mang btsan gyi masman mdzad do/ /rgya gar badz+ra gyi sras khyung bo rdo rjes 'dus srong mang po rje'i bla sman mdzad/ khyung bo rdo rje'i sras/ gagathog yono tan mgon po yin la/ 'di bas rgyalabo mes ag tshomu dang de'i sra sa khri srong lde btsan gnyis ka'i bla sman mdzad/ ྾na tan mgon po la sras 'bum seng / dpal 'bum/ dga' dga' gsum yod pas/mu tig btsan po/ mu ni btsan po/ mu khri btsan po rnams kyi bla sman mdzad/ sras gsum pa la sras sra lu zhes sam g.yu thog 'gro mgon du grags pa 'khrungs/ des mnga' bdag khri ral dang glang dar gyi bla sman mdzad/ dzagro mgon gyi sras g.yu tho ga jo sras kyis mnga' bdag 'od srung gi bla sman mdzad/ jo sras kyi sras g.yu thog byams pa thugs rjes mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi bla sman mdzad/ g.yu thog byams pa thugs rje dpal gyi sras byams pa dkon mchog legs/ de 'i sras byams pa bde legs yin la/ 'di yan gyi gdung rgyud dag la g.yu thog rnying dza ba zer la/ g.yu thog rnying ma ba de dag gi nang nas blo gros bshes gnyen yan gyi lo rgyus zhib par gi snang /snyo de'i rgyu batshan yang de 469
