dag gi skabs su bod rang gi yi ge'i thog nas yi ge 'bri ba'i srolīyodar ba'i stabs kyis/ mkhas pa 'di rnams kyis gzhung lugs la sbyang tshuladang mdzad pa ji ltar gnang ba sogs kyi gsal cha sgromed / 'di dag ma zad/ gnam ri srong btsan yan gyi rgyalane+edag gi lorgyus kyang rgyas gsal med do/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su blon po thon ṣ+kasam lha ṭas bod kyi yig gzugs gsar skrun gnang ste brda sprod pa'i gzhung brtsams/ de nasposam bho ṭa dang khong gi mchan bu rnams kyis legs sbyar gyi skad las chos dang rig pa'i gnas bod yig tu bsgyur mgo brtsams so / de phyin chad bod rang gi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol dar bas/ galhathog gdung rgyud 'dre rje rgya gar badz+ra tshun chod nas lo rgyus cung zad gsal bo yod/ bod rgyal gdung rabs la'ang srong btsan sgam po tshun nas lo rgyus cung zad gsal bo yod par ma zad/ de tshunachad kyi rdo ring gi yi ge dang / gtsug lag khang gi yi ge sogs mthong rgyu yod pa las/ de'i sngon gyi bsgyur yig dang /rdo ring gi yi ge dang / mchod rten dang sku 'dra sogs kyi gzungs gzhug gi yi ge lta bu'ang mthong rgyu med do/ /'o na de'i sngon gyi sman pa dag gis/ sman ji ltar sbyangs pa red zer na legs sbyar 470

gyi yi gi sogs mi rigs gzhan gyi yi ge'i steng nas bslabasi par mngon te/ sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang bi lha dga' mdzes ma gnyis kyis reg pa rtsa'i mdo sogs bod kyi slob ma la gnang ba ste paslabs pa las bsgyur ba'i gtam med pas shes so/ /'dre rje rgya gar badz+ra de nyid kyis gso ba rig pa sogs chos dang rig gnas mang bo la sbyangs nas mkhas pa chen por gyur te stod lung skyid sna zhes pa'i sa char bzhugs nas/ 'gro ba nad pa'i don mdzad/ nad pa gang yod kyi sar phebs nas geso dpyad mdzad/ phan pa rgya chen po byung bas snyan grags kyis bog yul khyab/ phyogs kun nas bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya chen byung / g.yu mang bo 'bul ba byung ba khang thog tu bkram yod pa lug rdzi zhig gis mthong nas/ mkhas pa mthong ba don ldan la g.yu'i thog 'dug go zhes bsgrags pas/ de nas bzung mkhas pa g.yu thog pa zhes grags so/ /de nas mkhas pa chen po de/ bdud rtsi sman sgrub dang mgo jig rin chen gnad 'grel sogs sman dpyad kyi gdams pa ༷ 'tsholnga phyir rgya gar la byon/ khong dang bor lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bor byon nas klu sgrub dang mjal gser srang stong phul nas mgo thig rin chen gnad 'grel zhus pas rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong 471

dang bcas pa gnang ngo / /de nas rgya gar phyi yul pad mo'irkagling zhes bya bar phe bas nas sman pa mkhas pa su yod btsal bas/tshong 'dus shig tu bram ze zil dang gzi bajid che ba zhig ldang 'phrad/ des khyod gang nas 'ong / don dag gang la 'opa zhes dris pa la lo rgyus rgyas par zhus/ khong sman pa bi byi zhes pa'i mkhas pa chen po zhig yin 'dug pas/ de la bdud rtsi sman sgrub sogs zhus nas gnang / —de la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang bo'i mdun nas sman rig sogs gzhung lugs mang bo sbyangs nas mthar rang yul du phebs te btsad po'i sras mo dga' skyong ma zhes bya ba khab tu bzhes pa la sras g.yu thog khyung bo rdo rje 'khrungs betho/ / khyung bo rdo rje de yang dad brtson shes rab dang ldan zhing /yab kyi drung nas rig pa'i gnas spyi dang khyad par sman rig la sbyangs pas na phra mo nas kyang mkhas pa por gyur nas/ nad po yod tshad kyi sarosong nas sman dang dpyad byas/ de'i dus sman khang med gshis/ sman pa rnams nad pa gar yod kyi sar 'gro dgos pas/ de'i ming la nad pa bskor zer/ khoja gis ngal dub khyad du bsad nas nad pa bskor stabs/ nya mas myong phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ khong gis yab la zhus pa'i gsung 472

mgur rdu/ sman pa'i rgyal bo skyes mchog sprul ba'i sku/ /khyed kyi thug4rje sa gso rig spyi khog phubs/ /bdag blos sbyangs pas man ngag 'dod rgu 'grub/ /sgrub thabs zab mos nad rnams dngos su mthong / /nad pa bskor bas myong ba lag len rtogs/ /zhes dang / ri — dregs med byams pa'i sems kyis nad pa bskor/ /ngal dub khyad du bsad nas nad pa bskor/ /phyogs cha nye ring meg pas nad pa bskor/ /mi ngo nor ngo ma bltas nad pa bskor/ /ser sna 'du 'dzi med pas sman sbyin btang / /zhes dang / myong med kha ta byed na sman pa 'khrul/ /tsha grang sdebs la mi mkhas sman pa 'khrul/ /bsil drod phyogs log byed na sman pa 'khrul/ /zas dang spyod lam mi mthun sman pa 'khrul/ /kha dmar gtar sreg mi shes sman pa 'okhrule/ /tshig dang nyams len 'dzol na sman pa 'khrul/ /dug chu chang la dga' na sman pa smyo/ /g.yo sgyu sdig la dga' na sman pa spyo/ /mtho 'dzug ngan la dga' na sman pa spyo/ /bud med g.yem la dga' na smren pa spyo/ /don med bskur la dga' na sman pa snyo/ /sman sbyoracisdebs la mi brten sman pa snyo/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ / 473

yib spyang thugs dgyes nas/ bu khyung bo rdo rje la mgur gsungs pa/ bu blo stobs che zhing shes rab ldan/ /lang tsho gzhon yang blogros ldan/ /gso dpyad bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /bsil drod tsha grang sdebs la mkhas/ /gtar sreg rma chas bzo la mkhas/ /tsha grang nad kyi skad ster zhing / /mkhas shing mkhas par gyur pa'i bu/ /da dung gso dpyad bstan pa spel/ /bu khyod skyes pa pha yi dpal/ /zhes sogs gsungs/de nas g.yu thog khyung bo rdo rjes rgya bza' chos kyi sgrol ma khab tu bzhes pa la sras g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes bya ba'i ma khas chen snyan grags can de 'khrungs so/ /gahaṃska bu/ gakyi rdogha ā+oṃd na ldon tan nagon spuzhi rnan thān skyod thād burnod pu/ de yang g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po 'di nyid /bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang dgung mnyam yin pa dang dgung snying sa pho sprel yin/ zhes rnam thar rin po che'i gter mdzod 474

las gsungs mod/ khri srong 'khrungs lo la'ang deb ther rnamasposumi mthun pa yod la/ deb ther mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/yig tshang shas che bar lcag sa pho rta la 'khrungs pa 'thad pa'i —phyogs byed pa mang gsungs pas/ de ltar na spyi lo790yin no/ /des na lcags rta rme'i sprel zla'i tshes bco lnga la sku bltams par gsungs/ de nas dgung lo gsum lon pa'i tshe/ yab kyis klog yig bslabs/ tshegs med par mkhyen/ yab kyi mdun nas gso dpyad kyi gzhung lag len dang bcas pa la sbyangs bas skomakhas par gyur/ de nas yab kyi thugs dgongs la/ nga'i bu 'di na tshod 'di 'dra chung yang / yi ge dang sman sogs la 'di 'dra mkhas 'dug na tshod gzhon stabs zhabs 'bring zhig bzhag nas nad pa bskor du gtong dgos dgongs nas/ bu la/ da 'gro ba nad pa'i don du sman rkyal thogs la 'gro don mdzod gsungs nas/ slob ma dgob rdo rje bya ba zhabs 'bring bar bskos te nad pa bskor zhing 'gro ba nad pa'i don byed du bcug go/ /de nas sras g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos nad ba grangs las 'das pa nad las thar bar byas pas/ sman bla gnyis pa g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes snyan grags rgyas so/ / dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i tshe/ rgyul bo mes ag tshom gyis 475

g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i snyan grags gsan nas/ chos blon ta rag kha zhes pa gdan 'dren la btang / g.yu thog pa chen po yang rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin byon/ rgyal bo yab sras kyis brang ti rgyal gnyen mkhar bu la sogs pa bod kyi sman pa rnams dang rtsod du bcug de'i skabs su/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos/ bdag dang gzhan gnyis rtsod pa byed pa la/ /dpang bo bub pa'i sman pa bod na med/ /bdag ni gso dpyad rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /dris pa'i lan la brdugs med lan yang 'debs//gso dpyad lag len nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra/ /gang la brgyab spyang thogs brdugs yod ma yin/ /de yi rtsod lan 'debs mkhan su yis byed/ /ces gsungs nas brtsad pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po rgyal te/ rgyal bo yab sras kho nga la yid ches nas/khri srong lde btsan gyi bla sman du dbang bskur/ bod kyi sman pa mi dgu la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis bkur sti zhus shing slob dpon du gyur nas gdams ngag zhus so/ / delhanas nyin zhig bsam yas su mi zhig na nas yod pa'i tshe/ brang ti rgyal gnyen mkhar bu la sogs pa'i sman pa rnams kyis bcos gang byas kyang ma phan pa zhig yod/ de'i tshe rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pa chibs chags la byon pa'i zla la g.yu thog pa 476

chen po la sogs— pa'i sman pa rnams yod pa'i tshe/ nad pa de mi zhig gispokhur nas/ nad pas rgyal bo lags bdag ni 'a/di lta bur gyur/ sman pa sus/ bcos kyang phan pa'i skabs ma rnyed/rgyal bo chen pos bskyab tu gsol zer bas/ rgyal bo na re/g.yu thog pa g.yu tho—ga pa gsungs pas/ mkhas pa g.yu thog pas rtsa zhig rigazigs te/ rgyal bo chen po mi 'di'i nad gso bar 'dod na/ rgyal bo'i chibs pa de bdag la g.yar bo zhu gsungs pas/ rgyal bos kyang chibs bshol nas chibs pa g.yar ba la/g.yu thog pa chen pos chibs pa bcibs nas/rī nad pa'i lag pa la thag pa btags te phyagarigis bzung nas chibs rgyug byas so/ /de nas nad pa sos pas rgyal bo ya mtshan par gyur nas/ nad kyis gdungs pa la rta brgyugs pas gang la phan gsungs pas/g.yu thog pa chen pos gsungs pa/ mi 'di'i rtsib ma dang glo ba 'byar bar rta brgyugs pas rtsib ma dang glo ba phral nas nad las thar ba lags so gsungs pas/ rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pa ya mtshan par gyur nas/ rgyal bos g.yu thog pa chen po la chibs pa sga dang bcas pa gnang ngo / /de nas sman pa g.yu mgon khong rang yul du phebs nas chibs pa sga dang bcas pa yab yum gnyis la phul lo/ /yul snon sman pa kun rgyugazer 4dhe7

ba zhig yod la/ sman pa des g.yuyog pa yab sras la chags sdang gi rnam pa zhig byed kyin yod pa de'i kyin byas/ g.yu thog pa po'i thugs la/ ngas nad pa'i don byed pa lasman pa skun po 'dis sdig tshab chen po bsags pa snying re rje dgongs nas bzhugs yod pa'i tshe sman pa de'i bu mo btsun ma zhig yod pa la mtshan srin langs nas chags pas myos te la phug cig mtshan mar brdzangs pasartsa ba chad de mtshan mar lus pas mo'i mtshan ma'i srin bu khros nas 'chi la thug cing / pha sman pas la phug thon pa'i thabs gang byas spyang ma thon/ bu mo ma dang bcas pas phas phan pa'i skabs ma mchis/ g.yu thog pa yab sras gdan 'dren zer bas/ pha na re/ bu mo shi na'ang zog rgan pha bu mi 'bod zer ro/ /de nas ma bu gnyis kyis pha la dbang med par g.yu thog pa yab sras gdan drangs pas/ yab kyis sngar gyi gtam rnams thos pasam gshegs shing sras lda yang bshol btab/sras g.yu mgon gyis yab la zhus pa/ nad pa dang sman pa nad g.yog sogs 'khor gyi log sgrub mi bzod na sman pas snying rje bsgoms nas nad pa'i don byed pa dang rgyab 'gal min pa mi yong / gnod lan du phan 'dogs dgos par 'dug snyam nas/yab la ma nyan par byon pas/ bu mo de'i pha na re/ bdag gi 478

thu mo 'di bu las lhag pas/ 'di khyod kyis 'chos shig bu mo la gang ri ba'i bya dgar khyed rang la 'bul zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos khyed rang gis bcos ma byas pa yin nam gsungs pas/bdag gis bcos gang shes byas kyang ma phan zer/ de nas g.yu mgon gyis du tshwa sbyar nas sna la btab pas sbrid pa byung bas la phug thon to/ /de nas mngal gyi srin bu 'khrugs pa la smanodapyad gnang nas bu mo nad las grol rto/ /de nas kun rgyug pa yid ches nas phyag 'tshal zhabs spyi bor blangs 'bul ba mang bo phul to/ /de nas kun rgyug pa na re/ bdag la man ngag zhu zer bas man ngag nyams yig gnang ngo / /g.yu thog pa chen bo dgung lo bco lnga tsam bzhes pa'i skabs shig la rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyis spyan bsnyung ba la g.yu thog pa spyan drangs pas/ g.yu mgon gyis/ rgyal bo'i spyan bsnyung ba las tshab che ba zhig yong ba 'dug ste 'phongs la rwa skye bar gda' zhus pas/ rgyal bos/g.yu thog pas thabs mdzod gsungs/ g.yu thog pas/ rgyal bo'i phyag gis zhabs 'phongs kyi rus pa 'phur na phan gsungs/rgyal bos g.yu mgon gyi gsungs ltar mdzad pas/ mig nad dragade'i rgyu mtshan rgyal bos lag pas rgyun du spyan 'phur ba'i goms gshis chags pas/ rim gyis mig la gnod nas mig nad byung /479

lag pas 'phongs 'phur bas/ lag pa mi gtsang snyam nas/ mig la ma reg pas mig nad rim gyis drag pa'o/ /yang skabs shig rgyal bo'i tshems bsnyung bas mkhas pa g.yu mgon gyis gsungs pa/rgyal bo'i ya rkan gyi dkyil du 'dzer ba skyes nas gtam gsung mi thub pa yong byas pas/ rgyal bos gsungs pa/ 'dzer ba mi skye ba'i〉 thabs gyis7 gsungs pas/ 'o na rgyal bo rang gi ljags kyi rtse mos ya rkan phur cig zhus pas/ rgyal bos de ltar mdzad pas/tshems na ba dwangs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / tshems cung zad mi bde ba la ljags kyis rgyun du reg thug byas pas nad je thur song / rtses rkan la 'phur dgos byung nas so la reg gtug ma byas pas rim dwangs byung / g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i tshe/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyis/ phyogs rigs kyi sman pa dgu spyan drangs nas/ mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog pa dang rtsod pa mdzad pas/rgya nag gi sman pa stong gsum na re/ bod na sman pa yod dam zer bas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ rgyal bo lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan ring gi sman pa dung gi thor cog can nas bzung khri srong lde btsan ring gi g.yu thog yon tan mgon po kho rang yan gyi lo rgyus brjod pas/ rgya gar gyi sman pa na re/ rgya gar/ rgya nag bal 48snyi

pol/ li yul sogs la gso ba rig pa'i bka' bab tshul gang yin gsungs pas/ g.yu thog pa chen—pos 'di skad gsungs so/ /rgyasna gar gyi lugs la rig pa ye shes kyi rgyud/ rgya nag gi lugaspo la 'a khor 'das rtsis kyi rgyud/ ba la bo'i lugs la 'khor 'das bzo'i rgyud/ kha che'i lugs la rdzas sbyor ri na sgo che'i rgyud/sog po'i lugs la nad phyir 'dren pa gtar kha'i rgyud/ gar log gi lugs la nad bsreg pa me'i rgyud/ ta zig gi lugs phand gsod pa dugs bcos kyi rgyud/ khrom gyi lugs la chu dbyad bsil gyi rgyud/ za hor gyi lugs la nad sdud pa rngab ru'i rgyud/ ge sar gyi lugs la nad 'ded pa sngags kyi rgyud/ zhang zhung gi lugs la nad thur du 'ded pa bshal gyi rgyud/ o rgyan gyi lugs la nad gyen du 'dren pa skyugs kyi rgyud/ bod kyi lugs la nad gso bar byed pa gnyen po bzhi ldan gyi rgyud/ g.yung drung bon gyi lugs la nad zhi bar byed pa dugs lum byugs gsum gyi rgyud/ thags bzang lha ma yin gyi lugs la nad bcing ba de ba chings kyi rgyud/ tshangs pa lha'i lugase la gso dbyad 'bum gyi rgyud/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i lugs la thugs rje rang grol gyi rgyud/ drang srong gi lugs la tsa ra ka sde brgyad kyi rgyud/ phyi ba'i lugs la dbang phyug chen po'i rgyud/ nang ba'i 481

lugs la rigs gsum mgon po'i rgyud do/ /gsungs pas/yang bal bo'i sman pa na re/ mkhas pa so so'i lugs la du yod dz+rar bas/ yang g.yu thog pa pos 'di skad gsungs so/ /phyogs rigs kyi sman pa mi dgu'i lugayoni 'di lta ste/ dang po ni rgya gar shan ting gar bha'i lugs la lus spyi gso ba'i yan lag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ rgya nag gi sman pa stong gsum gang ba'i yugs la byis pa gso ba'i yan lag chung dpyad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ma hā de ba'i lugs la mo nad gso ba'i yan lag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rnyarma bud snya'i lugs la gdon nad gso ba'i yan lag rdo rje pha lam/ bal bo'i sman pa da na shī la'i lugs la rgas pa gso ba'i yan lag gnad kyi mdzub tshugs/ kha che'i sman pa khu na badz+ra'i lugs la dug nad gso ba'i yan lag rus sbal gyi 'gyur 'gros/ sog po'i sman pa na la shan dir pa'i lugs la rgas pa gso ba'i yan lag bcud kyi rgya mtsho/ dol bo'i sman pa khyom ru rtse'i lugs la ro tsa gso ba'i yan lag dga' bde 'phel byed/gru gu'i sman pa seng ge 'phel byed kyi lugs la btsal ba thig gi yan lag ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long / khrom rgyal mu rje the khrom gyi sras btsan pa shi la na'i lugs la khrom gyi dbye ba drug la sogs pa dbye ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ / 48nyu

bod kyi sman pa mi dgu'i lugs ni 'di ltar/ bi byi'i lugs la/ bi byi'i bo ta kha ser/ 'ug pa'i lugs la/ lag len gsal sgron/ cher rje'i lugs la/ cher rje'i zin thigabrang ti'i lugs la/ gdams ngag gser bre dang dngul bre/ mi nyag gi lugs la/ rdo sbyor chen mo/ g.yu thog pa'i lugs la g.yu thog bu don nyams yig khrid yig rgyud kyi cha lag bco brgyad/ gnya' ba'i lugs la/ 'grel ba dri med 'od zer 'phros pa dbang gi rgyal bo/ stod sman gyi lugs la/ stod 'grel gzi 'od 'bar ba/ mtha' bzhi'i lugs la bstan bcos lam gyi sgron me rnams so/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gzhan yang / kha che'i sman pa dang / sog po'i sman pa/ gru gu'i sman pa rnams kyis dri ba byas pa la lan thogs pa med par btab pas/ phyogs rigs kyi sman pa dgu na re/ bod na 'di lta bu'i skyes mchog dam pa bzhugs pa ya mtshan gsungs nas/chigayu thog pa chen po la bstod pa 'di phul to/ / sdon bsags sbyangs pa'i yon tan rab rgyas shing / /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi mgon gcig pu/ /bod yul mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma mchog /g.yu thog chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te bla mar bsten 483

to/ /de nas rgyalībo 'khor dang bcas pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po rgyal/ te/ phyogs rigs kyi sman pa rnams kyis phyag byas pa mthong nas ngo mtsharir zhing dad par gyudza to/ / ci ri de nas phyogs rigs kyi sman pa rnams kyi nang nasangargya nag gi snan pa na re/ gza' khyi bya gsum gyi bcos thabs khyed kyis bdag la gnang du gsol/ gsungs pas/ rmo g.yu thog pa chen pos/ bya khyi gza' gsum gdug pa che bas/ de drag bcos byed d+nghami nyan/ 'jam bcos byed dgos mod/ de'i sgrub thabs nged kyis mi shes khyed kyis gdams pa stsol gsungs pas/ rgya nag stong gsum gang bas gza' bcos srog gi 'khor lo/ bya bcos mtshan gyi 'khor lo/ khyi bcos spu gri'i 'khor lo ste/ 'khor lo gsum gyi gdams pa g.yu thog pa chen po la phul to/ / 4 de nas g.yu thog pa chen go/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'irtso tshe rgya gar la 'gro nu thag bcad nagagaser mang bo btsal te bsgrubs/ rgyal bo la sogs pas bshol btab kyang ma thebs par gser srad brgya 'bul bar khyer nas rgya gar la byon/ bal bor slebs nas bal bo'i sman pa dha na shī la ha dang mjal/ ci khong gis sne len dang bya dga' chen po mdzad/ bal bo rnams la 'di bod kyi sman pa g.yu thog pa chen po red gsungs pas/ bal 484

bo'i nad pa mang bo'i don du bal yul du cung zad bzhugs dgos byung / bal bo'i sman pas tshad pa sgos bcos dang rngam ru ste ba'i man ngag rnams skyes su phul/ de nas rgya gar du byon pas/ bal bo dang rgya gar gyi mtshams —ri kun tu rgyu bar lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na rgya gar nas tshur phebs pa dang mjal/ lo tsā ba na— re/ g.yu thog pa gang la 'byon zer/ bdag rgya gar la gsaurig gdams ngag len du 'gro byas pas/ lo tsā ba na re/ khyed rgya gachor dzi'abyon na/ paṇa chen tsa na dra de ba la sman rig gi gdams ngag khyad par can yod pas de longs zer/ de nas g.yu thog pa rgya gar la byon te/ lo tsā ba'i gsung ltar paṇa chen tsan dra de ba'i drung du byon te gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga phul nas d+ku gdams ngag zhus so/ / de nas paṇa chen tsan dra de bas g.yu thog pa la gso ba’ rig pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang bo gnang / slar yang gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga phul nas rgyud kyi kha skong zhus pas/ rgyud kyi kha skong mu tig phreng ba/ rgyud kyi dkar chag gsal ba'i sgro—na me gnang / de nas rdo rje gdan du phebs/ phyi skor la phyin/de na mdze mo rkang lag zha ba/ mig 'gribs shing ra ling skyes pa/sha sprin sha 'dzer gyis gang ba/ mgo bo srin nad kyis btab pa/485

stod 'khrugs pa dang / bar bad kan/ smad grang bas khyer ba/tshigasarnams chu ser gyis khengs shing / lus spyi dasachus bzung ba/ kha skugs nas smra mi shes pa zhig gzigs pas/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje lhang nge ba zhigaskyeyonas/ bla ma dang lha la gsol 'debs dang pacas mdze mo la sman dpyad byas pas yun mi ring bar mo nad las thar/ mdze mo lus sems kyi sdug bsngal lasangagrol/ de nas khong rgyal bo'i khab tu phebs/ mkhas pa chen po the dbangatshozhes bya ba'i drung du/ a tsa ra'i sde skoraphyi na nga gsang gsug rgyud 'grel stong dang rtsa gcig dmar 'ded brgya dang bco brgyad/ ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long / byang khog gsacha dbye mdzub btsugs/ thur dpyad gnad kyi lde mig mngon shes gnad kyi 'phrul 'khor/ gsang thig rin chen sgron me/ man ngag 5na byed gnod byed bsam las 'das pa/ phran tshegs kyi man ngag rtsis las 'das pa rnams zhus shing sbyangs/ yon du gsor srang nyi shu rtsa lnga phul/ de sogs bla ma du ma bsten nas rgya gar du lo gsum la bzhugs/ phyir bod yul du phebs/ lam bar du phar byon tshur byon bsdoms pas lo gcig 'gor song gsungs/ de nas gdams ngag gi skor mdzod mang bo zhus nas 486

bod du sgribs pas/ rgyal bo shin tu mgres nas/ g.yungathog spu chen po rgya gar la byon pa'i lo rgyus dang phyir 'khor ba'i lo rgyus dril chen bsgrags so/ / yang g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo so lnga bzhes pa'i tshe /gsor mang bo bsnams nas rgya gar du thengs gnyis pa snyon/ sngar gyi slob dpon paṇa chen tsan dra de ba'i drung nas gdams pha mang bo thob/ gzhan yang slob dpon mi rmi tsan dra de ba dang / sngar gyi slob dpon mkhas pa mi dbang gi mdun nas khrid yig brgya rtsa la sogs pa thob nas sbyangs/ rgya gar du lo gcig bzhugs /lam bar la zla ba brgyad 'gor/ phyir bod du phebs nas sngar bzhin nad pa shin tu mang bo nad las grol bar byas par ma zad/bu slob dam tshig can dang dad brtson shes rab dang ldan pa ‘ rnams la sman dpyod kyi yon ngag rnams ma sbaso dzir bstan cing /rgyud kyi sdo skor phyi nang gsang gsum/ sgronedapon gyi gsung ltar kha bskangs nas/ gyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i non du yi ger bkod /bod gangasastocan du gso dpyad dar zhing rgyas par gnang zhing /ca kyi 'phrin las ha cang rgyas bzhin pa'i tshe/ spyir nag phyogs zag dog cing / khyad par blon pongaglang sna can bya bas bod kyi mkhas pa rnams la skyon phab/ g.yugre thogastopa po 0tson du bcug de 48lha

—sdes blon po glang sna tshi las 'das pa la/ mi rnams kyis g.yu thog pas mthu byas zer rinas/ 4 ga8 thog pa chen po klo kha khra'i yul du sgyugs so/ / ge de nas g.yu thog pa chen po klo kha khra la rgyal bo me rtsa yo khur zer ba zhig 'dug pa'i gam du slebs/ klo kha khra la mi sha za ba'i srol yod pas/ rgyal bo me rtsa'i sems la/ mi 'khyams 'di'i gzugs phung rgyas 'dug pas bsad nas sha za dgos bsams te /g.yu thog pa la/ khyod sa phyogs gang nas yin/ don gang la yong / las su gang shes/ ming la gang zer/ nged kyi sa 'di shin tu tsub pas do nub yod pa sang nub med zer bas/ g.yu thog pas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhib par bshad/ khyad par du khong gis nga mi srog gso ba po yin/ srog ster gyi bdud rtsi nga la yod byas pas/ kho na re/ khyod de ltar yin na nga la na tsha yod pas rtsa la ltos zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos da lta rtsa la lta ba'i dus min/ sang nyin ri mtho la nyi ma shar ba dang blta'o gsungs/kho na re/ rung zer nas phyi nyin 'gram pa g.yas su ram bcu—ga g.yon du btsag bcug rtsa gnad skud pas bsdams nas da rtsa la ltos zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos kho'i bya ba dang bsam pa tshang ma ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ nas/ rgyal bo da lta bsnyung mi mnga' yang khyed mi sha za

'a dod pa ded gsungs/ — — ji 9 yeng g.yu thog pas gsungs pa/ klo yi rgyal bo me rtsa khyod/ /mi yi sha khrag za 'dod phyir/ /rdzun dang g.yo yi na rdzun byed/ /khyed kyi lud pa sngo ljang de/ /ram dang btsag gi rgyu las byung / /rtsa rnams tsha zhing mi bde ba/ /rtsa gnad bldams khas 'khrugs pa yin/ /nga ngo khyed kyis ma shes na/ /g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zer/ /mkhas pa kun gyi gtug sa yin/ /tshe srog ster ba'i tshe lha yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ pas/ kho na re/khyed kyi sha kham re dang khrag thigs re gtong zer nas/ 'khor rnams bskul te gsod grabs byas skabs/ la las gsod mi rung zer/ la las gsod dgos zer ba sogs nang mi 'chams pa byung nas/ kho tsho'i nang khu la du gsod rmas chen po byung / khong gi sems la nga la mi srog 'tsho ba dang gnod lan du phan 'dogs nga pa'i dam bca' yod pas/ da zug rngu can 'di rnatsoms la phan 'dogs dgos dgongs nas/ rmus ma rnams kyi rtsar song nas so sor sman byugs pa sogs sman dpyad byas pas/ tshang ma nad 'a55 grol to/ / yang rgyal bo ngan pa des/ g.yu thog pa 'di nges par gsod dgos snyam nas 'dzin mi pho nya mngags/ g.yu thog pa 489

chen po byol bas/ pho nya rnams kyi ma rnyed par phyir log de nayogayu thog pa chen po'i thugs dgongs la/ yul 'di ni 'di 'dra ba'i mtha' 'khob cig tu 'dug da mtha' 'khob chos la 'jug phyir na nus 'chi nus zhen med chags bral zhig bya dgos dgongs nas/ klo'i rgyal bo la btsun mo kha khra mdzes ldan zer ba'i gshis rgyud 'jam zhing rang bzhin bzang ba zhig yod pa'i rtsar song nas/ chos kyi gtam byas pas/ btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa dad par gyur nas/ khong pho brang du gdan drangs nas chos zhus/gser srang lnga brgya phul/ bya ba de blon po kha khra nag po bya bas tshor nas/ rgyal bo la btsun mo kha khra mdzes ldan ma dang g.yu thog pa gnyis lus 'brel byas 'dug ces zhus nas/ g.yu thog pa dang btsun mo gnyis lhan cig tu ras kyisabacings te/ mtsho nag ba rlabs can zhes pa'i nang du bskyur to/ /g.yu thog pa dang btsun mo gnyis mtsho'i rba rlabs kyis pha rol tu 'phangs nas ma shi bar re zhig 'gro don byas te/ skabs shig nas g.yu thog pa chen pos btsun mo pho brang du bskyal/ rgyal bos g.yu thog pa mtshos ma gnod pa tshor nas/ blon po zhig khrid de g.yu thog pa 'tshol du song / g.yu thog pa dang 'phrad de 'thab pas/ g.yu thog pa ma thub par/ g.yu thog pas rgyal blon gnyis kyi rkang ba 490

nas bzung ste sa la drud cing sa la brdabs te/ mtsho nag rba rlabs can gyi nang du bskyur to/ /zhes bsdigs mo mdzad pas/kho gnyis skrag ste/ g.yu thog pa lha'i sprul bar 'dug sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags/ da khyed kyis gang gsungs bgyid pas bdag rgyal blon gnyis srog gi 'jigs pa las skyobs zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ 'o na dkon mchog gsum la—skyabs su 'gro'am gsungs pas/ rgyal blon gnyis na re/ bdag cag 'khor bcas chos sgor 'jug ci gsungs dang du len pa'i bro(mna')phul to/ /de nayogayu thog pa chen po pho brang du spyan drangs/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas kyis bkur snyi gya nom pa'i zhabs tog byas nas chos zhus pas/g.yu thog pa chen pos/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams gsungs nas/ dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par byas pa'i snyan pa bod du thos so/ /de'i tshe bod kyi rgyal blon rnams kyis bka' bgros nas g.yu thog pa chen po gdan 'dren pa'i mi gnyis klo yul du brdzangs/de gnyis kyis g.yu thog pa chen po gdan drangs te/ g.yu thog pa po rang yul du phebs so/ / 491

de nas rgyal bu sod na logs kyis g.yu thog pa chen po pho brang du gdan drangs/ za 'og khri dgu brtsegs kyi steng du bzhugs su gsol/ nor bu rin po che'i 'bul ba mdzad nas bstod pa phul to/ / de nas g.yu thogagapa chen po dgung lo so brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe yang rgya ger la song nas sngar ma gsan pa'i gdams ngag le na dgongasanas gser srang stong bsnams te rgya gar du thengs gsum par byon/— batshol bor zla ba drug bzhugs pas bal bo'i ye rang grong na bram ze gnyis rgya gar la gdams pa 'tshol ba la 'a gro zer ba gnyis dang mjal te khong gnyis dang bsdebayonas byon/ rgya gar nub na mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa su bya ba yod gsum̐ngs pas/ bram ze na re/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan chos skyong bya ba na len dra na bzhugs zer bas/ g.yu thog pa na len dra ru byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan chos skyong la gser srang lnga bcu phul nas/ kye rdo rje gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang ma hā ma ya sogs chos dang gdams pa mang bo zhus/ de nas pad ma spungs pa'i skyed tshal du phebs te/ slob dpon pra wa has ti la gser srang lnga bcu phul nas dam chos rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor rnams zhus/ mkha' 'gro ma seng gdong can 492

la mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi chos skor rnams zhus/ yon du gser srang brgya phul/ paṇ+ḍi ta rig pa'i khu byug la gser srang bcu phul nas rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la sogs pa'i rig gnas phyi nang mtha' dag zhus/ bram ze sa ra ha la gser srang brgya phul nas phyag rgya chen po brda'i skor/ dbu zhabs zung 'jug rdzogs phyag zung 'jug rig pa'i ral skor lnga rnams zhus/ drang srong chen po gzhung skyes la gser srang brgya phul nas skar rtsis ri bo rdul 'bebs/ nag rtsis 'khor 'das gtan 'bebs la sogs pa rtsis kyi rnam grangs brgya rtsa gcig khyad par 'bras rtsis shing rta'i srol 'byed zhus/ mkhas pa me dbang la gser srang brgya phul nas/ gso dpyad 'bum pa/ rgyud shel gyi me long / bstan bcos so ma rā dza cha lag kha skong dang bcas pa rnams zhus/ paṇa chen tsan dra de ba la gser srang brgya phul nas drang srong snyan brgyud dang bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa rnam/sa zhus/ gzhan yang skyes bu tshad ldan la gser gyi 'bul bas mnyes par mdzad nas/ phan byed gnod byed 'dres pa'i gdams pa gnad ldan shin tu mang bo zhus so / / de nas g.yu thog pa po mu stegs kyi sgyusde chen po zhig tu khyon/ de na mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta smra ba zla med bya ba zhig yod pa 493

de na re/ nged gnyis rtsod pa byed/ khyod rgyal na nga khyod kyi rjes sa'ajug nga rgyal na khyod nga'i rjes su zhugs shig zer bas/ rung gsungs nas/ khong gnyis kyis rtsod pa byas pas/ g.yu thog pa chertswapo rgyal nas rgyalīrnga lan bdun brdungs pas/ bod rgyal rnga bdun par grags/ de nas smra ba zla med g.yu thog pa chen po'i slob mar gyur te/ phyag phyir khrid nas rdo rje gdan du byon pas mkhas pa me dbang dang mjal nas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ mkhas pa me dbang mnyes nas/ smra ba zla med nga la phul cig gsungs/ g.yu thog pa chen pos kyang phul nas nang ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta smra ba zla med zer ba'i mkhas pa rtsod bral cig byung bar grags so/ / de nas g.yu thog pa chen po bod la chas byon pas lagabar zhig tu pha dam pa dang mjal/ g.yu thog pa chen pos dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed/ dkar nag khra gsum gyi mkhyud spyad/ rten 'brel brgyad cu rnams zhus nas bod du bar chad med par phebs so/ /rgya gar du phebs thengs gsum pa 'di'i skabs rgya gar du lo bzhir bzhugs gsungs so/ /de nas mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog pa rgya gar nas phyir 'khor ba'i dga' ston du yon bdag bu slob shin tu mang bo 'dus nas tshogs 'khor bshams/ gtang 494

rag phulaba'i tshogs gral du khong gis rgya gar du byon tshul dang gzhan la med pa'i gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa lon tshul rnams gsungs pas bu slob dang yon bdag tshang ma dad cing ngo mtshar bar gyur/ bod kyi rgyal bo yang shin tu dgyes nas dwags kong khyung gsum g.yu thog la phul to/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos/ mkhas pa mi dgu la sogs pa'i bu slob rnams la rig pa'i gnas lnga nyin bshad mdzad/ snying bo don gyi man ngag rnams mtshan la 'chad nyan mdzad/ slob ma byang chub rdo rje/ slob ma 'jam dpal seng ge sman pa dkon sna mchog ming can rnams kyis zhus ngor sman a ru ra byung tshul ro nus sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ / de nas dpon slob thams cad kyi thugs bzhed la dngul chu'i sgrub pa zhig bya'o snyam nas/ dpal ldan 'bum seng dang /dbus pa phyug gtsang bde la sogs pa'i slob ma kha yar kong pho'i dngul chu chung rgod ma len du btang bas/ kong po'i stang bo che'i dngul chu khal lnga bcu nga lnga lon pa la/ rdzas 'dul sngags 'dul btso bkru sogs mdzad nas/ dpon slob lnga brgya tsam bal yudzidu 'gro don la byon/ der rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta nyi ma rab gsatshwa dang mjal nas yi ge dang rtsa'i dkyil 'khor brgal brtag mdzad 495

pas/ g.yu thog pa rgyal stobs kha che'i lul du snyan grags kyis khyab/ de nas kha che'i —rgyal bo 'dzum ha ri 'bam nad kyis thebs pa la dngul chu'i sbyor sde dang rtsa lto bsgrig pa'i gdams ngag mdzad pas/ rgyal bo bsnyun las grol nas mu tig khal nyi shu rtsa lngas mgo byas pa'i rin po che du ma phul/ rgyal bos zhus ngor dngul chu'i las sbyor rgyas par gsungs so/ /de nas dpon slob rnams phyir lha sar phebs/ jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi rgyan bkod pa'i 'phan rgyu ta hun las grub pa nyi shu rtsa lnga la bu tig khal bcu bkod nas phul/ 'pharges pa rang byon la mu tig khal lnga bkod pa'i 'phan phul/ ma cig dpal lha la mu tig khal gcig bkod pa'i 'phan phul/ lha sa na yod pa'i mi lnga stong tsam la chang tshugs zla ba gcig btang ngo / /de nas yer bar phebs nas o rgyan phug tu zhag 'gar bzhugs nas 'gro don byas/ de skabs bal bo'i rgyal bo ha snya ru/ grang ba thur babs kyis zin nas/ gdan 'dren pa rgyung bas/ dpon slob rnams bal bor phebs/ bal bo'i sman pa shī ri sing ha dang mjal/ rgyal bo'i rtsa la sman pa gnyis char gyis gzigs pas g.yu thog pas gsungs pa/ rgyal bo'i nad 'di khyed bal bos tshad par 'dzin/ nged pod kyis grang bar 496

'dzin rte/ 'di la sngar lan tshwa ma btong bas thur rdu 'aspres pa yin/ da lan tshwa che chung ran pa bsten gsungs pas/ bal bo'i sman pa na re/ lan tshwa ni nad kun la mi 'jug ste/ — —dug bzhi dang bral ba'i spyod lam dgos/ dug bzhi ni lan tshwa rus pa'i dug chang sha yi dug nyi ma pags pa'i dug bud med lus zungs kyi dug ste dug bzhi spo nga nus na bde stobs 'phel/ nad pa myur du 'tsho zer zhing / sgrub byed sngon gyi lo rgyus dang bcas pa gsungs te/ dug bzhi spong dgos pa'i sgrub byed mang bo bkod/ g.yu thog pa chen pos de'i lan du 'di ltar gsungs te/skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi dngos bstan de 'dra yin kyang /de la dgos pa dgongs gzhi spyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa yod pas/ nga'i gdams pa lag len 'di yin te ston cig nadadzo gzhi gang dang gang la yang / /dug bzhi spab bar gsungs pa de/ /spyir btang bshad pa'i dbang du byas/ /dmigs bsal lag len 'di ltaste/ /khrag mkhris rgyu byas tsha brkyang ba la/ /ro ni tsha skyur lanari tshwa mngar ba spang / /kha ba bskab dus kun bsten par gsungs/ /lci snum ro dang tsha ba bstenacidrags na/ /tshad pa gzhi 'dzin khrag mkhris glo nad skyed / /497

bad drudzi rgyu byas grang ba skyung ba la/ /ro ni tsha smyur lan tshwa mngar ba bsten/ /kha dang bska ba dus kun spang bar gsungs/ /yang rtsub grang dang bsil rtul bsten dragayon/ /pho ba'i mi 'ardziskran dang dazhe chu skye/ /nad rigs spyi la lan tshwathāsten tshudze+eni/ /grang nad rkyang bar lan tshwanecha gsum bro/ /tshwa grang 'dres na lan tshwa rta la bsten/ /nad med pa la sum gnyis bro ba tsam/ /de las thal na tsha ba rkun por skye/ /lan tshwa med na grang ba rkun bur skye/ /de phyir lan tshwa'i bsten tshul shes par bya/ /zhes dang / lan tshwa rus pa'i dug tu gsungs lags kyang / /lan tshwas rus chag sbyor dang chu ser skem/ /zhes sogs dug bzhi'i spyi btang ridamigs bsal gyi gdams pa lo rgyus dang bcas gsungs pas/ sman pa shī ri sing ha dad par gyur nas/ mkhas pa po g.yu thogab la phyag byas/ sngar 'gran sems 'chang zhing chags sdang gi/ sgo nas rtsod pa byas pa la/ 'gyod bshags byas shing gdams ngag mang bo zhus ba dang / g.yu thog pa chen po mes po dang bcas pa rgya gar la phebs tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang zhus theṭa/ / de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos nyin mtshan dbyer med du 'gro 498

ba nad pa'i don byas/ skabs shig g.yu thog pa dpon slob rnams kong po sman lus dgon par phebs nas re zhig bzhugs/der 'gro ba mang bo nad kyi 'jigs pa las skyob par mdzad/ kong po don yod rdo rje zhes bya ba la bu mo mkhas pa zhig lod pa'i drung nas/ khyi dug gi bcos thabs bye ma reg gcod du grags pa gsan to/ / tsho de rjes g.yu thog yon tan mgon po slob ma nyis brgya dang — bcas pa mnga' ris saphebs nas/ 'gro ba mang bo la sman sogs rten 'brel du ma'i sgo nas 'gro don bsam las 'das pa mdzad/ de'i tshe mnga' ris kyi sman pa mthu chen rgyal tho bya ba phrag dog skyes te/ kho'i slob ma zhig rtsodartsopa byed du btang byung ba des g.yu thog pa chen po la/ khyed g.yu thogatshopa chen bo mkharu'i pa yin zer bas/ ngas dri ba 'di rnams la lan thob cig zer nayo'adi skad brjod/ — ro nus zhu rjes kun ldan pa'i/ /sman mchog de 'dra bod na med/ /sa steng dug rigs bsam micakhyab/ /sa steng sman du gyur pa ci/ /rgyug rtsa khog stong nang na mar/ — /khrag ngan rlung gis rtsa spug bdas/ /dbugs dang bsdebs nas 'phar zheb la/ /rtsa la brtag pa ci yi phyir/ /nad de gnyen pos 499

'dzoms pa la/ /nad la phan zhesu tha snyad 'khrul/ — /de 'dra'i 'gal ba ltag sgrod la/ /g.yu thog pa yis lan thob ci ga /ces zer byung ba'i lan du g.yu thog ba chen pos 'asna skad gsungs lha // / — — — sdu — ro nus zhu rjes kuno ldan pha'i/ /sman mchog bod na med ce na/ /a ru ra yang med par 'gyur/ /sa steng sman min gang yang med/ /nad gzhi rang rang gnyen po'i sman/ /lus dang gri ba ma'i tshul bzhin gnas/ /sa steng dug sman stobs che yang nga/ /'khol ba shes na sman gyi mchog /rgyug rtsa khong stong angs pa'i nang / /don snod bcu gnyis rtsa rnams mtsho'i /ba rlabs 'phreng ba ji bzhin du/ /ma 'dres so sor rgyu ba yod/— /jingo lharlung khrag byed las yin/ /tha snyad rtsa la brtag ces bya/shā /oṃl brtag kyang rlung la btag /rlung khrag rtsa gsum zung 'jug yin/ /nad de gnyen pos 'joms pa la/ /nad la phanari zhes tha snyad de/ /nad la mi phan nad la gnod/ /nad kyis btabasku/ de la phan/ /brda sbyor mkhan po'i rtog spyod yin / /zhesangasogs gsungs pas/ kho dad par gyur te/ g.yu thog pa chen po'i slob mar gyur/ sems can la phan 'dogs pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur to/ / 500

de nas g.yu thog pa chen po sa skyar phebs te/ 'jam dbyangs phug pa zhes bya ba na sman pa yon tan dpal bzang zhes bya ba yod pa de'i mdun du phebs nas/ sbyor ba'i phreng bu losogs pa'i man ngag brgya rtsa gcig zhus so/ /de nas ba55 pa'i lam bar du sman pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang mjal bas khos chib sa pa sga 'khor tshang ma zhig dang gser srang bzhi phul te gdams pa zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos bdud rtsi bum pa rtsa ba'i rgyud gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang / de nas dpon slob rnams kong por byon/ kong po'i sman pa khamasajigasum zil gnon gyis chibs pa sga 'khor tshang ma gcig dar yug bcu/ gos yug lnga/ ja sig bcu/ gserosrang bco brgyad rnams phul nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ de nas dpon slob rnams rgya nag tu ri bo rtse lnga bskor du phebs/ lam du gangs char sogs kyis dka' tshegs chen po byung / ri bo rtse lngar sman pa drang srong ad+ma zhes bya ba las sbyor ba'i phrerdotho dang / byang khog don 'grel la sogs pa'i gdams ngag khyad bar can mang bo gsan te/ phyir bod du phebs/ yang g.yu thog pa dpon sloba'abya yul du phebs/ bya yul gyi mjal gidaman btsun bya ba'i bud med smun pa la sogs pa'i slob ma rnams la sman dpyad la sogs pa'i 50/

gdams pa rgya cher bstsal/ de nas dpon slob rnams dwags por rtson/ sman pa lhun grub rdo rje rtsod pas pham par byas te rjes su bzung / de la sogs pa'i slobha ma rnams la sman la sogs pa'i gad rdzomaskyang po gnang ngo / / ri g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo zhe lnga bzhes skabs rgyud bzhi gter nas spyan drangs/ rgyud kyi cha lag la sogs pa'i gso dpyad kyi dpe rgyud kyi cha lag bco brgyad la sogs pa'i gzhung mang bo blartsams/ de nas dgung lo nga lnga bzhes pa'i dus/ slob ma bde— ba dpal phyag phyir khrid nas kong por byon/ der slob ma sum brgya tsam 'du ba byub / de rnams la rgyud bzhi cha lag kha skong dang bcas pa gnang bas/ sman pa 'bum rams pa bya ba lngasgyu bcu tsam/ sman pa rab 'byams pa bya ba lnga bcu tsalobyung / sman sna pa dka' bcu ba bya ba brgya tsa ma byung nas dgung lo drug cu re lnga'i bar kong por bzhugs so / / sman pa 'bum rams pa bya ba'i gzhung tshad ni/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong mdo byang / phyogs rigs kyi sman pa dgus bsgyur ba'i gso dpyad kyi‘dpe rnams dang / bod kyi mkhas pa mi dgus mdzad pa'i dpe rnams dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzadacipa'i bstan bcos so ma rāsmyo dza dang / yo rgyun bya0lha

rin po chis mdzad pa'i bdud mi'i bum pa/ slob dpon dpa'alhabos mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa/ drangasrong dpal ldan 'phreng bas mdzad pa'i drang srong snyan brgyud/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zla dgas mdzad pa'i tshig don blo zer sogs kyi rtsa 'grel kha skong cha lag rnams blo la thon zhing / de dag gi don lag len du sgrilashes pa la bya'o/ / — sman rams pa bya ba'i gzhung tshad ni/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong mdo byang / bod kyi mi dgus mdzad pa'i gdams pa dang / bstan bcos so ma rā dza dang / bdud rtsi bum pa tsa 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa'o pa sman pa dka' bakhyi ba'i gzhung tshad ni/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong mdo byang dang bcas pa'o /sman pa bsdus ra ba'i gzhung tshad ni/ rtsa bshad phyi gsu ma rtsa 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa la bya'o/ /rgyud bzhi cha lag re tsam thon pa rnams kyis/ g.yu thog pa chen po'i grwa ba rnams kyi thug pa skol ba dang / bang chen pa dgos par gda'/ de nas g.yu thog pa chen po dpon slob dar rtse mdor byon ri te/ rgya bod kyi 'gro ba mang bo'i srog bskyabs/ de nas dpon slob stong tsam gyis kong po'i sman lung bya bar sman gyi dgon pa lta 4 503

na sag bya ba btab ste/ sman pa'i rigs su gyur ba'i bya bral ba thams cad la bshad nyan gyis sgro 'anogs gcod pa byung ngo / /gnas der sman bla mched brgyad/ drang srong rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa dang / dar byed kun tu grags pa'i sman pa rnam sardo la rang byon du yod pa'i rten 'brel gyis gnas der 'brel ba zhugs pa tsam gyis sman bsod rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ / rīgayu thog pa chen pos yum rdo rje mtsho mo khab tu bzhes pa la sras 'bum seng / dpal 'bum/ dga' dga' gsum 'khrungs/sras gsum yang rim gyis mkhas par gyur/ skabs shig nas/g.yu thog pa chen pos/ gtsang 'di sa ngan pas chas mi 'byor rang yul du 'gro dgos gsungs nas bslab bya 'di ltar gnang /khyed rnams rang 'dod khog 'gras ser sna ngan g.yo bor la/ byang chub kyi sems kyi gzhi bzung / 'gro ba dad pa'i bya ba don du gnyer/ mtho 'grogs dang khe tshong mi byed par ngag glod mtha' nas skyongs/ mi ngo zas ngo la mi lta bar nad la phan pa'i sman dpyad mdzod/ phyogs cha nye ring spongs la kun la khyab pa'i sman pa mdzod/ bdag bzung gi gnas mi brten par rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim la nad pa phyogs med la ltos/ che btsan gyi bla 504

sman ma byed par sprang bo brtse bas skyongs/ nag chang phyogs su ma 'dod par dkar gsum lto la brten/ rta drel bzhon pa sgongs la nad pa'i bran du rgyugs/ mi shes shes par ma rloms rgas kyaroslob gnyer mdzod/ mi srog tshad len ma byed mi shes pa ngos longs/ sgo gsum chos la 'bungs la phyi ma'i lam sna zungs/ gsungs nas slob ma brgya tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams rang rang gi gnas su log rang gi sras gsum la gso dpyad kyi bka' gtad de/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ phyi ma'i don chen sgrub pa la nyin mtshan g.yel med du bzhugs so/ /de nas skabs shig g.yu thog pa chen pos/ slob ma rnams la gangs te se bskor du 'gro gsungs pas/ slob ma rnams kyisabashol btab kyang ma thebs par gangs te ser gnas bskor la phebs/ bod kyi gangs te se ri bo bzhi mtsho dang bcas pa bskoronas la stod brgyud de bal bor phebs/ 'phags pa shing kun3 bskor te la stod bal bo la sogs pa'i yul mang bor phebs nas/'gro ba mang bo'i srog bskyabs/ de nas 'on ljang rdo'i lha khang du phebs/ der rgyal bo'i bla sman 'dzin pa bzhi yod pas/ de rnams kyis/ rtsa'i rgyal blon srasadang bcas pa ngos 'dzin lugs shig zhu zer nas ja sig gcig yon du phul ba la/ g.yu 505

thog pa chen pos/ rtsa'i rgyal bo sde lnga/ rtsa'i blon po sde drugartsa'i btsun mo sde dgu/ rtsa'i sras sde bcu/ rtsa'i las byed sde bcu/ rtsa'i khol mo sde gcig rtsa'i dmag mi grangs las 'das pa/dwangs ma dang rlung thig le rgyu ba'i rtsa'i gtso mo gsum/ rtsa'i 'khor lo bzhi/ rtsa'i pho brang lnga rnams yod do gsungs nas rtsa'i stong thun rgyas par gsungs so/ / der mi mgo bo tshal bar chag pa zhig ston 'ongs pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ 'di lta bu'i nad pa la gso dpyad byas kyang phugs phan thogs pa dka' gsungs kyang / nad pa na re/ bdag mi 'gyod pa la gang la gang dgos mkhyen mkhyen zer/ khong gis sman pa gzhan dang sprod do gsungs pas/ sman pa gzhan gyi don med/ khyed rang gi lagatshotu 'chi zer/ de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos dras drub sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyi bcos mdzad/khyad par seng phug dod pa/ klad med 'don pa/ rus mthong dbye ba/ klad pa bsdoms pa/ lha ba 'gugs pa/ gro kha'i 'jibs chang / krung gi them bu la sogs te rus chag rdza stugs kyi gdams pa mdzad nas/ klad rus rtsa la sogs pa skyon thams cad sangs nas nad pa mkhar ba la chags tsam yod dus/ nad pa'i spyod pa log pas/ gza' nad phog nas bal 'dab ltar 506

lob pa dang / rengs pa dang / kha sna mig gsum yo zhing / kha chu mi thub pa/ gtam ldib pa/ lus zo mi thub pa byung ste/ g.yu jog pa chen po spyan drangs pas/ 'di mgo skyon min gza' phog pa red gsungs kyang / tshang mas mgo skyon du thag bcad/ kho tshe 'phos so/ /yang g.yu thog pa chen pos nad pa mgo nad yod pa zhig sman pa gang gis bcos kyang ma phan pa zhig la bcos mdzad pas/ mgo nad las grol te skor ba byed pa'i tshe/ zas log byung nas pho ba na ba'i tshe/ mkhris skyugs btang bas zas dang nad gson por thon nas yod pa'i tshe/ yang chu bsris pas chu gsang bsros pas nad las grol kyang zungs kyis ma thub par nad pa tshe'i dus byas pa las/ yul de'i mi zhig gis nad pa skyel mi dgos na g.yu thog pa gdan drongs zer ba sogs/ g.yu thog pa po la bskur ba 'debs pa/ khong gis thos nas gsungs me/ chu chun grangs mang na rdza'i bu chu chun gyi lag tu chag nad pa kun sos na gdan thog tu pur mi chags/ rta zhon grangs mang na rtas brdabs pa yang yod/ rta la chag pa yang yod gsungs/ kho de nub mo 'bu log langs nas 'chi grabs yod pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po gdan 'dren du yong na'ang / bu slob rnams kyis nged dpon slob rnams phyin na/ nad pa'i skyel ma byed zer/ kho shi 507

na'ang shi zer nas g.yu thog pa chen po la zhus/ kho'i chung ma g.yu thog pa chen po'i mdun du song nas/ bzod pa bzhes la nad pa srog las bskyab tu gsol zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa'i bu slob rnams kyis zhus pa khong la bskur ba btab pas 'byon mi 'tshal zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po'i zhal nas/ spyir sman pas khro 'dzin byas na dam tshig dang 'gal/ sgos nad pa'i sems ba sad na mi bzang gsungs nas byon te nad g.yog la sems gso mdzad/ nad de la phan pa'i sman gla rtsi bdun pa dang / chig thub khaṇa ḍa gnyis ltag sprod gnang / de'i steng du bshal sman bsnan nas sbyangs/ sman nas sun gyis drangs/ long rtsa phab/nad pa drod la sgor nas pho ba khu tshur gyis phur/ de ltar byas pas glang thabs kyi rigs tsha grang med par tshang ma bsal te/ nad pa de nad las grol/ de nas nad de las thar ba'i gtang rag tu/ mkhas pa chen po la chibs pa sga srab gyis brgyan pa zhig dang nas khal brgya rnams phul nas 'khor dang bcas pa la bshags pa phul to/ / de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos nad pa zhig la rtsa gzigs pas/ nad pa khyod kyis sngar sman pa su bsten/ sman gang zos/nad 'di gang du ngos bzung gsungs pas/ nad pa na re/ bdag 508

gi nad 'di ma zhu ba yin zer/ lo gcig bla ba lnga tsam song /sman pa 'phrad tshad kyi lag nas sman zos/ lhag par bdag gi nad 'di la rgyus yod pa'i sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel bya ba zhig yul 'di na yod zer ro/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos sman pa de bos nas/ nad pa 'di'i nad gang red ces dris pas/ kho na re/ dang po ma zhu ba'i rgyu byas da lta skran dmu chur song ba 'dra zer bas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos de ma red/ nad 'di tshad pa 'dres pa red/ da lta tshad gzhug ma chod pa red/ zas dang spyod lam log pas/ da tsha chur 'gro gsungs/ kho na re/ de la bcos thabs gang byed zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ tsha chur grang chur bsgyur grang chu gtan la 'bebs gsungs pas/ khos tsha chu gso mi thub/ grang chu gsor rung zer bas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos rgyud kyi dngos bstan de 'dra yin kyang chu'i 'phrul 'khor byas na gso thub par 'gyur gsungs nas/ chu'i man ngag bdun ldan/ go rim nges pa'i dpyad la sogs pa mdzad pas nad las grol bas/ sngar gyi sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel gyis/ khyod nad las grol ba nga'i sman gyi drin yin pas nga la gtang rag dgos zer bas/ nad pa na re/ nga nad las grol ba g.yu thog pa po'i drin yin/ khyod la gtang rag mi yong byas pas/ kho khros 509

te/ las mkha' 'gros byas pa dngos grub 'bal mo la mi yong /nad ngas bcos pas drin gzo g.yu thog pa la byed pa mi rigs zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos nad pa la/ spyir lha rje 'di med thabs med pa'i mi yin pas/ khyed kyi nad nged kyis gsos pa yin yang / gtang rag khong la phul cig gsungs pas/ nad pas kyang bka' dang du blangs te/ sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel la gtang rag sogs bya dga' chen pos mnyes par byas so/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel la 'di skad gsungs/ — sman pa 'tsho byed bsam 'grub 'phel/ /'dod chags dang rang 'dod ma che bar/ /khrel dang ngo tsha'i gaban la bzhugs/ /zhe sdang dang phrag dog ma che bar/ /dad pa dang mos pa'i g.yang gos gyon/ /gti mug dang le lo ma byed par/ /brtson 'grus dang bag yod kyi ska rags chings/ /nga rgyal dang ser sna ma che bar/ /byams pa dang snying rje'i rgyan cha thogs/ /g.yo sgyu dang gzhogs slong ma byed par/ /nges 'byung dang shes rab rta la zhon/ /ngan g.yo dang bag med ma byed par/ /dran 'dzin dang skyo shas ci rigs mdzod/ /gtang rag dang bya dga' ma sems par/ /phan sems dang gzhan sem/sa bya ra 510

thongs/ /mi srog la tshad len mi byed par/ /man ngag la slob pa gdeng ldan gyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ sman pa bsam 2grub 'phel dad pa skyes te phyag phul zhabs spyi bor blangs so/ / g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu bzhes pa'i tshe/ bu dang slob ma rnams kyis/ gdams ngag gnad dang ldan pa zhig bdag cag rnams la gnang du gsol zhus pas/ gastso thog pa chen pos gsungs pa/ nga'i bsam pa la nga rang la gang yod kyi gdams ngag khungs lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ khyed rang rnams la byin tshar ba'i lugs yin/ nga mi rgan dal du chugs gsungs pas/ sras g.yu thog 'bum seng gis 'di skad zhus so/ /bdag cag rnams la sngar yang gdams ngag gi dkor mdzod kha phyes nas thang mar brdol kyang da dung yid ma tshim/ da dgung lo yang brgya dang nyi shu bzhes 'dug rig 'dzin drang srong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tshogs dpon du nam ci 'byon mi shes/ da gdams ngag gi lhag ma bdag bu slob rnams la gnang 'tshal zhes zhus/ so/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos rgya dkaro nag bal bo la sogs pa'i mkhas pa thams cad kyi man ngag gi snying bo bsdus pa/ g.yu thog nyams yig mthong ba don ldan ma 511

bu slob rnams la gnab/ de nas dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga'i bar du bu slob rnams la gdams ngag gi dkor mdzod gang la gang dgos gnang zhing / dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga'i tho ga zel zla'i tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs su sku gshegs so/ /g.yu thog pa chen po'i gsung rtsom gyi skor ni/ rig gnas phyi nang zhes pa'i gzhung la le'u so gsum/ sde skor phyi nang gsang gsum la le'u nga lnga/ rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad 'grel ba kha skong dang bcas pa/ rgyud 'grel stong rtsa gcig la le'u stong dang sum brgya/ man ngag phan byed dang gnod byed kyi gzhung phran shin tu mang bo/ dmar 'ded kyi man ngag la le'u brgya dang dgu bcu/ ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long la le'u nyer lda byang khog gsang dbye le'u brgyad/ thur dpyad gnad kyi sde mig la le'u so lnga/ mngon shes gnad kyi 'phrul 'khor la le'u bco lnga/ gsang thig rin chen sgron me la le'u bco brgyad/ nag rtsis 'khor 'das gtan 'bebs la le'u brgya dang nyi shu/ 'bras rtsis la le'u nyer lnga/ dkar rtsis ri bo rdul 'bebs la le'u drug cu/rgyud bzhi'i them yig gab pa gsal byed/ tho byang / rgyud kyi kha skong / dkar chag cha lag me rtsa mdo chod nag po/ gtar kha lag len 'phyugs med/ gyen 'dren lcags kyus nya 'dzin/512

thu ra 'bebs ri bo rbab sgril/ nyams yig mthong ba don ldan/khrid yig brgya dang nyer gcig nad pa la gces pa srog 'tsho dpal skyed kyi gdams —pa/ sman pa la gces pa bskrad pa lnga ldan gyi gdams pa/ gzhan yang phran tshegs man ngag gi gzhung phran mang bo yod pa la sogs pa'i gzhung shin tu mang bo mdzad gsungs so gaspun da/ /gu zhog gsan na ldon tan na/na spruzhi rnan ban skyod skaki burnod bu/ — g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i rnam par thar ba cung zad brjod pa la/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ byams pa bde legs yan gyi g.yu thog gi gdung rgyud la/ g.yu thog rnying ma zhes grags/ de nas g.yu thog nyi ma 'od zer/ pad ma rdo rje/ gu ru rdo rje/ byang chub rdo rje/ gangs can mkhas pa dang lnga bo 'di gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos la mkhas shing rinyams su len mkhan yin la/ lhag par gangs can mkhas pa zhes bya ba 'di gsang sngags gsar rnying dang gso dpyad spyi la shin tu mkhas par gra—gas spyang / 'di lnga'i ring la bdud rtsi sman— sgrub dang sman phreng sogs 513

nub cing / g.yu thog gsar ma'i mgoracibyung ba'i rus rgyud tsam las gsar ma dri ma med pa ma yin gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yāng 'di ltar yin snyam ste/ bstan pa snga dar dang snga dar gyi mjug tu byung ba'i g.yu thog gi gdung rgyud rnams la g.yu thog rnying ma 6dang / phyi dar gyi skabs su byuja ba'i g.yu thog gi gdung rgyud rnams la g.yu thog gsar ma zer la/ glang dar mas chos dang rig gnas kun bsnubs te/ chos byas mi chog pa'i bka' bsgragame pa'i rjes —nag rjos dang ldeg gnasta gangartse la'ado tshoslob gnyer byed pa'i srol re zhig nub/ de'i stabs kyis gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa'ang shin nyu nyams dmas par gyur/ des na nyi ma 'od zer sogs lnga bo 'di snga dar dang phyi dar gyi mtshams sam phyi dar gyi mgo tsam la byung stabs/ gso ba rig pa'i khrid rgyun dang lag len gyi rgyun phal cher chad kyang dar spel gtong ma thub pa'i stakyibs kyis/ g.yu thog gsar ma'i mgor byung yang rus rgyud 'dzin pa tsam las gsar ma dri ma med pa min zhes sngon gyi lo rgyus las bshad do/ / 9 des na g.yu thog gsar ma ni/ sngar gyi g.yu thog rnying ma'i mkhas chen lnga'i mtshan slar gsar ma'i skabs kyi mkhas chen lnga la rim bzhin gsol ba/ gsar ma 'dre rje badz+ra/ gsar ma khyung 514

boji rdo rjo/ gsar ma yon tan mgon po/ gsar ma 'bum sedz+wa/ ga sur ma sra lu rdo rje grags te lnga la zer la/ de lnga'i nang nas kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa ni gsar ma yon tan mgon po yin no/ / r+sha g.yu thog rnying ma 'dre rje badz+ra gyi skabs su khyim gzhis stod lung skyi sna zhes pa'i sa char yod la/ gsar ma 'dre rje badz+ra gyi skabs su khyim gzhis nyang stod sgo bzhi re thang zhes par yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan 4gyis 'diriba'i mtshan la nyang stod sgo bzhi re thang ba— yang zer ro — gsar ma 'dre rje badz+ra 'di ni/ gangs can mkhas pa'i srasu su sku 'khrungs te/ gzhon nu nyid nas yi ge dang rig pazhid+kuganaspo la sbyangs/ blo rig gsal zhing skyes bu dam pa'i ngang tshul dang — ldan pas/ rten 'brel gyi dgos khyad la dmigs nas/ rnying ma 'dre rje badz+ra gyi mtshan 'di ba la gsol te/ gsar ma 'dre rje badz+ra du grags/ khong nar son nas sman dpyad kyi rgyud pa chad pa dag slar gso bar dgongs nas rgya gar du byon nas/ sman phreng dang bdud rtsi'i sman sgrub sogs gsan/ gzhan yang mkhas pa du ma'i mdun nas—gso dpyad sogs gsan pa mtha' dag rang gi sras gsar ma khyung bo rdo rje la gnang / gsar ma khyung bo rdo rje ni rig—gnas 5 15

bcu la mkhas shing / khyad par du gso ba rig pa nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad pa'i mkhas grub chen po yin zhes snyan grags rgyas shing / 'phrin las kyang shin tu che/ de'i sras la gsar ma yon tan mgon po 'khrungs pa yin te/ khyung bo'i jo mo pad ma 'od ldan zheyobya ba shes rgyud dul zhing byams snying rje can zhig yod pa la/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus yab khyung bo sogs kyi mdun nas yi ge sogs la sbyangs/ dgung lo brgyad nas bzung rig pa'i gnas kun dang khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa la sbyangs shing / phul du phyin par mkhyen pas gzhon nu nyid nas kyang snyan grags dang 'phrin las rgyas pa yin te/ rje rang nyid kyi gsung las/ ri kho bo g.yu thog mgon po yis/ /lo brgyad lon nas sman dpyad sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gangs can khrod kyi gagathog mgon/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes bzung bas/ /nang dang gtan tshigs sgra rig dang / /bzo dang gso ba rig pa yi/ /tshig don kun la mkhas par gyur/ /ces gsungs so rje 'di dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i skabs shig tu/ dge bshes rog ston zhes pa dbus phyogs su grwa skor la 'byon mkhan 516

zhig 'a9ba bar du zhabs 'bam gyis bsnyung nas gsar ma g.yu thog pa chen po'i drung du ston par byon pa la g.yu thog pari chen pos gzigs nas sman byas pas khong snyun las grol te/ dga' bzhin du dbus la byon/ lo gnyis tsam gyi rjes su yang dge bshes rog ston la chu nad shin tu thu ba zhig byung bas/ sman pa kha shas la gtugs na'ang drag skyed ci yang ma byung ba la dbus pa dar grag sakyi snyan pa thos te/ de'i drung du phyin nas 'phrod bsten bgyis pas nad las grol/ de nas khong la g.yu drug dmar nam mkha' gsal bya ba nas khal stong ri ba zhig yod pa de/ dbus pa dar grags la phul/ gso dpyad kyi slob dpon zhus nas rgyud bzhi zhus pas/ dbus pa dar grags kyis rog ston la rgyud bzhi man ngag gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa gnang zhing / gzhan yang sman dpyad kyi man ngag mang bo gnang / de nas dge bshes rog ston log byon pas yar lam g.yu thog pa pos snga sor rkang 'bam bcos pa'i drin dran pa dang / rgyud 'di g.yu thog pa la phul na phan pa rgya che bar dgongs nas/ sgo bzhi re thang du byon te g.yu thog par rgyud 'di gzhung 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa phul/ de nas rgyud 'di yan lag brgyad pa sogs gso dpyad spyi dang cung zad mi mthun pa'i thad rnams la/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po 517

dang rog ston gnyis kyis rtsod pa mdzad pas rog ston rgyal bas rigayu thog pas rgyud 'di khungs sgetsun par gzigs te thugs shin —tu mnyes nas/ rog ston la rta sga srab dang bcas pa zhig dang yu ma rgyas pa 'dzum r+shagye gtsu byasasmopa'i 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/ re zhig chig rgyud kyi bka' rgya grol zheb ma mdzad par rje nyid rang gis zab bzhes su mdzad/ ji 'di'i sngon du g.yu thog gdung rgyud gsar ma— la rgyud bzhi'i man ngag gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa rgyun chad 'dug go/ /de nas dgung lo bco brgyad du phebs pa'i tshe rgya gar la phebs nas/ thog mar ku da'i yul du gtso mo dpal ldan phreng ba zhes bya ba las lcang lo nag po'i rgyud gsan/ yul 'khor mo — 'jig tu phebs nas/ yan lag brgyad pa/ so ma rā dza/ phanasnye pa'i mdo/ rin chen spungs pa/ ku mud/ reg pa rtsa mdo/ srog skyob ṭī ka rnams gsan/ sing ga la'i gling du phyin nas / gle zer dkar nag bdud rtsi bum pa che 'bring chung gsum rnams gsan/ rgyal bo'i khab tu dpa' bo'i bstan bcos yan lagami brgya da pa/— 'khrungs dpe che chung / rdo sbyor gab pa rnams gsan/gser gling du byon nas drang srong phyogs kyi go cha zhes bya ba las sman gyi rgyud/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ sha khrag 'tsho ba snying rje med pa'i rgyud/ srog chags sgrol ba'i rgyud/ sgrol ma 'byung rgyud /518

gosir sogs rin po che'i bzo rgyud/ gro ga'i 'dab ma'i rgyud / —'jam dpal yab yum gyi rgyud/ bse sgrom gyi rgyud/ pa dpa' bo 'ching 'grol gyi rgyud/ ro bkra'i le'u/ ro bkro sil bu/ 'byung —ba so so'i rgyud/ — rtsa mdo chen mo/ snying /bo bstan pa'i rgyud/ lus kyi rnam gzhag bdud rtsi them yig rig pa rtsa dpyad/ 7rgya yi smra chung / gu ṇa sha baposhā rgyud bam po sum brgya the/ ka sa'i tshal zhes pa'i tshale du lha mo bdud rtsi ma zhes pa dang mjal nas/ri zhuse lan skor gsum dang / mo rtsi 'chi med bcad 'as+hor rnam yogasan/ slar yang bai snya'i yul du lha mo bdud rtsi'i mdun nas gso dpyad kyi gzhung sgrol ma skor gsum so gas gsan lko dgungatsho lo nyer gcig thog bod du phyir phebs nas/ shangs dpadzosnyele zhes pa'i sa char bzhugs nas/ bu slob du ma bsdus te 'gro ba'i don rmadzad do/ri/ dgung lo sum cu so bzhir slebs pa'i tshe yang rgya gar la ca phebs nas drang srong tsa ra ka sogs paṇ+ḍi ta du ma'i—mdun nas ca gdams pa meng bo thob/ sngar gyi slob dpon mo/ ga'o mo dpal ldan phreng ba'i mdun nas/ yan lag bgyed pa bsil zedzogyi gnad dang / rgyud rigs drug cu rartsa lnga sogs gsan na sa/ slar yang bod du phebs te/ lus caltadu ma na ba dang 'chi ba'i 5rku9

sdug bsngal las thar bar byas pa dang / slob ma skyong ba sogs kyis 'gro don bar ma chad par gnang bas/ rtsod bral gyi mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes mtshan snyan gyi gdugs dkar bos gangs can gyi ljongs yongs su mdzes par byas so/ / gzhan yang gsar ma g.yu thog pa chen po rgya gar du phebs te mu stegs kyi ston pa lnga brgya brtsad pas pham par byas pa dang /yang rgya gar lho phyogs dpal gyi rir phebs pa dang / skabs shigabyuyo rgyan gyi yul du phebs pa dang / yang rgya gar du phebs te/rgyal bo chen po zhig gi mchod gnas mdzad pa dang rdo rje gdan du paṇ+ḍi ta mang bo'i tshogs dpon mdzad pa sogs snga phyir rgya gar du lan drug byon pa yin te/ rje rang gi gsung las/ rgya gar 'phags yul lan drug bskor/ rma hā rā dza'i mchod gnas byas/ /mu stegs ston pa dregs pa can/ /dpon slob lnga brgya rigs pas bcom/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byas/ /rdo rdzigadan du slebs pa'i tshe/ /paṇa chen mang bo'i tshogs dpon byas/ /mkhas pa 'tshogs pa'i gtsug rgyan yin/ /rang 'dod mi shes drange gtam lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gsar ma g.yu thog pa chen po dpon slob rnams kyis 520

'gro don rgya ts+tshan po gnang zhing bzhugs/ skabs shig dpon slob brgya lhag tsam gtsang gi tshogs 'dus mgur mor btsad po dzo darayab sras rnams kyis spyan drangs/ dus der sman dang / sgra'i bshad pa mdzad/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab la ṭī ka brtsams pa dang / rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i khrid bskyangs pa'i chos gzhis zla ba lnga la bteg de rnams legs par tshar nas dga' ston gyi nyin btsad pos tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po bshams shing / rje btsun g.yu thog pa chen po'i drung du gse ro bre chen gcig dngul/ bre gnyis/ chibs pa ngang ba khyung gshoka gi mgo byas pa'i chibs pa lnga/ chibs rol drug ja sigartadagu/ tshos ltang / mdzo g.yag 'bri/ gos yug dar yug man tri yugaka dan gyi gtsos pa'i 'jam phrug bub longs re re bzhin dgu tshan re phul/ za 'og yug gnyis/ gser 'bum tshar gcig g.yu dmar nyi ma khrom gshog sras mo lha mdzes ma'i mgul du btags nas phul/ bu slob spyi la'ang gtang rag bsnyen bkur so sor gral 'byed/ spyi 'bul phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas gtang rag gi dga' ston bla na med pa mdzad do/ / de nas gsar ma yon tan mgon po dpon slob suyobargya lhag tsam zhig k+ṣid grong du rgyal bo lha btsun gyis spyan drangs shing 5lhashā

zla ba bzhi'i mchod gzhis bteg pas/ bdud rtsi sman sgrub sogs mdzadapyicing / der 'bul ba ches shin tu mang bo byung yang /phyogus de'i dge 'dun thams cad spyan drangs nas so sor gang dang gang la 'dris pa'i thugs das mdzad par gsol zhing / zhag mang bo'i bar du bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i sgonas mchod/ sprang bo dang nad kyis mnar ba'i nyam thag pa rnams la'ang zang zing gi dngos pori gang la gang 'dod dang / khyad par sman gyi sbyin pa rlubs po che'i sgo nas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad/jo bo rang byon wa ti bzang bo'i drung du'ang blor mi shong ba lta bu'i mchod pa phul nas thugs smon mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon pos snga phyir ljags rtsom mdzad pa ni/ brgyud pa che chung gi snying bo bsdus pa dang / dpa' bo'i snying bo bsdus pa'i mdo gnas kyi 'grel ba mthong ba'i me long / rtsa dpyad rig pa rang gsal sde tshan lnga ba/ lag len mdo chung / man ngag shog dril skor gsum/ rgyud chung ba/ nyams yig bu don ma rnams mdzad/ khyad par dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di nyid gso dpyad kun gyi yang rtser gzigs na/sa gangs can gyi ljongs su lus can kun gyi spyi nor du spelha/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab nas 52lha

gser mchan/ zong mchan gnyis btab/ rgyud kyi gzhung 'grel man ngag kha skong dang bcas pa'i go chod du cha lag bco brgyad legasi par bsgrigs nas skal ldan gyi thugs sras dam pa sum ston ye shes bzung la gdams so/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal byed mdo sngags kyi gsung rab du ma'i dgongs 'grel rtsom par mdzad do/ / rje 'di la bu slob grangs las 'das —pa byung ba'i gtso bo ni/yul ru mtshams sum pa'i bur skyes pa ye shes bzung zhes pa rje nyid kyi zhabs rdul lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bsten te lus longs spyod kyi sgo nas mnyes par byas shing ci gsung bka' bzhin du ru dus skad cig tsam yang g.yel ba med par sgrub pa zhig yod pa de dang / ljang sman leb se/ 'bal sman nyi ma/ ston pa a tshes/sha rasda gi ma dpal/ g.yu thog bsod nams seng ge/ dge bshes rme rog chung sogs mkhas pa ming dang don mthun pa sum brgyar nye ba byung ngo / /de nas mkhas grub chen po de nyid kyis dgung lo bdun cu don drug bzhes pa'i tshe bu slob rnams la bslab bya dang zhal gdams du ma gnang nas sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang ngo / /g.yu thog gsar ma'i lo tshigs sogs dar mo sman rams 523

pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar du mi gsal zhing / sde srid kyis bai sngon du/ rnying ma nas mi rabs bcu gsum snga phyi ha lam 'brom sogs dang dus mtshungs gsungs shing / mar mi dang dwags po lha rje'i rjes su byung ba 'dra ste/ khong gi gsung gleng skabs de dag gi sgros byung 'dug des na rab byung gnyis pa'i stod tsam zhig e yin snyam mo/ /zhes g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar 'di ni/ bsam gtanajirgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas/ gzhan dag gis bskul ma nan che ba'i ngo ma bzlog par/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po rnying ma'i rnam thar gzi brjid rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba dang / g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i rnam thar dar mo sman rams pas mdzad pa las thun mong gi mdzad pa tsam btus te bsgrigs pa yin la/ rab rgyal lcags sprel lo'i(spyi lo1980)dbyu gu zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba dad bor dbu btsugs/ smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang bo dang bo'i nyin mjug rdzogs par bris pa'o// //

ri'i+o / /rtsom pa bo rang gi byung ba brjod pa rang gsal ā dar sha zhes bya ba bzhugs so// naskyod dan burnod bu gogaska/ — bdud bzhi las rgyal bstan pa'i bdag po dang / /zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin byams 'jam dbyangs/ byu/shing rta che gnyis la sogs 'phags bod kyi/ /paṇa grub bkal drin can rnams phyag gi yul/ /pad dkar ltar bsngags bcom ldan —shākya'i tog /de yi bstan la phyi dor legs bgyis pa/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la snying nas 'dud/ /mkhas grub gser gyi 'khor lo la brten nas/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i khyon la dbang bsgyur ba/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa yab sras dang / /'khrungs rabs bstan bdag che rnams rnam par rgyal/ /bskal bzang rgyal kun bstan pa'i snying bo mchog /'jigs med 525

sku bzhi'i dpal mnga' cong kha ba'i/ /bstan pa spel la dbang 'byor 'phrin las kyis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bzang bo rtag tu bsten/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /lhag bsam dag pas spel la mthu grub pa/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i gser ldan bu mo'i ltor/ lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'khyil la snying nas gus/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags pa yi/ /chos tshul legs bshad spel ba'i dpal ldan zhing / /gdul bya'i rmongs mun sel mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon/ /skyabs gnas de dag byang chub bar du bsten/ /gzhan yang bstan pa'i4 nyi ma bsil ljongs 'dir/ /yongs su 'dren pa'i rgyal blon lo paṇa dang / /bdag la klog sogs yon tan rab spel ba'i/ /bshes gnyen rnams la dus kun bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mkhos med bdag gi byung ba'i sgrung gtam zhig /rnam g.yeng snon par brjod la dgos med kyang / /dbyu gus yang yang bskul ba'i rnga sgra bzhin/ /cung zad brjod la bla mas gnang ba stsol/ /deng skabs slob ma du ma zhig gis khyod kyi rnam thar zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul mod/ rnam tha ra zhes pa/ lam bden la nyams len mthil phyin par byas nas/ kun 'byung rtsa ba nas spadas pas/ sdug bden gyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa las thar ba'i 526 d+ngha

rim pa ston pa la rnam thar zhes brjod pa yin mod/ bdag lta bu lung rtogs kyi yon tan ci yang med pa dug gsum gyi dbang du song ba dag la de lta bu brjod rgyu ci yang med par ma zad/ 7 paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ skyon mang dug tshogi tsher ma'i tshogs 'khrigs kyang / /yon tan yongs 'du'i tshal bzhin sgro btags te/ /dbyar skyes rnga gsang stong ltar cher sgrogs pa'i/ /rnam thar tshul la kho bo yid ma ches/ /dam pa'i snying la 'jigs pa sbyin byed pa/ /dug gsum chang gis rab tu myos pa yis/ /zlos gar mngon par bsgyur kyang tshul bstan zhes/ /yol ba'i phag tu 'chel la'ang bdag mi dad/ /mdo rgyud dam pa'i gzhung dang bstun pa na/ /mngon mtho'i 'bras bzang bskrun pa'i4 sa bon kyang / /rnam par myags mod 'on kyang kun mkhyen du/ /rlom zhing gsal bar sgrog la'ang bdag mi mgu/ /bag med spyon pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyang / /theg mchog gsang ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa zhes/ /gya gyu'i rnam thar tshul la'ang bdag mi mos/ /zhes dang / kun gzigs/ lnga ba chen pos/ sgro btags gleng mo'i mi gtsang phung bo'i lus/ /sgra don snyan 'gyur rin chen rgyan spud nas/ /rdzun gyi gar bsgyur lce bde'i brjod pa la/ — /snying bor rlom yang e raṇ+ḍa yi 'bras/ /zhes dang / deng dus sgo 527

gsum mi dge'i do ra na/ /gya gyu'i gar mkhan tshul 'chos gos gyon pa'i/ /cher rlom mang bo'i rnam thar 'khyog po'i tshig /mthong tshe dpyod ldan phal cher bsting tshig smra/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ rang phyogs bstod pa dang / gzhan phyogs smad pa sogs kyi sgro btags dang / skur 'debs kyi ngag 'khyal smra ba la dgos pa med par ma zad nyes dmigs ha cang che bas dgag bya che mod/ rnam thar med la/ lo rgyus ngo ma re rang gis ma bris na/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal bzang gi gsung las/ slob ma'i brtsams pa'i rnam thar phal cher ni/ /che brjod drags pas bla ma zog por gtong / /des na rang gis rang gi rnam thar ni/ /sgro skur spangs nas mdor bsdus yi ger bkod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ rang gis byung ba dang de'i skabs kyi 'jig rten gyi 'gyur ba bcas brjod na/ phyis su lo rgyus brtag dpyad byed pa la'ang mkho ba'i skabs srid pas cung ṭad brjod pa la zhugs so/ /skru sprultanaska 2zhi skon/ des na bdag skye ba'i yul dmu dge zhes pa dge bcu tshang —ba'i yul deng sang zung chu rdzong gi khongs su gtogs pa de yin/528

de yang bod kyi yul/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi sa gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba yod pas rdzing dang 'dra/ bar dbus gtsa nga rugyibazhi yod sa brag dang chu 'thab pas yur ba dang 'dra/ smad mdo khams kyi sa 'di nags dang na'i ljongs yin pas/ bdag skye yul 'di nags tshal gyi sa yin spu/ 'di nas rta pho'i nyin lam gcig tsam brgal bas na'i ljongs su slebs/ na 'dam che mod spang ljongs rtswa chu phun sum tshogs pa yogastabs the ba sogs 'brog sde chags yod/ dmu dge'i yul 'di bod yul yin mod/thang rgyal rabs dar ba'i skabs su/ thang dmag mtha' bskrod btang ba'i rjes su rim gyis bod mi dag 'dus te yul tsho zhig chags/ yul de'i byang phyogs su a zhig sgom khang zar ba'i brag dzokhung zhig yod/ de'i nang du sngar bon po'i a zhig gi ri khrod pa4 zhig yod pa de'i 'tsho rten du ra lug kha shas yod pa dmu dge'i rkun jag nams kyis rku 'phrog byas stabs/ bon po'i a zhi ga dang snang zhig ces pa'i sde shog gam rus rgyud kyi sngags mkhan rnams zla bsgril gyis dmod mo byas spyang dmu dge'i yul sde rnams je dar du song gshis/ de phyogs kyi mi rnams kyis de la dmos na dge 'dug zer nas/ dmod dge zhes pa'i ming chags/deng sang yang zung chu phyogs kyi bod mi rnams kyis dmod dge zhes529

'bod/ 'on kyang 'brog phyogs su sgra gdadzos shugs drag pa'i rkyen gyis brda 'gyur te/ dmu dge zhes grags/ datshomu thag lha yis ribazung zhing dge bcu yul la tshang ba'i don yin zhes deng — sang tshang mas da mu dge zhes 'bod ba dang / lo rgyusasogs su de bzhin bris 'dug la de ltar 'bri bzhin yod/ yul de la sde ba bco brgyad yod pa'i sde ba dang bo 'brog sde yin/ phyugs zog la nor zer stabs/ phyugs zog 'tsho ba'i sde ba de la nor ba ru zer/ nga rang skye yul ni dgon pa'i 'og gi sde ba sog po ru zer ba'i rong sde dang bo de yin/ nged kyi skye khyim ni grong smad ces pa'i brda rnying gyong smad tshang zer ba'i khyim tshang gsum yod pa'i ya gyal yin la/ khang 'gram du gu ru sirnyi'i 'khor lo zhig yod stabs/ gyong smad 'khor lo tshang zer/ gyong smad tshang gi mi rgyud ni’dpa' mdzangs brtul phod cig yin yang 'byor ba 'bring tsa ma zhig yin 'dug nged kyi ma rgyud ni thal tshang zhes pa'i mi rgyud la dge bshes dzung chu'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho zhes gragasapa'i sgo oṃng dge bshes chen po rta tshag yongasasta'adzin rin po che zhes yul dbus su skad grags che ba de sogs tshodage bshes du ma byung ba'i mi rgyud dang / rgyal rong sgom chen pa'i yang sprul khe tshang bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub rgya mtsho zhes grags pa'i mkhas grub nyis 530

'dzogagyi bla ma de'i tshartsobu bsod dar dang dge bshes thal bla ma blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang bo'i sring mo gnyis bza' bla bsgrigs pa la nga'i ma a tshe skyes pa yin 'dug nga'i pha rgan ni chos dad che zhing mi bden pa bden thub cig tu brtsi/ —ming la dge 'dun skyabs zer zhing / gces 'bod byas te a dgen zer/ gyong smad tshang yin stabs gyong dgen zhes grags/ yi ge shes pas rdor gcod sogs kha ton dang / phyag skor smyung gnar+sā sogesgol 'bad 'bungs byed mkhan zhig yin/ sa rgan yang dad pa cen ma ṇi dung rgyur gcig lhag bton/ du nga sagasum skye sa/khyim tshang phyug po min la ha cang da bul bo yang min 'dug dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ ha cang phyug po'i khyigartsami skye zhing / /ha cang dbul bo'i khyim du mi skye bar/ /bar ma dag lhagi cikhyim du skye bar shog rī /ces smon lam gnang ba bzhin/ bdag rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing pho stag gi lo (spyi lo1914) hor sa bcu gcig pa'i yar ngo zhig la khyim der btsas zer/ de skabs a lags bar zhing tshang zer ba'i bla2lobagres pa/ lung bstan la thogs pa med pa dgon grong kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa zhig yod/ khong gis nga rang ma skye sa pa'i skabs khyed tshang gi khyim du gos chen gyi 'bol gdan ser lhazhig ba’nga / yol ba ser bo 531

zhig kyang brgyab 'dug pa rmis gsungs thal zer/ bden pa yin min mi shes/ de skabs nged kyi yang zhing thal dge bshes mtshan brjod par dka' ba gyi rje blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang bo ma —mchog mtshan nyid dgon gyi khri ra bzhugs skabs yin gshis/ khong gis a mchog rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho la/nga'i tsha mo la bu zhig skyes khyed kyis thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes pas bu chung nga la byin rogs gsungs/ skye 'go'i bu yin stabs 'bul thag mi chod zhus par/ khyed kyi tsha mo de lo gzhon yin stabs da rung bu phrug yod rgyu red 'di nga la byin rogs gsungs mod/ pha ma sogs e 'thad ci shes bsam nas 'bul ga ma chod ces zhal nas gsungs/ bdag byis pa yin dus/ gzugs po bde mo zhig yin stabs khyim mtshes dang bza' mi nye 'brel sogs kyis gces shing pang —nasa'akhur ba las gyos ko sogs kyi nang du nyal ma dgos 'dugam rgan gyis khur nas mgon khang la skor ba mang bo byas/ gyis pa'i rtsed mo'i skabs/dze 'chad nyan sgom sgrub byed pa sha stag brtses pa dran 'dug cung zad ner son nas rgyugs 'tsho ba dang / zhing 'debs dus mdzo sna 'khrid pa/ ston zhing ba rnga dus bam po 'gespyob sogs khyim las gang thub byas/ lo brgyad dgu zhig lon dus/53lha

ma'i pha rgan a mye bsod dar dang / ma'i mying bo dkon mtshagi bde chen gnyis kyis bla rma rnams la gsung brtag zhus par bu chung 'di grwa ba —sdod dgos gsungs zer nas grwa ba byed rgyu byas/na2 tu :da naska danu dge sprumi giska skosdon zhozhi dalkonaci du skyoska glun zhugaska dazhi snyen/ de skabs rna a zhang bla ma rin po tshorte shā.a/mchog mtshan nyid dgon gyi khri bzur nas/ dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dar+sā gyi khrir bzhugs yod/ khong gi mdun nas tshoka kha slob pa'i mgo bzung ste zhang bo bde chen dang / phyorgan gyidrwang nas klog dang skyabs 'grokung bshags sogs bslabs/ rang lo bcu gcig thog bde tshang khri rgan blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi yosnyi mdun nas nged sogs byis pa bcu rab tu byung ste dge ’tshulagyi sdom pa mnos/ tshobadag dziming la blo bzang bsam gtanazhesaganang de mtshungs dacadageno — bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon gyi cho yogrwa stso tshogs la zhugs/ tre — dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon ni/ rje'i slob ma snga tshar bzhi'i nang tshan/ tsha kho ba ngag dbang grags pa'i dpal 533

gyis phyag 'debs mdzad/ rjes su stong skor sku phreng gsum gyis rim par bskyangs/ de rjes dgon pa kun mkhyen 'jigasamed dbang bo la phul te/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags gnang nas rgyud— r+sā btsugs/ de phyin bla brang gi dgon lag tu gyur/ kun mak+ṣen sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i dus su mtshan nyid btsugs/ 'dzin grwa bcu gsum byas/ nga rang tshogs su zhugs skabs grwa ba lnga brgya lhag yod/ dgepyibashes bzang bo du ma dang /skad grwa ba 'don rta dbyangs la mkhas pa du ma yod/ phyag skor dang sgom sgrub nyams len la 'bad mkhan mi nyung ba re bzhugs 'dug kha ti skya ti spyod ngan can yang 'ga' zhig— 'dug bdag khadog dkar dmar nas zhu/gas te/ rtsi bzhag sogs 'dzig khul byas kyang / rtsi bzhag shog gu sna ring phyed tsam las miwaṃn/ bag chags cung zad yod pas/ ya rabs dang 'chad༄7na la da ga' tsāb tsam las bzang spyod dang ngan spyod 'dres ma'i— nang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor g.yeng / dge bshes po dkon mchog dge 'dun tshang dge rgan du bsten nas dpe khrid la 'groskyal byas/ a zhang bla ma rin po che'i mdun na sa/ rigs gsum gcig sgrub kyi rjes gnang / 'ja ma dkar rjes gnang sogs dang / drag po gsum 'brel gyi rjes gnang / 534

blodzigs byed bcu gsum ma dang dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbalda / — kun rig gi dbang / rta mgrin yang gsang gi dbang dang / bka' srung rnams kyi rjes gnang srog gtad sogs bka' chos du—ma thob/ bsdus grwa/ grub mtha' rin 'phreng / grub mtha'alhu ba/ sa lam rnam bzhag sogs blo 'dzin byas nas rgyuges sprad/grwa tshang mdo sngags zung 'brel yin mod/ri —blo 'dzin mi bzang stabage rgyud phyogs nas 'don cha mang bo blo 'dzin ma thub/ thig dang gtor ma bca' bzo sogs cung zad bslabs/ a sa blo bzang bkra shis zhes zhu ba'i mkhas pa zhig yod/ — khonga'akhomat+pan du rgyunapar song nas/ yi ge dkar nagadang dag yig sogs cung zade sbyangs/ khong ngan sngagaspo dang mthu byad sogs la mkhas pas cung zad re bslabs/ gte bo 'ga' res bdag la thotswaso gtse byas par/ ma khu blo bzang bkra shis rdzingag bkod ltar dam can bskul bas rtags mtshon myurodu thon lkordzorang tsho grwa tsha nga —'di dang kha 'bral dgospo rgyung — —rang lo4 bcu gnyis thog skyabs mgon thabs cad mkhyen pa nya rje btsun blo bzang 'jam dbyangasalpe shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo dmu dger zhalo bsgyur gnang / khong gi zhal sngo las 'a jam dbyangs dkar bopirjes chu nang rīng / lung du ma rgya35

thob pa'i skal ba byung / 'dzin grwa rtags rigs la sleb skabs zhang bo bla ma rin po—che la 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi khrid lung dang bcas pa zhus nas/ rmi lam spre sogasajirtags mtshan yag po re e yong snyam pa'i re dogs dang bcas/ bsnyen mtshams lagyigrogs po gnyis dang bcas bsdad de dpa' bo 'brurtso drug 'bum phrag drug bzlas/ kha skong sbyin sreg bcas bsgrubs/ rtags mtshan ci yang ma thon/ 'on kyang blo 'dzin je bzang la song ste rtsi bzhug snga dro'i skyor sbyang re la shog grangs sna ring gcig dang phyed zin pa byung / de mtshungs rtags gsal gyi go ba yab je bzang la dga' rab song 'dug ri na rgyu zhig byung nas dgongs dzizhus te ri khrod mtsho ltem zer bar song mo nasazla ngoskrug lhag la bsgrud de phyag mchod dang sbrags dmigs —brtse ma dga' rab bton/ sngon dmu dger gru ba dung rna yin zer mkhan gyi snga nas pa rtsan ma zhig slebs nas/ mig 'gebs sogs ngan sngags 'ga' shes pas/ tshogyong smad kyi gnyen tshan rgya tshang zer ba zhig gi khyim du rgya mi tshong ba zhig yod pa de'i dngul zhibor chen zhig sngags pa des brkus/ nged kyi a myes sogs spun ba zhi yod pa ra mda' song nas sngags rgan bzung ste btson las sna dgu btang nas dngul sogs brkus rdzas tshur blangs/ de'i rkyen 536

gyis sngags mkhan khos la rtse'i kha zer sa'i chu mig zhig gi nang du mnan gtad brgyab pa red zer/ — rimi rabs la sa bdag klu gnyan gyi nad thebs kyin stsod/ bdag la'ang rmi lam du sbrul sogs rmis pa dang / der brten klu nad lta bu byung gi 'dug a lags bar zhing tshang la gsung brtags zhus parodrag po sum ri 'brel thon gsungs/ de nas thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i gsungs gi sgrub thabs steng nas zla gcig lhag k+ṣ-il drag po sum 'brel gyi 4 ci bsnyen mtshams kha skong sbyin sreg bcas r+pā bsgrubs/spre ska rma 'dres mdo'i sog tshang bla ma nye 'brel yin stabs sngar nged cag gi —gam du rgyun du phe bas bzhin yod pas/ skabs shig khong gis/ dge phrug 'di/'i rim gro la gnas brtanalhag mchod cig thon/ rdzo rang gis gso sbyong hur thag gyis/ thub dus shig la 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen mtshams shig la sdod gsungs pa dran nas ri khrod mtsho ldem nas/ — ri khrod pa a khu bsamu gtan kha ba zer ba'i mam— sku drin can des sgrub grogs gnang rinas 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang chos rgyalacu skrub sprags ma'i bsnyenamatshams sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ de rjer+sā dpa' cig dang 'ja.oṃdabyangs dkar bo sprags pa'i mtshams gcig la bsdud/ de rjes yang dpa' cig gi mtshams gcig la bsdad/ — rang lo bcu dgu'i 537

thigasnegazhung rgyugs sprad/ bsdus grwa dang / blo rtags sogs la cung zad sbyangs pas rmang gzhi cung zad yod pa'i thog phar phyin gyi dbu nas sbyangs pas/ 'dzin grwa'i nang nas cung zad bzang ba'i gras su slebs/ de nas 'dzisna grwa'i skyor dpon du bskos/ dpyid 'dzin grwa gtug skabs dge rgan rin po ches/ brgyad stong don bsdus nas bshad pa'i stong nyid stong nyid yin min sogs kyi rtags gsal bsgrigs pa dang / zhang bo bla ma rin po ches rgya 'grel nyer gcig rgya 'grel yin min sogs kyi rtags gsal bsgrigs pa 'phangs pas rtags gsal legs par song bas bla ma rnam pa thugs dgyes pa byung / phyi nyin khas len 'dzin skabs khas len shor ba chen po rang ma byung zhing dge bshes rnam pas go ba chags 'dug ces gsung gi 'dug zer/de skabs shig bla brang nas yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang 7 rje bskal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon gyi khrir phebs/ khosagi mdun nas rtsi bzhag dang lam rim nyan pa las gzhan/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ phyag rdor 'khorochen/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub sogs dbang dang rjes gnang mang bo zhig thob/ spyir grwa ba 'ga' zhig gi spyod ngan dang bdag gis kyang brnyas gtse myong ba sogs kyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 538

yid sun pa dang / khyad par grwa sa chen po zhig la song nas slob gnyer re byed rgyu byung na snyam pa rgyun du byung ba dang / khong a zhang bla ma rin po ches gsung 'phros skabs bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'chad nyan la bsngags brjod yang yang byed kyin 'du—ga pas tsho yid drangs te/ bla brang du 'gro 'dod nar mar byung na'ang thabs ma 'grig de rjes rgyam kho sprulo sku dang bzang sa byas te khong gi pha yul mdzod dge bzhag ldom yin gshis khong pha spul la chi 'gro dus bdag grwa ba byas nas rkyang rtsa'i chu khol la song / ji glu sdid sprumi giska‘zha/sko du skespru gnyen zhogarna gnad buzhi sken/ ri/ de nas bla brang la 'gro rgyu byas mod khong blo 'argyur nas 'grosgro lothub/ de dus khong a lagoyomongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang dmu dge nas bla brang la phebs/ lam zhor līstag tsha dgon du phebs/de skabs bdag khong gi mdun du song nas bla brang du slob gastonyer la 'gro ched gsung brtag zhus/ bdag sa sho thengs gcig 'phangs nas shes rab kyi lha zhig bsgrub na slob gnyer la song naspyo legs gsungs/‘ rgyam kho sprul sku la sho thengs kha shas 'phangs nas rta mgrin bsnyen pa thon gsungs/ de ga nas phyag rdor 539
