'khor chen dang / bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang dang serogadong gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs thob/ de nas bzhag ldom la song ste/ bzhag ldom gyi dgon pa khang sar nyin nas —'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i bsnyen mtshams shig btang /de'i phyi lo rgyam kho sprul sku pha yul la 'gro bzhin yod pa'i rjes su —bros byol gyis ba'ag ldom du song / kho'i yul bas skyel ma mngags te nged gnyis zla brang du song / khong a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi nang chen gyis khang ba dang bca' lag g.yar ba sogs gnang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rmad byung thos bsam gling gi chos —grwa la'adzin grwa /don bdun cu nas zhugs/ de skabs sde khri rin po che tshogs chen khri ba red/ mkhas dbang‘‘rab phug cung gsum’ du grags pa'i nang tshan mkhas pa'i dbang phyug rje dkon mchog bsam 'grub ces mtshan yongs su grags pa sno nyid dge rgan du bsten/ mched grogs mi nyung ba zhig dang mnyam du dpe khrid la jihur thag byas/ dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang sogs la'ang de mthun byas/ sngar dmu dge nas bsdus grwa blo rtags sogs cung zad sbyangs mod/ / rigs lam la de tsam zhig yid tshim pa zhig ma byung bas/cho grogs po 'gas kyang 'dzin grwa mar bab nas blo rtags sogs dzosbyang na bzang tshul sogs bshad pas/ 'dzin 5 40

grwa bsdus chen du bab/ — de'i sngar lo dak+ṣiṃdager dmar dmagaciyong / go min tang gi dmar dmagabakag 'gog byed mkhan gyi dmag dbu dge'i dgon par bab/ dmar dmag slebs skabs go min tang gi dmag gis 'gog ma thub par dgon pa'i nang— du 'dug sa med par byed dgos snyam nas dgon pa tshel bsregs te phyed tsam 'tshig phyed tsam lus pa'i nang du ma'o tse tung sogs dmar dmag rnams bsdad/ de'i gyi rmelo yang dmar dmag skor zhig thon1 zhu'u shing chan gyi dmag red zer/ 3der brten grwa ba du ma bla brang du bros 'ong nas grwa sar zhugs/ mdzod dge phyogs su yang dmar dmag yong stabs/ rgyam kho sprul sku'i pha yul nas nged gnyis phyir yong dgos zer/ sprul sku phyir logabadag la u tshugs kyis 'gro dashos zer yang slob gnyer la yo nga —ba yin stabs phyir log na don med snyam nas ma song / kho rang slob gnyer la 'dod pa cher pas phyir log pa red/ de lo dbyar thog 7 paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzab chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te dus 'khor dbang mo che sogs bka' chos 'ga' gnang / mjal ba khri phrag mang bo 'dus/ de skabs ri pin dang 'jar man gyi dmag gis 2thom gling dmag 'khrug 54’

gnyis pa slong bzhin pa'i skabs yin 'dra/dbyar gnam lha gong du lto slong du song / rtsam pa je gang dang mar rdog gcis/ rnyed pa 'tsho rten byas nas ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin du song ste gzhung rgyugs gshar sbyang byas te dgun gzhung rgyugs sprad/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga las rgyan 'jug gnyis dang mdo gdugs sgrol ma sogs kyi lung thob/skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa lha ldan phyogs bcibs skyod gong du grwa tshang la tshe dbang gnang ba bdag gis kyang thob/bla brang sgrung nas 'khyam ra ste 'dug sa khang chung re rnyed mod/ khang bdag la g.yog byed dgos pas dpe cha lta rgyur gnod/ de'i stabs zhang bo bde chen gyis bdag la khang ngan zhig nyos/ der bsdad/ de'i ston rtags rigs gsar rtsod yin pas/ rtags rigs skor dang rnam 'grel ṭīka chen rig pa'i rgya mtshodzhal sdug rus byas nas bltas/ nges cha yang dga' rob song / ston rtags rigs gsar rtsod skabs 'dzin grwa'i nang gi bzang gras su chud/ de nas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil der rigs pa smra ba'i gras ༄ chud tsam na/ dmu dge bsam gtan zhes pa'i 542

ming de/ grwa sa der grags tsam byung / phyis su sa gzhan dag tu'ang ming de ltar 'bod pa byung ngo / /dge rgan rin po che yang thugs dgyes 'dug phyis su khong gis khyod kyis ṭīka blo la bzung yod pa e yin gsungs/ min nges cha yag po btang bas thad ka thad sor bshad rgyu yod/ gzhan gyis blo la bzung 'dug bsam pa red lags zhus/ khong gis ngas kyang rtags rigs gsar rtsod skabs ṭīka la dz+was cha yag po btang bas nged kyi 'dzin grwa'i gsar rtsod la phan thogs song gsungs/ 'tsho ba skyo bo yin yang / lto gos la gyong bskur te slob gnyer la 'bad/ dgun gnam lha gong ma'i khog tu lto slong du song /dpyid bdag 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon la bsko bzhag gnang / dbyar thog rigs —grwa'i skabs snyan grags sprul sku nged gnyis kyi blo rig gi tshogs gleng / ston ka don bdun cu gsar rtsod yin pas/ sa lam don bdun cu/ skabs gsum pa'i mtha' dpyod sogs kyi dpe khrid zhus/ dpe ltas yang dga' rab byas/ gsar rtsod mtshan phud skabs yang rtags gsal gtong ba dang / khas len gang cha nas yag po byung / dpyid 'dzin grwa gtugs dgos pas/ bdag skyor dpon yin gshis thog mar langs te 'phros dang sa bcad bton te rtags gsal gtong dgos/543

dge rgan rin po ches/ bdag la‘‘gzhung gi dngos bstan gtso bo'i mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun nyi shu lhare re la rgyal sras zhe brgyad yod pa'i phyir ’zhes pa'i rtags gsal bsgrigs/ langs skabs bdag la skad snyan po zhig yod pas/ 'phros dang sa bcad legs po bton pas dge 'dun rnams thugs dgyes 'dugartags gsal yang yag po song / ston chos 'khor gsar rtsod byas mthar/ rdo sbis phyogs su bsod snyoms la song lam bar kha ba che zhing rkang ba na ba sogs dka' las chen po myangs/ nas dga' rab zhig rnyed pa 'khyer thabs bral bas btsong nas rin dngul sgor nyer lnga yod pa des 'tsho ba la phan thogs chen po byung / pha yul nas a zhang bla ma rin po che'i 'phrin yig 'byor gsal/ dpe cha lta ba hur thag byed gyin yod pa bzang / bka' chosal hur thag gyis/ blos lcogs na rig gnas yang gal che gsungs yod/ blos lcogs na gsung yod stabs phar phyin dam bca' bzhag bar du rig gnas la nan tan ma byas/ rang lo nyer gsum yar mar nas mkhan rin po che ngag dbang da ge legs tshang gi zhal snga las bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang / bka' srung rgyal bo sku lnga/ dam can seng bzhon dang ra bzhon gnyis kyi srog gtad sogs thob/ bla kho rdo rje 544

'chang mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na gyi rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga las/ thog mar dbyangs can sgra ṭīka gi bshad lung / lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / rje'i gsung 'bum gyi lung sogs bka' chos du ma nyan/ khyad par lam rim bde lam gyi khrid thengs lnga tsam nyan pas/ — nges 'byung spu si re skyes te bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba'i bsam pa skyes/ de'i skabs shig la/ pra phab mkhan zhig la pra phab zhus pas/ ljon shing sdong bo che/na po zhig gi rtser rdo rje rtse dgu ba zhigi yo/da pa bab 'dug khyod rang grwa sar zhugs nas dpe cha bltas na legs 'dug zer/ kho rang sa gzhan gyi grwa ba yin gshis nga grwa sar zhugs yod pa khos ma shes 'dug ngas spyang ma bshad/ tshe tshad dris pas/ ang grangs re gnyis bab dzadug zer/ phyis khyod lho phyogs kyi yul zhig tu mi 'dod bzhin du 'gro rgyu 'byung / yul de'i g.yonajiphyogs lung bar mtsho chung re yod la/ rgyab ri'i thog shug sdong sogs sdong bo thar thor skyes 'dug yul de'i byang shar mtshams su bde mchog gi gnas shig 'dug der gnas 'brel re bzhag na bzado zer/ de'i ming la ci zer zhes dris pas/ ba yig cig dang ra yig cig babaci'adug zer/ phyis su brtags tshe/ de 'bar khams yin 'dug545

de'i shar byang mtshams la bai ro tsa na'i sgrub phug yod/ bde mchog gi gnas yin 'dug snyam/ rjes su der song nas bde mchogapa dril bu lha lnga'i bdun sgrub cig byas/ rang lo nyer bdun thog sa ga zla sa'i tshes bco lnga la bsgrub bya brgya phrag yod pa'i grangs su 7 rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las bsnyen par rdzogs/ de ma thag dge rgan rin po che la dge slong gi bslab bya zhus te srung khul byas mod/ dngos gtsang phul du byung ba zhig rim gyis dka' yang bshags sdom sogs la rem par byas/ 'dzin grwa gzhung gong du slebs yod pas thal phreng dang zur bkol rten 'brel dang / kun gzhi sogs la dpe khrid dang lta rtogs gang rīthub byas/ 'dzin rwa grwa gtugs skabs dge rgan rin po ches khyab mtha' legs po zhig gnang modaska bdag khyab mtha' la go ba zhan zhing / thi rnams grangs brtsegs pa la mi dga' bas/ sngar lo lta bu'i spro sang nge zhig mari byung yang / de nyid ston ma dgos/ bdag skyor dpon yin skabs tshogs chen khri ba a lags ni— gu tshang yin la/ khong par myin skabs brgyad sogs rtsi bzhag thams/ cad thugs thog sde yod gshis rtsi bzhag mang bo 'chad/ bdag gis spyang chospomatshams re la chos thog rjes ma'i rtsi bzhag cha tshang blo 'dzin byas/54 6

nangs dus kyi skyor sbyang re'i skabs shog gu mda' tshad ma ga nyis re leṭa par zin/ dge rgan rin po che'i mdun nas phar phyin ma 'a dpyod dang drang nges legs bshad snying bo gnyis gung thang rin po che'i mchan dang sbrags nas dpe khrid gnang ba thob/ de skabs shig nas dge rgan rin po che gika' 'gyur gyi lung gsan parate phebs stabs dpe khrid thugs mi khom pas/ rnga ba smon lagazhes grags pa'i dge bshes chen po la sngar nas rgyus yod gshis khong7 la dpe khrid zhus/ shā khong la na bza' lhang btsem byed pa/ me gtong ba/ — ril ma lon pa/ na bza' btsems pa/ dpe cha btsal ba sogs kyis sku g.yog le gsa'ipo bsgrubs/ dpe khrid la hur thag byas pas bdag la thugs shin tu dgyes/de skabs shig nas/ khomi gung thang rin po ches/ khong oṃlags rin po che mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nasabyusmos na/ 7 rje 'jigs thed 'phrin las rgya mtsho las/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung / sgrub thabasargya mtsho/ snar thang batsho rtsa/— ba ri brgya rtsa/ rdo rdzephreng ba/ mi tra brgya rtsa sogs dang / dben sa bka' 'a bum sogs lung du ma/ hor tshang gsorakhri rigapo ches zhus ngor/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dab ngatshubo tshigasung 'bum sogs lung du ma/ gzhagayang sman pa'i 'a du khang 541

nang nas/ sman bla/ sdi/ 'khrugs pa/ cho rta mgrine gsang sgrub/rta mgrin pad+ma gar dbang rnamagakyi dbang ( — r+shasku phreng ba zhi ba'i gsung gi de'i dkyil chog gi lung sogs dang rgyud pa'i 'du khang nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum —sogs dbang bka' du ma zhigarī slo thob/ thob yig storwa bas/ 'ga' zhig brjed 'dug de nas 'dzin grwa skabs dang bor slebs/ drang ngesartsisogs thal 'asbeng zur bkol la dga' rab bltas/ 'dzin grwa gtugs skabs drang nges mchan gyi semes tsam snapa'irtsostong nyid ston pa'i skabs las 'phros te rta gas gsal btang / rtagasagasal shin tu song /— 'dzin grwa skabs bzhi bar slebs skabs/ thal 'phreng mtha' dpyod dang sdom blo 'dzin byas/ skabs bzhi ba'i gser 'phring dang sbrags nas blta rtogs byas/ 'di lo rigs grwa ri skabs skabs bzhi ba'i tshogs gleng byas/ drang nges skor la'ang zhib lta byas/ bsam gzugs la cher lta mtshuthub/ 'dzin grwa gtugs skabs/ rgyud bla ma'i rdo rje ga nas bdun gyi thad nasartags gsal btang / sngar nyin khas len 'dzin ska bas37bachasamagon rin po che yang phebs/ rigs lung ba drug tsa4 langs yang khas len shor ba cher ma byung / dge bshes rnam pas skabs bzhi ba'i khasang len dam bca' yag po byung gsung gin 'dug 548

zere/ da ma bca'e thon rjes/ a khu smode lam tshang gi mdun du4 bcangasasgos/ khong gis 'o khyod kyis mying dge lon 'dug khyod la phare phyin gyi go ba chags ske'edug zer gyin’'dug gsungs/ci— de nas dgun phar phyin dam bca' 'jog dgos pas dpo ltas la —'bad/ de nas phar phyidz+wa da ma ba ca 'a ran skabs skyor dpon dang bla ma/— dbu mdzad gesume gyis dam bca' 'jog pa'i skarbasi kyi di zla bo bsal chog —pas/ ngas pu rad pa bkra shis rdo rje ba—domab/— a lagasaganyan grags tshang gis rnga dza dkon mchog bdams/ dbu mdzad ro nga bar mgo khra zermab des hor tshang chos ldan zer pa — bdams/ dam bca' dngos gzhi'i skabs bdag skyor dponalke yin gshis dka' rams 'dzin grwa dam bcar 'gro dgos/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes— nyi shu tham pa'i dgong mo zla ba ma shar gyi b.rodu rdo bcal sku rim gyi dam bca' 'dug dgos/ dka cha ra—mas zhe skyor dpon bzhengs nas/ rnam pa de lta'i mdo sde gzhan yeng ni/ /dreng don nyid du lung 'dis gsal bar byed/ / juce7sa pa'i— dbu drengasi te dbu ma dang legs bshad gleng bo ba car snye ba'i rtags gsa'akhorag thag chod btang / dwo zla bo yang tshungesang4che bas ngod genyis kyi khas len shor tshabs chen po ma byung / rtsi'inyin zhogase kha'i chos grwa'i skabs skabs bzhi ba'i brgal lan— 549

skabs nas rtags gsal btang / —a khu lha mi tretshang sogs dam ba0'a thon rin gyi dge bshes mang bo phebs nas rtags gsal btablo / bdag la nges cha cung yod gshis dka' las chen po ma byung / gung tshigs chos grwa yar tshogs la yun bung bas rtags gsal mang bo ma gnang / jugung tshigs chos grwa mar grol nas kha dog dkar dmar nas bzung ste 'dzin grwa rer chos thun rer dmacho bca' bzhag bdag la dam bca' yag po byung ba'i grags skam zhig kyab rgyas/ dam bca' tshar rjes khong a khu smon lam tshang gi sku mdun du mjal bas/ zhal nas phar phyin dam bca' yag po byung / da ngas khyod la dbu ma zhig 'khrid/ dbu ma gal che thakhrisang(theg/ rme de nas 'dzin grwa dbu ma gsar bar slebs pas khong gi mdun nas dbu ma lung rigs sgron me khrid/ de rjes smon lam chen mo'i skabs/ pha yul nas pha rgan slebs te da lan nges can du pha yul la lan cig 'gro dgos/ — lo ngo dgu la pha yul du ma slebs/ — ma rgan gyis khyod dran nasu rtag par gdong mchi mas gang 'dug zor/ nged kyis slob gnyer gyi 'phro bskyur nas‘ 'asgo mi 'dod/ 'on kyang yul phyogs dang nye 'brel sogs kyis kha ta byed pas ci bya gtol med du gyur/ a khu smon lam tshang gi 550

mdun du song nas de lugs zhus pas/ re zhig cang mi gsung byubar gzigs nas bzhugs/ de'i 'asbor a ha lhangs khyod la bar chad cig thon yong bsam gsungs/ de nasawā yul du mi 'gro ka med byung nas lam bar du zhag nyi shukartsa grangs 'gor/ spyir bdag blo bratha du 'byor nas 'dzin grwa mar gabab gong du/ nub cig rmi lam du khang ba'i nang sbrul mang bo zhig thon pa rmis/— gyi'i nyin chos grwar rtsi bzhag nyan du 'gro skabasarosnyig rus rgal ji — tshigs shig gi thog tu spos nas rnadzo mthil du rma chen po btod/ de naspotshogs chos grwar 'igro ma thub par bsdad/ sde dzirinasgrupo che thub bstan nyi ma'i gsung gi drag po sum 'brel gyi cho ga'i steng nas bsnyen pa bsags/ nub cig rmi lam du khyung gi phyag rgya byas te/ byang phyogs nas khyung spyan drangs pas/ thang dkar lta —bu'i bya chen po mang bo zhig 'bur yong nas sa thams cade gang ba rmis/ yang nub cig bdag ri sked ‘cigabyutu bsdad yodarīpangasha ri gsham du mtsho zhig yod pa'i nang / chu gnas po sbrul gzugs 'doyogasum tsam zhig yod snyam pa mdog dmardzaskya zhig 'dug /masnoskabs nub phyogs kyi ri rtse nas khyung nag po zhig 'phur yong bhe nas/ —chu gnos de bdas nas 'dzin grab byas/ bdag gisposems la khyung 'dis chu gnas de gsod gyin 'dug snying rje bsam 55/

pa skyes rgyung / de rjes rma chen de yang myur du drag song / de sdon skabs skabs susbrul re rmis dus rma skyon re yong la/ de nas cung zad dga' ru song / derurjespoyang nub cig nged kyi malgo sar sbrul zhi ga nyal 'duge nged kyis yi dam phyag rdor bskyed de snying ka nas me 'od spros pas/ kho khang ba'i gru cog brgyud nas phyir song / sbrul lus tshon gcig gi mtshams nas tshigs yod pa lta bu zhig rmis/ phyi nyin grwa tshang gi chu rags las sar 'gro dgos gshis/ song skabs sems chung byed dgos snyam ste g.yo sgyu gang thub byas mod/ rkyen ci yang med par lag pa'i mkhrig mar tshon gang tsam gdub kor gyi tshul du skrangs nas na zug cung zad byung / 'dzin grwa mar bab rjes 'a jomargyadabyangs dkar bo'i bsnyen mtshamasathol thengs kha shas bsdad/ skabs shig mkhan po ngag dbang dge lags tshang rje ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gsung gi 'jam datsangs dkar bo'i sgyung gnas cho ga'i steng nas smyung gad+nghanas mchog brgyad dang 'brel bsnyen mtshams sbyin sreg dang bcas bsgrubs/ zla 'dzin dang 'brel bar sgrub 'don kha shas byas lo re bzhin 'cham lcags mkhar ba'i mtshams kyi skabs su 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi bsnyen pa re btang ste sbyin sreg kyang der zhugs/ 'tsho ba skyo bo 'dug pas/ lto slong du rgyung 55lha

rigayul du lan gsum phyin/ phyis su khong a lags yongs 'dzin rin po ches/ skyid thang ma ṇi ba zhes pa'i dge rgan du bzhag de bas khang ba zhig nyos nas der spos/ 'tsho ba la phan thog chen po byung / bdag pha yul du yong shul du gzhun la bcol/ bdag pha yul du 'byor dus a zhang bla ma rin po che sku mtshams la phyu bzhugs 'dug kyang nga tho nang la bzhag 'dug de skabs dmu dge'i a lags sgo mang tshang dmu dge dgon gyi khrir bzhugs yo da gshis/ bdag la khyod 'dzin grwa gtugs skabs skabs dang bo'i 'dzin grwa'i nang bsdad nas yar gtugs mar gtugs gnyis kar langs dgos zer ba bzhin chos grwar song shas/ 'dzin grwa gong mar gtugs skabs/ mtha' dpyod kyi sher phyin phar phyin thad kyi/ 'di dag la bshad tshul mang yang 'di ka rang khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i 'di sgra snyegs gzhi la theg pa gsum gyi lam yod pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phangs te rnam bshad gser phreng mkhas grub rin po che'i rtogs dka'i snang ba gsum gyi tshig — zirna bsdur nas 'phangs pas rtags gsal song / mar gtugs skabs dgongs ldem dgongs gser 'phreng dang ma tha' dpyod sogayobasdur nas 'phangs/ rtags gsal yag po song / rjes sor khri ba sgo mang tshang gis bdag la zas ston zhig drangs kha 553

btags nyis 'brel zhig 'thewa te/ bstan pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'am/ /khyab kyang nyams parogyur pa'i phyogs der ni/ /snying rje chen pos yid rab bskyod pa yis/ /phan bde'i gter de gsal bar byed par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rjes sor rang re'i dgon pa 'di'ang thugs la 'dzin dgos gsungs/ de rjes a zhang bla ma rin po ches yang gong gi lung de drangs nas/ rang re'i dgon pa 'dir yang bstan pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa min yang / khyab kyang nyams dma' ba yin pas/ rjes sor khyod khang ba shel sgo can re'i nang slebs dus rang re'i dgon 'di yang brjed ma 'gro gsungs/gang ltar de skabs kyang grags skam zhig rgyas/ a zhang bla ma khong gi gsung bkod ltar ri khrod mtsho ltem du song nas sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa btang tā re 'bum phrag bcu sbyin sreg bcas/ de skabs rtsom kha shas bris nas khong la phul bas thugs dgyes/ a zhang bla ma rin po che la phur ba'i gtor dbang zhig zhus kyang dpe ma rnyed/ gza' nyi ma mdung gang ma'i rjes gnang zhus/ mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs tshang ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gsung gi 'dzam dbyangs dkar bo'i smyung gnas cho ga'i lung / rje gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i bstod bya54

sprenagyi mtsho'i lungo sogs zhus/ 'dus/ ring la khong la bsnyen bkur gang nuṭā zhus/ 'phros pa dang dogs gcod du ma byas/ zhal nas khyod kyis dpe char yag po bltas 'dug khyad par skabs bzhi ba dang drang nges la yag po bltas 'dug da phar bla brang du song nas rig gnas la sbyangs dgos gsungs/ lam grogs ma rnyed par pha yul nas zla ba brgyad 'gor song / de nas bla brang du phyir log nas dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bsnyen pa zhig ri btang / sbyin sreg dang bcas pa khong a lags bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi gsung thog nas bton/ de'i skabs su rmi lam du gdong sna'i brag ri mthon po zhig gi khar mtsho zhig yod la de 'phyur nas rba rlabs kyis nyi ma yang sgrib bzhin yod la/ bdag gi sems la lung mjug tu mi sde yod na thams cad chu rlabs kyis 'ded 'gro rgyu red ma bzang snyam pa shar/sto ci'i ltas yin ma shes/ de nas snyan ngag zhig bslab na rtsom e yong snyam nas/ dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa zhig brtsams/ gzhan gyis rtsom yag po 'dug zer/ yang 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i bstod ba le'u gsum can zhig brtsams/ rtsom la dras rgyag mkhan ngo shes shig yod pa la bstan pas/ yig skyon 'ga' zhig phud pa las rtsom tsāl 555

dras rgyag spreci ma rnyed 'arbeg de nas ku re'i tshul gyis rtsom 'bri ba dang / yig bskur sogs tshigs bcad du sdeb pa mang bo bris pas/ rtsom shar shar thon pa zhig byung / de'i sngon mi la'i rnam thar la mjal ba dang / khong a khu zhang btsun bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung gi las rim skor dpar nas spreltas pas dad pa dang nges 'byung spu si re skyes te mig nas mchi rīm byung zhing gsol ba btab/ nub cig rmi lam du 'du khang nang du song nas 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i 'dra skur mjal bas/ gsung byon te sho lo ka gcig gsungs mnal sad dus tshig rkang bzhi bo blo la shar re thon 'dug nang don yag po zhig red snyam/ yun ring bo song rjes brjed 'dug— yang skabs shig rmi lam du/ nga stag tshang lha mo'i shar phyogs kyi ri mthon po zhig gi khar bsgrud yod la/ phar lha mo'i yul du bltas pas/ lha mo'i gser khri dgon gyi go sar gser gyi mchod rten chen po brjid chags pa zhig 'dug de'i 'od kyis lung ba thams cad 'od gsal bar 'dug re zhig nas mchod rtenarī gyi 'od rim gyis nyams nas mun nag 'thib ste nag thib kyis song ba rmis/ phyis su lha mo'i gser khri tshang dgongs pa chos dbyings thim pa'i gtam thos pas/ der bltas pa yin rgyu red 556

snyam song / yang nub cig rmi lam du/ mchod rten dkar bo chen po zhig grwa ba mang bo zhig gis skyor 'dug mod/ re zhig nas mchod rten 'gyel song ba rmis/ grogs po tshos bse tshang dgongs pa rdzogs song / khyed kyi rmi lam der bltas pa red zer ba byung /skyid thang sprul sku la gzhung rgyugs sprod du bcug slob gnyer yong rgyu'i re ba mi 'dug pas phar rang yul du 'gror bcugakhang ba yang btsong du bcug bdag gzhan gyi khyams ra zhig tu spor te rig gnas la sbyangs dgos shar nas/ nyin zhig pra phab mkhan de gdan drangs nas/ nged kyis mig 'phrul sogs sgyu ma sna tshogs shig slob 'dod pas ji 'dra zhes dris pas/ zam pa sked chad cig bab 'dug mi bzang zer/ 'o na rig gnas shig bslab na zhes dris pas/ ral gri 'od 'tsher ba zhig bab/ shin tu legs/ 'on kyang ral gri'i rtse la ser kha phra mo zhig 'dug mod/'jam dbyangs chos rje'i gsol 'debasayon tan dkyil 'khor ma bton na skyon med pa shar 'dug zer/ yang ngas rigs gnas bslab na las 'brel yod sa'i slob dpon de gang na 'dug dris/tshogs chen 'du khang gi shar phyogs su yod la/ dgud grangs lnga bcu drug cu yar mar zhig red/ rtogs pa mthon po zhig yin 557

kyang / mdzad 'phrin ches cher rgyas par ston gi med pa 'dra ste/pad+ma chen po zhig gi nang du/ shel gyi mchod rten zhig 'dug ste/pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams kyis mchod rten cung zad btum ste 'dug zer — rjes sor nged kyi bsam par/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lha mo'i tshul khrims rin po che grags che'ang / dgung grangs thod thug kyang gzim khang tshogs chen 'du khang gi shar phyogs su med pas thod mi thug long a lags rgya zhabs drung rin po che/ dgung grangs dang tshogs chen 'du khang gi shar phyogs su yod pas de gnyis thod thug kyang mdzad 'phrin ches cher rgyas par ston bzhin pa yin te/tshogs chen khrir bzhugs yod/ dbang bka' chos rgya cher ston bzhin pas/ thod mi thug bsam nas gang yin nges pa ma rnyed/phyis tshogs la song nas dus 'khor srib gral zhig nas dus 'khor ba 'ga'i gral mthar bsdad/ de'i nyi na gral gyi gral 'gor/ grwa rgan dbu che zhing dbu skra cung zad dkar ba zhig de mthong ba na sems dga' zhing yid dang ba zhig byung / mnyam du yod pa'i dus 'khor ba de la/ gral 'go'i a khu de su red ces dris snyepas/ 'o de a khu oṃ 'khyil tshang zer ba'i mkhas chen de red/ khong dpal ldan lha mos dus 'khor grwa tshang la gnang ba'i grwa rgyun red/558

sdiri dus 'khor la grwa rgyun nyung skabs lhag tu/ skyabs makaun sku sbeng bzhi ba bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug tshang la zhus par/ lha mo'i bskang bshags 'bum thon gsungs/ bskang bshags 'bum sgrub tshar ba'i nub mo/ dge bskul gyi rmi lam du bud med rgyan cha can zhig gis grwa phrug cig khrid 'ongs nas 'di bdag gyis zer ba rmis/ phyi nyin thos bsam gling nas 'di ba dus 'khor la zhugs rgyu yin zer nas ngo ston la khrid yong ba red/dge bskul gyis mdang rmis pa'i ban phrug de red zer/ de nas dpal ldan lha mos dus 'khor grwa tshang la gnang ba'i grwa rgyun red zer/ khong mkhas pa chen po red zer ba thos 'phral bla mar bsten snyam pa'i blo skyes/ de rjes khong a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi mdun du song nas/ ngas a khu oṃ 'khyil tshang gi mdun nas rig gnas slob bsam gyin 'dug ste e 'grig zhus — pas/ de bzang oṃ 'khyil tshang la ngas bcol gsungs nas/khong gis bcol rgyu byas/ de nas dge rgan rin po che rje dkon mchog bsam 'grub tshang la de lugs zhus pas/ bzang gi/ oṃ 'khyil tshang gi mdun nas ngas kyang / dbyangs can sgra ṭīka gi khrid lan gnyis su zhus pa yin/ khong la khyod ngas bcol na'ang chog gsungs zhes bka' grol/ de nas khong a lags yongs 559

'dzin rdo rje 'chang gis bcol bdams gnang nas bzung / slob dpon rin po che paṇ+ḍi ta rje oṃ 'khyil ba 'jam dbyangs legs bshad dpal bzang bo'i zhabs la gtugs/ sum rtags dang /dbyangs can sgra ṭīka gi ri mo'i mdzub khrid rdzogs par zhugakhong rang nyid kyi gsung gi dbyangs can sgra mdo'i byings sgrub dang / skad gnyis shan sbyar/ shes bya'i mkha' dajibyings ma'i rgya dpe ma rnyed par/ bod skad kyi steng nas saṃ skṛ tar bsgyur ba dang / ye snyarma'i byings sgrub dang 1 re byings sgrub/ ha k+ṣa byings sgrub sogs kyi phyag khrid/ gzhan yang snyan ngag dbyangs can dgyes glu'i mdzub khrid bshad lung sbrags ma dpe brjod kyang dzajog bzhin khrid/ dge rgan rin po che'i mdun nas dartsa ma dang mdzod kyi dpe khrid/ dge bshes gzhan zhig gi mdun nas mdzod kyi khyab mtha' cung zad sbyangs yang byang chub pa zhig ma thub/ lha mo'i tshul khrims pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta pongade ba'i mdun nas latshi wartu sug ring sogs dang / khong gi gsung gi nag rtsis kyi del 'grems dang / 'bras bshad gnyis kyi khrid legs par thob/ rgyud stod pa'i 'du khang phug tu khong a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi bka' gsung bzhin bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sngags rnams gser gyis lañchar brisaripa 560

da lta yang yod 'dug — rang lo so gnyis thog bla brang phyag mdzod dbal mang tshang nas a mchog dgon pa'i 'du khang du lami 'bri bar tshags btsugs/ de skabs a mchog dgon rgyud pa grwa tshang gi a khu 'jam dbyangs rnga phrug zer ba rogs skyor la tshags btsugs khong thugs rgyud legs shing rgya rtsis kyi ri mo la byang chub pas khong gi mdun nas rgya rtsis kyi ri mo cha tshang bslabs/ khong gi 'dodazlomos bzhin snyan ngag dang sgra'i ri mo'i mdzub khrihwaphul/ a mchog dgon de'i grwa ba kha shas la dag yigartsodang sum rtags bris sogs —khrid/ de phyin lo re bzhin rgya rtsis kyi li tho nyi zla gzalha'adzin bcas phud/ dmu dger yang bskur/ de nas slob dpon rizha po che oṃ 'khyil ba'i zhal snga las/ rigs ldan mchod pa'i 'od snang cha tshang gi khrid zhus/ dge rgan rin po che 'jayo pa'i dbyangs mtshan brjod par dka' ba bhe rje dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzab 7bo'i mdun nas/ dge bshes sum༄dzim grangs shig dang mnyam du 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i bzhad lung damre khrid dang sprags zla bu gcig lhag gi ring la thob/ kiskyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng lnga ba bhe rje btsun blo bzang 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ri 561

dpal bzang bo yul dbus nas rang dgon du phibs rjes/ grwa6tshang so so'i 'grig lam sogs la dag ther gnang ba dang dus mtshungara'i bla bradzothub bstan pho brang du grwa chung gi slob me— zhig— btsu gas/ ske slob grwa der srong btsan sgacim po'i zlos gar btsugs/zlosadzigar 'dzugs skabs gyo thog ma'i 'og tu bka' shog sbyar te/zlo sa gar 'di la dgos pa chenazupo smod/ khang sar rin po che'i zhal nas/ sngon sde srid phag mo gru pa byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis rke yongs la da—bang bsgyur ba—'i sngon rol tu/ gnyal nas 'o'ardziba'i blosarke ga ra tshogs pa zhig gisaripho brang sne gdong du srong thatsan sgam po'i zlos gar gzigs 'bul zhus pas rten 'brel tson gyi sa grub// rgyal dbab bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtshos zlos gar gzhan las srong btsan sgam po'i zlos gar 'di la 2 gtsigalosu —byed/ ces yongs 'dzin khang sar rin po ches gsungs zhes sogs kyi bka' shog sbyar/ mi bsrun brlang spyod kyis bstan pa bcom nas slar gso ba'i thog mar dkon mchog gi sgra bsgrags shing / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan sgrogs pa la zlos gar 'di dang / gling sgrung gnyis chos sgo phye spyad du gyur to// rna rjes sor bdag slob grwa de'i dge rgan du bskos/ dpe cha slob gnyer byed rgyu la gnod snyam du sems sdug chen po byung / phyag 562

medzod dathel mang tshang la zhus nas dgongs pa zhus kyang dgongs pa ma lon/tshodi rjes skyabs mgo na thams cad mkhyen pa khong gi zhal nas/ tshogs dzadu'i sdog gsung gnang ste/ — deng dus gsar brje zer ba de 'dzam gling 'dir chu'i rlabs bzhen yong gin yod/mi rang rang 'dra ba sngon las kyi dbang gisakhri kha godan kha 'di ske 'drar skyes na/ yul khams spyi blos gtong nyan rgyu ma red bsam 4nas/ bsam pa yar bsam/ skud pa yar 'khel byas dziyikau yang / dithang na gnya' la rka brkos dang ba 'dra 'dra/ ri mgorasku'idrangs dang kha 'dra 'dra bshad ska yod dzired/ khyed rnas pa slob rma tsho yin na yang / — ngas brgya bo'irgyub ki bsal/— ṭībargyadayo'i gyab ki bdamaso nas/ rig gnasayag bo re e slob snyam duthere byas pa yin pus/ ri ba ṣecan la ro ga cig ma gcod/ la khongs k+ṣe bsamasugatan yang / chos 'jig starten gaṣ+ṭhas kurarnayodasnyogache ba yin gshis dge rgan du bskobazhag/byas g.yin/dzokhyed rnamaspo kyis kyang bci bkur dang gsung barmadagos/ ri chozhe sasogasong gsungs/ — 3 — 6 ri ri sne ma rngo — rgyun par gsung bshad skabs/rko sna bstan pa rin potshetso0 zad kyi mar me lta bur rgyur/ bobasagang yod kyis cung re yin na'ang gnas snyeb pa'i phyir 'apad ba yin ga sungs/ / 56zu

bdag chab srid kyi phyogs la rgyus med la/ yig tshang sogs dang mi chen dpon chen la skrag nyamasagus zol sogs cher mi shes mod/ khong thams cad mkhyenacho pa bdag la thugs shin tu dgyes pas gong 'og gang gi yang brku' bkyon sogs byung ma— myong / slob grwa'i 'dzin grwa rgan pa la sum rtags dang snyan ngag sogs khrid khul byas/ rab rgyal me khyi lo'i dbyar thog rin po ches —bka' gnang ste/ da/ lo mtha' ba sogs lha sde gong 'gab tshang ma'i dbyar gyi shing slong klu 'dus tshal mgor 'gro dgos dzo nabs gras pa byings dang khong yang phebs rgyu gsungs nas tshal mgo'i thang chen du dga' ston chen po byas/ deng skabs 'di lasalhag pa'i skyid po yong re skan gsungs/ bsang khog gi lha sde'i rta rgyug spyang ded bya sa/ ca/da' rtsed bo'u rtsed sogs rtsed mo sna sogs dhekyi 'gran bsdur byas/ khong gis mang tshogs la yon tan gzhir gyur ma sogs kyi lung gnang / zi len blo bzang tshe dbang sogs srid 'dzin las khungs kyi mi sna yang phebs 'dug glu dang bro gar sogs kyi 'gran bsdur la bya dga' gtos chen byin/ nged cag slob grwa'i dge rgan rnams kyang mgron 'bod gnang / de lo yar mar la khong a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas rjes gnang sogs bka' chos kha shas thob mtshams bsnyen sgrub kyang kha 564

shas byas/ de lo'i lo rnying nang du nyin du mar slob grwa'i rnam thar gshar sbyang byas/ khong gis dka' rams pa rnams la srung ma dmar nag gnyis la mchod sgrub rgya rngen po byed du bcug khong gis da lo lo gsar rnying skabasarnam thar lan bdun 'chum dgos gsungs/ gshar sbyar gi mjugatu 'cham gos sogs mnabs ste lngan ga/ cig 'chams/ me phag lo'i smon lam skabs lan lnga 'chams/de lor hor zla gnyis par zla bsholayod pas/ bsho la zla'i nang thu'u bkwan rin po che phebs pas/ khong la spyan 'bulalan gcig zhus te lan bdun song / gshar sbyang gi skabs bdag la nod+ku 'dzin pho brang grub pa'i dga'altanashā brda tho zhig bri sa nas snum dpar rgyob tshes grangs 'bri mi dgos gsungs/ nyin gciska ba dag la gsol ston zhig gnang nas dgyes pa'i rnam ba du ma zhig bstan/ thu'u bkwan rin po ches slob grwar dngul sgor brgya dang nyer lnga gnang ba/ bdag la sgor mo 'di tsho khyod kyis khyer/rjes sor khom dus 'u cag gis dal mo byas nas za/ za rgyu yod na— za shes rgyu red ces bzhad mo dang bcas te bdag gi lag tu gtad/ delī phyi nyin thu'u bkwan rin po che phyir phebs/ bdag gis sku mdun du mjal 'phrad cig zhu snyam ste/ song nas sku mdun pa la snyan gsan zhur bcug zhul nas de ring khong sku 565

khams cung mi bde/ rjeyonas mjal snye2phrad dang gsung sgros byed gsung gin 'odug be+er/ de'i rjes sngon zhig nasarnabadag gi rmi lam du nyi ma gzas zin pa sha stag jise/ sems la ngas sa ris sbyangasne nas/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin bris pa de'i stabs e yin snyam/ khong gis me tog sprezhes te me tog gis thar ba yin yang /yang de skabs me tog bzhes 'dug zer gyin 'dug zhag bdun pa'i nyin bdag rang shag tu yod skabs rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs song zhes pi'i skad ngan de thos 'phral sems sdug gis gcig pur mig chu mang bo zhig bton/ mthar cung zad gnyid yur ba lta bu'i ngang rmi lam du rin po che nga'i thad du phebs 'dug zhal nas/ khyod kyis che che byed rgyu can po ma byed gsung gina'adug nga'i sems la ci yin/ ske slob grwa ba rnams la che btsan gyi rnam pa ma ston can po e yin snyam/ ngas khong gi zhal du bltas pas/ zhal cung zad skrang yod pa lta bu'i nyams 'dug ngas khyegal brten pa'i sems sdug cig 'dug ste/ zhal skrang 'dug zer bzhin ngu skad chen po bton pas gnyid sad/ sngas 'bog spyang rlon tsha re 'dug de'i phyi nyin nas zhag bcu bzhi ra gdung mjal yod pas gdung mjal dang mchod 'bul dge sgrub sogs byas/slob grwa'i sgor mo mchod rten zhal 'debs su phul/ khong dgongs 566

dzi rdzogasari pa'i phyi nyin/ yig tshang gis slob grwa'i dge slob thamasathucad snyobasdus te/ da rinatse che yang ma bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis slob grwa yang 'thor dgos gsungs nas slob grwa gtor/ dgongs rdzogs tshar rjes phyag mdzod tshang nas bdag la rdo rams pa'i mdud pa gnang / khong a lags rin po che 7 rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos tshogs chen 'du khang gi gtsang khangaci rgya bskyed de tshon byugs pa'i skabs/ dge rgan rin po che brgyudarkanas bdag la lachi 'bri dgos gsungs/ dge rgan rin po che'i gsung bkod ltar/ ngas rigs gsum bgon po'i sngags lamir bris te phul nas/ khyed kyi thugs la 'bab na ngas 'bri zhus pas/ los 'bab/ mi 'bab rgyu ci— yod gsungs/gdung mdun la dri med rnam gsum gyi gzungs phris gsungs pa bzhin bris/ de rjes 'du khang yongs rdzogs la tshon rtsi byug skabs/ dbon sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'ine thugs dgongs bzhin du 'du khang thog la lachi bzang spyod saṃ skṛ sto'i skad kyi steng nas cha tshang bris/ gyo thog ma'i 'og tu khro bcu'i sngags dang khyams kyi mtha' skor du chos skyong so so'i sngags bris/ spyi lo1978lor bdag bla brang du song skabs lami cha tshang yod pas lo cung zad gzhon dus bris pa de cung zad legs snyam pa byung / spyi lo1986lor 567

bdag song skabs 'du khang chin moyomi bzhes/ri khyamasar ma tshig par yod mod/ bskyarogaso byid rgyu'i gra sgrig giyogatorogyin 'dug nga zhwa bar gcig gi lakye dbar brgyab nas/ shertswarab kyis bris nas dparoba'i—lami 'i malpeg thog tu dpar yod/ 'on kyang ngas bris pa yin pa'i kha byang yed/ slob grwar dge rgan byed pa'i skabs rtsis gzhung zhig kyang bris mod phyis su dpe stor/ pha yul nas ma rgan slebs te/ zla ngo drug la byag skor sogs dge sbyor dzig po bsgrubs/ rdo rams pa byas nas lo gnyis dang zla ba brgyad song ba 'i mtshams la bla brang du gung khra natang — cheslebs/ bcings grol tshogs chen zer ba 'tshogs dus/ rogs las la shog zer nas song / tshogasa'adu grol nyin dga' ston chen po zhig byas skabs/ tshogasgo 'du der rogs las la 'gro mkhan bod mi kha shayol yi gi sbyar 'dug bdag kyang de'i gras su yod/ dmu dge'i bar zhing sprul sku bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs zhugs gnang nas nga'i gam du yod pa de dang / reb tsa'i bstan pa nged gsum/ yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bkod bzhin ston khar gnas dan 'dug sogs su mjal skor la song / dan 'dug dang / lha lung dpal rdor gyi sgrub phug dri med kun ldan gyi spyan chab mtsho sogs la mjal nas smon lam yag po btab/568

dan 'dug dang / sgrub phug nas yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bkod bzhin 'jam dbyangs rmikar bo'i sgrub thabs sogs bton nas nyin kha shas la bsdad/ phyir 'ong nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bsnyen pa sbyi/na —sre ga dang bcas pa dang / khro bo 'dod rgyal dmar bo'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg bcas bsgrubs/ de'i sngon rdo rams pa yin skabs sogs su slob ma mang tsam 'dus/rnam 'grel dang phar phyin skor gyi dpe khrid dang / rig gnas skor yang dpe khrid mi nyung ba byas/ longs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan brjod par dkau' ba bherje dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga las sems bskyed mchod pa / 'grel ba bzhi sprags/ 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bzhad lung / sngags rim chen mo/ rim lnga gsal sgron sogs kyi lung / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ tshe gcig nyams len gyi khrid/ ljags byin rlabs/ thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro sbrags sgrub thun mong ma yin pa sogs kyi khrid/ mgon po bka' bcu gsum dang sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs bka' chos dang dpe khrid mang bo zhig bka' drin du bstsal ba thob/ 569

skyod chen nakhan sdozhi natshon gasrolu naska pre cen du sdebuska pu dad lus pyed pun ltaglugi puzhi sken/ —— sngon smad sog pu rad dang hal ha ༵gas u ru su'i dmag gis gung khran ring lugs btsugs te bcos sgyur byas/ skyabs mgon rin po che 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yang sprul thugs brtag gcod rgyu'ang gong gras rnams kha mi 'cham zhing / 'ga' zhig gis paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas thugs brtag gcod dgos zer/ 'ga' zhig gis paṇa chen gdan sar bkod med stabs mi 'grig pas rgyal ba rin po ches thugs brtag gcod —dgos zer/ gser khri rnam gsum dbang che bas sku gong ma rnam gnyis yang paṇa chen rin po ches thugs brtag bcad pas legs lam byung / gdan sar ma 'khod kyang / khong a lags bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'khrul ba med pas gzigs te thag bcad pa dbus gtsang sogs phyi nang kun gyis khas blangs zin pas/ paṇa chen rin po che sku 'bum nas gdan 'dren zhu dgos zer zhing / gdan 'dren pa mngags mod/ paṇa 57yi

chin nang ma sgang gi mi drag kha shas kyis bla brang gi mi drag sku drag rnams nang mthun po byung yod med la dogs pa zos nas phebs rgyu khas ma blangs/ bdag bla brang du zing cha che bas 'dug mi 'dod pa byung / dgon pa'i tshogs chen khri rin po che sogs las sne 'ga' zhig dang / rdzong gi dpon chen 'ga' zhig giyospyang khyod lan grur song nas bya ba re sgrub na zer ba byung / bdag spyang rnam g.yeng la goms pa'i dbang gis grong khyer che sa rnams su ltad mor 'gro 'dod skyes/ de'i skabs gung thang rin po ches bdag 'bod pa gnang ste/ gsol ras gnang / spyi sger gyi don dang / rig gnas dang lo rgyus sogs kyi gsung 'phros mang bo gnang / bdag rgya yul du 'gro rgyu byed bzhin pa'i skabs shig tu yang gung thang rin po ches sku mdun dusgyubos nas sngar bzhin gsol ras dang / gsung 'phros gnang / zhal nas khyod nged cag gi lho rgyud zhabs gras kyi khongs su gtogs pa gyis/ khyod la drung chen mkhan po'i go sa ster/ khyod 'dir 'dug mi 'dod na stod phyogs su song na chog gsungs/— bdag gis stod phyogs su 'gro mi 'dod/ rgya yul du 'gro 'dod tshul sogs zhus/ khong gis rgya yul du 'gro na pe cin du song na bzang / nga'i tshab byas nas ma'o spu'u zhi dang kyu'u tsung zi lin la 'tshams zhu/ ba byas 57lha

nas song na/ dmigs bsal gyi blta rtogs yod/ 'gro sgo tshang ma ngas gtong gsungs/ 'gro rgyu bla ma la zhu dgos mod/ khong a lagasro yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang ma mchog dgon grong gis gdan 'dren zhus nas der phebs te/ r+ṣa rdo rje 'phreng ba dngami tra brgya rtsa sogs gnang gin 'dug dge rgan rin po che yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang rje dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bo chu mig brgya rtsa 'grim du phebs/ khong a khu smon lam tshang hor tshang tsag tsag sgar gyi dge rgan du phebs/ de'i shul du bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi nang nas/ paṇa chen shrī la'i mtshan can te a khu lha mo'i tshul khrims tshang gcig pu bzhugs yod stabs khong la zhu dgos pha byung ste/ bla mas bka' ma grol na bya bzhag 'gro 'dug gang yang lam 'gro mi 'ong bas pho tshod bskyed de zhus pa na/ zhal nas 'grig gi khyod rgya nang du song na phan tsa ge tsig ge thogs yong gsungs nas bka' grol/ rjes sor sku mdun du bcar skabs/yang zhal nas khyod rgya nang du song na dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho'i mdun nas sngags shig khrid e thub ltos/ khong ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin zhes yon tan mang bo brjod pa dang /tshe rabs dran pa'i mngon shes yod tshul rgyas par gsungs/ khong gis dge bshes rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho la bcol dam gyis 57lha

lāphya ga yig kyang bskur/ bdag gis khong la tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing zhus pas/ dgyes bzhin du gnang / gung thang rino po che nas/ yag po byung / bla ma'i bka' yang grol/ tshe dbang zhus pa bzang / gzhan don byed pa la tshe ring dgos gsungs/ de nas gung thang rin po ches bla brang du gsol ston bshams te/ bdag la phyag mdud lha dar bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad gsung bzhin/ lho 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i drung chen mkhan po'i mtshan btags gnang ba yin gsungs/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i thugs dam gyi rten sgrol ma'i sku'i mdun du khrid de 'u cag gis bstan 'gro'i don ci nus byed rgyu dam bcas pa yin gsungs/ de nas khong gis bdag la sog chas cha tshang khong gis mnab bzhin pa'i gos chen kha 'ja' ser bo gnang / 'gro chas sgor sum brgya lnga bcu bcas dang / mtshams zhu la 'bul rgyu'i gur kum dang gla rtsi 'bor chen bcas dang / —skad bsgyur langayin ci yon zer ba'i rgya mi zhig mngags/ khong gi chibs pa nga la bzhon rtar 'god sgrig byas te skyel yobacas gter lung bar du phyin/ de nas bzhon pa sogs glas te ka ci mkhar du slebs/ de gar ya han krang gtso 'dzin byas nas tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs yod par der zhugs nas tshogs chen thog gtam kha 573

shas bshad/ di nas rlangs 'khor la bsdad nas lan grur slebs/ dge bshes rin po che shes rab rgya mtsho yang de gar— phebs 'dug pas zhal mjal/ tshul khrims kyi yi ge bskur te slob ma zhig bcol dam byas yod pa de khyod e red gsungs/ red lags zhus phas de nas bzung nang mi lta bur gyur/ kan su'u zhing chen gyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang span men zer ba sngar nas ngo cung zad shes pas sne len gzab rgyas gnang / kha sho tsa'i ge gung thang tshang gi tshong ba byed rgyu byas/ dngul sgor khri bzhi lag tu bzhag nas lha sar mngags grab byed ched de 'khor bcas la me mda' nyi shu'i 'dzin yig blangs/ thel zhig kyang bzos nas skad bsgyur yin ci yon yar 'gro rgyu byas/ rab rgyal lcags stag (spyi lo1950) lo rang lo so bdun thog dge bshes rin po che dang zhin cang gi dpon kha shas dang mnyam du gnam grur bzhugs nas pe cin du song / thog mar dge bshes rin po che sogs dang / nged kyang mgron khang sne len khang du bsdad/ de skabs lis be han krung dbyang mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin dang krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'i/ pu'u krang gcig lcogs yin la/ o lan glu mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa dang /574

dibyange cin rin mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi gzhung slosnyelas then gyi spu'u rin yin stabs/ de rnams rgyun par dge bshes rin po che'i gam du 'ong nas gros mol dang blo 'dri byed/ bdag rig gnas la dga' bas slob grwa zhig tu song nas rgya yig dang dgyiske yig cig slob snying 'dod/ 'on kyang dbyang cin rin gyis/khyod las byed pa byas na nged cag la mkho/ da dung si khron/ shas khams/ bod ljongs rnams bcings 'grol ma btang / bod yig gi las don gal che zer byung / dge bshes rin po ches nges par khas longs/ las byed pa byas nas bstan 'gro'i don ci nus re byed dgos gsung stabs khas blangs nas/ mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi si bzhi yod pa'i gsum pa'i nang du spor/de gar rdo rje tshe brtan/ phun bkra sogs yod pas stabs bde byung / de gar yig bsgyur ba phun bkra dang / rgya mi kha shas yod/ hang men shan bsod nams rgya mtsho yang nged kyis gong la zhus nas las khungs de gar bkod sgrig byas/ der mi dmangs brnyan dpar sogs yi ge bsgyur ba dag la zhus dag byas nas bsdad/ rab rgyal lcags yos(spyi lo1951)lor gung thang rin po che sogs de gar lta skor la phebs/ de rjes paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor bcas phebs te/ srog chags ra ba'i 575

nub phyogs kyi khran baspun los zer ba'i pho brang zhig yod pa der bzhugs/ bdag kyang der spos te sne len 'brel gtugs pa byas/ yongs 'dzin rgya yag rin po che yang phebs yod pas bla brang skyabs mgon rin po che'i yang sprul thugs brtag gcod rgyu'i don skor zhus par zhal lan yag po gnang / de lugs 'phrin yig gi lam nas gung thang rin po cher zhus/ nga phod sogs bod kyi 'thus mi rnaspas rgya gar nas chu thog brgyud pe cin du 'byor te bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gyi chiras yig don tshan bcu bdun pa thag bcad/ chings yig par zhus kyi las don la'ang zhugs dgos byung /rab rgyal chu 'brug (spyi lo1952)lo rang lo so dgu'i thog phung khams yang mi bde zhing / pha yul nas pha ma sogs kyis rang yul du yong dgos tshul gyi 'phrin nan cher byung bar brten nas las khungs la dgongs pa zhus te/ pe cin nas han kho'u bar me 'khor brgyud/ de nas khrung chin bar du chu thog gru gzings brgyud/ de nasarlangs 'khor du bsdad nas khrin tu'u ru 'artsor/'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs kyis sne len bzang bo byas te/bkan shan nas rlangs 'khor med stabs dpa' kan zer ba'i 'khyog la bsdad nas zung chu rdzong du 'byor/ lam du zhag576

bcu gcig 'gor/ de gar zhag shas ngal gsos te/ u lag rta zam las rang yul du 'byor/ pha ma sogs bdag la ngo 'phyad pas dga' spro skyes shing bdag gi gcung dge slong chos kyi rgyal mtshan dbus mjal du song ba bkra shis lhun hūṃ nas gshegs pa gsar du thos pas sems kyi sdug bsngal yang myong bas dga' sug 'dres ma'i ngang du gnas/ bla brang gi a lags rigs grwa tshangadamu dge'i gyib yin pas khong rang nyid dang grwa tshang gi 'go khrid nas bsnyen bkur bla na med pa gnang / zung chu rdzong gi tang gi u yon lhan khang gis mngags bcol ltar dmudage'i rang skyong srid gzhung btsugs/ nga ro 'brug rgyal kru'u rin dang / sgo mang bla ma dang nor ba'i 'go phur gnyis kru'u rin gzhon pa dang /tsho bzhi'i 'go ba rnamasa.u yon du bskos/ tshogs 'du du mar zhugs te mngags bcol ltar dril bsgrags byas/lo de'i ston mjug tu ra phug mkha' 'gro'i rdzong chen du song nas/ ri khrod dbang bo gnas brtan chos grags tshang la brten nas zla ngo drug la bsdad/ sa chu 'phrod la khams dwangs pas lus la nad gzhi zhig yod pa lhag med dwangs/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen mtshams sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag 5nyi shu 'gro ba byas/ slar yong thu'u bkwan gyis gsung ltar sgrub pa la 577

nyarnodug khul byas/ zhang btsun bstan pa rgya mtsho'i gsung gi sgrub thabs steng nas/ nyi ma sbas pa'i zhegs kyi sgrol ljang gi mtshams la zla ba gcig la bsdad/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg bcas/ tā re 'bum phrag bcu song / gzhan yang zhang btsun pa'i gsume gi steng nas mi tra'i lugs kyi sgro‘sda ma'i bsnyen pa sbyine sregajidang bcas/ bdag 'jug kyang nyin shas la bton/ gnas brtan chos grags dang mnyam du gdugs dkar gyi bsnyen mtshams sbyin sreg bcas bsgrubs/ gcod kyi sgrub mchod du zhugs te dbu mdzad byas/ de gar 'dub/ ring la grub mtha' chen mo/ stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed sogs gzhung 'ga' zhig la lta klog byas pas/ skyed cung zad thon/ sring mo bde mchog skyid kyang de gar 'ong nas cung zad bsdad de bod yig bslabs/ gnas skor la'ang thengs gcig song / gnas bstod cig kyang brtsams/daspu dge sprumi gisu 'khro/ na glu'u dgon / slozha dak+kon du buskeska naska 6 den zhachad nyan gnad buzhi sken / rab rgyal chu sbrul (spyi lo1953) lo rang lo bzhi bcu'i thog 578

kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma gyi rje btsun blo bzang 'jigs med thub bstan cho—sa kyi nyi ma dpal bzang bo'i gsung shog 'byor te/lha rams pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin dang / nged gnyis dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo dgon gyi mtshan nyid dge rgan du bsko bzhag gnang / de nas gsung shog 'byor ba dang dgon par song nas bar zhing nang chen nang bsad/ dge bshes 'ga' la legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung daja sprags nas dpe khrid rgyas pa byas/ de nas 'dzin grwa so sor dpe khrid gang thub byas/ las sne rnams dang gros bsdur byas te/ bla brang nas khong a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gdan 'dren zhus par/ ston mjug tu 'di phyogs su chibs bsgyur gnang / grwa tshang gis chi—bas bsu ser 'phreng bcas dgon par phyag phebs/ phyi nyin grwa mang gis brtan bzhugs shig phul/ bdag gis brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa zhus/ rnga mchod rjes nas bzung grwa tshang la/ lam sngags gnyis kyi bshad thang / grub mtha' chen mo'i bshad lung / gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung / lam rim bde lam gyi khrid/ ljags byin rlabs/ thun drug rnal 'byor sogs —kyi khrid/ sngags phyogs pod gnyis kyi lung / byams chos sde lnga'i lung / spyod 'jug chen cimo'i bshad lung / bde gsab 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi 579

khrid/ mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ dag 'a ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang / dga' ldan 'pho khrid/ nā ro chos drug dang ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid sogs dang / lung mang bo gnang /rab rgyal shing rta(spyi lo1mo954)lo'i hor bla baṣ+kab nas/ bde gsang 'ujigs gsum/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ sgrol ma rdotswarje rnam 'byor ma/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug tshe dpag lha dgu/ gdugs dkar lha mang dang / lha bcu bdun ma gnyis byad grol dang bcas pa/ stag phu sgrol ma sogs kyi dbang dang mgon po'i bkal gsum/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang dang / bla ma dbu ma ba'i gsung dang bcas pa'i lung / rigs spusum gcig sgrub dang / 'jam dkor sogs kyi rjes gnang du ma/ gzhan yang gcod dbang sogasangabaka' chos du ma gnang / hor bla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin sgeg chen gso sbyong gnang / tso'asur bla mas sbyin bdag byas nalogrwa tshang gis gnasaubacu'i phyag mchod dang 'brel brtan — bzhugs phul/ bdag gis brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa rgyasacepa ri zhig phul bas thugayodagyes/ khong gi mdun nas thig rtsa sna mags bslabs/ bdag gis rdo rdoms pa sangs rgyagadang / a lags gzhi tshang tshang sogs 'ga' zhig dze+eskar rtsis dang nag rtsis sogs 580

khrid/ rigs ldan mchod pa'i mi tog ces pa'i nyi lhagaza' 'dzin gyirtsis gzhung de brtsams/ gzhan yang sa bdag lto 'bye'i thig rtsa mtha' dbyad bcas brtsams/ ma lags rigs grwa tshang dang / a lags kha gya sprul sku sogs nyi shu sum cu zhigatal lto 'phye'i thig khrid/ de skabs shig la sgrol ma'i bstod pa tshig ring can zhig rtsams/ de rjes khong gis sems bskyed mchod ba gnang / rgyam khos 'bulachenanebategs te bdag gis skyabs 'jug zhus/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin dmu dge nor bas zhus ngor stod mo lung nas dus 'khor dbang chen gnang / de skabs bdag dang / lha rams pa/ rgyam kho gsuyogyis rus rgyan sbos/ grurorgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang gdugs dkar sogs kyi lung gnang / nyin zhig bdag dang / lha rams pa/ gzhi tshang sprul sku nged gsum sku mdun du song ste rnam thar zhus/ gsol zho bzhes 'phro'i nang nas khagazar gyis bcus te/ nged cagasagi lag mthil du gnadz+waste khong gyirnam thar ragagabasdus shig gsungs/ de'ibyusngon zhigatu bdag lakhyodabyukyisa'ajigs byed dpar cig gi bsnyen pa nyi shu thongs/ de nasabyubaka' chos sa 'don rno 'don gyisagasungs/3 rjes sor spyi gegs byung skabs sems la bla mas rten 'grel bsgrigayob yin rgyu red/ bkau' chos 'don rgyu 581

zhig gang na yong bsam/ 'on kyang tshe mjug 'di la mang bo zhig 'don rgyu byung ba 'di lung bstan par nges snyam/ de rjes gung thang rin po che bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khrir bskos yod pa thos 'phral rogs pa gnyis bcas stod kyi a mchog tu song nas kha dar phul/ 7 gsung spros rgyas par gnab / ston mjug dgon nas stag phu sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa btang / sbyin sreg phul/ de'i skabs rmi lam du dkon mchog bstan —'dzin zer ba'i grwa ba zhig gis tshong rar mi sha khyab tshal chen po zhig bshams 'dug pa la bdag gis rdzu gri blangs nas mi sha dum gcig bcad de za ba rmis/yang khong rin po che dmu dger bzhugs skabs/ bdag gis phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi bsnyen pa btang / sbyin sreg tshar nas sku mdun du song nas mjal bar/ khyod bsnyen mtshams la bsdad pa shin tu legs gsungs/ yad skabs shig khyod rnam 'joms kyi mtshams la sdod gsungs nas gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi rnam 'joms khro nag gi cho ga yongs rdzogs gyi lung gnang bas bdag gis bsnyen mtshams sbyin sreg bcas bsgrubs/ yang 6khyod ri khrod mtsho ltem du song la rta mgrin yang gsang gi mtshams la sdod gsungs pa bzhin song nas/ yang gsang gi mtshams la bsdad skabs rmi lam du mi ro chen po gnyes bshas nas/ nang cho 582 —

drugs te ṣ+penyi shu rtsa grangs shig la zas ston drangs pa mis/ yapa de ska bas zhang bo—bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis gsung 'a phros gnang ste/ rtags gsal 'ga' zhig gi khas len gyi rgyun bla brang gi gsung rgyun 'di 'dra yin/ dmu dge'i khas len gyi rgyun 'di 'dra yin zhes gsungs pa rmis/ yang nub cig bdag sa 'og gi mun khung gi lam du 'gro bar lag tu lag 'dzin glog— sgron zhigaspre yod pa cher mi gsal stabs/ cho mthe bong gis gsal byed 'dzer tog mnan kyang je gsal la mi 'gro/ bsam par lam 'go chod 'dug des chog bsams byung ba zhig rmis/ spyir bdag gi mig mi gsal bas de'i rim 'gror mtshams der 'dug bcug pa yin la/ da bar du mig cher mi gsal yang rang mgo thon pa zhig byung ba de'i ltas yin nam snyam/ de lo snga phyir 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mtshams la lan lngar bsgrud/ rgyun ldan dpe khrid byas/ grwa mang thugs dgyes pa byung / gid kyād snaghagan zhaglun tad zhoghaska py-ig spuska gnad buzhi rnon/rab rgyal shing mo lug(spyi lo1955)lo'i hor zla gnyis par rang lo zhe gnyis thog lha rgyul gling srid gzhud gi 'bod mi 583

gnyis thon/ da 'gro ran 'dug bsatshwanagartorgyal gling du song / hor zla gsum pa'i tshesakacig nas bdag la rig gnas kho 'i rdzokrang gzhon pa/ bar zhirdosprutse sku khrid yod pas de lta drung yig kho'i kho krangagazhon pa'i go gnas gnang / mingasakyāng gsar 'asnar khang du spros te bod yig gsaro'agyur rtsom sgrig gi las —slo'agan gcig rtsogs bgyis/ der 'go khrid tsha'o pu'u kra nga zerob zhig yod pa bdagal shin tu dga' bas bsnyen bkur bzang bo thob/ khams pa lo phan zer ba de gar yod pa grogs po bzasprasabor gyur/ zla drug par rang yul du yong ste tshogs chos grwar song / rigs grwa'i 'phrin las kyi nyin/ bcos bsgyur byas nas bstan ba re zhig nyams rgyu yin mchi'ang slar dar ba'i smon lam snyam du sems skyo ba'i ngang nas smon lam btab/ dbyar gnas grol nas slar lha rgyal smreng du song ste bar zhing sprul sku'i rna bar 'bras ngan zhig byung ba dang / zhabs zhu tshe dbang gi lag pa'i gru mor skrang 'bur zhig byung yod pas srid gzhung gis rogs skyor 'og khrin tu'u ru song nas bsha' bcos byas pas/ tshe dbang gtan drag tu song / sprul sku yang re zhig drag nas lha rgyal gling du song ste re zhig bsdad/ dgun pha rgan pho nad kyis bzung yod ba thos 'phral rang yul du song ste grwa tshang la nyin zhag gcig gis bsnyen 584

bkur zhus rte pha rgan la kun rig gi dbang zhus/ rab rgya'aglotho pho spre la(spyi lo1956)lo rang lo zhe gsum thog khrin tu'u ru tshogs 'dur song / bcos bsgyur byed rgyu bsgrags/ rongastsolabacos bsgyur byas/ bdag gis sgrol ma'i 'dod gsolaphul phul can gnyis ka skorgyal srid rin po che bdun la sbyar ba zhig brtsams/ sher bzang gis lcags dpar la btab/ dbyar khrin tu'u ru song nas/ bod yig gi slob deb brgyad bzo rogs byas/ ston kha bar zhing sprulasku yang nad je thur song ste khang dmar dgon nas sku gshegs/de'i dgun thog pha yul nas pha rgan yang 'das/ der brten nges 'byung re skyes nas/ lam rim sogs la dpe ltas byas/ de nas dmigs brtse ma'i mtshams sbyin sreg dang bcas bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum 'gro nges byas/ dpyid dus 'khor kyi bsnyen pa btang sbyin sreg grwa tshang dang lhan tu byas/ rab rgyal me mo bya (spyi lo1957)lo rang lo zhe bzhi'i thog khrin tu'u ru g.yas lhudā pār ngo rgol byed pa'i tshogs 'dur zhugs dgos byung / 'on kyang chos lugs bcos bsgyur ma byas stabs gzan sham gyon nas btsun tshugs bzung zhing rgya skad mi go ba'i rnam pa bstan pas/ rang gzhanatshugang la'ang ngan smras byed ma 585

dazhos/ yongs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs sdis blayang du yong na gsung yang brtag pa ma chud stabras ma song / ston yang khang da mar dgon du song ste mtshams la bsdad/ mi 'khrugs pa'i bsnyen mtshams dang / 'jigs byed bdag 'jug du ma bton/ zhor la slob ma kha shas la sum rtags sogatse rig gnas kha shas bslabs/ lha rgyal gling nas 'khor lo sna tshogs dang dkyil 'khor dang rgyal sras lag len sogs 'bor chen lcags dpar la btab/dgun yang khang dmar dgon nas bsdad/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi bsnyen pa bcu gsum btang sbyin sreg dang bcas grub rjes/ rab rgyal sa pho khyi (spyi lo1958) lo rang lo zhe lnga'i thog slar lha rgyal ṅgeng du 'ong / lo de'i zla brgyad pa'i nang rang skyong srid gzhung 'bar khams su spos stabs budag kyang 'bar khams su spos/ de skabs shig rmi lam du dug sbrul chen po phu thung tsam zhig yod pa sge'u khung nang nas yong ste/ nga'i mgo kha nang du bcug nga'i lag tu gri gug cig yod pas des kho'i kha sha sogs gshags te mgo nas bkog kho gar song cha med du gyur/ nub cig yang sbrul chen po 'dom gsum bzhi tsam yod pa zhig 'ong bar/ nga'i lag tu gri thung zhig dang tho ba zhig yod pas gri thung sker bzhag— nas tho bas brgyab pa ske bcad nas sa la lhung / bltas 586

pas shing gis bzos pa zhig yin 'dug pa rmis/ de phyin klu skyon sogs kyis mi thub pa zhig byung song snyam/ ko jipad bamāsu cwad bcosu bsgyur byas pa'i gtam dag thos shing / gsar 'gyur thog nas kyang mthong thub/ zla bcu ba nas bkas bkrod k+ṣad 'dzin kyi rnga ma gcod dngo/sa zhes pa'i las 'gul langs/ zla ngo gsum la las 'gul byas/ gzan sham gyon bzhin tshogs 'dur zhugs mod/ las ka'i bsgyur bkod pa'i grangs su 'gro ma dgos/rab rgyal sa mo phag (spyi lo1959) lo rang lo zhe drug thog lugs rnying gi lo sar nas gzan sham mi 'phud ka med byung / lo de'i spyi zla lnga bar pe cin du rgya bod shan sbyar tshig mdzod dang /ma'o tse tung gi gsung rtsom gces bsdus deb dang bo bsgyur bar zhus dag byed du shog zer der song / rjes su tshe tan zhabus drung tshang phebs/ khang mig gcig gi nang du mnyam du bsdad/ khong thugs rgyud 'jim zhing bod rang gi rig gnas la sha zhen che bas nged gnyis yid mthun po byung ste/ za ma za ba dang / 'khyams 'khyams la 'gro ba sogs mnyam 'gro mnyam 'dug byas pas skyid po byung / spyi zla dgu ba'i tshes sum cu'i nyin rgyadze+ekhab dbu brnyes nas lo bcu 'khor ba'i dgalī ston tshogs 'dur zhugs shing / bcu ba'i tshes gcig nyin ltad mo'i gzigs stegs steng du 587

song nas ltad mor g.yeng / nub mor byang mtsho'i dkyil ri'i rtse'i mchod rten thad du songabyunas glog me'i mi tog sna tshogs la ltad mor bltas/ de nas me 'khor du zhugs te khrin tu'u ru slebs/khrin tu'u nas slob tshung tshig mdzod bzo bar zhugs tsheblo gcig snye la bsdad/ de nas 'bar khams saslebs nas zhang bo dang rdzorgaspyo 7glujirdzo gnyis 'bar khamasasu gdan drangs/ ma rgan sring mo bde mchog skyid kyis rnga bar gdan dradz+was/ zhang bo nga'i gam du zla ngo bcur bzhugs te/ bdag gis bsnyen bkur ci nus zhus mod// 'on kyang mchong skyod kyi nam ngan dang 'phrad pas bsnyen bkur yid tshims pa zhig byed ma thub/ rab rgyal lngags pho byi ba (spyi lo19 60) lo'i horozla dang bo'i tshes bcu gsum la khong slodagung lo re bzhi'i thog sku gsheshas/ gsang ba'i lam nar+sā dge sbyor sogs ci nus bsgrubs/ de skabs nub cig gi rmi lagodu/bya nga phyogs su song bar grong khyer chen po zhig yod pa'i mdun sgor slebs nas bltes pas/ rtsegs sum cu re yod pa 'ahraba'i khang rtsegs mang bo yod pa/ srang lam che zhing rlangs 'khor chen po 'gro bzhud byid pa zhig 'dug mdugasgo'i nang gi g.yon phyogs nas 'phrul 'khor chen po yangs shrīng rgya che ba zhig gi nang du skyabs — 588 cho

mgon rin po che bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshang dartswa/ dbal mang tshong rnam gnyis bzhugs nas tshur phebs bzhin yod la/ bdabashagi rogs la dmu dge'i gzhi tshang sprulaskyayod pa 'dra bar/ rin po che la mjal dgos mod/ dbal mang la mi masgrul snyam pa yi da— la shar ba rmis mtshams mnal sad/ de rjes sgo mang sgar du mdzol galabaltas snyam/ lo de'i dbyar dgongs r+pā zhus te rnga stod du sring mo dang ma rgan yodasar khams sangartswal song zla gci ga dang phyedal bsgrud/ dgogapa grol nas 'khor khang nang dudape cha pod du ma 'phangs yod pa'i nang nas pod kha shas blangs/ mar chur gro rtsasasogs 'bor chen lag yong byung ltabs 'tsho ba la phan chen po thogs/ de nas yul khams la mu ge byung ba dang /las 'gul gyis mnar gcod bar ma chad par byung ba'isterkyen gyis skyo ba skyes te/ cog tse'i rgyal khang nang nas dpe cha mang bo g.yar nas/ dpe lta dang 'brel bapo' gdams blo sbyong skor la sems cungazad 'dres par byas/ mig chu 'don bzhin gsol ba btab/—yig brgyadhe'abum la nye ba bton/ thu'u bkwan gsung steng nas rig byed ma'i bsnyen pa 'don skabs nub re bzhin mi ro sha stag rmis/ skabs 'gar mi sho cung zad re za zhing / mi'i mgo rus kyi mgo 'phreng misgrigs pa yang rmis chi589

rab rgyal lcags molhakung (spyi lo 1961 ) lo dang / chu pho stag(spyi lo19 62) lo rang lo nai dgu'i thog su'u len bzo bcos ring lugs la dgagagatong gi las 'gul chen po langs 'in tshobazhin dgag gtong tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ mi rnams la mu go'i skrajo nad byung / ltogs grir shi ba'ang yod/ d+ngharab rgyal chu motreyos(spyi lo1963)lo rang lo lnga bcu'i thog mjirgan 'bar khamayosu bsus lkobasnyen bkur zhus/— 'bar khams mkhan po'i mdun nas mo la dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ rirab rgyal shing pho 'brug(spyi lo1964)lo rang lo nga gcig thog hor zla bzhi9bar ma rgan rang yul du song / rang yul nas kyang dge sbyor la 'bad pas/ ma ṇi dungahophyur lhag bton/ dung so gsum skyes/ — snyo rab rgyal shing mo sbrul(spyi lo1965)lo rang lo nga gnyis thog dus ngan nam ngan mjug bsgril/ zas gos sogs gang thad nas mod nyi ler song / khrin tu'u ru song nas zhag kha shas bsdad/'on kyangad+kuspyi tshogs ring lugs kyi las 'gul dang / zhi dag bzhi'i las 'gul sogs bar ma chad par byung bas dus bde 'jam zhig min la/ rab rgyal me pho rta (spyi lo 1966 ) lo rang lo nga gsum thog spyi zla drug par rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i god bye90

chag chin po de bslangs/ spyi zla bcu bar dmar spung dmag ces pas khul srid gros khang nas nged cag mi lnga bzung nas bca' lag yo byad thams cad 'phrogs/ khrom skor la khrid/ 'thab rtsod byas mod/ sems la sdug bsngal ma myong / 'khor— ba kho rang gi rang bzhin red snyam nas/ mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs cung zad re sgom khul byas/ sngar lam rim blo sbyong sogs la bltas pa cung zad ngo 'phrodasbyipa byung / de rjes mu mthud nas mi mang bo bzung / de skabs nub cig dge rgan rin po che yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa chos gos snam sbyar mnabs nas bzhengs 'a dug pa la mjal ba rmis/ phyis su dge —sbyor cung zad rmo'aphel ba'i rtags yin 'dug khrom skor la 'gro —ba'i skabs/ chos gos snam sbyar gyon du bcug ri khrogazhwa cog cig mgo la bskon/ rgyab tu 'jam sdud bzang gsum kyi dpe khur du bcug phrag pa g.yas g.yon du bka' gdams glegs bam kyi shog grangs kha shas re btags/ lag tu 'phreng ba zhig dang dzo bo'i rnam thar chen po'i dum bu zhig bzhag nas/ kha 'bod sna tshogs 'ur dir gyi ngang du ded/ga nged kyi sems la dga' snang 'ig skyes te/ mgur zhig 'then 'dod nas/ lus la ngur smrig gi gos shig gsol/ /bka' gdams gdams ngag —gi rgyan zhigatshu3 91

gsol/ /lag tu bka' gdams kyi glegs bam gtad/ /mgo la sne ring gi zhwa zhig bskon/ /e ma de ring gi skyid pa la/ / zhes sogs gang shar thol byung du smras pa dang / mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus da lta bdag la spen pa dang / /bdag gi bde dge gzhan la btang ba yis/ /'gro kun bde dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes kho tsho'i kha 'bod dang sprags nas skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags pas/ skabs 'gar kho tshos mi thos/ skabs 'gar thos kyang rgya mi tshos don mi go bar/ 'dis log spyogakyi kha 'bod byed ki yod pa 'dra zer nas/ bod phrug klad med re khrid 'ong nas/ 'dis ci zer nyon zar mod de dag —kyang rgya mi dang 'dra bar ci zer ha go gi mi 'dug mdor na 'di dag thams cad dge sbyor kyi bog 'don/ bla ma'i byin rlabs red snyam/ bla gcig tsam nas/ rdzi 'gag 'a bo gyo'i khog tu dam po ta tos zer ba'i ru khag sngon thon gyi nang du zhing las la ded/ de gar las ka lci zhing thog mar zas kyis mi 'dang bas dka' ngal byung / rta sha sogs lag tu gang byung za dalhas byung / pha yul nas sring mo che bas sgor nyi shu bskur ba 'phrod pas srog 'tsho'i gsos sman du gyur/ der mthud srang mo bde mchog skyid kyis rnga ba nas sgor mo dang / za yig rtsam pa 592

sog sarim par bskur bas 'tsho ba'i thog gi dka' tshigayoripospyo par bsal snyo de gar lo gcig dang nyin bcu gnyis la ngal rtsol byas/ de nas rab rgyal me mo lug(spyi lo1967)lo rang lo nga bzhi'i thog 'bar khams su 'ong nas slob sbyong dang ngalartsola'adres ma'i ngangadu skabs 'gar gcig gis gcig la—ngan dz+ras byed dgos ba —sogs dka' tshegs shin tu che/ slar mu ge yang byung / de skabs bdag gi rmi lam du/ smyug ma'i ja shubs shig dzinang durumi ro zhig btum yod ba/ de sregangadagosapa red zer ba thengs kha shas rmis/ de rmisartsopa'i phyi nyina'atshub cha che/ ro de sreg pa ni 'thab rtsod reg pa'i ngo yin 'dug snyam/ nub cig rmi lam 'graba'i 'khrudze+esnang la nyal khri'i mjug tu r+sha'adra ba zhig langasakhaga'adug gzugasaji—bzhin miñcagasal yang / lus la dkar ril le re yod 'a dug des zer ba/ ro sreg mi dgos chu'i nang du 'phangs tshar ze ra ba byung / semasaladabal ldanasgelha mo'i 'phrin las red 'thab rtsod reg rgyu ma red bsam/ yang las 'gul de'i mi 'ga' zhig gisa'izhwa zhig 'gebs e thub snyam yod/ nga la yang rdogs ba de skyes yod skabs yang / rmi lam du sring mo 'bring bo 'dra ba'i bud med cig gis/ ka ba zhig gi ngor dpyang yod 593

pa'i zhwa zhig yod pa blangs nas chu chen nang du 'apangs pagyu 'is/sems la de yang dpal ldan lha mo'i 'phrin las yin rgyu red zhwa 'gebs mi thu ba pa 'dra bsam/ yang 'ga' zhig gis bdag la gledza 'gel gyi bsam 'char mang bo ’zhig bshad// 'go khrid pa 'gas khyod kyis khas len dgos/ ma blangs na nag nyes je che yin zer/ bdag la sems dkar ba 'ga' zhig gis kyang khas len dgos ma blangs na mi bzang rgyu red zer/ ci bya gtol med du gyur yod skabs/ nub cig rmi lam du dge rgan rin po che yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pañcaphebs nas/ gzhan gyis ci breshad thams cad khas ma len/ lin tsong men gyis kyang ci bshad khas blangs pas g.yas phyogs pa'i zhwa gyon dgos byung gsungs pa rmis/ yi ge bris te de dang de ngas mi dran zhes phul bas skyon ma skebyung / yang de'i rjes shig tu rmi lam du slob dpon rin po che oṃ 'khyil ba phebs/ nged kyi nyal khri'i thogacu bzhugs/ nged kyis zhus pa/ nged cag gi las skal ji 'dra zhus pas/ phug gi yag po zhig yong gi ya gsungs/ ngas phug gi gsungs tshul la bltas na/ gnas skabs dka' tshegs re yod pa e red zhus pas/ khong gis tā rā tā rā gsungs/ de'i mtshams la gnyid sad/ re zhig go ba ma lon yang / tā ra sgrol ba la 'jug la de la mo rkyen ā pa 594

byi na pas/ sgrol ma zhes pa yin pas sgrol ma thon gsungs pa yin 'dug de rjes yang( las 'gul gyi 'tshub cha byung yang / rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas skyon ma byung / yang skabs shig sring mo 'dra ba rgya ther gyi gos gyon pa zhig yong te lhod por bsgrud/kha brda kha shas byas nas de nos nub phyogs su lam yangs shing legs pa zhig yod der bzhud yong ba rmis/ phyis thos pa ma rgan de nyin shi ba yin pas/ ma rgan skye ba yag po zhig lon yod pa 'dra snyam/ — de skabs shig tu mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam zhig lag 'byor byung nas cung re bton pas rnub mo byis pa zhig gis ro bsha' bar rmis/ spyod 'jug las/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ /skyo bsatre dregs pa sel bar byed/ /'khor ba pa la snying rje skye/ /dge la dga' zhing sdug la 'dzem/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de dag gi rkyen gyis/ lus sems gnyis ka'i thog nas dge sbyor cung zad byed thub pa byung /spyod 'jug chen mo blor bzung nas skyor sbyang byas/ rnga ba nas sring mos zas gos sogs mthun rkyen bsgrubs/rab rgyal chu mo glang (spyi lo1973) lo'i hor zla gsum pa rang lo drug cu'i thog bcings grol thob ste/ sngar gyi phog skal bkag bsdams byas pa dang / sngar bca' lag 'phrog len byas 595

pa'isnyerin 'bab bcas khyon bsdomad+nghas sgor khri gcig dang stong tshogasum byin pa dang lda gzu'adogs r+sā tshod sogs dngos rdzas kha shas phyir slog —sgor stong gsum chos phyogs su skartong khul byas/ sring mo gsu0la sgor stobhāganyis re byin/ bde mchog spyid la de'i steng sgor stong lhag byin/ stong gnyis rnga ba'i dngul khang du bzhagashing phosnyeltag (spyi lo1974) snalo rang lo re gcig thog rnga bar song sring mos rnga bar khang labazo rgyu byas/rab rgyalashing mo yos (spyi lo1975) loru khrin tu'u ru song nas bod rgya tshirta mdzod bzo rgyu'i shazhi bting / dbyar byuthotshi zasabar song nas khang ba gsar ba'i4nang cung zadad+kusdad/— rab rgyal me pho 'brug (spyi lo1976) lo rang lo re gsum sog mchuraradas pa'i lor rnga bar song nas zla ngo drug la bsdad /nipe ltas gang thub byas/ byuracha rgyal r+ṣa mo sbrul (sbyi lo1977〉lo rang lo re bzhi'i thogaskyiltazla bcu gnyis pa'i nang khrin tu'u ru si khron zhing srid gros skabs bzhi ba'i u yon lhan tshogs kyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ bdag rgyun las u yon skodu bdams/ zhing chen nang khul du lta skor la song 6rab rgyal sa pho rta (spyi lo1978ste lo rang lo re lnga'i thog 596

spyi bla batshozhi bar pe cin du song / bod rgya tshig mdzod bzo rgyu'i skor la gros bsdur byas/ ri zhid chen sded kroska / snyon skasu lta ldon dad k+ṣulu sded sproska / n+tuzhu zhi gzhon pun nasnasna naska py-ig skagi ghand spruzhi naded ne+eska rlubuska sdo chezhi sken/ sngar spyi lo 1959lor krung dbyang mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi nang du ma'o tse tung gsung rtsom slob sbyong 'dzine grwa zer ba zhig btsugs nas bod yig bcos bsgyur byed dgos zer nas/ bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs dkrugs te ci min 'di min zhig bzos/ ‘‘gnad bsdus’mizer ba zhig bsgrigs te rgyal yongs kyi bod sa khul yod do cog tu bkram/ bod yig gi tshags par dang dus deb thams cad rgya skad dang bod skad gang yirne mi shes pa zhig tu gyur/ 5gnad bsdus’ de 'i rjes su 'brangs nas sum rtags shig kyang brtsams nas si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar yang btab/ de la dgag pa zhig brtsams yod pa mdzug cung zad ma grub kyang gang tshar ba de kho tsho la bstan nas/ lan khyer shog ces dgag yig kho tsho'i lag tu banag 'on kyang lan 597

tshig gcig spyang 4 'ong / me de nas bdag la 'gan bzhag ste/ a khu 'jigs med dang / a khu bsam 'grub/ smon lam gsum bla brang nas drongs shog zer ba bzhin pe cin nas lan grur song / nub byang mi rigs slokha grwa chen mos bosdo 4pa ltar song nas/‘ nyispyo gyed la bshad me byas/rtarme nang don ‘‘—gend bsdus7la dgag pā btang / skyabs mgon rin lo che dang / zi len blo bzang tshe dbang rnam gnyis la zhal mjal/ gsung 'phros gnardoba'i bskal ba thob/ de nas gtsos la rang skyong khul yod sar song ste yong don sotshis brjod/ bka' shog bstan/4rogs skyor gnang ste bla brang༄ song / a khu 'jigs med 8 na mtho zhing nad yod pa dardo/ bye brag tu dpe khrid gnang gin yod pas ma khrid/— lan gru nas gling tshang khrid zer mod sku na smin pas ma khrid/ — bsam 'ayib dang smon lam gnyis khrid nas/red cag gi rang skyong k+ṣal brgyud de khrin tu'u ru song / bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo bzo rogayobyas/ chos kyi tha snyad stong drug tsam zhigabazos mod/ rjes sor cha —tshang ma bzhag la bzhag pa'ang d+kuXkhor log kha shas kyang yod tshod 'dug zhor la bsam 'grub/rgya mtsho gnyir+sā la sgra khrid/ dbyar 4thog rnga bar song ste khul dril bsgrags putshu'i 'go khrid 'og rang skyong khul gyi dus thung slob 598

sbyor 'dzin grwa dang bo btsugs/ supi rtags paslabs/— blo spusal 'jug ngogs brtsams/d+ngha de7rjes sum rtags rtsa ba'i tshig 'grel de brtsams/ dgun slar khrin tubu ru song nas tshig mdzod kyi las don dang dpe khrid byas/ srid grosatshogs 'du sog sa la zhug sa /de lor bdag rang skyong khul srid gros kyi spusnye ṣ+ka gzhon par snye padams/ rab rgyal sa mo lug (spyi— lo1979)lo rang lo re drug thog dgun dpyid sngar ltar bod rgya tshig ma dzod kyi las ka dang slob ma kha shas la sgra dang sdeb sbyor sum rtags snyan ngag sogs khrid/rang gis sgor phud de —sgra mchan chen mo dacing // bod mkhasasnyan ngag gahetshige gi dpe brdzod 'grel ba dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i gsung dpar brgyab/ sgra mchan dang a mchog tshang dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgya mtsho'i ldob sbyor 'grel ba/ mtshams sbyor lnga ba'i byings sgrub tshar stis brgya da par/ dpyid hor bla bzhi bar glang chen 'gying rir—song / lha khang so sor bla mchod dang smon lam rnam lnga sogs brton/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin ri rtser slebs tshi mchod dang smon lam sogs bton zhag gnyis la bsdad/ smon lam legs par btab/ gnas bstod cig spyang brtsams/ glin gyi rgya mtsho'i nang nas rim gyis nyi— zer sbo ba'i ltad mor bltas/599

bsam 'aspub sogasasgrukyis lha'i sgron mi yang mthong 'dug dbyar thog rnga bar songakrunas khul dril bsgrags pu'u'i 'go khrid 'og rang skyong khul gyi dus thung slob sbyong 'dzin grwa thengs gnyis pa btsugs/mang mang la sum rtags snga lo las zab pa dang / skor zhig la sgra khrid/ blo gsal dga' ston brtsams/ dgun sngar bzhin khrin tu'u ru song nas tshig mdzod kyi las ka dang dpe khrid byas/ lo mjug zhing chen srid gros tshogs 'dur zhugs/ rab rgyal lcags pho sprel(spyi lo1980)lo rang lo re bdun thog spyi zla dang bor pe cin du mi rigs grangs nyung skad yig gi tshanarig gros bsdur du zhugs/ nyin bcu gnyis ring la rtsod gleng bgyis mthar‘‘gnad bsdus ’zer ba yig log yin par thag bcad/ de nas rim gyis gsar 'gyur dang dus deb thams cad bod rang gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thog tu bab/ bod rang gi rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi la gnod skyon chen po byung gin yod pa legs par bsal bas phan pa chen po byung ngo / /dgun sngar bzhin tshig mdzod kyi las ka dang / dpe khrid mang bo byas/ gnad bsdus ’kyi dgag yig mtha' daphyad zer ba de bod rgya tshig mdzod khang gis snum dpar brgyab nas/ tshig mdzod khang gi las byed pa yongs la tshar gcig khrid/ rnga ba nas snum 600

dpar zhig brgyab/ rjes sor lha sa nas snum dpar thengs gnyis brgyab/ kan lko gsar 'gyur khang nas kyang dpar legs po zhig brgyab/ sa khyab rdo khyab byung / pe cin nas dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi yi ge 'byor te/ bsngags brjod kyi bstod tshigs sogs byung / de nas zhor la blo gsal rigs sgo brtsams/ dbyar 'bar khams su 'ong nas rig slob cus kyis 'gro sgo btang ste/yig rmongs sel ba'i slob deb dang slob chung slob deb/ deb dang bo nas bzhi ba'i bar bzos/ g.yu thog gsar rnying gi lo rgyus brtsams rab rgyal lcags mo bya (spyi lo1981)lo rang lo re brgyad thog dgun sher bstan dang sher gri gnyis la rgyug bris 'don tshul bslabs/ dmu dge dgon pa'i don du yi ge du ma 'phangs/spyi zla gnyis pa nas saṃ bod shan sbyar rtsom pa'i 'go tshugaspa rangaskyong khul du chos lugs mi sna'i tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ tshogs 'du'i thog tu chos lugs srid jus la g.yonartelhung gi shugs rkyen thebs/yig cha nor 'khrul can bzos/ bdag khrin tu'u ru zhing chenarisrid gros rgyun las tshogs 'dur song / rīde'i skabs zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'us chos lugs kyi rnon la bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ de'i skabs bdag gis khul nang gi las ka nor 601

'tshol can rnamasacither 'don byas/ bu mthud nas zhirochen srid gros dang / mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen 'tshogs/ de'i skabs dmu dge dgon pa 'tshogs chogapa thag bcad par mu zad/zhing chen rispa pa'i rig gnayobadagaskyong byed rgyur thag bcad de/ rdo yig 'jog rgyu byas/ spyi zla lnga ba'i samajugal mdzod dge'i rdzong gis btsugs pa'i sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa bzhag ldom slob grwa 'bring ba'i nang btsugs te slobazum nyer drug la sgra khrid/ de nas hong yon du 'ongs nas rang skyong khul gyi dus thung slob sbyong 'dzin grwa thengs gsum pa spyi zla bdun pa'i tshes 'go nas btsugs te dbyangs can dgyes glu dang bod mkhas’dpe brjod sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs sbrags nas khrid/ blo gsal 'jug ngogs sum rtags rtsa ba'i tshig 'grel dngabaca sa pa spyi zla dacaba'i tshes bcu drug bar khrid/ tshes bcu bdun nyin rnga bar 'gro zho ra la mtshan nyid dgon par song / rnga bar song nas ngal ga so'i zhor la snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod brtsams pa dab bod corig gnasad ra tshul yang brtsams/ gebrag rtogs byed darosgra sbyor bam gnyis las saṃ bod shan sbyar gyi shog nye du yo bris/rab rgyal chu pho khyi (spyi lo1982)lo rang lo re dgu'i thog 602

spyi tshogasum pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nub mo nas slob bu nyi shu skor la rang shag tu snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod spyi zla bzhi ba'i tshes /spyom cu'i nub mo'i bar khrid/ de nas sa lam dang grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba cha tshang / blo gsal rigasasgo sogs khrid/ lha sa'e sman stsas /smreng gispobos pa ltar blobazang don 'grub rogs parokhridade spyi drug pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin khrin tu'u ru song /spyi zla bdun r+shapa'i tshes gnyis nyin gnam grur zhugs te lhatresar slebs nas krung go gnam rig skar rtsis kyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ skar rtsisachomathun tshogs kyis ming 'dzin tshogs’gtso gzhon par bdams/ snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod khrid/ dus 'khor go la 'bri bkod dang mgo 'jug gi rtsom dang skar rtsis kyi gzhung ca tshang zhig brtsams/ gtsang dang lho phyogs su mjal skong dhas pa byas/ thub bstanatshodam pa sogs 'ga' zhig la spyod 'jugachen mo dang leg0bshad snying bo'i bshad lung bton/ la sa khungs mat+pā bor song nas bshad pa byas/ gtsug lag khang gi thog khang nas paṇa chen rin po cher nang mjal zhus/ paṇa chen rin po che gsung bshad tshogs 'du chen mo'i skabs tshogs 'dur zhugs/ dru ku la'i gos bzang sogs dpe cha mang bor mjal r+bhab bstan dam pa'i zhabs brtan gso 'debs brtsams/r+ghaṃ9

gtsug lag khang dang ser 'bras dge gsum sogs la mjal te 'brel 'jog byas pa dang / bkra shis lhun po brgyud sa skyar song / sa skya'i gtsug lag khang sogabla la zhib mjal byas/4 de ga'i bod yig slob 'bring gi nang du song ste ba shad pa byas/ gtsug lag khang gi steng gi ta la'i lo mar bris pa'i rgya dpe mang bor mjal bas/ rang re'i bla brang gi khrid rgyun gyi lami ji bzhin 'dug de nas dad ldan mang tshogs mang bo'i re ba bskang / phyir bkra shis lhun por lhags te lha khang so sor mchod mjal rgyas pa dzo byas/ de ga'i srid gros khang dang sman khang gsar ba'i nang du bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ sridajidang rig gnas skor gyi gtam bshad/ pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon por mjal ba'i skabs yang thog gi rten 'gangs can mang bo ste/ dge ldan sprul ba'i glegs bam bzhugs sa'i sho ka li sogs la mjal/ bkra shis lhun po'i dgon gzhung nas bsnyen bkur bzango bo thob mar lam zhwa lur mjal skabs gtsug —lag khang gnyis lhag yod pa la zhib mjal dang / sa skya paṇa chen bsnyen par rdzogs skabs kyi khrus byed sne'i rdo gzhung la mjal/ de ga'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bzang bo gnang / de nas lho khar mjal skor la song / pho brang yum bu bla sgang dang / chos rgyul mes dbon 604

rnams kyi bang sor yang mjal/ lho kha nas grub chen rkyang bu'i r+sha gdung rus kyi sku rang byon bcu gsum la mjal/ gzhan yang slob dpon pad ma'i lcags kyi rdo rje dang bse 'bag sogs rten 'gabs can mang bor mjal/ po tā lar mjal skabs de ga'i bdag gnyer khang gis gsol ston zhig spyang gnang ste/ gsung bshad cig gnang dgos zhes zhus pa ltar bshad pa zhig kyang byas/de ltar zla ngo bzhir bsdad nas spyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes 'gor gnam grur zhugs te khrin tu'u ru slebs/ de gar paṇa chen rin po che dang / gung thang rin po cher mjal 'phrad byung / lho nub mi rigs slob grwar thengs gnyis song nas rig gnas kyi bshad pa dang sngags kyi klog thabs shig khrid/ spyi zla bcu gcig pa'i zla mjug tu 'bar khams su slebs/ spyi zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes sum cu'i nub nas mi kha shas la legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung shog bu bco lnga tsam bton/ spyi zla bcu ga nyis pa'i nang mi rigs grangs nyung dang chos lugs kyi mi sna drug cu lhag gi lta skor tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso byas te rang rgyal gyi lho phyogs kyi zhing chen dgu'i grong khyer che khag rnams su lta skor byas/ hrang he nas spyi lo sar/bzhag ldom slob 'bring gi dge slob yongs dang / mdzod dge'i bod sman khang gi mi 'ga' la yig bskur snyan tshig gis brgyan pa 605

re zhings/ rab rgyal chu rdzo—spu (byi lo1983)lo rang lobadunakhyu'i thog sbya mganyis pharozhing chen srid gros rgyun9 las tshogayo 'dur zhugs/ tshogs chung dang tshogs gnyis4) thog gta masabashad/ bsas 'chadz+wagand can sam zhig bsha/da/ spyi bla gsum par pe cin du song / krung dbyang mi rigasaslob gagana' yig slob sbyong 'dzin grwarosnyan ngagadzhayang gsal snang mdzod khrid/ de skabs si khron zhipachen srid gros u yon lhan tshogs skabs lnga ba 'tshogs/ de skabs bdag slar yang rgyun la.ā+oṃ.u yon la bdams 'dug de mtshungs rang skyong khul srid gros skabs bdun pa 'tshogs nas bdag slar yang kru'u zhi gzhon par bdams 'dug rī 4k+ṣ-i gna' dus zhe ho zer/ deng sang khrin tozha na zer bar mjal skor la song / bsam yas dang / bkra shi galhun po/ po sne la/ bde mchog pho brang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang sngogs su mjal/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal yin ladabang phyug4ṣ+karten brag rdo sra zhing mkhyegs pa khang brtsegs bcu phrag du ma las lhag pa'i mtho dma' yod pa'i dbang phyug gi mtshan ma'i dbyibs yod/gnas der zhag bdun bsdad de mjal skor byas/ gzhan yang 606

lhotresdo dro— skresro la snying bor bzhugs pa'i mchod rten chen po yod/ rgya yig gi bsam yas kyi dkar chag nang du khri srong sde btsan rgya 4 bza' las 'khrungs pa'i lo rgyus spyang yod/ pe cin du zla ngo bzhir bsdad/ pe cin nas yar yong zhor la tā thung grong khyer du song nas brag la brkos pa'i sangs rgyus byang sems kyi sku che chung mang bo yod par mjal/ gzhan yang grong khyer du lha khanganidu ma la mjal/ de na sa ri bo rtse lngar song ste nyin bdun la bsdad nas mngal skor byas/ de nas me 'khor brgyud lan grur gung thang rin po che'i gzim shag tu babs/ de nas sku 'bum du song nas drug pa'i smon lam 'chathadang bcas pa sogs dang gser gdung sogs rme mjal/ de nas bla brang du so nga ste mchod mjal dang dge 'dun re'i phyag k+ṣiṃsgor gcig re phul nas 'brel 'jog tsa gabya po 4 a khu dge 'dun tshang gis gsol ston zhig gnang / khong lajibadag gis blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid zhus/ dngul chu tho gas med gsung gi steng nayoganang / de nas 'bar khamagosu slebs/slar dmar thang rdzong bod yig slob 'bring du slob sbyong 'dzin grwa —btsugs gtso bo sum rtags khrid/ mu no btsan bo'i zlos gar labakod 'doms byas/ phyir 'bar khams sa'ongs nas rangaskyorokhul btsugs nas lo ngo sum cu 'khor ba'i dga' ston du zhugs/607
