de nyin nyi zla skaragasum dus gcig la mthong / de nas sgo mang sgar du song ste hor zla dgu ba 'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin grwa tshang yongs la skyabs 'gro'i khrid bton/ yig brgya'i mtshams la bsdad/ thun mtshams su dpe khrid cung zad byas/ lo de'i spyi zla bañca gcig pa'i zla mjug tu pe cin dusna song nas nang bston mthun tshogs kyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ phyir 'ongs nas sgo ma nga sgar du song ste/ skyabs 'gro/ bla mchod/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma rnams kyi khrid bton/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub/ sgrol ma dkar ljang gnyis/ chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/ 'jam da kar dang khro bo mi ba/yo ba dkar —bo/gnas brtan bcu drug rnams kyi rjes gnang bton/ spyod 'jug gi bshad lung / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang tshe mdo sogs kyi lung dang / blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid bton/ de nas rdzong thog gi rang shag tu yong / smra dbang sprul sku'i zhus ngor kirti dgon pa'i grwa ba brgya dang drug cu lhag dang / ho tshigs dgon pa'i grwa ba lnga bcu gzhan yang grwa ba kha shas bcas nyis brgya lhag la/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i rjes gnang / gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang bton/ sgrol ma rdo rje rnam 'byor ma'i mtshams la bsdad/ sman pa zhig gis zhus ngor/ kiti dgon pa 608

dang / bsī dgon pa sogs kyi grwa ba nyis brgya lhag la/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid/ de'i phyi nyin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang gi sta gon/ de'i phyi nyin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang dang drag po sum sgril gyi rjes gnang bcas bton/ — rab rgyal shing pho byi(spyi lo 1984) lo rang lo don gcig par snga phyir gsang 'dus dang bde mchog gi bsnyen pa btang /sgar yang hor zla gsum par sgo mang sgar du song nas tshes bco lngar gso sbyong du song nas mdo bton/ de nyin bsgrub bya brgya lhag la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa phog de'i phyi nyin nas nyin bzhir 'du khang thog nas grwa mang la sdom gsum bslab bya bton/mi bdun la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid dang / khu zhang tshang gi gsung 'jam dbyangs dkar bo zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi lung bton/ mi bcu gsum la stag phu sgrol ma'i dbang bton/ de nas rnga ba'i rang shag tu yong nas kun mkhyen phar phyin skabs brgyad kyi’mchod brjod dang bar skabs tshigs bcad kyi 'grel ba brtsams/ spyi zla lnga bar rdzong rig slob cus kyis btsugs pa'i slob sbyong 'dzin grwa mi nyis brgya lhag la sum rtags dang snyan ngag khrid/ sgo mang sgar gyi grwa ba nyi shu rtsa grangs shig la blo gsal rigs sgo khrid/ spyi zla bdun par kan su'u klu 609

chu rdzo nga du so/nga3sa zla ba gcig dadzu d+dhad la slob ma nyis brgya lhag la blo gsal 'jug ngogs dngartso/ blo gsal dga' ston/ debyangs 7na ga ka sogs khrid/ de nas mdzod dge'i bzhag sdom bod yig slo ba 'bring du spyi zla brgyad phalngasatshes bcu phyug dzotshoyong rang skyong khul gyis btsugs pa'i sbyong ba rdar thengasajibazhi ba btsugs/kan lho nas slob ma bcu bdun dadzo/ rang khul gyi slob ma nyis brgya lhag la/ skar rtsis rigs ldan mchod pa'i 'od snangatshudang / rang rtsom nyi zla gza' 'dzinalbe'u mig bcas rigs lda na mchod pa'i me tog dang / go la tshon ris ma 'bri tshul thig bcasakhrid /'go mjug gi mchod brjod sogs brtsams/ snyan ngag sgong gsal snang mdzod/7— blo gsal 'jug ngogs/ dbyangs can sgra ṭīka sngar gyi khrid 'phro de phan gyi 'go nas yongs rdzogs dang / ldeb sbyor 'grel ba lo chen snyarma 2'i gsung dang bod kyi lo rgyus bcas khrid/ rig ldanad+kuchod pa'i lod snangadang / rig ldan mchod pa'i me tog gasnyasarañcakhyung bcu bduspyo yar rtsiso 'go spos/ de nas skor zhig la 'jam dbyangs nā ga rasnya —dang 'jam dbyang sa slo dkar bo'i rjeyoganang / tswabastod pa don zab ma'i lung sdocas bton/ bsgrub bya gnyis lagadage tshul gyi sdom pha phog de nas sbyigabla bcu ba'i tshes brgyad nyin mdzod di ge'i bod sman khang du 610

slebs te nyin 'gar ngal gsos/ sman khang tsu 'dug skabasanub cig ltag tsha dgon pa'i mdun ri'i rtse nas zla ba cung zad tre cig ma gang ba 'dra ba'i zla ba yag po zhig shar dzā rmis/ spyi rtsabacu ba'i tshes bcu gsum nyin stag tsha chosabazang gling du slebs/ spyi zla bcu ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin phyi dror bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi skyabs khrid dang / skyabs 'gro'i lutha / hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gcig dang tshes’nyer gnyis la sdom gsum gyi khrid/ 'chad nyan g.yang 'bod kyi lung / tshes nyer gsum la las mchog sgo 'byed/ bstod pa don ldan ma'i lung / — tshes nyer bzhi la rdo rje 'jigayobyed bcu gsum ma'isnyesta gon/ tshes nyer lngar de'i dbang / tshes nyer drug la dipa' cig gi debang / dpa' ci ga gi cho ga byang chub lam sgron/tsho kun mkhyen bzhi ruba'i’gsung gyi'akhor chen mngon rtogayobasdusarīs/ rnam 'joms gzungs ribaca gas kyi lung / tshes nyer bdun la phyag rdor 'khor chen midabang / tshes nyer ba rgyad dze+eskye ra lhadeXgayomirta mgrinagasang sgrub kyi dbang / rta mcho ga jotshogaba'idagobs rgyan dang / rta mchog rol ba'i zhalalung gnyis rdzilung ༈ cho tshes ster dgu'i nyin gso sbyong gyimagon du song / mi bcu bzhir dge tshul gyi sdom dziphog gnam gang la sgrol ma dkar ljang genyis kyi rjes gnang /tsho 61 1

sgrol bstod/ legs bris ma dang / sgrol dkar bstod pa bcas kyi lung bton/ hor zla bcu ba'i tshes gcig la rigs gsum gcig sgrub kyi rjes gnang dga' ldan lha brgya 7'i khrid dang lung / sher phyigagyi stong nyid le'u sogs kyi lung / tshes gnyis la 'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang / dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang / 'di'i skabs su mchod me cher 'bar te me lce 'dom phyed tsam byung / bstod pa don zab ma/ 'jam dbyangs bstod sgrin rgya mtsho/ dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa chu 'dzin dkar bo ma/kun mkhyen 'jam dkar sgrub thabs/ gung thang 'jam dkar sgrub thabs dang / dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rje'i bsam lhun/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo/ so thar mdo bcas kyi lung / tshes bzhi lo'ajigs byed dang chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / tshes lnga la mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi drag po sum 'brel gyi sgrub thabs/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang smon lam sogs kyi lung /tshe sa drug la gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang / rgyan 'jug gnyis/ bdag gi zhabs bstan gsol 'debs do na gnyis tsur grub ma dang / bdag gi rjes 'dzin smon tshig dbyar skyesacho rnga gsang gnyis bdag gis brtsams pa de'i lung / shes bya'i rnam 612

—ṅgedz+was blo gsal rigs sgo las/ dge bcu'i sems byung gi bag yod kyi mtshan nyid bar gyi lung bton/ mi kha shas la mchod brjod kyi 'go'i sdeb0sbyor gyi sgra sgrub khrid/ stag tsha dgon nas tshur lam dmar thang rdzong bod yig slob 'bring du song nas rje'i bstod sprin rgya mtsho dang chu 'dzin dkar bo ma'i lung bton/ de nas 'bar khams su slebs nas tshogs 'du kha shas la zhugs/dgun rnga bar song nas khro bo 'byung 'dul dang thugayorje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bsnyen pa btang / stag tsha dgon gyi gdan rab brtsams rab rgyal shing mo glang(spyi lo1985)lo rang lo don gnyis pa/ spyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdunartal mtshan nyid dgon par song / nyin dang bor lam rim bsdus don gyi khrid bton/ de'i phyi nyin rta mgrin gsadz+wasgrub kyi dab nga gi sta gon/ de'i phyi nyin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang / de'i phyi nyin rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i dbang / 'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs smra seng dang khro bo mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang //'di'i skabs 'brug grags pa dang char sim bu babs/ lung kha 613

shas bton/ bod yig slo ba grwa 'gring ba'i slob ma rnams kyis tshig rgyugs rtsag de nas 'bar khams su slebs te khulu srid gronasargyunala.ā+oṃdang / srid gros u ldon lhan tshogs kyi tshogs 'dur zhugarab / khul mi dmangasku'i'athus mi'i tshogs — lasazur zhugs byas/ spyi sa lnga bgi tshes 'gorokhrin tu'u ru song nas lho nab mi rigayologagachen mo'i nang zla ba gcig dang phyed la snyan 'grel yang gsaldosnang mdzod khrid/ de nas spyi zlabyu drugatsho pa'i tshes nyer bzhir hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ dbu dger slebs te grwa tshang gi thugs dgongs ltar mjal kha btang / hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu drugal lam rim bsdus don gyi khrid bton/ tshes nyi shu'i nyisasog 'o ru'i phar kha'i thang du ras gur 'ibs te sog po ru sde'i gtsos ru grong rnams la grub rgyal—lugs kyi tshe dbang dar+ṣa / skyabs 'gro/ rtsang bshags/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi bstod pa dang /dmigs brtse ma/ ma ṇi/ rta mgrin bsnyen pa/ seng gdong bsnyen pa/— 'od zer can ma sogs kyi lung bton/ bshad pa dge bskul kha ta sogs byas/ sgor brgya byin kyang ma blangs/ tshes nye ra gcig nyin grwa tshang la/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang gi sta gon dang / lam gtso'i bshad lung / skyabs 'gro/ nyung 614

the6khakha/ pyi dega' ldan lha brgya ma/ ci sgolabastod/ sgrolarapokhasabastod tha/ spyi bshags/ rten k+kibrel bstod pa rnams kyingosadz+wabaton/ — tshes nyer gnyis nyin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbacasadang / rta mchog rol ba'i dgongs rgyan dang / rta mchog rol spre'i zhal lung gnyis kyi mung bton/ tshes nyer gsum nyer bzhi nyer lnga gsum la/ gsang 'dus/ bdelichog 'jig sa byedajibacu gsum ma rnams kyi dbang bton/ tshesanyer drug la 'jigs byed dpa' cig— gi dbang dang 'jigs byed za ma tog dag/bdud las rnam rgyal gnyis kyi lhan thabs kyi lung bton/ tshes nyer bdun la mgon po bar chad kun selalha rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjesmo gnang / mgonage'i ri gakhor chog gi lung rnams bton/ tshes nyer brgyad tshwa'aṣ+pem dbyangaspodaskar bo'i rjes gnang / dbyangs can mdecikaromo'i rdzis gnang / kunanemakhyen 'jamasmadabyaldas dkar bo'isgrub thab sa las tshogs dang bcas pa'i lung / — kun mkhyen 'jigs dar+pāng bo'i 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sbyin sre ga dang bcas pa 'i lungahūṃ gung thadzogasung dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thab sashuspre lungagaskem lags rin po che rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgyad+kutsho 'i gsung gi 'jam dbyangs dkar bo /dang zholcebrelhoba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/615

da byangs can bstod pa chu 'dzin dkar bo ma/ nag mo khol gyis mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes nyerodatsur dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ rigasagasum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnaro/ mkhan po ngag dbang thub bltan rgya mtsho'i gsung gi dmigs brtse ma'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i lung /gza'— nyi ma mdung gang ma'i rjes gnang rnams bton/ gnam gang nyin gso sbyong gi mgon du song nas mdo bton/ de nyin bsgrub bya zhe drug dge tshul slong gi bslab pa la bkod/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes gcig la ras gur nang nas rta mgrin yang gsang gi dbang bton/ tshes gnyis la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang / bde mchog rkang brgyaske da dngadzobade mchog gsang 'dus 'jigs byed rnams kyi smon lam dang shis brjod/ paṇa chen gsung gtor ma brgya rtsa dang /chab gtor shāka thub ma/ bstan sgron gsung 'jam dbyangs nag po'i mngon rtogs rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes gsum la nā ga rasnya'i rjes gnangs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi de'i cho ga'i lung / tshes bzhir grub mtha' rtsa ba don bdun cu/ sa lam/ zhi ba lam zab/ mngon rtogs rgyan/616

'artsag ge dhe byang chub lam sgron/ gnas bcu/ sman bla marjog bden mu rnams kyi lung / tshes drug la 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug gijirjes gnang / gzhung las pa chos ldan tshogs 'phel gyis maṇ+ḍal gyi phashad pa gang legs shig zhus/ de nas kan lho'i bsu ma thon te gtsos grong rdal du song nas spyi zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi nas zla gcig tsam la/ snyan ngag yang gsal snang mdzod nang blo gsal dga' ston khrid/— de nas bla brang du song nas nyin bcur bsdad de/ snga dror bsang chu rdzong gi bod yig slob 'bring du song ste blo gsal rigs sgo dang rigs lam 'phrul sde'i daphe khrid bya sa/ phyi dro bla brang gi dge 'dun pa du ma la bka' chos bton/ bka' chos 'don grabs byed pa'i skabs su nyi ma shar yod kyang rgyab ri'i rtse nas spren dkar dum bu zhig yod pa'i nang nas 'brug grags/ bka' chos 'tshogs ma tha ga char zim bu zhig babs/'di bla bratha du bka' chos 'don pa'i thog ma yin pas rten 'brel 'grig snyam/ lke bka' chos thog mar yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i khrid/de nartswalam gtso'i khrid/ dga' ldan cilha brgya ma'i khrid/ khong a lags rin pospoche'i gsung ji/ dus 'khor blos bslang bzhengs tshul gyi lung / pra sti'i sum cu ba'i 'grel ba kun bzang dgongs rgyan gyi khrid sogs bton/ 'di skabs —shig tu nub byang mi rigs 617

slob grwa che na mo'i gtagadzigs rigs pa'i ming 'dzin dge rgan chen mo'i go gnas kyi bka' shog thon/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu drug nyin ma khu dge 'dun tshang la rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung zhus/ gong sa mchog gi gsung bkod ltar dzin grwa'i skabs bzhi ba man chad kyis dam bca' btsugs/ de skabs ba 'tshogs su ma zhugs kyang dpe khrid zhus nas yod pa rnams kyang phebs nas chos rtsod 'ur chil le ba zhig byung / tshes bcu dgu'i phyi dror mchod mjal rgyas pa byas/ gtsos brgyud nas stag tsha chos bzang gling—du babs/ — tshes nyer gsum nyin bsgrub byarage slogab cu gcig dang dge tshul lnga la sdom pa phog tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin zung chu rdzong du slebs/ spyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes sprucu gnyis nyin nas 'go bzung ste rang skyong khul gyis btsu gas pa'i dus thung sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa thengs lnga ba btsu gas/ sa skya'i legs bshad cung zad dang / blo gsal 'jug ngogs cha tshang / sum rtags cagasa'i tshig 'a grel bcas zla ba gnyis tsam gyi ring la khrid/ phyi zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer drug nyer bdun nyer brgyad gsum la/ gzi tsha'i yul ljongs dang dung ri'i gser mtsho la bde mchog rkang brgyad 'donabyubazhin mjal skor byas/ rus sbal dgon pa'i grwa ba gsum la 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung bton/ do ma ṇi'i 618

gnas kyi lo rgyus brtsams — ri — de nas spyi zla bcu bar 'bar khams su log de nas slar bun cang kron chus su song ste spung go bod kyi lo rgyus kyi —gzhung —lugs gros bsdur gyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ tshogs tshogs chung thog tu gtam rus pa can bshad/ de nas phyir 'bar khams su log spyi‘zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer bdun nyin mi blodun la 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma/ byangachub lam sgron/ lam rim smon lam rnams kyi lung bton/ horathozla dgu ba'i nyer gsum la rnga bar song nas kun rig dang thub pa — dam tshig gsum bkod kyi bsnyen pa btang / — mi gagyis la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phogarab rgyal me pho stag (spyi lo 1986) lo rang lo don gsum pa hor zla dang bo'i tshes bcu gsum nyin/ mchod rten rtsogs kyi dgonaspyopar song nasacegrwa 'ang dang mang tshogs la yon ta na gzhi gyur ma dang dga' ldan lha baspya ma'i khrid/ mtshan nyid tshugs rgyu'i rten 'brel bsgrigapha/ tshes bco lngar zangs dkar khang dmar dgon du song / bcu bdun nyin 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i sta goska/ bco brgyad nyin 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum mū'i dbang dang / mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi 619

rjes gnang / bcu dgu'i nyin 'jigs byedadzādapa' bo gcig pa'i dbang dang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang /tsha gsur dri mchog 'dod yon ma'i lung / tshes nyi shu'i nyin dus 'khor spyi bka'i dbang dang / dpal ldan dang bo ma'i lung /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang thun mong ba/ tshes nyer gcig nyin rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i dbang dang /rnam sras ser chen gyi rjes gnang / rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi lung / tshes nyer gnyis nyin kun rig gi dbang dang / thar mdo dang / 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo'i lung / tshes nyer gsum nyin thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang dang / 'jigs byed dpa' cig lhan thabs dang / lha bcu gsum ma za ma tog gi lhan thabs kyi lung / de nas 'ga' zhig la dge tshul gyi sdom pa phog grwa mang dang grong ba bcas la mjal kha btang / de nas 'bar khams su yong / nub byang mi rigs slob grwas rlangag 'khor gnyis bsu bar thon yang / na nas sman khang du nyin bcu gcig bsdad/ de nas spyi zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin lam du chas te bla brang du song / bla brang nas dpe cha re g.yar nas nyin gnyis la bsdad/ de nas lan grur song nas nub byang mi rigs slob grwar zla gnyis bsnad de zhib 'jug slob mar 620

sgra khrid/ nub byang mi rigs slob grwa'i bod kyi slob ma rnams dang / lan gru grong khyer gyi bod kyi las byed pa rnams la lhan 4du bod kyi lo rgyus khrid/ de nas bla brang du 'ongs te/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer lnga nas 'go bzung ste nyin bcu gsum gyi ring la 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid bton/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu dang tshes bcu gcig gnyis la ngag byin rlabs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa rnams kyi khrid/ de nas nyin dz+nya ma'i ring la blo gsal 'jug ngogs dang / pra lta'i sum rtags/ yang gsal snang mdzod rnams dpe khrid byas/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin tshogs chen 'du khang gi go sar sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig brgyab/ de nas bzung sa bdag lto 'phye'i cho ga'i ngag 'don gyi rim pa bsgrigs/ tshes nyer brgyad nas bzung ste 'jam dbyangs chosposkor gyi rjes gnang cha tshang / dbe+en sa'i gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed dang bcas pa/ gdan thog gcig pu ma'i lung /snying zhugs ma gtogs mgon po'i bka' bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang cha tshang bton/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcutshoganyis nyin sgrol ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang gi sta gon/ tshes bcagasum nyin dbang dngos gzhi/ hor zla drug pa'i bcu bzhi nas bzung hor 621

zla bdun pa'i tshes/ nyer gcig bar sgrub thabs rin 'byung—gi rjes gnang cha tshang lung dang bcas pa bton/ 'jam da byangs dkar bo'i rjes gnang gi mjug mkhan po ngag dbang thub bstan rgya snye mtsho'i gsung 'jam dbyangs dkar tho'i smyungaganagachoka dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs las tshogasang nga — dang bcas pa/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi sgrub thabs sbyin sretha/ dang bcas pa/ bstod pa don zab ma/ a lags rin po tshe'i gsung gi rdo rje gsum gyi bzlas pa byed tshul bla ma dang lhag lha dbyer med kyi rna—la labyor/ bdag gis brtsa'akhasapa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i 'dod gso la/ bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi bstod sgrin rgya mtsho so gas kyi lung bton/ che sa nyer gnyis nyin/ rigs gsumaspyo3spyob2) rjes gnang dar /dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ mjug tu tshogs 'khor bskor/ grwa mang —la mjal kha btang / tshes nyer lnga'i nyinagator ma ba rgya rtsa'i phyag khrid byas/ 'di skabs slob bu bcu phrag lhag la lachi khrid/tshes nyer drug nyin/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi zhi rdzosbrags sgrub thun mong masayin pa'i khrid dang / khu zhang gsung gi 'jagadabyangs/ dkar bo'i zhi khro sbrags sgrub lung bcas bton/ tshes nyer dgu'i nyin 'khor lo'i sa 'khor gnam 'khor dang srog shing 62lha

sri tshul4bh+rikhor lo bcigs tshul sogs kyi khrid/ de'i skabs a khu dge 'dun tshang la blosbyong mtshon cha'i 'a khorolo'i lung zhus/ hor zla brgyad padzi tshes bdun brgyad gang rung la lam la zhegaso te stag tsha dgon du slebs/ tshes bcu'i nyin yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i bshad lung dang / bde mchog dril bu lha lnge'i da bang /tshes bcu gcig nyin dus 'khor spyi bkaladabang dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung / tshes bcu gnyis nyin dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang / bcu gsu ma nyin kun rig gi dbang dang /drag po gsum sgril gyi rjes gnang / mdzod dgeli.a khu mkhas grub bstan 'dzin gyi gsung sgrol dkaratshe sgrub 'od zer drug sprags ma'i lung /— tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin thugs je chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang dang / thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba'i rjes gnang / tshe mdo / rnam rgyal gzungs ring / thu gsar+shardzechen po'i gzungs ring / ma ṇi/ kun rig rtsa sngags/ gtsugartor dri med kyi gathungs rnams kyi tsang / tshes bco lnga'i nyin mi 'khru gas pa'i dbang / seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang / mtshan sngags kyi lung / tshes brtswadrag nyin dge tshul gnyisadang bsnyen rdzogs dgu bsgrubs/ de nas 'bar khams su slebs/de rjes ngag dbang grags pa'i sku gdung la mjal/ bla mchod 623

dang smon lam sogs bton nas gsolab btab/ de rjes thugs rje chen por song nas bla mchod dang smon lam sogs bton nas gsol ba btab/ mjal skabs thugs rje cheno por spyan chab rgyung ba lta bu shar/ de rjes bai ro tsa na'i sgrub phug tu song nas bdun gcig la bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i bdag 'jug bton/ de nas rnga bar song nas sman lha dang / mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen pa btang / 'di skabs mtshan ma legs po byung / mkha' spyod ma'i bdag 'jug bdun sgrub gcig bton/ smra dbang sprulatresku dang blo bzang rgya mtsho gnyis la legs bshad snying bo'i bshad lung rdzi bton/ — rab gnas me mo yos (spyi lo1987) lo rang lo don bzhi —ba la bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long gi mjug brtsams/ dbyarog dong ru dgon du song / gdong ru dgonajigyi grwa tshang dang / gzhu shubs dgon gyi grwa ba rnams dang / 'brog dge dgon gyi grwa ba skor zhig bcas la 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid nyin — brgyad la bton/ a lags ser skyes sogs la bla mchod kyi khrid/seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i rjes gnang / thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba'i rjes gnang / grwa ba 'ga' zhig la dag yig mkhas pa dga' bskyed 024

khrid/ 'ga' zhig la lami dang yi ge yang khrid/ ludzi khe shasabaton/ tshogs mang dang grong ba bcas la mjal kha btang / nyin bco lnga 'gor/ de nas yar yong nas sgo mang sgar du song / grwa mang la lam rim bde lam gyi khrid nyin brgyad la bton/ nge nas 'go log khang sar dgon du song / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ rigs gsum gcig sgrub kyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang sta gon bcas/ —'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang / mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba bsnyen dus dang 'grel ba'i rjes gnang / lha mo'i rjes gnang / rnam sras ser chen gyi rjesaganang / bag tse'i rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang / dus 'khor spyi bka'i dbang / rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang / kun rig gi dbachong / gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbakhu byad grol dang bcas pa/ legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes genang / sgro la dkar gyi rjes gnang / seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang / rnam rgyal ma'i rjes gnang / skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ de ltar mkha' dbyings ma/ bla mchod/ dpal ldan sa 625

gsum ma/ skabs gsum pa/ lam rim bsdus sdon/ — 'jam dpal mtshan r+pārjog shes—bya'i mkha' dbyings ma/ rtogs thārjodapyamadunas mo / tsoja bshagasalta spyi bshags/ rī smon lam sde lnga/ gsang 'dus smon lamya/ 'jigs byed smon 'gre/ la—brlachos rgyal ma/ layosngagagag nyis kyi smon lam/ /ṭ+wāṃ yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ bstod sgrin rgya mtsho ma/ —lam sgron/ 44 bltan 'bar ma/ mi 'khrugar+sāri pa'i gzungs/ sher snying / sgrol bstod/legasabri sam/ chu 'dzinadakar bo ma rnams kyi lung / mjug tu tsho g.yo'akhor bskor/ chos grwa'i gzhir song nas mtshan nyidatshugs pa'i rten 'bredzobasgrigayote ldodon pawaton pa dang bshad pa byayote mjug tucitshang mas thal skad btang nas grol/ mang gas la mjal kha btang / nyin dgur b.rid nas grwa mang gis skud btang dar 'bod dang ba casate phyi ra sgo mang dgon du log hor zla bzhi ba'i tshespobaco lnga'i nyin gso sbyodzogi mgon du song nas mdo bton/ bsgrub bya brgyad nalhag la dge tshul slong sgosdo ma pa phog tshes bco brgyad nas 'jigs rgyud lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang sta gon da nga bcas pa/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang / gsang 'dus kyi dbag/ bde mchog tso i pa/ dritshwa bu lha lnga/ skerta mgrin gsang sgrub/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ sma na 626

lha/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu rnams kyi dbang / gdugs dkar lha ba bdun ma'i dbang byad gro4 dang bcas pa/ kun rig gi dbang / chos grwa'i nang nas dashon grong kun dzhal thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang btwonaste mjug tu skya rtserokun la mjal kha btang / grwa ba stong lhahwa'adus/ 'jam dbyangs dkar+sha ser ga / dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ rigapha/ gsum gcig sgrub/ mgon po bar chad kun sel/ lha mo/ rnam sras ser chen rnams kyi rjes gnang / datshwa can mgar nag gi srog gtad/ sku lnga'i srog gtad/ khyung khru'i rjes gnangarī/dmigs brtse mu'i las tshogs bcu gcig gi lung / grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bton —te mjug tu tshogs tre'akhor bskor/ ma lags bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la brda sbod blo gsal 'jug ngogs dang lañcha dang sug ripagi yig gzugs blo rig zur rgyan khrid/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bzhi'i nyin 'a khor lo'i sa 'khor gnam 'khor srog shing 'bri tshul sogs khrid/ tshes lnga nas 'a dul ba mdo rtsa'i bshad lung dang / zi gzhigasum cho ga'i bshadaltaja bton/ 'dul sdom gyi dpe khrid/ — sa lamari/ rin chen phreng ba/ grub mtha' rtsa ba/ don bdun cu rnams kyi dpe khrid/ baspom gzugs legs bshad bum bzang / tsho dbu ma lung rigs sgron 6ཿ7

mi'i sims tsam dgag pa'i bar khrid/ a khu tshang gi bsdus grwa khrid/ blo gas/la 'jug ngogs/ snyan ngag yang gsal snang mdzode khrid/ 'ga' zhi ga la lami dang yi gi khrid/ nyin gcig grwa mang snelīthog gso sbyong gi lung bshad pa dang bcas/gdugs dkar 'khor lo'i khrid bton/ de nas sngo shul dgon du song nas grwa mang la lam rim bsdus don gyi khrid bton/ gdugs dkar 'khor lo bzhag sgo mang nas sprul sku bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sbyin bdag byas te grwa mang nas gnas bcu'i brton bzhugs phul/ sprul sku tshang gis bshad pa legs po byaso/de nas 'bar khams su slebs te khul srid gros kyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs tshen la zur zhugs byas/tshes sum cu so gcig gi nubalpo srid gros kyis ston chen byas/ derazhugs nas rang rtsom bstod tshig sogs bsgrags/ 'bar khams nas kyang dpe khrid 'ga' byas/ a lags bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la blo gsal dga' ston kha tshang dang dbyangs can sgra ṭīka gi steng nas sgra'i ri mo zhib khrid kyi 'go bzung / a lags bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang shes rab rgya mtsho gnyis la phar phyin skabs dang bo'i mtha' dpyod mchan dang sbrags pa myang 'das bar khrid/ rab gnas me yos lo'i zla 6lha8

bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum(spyi lo1988zla1tshes12)nyin sman pa bstan kho dang / a lags bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs 'ga' zhijig la/ 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo dang / rang rtsom sa bdag lto 'phye'i thigs 'debs tshul rab gsal me long zhes bya ba dang / lto 'phye'i bskyed chog ngag 'don gyi rim pa/ skyo mgur bla ma mkhyen ma/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la 'dod don gsol ba don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba dang / lus ngag yid gsum bcings grol/ kha mchu zhi byed sogs kyi lung bton/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyi shu nyin/ gzungs 'jug 'khrul spongs nyin mor byed pa'i snying bo dang / gzungs 'jug gi zur 'debs 'khrul sel ga pur chu rgyun/ gzungs 'bul gyi man ngag gzungs 'bul gyi lhan thabs gnod sbyin dang tshogs bdag 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/gzungs 'jug gi lag len mdor bsdus bcas kyi khrid bton/tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin 'ga' zhig la kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung yi dam sgrub skor las/ sgrol ma dkar mo la brten nas tshe sgrub pa'i cho ga 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang dang / sgrol ljang mngon rtogs mdor bsdus/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas bum pa skrub tshul rnams kyi lung bton/639

de'i 'phror khrin tu'ucaru song nasazhing chen srid gros kyi tshogs 'du dang mi dmangayo'athus mi 'i tshogs chen la zur zhugs byas/ de nagodamu dger yong / mi kha shas la snar thang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i sngags klog thabs ②'grel khrid/ hor zla bcu gastes pa'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin bla r+sādu ma zhig la/ 'jam dbyangs nyi masadri sa lan dang tshesanyer lnga'i nyin bla ma lnga bcu ba'i rnam bshad—gnyis kyi khrid dang / dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa chu 'dzin dkar bo ma dang / mar gad zhu 'dra ma gnyis kyi lung bton/rab gnas spopho 'brug (spyi lo1988)lo rang lo don lngab hor zla dang bo'i tshes lnga nas kha shas la nag rtsis khrid/horangazla dang bo'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin tsha bu bslab gsum rgya oṃtsho tshogs la zhugs/ chos mdzad btang / dge 'dun re'i phyag tu sgor mo gsum re phug spyi 'jog la yul ba tshang gispo'abri gcig phul/ bdag gis sgor mo stong gcig lhag gis spen rgyan ba zhag hor zla gnyis pa'i nang tshe dpag lha dgu'i bsnyen pa btang / grwa ba 'ga' zhig la thar mdo'i lung bton/ tshes bcu drug nas swotshang yongayol dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang / tshes bcu bdun nyinarajigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi sta gon/ de'i phyi nyin de'i dbang / tshes nyi shu'i 630

nyin 'jigs byed dpa' bam̐ gcig pa'i dbang dang / mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / tshes nyer gcig nyin gsang 'dus kyi dbang / tshes nyer gnyis nyin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang dang / dam can mgar nag gi srog gtad/ tshes nyer gsum nyin kun rig gi dbang dang / rta mchog rol ba'i darigongs rgyan gyi lung / tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang dang / grub mtha' rtsa ba'i lung / tshes nyer lnga'i nyin tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang dang / tshes nyer drug nyin 'jam da byangs smra seng dang / dajam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dbyangs nag po rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung / tshes nyer bdun nyin chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang / rta phyag khyung gsum/ lha mo/ dam can seng zhon/seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum rnams kyi rjes gnang / mjug tu rigs gsum gcig sgrub kyi rjes gnang bton/ bsgrub bya bcu phrag kha shas la dge tshul slong gi sdoyopa phog slob bu du ma zhig la sum cu ba dang grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba/ 'dul sdom gyi dpe khrid/ dbu ma lung rigs sgron me rnams khrid/ gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung bton/ 'tshogs chos grwa la do dam dang / 'du khang gsar bzhengs la bkod khyab dang do da ma byas/ a lags 631

bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan slebs nas khong la sgra dang sdeb sbyor sogs mu mthud nas khrid/ de nas dge 'dun nyi shu dang / rten 'brel kun gzhi'i mtha' dpyod/ bsam gzugs sogs khrid/ 'ga' zhig la rig byed ma phyi sgrurba kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bton/ 'jigs med dbang bo'i yi dam sgrub skor las mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs/ a lags rin po che'i gsung lha mo ku ru kuble'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bstod pa don zab ma rnams kyi lung bton/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i nyin gza' nyi ma mdung gang ma'i rjes gnang bton/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes gnyis nyin dge tshul bcu gcig bsgrubs/ sngar rnga bar yod skabs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas gung thang rin po che brgyud de a lags bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar sa bon dang lha dar srid du ring ba bcas bskur te/ rnam thar rtsom rgyu'i bka' lung gser gyi ba tog spyi bor bab/ de nas bzung ste zhar zhor la bris te lo de'i hor zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin mjug rdzogs par bris/ de rjes skor zhig la grub mtha' rin chen breng ba khrid/de rjes thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsnyen pa btang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i 'dun dang 632

gdung mchod byed pa'i bkod pa byas/ — rab gnas sa mo sbrul(spyi lo1989)lo rang lo don drug pa hor zla dang bo'i tshes gcig nyin 'ga' zhig la tshe mdo'i lung bton/ smon lam grol nas bco brgyad nyin 'bar khams su slebs/ de nas spyi zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nyin khul srid gros skabs brgyad pa'i tshogs chen la zhugs—/ bdag slar kru'u zhi gzhon par bdams/ spyi zla gsum pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin pe cin du rgyal yongs srid gros skabs bdun pa thengs gnyis pa'i u yon tshogs 'dur zhugs/ bdag rgyal yongs srid gros u yon du bdams/ khong skyabs mgon rin po ches khyod bla brang du yong nas bka' chos zhus ma zhus kun thon zhes bka' gnang / spyi zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lngar khrin tu'u ru song nas/ rgyun las u yon gyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ spyi zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin rnga bar song / kirti'i rgyud pa'i khri ba bse srib sogs la 'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang / drag po sum sgril gyi rjes gnang / sgo mang sgar du song nas nyin gsum la nā ga rar+sha/ seṅge sgra/ drag po sum sgril/ klu dbang rgyal bo/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng / rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs rnams kyi rjes gnang bton/ sa ga zla ba'i gnam gang nyin bsgrub bya lnga bcu lhag la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa phog633

hor zla lnga ba'i tshis gcig nyin sdo shul dgon du song nas rigs snyegasum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bton/ tshur sgo mang la yong /gtor ma brgya rtsa'i phyag khrid bton/ tshes lnga'i nyin 'du khang gi go sar sa bdag sto 'phye'i thig brgyab/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gcig la stag tsha sgar du 'byor/ tshes bcu drug nas grwa tshang la bde lam tshigs bcad ma'i khrid nyin lnga la bton/ tshes nyer gcig nas nyin gsum la tshe gcig nyams len gyi khrid bton/de'i skabs bka' chos kyi mjug tu bsdus grwa'i dpe khrid byas te dam bca' tshugs pa nyin bdun la byas/ a lags dang bslab gsum rgya mtsho gnyis dam bca' la zhugs su bcug tshes nyer lnga'i nyin dge slong sum cu dang / dge tshul bcu tsam bsgrubs/tshes nyer bdun la kun rig gi dbang bton/ tshes nyer brgyad la 'jigs byed dpa' cig gi dbang / tshes nyer dgur theg chen gso sbyong gi lung byin/ a lags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang bslab gsum rgya mtsho gnyis kyis zhus ngor/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi dbang bton/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig nyin/ rdo rje rnam 'joms ljang sdon/ rig byed ma thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis ka seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum/ lo gyon ma ser mo rnams kyi rjes gnang bton/ tshes gnyis nyin bde mchog lu i 634

pa'i dbang dang / mgon po phyag druskapa'i rjes gnadzobaton༈tshes gsum nyin chos rgyal phyi sgrub/ dpal ldan lha mo/ rnam sras ser chen rnams kyi rjes gnang bton/ tshes bzhi lnga drug gsum la ngal gsos/ tshes bdun la gzhi sum cho ga'i bshad lung /tshes brgyad nyin bod5sman khang gis zhus ngor/ sman lha bde gshegasabargyad dang / zhang blon gyi dzesaganang / tshes dgu'i nyin gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung gi mjug— bton/ tshes bcu dang bcu gcig bcu gnyis bcu gsum bzhi la sngags kyi sa lam ‘ khrid/ de dag gi pijug tu bsdus grwa khrid de nyin bdun gyi ring la da.oṃbaca' tshugs/ khyon nyin bcu bzhir dpe khrid dang dam bca' tshugs/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin bsdu ba sogs byas/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du slebs/ tshes bco brgyad nyin nas dbyangs can dgyes glu'i bshad lung bton/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig nas bajucu bzhi bar bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid bton/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang dga' ldan 'pho khrid bton/ tshes bcu drug bcu bdun bco brgyad bcu dgu rnams la dbyangs can sgra ṭīka bshad lung gi mjug bton/ tshes nyi shu'i nyin gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sta gon dang lam rim bsdus don gyi r+ghaṃbyi5

khrid bton/ tshes nyer gcig nyin gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang / tshes nyer gnyis nyin gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang / tshes nyer gsum nyin nag po spyod pa'i bde mchog gi dbang / tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin stag phu'i sgrol ma'i dbang dang chos skor cha tshang gi lung bton/ tshes nyer lnga'i nyin rges sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa bton/ pra sti'i rtags 'jug gi khrid bton/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer drug nas ba ri brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa bton/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bzhi nas snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / yig rnying gi lung dang bcas pa bton/ tshes bdun nyin snar thang gi mjug dang kun mkhyen gsung lo —gyon ma'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i lung bton/ de'i phyi nyin tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje srog shing bton/ mjug tu mang tshogs la mjal kha btang / tshes dgu'i nyin yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i khrid dang dga' ldan 'pho khrid bton/ de'i skabs shig tu skyarbes mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' gsung bzhin skabs bzhi ba man chad dang / tshogs su ma chud kyang dpe khrid byas nas bsdad yod pa dang / ngal rtsol ba bcas bsdus te nyin bdun la dam bca' tshugs te rtsod pa shog chen po byas te de la lta 636

rtogs rgyas/ di'i skabs shig tu 'du phung cung zad mi bde ba /byung stabs/ nyin kha shas la ngal gsos/ slob ma rnams kyis rim gro rnam rgyal gzungs ring tshar sum brgya/ gnas bcu tshar chig stong brgya dang go brgyad/ seng gdong ma chig 'bum tshobazhi khri lnga stong / gdugs dkar tshar nyis stong lnga brgya bcu gsum/ mdo tshar sum stong lnga brgya/ sgrol ma tshar chig stong bzhi bcu/ tshe mdo tshar dgu brgya dang zhe lnga/ gsang 'dus lho sgo tshar bcu bzhi/ brgya bzhi tshar bzhi dang / lus ngag yid gsum bcings grol sogs rang 'gul gyis bsgrubs so/ /tshes bco lnga'i nyin bsgrub bya bdun cu brgyad cu zhig la dge slong dang dge tshul dge bsnyen rnams kyi sdom pa phog tshes bco brgyad nyin stag tsha sgar du 'byor/ tshes nyi shu'i nyin bsgrub bya gsum la dge tshul gyi sdom pa phog tshes nyer gcig nyin ging lnga gza' gdong / bag tse dang bcas pa'i srog dbang srog gtad bton/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis kyi dus chen nyin/ klu dbang rgyal bo dang / 'jam dkar lha lnga'i rjes gnang / thu'u bkwan gsung drag po gsum sgril gyi sgrub thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i lung bton/ bla brang 'du khang du 'bul rgyu'i kun bzang 'khor lo zhig brtsams/ de skabs shig tu sman pa kha shas 637

la/ sgrol bstod dang / seng gdong ma sogs kyi lung bton/tshes nyer brgyad nyin 'bar khams su slebs/hor zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer lnga'i(spyi lo1989zla1 1tshes 22) nyin 'bar khams nas lam du zhugs te dgung mo khrin tu'u ru slebs/ tshes nyer drug nyin 'byor tho bkod/ tshes nyer bdun nyin nas zhing chen srid gros rgyun las u yon gyi tshogs 'dumo zhugag de'i skabs su si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i zho krang gzhon pa rdo rje dgra 'dul dang / kho krang rig 'dzin rnam rgyal sogs kyis zas sna lha dar gyi zhu rten bcas nged cag gi slob grwa'i nang du cis kyang phebs pa'i bka' drin skyong dgos zhes nan gyi sa zhus par brten yong rgyu khas blangs/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum (spyi lo1989zla1 1ches30) nyin phyir lam du btegs te was kros su bsdad/ de'i phyi nyin 'bar khams su 'byor/ tshes dgu'i nyin rgyal dge'i dgon gyi grwa ba gnyis slebs /nas rgyal dge dgon bkra shis slob brtan gling gi byung rabs shig dgos zhus par brten brtsams/ tshes bcu'i nyin grwa ba de ba/nyis la dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / de ltar mkha' dbyings ma/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ lam rim smon lam rnams /kye lung bton/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer gnyis 638

(gyilo 1989zla12tshis19)nyin rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul srid gros u yon lhan tshogasaskabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs bdun pa 'tshogs pa'i 'byor tho bkod/ tshes nyer gsum nyin nas nyin gsum la rgyun las u yon lhan tshogs kyi tshogs 'du dngos la zhugs/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyer brgyad gnyis la srid gros khang gis gsar du bzhengs pa'i 'dug gnas kyi nang du spor/ 'di skabs su chos dang rig gnas kyi 'brel ba spyi nor phun tshogs zhes pa zhig brtsams/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun(spyi lo1990zla1tshes13)nyin dmu dge la 'gro phyir lam du zhugs/ dgong mo mong shan du bsdad/ phyi nyin dmu dger 'byor/ tshes nyi shu'i nyin nas tsha bu bslab gsum rgya mtshos bsdus grwa'i rtsa tshig dang bswe bsdus tshogs rgyugs la 'bul rgyu'i 'go brtsams/ rab gnas lcags rta ste rang lo don bdun pa'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes bcu'i(spyi lo1990zla2tshes5) nyin khrin tu'u ru song /phyi nyin si khron zhing chen skabs drug pa'i rgyun las u yon lhan tshogs thengs bcu bar zhugs/ tshe sa bcu gsum nyin si khron zhing chen srid gros skabs drug pa'i sayon lhan tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshogs 'dur zhugs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin gyi snga dro si khron spyo39

zhing—chen mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen la zur zhugs byas/phyi dro srid gros kyi tshogs chung la zhugs/ tshes bcu drug nyin gyi phyi dro rgyun las u yon lhan tshogs la zhugs/ tshes bco brgyad nyin gyi phyi dro bod kyi sa gnas kyi las don gros bsdur gyi tshogs 'dur zhugs te gtam bshad/ tshes bcu dgu nyin gyi snga dro mi dmangs ci'athus mi'i tshogs chen la zur zhugs byas/ phyi dro srid gros tshogs chung la zhugs/ tshes nyer gcig nyin gyi phyi dro si khron zhing chen srid gros tshogs 'du mjug bsdus/ de'i skabs sgrub sdobs rgya mtsho'i rjes chog dpar/ tshes nyer gsum nyin lam rdu zhugs te tshes nyer bzhir dmu dger slebs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi (spyi lo 1990 zla 2 tshes28)nyin grwa tshang dang grong ba yongs la thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang dang / thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba'i rjes gnang / 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi smyung gnas cho ga dang / a lags bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gi rig byed ma'i cho ga bsdu ba'i lung rnams bton te grong ba rnams la mjal kha btang / de'i phyi nyin gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang dang / dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i ris gnang / mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lung rnams bton te grwa mang la mjal kha btang / de dag gi skabs su bshad pa dang kha ta 640

rgyas par byas/ de'i phyi nyin da ge slong so gnyis/ dge tshulo gcig rab byung ma gnyis/ dge bsnyen bcu rnams la sdom pa phog hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin mi gnyis la dge slong gi sdom pa phog phyi dro grwa rgan bco lnga la dngul chu thogs med kyi gsung gi blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel ba'i steng nas de'i khrid bton/ tshes bcu gnyis nyin grwa ba bcu phrag kha shas la 'dul ba'i bslab pa sde lnga'i khrid bton/ 'di'i skabs paṇa chen rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig brtsams/ tshes bcu bdun nyin la dmu dge nas lam du zhugs te tshes bco brgyad nyin khrin tu'u ru 'byor/ tshes bcu dgu nyin snga dro gra sgrig tshogs 'du la zhugs/ tshes nyi shu(spyi lo 1990zla3tshes16) nyin snga dro gnam gru la zhugs te pe cin du 'byor nas 7skyabs mgon 'jam bzhad rin po che dang khri gung thang rin po che rnam gnyis la mjal/ a blo tshang yang phebs 'dug pas mjal/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin rgyal yongs srid gros skabs bdun pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i tshogs chen la zhugs/ phyi nyin snga dro sman khang du song nas mig bstan/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen skabs bdun pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum par zur zhugs byas/64/

tshochas nyir lnga nyin yang mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogayochen la zhugs/ tshes nyer dgu nyin phyi dro mdza' gcugs tshong khang du lta skor la song / hor zla gsuyopa'i tshes gcig(spyi 'o/1990zla3tshes27) gi dgong mo mi dam ngas tshogs khang chen mo'i thog khang du mi rigs grangs nyung gi u yon dang 'thus mi rnams la ja tshogs kyi dga' ston drangs pa'i gras su zhugs/ de'i phyi nyin 'thus mi'i tshogs chen la zur zhugs byas/ phyi dro krung dbyangs mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i nang gi bod yig sde khag la bod kyi lo rgyus sogs kyi bshad pa rgyas tsam byas/ 'di skabasartsosu chab mdo dgon gyi a lags rgya nag pa tshang gis chab mdo dgon la dbang bka' chos mang bo zhig dgos pas nyid ci nas kyang gcig phebs dgos zhes yang yang zhus par/ de lugs gyi skyabs mgon rin po che dang khri gung thang ba rnam gnyis la zhus pas phebs na shin tu legs zhes bka' gnang khrol bas bdag gis kyang yong rgyu khas blangs/ de'i phyi nyin gros tshogs kyi mjug bsdus/ dgong mo kha shas la 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung bton/ tshes bzhi nyin bod brgyudatshunang bstan gros tshogs su zhugs te snga dro gyi 'jam bzhad rin po ches gros tshogs kyi gtso 'dzin mdzad/ gung thang rin po ches gsung bshad 'gangs can mang bo gnang / de'i 64lha

'phror bdab/ gis kyang gtam zhig bshad/ phyi dro a lags 'jayo pos kyang gtam rgyas pa zhig bshad/ de'i phyi nyin gung tha nga rin —po ches gros tshogs kyi gtso 'dzin gnang / phyi dro bdag tshogs 'dur zhugs ma thub par gnam gru la bsdad dekhrin tu'u ru 'byor /tshes bdun (spyi lo1990zla4tshes2) nyin pham du zhugs te khro chu rdzong du bsdad/ de'i phyi nyin dmu dger 'byor/ de'i phyi nyin dpe cha sogs gra sgrig byas/ tshes bcu nyin lam du zhugs te lis rdzong shu bsdad/ bod yig0par khang gis sne len byas shing de'i phyi nyin bstan 'gyur zhu dag byed mkhan gyi dge 'dun pa zhe lnga la mjal 'a phrad byas te dgong yo'abarokhams su 'byor/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco brgyad (spyi lo19 90zla4tshes13) nyin gyi snga dro rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul srid gros skabs brgyad pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'go 'dzugs kyi tshogs 'dur zhugs/ ri tshes nyi shu nyin gyi phyi dro rnga ba khul mi da.oṃngs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen skabs drug pa'i gros tshogs 9 thengs gsum par zur zhugs byas/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin stidzisnga dro mi rigs mthun sgril skor gyi tshogs chen skabs gtaspobashad byas/ tshes nyerogasum nyin gyi phyi dro rnga ba khul gzugs mthong glog 'phrul nang du gtam bshad/ tshes nyer bzhi stin bod sman khang 'dzugs rgyu'i 643

don du gros tshogs 'tshogs nas de'icidon du gtam bshad/ tshes nyer lnga nyin srid gros tshogs 'du mjug bsdus/ tshes nyer drug nyin khul mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen mjug bsdu ba'i tshogs chen la zhugs/ 'di skabs chab mdo dgon gzhung gis tshab byas te rdzong nang sprul sku byams pa mkhas grub tshang dang rta dbang gnyis kyis dngos skyes du ma dang bcas khyed chab mdo dgon du phebs rgyu'i gdan 'dren par yong ba yin zer bas/ bdag gis yong rgyu'i dus tshod sogs gsal bar bshad de khong gnyis phyir btang / tshes nyer brgyad nyin saṃ bod shan sbyar par skrun legs par grub pa'i dga' ston du zhugs nas gtam bshad/de'i phyi nyin 'bar khams dge thon slob grwar song nas bshad pa rgyas pa byas/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes gnyis(spyi lo1990zla4tshes26) nyin rnga bar yong / tshes drug nyin grwa ba zhig la mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lung bton/ tshes bdun nyin mtshan nyid dbo/na gyi shes rab thogs med la bde mchog bsnyen chen byed tshul khrid/tshes brgyad nyin jo nang gi grwa —ba kha shas la bstod sprin rgya mtsho/'jigs med dbang bo tshang gi 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs/ lam rim bsdus don rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes dgu nyin sgo mang sgar du song ste dmu dge dgon gyi 'cham 'bag bzo — ne 644

mkhan gyi sgo mang dgon gyi lha bzo rnams la gsol ja drangs/ tshes bcu gcig nyin sgo mang dgon gyi 'du khang gsar ba rtsig bzo byed bzhin pa'i las gnas dang / gzhan yang bzhengs grub pa'i dam cam/ lha khang dang / gnas chung lha khang sogs su rab gnas dang shis brjod byas/ phyi dro grwa tshang yongs la sdom gsum bslab bya khrid pa'i 'go brtsams/ phyug tshang gi sku bstod gsol 'debs shig sngar bdag gis brtsams pa de'i lung bton/ tshes bcu gsum nyin gyi phyi dro so thar sdom pa'i mjug grub ste byang sems sdom pa'i 'gor bzhag phyi dro sprul sku bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi shag tu spor te zhag gnyis la bsdad/ tshes bco lnga nyin tsho drug smyung gnas pa stong lhag la dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ ma ṇi/ a ra pa tsa na/ phyag rdor gyi bsnyen pa/ rta mgrin bsnyen pa/ nā ga rasnya'i bsnyen pa sogs kyi lung dang / sgyung gnas kyi phan yon sogs kyi bshad pa byas/de'i phyi nyin gyi zhogs par khyim pa nyis brgya lhag la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa phog phyi dro rdzong thog tu yong / tshes bcu dgu'i nyin bswe dkon gyi grwa ba gnyis la yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i lung bton/ tshes nyer gcig nyin gyi snga dro 'bar kha mas nas bsu ma thon pas lam du chas te phyi dro 'bar khams su ri 645 —

'byor/ tshes nyer drug nyin si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i ho hru'u ci dang kho krang rig 'dzin rnam rgyal gnyis gdan 'dren du 'byor/ tshes nyer brgyad nyin khul srid gros kyi srid 'dzin kho krang rgya mtshos bskyal te ar+sha lags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan /mchod dpon shes rab rgya mtsho/ bslab gsum rgya mtsho dang nged cag srid gros khang gi rlangs 'khor chung ba zhig la bsdad/ gdan 'dren pa gnyis dang rgya mtsho rnasas rlangs 'khor chung ba gzhan zhig la bsdad nas thugs rje chen po'i chu brgyud/ 'dzam thang nas 'ongs pa'i chu g.yas phyogs su bskyur te/ rgya mi nags las pa yod sa'i lung chung brgyud de g.yu khog tu slebs/ sa de ni dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa yin 'dug g.yu khog ni ri stod nags tshal yin la ri smad spang ljongs su 'dug pas ha cang sa cha skyid po zhig red/ der g.yu mkhar dgon zhes pa'i rnying ma'i dgon pa zhig 'dug de nas la brgal bas rta'u rdzong gi grong rdal 'dug der nya mtsho dgon zhes pa hor chos rje ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis phyag 'debs mdzad pa yin zer/ rgyun du grwa ba brgya lhag las mi 'dug de'i nye 'dabs su zhing chen bod yig slob grwa yod pas de nas nyin bco lnga'i ring la snga dro dus tshod gnyis gnyis la blo gsal rig sgo khrid khul byas/ gtso 646

chir kha —ta bslab bya mang bo byas pa yin/ a lags bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang shes rab gnyis kyis kyang dpe khrid byas/ 'ga' zhig la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog cing / kha shas cil gung thang tshang gi slob gnyer bslab bya'i lung bton/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gcig nyin chab mdo dgon gyi 'phrin las chos 'phel dang rnam rgyal gnyis bsu bar thon/ tshes bcu gnyis nyin gyi snga dro dge slob yongs dang mnyam du par mang bo brgyab pa dang / phyi dro bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs / dar zhig byin pa'i ngos la/ latshi dang bod yig shan sbyar du/ pasil ldan gangs kyi ra ba na/ /lnga phrag zung gi rig pa'i gnas/ /yongs su mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bdag po nyid las gzhan na su/ /zhes bris 'dug dgong mo sman pa 'od zer gyis khong tsho'i dgon gyi sprul sku zhig khrid byung nas chos 'brel zhus pas gang blo ma dang / bstod pa don zab ma/ chu 'dzin dkar bo ma rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes bcu gsum nyin slob grwa'i rlangs 'khor chung ba gcig dang kho krang gzhon pa byang dga'i skyel ma dang / chab dgon byams pa gling gi bsu bar yong ba'i rlangs 'khor chungathub gnyis kyis bsu skyel dang bcas lam du zhugs te— brag mgo dgon du 'byor bas de ga'i mkhan pho blo bzang don — 647

cirgyub kyis gtso byas grwa tshang yongs kyi 'er 'phreng dang rgya gling gdugs dar sogs bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas/ khri la bsdad de maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten dang dngos 'bul gyi gtsos kun gyis re ba bzhin mjal kha btang / steng 'og gi rten dang brten par mchod mjal rgyas pa byas rjes gsol ston drangs/ der grwa ba lnga brgyar ma longs tsam bzhugs zer/ de nas grwa tshang yongs kyis skyel ma dang bcas lam du zhugs te phyi dro si khron zhing chen bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling gis bos pa ltar der 'byor bas rgya gling ser 'phreng bcas bsu ba byas/ gsung bshad dang chos 'brel zhig dgos zhus par brten bslab bya mang bo dang yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i lung bton/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku li ma zhig bcas phul/ de nas yang gsol ston drangs pa rol te dgong mo dkar mdzes grong rdal gyi sne len khang du bsdad/ phyi nyin snga mor dkar mdzes dgon par mjal bar song bas sprul sku skyabs mgon tshang gis gtsos las sne rnams kyis rgya gling spos sna bcas 'du khang steng du gsol tshigs drangs te 'phros mol rgyas pa byas/ steng 'og gi sku gsung thugs rten dang / chos grwa'i rtsod gral sogs la zhib mjil byas/ skyabs mgon dang mkhan po gnyis kyis rjes sor khyed dgon 'dir phebs nas ma mtha' zla sgo4byi

gcig yin kyang ba zhugs/ dpe khrid zhig gnang rgyu bka' drin skyong rogs gsungs/ de nas lam du zhugs te sde dge rdzong gi sa khongs ma ṇi ka mgor 'byor bas de nas nyin gung gi zas zos/de nas yid lhung mtsho 'gram brgyud khro la ring mo brgal te phyi dro sde dge rdzong du 'byor bas nub der sne len khang du bsdad/ sprul sku karma seng ge dang thub bstan tshe ring gnyis kyis sne len gzab rgyas gnang / tshes bco lnga nyin gyi snga dro sde dge par khang chen mo la zhib par mjal zhing / par khang nas dpe cha kha shas blus par yon ma blangs/ phyi dro 'du khang dang bka' bstan gyi dpar la mjal zhing 'du khang nas kho tshos sne len byas/ de nas dges bla zhes pa'i bla ma bgres po dgung lo gya brgyad bzhes pa gsan rgya shin tu che ba zhig yod pa la mjal/ de nas bod sman khang shin tu rgya che ba zhig yod pa de'i nang du song nas sman gyi 'grem ston sogs la bltas/ kho tshos sne len gzab rgyas byas te 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung dgos zer ba bzhin lung bton/ sman sna kha shas gnang ba blangs/ sman 'ga' zhig nyos/ dgong mo karma seng ge dang thub bstan tshe ring gnyis kyis mgron du bos pas der song / nged cag 'khor bcas la bzang spyod kyi dpe mang bo zhig byin/ de'i phyi nyin chab mdo dgon gyi rlangs 'khor gzhan 649

zhig kyang bsu bar 'byor yod pas slob grwa'i rlanges 'khor skyelam dang bcas phyir log rgyu byas te/ nged cag lam du zhugs/ lam bar du khyim tshang gcig gis ja zhus byas pa blangs/ de nas lgoche chung gsum brgal te tho pa yul tshor 'byor bas der bsdad/ tshes bcu bdun nyin stag ma r+shal brgal/ ri zhol du chab mdo dgon gyi jacithab steng du babs/ ja thab khar mkhan po rin po che byams pa chos grags dang / rgya nag sprul sku rin po che/ rdzong nang sprul sku rin po che/ dus 'khor sprul sku rin po che dang las kyi sne mo ba rnams kyis bsu ba byas/ de nas dgon du 'byor te grwa mang gis ser 'phreng rgya gling gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs dang bcas 'dug gnas 'du khang steng du 'byor/ las sne dag slebs te gsung mol rgyas/ nyin shas la ngal gsos/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu dgu nyin snga dro grong ba stong phrag gcig lhag la mjal kha btang / phyi dro grong ba brgya phrag gsum tsam la mjal kha btang /de'i 'phror dgon pa'i las sna mkhan rin po che byams pa chos grags dang / rdzong nang sprul sku/ — rgya nag pa/ dus 'khor sprul sku sogs la gros byaso nas bka' chos kyi skor la dgos mkho sogs bshad bsdur byas/ dgong mo/ rje rin po che'i rnam sger bsdus pa zhig brtsams pa'i mjug bris/ de'i phyi nyin tshe dpag 650

grwa tshang darok+ṣiṃnag pa sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul nas tshe dpag med lha dgu 'i dbang zhus/—— grong ba brgya phrag kha shas la mjal kha btang / de rjes dge bshes yu lha dang rta mgrin gnyis kyis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum phul/ phyi dro grong ba chig stong lhag la mjal kha btang / tshes nyer gciganyin gyi snga dro grong ba brgya phrag kha shas la mjal kha btang / de nas chos grwa la song nas 'dzin grwa thams cad la mjal zhing / 'dzin grwa 'ga' re'i nang du rtags gsal 'ga' re btang / de nas kun dga' ra ba dang /thos bsam gling gi 'du khang / tshogs chen 'du khang bcas la zhib mjal byas/ yang grong ba rnams la mjal kha btang / tshes nyer gnyis nyin gyi snga phyi dro gnyis kar mjal kha ba tang / tshes nyer gsum nyin gyi snga dro sngar bzhin mjal kha btang / phyi dro mkhan po sogs sprul sku dang las sna rnams kyis spos sna dang rgya gling btang zhing / 'du khang nang du song nas grwa ba stong phrag lhag dang grong ba bcas la lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid bton/tshes nyer bzhi nyin gyi snga dro dkon rdor sprul sku rin po che 'khor bcas la mjala'aphrad byas/ phyi dro gdugs dkar dbang gi sta gon bton/ de'i 'phror grong ba stong phrag kha shas la mjal kha btang / tshes nyer lnga nyin gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i 651

dbang byad grol dang legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang bcas bton/ grong ba stong phrag kha shas la mjal kha btang /tshes nyer drug la tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang bton/ mjug tu rgya nag pa rin po tshe'i gtsos tshe dpag grwa tshang gis maṇ+ḍal rten —gsum 'bul ba bcas blangs/ grong ba rnams la mjal kha btang / tshes nyer bdun la snga dro khyim pa gnyis la tshangs spyod dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ grong ba mang bo la mjal kha btang / tshes nyer brgyad la bde mchog lū i pa'i dbang bton/ tshes nyer dgu la snga dro grong ba brgya phrag kha shas la mjal kha btang / phyi dro rdzong nang rin po che'i gtsos rnam grol grwa tshang gis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dngul lor bcas phul te/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang bde mchog ngam rdzong / mi tra lha drug gi rjes gnang rnams zhus/ khom pa yod na 'don rgyu khas blangs/ grong ba mang bo la mjal kha btang / grwa ba dang grong ba kha shas kyis tha ma kha bcad/ tshes sum cu nyin gyi snga dro sngar bzhin mjal kha btang / phyi dro chings su tsug thu'i gsung gi sgrub thabs rin cen 'byung gnas kyi lhan thabs steng nas jo lugs sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo nas bzung / dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bar rjes gnang lnga bton/ shol zla lnga ba'i tshes gcig la snga dro sman 652

khang nang song nas lus la zhib 'jug sman dpyad byas/ phyi dro gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa nas rdor sems ser bo'i bar rjes gnang lnga bton/ tshes gnyis la rdo rje gdan pa gtso 'khor gsum nas bde mchog lhan skyes bar rjes gnang bcu bton/tshes bzhi la nā ro mkha' spyod dang dpyal lugs mkha' spyod gnyis kyi rjes gnang / tshes lnga la me tri mkha' spyod nas phag mo gnam zhabs ma'i bar rjes gnang lnga bton/ tshes drug la phag mo kurma bā gli nas bcu gcig zhal dpal mo'i lugs kyi bar rjes gnang dgu bton/ tshes bdun la don zhags lha lnga ba ri'i lugs nas/spyan ras gzigasga rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bar rjes gnang bcu gsum bton/ tshes brgyad la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi sgrol ma nas tsun+da tā re'i bar rjes gnang bcu bzhi bton/ tshes dgu la ngal gso byas/ tshes bcu la phyag rdor u tsar+ya nas phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gsar ma'i bar rjes gnang bcu bton/ tshes bcu gcig la rta mgrin dpa' cig jo bo'i lugs nas rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi bar rjes gnang drug bton/ tshes bcu gnyis la mi g.yo ba sngon po bus btsugs ma nas tshe dpag med dkar bo mi tra'i lugs kyi bar rjes gnang bcu bton/ tshes bcu gsum la gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu nas 'jam dkar sher rab 'khor 653

gle'i bar rjes gnang bdun bton/ tshes bcu bzhi la rje bcun byems pa ni ri ti ba'i lugs nas dam tshig gsum bkod gtso rkyeng bar rjes gnang bcu bton/ tshes bco lnga la snga dro a lags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis ngayoblortsams pa'i 7 bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar yi ge dbu can gaphab zin nas/ daphe phul te lung zhus/ phyi dro ku ru ku l+le gsang skrub nas gsang 'dus nas byung ba'i khro bo bgegs mthar byed bar rjes gnang bcu bton/ tshes bcu drug la sna tshogs yum dkar mo nas khro mo sme brtsegs nag mo'i bar rjes gnang bcu gnyis bton/ tshes bcu bdun la bde mchog khro bo reg tshig nas nā ga ragla'i bar rjes gnang bcu bton/ tshes bco brgyad la sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun nas spyan ras gzigs don yod mchod pa'i nor bu'i bar rjes gnang bcu gsurim bton/ tshes bcu dgu la gsang ba'i bdag po lhan skyes nas tshogs bdagatreser bo'irtsobar rjes gnang bcu gsum bton nas rin 'byung nang gi tā ra nā tha'i gsung gi rigs gsum mgon po'i cho ga'i lung 'don pa phyag len ltar byas/ tshes nyi shu la rtsa ba'i sgrol ma ljang khu nas yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i bar rjes gnang bco lnga bton/ de'i nyin bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas 'du khang bskyar bzhengs grub pa'i dga' ston du 654

gdan 'dron pa thos pa dga' dang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gasnyis 'byor/ kun mkhyen 'dra sku li ma dang rten sna du ma bskur 'dugatshes nyer gcig la sgrol ma khro gnyer g.yo ba ma nas rnam sras yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi ba'i bar rjes gnang nyer gcig bton /tshes nyer gnyis la ngal gsos/ tshes nyer gsum la dzasnya la ser bo gtso rkyang nas dzasto la ljang khu dus 'khor lugs bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/ tshes nyer bzhi la gnod sbyin nor bu bzang bo nas yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma'i bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/ tshes nyer lnga la gnod sbyin zhang blon bdud 'dul nas khol bo kurnyi li'i bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/ tshes nyer drug la grong ba med par grwa ba dge 'dun pa rnams la mgon po bar chad kun sel nas mgon po phyag bzhi ba grub zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs bar rjes gnang drug bton/ tshes nyer bdun la mgon po phyag bzhi ba klu sgrub lugs nas gur mgon lcam dral bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/ tshes nyer brgyad la gur mgon lha brgyad ma nas mgon po legs ldan mched gsum bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/ tshes nyer dgu la mgon po i gho ra nas mgon po gri gug lha dgu dz+nyā na'i lugs bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la mgon po ber nag zangs gri can nas 655

mgon po trasnyad rkang thang ma'i bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/tshes gnyis la mgon po trak+ṣad ma ning ma nas mgon po zhal bzhi ba dkar bo tshe 'phel bar rjes gnang bdun bton/ tshes gsum la zhal bzhi ba ser bo nor 'phel nas lha mo srog sgrub lcags phur ma'i bar rjes gnang brgyad bton/ tshes bzhi la lha mo rdeng skyong ma nas dur khrod bdag po lcam dral gyi bar rjes gnang bcu gcig bton/ tshes lnga la ngal gsos/ tshes drug la sgrol ma brgyad pa rab tu rgyas pa'i sgrol ma dang / pu tra lcam dral nas tshe ring mched lnga'i bar rjes gnang bdun bton nas sgrub thabs rin 'byung las gsungs pa'i yi dam rnams kyi rjes gnang bka' rgya ma bzhi ma gtogs yongs rdzogs bton/ zla ba gcig dang nyin drug 'gor/ tshes bdun la ngal gsos/ tshes brgyad la jo khang nang nas bla sprul dang dge 'dun pa bcas sgrub bya nyer lnga la/ bka' rgya ma/ rig byed ma thun mong ma yin pa dang / khro bo mi g.yo ba dkar bo thun mong ma yin pa/ seng gdong ma dmar mo thun mong ma yin pa/ dmag zor rgyal mo thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi rjes gnang rnams bton/ tshes dgu la snga dro dge bsnyen gcig bsgrubs/ phyi dro mngacatshogs la rigs gsum gcig sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang rin 'byung brgya rtsa'i dam 656

bca' 'chag mid 'don tshul gyi lung / mardzug tu tshogs 'khor rgyas par skor/ tshes bcu la ngal gsos/ tshes bcu gcig la mang tshogs la pradz+nyā'i khrid yig steng nas ljags byin rlabs kyi khrid dang sgrub thabs rin 'byung dbu nas shog grangs brgya dang bco brgyad bton/ tshes bcu gnyis la pradz+nyā'i khrid yig steng nas thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid phyed tsam dang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung shog grangs brgya dang so gnyis bton/ tshes bcu gsum la thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'phro dang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung shog grangs brgya dang gsum bton/ tshes bcu bzhi lasapragle'i khrid yig steng nas dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i khrid dang / lung shog grangs brgya dang gsum bton/ tshes bco lnga la pradz+nyā'i khrid yig steng nas za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gi khrid dang / lung shog grangs brgya dang nga gsum bton/ tshes bcu drug la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid rgyas pa lung shog grangs nga lnga bton/ bod rtsis kyi bco lnga yin pas dgong mo zla 'dzin yod gshis bdag gi grwa ba gsum la 'jam dbyangs dkar bo 'don du bcug tshes bcu bdun la ngal gsos/ tshes bco brgyad la rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gi sta gon dang / yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid/ byang chub lam sgron gyi lung / rin 'byung lung shog grangs nga lnga bton/657

tshes bcu dgu la thugs sde chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang dang / rin 'byung lung shog grangasartsoso bzhi bton/ rgya nag sprul sku rin po ches gtso byas te sku zhabs grwa tshang gis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'bul ba bcas phug tshes nyi shu la mkhan rin po ches zhus ngor kun rig gi dbang dang / rin 'byurolung shog grangs drug cu bton/ mjug tu mkhan rin po ches maṇ+ḍal rten gsuca/ yon 'bul bcas gnang / tshes nyer gcig la mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang dang / rin 'byung lung sho ga grangs re gcig r+pāton/ tshes nye ra gnyis la sman bla lha nga gcig pa'i da bang / rin 'byung lung shog grangs don gcig bton lung gi mjug rdzogs/ tshesasanyer gsum la rta mgrin gsang sgrub skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang sgrub thabs kyi lung bcas bton/ tshes nyer bzhi la gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dbang bton/ tshes nyer lnga la ngal gsos/ tshes nyer drug dang nyer bdun nyer brgyad nyer dgu rnams la 'a phags pa lha'i skyed tshal du song nas ngal gso byas shing / zhor la bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / mchod dpon shes rab rgya mtsho/ dbon bslab gsum rgya mtsho gsum la/ rang rtsom gyi bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar gyi lung dang / blo gsal 'jug ngogs kyi phyed tsam gyi lung bton/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la 658

slar dgon tho ga tu slebs/ tshes gnyis la bde mchog grwa tshang gis bdespachog bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid zhus stabs bla brgyud kha bskang brtsams/ tshes gsum la bla grwa bdun cu lhag la stag phu sgrol ma'i phyi nang gnyis kyi dbang dang / bstod pa gdung 'bod kyi lung bton/ tshes bzhi la dus 'khor sprul sku rin po ches gtsos dus 'khor grwa tshang gis maṇ+ḍal sku gsung thugs rten dang dngul lor 'bor chen bcas dus 'khor dbang chen dang /'grel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad lung bcayozhus/ rjes soro'adon rgyu khas blangs/ phyi dro bla grwa nyer gcig la bde mchog smon spum thog nas bde mchog bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid bton/ sman pas khrag shugs la bltas pas khrag shugs ha cang mtho zer tshes lnga la seng gdong gtso 'khor gsulodang / phyag rdor gtum po khyu nga lnga'i rjes gnang bton/ dgong mo rdzorolung sprul skyarinapo che lha sarabyutshogs 'du la 'argodagos pas mjal du 'ong nas/ smanalabla'i sku rgya ga ra shar li ma dngul lor du ma bcayoganang ba dang / rgya nag rin po ches zhus ngorosmagabla mchog bden ma'i lung bton/ tshes drug la dus 'khor sprul sku rin bo ches zhus ngor 'jam dbyangs dmar ser zhi khro sbrags sgru ba kyi khrid broñca'i khrid yig steng nayobaton/ maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'jam 6bya9

—snedabyangs kun gzigs kyi gser sku/ brag yab bu dgon dge bshes blo bzang nor bu'i gsung 'bum pod dgu dngul lor bcas yon 'bul gnang / rgya nag sprul sku rin po ches maṇ+ḍal rten gsum yon 'bor chen bcas thengs rjes mar bde mchog ngam rdzong dgos zhes zhu gnang mdzad/ tshes bdun la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig gi tshe dbang bton/rgya nag rin po ches yon 'bul sogs gnang / tshes brgyad la blo bskal gyis bla mchod tshogs shig byin/ de'i 'phror 'du khang nang nas bla mchod sgo nas brtan bzhugs mkha' 'gro'i bsil sto bablog dang / tshogs 'khor bcas dang / yon gtos chen phul te/ mkhan rin po che byams pa chos grags tshang nas maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa shin tu legs pa gnang / tshes dgu la ngal gsos/ tshes bcu la lha khang rnams su mchod mjal rgyas pa byas te rigs chung tshogs gleng la mjal/ tshes bcu gcig la ngal gsos/ tshes bcu gnyis nyin grwa mang la mjal kha btang / snga ma'i skabs nged cag gis mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs 'don bzhin mjal kha btang /phyi ma'i skabs byams pa'i dam bca' ba'i gzungs 'don bzhin mjal kha btang /chab mdo dgon chen du 'dug ring la chab mdo'i dge 660

'dun pa rnams dang dgon lag rnams nas phebs pa dang / brapo yab saudagon dang bu dgon gyi grwa ba sogs stong phrag gcig dang 4brgya phrag du yo'adus/ bdag gi bka' chos 'don khul gyi bar la khyim pa shin tu mang bo la mjal ṣa btang / gtsug phud phu4te rab tu 'byung bar khas len pa'i pho mo du ma byung / sgu gsudz+wathugs rten sogs 'bul mkhan du ma byung / bdag gir+sā bka' rtsos kyi skabs satha sakha'i nyes dmigs bshad stabs/ tha ma kha gcod rgyu khas len mkhan grwa ba dang grong ba du ma byung / grong ba chang rag gcod mkhan yang du ma byung / de phyogs kyi mi rnams dad pa lhag par che stabs/ 'brel 'jog gyidangul lor mang du byung ba dang / dgon pas kyang 'bul chen byung bas/ dad rdzas rnams chud zos su gtong mi nyan snyam ste/ dmu dge'i dgon gyi dbyen skum mchod rten 'thor zhig tu 'gro brnan yod pas/de rtsa ba nas gsar bzhengs byed rgyu sems la shar te/ phyir rang yuladu slebs nas sring mo bde mchog skyid la de lugs kyi bkod chab btang / chab mdor 'dug ring la/ mchod dbon shes rab rgya mtsho/ a lags bsam gtan bstan pa'i mtshan gnyis kyis lañcha dang wartu dang yi ge sum rtags sogs grwa — gzhon du ma la khrid spel byas/ mkhan rin po che byams pa chos 66/

grags kyis kyang bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan las dbyangs can sgra ṭīka gi thog nas sgra'i ri mo sbyangs/ khong gis bsam gtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la phar phyin bde na bzhi sogs dpe khrid gnang / tshes bcu gsum la dgon pa'i bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa 'phrin las chos 'phel sogs skyel ma du ma dang bcas lam du zhugs skabs bla grwa dge 'dun pa rnams kyis ser 'phreng bsgrigs nas skyel ma rgya chen po byas/ stag ma la'i la kha nas de ga'i ru ba rnams kyi zho ston drangs/ mardzal kha dang smon lam bkra shis sogs bton nas/yul phyogs spyi la bkra shis lo legs 'byung phyir smon lam btab/lam skabs rnams su lam bzo ba dag bod rigs yin stabs mjal kha zhu mi mang du byung ba'i re 'dod skong bzhin yong / de nas sde dger zhag bab byas te dpe cha kha shas blus/ tshes pacu bzhi la dkar mdzes nas zhag bab byas/ dkar mdzes dgon dang nang bstan slob grwa la sa bod shan sbyar ni nga / lachi'i ma phyi/sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig bshad dang cho ga lo rgyus kun dga'i me long rnams kyi dpe phul/ tshes bco lnga la brag mgor slebs te zhag bab byas/ brag mgo dgon dang / rta'u nya mtsho dgon la yang gong gi dpe cha de rnams phul/ tshes bcu drugari la 'bar khams 66lha

su slebs/ tshes bcu bdun la7 'brel gtug mang tsam byas/tshes bco brgyad la bstan 'gyur gyi dpar byang smon tshig dang /sgrang char thog tu 'jog rgyu'i smon tshig brtsams/ tshes bcu dgu la phan tshun sne len gyi mgron 'bod byas/ tshes nyi shu la dmu dger slebs/ tshes nyer gcig la grwa tshang gi las sne rnams phebs nas 'tshams 'dri gnang / tshes nyer gnyis dang nyer gsum sogs la ngal gsos/ tshes nyer lnga la mdzod sdom 'bru 'grel rtsom pa'i 'go bzung / tshes nyer brgyad la mkhan po dang rdo rams pa 'jog rgyu sogs gros byas/ tshes sum cu nyin ser sde'i grwa ba rnams kyis dgag dbye'i gling kha la bos pa ltar song / hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la rdo rams pa gsum la mdud pa byin/dge bshes bskal bzang tshul khrims tshang mkhan por bzhag ste mdud pa dang kun mkhyen 'jam dpal zhal lung gi zin bris kyi dpe phul/ de nyin a khu bskal bzang zer bas khri ba'i bca' yig bar chad brel zing skabs sbas skong byas pa bdag la byin stabs/ rten 'brel 'grig snyam ste/ las sne rnams la mkhan po gsar bzhag tshang la 'bul du bcug tshes gnyis la a khu chos ldan gyis ngag dbang grags pa'i sku bzhengs rgyu khas len byas par gzungs gzhug tu 'bul rgyu'i paṇa chen gdung tshwa sogs byin/663

tshis bdun la grwa mang yongs la ma ti'i lubasmo kyi 'jam dkar 6 rjeso gnang dang kun mkhyen gsung gi de'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dong bcas pa/ 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi 'jam dkar sgrub dzebs/ za byed mkhi' 'gro'i sbyin skregici dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ rme 7 bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gi rig byed ma 'i cho ga bsdus pa/ bstod pa don ldan ma rnamasabyukyi lung bton/ tshes bcu gcig la a lags gzhi tshang rin po ches gtsor byas pa'i bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang dang mkhan rin po ches gtso byas pa'i bla ma las sne dang grwa rgan kha shas 'dzin grwa bcu gsum gyi skyor dpon rnams dang bcas phebs nas bdag la brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes nyer gcig nas bzung tshes nyer dgu bar zhogs kha'i chos grwa rnams su solda / chos grwa la do dam byas shing rtsod rgyugs blangos/ phyi dro rnams su dpe khrid la 'gror bcug pa sogs 'chad nyan do dam byas/ hor zlo dgu ba'i tshes lnga nas bzung dge 'dun nyi shur dpe khrid byas/ tshes brgyad nas mdzod bsdus 'grel ba tshig don rab gsal gyi gnas dang bo'i 'grel ba brtsams tshar nas/ gnas gnyis pa'i 'go bzung / tshes bco brgyad la nag khra 'brir bcug dge bskul la bkod chab btang ste/ tshes—nyer gsum nyin 'cham rgyug la 664

mkhan rin po che sogs tshang ma phebs dgos/ mgon khang btsan khang so so'i nang du mchod me dmar nag phul/ snyan shal/ drug cu ba nag po/ chos skyong so so'i bskul ba gsung nas zhabs brtan gnad can bsgrub dgos zhes bshad/ tshes nyer gsum nyin shing slong yin kyang / grwa tshang gis zhogs kha 'tshogs nas 'jigs byed gsungs te chos skyong so so'i gtor 'bul gsungs te sgo 'byor du lnga mchod skabs ltar 'tshogs nas 'cham rgyug len zhor la/ drag po'i las bcol tshad ldan byas pa gnad du song ba'i rtags mtshan kyang shar/ tshes nyer bzhi dze+edage 'dun nyi shur khrid tshar/ lnga mchod skabs mdzod bsdus 'grel ba gnas gnyis pa yan chad brtsams tshar/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum nyin grwa ba bcu bdun la mdzod kyi dpe khrid kyi 'go bzung /zla de'i tshes bcu bzhi la gnas gsum pa'i 'grel ba brtsams tshar/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig(spyi lo1991zla1tshes16) nyin mdzod kyi gnas gsum pa'i bar dpe khrid tshar/rang lo don brgyad pa hor zla dang bo'i tshes gcig (spyi lo 1991zla2tshes15) la lo sar dga' ston gyi mjal kha btang /tshes gnyis nas tshes bcu gcig bar 7a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar brtsams/ tshes nyer bzhi la dbyen rlum — 665

mchod ten nang sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig gdab/ ar chog gi snyan gsan phul/ de'i phyi nyichu 66pa chog byas/ tshes nyer bakhyi/ la pe 'in rgyal yongs srirī gros tshodaṣ+ka 'du'i brda tho thon/ tshes nyer brgyadal mkhan rin po cher+sākatsor byas— las kyi sne mo rnams dang spyozu dpon rnamasaci dadz+wabacas yong nas po cinanasadz+ramyur du —rang dgon du phebaṣ+kargyu mkhyen zer sgor brgya byin/ hor rla gnyi sa pa'i tshes gnyis 4 mgar ba sbru la skya sogs kha shas 4 dam can mgar nag gi srog gtad bton/ — phyi dro ser sde'i grwa r+pā rnams yongaka tshesangagasum—(spyi lo1 991rla3tshes18) nyin— rlang5 'khor la— zhugs nas— wis kru'u la slebs/ de'i phyi nyinakhrin tu'u ru slebs nas zhing chen srid gros kyi sne len khang du bsnad/— tshes lnga la cinadzica—nga ྾gron khang du sbos te 'byer tho bkod /tsho de'i phyi nyiṣ+ka lde dro gnam grur bsgrud nas pe cin —duk+shibs/ ci phyi dro 4 rin po che dang gung thang rin po che rnam gnyis la mjal nas gsung 'phros rgyas pa gnang / tshes bdun nyin snga droci a la khardzo'ajam po dang a khu bsardzo'agrub gnyis la mjal 'phra da dang / phyi dro nang bstan slob grwa'i 'go— khricid pa kha shas yong / slob ma —drug la gang blo ma dang / chu 'dzin dkar bo ma'i lugabaton/ de'—phyi nyin (spyi lo1 991bla3tshes23) rgyulko yongs srid gros skabs 6〈khu〉

ribadun pa'i—gros tshogs thengs bzhi ba'i yar tshogs la zhugs/ de nago bzung hor zla gnyis/ pa'i tshes nyi shu (spyi lo1 991zla4tshes 4)bar corgyal yongayosrid gros dang / mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen gnyis kyi tshogs 'du che chung la zhugs/ de'i ska bas gyi ri na po che dang / gung thang rin po che rnam gnyis la mthalari 'phrad thengasahokha shas zhus te/ gsungasasna'aphros du ma gnang / chab mdo'i a lags rgya nag pa rin po che phebs na sa dngos skyes —lha dar bcas chab mdor slar yang yong dgos pa'i bskul ma gnang / a lag sa nags gtsang rin po che gtsos bod brgyud nang bstan mtho rim slob grwa'i 'go khrid pa slebs nas/ gangs can rig pa'i sgo 'byed ces pa'i dpe deb bcu bzhi gnang / horotshang 'jigs med kyi sanga.a tsogs 'jagapo brgyud nas zhus ngor rtsom zhi gabris/ slob gab kha shas la yon tan gzhir gyur ma/gang blo ma/ chu 'dzin dkar bo ma rnams kyi lung bton/ krung go gnam 'grul kung si'i gzhung las khang gi drung yig chen mo yong nasachos kyi skor gyi dri ba mngadzhabo byas shing khos— chos sgrub kyin yodasgru pa'i— lo rgyus mang bowāshad/ bod brgyud nang bstan mthunatsho tshogs kyi tshogs 'du zhig gi brda thon kyang dgongs pa zhus te/ tshes nyer gcig la gnam grur zhugayote khrin tu'u ru 'byor/ rnga pa khul 667

srid gros tshogs 'du'i brda tho 'byor yang dgongs pacizhus/ tshesacinyer gnyis la bkra shis tshe ring sogs kyis rogs byas te zhi nga chen mi dmangs sman khang du song nas/ sman pa kun dga' la rdo rdzitshe brtan gyi bcol dam ngo sbyor yi ge sprad de mig sogs la zhib 'jug byas/ tshes nyer bzhi la yang 'bum skyabs kyis rogs byas te sman khang du song nas zhib 'jug byas/ de'i phyi nyin srid gros kyi ngo sbyor yi ge bris/ tshes nyer drug la sman khang du bsdad/bsod nams bkra shis kyang 'byor/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la mngal chab kyi nad bco dgos zer nas/ mtho rim las byed pa'i nad khang nang du sgos/ de'i sman khang nang nas zhib 'jug ches mang bo byas/ zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs las khungs du ma zhig blta 'drir yong / bla brang dang dmu dge stag tsha dgon rnams kyi 'tshams zhu— ba yang 'byor/bka' bstan dpe bsdur cu'u yi blo 'dri la bzhag yang gling rdo rje dang bkra shis tshe ring sogs yang dang yang du yong / de'i skabs rnam 'phel rig pa'i tshigs bcad dang / rgan po'i snying gtam zer ba dang / si khron bod rigs kyi ngang tshul zer ba yang brtsams/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer dgu nyin mig gshag bcos byed grwab byas kyang bzi khab rgyug skabs khrag byung nas khyo6byi

gshag bcos byed ma thub/ de nas re dogs mang bo skyes na sa/lha mo'i sho mo kha shas 'phangs pa/ bcu gsum dang dgu sha smrag bab/ 'on kyang rmi lam gsal bo re e thon re ba byas/ nub cig nam langs khar gnyid ma sad kyi ngang la/ mi zhig gis yang la zhig sgron nas nga la byin pas/ ngas nyal gur gyi ras 'tshig rgyur dogs nas mdun 'jog thog 'jog dgos bsam pa rmis/ yang dmur dgon gyi dge bskul dang mnyam du dpe cha zhig zhu dag byed kyin 'dug pa mig gis gsal bor mthong ba rmis/ yang 'ga' zhig la dpe khrid byed pa la/ dpe de nyid rgyug bris chung chung zhig yin kyang mthong ba sogs rmis pas/ gshag bcos 'grub rgyu red snyam/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer bdun la krang yan krang gis mig gshag bcos byas/ bde legs ngang 'grub pa byung / de'i rjes so gnyis btsugs/ shel mig bzos/ shel mig gyon pas mig gis gsal bar mthong ba byung / hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin khrin tu'u nas lis rdzong du 'byor/ de'i phyi nyin 'bar khams su 'byor/ 'bar khams su yod skabs yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa dkar 'don byung ba'i yig lan 'byor/ shin tu dga' ba byung / hor zla bdun pa'i tshes lnga la shel mig bzos pa legs 'phrod snyong / 'bar khams su zla ba 669 cho

gcig dang nyin nyi shu yir mar shwe sdad/ de'i ring la yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi rnamā thar dang / gnam rtsed lding ma/rgyung chub gzhung lam/ rtsa ltung rnam bshad/ lam rim zin bris sogs la dpe bltas byas/ yongs 'dzin thanes cad mkhyen pa'i skya bstod brtsams/ hor zla blorgyad pa'i tsheso bdun nyin dmugidage dgon du 'byor/ tshes dgu nyin grwa tshang longs la yon tan gzhir gyur ma'i khrid bton/ tshes bcu la dbu ma 'jug pa'i lung dang bslab ston kha ta byas/ tshes bcu gcig la ljags byin rlabs dang thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid/ sdom gsudzobaslab bya'i khrid kyi mgo bzung / tshes bcu gnyis nyin sdom gsum bslab bya'i khrid/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin khyung nag me'i spu gri'i rjes gnang bton/ tshes bco lnga la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bton/ grong ba yang mang bo slebs/ smon lam sde lnga/gsang 'dus smon la ma/ ltung bshags/ tshosbyi bshags/ bstan 'bar ma/ rgyal ba ma lus ma rnams kyi lung brton/ tshespob cu drug nyin slob ma sum cu tsam la gtor ma brgya rtsa'i phyaskakhrid byas/ tshes nyer bdun la mdzod sdo/ma 'asau 'grel gnas lnga ba brtsams tshar ba byas/ tshes nyer brgyad nas hor zla dgu ba'i tshes gnyis bar la rgya dge dgon gyi gdan rabs brtsams tshes 610

sum cu dang / hor zla dgu b.litshes gcig la grwa79dul sdobhā gsum bslab bya 'i mjugakhrid/ tshes gnyi sa la rdorje sems dpa'i sgo ma bzlas kyi khrid dang / blo gsawo'ajug ngogs kyi ba zhi ba dgos ched bar gyi lung bton/ de nas gin kha shas la rdzidro tsha bu bslab gsum rgya mtshos nged rdzilo rgyu sa kyi sa bon rgyas b.rabri spoyod pa mdor bsdus te deb thog tu phab/ gan ga'i sdom 'grel rtsom rgyu'i 'gotsa.ā+oṃr+pāzung / hor rdzabacu ba'i mastodadu mdzod sdom 'grel ba'i mjug grub nas sgongs rdzogasatshar/ de nas nyin shas 'arijamadarka ra sogs kyi cho ga kha shas brtsams/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes lnga gyin nas grwa ba kha shaspulasnyan ngagadziyang gsadzisnang mdzod khrid pa'i dashu bzung / tshes bcu drug nyin snga dro las sne dang dge rgan 'brelīyod kyi sab rnams bsdus nas mgon po'i gtor /sgrub kyinaskor la dag ther bgyis te/ rtsod pa cad pa 'ga' zhig thag gcod byas/ tshes ba cu bdun la grwa ba mang bo zhi/ga la lam gyigatso bo rnam gsum gyihād bton zhingaka lta ba'i skabs shang ston bstanawā rgyaspatsho'i gsung gi dgongs gasnye rab gsalakhya zin bris lta mgur bragacha'i sgra dbyangs kyi khrid —spyag len ltar btonaci/ rang brtsam+mes 'jam dpa la gyi rto gas d+kugalas byung ba'i ngag gi rgyal bo gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs /67 1

'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sgrun+de thabs/ 'jam dpal seṅge gdan can dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs/ sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum las byung ba'i 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal smra seng gi sgrub thabs/ —yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bo'i sku bstod rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes bco brgyad nyin nas mdzod kyi khrid 'phro gnas bzhi ba nas khrid rgyu'i 'go bzung / tshes sum cu (spyi lo1992zla1tshes4) nyin mdzod kyi gnas bzhi ba khrid tshar nas mtshams bzhag snyan ngag kyang khrid mtshams bzhag phyag chen brgyud 'debs kha skong brtsams/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas tshes gsum gyi bar mang mang la bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i phyag chen gyi khrid bton/ tshes brgyad nyin bla ma las sde dang dgon pa bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi mi sna/ 'dzin grwa bcu gsum gyi skyor dpon bcas bsdus nas/ blo rig phar phyin rab 'byams pa bcas kyi ston mo byas mi chog pa sogs 'grig lam skor gyi don tshan dgu gros 'cham byas shing / gros 'cham legs par byung nas thag bcad/ 'di'i skabs snga phyir nyams len cung zad legs par byung snyam/ 672

rang lo don dgu'i thog hor zla dang bo'i tshes gcig (spyi lo slo1992zla2tshes4) la slob ma rnams la mjal kha btang / phyi dro gzhi tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po ches gtsos mkhan po sogs las sne sogs dang / dgon pa bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi mi sna/'dzin grwa bcu gsum gyi— skyor dpon sogs phebs nas brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes gnyis la grwa ba bcu phrag kha shas la skyabs khrid brton/ tshes gsum/ bzhi/ lnga/ drug rnams la snyan ngag yang gsal snang mdzod kyi le'u garmum pa'i 'phro nas khrid de gsum pa'i mjug rdzogs/ tshes bcu bdun nyin rgya mgar thar ba la dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ tshes nyer brgyad nyin zangs dkar nas bsnyen rdzogs zhu mkhan grwa ba bcu dgu dang / brag ra nas grwa ba gnyis bcas slebs/ tsho de'i phyi nyin brag ra nas grwa ba gsum bcas bsnyen rdzogs zhu mkhan grwa ba nyer bzhi slebs/ de'i nyin sgo mang sgar gyi 'tshams zhu ba gnyis 'byor/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la snga dro khang dmar gyi 'tshwams zhu ba la mjal 'phrad byas/ de'i 'phror lha khang gong ma nas bsgrub bya nga gsum la bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul gnyes bcas/ kyi sdom pa phogatshes bzhi nyin chos grwar song nas blta rtog dang / kun bzang 'khor lo 'bri rgyur bkod chab btang / de'i sngar snyan ngag khrid 673

skab sa/ tshul khrims/ rab rgyag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab gsum gyis kun bzang 'khor lo'i dpe brjod cung zad/ yag po bris pas/ de dag sgo 'byor du 'khrir bcug honetsā rīganyis pa'i tshes bcu gci ga (sbyi lo1992zla3tshes14) la rlangs 'khoraspyochung bar bsnad nes wisatwa'u grong rdal du slebs/ minyin khrin tu'u ru slebs te cin cang mgron khang du 'byor tho bkod/ phyi dro gra sgrig tshogs 'dur zhugs/ tshes bcu gsum nyin gnam grur zhugs nas pe ci na du 'byor te mdza' gcugs mgron khang du bab/ de'i phyi nyin 7 rin po che dang khri gung thang rin po che rnam gnyis la mjal 'phrad zhus de'i phyi nyin tshes bcu bzhi (spyi lo1992zla3tshes18) largyal yongs srid gros ska bas bdun pa'i gros tsogs thengs lnga bar zhugs/ de nas nyin shas tshogs chung du zhugs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1992zla3tshes20) nyin rgya la yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chenaskabs bdun pa'i grospotshogs thengayolnga bar zur zhugs byas/ nyin shas la tshogs chung du zhugabaka de skabs sman pa bstan khos dri ba kha shas dang / lam sgron 'gre95 ba dang lam rim rtsom skul zhus/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshesanyer drug (spyi lo1992zla3tshes29) nyin khrin tu'u ru slebs te srid 67lho
