thoba'isne len snakhang du bsdad/ cho de'i phyi nyin phu phrug gis rogs byas nas sman khang du song nas mig la zhib 'jug byas/ mig g.yas pa sdo lor gshag bcos byas zin/ g.yon pa da rung ma smin 'dug zer bas gshag bcos byed rgyu bshol/ thag ring 'osalta byed kyi she 'khamig cig brozos/ nyin gsum la ngal gsos/ phebs byams lcags 'a khor zhi gtakyang nyos/ hor tshozla gsum pa'i tshotshes gcig (spyi lo1992zla4 tshes3) nyin mong shan du 'khyor/ byi nyin dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon gyi rang shag tu 'byor/ grwa tshang gi las sne sogs 'tshams 'drir phebs/ —de 'i phyi nyin dbang cha sogs gra sgrig—byas te/ — tshes bzhi nyin wis kru'u la slebs/ tshes lnga la 'bar khams su slebs/ tshotshes brgyad nyin khang dmar dgon du song nas de nyin 'jigasabād — dpa' cig dbang gi sta gon byas/ de'i gyi nyin dpa'— cig gi dbang dang dam can ra bzhon gyi srogadzigatad bton/ de'i phyi nyin gsang 'duyomi bskyod pa'i dbang dang mgon bo phyag /drug pa'i —rjes ga nang / de'i phyi nyin bde mchogalca i ba'i dbang dang /dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang / de'i phyi nyin mi 'khrugs dzilha dgu'i dbang dang / thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i rjes gnang / kun mkhyen gsung gtor ma brgya rtsa'i lung / shes 6 75

bya'i mkha' dbyings ma'i lung bton/ de'i phyi nyin tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang / mjam dbyangs dam ra ser gyi rjes gnang / grwa tshang dang grong ba rnams la 'jal kha btang / de'i phyi nyin gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang byad grol dang bcas pa/ legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang bcas bton te/ grwa tshang gis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum bshad pa dang bcas 'bul chen btegs//hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi (spyi lo 1992 zla4tshes 16 )la 'bar khams su phyir slebs/ cham pa byung stabs de'i phyi nyin nas nyin bzhir chin me su'u yi ga nam khab nyen bzhi la brgyab/ tshes bcu dgu rmonyin dpe char lta byed kyi shel mig cig bzos/ tshes nyer bzhi la stag tsha dgon gyi 'tshams zhu ba 'byor/tshes nyer lngar lam du chas te mong shan du bsdad/ tshes nyer drug nyin rang dgon du 'byor/ tshes nyer brgyad nas dus 'khor sa chog gi dbu bzung / tshes sum cu nyin nas 'jam dpal dgongs rgyan 'chag med byas/ hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes dgur bum pa bkod/ tshes bcu nyin bdag 'jug blangs/ tshes bcu gcig la sta gon byas/ tshes bcu gnyis la byis pa ltarā 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ tshes/ bcu gsum nyin gong ca/ gong chen/tshes bcu bzhi nyin rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang 676 tho

mjug tu tshogs 'khor dang / khri rin po ches maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa phun sum tshogs pa gnang ba dang chabs cig dgon grong kun gyis 'bul ba rten gsum gyis sna drangs te 'bul chen btegs/ de 'phral grwa mang dang mang tshogs khri phrag gcig lhag la mjal kha btang / 'di'i nyin ni bod rtsis kyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga yin pas dus 'khor dang sher mdo gsung ba'i dus chen dang 'grig pa byas/ 'di'i skabs mchod dpon dang sa chog pa rnams khang dmar dgon nas gdan drangs/ rus rgyan sogs bca' lag yo byad thams cad khang dmar nas g.yar/ dgon grong kun gyis theg pa khur blangs kyi gra sgrig yag po byung / rdzong dang shog kha dang yul tsho'i las khungs kyi las byed pa rnams kyis rgyab skyor bla na med pa gnang / mi khri phrag lhag 'dus kyang 'khon 'dzing dang kha shags 'gyed pa tsam yang ma byung bar 'jam thing gis chos legs par nyan/ gnam gshis kyang shin tu legs pa sogs dkar phyogs pa'i lha rnams dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mngon/mdor na shin tu legs po byung bas skya ser kun yid tshim pa byurdza ngo ri'adi'i skabs su spyi bshad dang da bang bshad gtso bor byas/dge 'dun pa rnams la sdom gsugoligs par srung dgos tshul bla 677

med spyi dang / dus 'khor gyi rtsa ltung dang dam tshig sogs kyi bshad pa dang / spyir sdig pa'i nyes dmigs dang / gtso bor dge ba'i pan yon bshad/ bshad skabs yig thog nas bshad pa min par/ yul skad kyis daṣ+pe dang bcas— bshad/ sgra cher ga/tong chas kha shasabatsugs yod se shin tu bzang bas/ nyan mkhan khri phrag lhag yod kyang gling gi rmatha' dbus kun tu gsal bor go thub pas/ skya ser kun dge bskyal yid 'khul ba byung zhes kun yid tshim 'dug bdag la'ang 'bul ba sogs la re ba ci yang med pa ra/ thams cadabyul thar ba'i sa bon re e zhog bsan nas bla ma la gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nasacigralha ga nasacebazu nga 'a go mjug kun la shin tu legs pa byung ngo / /hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco brgyad nyin tsha bu mgon po tshe ring sogasanganang mi kha shas la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bton/ tshes nyer bdun nyin grwa tshang la khro bo smre ba brtsegs pa'i rjes gan nga bton/ lam rim bgrod tshul gyi bshad pa dang / bye brag dgon pa'i 'grig lam lung dang sbyar nas bshad pa/ las sne ngabasgo bzhag sogs la 'char gzhi gsar bkod yod pa sogs bshad/ rjes gnang yar 'tshogs skabs gnam gshis dwangs 678

lod mod/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi'i skabs 'brug sgra dang bcas drag char babs/ rjes gnang rtsol skabs gnam dwangs shing nyi ma dang 'ja' shar/ dbo/na gnas 'dir sngar bcos bsgyur skabs 'khrug zing byung ste gsod rmasacimang bo byung stabs/ ṣ+ka'akhrug sga/ grib cakhrig gnod pa che drag pas/ yi dam 'di'i rjesa'i gnang bton pa yin/ de'i phyi nyin rang gi/ lo rgyus kyi 'phro bris/ 'di dag gi bar skabs su paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ blo bzang ye shes/ dpal ldan ye shes rna mas kyi gsung 'bum dang /mdo sde phal lhache sogs la lta klog byas shing / rgyun gyi dajige sbyor sogs la 'bad khul byas/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu (spyi lo1992zla6tshes10) la mdzod dge stag tsha dgon gyi bsu ma 'byor/ tshes bcu gcig la stag tsha dgon du 'byor/ grwa mang gis ser 'phreng dang mchod dzos sna tshogs rgya gling dang bcas bsus teji'adu khang ske nang du ja gral la zhugs rjes grwa mang la mjal kha btang / de skabs char dkar 'bab byas shing 'ja' shar/ de gong lam bar du ser drag cig babs shing nye 'khor du tho ga cig kyang babs — mod skyon ma byung / de'i phyi nyin spru la sku rnam gnyis phebs na sa bka' chos zhus/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo 1992zla6tshes17) la dus 'khor 'du khang gsar ba'i nang nas bla grwa 679

yongs la lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi dbu btsugs/ de'i nub mo mchog sprul tshang la rmi lam bzang bo zhig byung gsu ngagyi/tshes bco brgyad dang bcu dgu gnyis kyi snga dro 'jam dbyangs nag po'i rjes chog brtsams/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin rang brtsams rjes chog steng nas 'jam dbyangs nag po'i rjes gnang dang dus 'khor lugs kyi khyung khra'i rjes gnang bton zhing / rang brtsams 'jams dbyangs nag po'i rjes chog dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi yi dam sgrub skor nang gi dus 'khor lugs kyi khyung khra'e sgrub thabs/ rnam 'joms kyi sgo nas khrus bya tshul rnams dang / gung thang gsung 'jam dbyangs nag po'i cho ga spyin sreg dang bcas pa'i lung rnams bton/ tshes nyer drug nyin lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung gi mjug grub/ tshes nyer brgyad nyin sngar gyi bge bsdus khrid mtshams nas khrid de de'i phyi nyin mjug grub nas grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba'i khrid kyi 'go bzung / de'i phyi nyin khrid tshar ba byas/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gnyis nas tshes lnga bar du 'dul sdom gyi dbu nas gang 'gro zhig dpe khrid byas/ tshes lnga'i snga dro de ga'i rdzong las khungs 'gas sde len gyi gsol zas drangs/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes drug nyin rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang gi sta gon dang / lam rim 680

bsdus don gyi khrid bton/ de'i phyi nyin dbang bton pa dang rang brtsams yongs 'dzin dkon mchog bsam 'grub tshang gi sku bstod kyi lung bton zhing / de'i nyin grwa tshang la yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog bsam 'grub tshang gi gdung mchod 'tshogs su bcug ste 'gyed btang / tshes brgyad nyin 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang / tshes dgu nyin 'jigs byedi dpa' cig gi dathāng / grwa tshang lachos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang dang brkyang bskum ma'i lung / tshes bcu nyin thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang / tshes bcu gcig nyin nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang / ltung bshags/ spyi bshags/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ de ltar mkha' dbyings ma/bla mchod/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ skabs gsum pa/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ skyabs 'gro rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes bcu gnyis la gdugs dkar lho bcu bdun ma'i dbang byad grol dang bcas pa/ legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang / gdugs dkar mchog grub ma/ rgyal ba bye ba ma bzlog pa bcas/ sgrol ma'i skon rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes bco lnga la dus 'khor 'du khang nang nas dge slong bcu dgu dge tshul bdun/ rab byung gnyis bcas kyi sdom pa phog tshes bcu bdun nyin bla khos 681

zhus pa'i rtsom bris/ phyi dro rigs gsum gcig sgrub dang / rnam rgyal lha dgu/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo rnams kyi rjes gnang / tshes bco brgyad nyin sgrol dkar/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ mgon po bar chad kun sel rnams kyi rjes gnang rnams bton/ mjug tu sku gsung thugs rten gyis thog drangs te 'bul chen btegs/ mang tshogs la mjal kha btang / de'i phyi nyin mchog sprul tshang gis 'bul ba bzhag de'i nyin 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos zhus ngor bslab bya zhig brtsams/ tshes nyi shu nyin ngal gsos/ phyi dro rigs grwa sprul sku phebs te mjal 'phrad byas/ tshes nyer gcig(spyi lo1992zla7tshes20)la bla brang phyogs su chas/ lam zhor du bzhag ldom bod yig slob grwar babs/ nged cag ngo 'khor gsum la paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i rnam 'grel pod gcig re dang sgor sum brgya bcas byin/ bla brang du babs pa'i phyi nyin slob ma dge bshes rgan pa rnams rim par phebs/ nas mjal 'phrad byas/ tshes nyer lnga nyin gyi a lags rin po che'i sku gdung mchod rten dang / tshogarme chen 'du khang steng 'og kun la zhib mjal byas/ de dag gi skabs su rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / sde ba thub bstan nyi ma/ rgya —nag pa 'jam 682

ṅka byabs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum sogs pod nyi shu rtsa grangs shig blus/ bla brang dpe mdzod nas tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa'i gsung 'bum pod gcig dang / mgon po'i be bum g.yar nas 'di phyogs su ma yig re 'bri e thub kyi re ba byas/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig dang tshes gnyis la rje'i lha khang nang nas dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid bton/ tshes gsum nyin ljags byin rlabs kyi khrid bton/ tshes bzhi'i snga dro 7 rin po che la mjal du song / phyi dro dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang 'brel ba'i shes rab sgrub tshul zhig brtsams/ tshes brgyad la khyim pa gsum la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa byin/ tshes bcu bzhi la rje'i lha khang nas thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang / sgo mang rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i gsung gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi thun mong ma yin pa len tshul gyi lung gnang /tshes bcu drug la za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg dang / dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i khrid/ tshes bcu bdun la rdo rje sems dpa'i jisgorma bzlas kyi khrid/ tshes bco brgyad la rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung / tshes bcu dgu la 'jacha/ dbyangs dkar bo'i rjes gnang dang / kun mkhyen gsung gi de'i cho ga las tshogs bcas/kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i gsung gi de 'i cho ga bstod pa don zab 683

ma/ bstod pa don— lhan ma/ lam gtso rnam gsum/ gyi a lags rin po che'i gsung gi 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i bla ma'i rnal —'byor rnams kyi lung / tshes nyi shu la dga' ldan 'pho khrid bton zhing / bka' chos grolamatshams 7 rin po che sdod shag tu phebs nas sman dang lha dar nyin bde zhig gnang / tshes nyer gcig la skyabs khrid dang / thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung / tshes nyer gnyis la grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba'i khrid/ gang blo ma dang sgrol dkar bstod pa'i lung / tshes nyer gsum dang tshes nyer bzhi la gyi a lags rin po che'i gsung gi 'grel ba'i steng nas lam rim bsdus don gyi khrid/ de'i skabs mkhan po ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gsung gi dpa' cig la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa len tshul/de'i zur 'debs sgo mang rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i gsung gnyis sgrags pa'i lung / 7 a lags rin po che'i gsung gi rdo rje gsum gyi bzlas pa byed tshul gyi lung rnams bton/tsheso nyer lnga nyin snga dro sman pa yong ste bdag gi nad la bltas/ri phyi dro dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang dang / 7khong a lags rin po che'i gsung gi de'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi lung bton/ tshes nyer drug dang tshes nyer bdun gnyis la sman pa 6skyu4

yong ste bdag la gnam khab brgyab/ tshes nyer brgyad la sman bas nad la zhib 'jug byas nas sman byin/ hor blo brgyad pa'i tshes gcig(sbyi lo1992zla8tshes28)la grwa ba bdun la dge slong gi sdom pa phog tshes gnyis la lam rim bde lam gyi khrid kyi dbu bzung / tshes gsum nas tshes/ drug bar bde lam khrid/tshes bdun la rang brtsapas blo gsal 'jug ngogs kyi lung 'phro bton/ a mdo zhib 'jug khang gi don du dbyar mtsho rgyas pa zhes pa brtsams/ tshes brgyad dang tshes dgu la rang brtsams sum rtags tshig 'grel gyi lung bton/ tshes bcu dang tshes bcu gcig la bde lam gyi khrid bton/ tshes bcu bzhi nas tshes bcu drug bar spyod 'jug chen mo'i bshagalung bton/ tshes bcu bdun nas tshes nyi shu bar rang brtsams yang gsal snang mdzod kyi lung dang bshad lung sprags ma byas nas bton/ tshes nyer gnyis la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig brtsams/ phyi dro lam rim bde lam khrid/ tshes nyer gsum la lam rim bde lam khrid mjug rdzogs/ nyin bdun la bshad pa sogs rgyas pa'i lugs su byas/rang brtsams bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ de ltar mkha' dgyings ma/ chu 'dzin dkar bo ma/ mtshams sprin gzhon nu ma/ mar gad zhu ba ma/ bla mchog gsum ma rnams haṃce5

kyi lung bton/ tshes nyer lnga la dwags po snyan brgyud kyi bde mchog gi dbang bton/ rang brtsams bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i 'jam dkar dang dbyangs can ma'i bsnyen pa 'don tshul/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'don tshul/ 'jam dkar zhi ba'i spyin sregarje bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi 'jam dkar bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rnams kyi lung bton/ tshes nyer drug la dga' ldan gzhung bsrings kyi khrid dang / rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gi dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid yig las tshogs dang bcas pa'i lung bton/ mjug tu re 'dod bzhin mang tshogs la mjal kha btang / bla brang du sdod skabs zas ma 'phrod pa lta bu'i nad drag po zhig byung / rgya sman bod sman gang gis spyang phan pa ma byung / za ma la yi ga chad/de mtshungs rmi lam du mi zhig gis rta dkar bo zhig khrid 'ongs nas da 'gro zhes rta nong du bskyon pa rmis pa dang / gzhan gshin po kha shas dang 'phrad pa rmis pa sogs la brten/ sems la da tshe zad yod rgyu red bsam zhing rjes sor bla brang dgon 'dir yong e thub mi shes snyam nas bka' chos gang zhus thams cad na ba bsran bzod byas te tshang ma bton/ de mtshungs dge spyor 686

dpe ltas sogs la 'bad ci thub byas/ sdug bsngal med na nges 'byung med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar nges 'byung spu sud re skyes byung / bla brang dgon 'dir bka' chos sogs nyag phra bar 'dug pas/ bka' chos gang gi skabs su nang sems la bskor nas bshad ci thub byas/ lus khams ma bde yang bka' chos dga' rab cig 'don thub song bas/ yong don zhog song snyam du blo bde 'bol gyis song / tshes nyer brgyad nyin bla brang dgon gzhung gis bskyal nas stag tsha dgon du 'byor/ bod sman dang rgya sman kun la bstan nas sman bcos byas mod phan pa ma byung /de mthun stag tsha dgon gzhung nas zhabs brtan mang bo bsgrubs/hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bzhi nyin stag tsha dgon gzhung gis bskyal nas dmu dge'i dgon du 'byor/ nad cher ma sos pa'i dbang gis tsha bu bslab gsum rgya mtsho'i 'dod mos bzhin khos khur blangs te rang shag nas tshes brgyad nyin grwa ba bcu gcig gis sgrol dkar tshe sgrub tshar brgya dang bcu gsungs/ rdo rams pa dge bshes 'od zer bdag gi gam du phebs te sgrol dkar tshe sgrub tshar brgya gsungs yod ces dngul lor sum brgya bcas brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes bco lnga nas grwa tshang gis 'jigs byed zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rmyomyur mthod ma/ brkyang bskum ma/ bka' rdzi 687

nyan ma/ 'jigs byed dpa' cig rnams tshar stong re/ bkala'agyur zhal phyes/ de dag bsgrubs rjes nad cung zad phyir dwangartswakyi mgo tshugs/ zas la yi ga cung zad yod par gyur/ lha saskar rtsis khang gi tshogs 'du'i brda tho 'phyor/ de mtshungs khrin tu'u ru tshogs 'du yod pa'i brda tho 'byor yang dgongs pa zhus/hor bla dgu ba'i tshes brgyad nas nyin gsum la rang gi lo rgyus bris/ hor zla bcu ba'i tshes brgyad la khul srid gros kyis mngags pa'i sman pa dang / de dang mnyam du tsha bu bsod nams bkra shis yang 'byor te nyin bdun la sman dpyad byas/ gnam khab brgyab/ sman du ma byin/ cung zad phan pa 'dra ba byung / sman pa song nas nyin shas kyi rjes su nad bskyar log byung ba lta bu'i je ngan la song / spyir lo bcu grangs la sha ma zos kyang / ma shi bar du sha khrag la rol mi dgos pa zhig e byung snyam na/ gzhan dag gis sha ma zos na phung bo nyams 'gro zhes bskul ma yang yang byung yang u tshugs byas nas ma zos/ 'di skabs sman paspophung bo'i bcud nyams che bas/ sha dang bcud can gyi za ma'i rigs za dgos nan tan byas/ bcud shin tu nyams che na nad byung yang gso thabs bral zer/ nad kyis sha zar bcug nas sha za dgos byung / 'on kyang sman pa yod dus zhu ba lta bu'i nyamartswa688

shar yang phyis su zhu mi zhu skabs byung bas nad je thu la song ba 'dra// 'di'i skabs snga phyi 'di dag tu mdo phal bo che dang / po to ba'i dpe chos sogs la bltas te byang chub kyi sems rin po che la bag chags ci thebs byas/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis dang gsum nyin gnyis la lha khang gong ma'i nang nas grwa tshang yongs la sbyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtsho'i khrid dang / rang brtsams 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i rgyun 'khyer dang / sgo mang rin po che blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i gsung gi thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi len tshul dang / mkhan po rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gsung gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dpa' cig gi sgo nas dbang bzhi len tshul dang / sgo mang rin po che'i gsung gi de'i zur 'debs gnyis ka gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i lung rnams bton/tshes lnga dang drug gnyis la khro bo sme brtsegs kyi sbyin sreg brtsams/bzlas brjod dang gzhung klog tshul yang brtsams/ tshes bdun nas rgyud bla ma'i tshig 'grel rtsom pa'i dbu btsugs/ de'isnyenyin li thang bla ma bstan 'dzin bde legs mjal du phebs/ chos spyod kha shas dang smon lam kha shas kyi lung bton/ smon lam sh+lau ka gsum yod pa zhig kho'i ngor brtsams/ tshes brgyad la 689

'bar dge slob grwa'i zho krang gzhon pa shen gri 'tshams 'dri dang nad 'drir 'byor/ tshes bcu bzhi la lha khang gong ma'i nang du grwa tshang yongs kyis sgrol dkar gyi brtan bzhugs phul/ nyi shu yar mar zhig la khul srid gros khang gis mngags pa'i sman pa bstan 'dzin 'byor/ sman dpyad dang / nad la brtag dpyad byas/ srog la skyon med zer/ tshes sum cu nyin sdig sgrib 'dag pa la bsam ste rdo rje sems dpa'i nyin thang bzhengs/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la lha khang gong ma'i nang du grwa tshang yongs la bla med lugs kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i rjes gnang dang / lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan gyi khrid dang / rang rtsom bzlas brjod dang gzhung klog tshul gyi lung bton/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin nas khams lhag par mi bde bar gyur nas/ grwa tshang la yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ grwa tog gser gsum/ gzungs 'dus/ phyag rdor 'khor chen bsnyen pa/ brgya bzhi sogs bcol/ de'i nyin gdong 'go'i yar khug gi sman pa bos nas bltas/ de'i phyi dror khul srid gros khang gis mngags pa'i sman pa rnams dang / tsha bu bsod nams bkra shis yang khul bod sman khang gis nga'i ched du dgongs pa byin te mngags pa 'byor/ sman pa rnams nyin bzhi la bsdad de gnam khab brgyab/ tshes nyer gcig nyin grwa ba 690

bzhis rnam rgyal tshe sgrub gsungs te rnam rgyal gzungs rilnge tshar lngabargya dang / gzungs thung tshar khri/ tshes sum cu nyin lha khang gong ma'i nang du grwa tshang gi grwa ba mang bo zhig gis rnam rgyal stong mchod gsungs/ rab gnas chu bya lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes gcig nyin grwa tshang la 'bras chan gyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ rang lo brgyad cur son/ gzhi tshang rin po che'i gsung bkod ltar/ phyi dro grwa tshang gi las sna rnams dang rgan pa rnams phebs nas brtan bzhugs phul/ spyir bdag na nas bzung rgya bod kyi sman pa dang / mo ba kun gyis skyon med rim gyis dwangs 'gro zer/ 'on kyang dwangs rgyu med pas bdag gi bsam 5 la skabs 'gar bla mas byin rlabs bog 'don re bsam nas/ na ba legs na na bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ skabs 'gar na rgas sdug bsngal mi bzod par myur du drag thabs re e yod snyam pa'i re dogs shar/ lo snga ma'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi'i dargong mor rmi lam du gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan brjod par dka' ba rje 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho phebs te ri gnyis kyi bar gyi lung phran zhig gi lam chung zhig tu khrid nas yar song ste ri'i rtse la slebs dus nyi ma yang shar 'dug de nas mnal 691

sad 'dug nad 'di'i mjug tu dag pa'i zhing zhig tu 'gro thub pa zhig e yin snyam dga' ba zhig skyes/ hor zla dang bo'i tshes bcu gcig nyin/ zhing chen srid gros kyi tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos pas rlangs 'khor 'byor/ 'go khrid rnams kyis gtso bo tshogs 'du min sman pa ston pa gtso bo yin zer/ 'on kyang gzugs phung ha cang zhan stabs dang / gsung brtag kyang ma chud pas ma song / de'i nyin nas tshes bcu bzhi'i bar gnam khab brgyab/ tshes bco lnga nyin grwa tshang la bcol nas mgon po'i gshegs gtor bcu gsum dang mgon po'i 'phrin bcol bton/ de nas nyi ma mang bo zhig la gnam khab brgyab/tshes nyer gcig nyin sgo mang dgon gyi 'tshams zhu ba mi gnyis 'byor/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin mdzod dge'i bod sman khang dang /stag tsha dgon pa'i 'tshams zhu ba 'byor/ sman pa bstan khos sman dpyad byas/ rtsa shin tu legs zer/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi nyin dbyen skum mchod rten gyi nyi zla tog dang gdugs rim pa bcu gsum sogs rdung mkhan gyi bzo ba rnams 'byor/ tshes bdun nyin khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi kum bkyes dang sman pa sogs 'byor nas khrin tu'u ru sman bcos byed du 'gro dgos zhes bshad/ tshes brgyad nyin dgon pa'i mkhan po dge bshes haṃ9nyu

chos dar tshang la mkhan po bsko bzhag gi mdud pa btags/ tshes dgu nyin khrin tu'u ru sman bcos byed du song ba'i lam du nyi ma gnyis byas te khrin tu'u ru slebs/ zhing chen srid gros khang /zhing chen 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u/ zhing chen mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang bcas kyis brtse gzigs bla na med pa gnang ste bkod 'doms legs par byas/ zhing chen srid gzhung gi hrin krang gzhon pa tshe kho yang slebs nas nad 'dri byas te las don dang bya ba gang thad nas legs po byed pa'i khas len byas/ de'i skabs nub cig sgrol ma'i sgo nas rmi lam brtags pas las ma zad kyang bsod nams zad tshar ba'i rtags thon/phyin chad kyang bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad rgyu'i rmi lam rmis/ de nas dgon pa'i grwa ba gnyis dang / sring mo bde mchog skyid 'byor te rang dgon du 'gro dgos zhes nan tan byas te tshes nyer bdun nyin khrin tu'u nas chas te tshes nyer brgyad nyin rang dgon du 'byor/ khrin tu'u ru song shul du grwa tshang gis bder gshegs rin chen me 'od kyi stong mchod dang tshe lha rnam gsum sogs sku rim 'bor chen bsgrubs 'dug tshes nyer dgu'i nyin sngo shul dgon gyi 'tshams zhu ba grwa ba lnga 'byor/ gzhung sger gyis dngul lor 'bor chen phul te brtan bzhugs phul/ da lta zhing chen gyis 693

mngags pa'i sman pa khrin tu'u nas slebasi te sman bcos byed bzhin yod/ 'on kyang / sman pas bor zhing rim gros bzlog tu med/ /gnyen rnams gson du re bas re thag cha—da/ /rang nyid ci bya gtol med gyur pa'i tshe/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i skabs su slebs 'dug go /yang tsha dge tshul bslab gsum rgya mtsho dang / tsha bu bsod nams bkra shis gnyis rgyun du gam du bcar te nad g.yog legs par byed bzhin yod do/ /rang lo brgyad cu'i thog hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer dgur bris so/ /las kyi bzo bos bskrun pa'i khang khyim de/ /bsod nams ka bas 'degs par ma nus pas/ /lus kyi khang khyim zhig la khad par gyur/ /grogs dge ba'i bshes rnams bde mo gyis/ /phyis su yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /byang chub sems kyis rang rgyud phyug par shog / kha sked dalkodaska da sdogaska puzhi sken/ — — d+ku/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ / thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen blo bzang grags/ /bsam bzhin ngur smrig gar rol 'od dkar can/ /694

goton gyi skyabs mchog gdul bya'i rmongs mun rnams/ /rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskud la rtag tu 'dud/ /gang gi gsang gsum rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /tha ma'i cha phran chu thigs tsam 'god pa'i/ /spobs pa gang thad nas kyang ma mchis mod/ /dad pa'i chu gter 'phel ba'i zla 'od bskrun/ /de yang rang cag rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na gyirdo rje 'chang chen po rje bsam gtan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas rnam par thar ba rang gi byung ba brjod pa rang gsal ā dar sha zhes bya ba yod pas der/ rab gnas chu bya lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer dgu bar yod la/ de nas khrin tu'u nas yar phebs/ grwa tshang gi las sna mkhan po tshang sogs kha shas phebs te bskun 'dri zhus/ de rjes khong gis zhal nas phran la da nga e 'dug mi shes/ gdung bzhu sa'i mchod rten brtsig byed kyi so phag dang / gdugs rim pa bcu gsum sogs las ma gtogs gzod khyed rnams mi khom zhes gsungs/ khul srid gros kyis mngags pa'i bstan pa dang sman pa 'byor/ sngo shul dgon pa'i grwa ba lnga phebs nas 'tshams zhu dang bsnyun 'dri zhus/ rten skal du tshil len gcig dang gos dag bcas gnang / khong gis rtsom 995

bzhin pa'i rgyud bla ma'i tshig 'grel thub bstan yar rgyas rtsom 'phro byas/ rang gi byung ba brjod pa rang gsal ā dar sha yang mjug bsdus/ hor zla gnyisangapa'i tshes sum cu nyin gyi zhogs par zhal nas/ skyes bu gsum gyi dpe risagasher grags ma gtogs reb skong bas 'bri mi thub/ 'a3 tshul lam rim chen mor bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang / spyod 'jug mdo phal bo cher yod gsungs/ dbyen rlum mchod rten gyis dkar chag khyod kyis phris/ a lags rin po che'i gsung gi rje'i dkar chag ltar dang / bsngo ba phal bo che'i bsngo ba'i le'u phris/ zhes dang /khyod la sgrub thabs rin 'byung lan gnyis thob bam/ thob lags zhus pas/ khyod kyis pham lhag gis ma gos pa sogs sdom gsum nyams len gyi mthil du gyis sogs gsungs/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ pham lhag gis ma rgo/sa pa dang / sngar mtshams bsnyen sgrub sogs byas yod pas bton chog ces gsungs/ bka' ma grol bar bton na phan mi thogs ba rje mi la'i rnam thar la ltos/da lta gung thang rin po che la/ kun mkhyen rin po ches dbang bka' chos thengs re la thengs re re bzhin bka' grol ba ma gtogs/ bka' ma grol bar mi gnang ba sogs gsung gleng rusapa can mang bo gnang / gnam khab brgyab/ hor zla gsum pa'i 696

/tshes gcig (spyi lo1993zla3tshes23) nyin gyi snga dro khong gis thugs dgongs bzhin dge bshes 'jam dbyangs nyi ma sogs kyis ltung bshags kyi phyag mchod gsungs/ phyi dro'i dus tshod lnga'i steng yas mas su sku gzugs je lhod la song ste phal cher zhing la phebs rgyu red snyam pa byung / thugs bkod ltar khong gzims pa dang / mdun nas yang tsha bslab gsum rgya mtsho dang / shag mtshes shes rab rgya mtsho/ phran dang / tsha bu bsod nams bkra shis bzhis dgung re bzhin skyabs 'gro rgyas pa/ bla mchod/bstan 'bar ma/— dge ldan lugs bzang rgyas pa'i smon tshigasmon lam shis brjod bcas bton/ tshes gnyis nyin gyi phyi dro yang gzims pa dang sngar ltar nged rnams kyis/ skyabs 'gro/ bla mchod/ gsang 'dus smon lam sogs rgyun ldan du gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus tshul bar du dgung re bzhin bton/ tshes gsum nyin gyi snga dro dbyen skum mchod rten la gser zangs kyi tog dang nyi zla za ra tshags sogs la gser byugs pa legs 'grub byung nas steng du bkod pas rten 'brel legs par 'grig gsungs/ 'di skabs bslab gsum rgya mtshos kun mkhyen rnam thar btsan po ma dang / 'dul 'dzin gsung gi kun rig ṭīka chen dang / dwags po lha rje'i lam rim thar rgyan/ las 'bras 697

gsal ba'i mi long / gsang ba 'dus pa'i smon lam gyi sa bcad rmebacud ldan snye ma zhes bya ba sprul sku skal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa rnams bton te khong gis gsan/ phyi dro bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas 'tshams zhur grwa ba gnyis phebs nas 'tshams zhu byas/ rim gro la ltung bshags gsung gsungs/ tshes bzhi nyin khul srid gros kyis mngags pa'i sman pa phyir song / tshes lnga nyin 'bar khams nas rang khul gyi dmag dpon zur ba a spang dang / 'bar khams dge thon slob grwa'i zho krang gzhon pa sher gri sogs 'tshams zhu dang bsnyun 'drir 'byor/ 'di'i skabs rgyun du nyin gnyis gsum rer gnam khab brgyab pa dang /de nas nyin rer ngal gsos/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bdun nyin gsang 'dus bdag 'jug nyin dang bo'i nyin gyi zhogs par phran la lcags mkhar gyi steng tshang ma bar rta byed dgos pa a lags rin po che'i gsung ltar dang / gtor sgrub kyi lha btags rgya nag pa'i gsung dang mi mthun pas/ mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung ltar dang / mgon chos kyi dbyangs kyang sngar gyi dpar rnying ltar gyis zhes ngas de zer ba byings 'dren dam chos la shod/ces gsungs/ tshes dgu nyin kan su'u zhing chen mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang / a mdo zhib 'jug khang gi 'go khrid sna 69byi

'brug thar sogs mi sna kha shas 'byor te 'tshams zhu dang bsnyun 'dri zhus/ tshes bcu nyin gyi zhogs par yang phran la sngar gsung ltar dang / phal chen cha pod du byams pa'i le'u dang bsngo ba'i le'u yod ces sogs gsungs/ tshes bcu gcig nyin khul srid gros kyi rlangs 'kho ra dang / khul rtsom sgyur cus kyi sman pa a khu bstan 'dzin 'tshams zhu dang bsnyun 'drir phebs/ yang tshes bcu gnyis nyin gyi zhogs par phran la pham lhag gis ma gos pa dang / sdom gsum dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du byas te/dbang rjes gnang sogs bton chog ngas bka' grol ba yin/dge tshul slong sogs da dung lo 'dang med pas rjes nas bsgrub chog ces dang / 'jam dbyangs nyi ma la'ang de bzhin kha brda gyis/ zhes gsungs/ tshes bcu gsum nyin zung chu rdzong gi 'go khrid kha shas 'byor nas bsnyun 'dri zhus/ tshes bco lnga nyin dge slong mdo sde rgya mtshos zhus pas tshe rabasarjes 'dzin zhig gsungs/ de rjes phran la/ spyir rjes gnang la las rung gi bsnyen pa mi dgos kyang ngas mkha' spyod ma'i las rung btang skabs mkha' spyod ma snying la zhugs pa'i 'khrul snang byung gsungs/tshes bcu drug nyin gyi zhogs par phran la/ rjes gnang zur bka' rnams mi 'dra/ lcang skya ngag dbang chos ldan sgyu gsung gi yi dam mismo9

spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang la ltos/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung lkegi bskyed rjogs rnams dgongs pa tshang gi/ 'jigs byed bskyed rim bde/ lhun grub paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung e yod/ ces gsungs/yod lags zhus/ nga'i dper shog gu gsum mi tshang / rgya nag pa'idzhagasung la'ang yod ces sogs gsungs/ khul srid gros kyis rlangs 'khor mngags nas sman pa a khu bstan 'dzin don grub tshang bsus pa tshes bcu bdun nyin 'dir phebs/ tshes bco brgyad nyin zhib gzigs byas/ tshes bcu dgu nyin phyir mdzod dger sman len par phebs/ tshes nyer bdun nyin sman pa a khu bltan 'dzin don grub tshang tshur phebs/ tshes nyer dgu nyin phyag rtsa byudang chu rtags sogs la gzigs/ sku khrus dang sku mnye rgyas pa byas/ gnam stong nyin gzer 'gog gi sman dang lud pa mi 'ong bar byed pa'i sman sogs phul nas phyir mdzod dger phebs/hor zla gsum pa phyi ma ste shol zla yin/ — de'i tshes gcig nyin rnga ba'i sgo mang sgar gyi 'tshams zhu ba dang / a lags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs phebs/ tshes gnyis nyin gyi zhogs par khong tshos 'tshams zhu dang bskun 'dri zhus/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sku gsung thugs rten sogs phul/ tshes gsum nyin zungardzichu rdzong gi srid gros dang nang bstan mthun tshogs bsnyun 'dri la 700 —

'byor nas zhus/ tshes drug nyin grwa tshang gi mkhan po tshang sogs phebs nas bsnyun 'dri zhus/ tshes dgu nyin rnga ba rdzong gi las khungs che ba bzhi dang / rdzong rig gnas do dam cus/ rdzong bod yig slob 'bring / a mchog mtshan nyid dgon sogs kyi mi sna brgyad 'tshams zhu dang bsnyun 'dri la 'byor/ tshes bcu nyin gyi zhogs par 'tshams zhu dang bsnyan 'dri zhus/ tshes bcu gcig nyin gser zangs rdung mkhan gyi bzo ba—rnams kyisagadugs ris pha bcugyigasum dang bre/ bum pa'i sgo khyim sogs thams cad legs par phyin pas/ bzhag ste dga' dar dang rten skal sogs gnang / bugs dgongs ltar zhugs 'bul skabs dgos pa'i jo bo rje dang rgyal bzhi'i sku brnyan a khu sher grags dang lha bzo bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis bzhengs nas spyan 'bebs zhus/ tshes bcu gnyis nyin pe cin nas spung go bod brgyud mtho sdim nang bstan slob gling gi a lags 'jam po phebaspote bskun 'dri dang bzod gsol phul/ tshes bcu gsum nyin sngar nas gsung bkod spunang yod pas 'char can ltar/ dge bshes 'jam dbyangs nyi ma sogs bdun la khong gis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che mngon du mjod de/ spyir 'di'i skabs bsnyun gzhi ha cang rdzi bas/ tshig gnyis gsum gsung ba yang dka' stabs/rme 701

'gi sprertson 'grus bskyed de gdul bya'i tha ma nga tsho la 'jigs byed rbasnyen gyi khrid yig gi lung gnang / sher snying dang /zhidza khams 'bul bar zhu/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum sogs kyi dbu khong gis bskul// gsung bshad la/ 'di ni them skas dang mi 'dra bar bka' cung zad yangs pa yin/ rtsa banesgo mang blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho tshang gi nag 'gros su bkod yod pas de yin sogs zhib rgyas gsungs/ mjug tu sa gzhi ma sogs dang / da dgon 'di gzhi bsnyen gyi brgyud pa ma chade pa yin/ 'jam dbyangs nyi ma dang ta ba la bka' grol yod pa sa dris sogs gsungs/ de nas 'jog chung nang du gdan cidra ngos te mchod khang nang la phebs/ der gdung rten spyi khri gang dngo phyeltacan bzo ba rna mas kyis bzhengs zin pa der gdan drang sa yod pas/ de la zhib gzigs gnang ste nga'i rus pa spar ba gang bo 'jog sa nyan yag red gsungs/ de nas gzim khang gi g.yas phyogs kyi rab gsal du phebs nas dbyen skum mchod rten chen mo'i bre dang gdugs rim pa bcu gsum nyi zla tog bum pa'i sgo khyim sogs thams cad tshes bcu gcig nyin nas mthar phyin yod pas/ de la rgyung mthong nang nas zhib gzigayoganang /dzago 'di mthordomi thub bsam yang da mthong thub song / cha tshad lha02

rkyang 'a khrig ces gsungs/ tshes bcu bzhi nyin gso'akyi ba thigs tsam yang ma bzhespo/ yang tsha bslab gsum rgya mtshor nga la sprulgosku blu mi dgos zhes a ne bde mchog skyid la bshad yag gyis gsungs/ de'i nub mo'i tho rengs kyi dus tshod bzhi'i steng la dri la brda btang ba dang phran yang rtab rtab por sku mdun du song ba dang / yang tsha dge tshul bslab gsum rgya mtsho dang / tsha bu bsod nams bkra shis gnyis rgyun ldan sku mdun du bcar yod pas/ nged rnams kyi gding ba bti6 sa/ zhal shar phyogs su ston gsungs/ tsho gding ba'i steng nas nga tshos bskor yang gzim khang lhor 'khor yod pas da dung mi thub gsungs/ de nas nga tshos gzim khri bskor/ 'o da chog gsungs/ de nas chos snam gsung bkod ltar sngar nas sbyar yod pas tshode phul/ de nas nam langs kyin e yod gsungs/ da dung med lags zhus/ de nas phran la khyod kyis lcags sakhar dang / gtor sgrub aukyi do na bshad e yod ces nan tan du gsungs/ bdag gis byings 'dren dam chos sogs la bshad yod lags zhus/ de nas yang tsha thubaslab gsum rgya mtsho la khyod cig rerad+ngha thag bcad dang na nyis — 'dzin gyis zhes sogs gsungs/ de nas gzhan gnyis res kyis cung zad re yer/ hor zla gsum pa snyi ma sholdozla'i tshes bco lnga 703

(sgyumatha1993zla5tshis6) ste nag zla'i nya la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang sherathodo gsungs pa'i durtswachen nyin/ res gza' phudz+wa bu rgyu skar sa ri/ nam langartswakyi du0 su da lta'i dus tshod bdun dang skarom nyer lnga'i thog skyangamyir+sā thigoger cung zad gzigs/ de nas btsum pa dang mnyam du seng ge nyal ltabs kyis dga' ldan yidadaga' cho sa 'dzin du phebs pa'i tshul bltan nag bdag sogs rtag 'dzin canarams chos la bkod phyir de ltar gnang / gsung bkod ltar dbu nab phul/ de dus nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin dkar pomang bo shar phyogs su 'gro bzhin mchis/ phran song nas grwa tshang dang / ma lags gzhi tshang rin po cher khong dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i snyan gsan zhus/ phyirtswa grwa—tshang phebs te gdung mchod 'tshogs/ chab mdo dgon chen gyiro dabhā.uyon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa 'phrin las chos 'phel dang / smon lam gnyis 'byor yang rkyen dbang gis zhal mjal ma thub/ mkhan po rin po che byams pa chos grags tshang dang / rgya nag pa tshang / dus 'khor tshang /cirdzong nang sbrul sku sogs spyi sger gyis sku gsung thugs rten dang tsho dngul lor mang bo phul/ de'i nyin nas gdung khang sogs bzhengs pa'i dbu bzung / tshes bcu drug nyin rdo rams pa 'od 704 —

ze ra tshadz+wagi gtsos grwa ba bcus rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas mchog khrus mthod/ —phyi dro grwa tshang gis mngags pa'i grwa ba bcu phrag kha shas kyis danong re bzhin dgongs rdzogs kyi bar rgyan 'jug — ri gsungs/ khul srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bstan 'dzin dang /'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi pu'u krang gzhon pa tshe ring khul nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi mi sna bcas 'artsor te dngos skyes khyer nas mya ngan zhus/ gshegs nas zhag gnyis kyi bar la sku gdung gi drod ma yal zhes bslab gsum rgya mtshos —gsungs/ bshol zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phye/sa nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par byas te/ bdag 'jug gsungs/ khul grid gros kyi skor gnyis pa dang / khul rtsom sgyur cus kyi a khu bstan 'dzin sogs phebs te/ gdung bzhu dus mkho ba'i rdzas dad bzang drug mya ngan zhu rten sogs phul/ stag tsha chos bzang gling gi dgo na gzhungad+ngha dang nang chen gyi mi sna 'byor te dngos skyes sogs phul nas mya ngan zhus/ tshes bco brgyad nyin 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum —ma'i bdag 'jug gsudas/ bstan 'dzin kru'u zhi sogs phyir 'bar khams su phebs nas khul gyi sa char mya ngan tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i gra sgrig byas/ tshes 5cu dgyu nyin ma cig khros ma nag mo'i 705

bdag 'jug gsungs/ tshis nyi shu nyin kun rig gi bdag 'jug gsungs/ bla brang dgon gzhung gi sman pa'i khri zur dge bshes 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho tshang sogs phebs/ dngos skyes dang gdung mchod 'tshogs/ tshes nyer gcig nyin cimi 'khrugs pa dgu'i bdag 'jug gsungs/ khang dmar e waṃ bde ldan gling gi grwa ba gnyis 'byor te mya ngan zhu rten phul/ tshes nyer gnyis nyin mchog khrus dang gdung mchod kyi 'don pa mdzod rtsa sogs gsungs/ — 'bar khams su rnga khulo gyis mya ngan tshogs 'du rgyas pa 'tshogs/ 'dir zung chu rdzong gi las khungs che ba bzhi dang /khrims khang / bod yig slob 'bring sogs kyis dngos skyes phul te mya ngan zhus/ tshes nyer gsum nyin mchog khrus dang gdung mchod kyi 'don pa sogs gsungs/ tshes nyer bzhi nyin yang tsha bslab gsum rgya mtsho dang / thugs bkod ltar a khu sher grags dang / phran rnams kyis gdung las byas/ gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i sku gdung rin po che ha cang mnyen po zhig mchis/ de nas a lags gzhi tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po che sogs grwa tshang dang thams cad kyis gdung mjal byas/ tshes nyer lnga nyin yang gdung mjal byas/ bshol zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer drug nyin nam langs pa dang gaṇ+ḍi mchod rol mchod rdzas sogs 706

kyis mdun bsus te sku gdung rin po chi zhugs 'bul sa'i ṅgechod rtenagyi bum par gdan drangs/ mkhan po las thog pa skal bzang tshul khrims tshang sogs grwa tshang gis rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgo nas sku sa/dung rin po che zhugs la phul/de nas dgongs rdzogs kyi bar bla mchod dang chos spyod rgyan 'jug sogs ma chag par gsungs/ rnam 'grel rtsa ba dang / 'du la ba mdo rtsa ba sogs gsungs/ —hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes pazhi nyin bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du tshos/sa chen la grwa ba re re'i phyag tu sgor lnga re dang / thos bsam gling gi grwa ba re re'i phyag tu sgor bcu re phul/ de mtshungs dgon sde du ma la 'gyed phul/ tshes bcu bdun nyin sngo shul dgon gyi grwa ba gnyis dgongs rdzogs la 'byor/ tshes nyer gnyis nas nyin bdun la gzungs 'jug dang 'dzam dkar gter sgrub sogs bsgrubs/ hor sgro lnga ba'i tshes bzhi nyin dgongs rdzogs su gdung mchod rgyas pa 'tshogs/ tshes brgyad nyin sku gdung mchod rten la gzungs 'jug phul te rab gnas byas so/ / dasnyen sgyen naskyod tain skozhedaska puzhi sken/da lta bzheng bzhin pa'i dbyen thum mchod rten ni/ sngar 707

cirtses raṅgeṅgel preco brgyad pa la khe tshang 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub rgya mtshos bzhengs pa yin/ de rjes(spyi lo1935lor) mer bsregs/ de rjes thal dge bshes blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang bos zhig gsos mdzad/ bcos bsgyur rjes kyi spyi lo1963lor sngar1956lo'i zing 'khrug skabs bcings 'grol dmag mi 'das po rnams kyi dur sa byas/ 1970lor chos ru zhes pa'i nang du dur sa spos/ de'i rkyen gyis rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs ma bshig 1981lor dgon pa 'tshogs pa'i 'du khang byas/ sngar bcos bsgyur byas phyin bdag ma byas stabs/ 'thor zhig tu 'gro bzhin mchis/ de rtsa ba nas gsar bzhengs byed rgyu'i thugs bkod gnang / skyes bdag zhes pa lcags lug lo'i hor zla dang bo'i tshes nyer bzhi nyin (spyi lo1991) de'i nang du sa bdag lto 'phyes thig gdab/ ar chog gi snyan gsan phul/de'i phyi nyin ar chog byas/ de nas rim bzhin bshig ste gzhi nas gsar bzhengs byas/ mchod rten dngos kyi gdong chen gyi rgya khyon la smis gru bzhi ma 196 yod/ mtho tshad la smis18 333 yod/ de la rtseg rim pa gsum yin/ rtseg 'og ma la smis4 333 yod/ rtseg bar sa la smis3 666yod/ rtseg steng ma la smis3 yod/ bum pa'i 'gos sam rgya 708

phibs la smis 2 yod/ de nas bre stan/ bre/ gdugs 'degs/gdugs rim pa bcu gsum/ thugs rje mdo gzungs/ za ra tsharīgs/ gdugs/ char kheb/ nyi zla tog rnams la smis 5 333yod cing bre nas tog gi bar dang / bum pa'i sgo khyim gyi mtho tshad smis 3 666 yod/ de rnams gser zangs las grub pas gser srang so gnyis lhag song / rtseg 'og ma gdong chen dang /rtseg bar ma bang rim yin/ dbyen skum mchod rten la bang rim bzhi dang / bang rim rnams zur brgyad yin/ rtseg steng ma bum pa yin/ mchod rten che ba de la gyang ra yod/ de'i rgya khyon la smis gru bzhi300yod/ gyang ra'i nang logs nas phyogs rer mchod rten cha brgyad re/ khyon mchod rten so gnyis/ mchod rten re'i sa 'dzin la rgyar smis1 40dang mtho tshad smis2 20yod/de rnams sa 'dzin nas thugs rje mdo gzungs bar ar 'dam las grub cing / gdugs dang char kheb/ nyi zla tog rnams shing las byas/ za ra tshags zangs yin/ de rnams kyi nang tshogs bdag gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor/ gzungs 'jug rgyas pa tshar re/ rje sku/ khong rin po che'i gdung tsha'i tsha tsha dang / mi 'khrugs pa'i sku/ tshe lha rnam gsum sogs gang mang gis gtaca/sa/mchod rten cha brgyad kyi dang bo sku bltams pa'i mchod rten ni/79ri

bang rim rlum po bzhi ba/ pad mas spras pa/ gnyis pa byang chub mchod rten ni/ bang rim bzhi ba gru bzhi/ gsum pa bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten ni/ bang rim bzhi ba gru bzhi sgo brgya dang brgyad yod pa/ bzhi ba cho 'phrul mchod rten ni/ bang riyobazhi ba gru bzhi glo 'bur yod pa/ glo 'bur ni bang rim re'i sum cha gcig phyir 'bur ba/ lnga ba lha bab mchod rten ni/ bang rim bzhi ba gru bzhi glo 'bur yod pa/ glo 'bur gyi dbus su them skas gsum rim gyis dbus ma'i them pa cung zad mtho ba/ drug pa dbyen skum mchod rten ni/ bang rim bzhi ba bang rim rnams zur brgyad pa/ bdun pa sku tshe brtan pa'am rnam rgyal mchod rten ni/ bang rim skum po gsum pa/ brgyad pa myang 'das mchod rten ni/ skum po bang rim med pa dril bu'i khog pa'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /dbus kyi mchod rten gyi rtseg 'og ma'i dbus su rje btsun byams mgon mtho tshad smris 5 666yod/ de'i g.yas su sa'i snying bo dang g.yon du 'jam pa'i dbyangs gnyis smis2re/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad seng khri bcas smis 2re/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal bo sogs bzhi la khri bcas smis1 50re/ de nas spyan ma nas 'beb pa'i bar gyi lha so gnyis po la pad 'dab bcas mtho tshad smis 1 re/ rtseg bar ma la 'od dpag 710

mid rma byas btegs pa'i khri bcas smis 2ri/ g.yas su spyan ras/gzigs dang g.yon du phyag na rdo rje gnyis smis1re/ de'i mtha' skor la 'od dpag med stong sku sdug dgos/ rtseg steng ma ste bum pa'i nang la rje tsong kha ba seng khri bcas smis2 333re/ rgyal tshab rje dang mkhas grub rje gnyis la seng khri bcas smis 1 60re/ rje tsha kho ba mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad rnams la mtho tshad smis 1 20 tsam yod snyam ste da lta bzheng bzhin lags/ byams pa la gzungs 'jug phul zin pas/ gzungs 'jug rgyas pa tshar nyer gcig dmigs brtse ma dang / gzungs chen sde lnga/ a ra pa tsa/ yig brgya rnams shin tu mang ngo / /seng khri'i nang tshogs bdag dang 'dzam dkar gter sgrub dang / mkhas grub rje dang paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan lugs kyi gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor rgyas pa/ rje sku mang bo dang / 'jigs byed kyi sku sogs bris 'bur mang bo dang bla brang bkra shis 'a khyil nas gnang ba'i kun mkhyen rin po che'i 'dra sku thugs kar gzhug khong gi gdung tsha las bzhengs pa'i rje sku dang / mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe lha rnam gsum dang / tsha tsha sogs gzhung nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar dbu dang sku'i stod smad bar gsum du phul/ yum rgyas pa — 711

'bum tshor gsum dang / brgyad stong ba sogs bzang drug dang ji bzang sogs kyis byur bur gtams so/ /rtseg 'og mare byams pa gtso 'khor gsum/ kun rig rtsa lha so bdun te lha bzhirtsebacu /rtseg bar ma la 'od dpag med gtso 'khoracogasum/ tsho bum mere rje yab sras gsum dang / tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa/ 'dul 'dzin/ 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad de bcu gsum bcas khyon sku 'dra nga drug po lha shing shug pas bzos dang bzo bzhin pa lags shing / sna tshogs bzo bo'am bi shwa karma dang mi gnyis pa rgya nag po'i yul las kre cang gi sor mo'i 'phrul ldan rnam pa'i sgyu 'phrul las byung ba'o/ /de ltar rdo bzo shing bzo gser zangs bzo galha bzo rnamasakyi las gla la sogs rags rtsis sgor khri tsho so bzhi song zin to/ /sgor mo'i 'dang song na steng 'og bar gsum la gser tshon byug rgyu dang / gyang ra phyi'i mtha' skor la 'khor khang bzheng rgyu sogs thugs bkod gnang yod/ legs byas tshogs gnyis gangs kyi ri las 'ongs pa'i rnam par thar ba ma dros klung chen las/ /tha ma'i cha phran chu thigs tsam zhig bkod pa dad pa'i chu gter 'phel ba'i zla 'od 'di/ /bskrun pa'i dge bas bdag sogs mar gyur sems can thams cad thar ba'i khang bzang bgrod pa'i phyir/ /them skas dang bo 712

theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes kyis dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni las kyi sde mo ba rnams kyis kha skong zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba ltar/ phran la'ang gang thad nas 'os med kyang yang tsha bslab gsum rgya mtsho'i zin bris la 'phri snon cung zad byas te rab hoganas shing khyi lo'i hor zla dgu ba'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i (spyi lo1994zla10tshes27)bdud rtsi thun mtshams su slob 'bangs tha shal ba shes rab rgya mtshos bris pa'o// //

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ lcags byams/mdun shog mdzes ris/ rin su'u zhan/ mdun shog gzigs byang / grags pa/par sgrig 'char 'god/ la ha'e yun/༄tsho/ /rdzedamya dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum pod dang bo bzhugs so/ /rjo mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/(zi ling grong khyer bun rin lam sgo rtags ang10)mtsho sngon zhing zhin hwa dpe khang gis bkram/ mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang gis dpar / deb tshad/ ho smis850྾ 1168 1(32 dpar shog 22 75 yig grangs khri 361997lo'i zla4bar par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1997lolizla4bar par thengs dang po dpar/dpar grangs/ 0 001da 2 0001sdu2glu 7da 5420da 0623—1(2 9ri sta / deb spus legs/ sgor28 00zug thapa chag 11dab dkyus ma/ ra23 00
